identity.description: Hurry, my friend, move with haste $bIn order for our rich lager to taste $bMore like beer and less like stew, $bHops are needed to make the brew.

Objectives.text: 给葛瑞姆·雷酒带去5捆蛇麻草以完成他的特酿。
Objectives.english: Bring Grimbooze Thunderbrew 5 hops to complete his special brew.

Description.text: 快点，朋友，动作要快$b要酿更多的酒来卖$b有人要酒呀没人要菜 $b一捆蛇麻草，就够酿酒来
Description.english: Hurry, my friend, move with haste $bIn order for our rich lager to taste $bMore like beer and less like stew, $bHops are needed to make the brew.

identity.title: Return to Verner
identity.objectives: Return to Verner Osgood at Lakeshire in Redridge.  Give him the Crate of Horseshoes.
identity.description: Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...$B$BHere they are, all boxed up and ready to go!  Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!

Objectives.text: 回去找赤脊山湖畔镇的弗纳·奥斯古，把铁匠阿古斯的一箱马掌交给他。
Objectives.english: Return to Verner Osgood at Lakeshire in Redridge.  Give him the Crate of Horseshoes.

Description.text: 好的，我会给他送去50套马掌……$B$B就是这些，你看，全部都打包好了，随时可以出发！告诉弗纳，我很高兴和他做生意，哦，对了，提醒他看清楚箱子上的标签！
Description.english: Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...$B$BHere they are, all boxed up and ready to go!  Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!

identity.title: Messenger to Stormwind
identity.objectives: Magistrate Solomon has given you a report which must be delivered to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind.  The judge wants you to return to him as soon as the delivery has been made.
identity.description: These are trying times, $c.  The township is under constant siege.  Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat.  The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance.  Get this report to General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind immediately.  Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad. $b$bNow make haste!

Objectives.text: 所罗门镇长要求你给暴风城的马库斯·乔纳森将军送一封信，并且在完成任务之后尽快回报。
Objectives.english: Magistrate Solomon has given you a report which must be delivered to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind.  The judge wants you to return to him as soon as the delivery has been made.

Description.text: 这真是段难熬的日子呀，$c。兽人的攻势没完没了，如果援军还不来的话，湖畔镇就要保不住了！我现在委托给你的这封信是非常重要的。立刻将这份报告送给暴风城的马库斯·乔纳森将军。你把信送到了那边之后，就马上带着那边回复的消息回来，无论是好消息还是坏消息，我都要尽快知道。$b$b现在就出发吧，快去快回！
Description.english: These are trying times, $c.  The township is under constant siege.  Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat.  The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance.  Get this report to General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind immediately.  Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad. $b$bNow make haste!

identity.title: Messenger to Stormwind
identity.objectives: Take General Marcus Jonathan's letter of response to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
identity.description: While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon. $b$bDismissed, $c!

Objectives.text: 将暴风城的马库斯·乔纳森将军的回信带给湖畔镇的所罗门镇长。
Objectives.english: Take General Marcus Jonathan's letter of response to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

Description.text: 在我等待着国王陛下的回应时，希望你能把这封信交给所罗门镇长。$b$b快去吧，$c！
Description.english: While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon. $b$bDismissed, $c!

identity.title: Underbelly Scales
identity.objectives: Gather 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales from Black Dragon Whelps, and bring them to Verner Osgood in Redridge.
identity.description: I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire.  If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.$B$BBlack dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander.  You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.

Objectives.text: 从黑龙雏龙身上收集6片雏龙的腹鳞，把它们交给赤脊山的弗纳·奥斯古。
Objectives.english: Gather 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales from Black Dragon Whelps, and bring them to Verner Osgood in Redridge.

Description.text: 我需要一些黑龙雏龙腹部的鳞片来支付从阿古斯那里买马掌的钱。如果你能帮我搞到6块鳞片的话，在付给阿古斯一些以后……我还能用剩下的给你做点好装备。$B$B黑龙雏龙经常在湖畔镇南方游荡，猎杀它们的时候要多加小心。
Description.english: I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire.  If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.$B$BBlack dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander.  You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.

identity.title: A Baying of Gnolls
identity.objectives: Kill 10 Redridge Brutes and 8 Redridge Mystics, then return to Verner Osgood.
identity.description: As if the attacking orcs weren't enough!  Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...$B$BIf you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.

Objectives.text: 杀掉10只赤脊山蛮兵和8只赤脊山秘法师，然后向弗纳·奥斯古复命。
Objectives.english: Kill 10 Redridge Brutes and 8 Redridge Mystics, then return to Verner Osgood.

Description.text: 似乎有这些整天攻城的兽人还不够乱！我发现最近老有一些混蛋豺狼人鬼鬼祟祟地沿着山脊在我的马场北面游荡，而且还偷我的马……$B$B如果你能把这些豺狼人都干掉的话，我，还有我的马都会感谢你的。
Description.english: As if the attacking orcs weren't enough!  Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...$B$BIf you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.

identity.title: The Lost Tools
identity.objectives: Foreman Oslow of Lakeshire wants you to retrieve his toolbox from the bottom of Lake Everstill.
identity.description: I could really use a hand here, $n.  With the town under siege, it's been hard to get supplies.  My tools were being delivered from Goldshire by wagon but the bridge was blown out.  We put the tools in a boat but the orcs hit it with a catapult.  Just my luck, my toolbox sank right to the bottom of the lake.$b$bRetrieve my toolbox, $n, and I'll make it worth your while.

Objectives.text: 湖畔镇的工头奥斯洛希望你帮他找回沉入止水湖底的工具箱。
Objectives.english: Foreman Oslow of Lakeshire wants you to retrieve his toolbox from the bottom of Lake Everstill.

Description.text: 我本来可以在这儿大干一场的, $n。可是，我的工具还没到货，由于镇子被包围了，我们很难得到外面来的补给。我本来托人从闪金镇把工具用马车运过来，可是桥被砸断了，他们只好改用船运，结果那船又被兽人的投石车给打沉了。不过，算是不幸中的万幸吧，我的工具箱没坏，它只是沉进了湖底。$b$b帮我把工具箱找回来吧，$n，我会付给你不错的酬劳的。
Description.english: I could really use a hand here, $n.  With the town under siege, it's been hard to get supplies.  My tools were being delivered from Goldshire by wagon but the bridge was blown out.  We put the tools in a boat but the orcs hit it with a catapult.  Just my luck, my toolbox sank right to the bottom of the lake.$b$bRetrieve my toolbox, $n, and I'll make it worth your while.

identity.title: Selling Fish
identity.objectives: Bring 10 Spotted Sunfish to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
identity.description: Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish.  There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!$B$BBring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them.  If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!

Objectives.text: 给湖畔镇的码头管理员巴伦带去10条斑点太阳鱼。
Objectives.english: Bring 10 Spotted Sunfish to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.

Description.text: 止水湖的斑点太阳鱼是天下闻名的美味。它们总是供不应求……可我这里的存货已经不够了！$B$B给我带回10条鱼来，我会好好酬谢你的。哦，如果你不会捕鱼的话……可以从鱼人那里抢来！
Description.english: Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish.  There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!$B$BBring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them.  If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!

identity.title: A Free Lunch
identity.objectives: Bring Parker's lunch to Guard Parker.  He patrols the road leading to Darkshire.
identity.description: Can you do me a favor?  I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.$B$BSo if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch!  Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.

Objectives.text: 将卫兵帕克的午餐带给他，他就在通向夜色镇的路上巡逻。
Objectives.english: Bring Parker's lunch to Guard Parker.  He patrols the road leading to Darkshire.

Description.text: 你能帮我一个小忙吗？我给卫兵帕克准备好了午饭，可他正在值勤……他是一个又高又壮的暴风城卫兵。他在外面是能自己保护自己的，可我们这样的寻常市民可不行，所以我没法去给他送饭……$B$B所以呢，如果你能帮我把他的午餐带给他的话，我也会给你提供一份免费的午餐！帕克就在通往暮色森林的路上巡逻。
Description.english: Can you do me a favor?  I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.$B$BSo if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch!  Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.

identity.title: Visit the Herbalist
identity.objectives: Speak with the Redridge Herbalist, Martie Jainrose.
identity.description: Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me?  You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.$B$BBut when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...

Objectives.text: 找到草药师玛蒂·詹罗斯，和她谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with the Redridge Herbalist, Martie Jainrose.

Description.text: 你回到达希那边的时候，能替我捎几朵花给她吗？你可以在湖畔镇西边的草药店里买到花。$B$B不过，你去买花的时候……千万别告诉药草师玛蒂这花是谁买的，也别说是要送给谁的……
Description.english: Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me?  You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.$B$BBut when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...

identity.title: Delivering Daffodils
identity.objectives: Give Darcy the Daffodil Bouquet.
identity.description: Here is your bouquet.  I chose Daffodils for you.  They're my favorite!

Objectives.text: 将水仙花送给达希。
Objectives.english: Give Darcy the Daffodil Bouquet.

Description.text: 这是你要的花。我为你选了水仙，这是我最喜欢的花儿！
Description.english: Here is your bouquet.  I chose Daffodils for you.  They're my favorite!

identity.title: Ghoulish Effigy
identity.objectives: Gather 7 Ghoul Ribs and bring them to Abercrombie at his shack.
identity.description: I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me!  In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!$B$BI want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls.  To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs.  You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.$B$BGet the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.

Objectives.text: 收集7个食尸鬼的肋骨，然后把它们交给亚伯克隆比。
Objectives.english: Gather 7 Ghoul Ribs and bring them to Abercrombie at his shack.

Description.text: 我住得离镇子太远了，根本得不到保护。那些食尸鬼和行尸走肉还没有把我吃掉简直是个奇迹！其实昨天还有一群噬骨者来敲击我房子四周的墙！$B$B我得做个假人，一个用来吓唬食尸鬼的“稻草人”。我需要食尸鬼的肋骨来制作这个假人。你可以从食腐者、噬骨者、食脑者、腐烂者和瘟疫食尸鬼身上拿到这东西。$B$B给我带足够的肋骨来，我就会给你一些奖赏。
Description.english: I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me!  In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!$B$BI want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls.  To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs.  You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.$B$BGet the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.

identity.title: Ogre Thieves
identity.objectives: Return Abercrombie's Crate to Abercrombie.
identity.description: A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me!  I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.$B$BAfter they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood.  I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.$B$BPlease, $n, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.

Objectives.text: 把亚伯克隆比的箱子拿回来交给他。
Objectives.english: Return Abercrombie's Crate to Abercrombie.

Description.text: 几个星期前，我离开家去远处采草药，有一群食人魔袭击了我！我落荒而逃的时候丢了一箱工具和草药。$B$B这些食人魔在把我赶跑之后大摇大摆地回到了暮色森林南边的食人魔山上，我的箱子肯定就在那一带。$B$B请帮帮我吧，$n，我很需要这个箱子，请你一定要帮我拿回来。
Description.english: A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me!  I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.$B$BAfter they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood.  I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.$B$BPlease, $n, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.

identity.title: The Defias Brotherhood
identity.objectives: Take Wiley's Note to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
identity.description: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons.  Perhaps that was a slip of tongue.  Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons?  Only one man would know for sure:  Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.

Objectives.text: 将威利的便笺交给暴风城的马迪亚斯·肖尔。
Objectives.english: Take Wiley's Note to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

Description.text: 我现在很想知道威利所提到的“石匠”是个什么意思，或许这只是一个口误？石匠公会跟迪菲亚真的有联系吗？或许暴风城军情七处的首领马迪亚斯·肖尔会知道真相。把威利的便笺拿给他，看看他对这个越来越大的谜团有什么想法吧。他就在旧城区的兵营里。
Description.english: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons.  Perhaps that was a slip of tongue.  Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons?  Only one man would know for sure:  Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.

identity.title: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
identity.objectives: Find Captain Sanders' footlocker and search it for the next clue.
identity.description: If ye be readin' this, it means that Ol' Captain Sanders is in a watery grave.  So my treasure is yours now, ye jest need to follow the clues. $b$bFirst ye need to find me footlocker.  It's probably half-buried in sand by now, along the Western Coast of Westfall near the shipwreck.  There be lots of shipwrecks but only one rusty anchor on the coast.  Find that anchor and you'll find me locker!  Look in there for the next clue.

Objectives.text: 找到杉德尔船长的手提箱，在箱子中寻找下一条线索。
Objectives.english: Find Captain Sanders' footlocker and search it for the next clue.

Description.text: 如果你读到这封信的话，那就意味着我，杉德尔船长，已经长眠在深深的水底了。所以，只要你按我的提示去做，我的宝藏就是你的了。$b$b首先你要找到一只小提箱，它应该就在西部荒野西海岸的某处船只残骸旁，如今八成已经快被沙子埋起来了。海岸边有许多处船只的残骸，但只有一只沉船旁有个锈掉的锚。箱子就在锚的旁边！在箱子里面，你可以找到下一条线索。
Description.english: If ye be readin' this, it means that Ol' Captain Sanders is in a watery grave.  So my treasure is yours now, ye jest need to follow the clues. $b$bFirst ye need to find me footlocker.  It's probably half-buried in sand by now, along the Western Coast of Westfall near the shipwreck.  There be lots of shipwrecks but only one rusty anchor on the coast.  Find that anchor and you'll find me locker!  Look in there for the next clue.

identity.title: <NYI> <TXT> Stormwind Commendation
identity.objectives: General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind will accept a commendation from Elwynn Forest.  Bringing him such a document will reward you with a choice of armor.
identity.description: If you earn a commendation from one of our Marshals, then bring it to me.  It will be good for one of our Lion Emblem gloves.

Objectives.text: 将艾尔文森林中某个治安官颁给你的奖状交给暴风城的马库斯·乔纳森将军，就可以在他那里挑选一件防具。
Objectives.english: General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind will accept a commendation from Elwynn Forest.  Bringing him such a document will reward you with a choice of armor.

Description.text: 如果你从某个治安官那里得到了一张奖状，就把它带给我。它会给你带来荣耀和不错的奖励。
Description.english: If you earn a commendation from one of our Marshals, then bring it to me.  It will be good for one of our Lion Emblem gloves.

CompletionLog.text: 去暴风城找英雄谷的马库斯·乔纳森将军。
CompletionLog.english: Return to General Marcus Jonathan at Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City.

identity.title: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
identity.objectives: Find the old barrel near the ruined chimney and search it for your next clue.
identity.description: The clue to the treasure reads: Good work, matey!  Now ye need to head due east.  East up the bluffs, east to the road.  Look for the ol' chimney ruins near the side of the road.  There you'll find an old barrel with your next clue.

Objectives.text: 找到废弃烟囱旁的老木桶，在桶里寻找下一条线索。
Objectives.english: Find the old barrel near the ruined chimney and search it for your next clue.

Description.text: 你开始读小条上的字：干得好，哥们！现在你可以开始向东走，到悬崖边的路旁好好找找，看有没有一处破烟囱，你可以在那旁边的木桶中找到下一条线索。
Description.english: The clue to the treasure reads: Good work, matey!  Now ye need to head due east.  East up the bluffs, east to the road.  Look for the ol' chimney ruins near the side of the road.  There you'll find an old barrel with your next clue.

identity.title: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
identity.objectives: Search the empty jug next to the windmill for the next clue.
identity.description: Searching through the barrel you discover another piece of parchment.  This one reads:  Now from this here barrel, face ye North.  Straight as the crow flies, keep ye walkin' till you see the empty jug next to the lone windmill on the sea bluffs.  If ye poke around that jug, ye just might find what you're lookin' for.

Objectives.text: 在风车旁的一个空水罐里寻找下一条线索。
Objectives.english: Search the empty jug next to the windmill for the next clue.

Description.text: 仔细搜索了木桶了之后，你发现了一小片羊皮纸。上面写着：现在，从桶这里转向北，像乌鸦飞翔一般绝不回头，一直走到你看见了海边悬崖上的风车为止。找到那风车旁的一个空水罐。仔细检查那个水罐，你就可以找到你要找的东西了。
Description.english: Searching through the barrel you discover another piece of parchment.  This one reads:  Now from this here barrel, face ye North.  Straight as the crow flies, keep ye walkin' till you see the empty jug next to the lone windmill on the sea bluffs.  If ye poke around that jug, ye just might find what you're lookin' for.

identity.title: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
identity.objectives: Locate Captain Sanders' chest and open it for your reward.
identity.description: Sure enough, deep within the Old Jug there is another clue to Sanders' treasure.  The ink has run in some places and the paper smells like whiskey but you can make out some of the text:  Now that ye found me ol' whiskey jug, you're almost to the treasure!  Just face West from the bottle and walk down to the shore.  Once ye get to the water, keep going!  Swim straight west till you find the island with me treasure chest!

Objectives.text: 找到杉德尔船长的箱子并打开它，取得你的奖励。
Objectives.english: Locate Captain Sanders' chest and open it for your reward.

Description.text: 显然，在这只旧罐子中藏着另一条有关杉德尔的宝藏的线索。纸上有几处墨水已经化开变得模糊不清，而且泛着一股威士忌的味道，不过你还是能从中辨认出这样的字迹：看来你找到我的威士忌罐子了，你离我的财宝已经很近啦！只要向西走到海边，然后一直向西游，你就可以游到放着小宝箱的岛上啦！
Description.english: Sure enough, deep within the Old Jug there is another clue to Sanders' treasure.  The ink has run in some places and the paper smells like whiskey but you can make out some of the text:  Now that ye found me ol' whiskey jug, you're almost to the treasure!  Just face West from the bottle and walk down to the shore.  Once ye get to the water, keep going!  Swim straight west till you find the island with me treasure chest!

identity.title: The Defias Brotherhood
identity.objectives: Take Shaw's report to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.
identity.description: The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef.  VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War.  Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete.  That just might explain a thing or two.$b$bI have written a more detailed account for your Master in Westfall.  Take this to him at once!

Objectives.text: 将肖尔的报告交给西部荒野的格里安·斯托曼。
Objectives.english: Take Shaw's report to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.

Description.text: 过去的石匠公会是由一个名叫艾德温·范克里夫的人运营着的。第一次兽人战争结束后，范克里夫承接下了在兽人们留下的废墟上重建暴风城的重任。很显然，范克里夫对国王陛下在重建工程完成之后给予他们的待遇非常不满意。总之，解释这一大堆具体的事情要花些时间。$b$b我这里有一份详细的说明，让你拿到西部荒野去交给你的雇主。你得马上把这个给他带去！
Description.english: The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef.  VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War.  Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete.  That just might explain a thing or two.$b$bI have written a more detailed account for your Master in Westfall.  Take this to him at once!

identity.title: The Defias Brotherhood
identity.objectives: Track down the Defias Messenger in Westfall and bring his message to Stoutmantle.
identity.description: We need to discover the location of the Defias hideout.  $n, my scout reports that a Defias Messenger has been seen on the roads between Moonbrook, the Gold Coast Quarry and the Jangolode Mine.  I want you to capture him.  If he resists, kill him and bring me whatever he is carrying.

Objectives.text: 追捕西部荒野的迪菲亚信使，并将他身上携带着的信件交给斯托曼。
Objectives.english: Track down the Defias Messenger in Westfall and bring his message to Stoutmantle.

Description.text: 我们必须得找到迪菲亚兄弟会藏身的地方。$n，我的探子报告说，迪菲亚帮的信使们经常出现在月溪镇、金海岸矿洞和詹戈洛德矿洞之间的路上。我希望你能抓住一个信使，要是他试图反抗，就干脆把他干掉，然后把他身上所有的东西带回来。
Description.english: We need to discover the location of the Defias hideout.  $n, my scout reports that a Defias Messenger has been seen on the roads between Moonbrook, the Gold Coast Quarry and the Jangolode Mine.  I want you to capture him.  If he resists, kill him and bring me whatever he is carrying.

identity.title: Messenger to Westfall
identity.objectives: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take his written plea to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.
identity.description: Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army.  They should have been here in force by now.  Time is a luxury we don't have, however.  I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help.  I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.$b$bTake this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle.  Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.

Objectives.text: 所罗门镇长要求你给西部荒野的格里安·斯托曼送一封信。
Objectives.english: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take his written plea to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.

Description.text: 暴风城的军队似乎遇到了些麻烦事，他们早就该到这里增援了，但直到现在还连个人影都没有。我们没多少时间可供浪费了！我不能再这样坐视人民继续无谓地牺牲而不去要求更多的增援。我听说西部荒野组建了一支民兵部队。$b$b把这封信带给他们的领袖格里安·斯托曼。或许斯托曼的人在国王陛下的部队到达之前能来帮忙抵挡上一阵。
Description.english: Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army.  They should have been here in force by now.  Time is a luxury we don't have, however.  I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help.  I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.$b$bTake this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle.  Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.

identity.title: Messenger to Westfall
identity.objectives: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Gryan Stoutmantle's response.
identity.description: Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read.  But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia.  If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.$b$bTake this response to your master in Redridge, $c.  And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.

Objectives.text: 将格里安·斯托曼的回信带给所罗门镇长。
Objectives.english: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Gryan Stoutmantle's response.

Description.text: 所罗门镇长的信让我感到心痛。但显然他并不知道西部荒野的战事也很吃紧——或者他知道，但不得不抱着一丝希望来寻求我们的帮助。如果不是暴风城对西部荒野的人民不闻不问的话，我们也不会需要建立民兵组织的。$b$b将这封回信带给你在赤脊山的主人吧，$c。请转告他，我的心情也因为那么多勇士的牺牲而变得十分沉重。
Description.english: Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read.  But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia.  If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.$b$bTake this response to your master in Redridge, $c.  And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.

identity.title: Messenger to Darkshire
identity.objectives: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take a letter to Lord Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
identity.description: I require your assistance once again.  I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense.  It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly.  You must exercise extreme caution.  Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of Duskwood.  Do not stray from the roads.

Objectives.text: 所罗门镇长要求你给夜色镇的艾尔罗·埃伯洛克公爵送一封信。
Objectives.english: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take a letter to Lord Ebonlocke in Darkshire.

Description.text: 看来我又得有事麻烦你了。我写一了封信给艾尔罗·埃伯洛克公爵，请求他从他的精锐部队——暮色森林守夜人——中抽出一些人来协助湖畔镇的防务。这封信必须马上呈送给他，而且你在旅途中要多加小心。埃伯洛克公爵是夜色镇的行政官，那座小镇就在暮色森林中，小心不要迷路了。
Description.english: I require your assistance once again.  I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense.  It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly.  You must exercise extreme caution.  Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of Duskwood.  Do not stray from the roads.

identity.title: Messenger to Darkshire
identity.objectives: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Lord Ebonlocke's letter of response.
identity.description: If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad.  Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid?  The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land.  If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.$b$bTake this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.

Objectives.text: 将埃伯洛克公爵的回信带给所罗门镇长。
Objectives.english: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Lord Ebonlocke's letter of response.

Description.text: 如果我不是和所罗门镇长私交甚密的话，我一定会以为他是个疯子的。因为暴风城拒绝出兵援助，就让我们把守夜人部队派去湖畔镇？守夜人部队就是因为这里被邪恶的魔法所影响才建立起来的。如果我把他们派离这里的话，恐怕还没等到他们走出森林，这里就会被邪恶的势力彻底吞没。$b$b把这封回信带给你在湖畔镇的主人吧。
Description.english: If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad.  Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid?  The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land.  If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.$b$bTake this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.

identity.title: Supplies from Darkshire
identity.objectives: Speak with Madame Eva.
identity.description: Oh, what is a poor old man to do?  I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.$B$BCan you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread?  You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.

Objectives.text: 去和伊瓦夫人谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Madame Eva.

Description.text: 哦，一个可怜的老人家还能做点什么呢？我需要从夜色镇拿点东西过来，不过路途太遥远，我又太老了……实在是走不动啊。$B$B你能去夜色镇给我拿点幽灵的发丝回来吗？你可以向伊瓦夫人要这东西，她的家就在夜色镇的广场旁。
Description.english: Oh, what is a poor old man to do?  I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.$B$BCan you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread?  You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.

identity.title: Ghost Hair Thread
identity.objectives: Bring the Spectral Comb to Blind Mary.
identity.description: There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.$B$BHere, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair.  Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.$B$BAnd take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...

Objectives.text: 把鬼梳带给盲眼玛丽。
Objectives.english: Bring the Spectral Comb to Blind Mary.

Description.text: 有个可怜的亡魂叫盲眼玛丽，她总是在夜色镇南部小山上的农宅里出没。$B$B拿着这把鬼梳，让盲眼玛丽用它梳头。然后再把梳子拿回来，我可以从上面收集到需要的幽灵的头发。$B$B小心点，那个屋子里潜伏着一些可怕的东西……
Description.english: There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.$B$BHere, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair.  Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.$B$BAnd take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...

identity.title: Murloc Poachers
identity.objectives: Bring 8 Murloc Fins to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
identity.description: Murlocs are becoming a problem.  Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm!  We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!$B$BHunt murlocs!  Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...

Objectives.text: 给湖畔镇的码头管理员巴伦带回8片鱼人的鳍。
Objectives.english: Bring 8 Murloc Fins to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.

Description.text: 鱼人们如今也成了一个问题。大群的鱼人渔民在止水湖沿岸下锚撒网，都快把湖里的鱼捞光了！我们得在他们把湖里的鱼都吃光之前把他们赶走！$B$B去猎杀那些鱼人！给我带回8片鱼人的鳍来，我会奖励你的。
Description.english: Murlocs are becoming a problem.  Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm!  We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!$B$BHunt murlocs!  Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...

identity.title: Poor Old Blanchy
identity.objectives: Verna Furlbrow in Westfall wants you to bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats.
identity.description: Poor Old Blanchy!  Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.$B$BI bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.

Objectives.text: 西部荒野的弗娜·法布隆要求你带给她8捧燕麦。
Objectives.english: Verna Furlbrow in Westfall wants you to bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats.

Description.text: 可怜的老马布兰契呀！我们让它干的活儿实在是太多了，看来它已经要累垮了。虽然我在离开农场以前就喂过了它，可谁会料到马车会在半路上坏掉呢？如果你能从田里替它取来几捧燕麦的话，我会对你感激不尽的。我想，你可以在田边找到足够的燕麦，不过你首先要将周围那些可怕的机器人先干掉。
Description.english: Poor Old Blanchy!  Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.$B$BI bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.

identity.title: The Coast Isn't Clear
identity.objectives: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
identity.description: You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast.  The Great Sea is treacherous indeed.  The coast of Westfall needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe.  The Murlocs are trouble though.$b$bKill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.

Objectives.text: 杀死7只鱼人潮行者、7只鱼人战士、7只鱼人智者，还有7只鱼人滩行者，然后向西部荒野灯塔中的葛瑞森船长复命。
Objectives.english: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.

Description.text: 你或许已经注意到了，海岸线上有许多船只的残骸。无尽之海确实是非常凶险，我们必须确保西部荒野海岸线上没有那些该死的鱼人到处徘徊，只有这样水手们才能安全地找到靠港的路线。$b$b去杀死7只鱼人潮行者、7只鱼人战士、7只鱼人智者，还有7只鱼人滩行者，完成任务之后到我这里来领取奖赏。
Description.english: You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast.  The Great Sea is treacherous indeed.  The coast of Westfall needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe.  The Murlocs are trouble though.$b$bKill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.

identity.title: Return the Comb
identity.objectives: Return the Ghost Hair Comb to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
identity.description: NO!!!!!$B$BTake it, take this comb away from me!$B$BI'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!

Objectives.text: 把幽灵的梳子拿回去交给夜色镇的伊瓦夫人。
Objectives.english: Return the Ghost Hair Comb to Madame Eva in Darkshire.

Description.text: 不！！！！！$B$B快把这个梳子拿走！$B$B我是个怪物，不会再有人说我好看了！
Description.english: NO!!!!!$B$BTake it, take this comb away from me!$B$BI'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!

identity.title: The Defias Brotherhood
identity.objectives: Escort the Defias Traitor to the secret hideout of the Defias Brotherhood.  Once the Defias Traitor shows you where VanCleef and his men are hiding out, return to Gryan Stoutmantle with the information.
identity.description: So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny $r like you to protect me?  Guess you'll have to do.  Better bring some friends too. $b$bYou know the deal, right?  You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout.  But you better be close by my side.  The Defias gang wants my head now.  If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.$b$bLet me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.

Objectives.text: 护送迪菲亚叛徒前往迪菲亚兄弟会的秘密藏身处。迪菲亚叛徒把你带到范克里夫和他的手下的巢穴之后，尽快回去向格里安·斯托曼汇报相关信息。
Objectives.english: Escort the Defias Traitor to the secret hideout of the Defias Brotherhood.  Once the Defias Traitor shows you where VanCleef and his men are hiding out, return to Gryan Stoutmantle with the information.

Description.text: 这么说，斯托曼就派了你这么一个芦柴棒一样的家伙来保护我？希望你能行，当然如果你再叫上几个朋友帮忙就好了。$b$b你知道你要做些什么吧？我会把你带到迪菲亚盗贼的巢穴去，而你呢，就得保护好我。当然，你最好离我近点，越近越好。现在全迪菲亚兄弟会的人都想要我的脑袋呢。要是他们看见我和你在一起，一定会来把咱们都宰了的。$b$b等你和你的朋友准备好之后，就来跟我说一声吧。
Description.english: So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny $r like you to protect me?  Guess you'll have to do.  Better bring some friends too. $b$bYou know the deal, right?  You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout.  But you better be close by my side.  The Defias gang wants my head now.  If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.$b$bLet me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.

CompletionLog.text: 去西部荒野找哨兵岭的格里安·斯托曼。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

identity.title: Gather Rot Blossoms
identity.objectives: Gather 8 Rot Blossoms and bring them to Tavernkeep Smitts in Darkshire.
identity.description: If you bring me some rot blossoms then I can brew you up a batch of zombie juice.$B$BRot blossoms grow in strange places.  In particular, I hear you can find them inside the skulls of Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends... not that I've gotten close enough to look!$B$BThe Raven Hill Cemetery is lousy with those skeletons.  You may as well get rid of them while you're looking for rot blossoms.  The town of Darkshire would be grateful.

Objectives.text: 收集8个腐败之花，交给夜色镇的旅店店主斯密茨。
Objectives.english: Gather 8 Rot Blossoms and bring them to Tavernkeep Smitts in Darkshire.

Description.text: 如果你能给我找些腐败之花来，我就可以酿造很多僵尸酒。$B$B这种花很难找到，听说在恐怖骸骨和骸骨魔的头骨里可以找到这种花……不过至今我还没有亲眼见过！$B$B乌鸦岭墓地和静谧花园里都有很多这样的骷髅，你可以在寻找腐败之花的时候顺便把他们干掉，夜色镇的人民会感激你的。
Description.english: If you bring me some rot blossoms then I can brew you up a batch of zombie juice.$B$BRot blossoms grow in strange places.  In particular, I hear you can find them inside the skulls of Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends... not that I've gotten close enough to look!$B$BThe Raven Hill Cemetery is lousy with those skeletons.  You may as well get rid of them while you're looking for rot blossoms.  The town of Darkshire would be grateful.

identity.title: Deliver the Thread
identity.objectives: Bring the Ghost Hair Thread to Abercrombie, in his shack north of the Raven Hill Cemetery.
identity.description: Here is your thread, $n.  It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.

Objectives.text: 把幽灵的发丝交给亚伯克隆比，他住在乌鸦岭墓地北边的房子里。
Objectives.english: Bring the Ghost Hair Thread to Abercrombie, in his shack north of the Raven Hill Cemetery.

Description.text: 这是你要的线，$n。它有很多种用途，比如用来束缚邪恶的亡魂，或者给没有生命的东西注入生命。
Description.english: Here is your thread, $n.  It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.

identity.title: Zombie Juice
identity.objectives: Speak with Tavernkeep Smitts.
identity.description: I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice.  Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.$B$BAnd please hurry, $n.  These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!

Objectives.text: 去和旅店店主斯密茨谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Tavernkeep Smitts.

Description.text: 我需要一瓶叫做僵尸酒的饮料。夜色镇血鸦旅店的店主斯密茨应该有些存货。$B$B最近晚上寒风刺骨，我得来点僵尸酒，好让我的血液重新沸腾起来。
Description.english: I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice.  Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.$B$BAnd please hurry, $n.  These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!

identity.title: Juice Delivery
identity.objectives: Bring the Zombie Juice to Abercrombie at his shack.
identity.description: Here's your Zombie Juice...$B$B...and be careful with this stuff.  It's strong enough to raise the dead!

Objectives.text: 把僵尸酒交给乌鸦岭墓地北方小屋里的亚伯克隆比。
Objectives.english: Bring the Zombie Juice to Abercrombie at his shack.

Description.text: 这是你要的僵尸酒……$B$B不过要小心一点，这酒烈得足以把死人给呛活过来。
Description.english: Here's your Zombie Juice...$B$B...and be careful with this stuff.  It's strong enough to raise the dead!

identity.title: Note to the Mayor
identity.objectives: Bring Abercrombie's Letter to Ello Ebonlocke, Mayor of Darkshire.
identity.description: Take this note to Ello Ebonlocke, the Mayor of Darkshire.$B$BHe and I are old friends...and when he reads it and discovers what you did for me...I'm sure he'll be just as happy as I am!  Hahahaha!

Objectives.text: 把亚伯克隆比的信交给夜色镇的艾尔罗·埃伯洛克镇长。
Objectives.english: Bring Abercrombie's Letter to Ello Ebonlocke, Mayor of Darkshire.

Description.text: 请把这封信交给夜色镇的艾尔罗·埃伯洛克镇长。$B$B我和他是老朋友了……我敢说，当他读完信，并且知道了你为我做的事情……他一定会和我一样高兴的！哈哈哈哈！
Description.english: Take this note to Ello Ebonlocke, the Mayor of Darkshire.$B$BHe and I are old friends...and when he reads it and discovers what you did for me...I'm sure he'll be just as happy as I am!  Hahahaha!

identity.title: A Dark Threat Looms
identity.objectives: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to take the strange smelling powder to Ashlan Stonesmirk, the explosives expert at the Mo'grosh Camp.
identity.description: If my suspicions are correct, this is some type of explosive powder. This must be analyzed by an explosives expert so we know just what we're dealing with here.$B$BThere's only one man for the job. Ashlan Stonesmirk was assigned to monitoring the ogres at the Mo'grosh Stronghold to the east. Head that direction and locate him so that he can shed some light on what this substance is.

Objectives.text: 主工程师辛德维尔要你把怪味粉末交给莫格罗什营地的炸药专家阿什兰·暗石。
Objectives.english: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to take the strange smelling powder to Ashlan Stonesmirk, the explosives expert at the Mo'grosh Camp.

Description.text: 如果我的猜测没错的话，这是某种火药粉末。应该找个爆破专家来分析一下这到底是什么东西。$B$B只有一个人适合做这件事。阿什兰·暗石就在东边的莫格罗什要塞监视食人魔。赶快去找他，让他看看这东西到底是什么。
Description.english: If my suspicions are correct, this is some type of explosive powder. This must be analyzed by an explosives expert so we know just what we're dealing with here.$B$BThere's only one man for the job. Ashlan Stonesmirk was assigned to monitoring the ogres at the Mo'grosh Stronghold to the east. Head that direction and locate him so that he can shed some light on what this substance is.

identity.title: Rise of the Silithid
identity.objectives: Take the Insect Analysis Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.
identity.description: I urge you to take this report to someone who has working knowledge in this kind of thing.$B$BI know this night elf scholar named Gracina Spiritmight.  She's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of Azeroth; she's a historian to boot!  If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is, and more importantly how to stop it, give her the report.  We'll need the help.$B$BLast I heard, she was residing in the Temple of the Moon, located in Darnassus.

Objectives.text: 把报告带给达纳苏斯的格拉希娜·灵风。
Objectives.english: Take the Insect Analysis Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

Description.text: 我希望你尽快把这份报告送到对处理此类事件有经验的人手里。$B$B我知道有一位名叫格拉希娜·灵风的暗夜精灵学者，她致力于研究卡利姆多大陆上那些与艾泽拉斯的普通生物截然不同的生物形态，她简直就是一本活的生物书！如果你想要知道我们面临的是怎样的威胁，以及如何解决这个威胁，那就把这份报告交给她吧，我们现在急需她的帮助。$B$B我听说她住在达纳苏斯的月神殿里。
Description.english: I urge you to take this report to someone who has working knowledge in this kind of thing.$B$BI know this night elf scholar named Gracina Spiritmight.  She's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of Azeroth; she's a historian to boot!  If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is, and more importantly how to stop it, give her the report.  We'll need the help.$B$BLast I heard, she was residing in the Temple of the Moon, located in Darnassus.

identity.title: Raven Hill
identity.objectives: Find out what is haunting Raven Hill.
identity.description: Something's amiss at Raven Hill, $n. Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and the third before that he says he saw light in one of the windows.$b$bIf, as you say, you care about the safety of Duskwood, find out what monster haunts in Raven Hill.

Objectives.text: 查出是什么东西在乌鸦岭神出鬼没。
Objectives.english: Find out what is haunting Raven Hill.

Description.text: 乌鸦岭出了点问题，$n。卡洛尔说那边的房子里有什么人——或者怪物——出没。有两个晚上，他发现有个身影在活动，第三天晚上，某扇窗户里还射出了灯光。$b$b你如果真的关心暮色森林的安危，就去查一查，看看是什么样的怪物在乌鸦岭出没。
Description.english: Something's amiss at Raven Hill, $n. Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and the third before that he says he saw light in one of the windows.$b$bIf, as you say, you care about the safety of Duskwood, find out what monster haunts in Raven Hill.

identity.title: Deliveries to Sven
identity.objectives: Deliver the supplies to Sven.
identity.description: Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.$b$bUnfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?

Objectives.text: 把补给物资带给斯温。
Objectives.english: Deliver the supplies to Sven.

Description.text: 你认识斯温吗？谢天谢地，终于有人能帮我了！斯温和他的同伴在暮色森林的西北边有个营地。$b$b不幸的是，他们的人手太少了，少到派不出人回镇里来取一些必需的补给品。你能把这些物资带给斯温吗？
Description.english: Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.$b$bUnfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?

identity.title: The Hermit
identity.objectives: Check on the old man in the shack near Raven Hill cemetery.
identity.description: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.

Objectives.text: 去乌鸦岭墓地附近的小屋查看老人的情况。
Objectives.english: Check on the old man in the shack near Raven Hill cemetery.

Description.text: 有个老人经常到镇里来买东西，不过我已经有些日子没见过他了。如果我没记错的话，他就住在一个可以俯视乌鸦岭墓地的小屋里。你能不能去看一看出什么事了？
Description.english: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.

identity.title: The Defias Brotherhood
identity.objectives: Kill Edwin VanCleef and bring his head to Gryan Stoutmantle.
identity.description: There is but one task left for you to complete.  Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated.  While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of Westfall that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all.  Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.

Objectives.text: 杀死艾德温·范克里夫，把他的头交给格里安·斯托曼。
Objectives.english: Kill Edwin VanCleef and bring his head to Gryan Stoutmantle.

Description.text: 这里恐怕还有最后一个任务需要你来完成。我们必须派人去除掉艾德温·范克里夫。说实话，就这样对一个活生生的人宣判死刑，这实在令我非常痛心，但为了西部荒野人民的利益，我不得不让范克里夫永远安息。把范克里夫干掉之后，提他的头来见我。
Description.english: There is but one task left for you to complete.  Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated.  While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of Westfall that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all.  Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.

identity.title: Oh Brother. . .
identity.objectives: Bring Foreman Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
identity.description: We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.$b$bYou look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful.  He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.

Objectives.text: 将工头希斯耐特的探险者协会徽章交给暴风城的维尔德·蓟草。
Objectives.english: Bring Foreman Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.

Description.text: 那时我们正在一个大矿洞中工作，就是那个隐藏在西部荒野月溪镇中的谷仓下面的矿洞……没人知道当时到底是怎么回事，总之矿道突然坍塌了，我逃了出来……可其他人就没那么好运了……我是说，从那以后我就再没听到过其他人的消息了。$b$b看上去你的运气可能会比我们好一点。如果你能帮我找到弟弟的话，我会非常感谢你的。他总是戴着一块探险者协会徽章，所以如果你找不到他的话，至少那块徽章能给我带来一些安慰……
Description.english: We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.$b$bYou look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful.  He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.

identity.title: Collecting Memories
identity.objectives: Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
identity.description: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in.  If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them.  If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.

Objectives.text: 给暴风城的维尔德·蓟草带回4张矿业工会会员卡。
Objectives.english: Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.

Description.text: 在那个可怕的日子，我的许多朋友都被埋在了矿洞里。如果你在冒险中正好路过月溪镇的那处矿洞的话，请帮忙留意一下有没有什么可以辨认他们身份的标志物品。如果你能找到他们的矿业工会会员卡的话，请一定要带给我，我好知道他们的结局，并与他们的家人谈谈如何为这次恐怖的事故善后。
Description.english: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in.  If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them.  If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.

identity.title: A New Threat
identity.objectives: Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
identity.description: I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.$b$bI hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.$b$bAnd that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! $b$bWe're a bit shorthanded here, $g lad : lass;, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.

Objectives.text: 巴尔林·霜锤让你去杀死6个石腭穴居人和6个壮实的石腭穴居人。
Objectives.english: Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.

Description.text: 我希望你能帮我们一把，$c。在上一次穴居人袭击之后，我们的人手就明显不够了。$b$b我听说他们现在已经遍布我们的国土，看来寒脊山谷也不能避免。东南部的山区和湖畔已经到处都是穴居人的身影了。$b$b糟糕的事情还不仅仅是这些，几天前，他们袭击并占领了我们西边的营地！$b$b我们这儿有些人手不足，$g孩子:姑娘;，我们需要强大的军队帮助我们赶走这些家伙。
Description.english: I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.$b$bI hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.$b$bAnd that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! $b$bWe're a bit shorthanded here, $g lad : lass;, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.

identity.title: Worgen in the Woods
identity.objectives: Kill 6 Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen for Calor in Darkshire.
identity.description: Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.$b$bYou believe yourself worthy to join us?$b$bI once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.$b$bTest your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.

Objectives.text: 为夜色镇的卡洛尔杀掉6个夜行织影狼人。
Objectives.english: Kill 6 Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen for Calor in Darkshire.

Description.text: 黑暗的势力正在笼罩暮色森林，而卡尔文主人正在努力驱除邪恶，保护夜色镇人民的安全是我们的职责。$b$b你觉得自己有能力加入我们吗？$b$b我以前也跟你想的一样，因为对哨所的安逸悠闲感到绝望，我投靠了卡尔文主人。如果你想要证明自己的实力，不是只靠嘴皮子说说就可以的。$b$b去找夜行织影狼人较量较量吧，他们经常在阳光树林——阳光，哈！——和烂果园出没。
Description.english: Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.$b$bYou believe yourself worthy to join us?$b$bI once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.$b$bTest your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.

identity.title: Theocritus' Retrieval
identity.objectives: Bring the Faded Shadowhide Pendant to Theocritus the Mage at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.
identity.description: <You hear a disembodied voice...>$B$BDo not be alarmed.  I am Theocritus, High Mage of Tower Azora in Elwynn Forest.  The pendant you are holding is a method of communication between the Shadowhide Gnolls and their master, Morganth.$B$BThrough months of research, I believe I too can communicate through these pendants.  If you can hear this message, then my spell was a success.$B$BBring me this pendant and I will reward you for the service.

Objectives.text: 将不再发光的暗皮坠饰带给艾尔文森林中阿祖拉之塔的法师塞欧克瑞图斯。
Objectives.english: Bring the Faded Shadowhide Pendant to Theocritus the Mage at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.

Description.text: <你听到了某种飘渺的声音>$B$B可别被吓着。我是塞欧克瑞图斯，艾尔文森林的阿祖拉之塔里的高阶法师。你手上拿着的饰物是暗皮豺狼人和他们的主子莫甘斯用来联络的工具。$B$B根据这几个月的研究，我也已经掌握了使用这些饰物进行通信的方法。如果你能听到我所说的话，就证明我的法术成功了。$B$B把这个饰物带给我，我会给你酬劳的。
Description.english: <You hear a disembodied voice...>$B$BDo not be alarmed.  I am Theocritus, High Mage of Tower Azora in Elwynn Forest.  The pendant you are holding is a method of communication between the Shadowhide Gnolls and their master, Morganth.$B$BThrough months of research, I believe I too can communicate through these pendants.  If you can hear this message, then my spell was a success.$B$BBring me this pendant and I will reward you for the service.

identity.title: Dwarven Outfitters
identity.objectives: Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
identity.description: What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?$b$bI'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.$b$bI need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?

Objectives.text: 斯登·粗臂想要8块硬狼肉。
Objectives.english: Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.

Description.text: 嘿，你是新来的吧？看来你需要些暖手的东西，对吗？$b$b我想你应该想要一副保暖的手套。我是个热心肠，很愿意给你一副手套，不过我有个条件。$b$b你帮我弄些狼肉来，我保证你不会被冻掉手指头。你觉得怎么样？
Description.english: What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?$b$bI'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.$b$bI need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?

CompletionLog.text: 去丹莫罗找寒脊山谷的斯登·粗臂。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Sten Stoutarm at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

identity.title: The Boar Hunter
identity.objectives: Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 12 Small Crag Boars.
identity.description: Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?$b$bThough, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.$b$bLong story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.

Objectives.text: 塔林·锐眼让你去杀掉12只小型峭壁野猪。
Objectives.english: Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 12 Small Crag Boars.

Description.text: 没什么能比得上用一整天的时间去打野猪更让人愉快的了，对吧？不过，寒脊山谷里的野猪太多了，你几乎已经不可能在那里再感受到狩猎的乐趣。你根本不需要去激怒它们，因为它们早就是怒气冲天，随时准备用獠牙把你拱上天了！事实上，这些过剩的野猪已经对我的日常狩猎形成了威胁。$b$b长话短说吧，如果你能帮我杀掉些野猪，我真的会非常感激你的。
Description.english: Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?$b$bThough, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.$b$bLong story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.

identity.title: Bloodscalp Ears
identity.objectives: Acquire 15 Bloodscalp Ears and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.
identity.description: Damn trolls! They've been killing off our agents in the jungle! I've already lost a good number of my best guards to skirmishes with them. The costs are piling up! How will I explain this to Baron Revilgaz?$b$bDecisive action... Think, Kebok... you weren't assigned to the post you have today for sitting around... I've got it! You... $n, is it? You'll help me, won't you? There's money to be had!$b$bHere's the deal... you bring me the ears of fifteen Bloodscalp Trolls, and I'll compensate you well.

Objectives.text: 给藏宝海湾的科博克带回15只血顶巨魔的耳朵。
Objectives.english: Acquire 15 Bloodscalp Ears and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.

Description.text: 该死的巨魔！他们杀死了我们派到丛林里去的人！我已经在和他们的冲突中损失太多优秀的护卫了。血债必须血来偿！这让我怎么向大财主里维加兹解释呀？$b$b是该做决定的时候了……想想看，科博克……你可不是被派到这里来整日无所事事的……啊，有啦！你……你就是$n，是不是？你是来帮助我的，是不是？这份工作的奖励可是很丰厚的哦！$b$b嗯嗯，给我带15只血顶巨魔的耳朵来，我就重重地酬谢你，如何？
Description.english: Damn trolls! They've been killing off our agents in the jungle! I've already lost a good number of my best guards to skirmishes with them. The costs are piling up! How will I explain this to Baron Revilgaz?$b$bDecisive action... Think, Kebok... you weren't assigned to the post you have today for sitting around... I've got it! You... $n, is it? You'll help me, won't you? There's money to be had!$b$bHere's the deal... you bring me the ears of fifteen Bloodscalp Trolls, and I'll compensate you well.

identity.title: Supplies to Private Thorsen
identity.objectives: Deliver the Miscellaneous Goblin Supplies to Private Thorsen.
identity.description: Hmm. Yes, I do have something you could do, actually. Lieutenant Doren and his followers up in the north need their regular supplies from us.$b$bThey haven't been delivered, and with the trolls attacking, I'll need someone to do it. Doren's camp lies northwest of the road at the entrance to Stranglethorn from Duskwood. Give the supplies to Private Thorsen, if he's not in the camp, then he'll be patrolling south of it. He'll take care of them.$b$bMind you, if you fail, you'll owe me restitution.

Title.text: 列兵索尔森的补给物资

Objectives.text: 将杂七杂八的地精补给物资带给列兵索尔森。
Objectives.english: Deliver the Miscellaneous Goblin Supplies to Private Thorsen.

Description.text: 嗯。没错，我这里确实有些适合你做的事。目前部署在荆棘谷北部的多伦上尉和他的部下需要我们的定期补给。$b$b不过由于巨魔的伏击，他们一直没能得到补给，所以我得找人来帮我处理这件事。多伦的营地就在从暮色森林进入荆棘谷的道路的西北方，你只要把补给品交给列兵索尔森就行了，相信他会处理好的。$b$b你要记住，如果你失败了的话，就得赔偿我们的损失。$b$b当然，你也可能会死在路上……
Description.english: Hmm. Yes, I do have something you could do, actually. Lieutenant Doren and his followers up in the north need their regular supplies from us.$b$bThey haven't been delivered, and with the trolls attacking, I'll need someone to do it. Doren's camp lies northwest of the road at the entrance to Stranglethorn from Duskwood. Give the supplies to Private Thorsen, if he's not in the camp, then he'll be patrolling south of it. He'll take care of them.$b$bMind you, if you fail, you'll owe me restitution.

CompletionLog.text: 去找荆棘谷的列兵索尔森。
CompletionLog.english: Report to Private Thorsen in Stranglethorn Vale.

identity.title: A Dark Threat Looms
identity.objectives: Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and show him the clue that you discovered.
identity.description: You take a sample of the strange smelling powder.

Objectives.text: 回去见主工程师辛德维尔七世，把你找到的线索交给他。
Objectives.english: Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and show him the clue that you discovered.

Description.text: 你取了些怪味粉末的样品。
Description.english: You take a sample of the strange smelling powder.

identity.title: Bookie Herod
identity.objectives: Find Bookie Herod's Records.
identity.description: If Kurzen knows Thorsen's secret, then we have a spy in our midst.  We must determine how the secret was leaked!$B$BThorsen's contact within Kurzen's camp was Bookie Herod.  Herod is Kurzen's logistics officer and knows everything about the running of Kurzen's Compound.  If you can get Herod's notes or records, maybe we can find out how Thorsen was discovered.$B$BWhen we were still with Kurzen, Bookie's office was on the top floor of the camp's only two-story house.  His records are probably still there.

Objectives.text: 找到书呆子赫罗德的档案。
Objectives.english: Find Bookie Herod's Records.

Description.text: 既然连库尔森都知道了这个秘密，那么他们一定也在我们这边安插了一个卧底。我们必须得搞明白这些机密内容是怎么泄露出去的！$B$B索尔森在那边的线人是书呆子赫罗德，他是库尔森的后勤官，了解库尔森的营地里的一切事务。如果你能搞到他的笔记或者档案什么的话，或许我们能分析出索尔森到底是怎么被发现的。$B$B当初，我们还跟库尔森一起共事的时候，书呆子的办公室是在营地里唯一一座两层房屋的二楼，他的档案应该还在那里。
Description.english: If Kurzen knows Thorsen's secret, then we have a spy in our midst.  We must determine how the secret was leaked!$B$BThorsen's contact within Kurzen's camp was Bookie Herod.  Herod is Kurzen's logistics officer and knows everything about the running of Kurzen's Compound.  If you can get Herod's notes or records, maybe we can find out how Thorsen was discovered.$B$BWhen we were still with Kurzen, Bookie's office was on the top floor of the camp's only two-story house.  His records are probably still there.

CompletionLog.text: 去找荆棘谷的书呆子赫罗德的档案。
CompletionLog.english: Find Bookie Herod's Records in Stranglethorn Vale.

identity.title: Investigate the Camp
identity.objectives: Find the hunters' camp and report its location to Krazek in Booty Bay.
identity.description: I've gotten reports of a group of hunters that have set up camp upriver of the Venture Company mining camp on Lake Nazferiti.  Now, normally I wouldn't care, but improbably, I heard that Hemet Nesingwary Jr. was one of the hunters there.  He's certainly well-connected, if you catch my meaning, and you never can be too safe.$b$bWhy don't you go check out the camp, $n, see what they're about?

Objectives.text: 找到猎人营地并向藏宝海湾的克拉兹克报告这个营地的位置。
Objectives.english: Find the hunters' camp and report its location to Krazek in Booty Bay.

Description.text: 我收到一条报告说，有一群猎人在风险投资公司营地所在的纳菲瑞提湖的上游建立了一片营地。通常我根本不会在意这件事，但当我听说赫米特·奈辛瓦里二世也是那群猎人中的一员时，我改变了想法。那家伙可是个名声显赫的人物，如果你了解我的意思的话，就会不像现在这样无动于衷了。$b$b你为什么不去那片营地里侦察一下呢，$n？去看看他们到底想干点什么吧。
Description.english: I've gotten reports of a group of hunters that have set up camp upriver of the Venture Company mining camp on Lake Nazferiti.  Now, normally I wouldn't care, but improbably, I heard that Hemet Nesingwary Jr. was one of the hunters there.  He's certainly well-connected, if you catch my meaning, and you never can be too safe.$b$bWhy don't you go check out the camp, $n, see what they're about?

CompletionLog.text: 去荆棘谷找藏宝海湾的克拉兹克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Krazek at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

identity.title: Colonel Kurzen
identity.objectives: Kill 6 Kurzen Elite, 4 Kurzen Subchiefs, and bring Kurzen's Head to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
identity.description: You have proven yourself time and again, and your resourcefulness seems to rival even that of Kurzen himself.  You may be the salvation of our band of rebels...if you can pit yourself against Kurzen and prevail!$B$BHe commands his men from deep within the Stockpile.  You must enter that cave, brave through his defenders, and face Kurzen and his leaders.$B$BFarewell, $n.  My hope, and the fate of my men, go with you.

Objectives.text: 杀掉6名库尔森精英和4名库尔森副首领，并将库尔森的徽记交给反抗军营地里的多伦上尉。
Objectives.english: Kill 6 Kurzen Elite, 4 Kurzen Subchiefs, and bring Kurzen's Head to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.

Description.text: 你一次又一次地证明了自己的能力，而你的足智多谋略似乎甚至能与库尔森媲美。如果……如果你愿意彻底投身到与库尔森斗争的事业中去的话……也许你将成为我们反抗军的救星！$B$B他就躲在那个名叫“储藏室”的洞穴深处发号施令。你必须进入那个洞穴，干掉他身边的保镖，最终把库尔森和他的副官们都给除掉。$B$B出发吧，$n。我们的生命与希望，如今都已经全部掌握在你的手中了。
Description.english: You have proven yourself time and again, and your resourcefulness seems to rival even that of Kurzen himself.  You may be the salvation of our band of rebels...if you can pit yourself against Kurzen and prevail!$B$BHe commands his men from deep within the Stockpile.  You must enter that cave, brave through his defenders, and face Kurzen and his leaders.$B$BFarewell, $n.  My hope, and the fate of my men, go with you.

identity.title: The Second Rebellion
identity.objectives: Kill 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighters.$B$BReturn to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
identity.description: We're fighting a losing battle with Colonel Kurzen.  Not only is he a brilliant tactician, he outnumbers us at least 10 to 1!  To survive, we need to use his own, covert tactics against him.$B$BEnter his camp to the east and kill his men.  Lots of them.  And get out before reinforcements can close on you.

Objectives.text: 杀死15名库尔森丛林战士，然后向反抗军营地的尤瓦中士复命。
Objectives.english: Kill 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighters.$B$BReturn to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.

Description.text: 我们正在与库尔森进行一场艰难的战斗。他是个非常优秀的战术大师，而且他的手下士兵的数量是我们的十倍！如果我们想要胜利的话，就必须使用他擅长的战术来对付他。$B$B到他在东边设立的营地里去，杀掉他的士兵，越多越好，然后在增援赶来之前撤退。
Description.english: We're fighting a losing battle with Colonel Kurzen.  Not only is he a brilliant tactician, he outnumbers us at least 10 to 1!  To survive, we need to use his own, covert tactics against him.$B$BEnter his camp to the east and kill his men.  Lots of them.  And get out before reinforcements can close on you.

identity.title: Bad Medicine
identity.objectives: Bring 7 Jungle Remedies and 1 Venom Fern Extract to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
identity.description: To have a chance against Kurzen, we need his healing support neutralized.  He has gathered a large number of medicine men who heal his forces with jungle remedies and poison our fighters with venom fern extracts.$B$BWe need those remedies and extracts for our own.  Search the Kurzen Compound - his medicine men and jungle fighters will have the remedies, and the extracts are probably stowed in some of the camp's supply boxes.

Objectives.text: 给反抗军营地里的尤瓦中士带回7份密林药剂和1份毒草汁液。
Objectives.english: Bring 7 Jungle Remedies and 1 Venom Fern Extract to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.

Description.text: 要想和库尔森搏上一搏，我们就必须削弱他们的医疗队伍。他在那里聚集了大批医疗人员，他们能用密林药剂治疗自己的部队，并用毒草汁液对我们的人下毒。$B$B我们要用这些药物来治疗我们自己的战士，同时我们也需要一份毒液的样本来研制解药。到库尔森的营地去把这两样东西找来吧，药品应该就在那些医疗人员和战士的身上，而毒草汁液大概是保存在营地中的一些物资箱里的。
Description.english: To have a chance against Kurzen, we need his healing support neutralized.  He has gathered a large number of medicine men who heal his forces with jungle remedies and poison our fighters with venom fern extracts.$B$BWe need those remedies and extracts for our own.  Search the Kurzen Compound - his medicine men and jungle fighters will have the remedies, and the extracts are probably stowed in some of the camp's supply boxes.

identity.title: Troll Witchery
identity.objectives: Bring 4 Skullsplitter Fetishes to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
identity.description: While I study those legends you acquired, gather for me implements of evil troll magic.  Enter the territory of the Skullsplitter trolls, a second tribe to the distant south, and acquire Skullsplitter Fetishes from their Witchdoctors and Mystics.

Objectives.text: 给反抗军营地的尼麦兹修士带回4只劈颅巨魔的神像。
Objectives.english: Bring 4 Skullsplitter Fetishes to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.

Description.text: 在我研究这些巨魔传说的时候，我希望你能帮我收集一些巨魔们施展邪恶魔法时必备的法器。到南边的那个劈颅巨魔部族的地盘上去，从他们的巫医和秘法师那里弄一些劈颅巨魔的神像回来吧。
Description.english: While I study those legends you acquired, gather for me implements of evil troll magic.  Enter the territory of the Skullsplitter trolls, a second tribe to the distant south, and acquire Skullsplitter Fetishes from their Witchdoctors and Mystics.

identity.title: Mai'Zoth
identity.objectives: Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
identity.description: Kurzen may be dead, but...that which drove him to evil still lives!  Through my studies I have discovered this: An Ogre Mage - Mai'Zoth - dwells in an Ogre Mound within the eastern mountains of Stranglethorn.  He is rumored to employ mind-controlling magic, and I am positive that he corrupted Kurzen.$B$BIf Mai'Zoth is allowed to live, then his evil may influence others, and may even cause another Kurzen to surface.$B$BKill him, and bring me his Mind's Eye, the artifact he uses to corrupt others.

Objectives.text: 将心灵之眼交给反抗军营地里的尼麦兹修士。
Objectives.english: Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.

Description.text: 库尔森的确是该死，不过……到底是谁将他带上了这条邪恶的道路呢？通过研究，我已经找到了真相：是一个名叫麦佐斯的食人魔法师干的。他住在荆棘谷东部的食人魔山中，据说他擅长心灵控制魔法，我也确信正是他使得库尔森上校堕落的。$B$B如果麦佐斯继续活在这世上，他的邪恶法术就有可能影响到更多人，或许又会出现另一个库尔森上校。$B$B杀死他，把他的心灵之眼带回来，这正是他用来诱惑他人堕落的物品。
Description.english: Kurzen may be dead, but...that which drove him to evil still lives!  Through my studies I have discovered this: An Ogre Mage - Mai'Zoth - dwells in an Ogre Mound within the eastern mountains of Stranglethorn.  He is rumored to employ mind-controlling magic, and I am positive that he corrupted Kurzen.$B$BIf Mai'Zoth is allowed to live, then his evil may influence others, and may even cause another Kurzen to surface.$B$BKill him, and bring me his Mind's Eye, the artifact he uses to corrupt others.

CompletionLog.text: 去荆棘谷找反抗军营地的尼麦兹修士。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Brother Nimetz at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

identity.title: Kurzen's Mystery
identity.objectives: Find the 4 tablets and bring their legends back to Brother Nimetz.
identity.description: Colonel Kurzen was once a great, noble man - I must find what caused his fall into depravity!  He may be under the sway of troll magic.  To confirm this, I must study some of their legends.$B$BThere are 4 tablets hidden within the troll ruins of Stranglethorn.  I must see what is written on these tablets!  Transcribe their markings and bring the transcriptions back to me.$B$BThe first tablet is in the Bal'lal Ruins, the second is in the Vile Reef, and the third and fourth are in the Ruins of Zul'Kunda.

Objectives.text: 找到4块石板并将上面的内容带回去交给尼麦兹修士。
Objectives.english: Find the 4 tablets and bring their legends back to Brother Nimetz.

Description.text: 库尔森上校曾是个伟大而高贵的人，我必须得找到让他堕落至此的原因！他一定是被巨魔的魔法给控制了。要想搞清楚这一点的话，我们就得先研究一下巨魔的传说故事。$B$B据说荆棘谷中的巨魔遗迹中隐藏着四块石板，我必须得看看这些石板上到底记述了些什么东西！你去给我拓一份这些石板上的文字来，把拓片都交给我。$B$B第一块石板在巴拉尔废墟里，第二块石板在暗礁海的海底，第三块和第四块应该都在祖昆达废墟里。
Description.english: Colonel Kurzen was once a great, noble man - I must find what caused his fall into depravity!  He may be under the sway of troll magic.  To confirm this, I must study some of their legends.$B$BThere are 4 tablets hidden within the troll ruins of Stranglethorn.  I must see what is written on these tablets!  Transcribe their markings and bring the transcriptions back to me.$B$BThe first tablet is in the Bal'lal Ruins, the second is in the Vile Reef, and the third and fourth are in the Ruins of Zul'Kunda.

identity.title: Skullsplitter Tusks
identity.objectives: Acquire 18 Skullsplitter Tusks and return them to Kebok.
identity.description: It's expensive and hard to kill enough tigers to support the export of tiger fangs to the islands in the South Seas. Luckily, we've developed a technique that allows us to take mundane horn-like objects and turn them into undetectable forgeries.$b$bThe closest match we've found, amazingly, are the tusks of the Skullsplitter trolls.$b$bHey, before you say anything, what the buyer doesn't know doesn't hurt them, am I right? Bring me a large number of them so we can get to work on the monthly shipment!

Objectives.text: 给藏宝海湾的科博克带回18根劈颅巨魔的獠牙。
Objectives.english: Acquire 18 Skullsplitter Tusks and return them to Kebok.

Description.text: 靠不停地猎杀老虎来保证对南海岛屿的虎牙出口实在是苦差事，不仅难度高，而且花费也也高。幸亏我们找到了一种替代品，就是这些劈颅部族的巨魔的獠牙。$b$b嘿，只要你不说，买家就不会知道，对吧？给我搞一批巨魔獠牙来吧，这样我们就能应付每月一次的供货啦！
Description.english: It's expensive and hard to kill enough tigers to support the export of tiger fangs to the islands in the South Seas. Luckily, we've developed a technique that allows us to take mundane horn-like objects and turn them into undetectable forgeries.$b$bThe closest match we've found, amazingly, are the tusks of the Skullsplitter trolls.$b$bHey, before you say anything, what the buyer doesn't know doesn't hurt them, am I right? Bring me a large number of them so we can get to work on the monthly shipment!

identity.title: Krazek's Cookery
identity.objectives: Bring Krazek's Crock Pot to Krazek the goblin.
identity.description: I do most of the cooking at the camp.  And it used to be a lot of work, until I bought a mechanical cooking pot from a goblin merchant in Booty Bay.  The pot is a wonder!  It saved me countless hours...until it broke!$B$BCan you take the pot back to the goblin for me so he can fix it?  His name is Krazek.

Objectives.text: 把克拉兹克的烹调锅带给藏宝海湾的地精克拉兹克。
Objectives.english: Bring Krazek's Crock Pot to Krazek the goblin.

Description.text: 在营地里，我是专门负责伙食的。过去的活真的很多，让我每天都要忙到死，直到我从藏宝海湾的地精商人那里买了台多功能机械烹调锅才有所改观。这锅实在是太棒了！它节省了我许多的时间……我是说，在它坏掉之前！$B$B你能帮我把这锅带到那个地精商人那里去，让他给我修理一下吗？他的名字叫克拉兹克。
Description.english: I do most of the cooking at the camp.  And it used to be a lot of work, until I bought a mechanical cooking pot from a goblin merchant in Booty Bay.  The pot is a wonder!  It saved me countless hours...until it broke!$B$BCan you take the pot back to the goblin for me so he can fix it?  His name is Krazek.

identity.title: Alas, Andorhal
identity.objectives: Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
identity.description: Alas, the time to attack Andorhal and drive out the lich that controls it is upon us!$B$BInside the ruins of the city is where the lich - Araj the Summoner - holds dominion.  He is guarded by numerous Scourge surrounding the remains of city's center, and his personal retinue of guardians attached to him directly is formidable.  You will need numerous allies to even stand a chance of facing him successfully.$B$BDestroy Araj, $n, and bring me a shard from his phylactery as proof!

Objectives.text: 把阿拉基的护符匣碎片交给西瘟疫之地冰风岗的指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特。
Objectives.english: Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

Description.text: 啊，进攻安多哈尔并彻底击败那个巫妖的时刻终于来临了！$B$B召唤者阿拉基就盘踞在安多哈尔的废墟中，他的贴身卫队无时无刻不在他的身边保护着他。你需要召集强大的盟友才能击败他。$B$B消灭巫妖，$n，从它的护符匣里拿出一块碎片来，作为你获胜的证据！
Description.english: Alas, the time to attack Andorhal and drive out the lich that controls it is upon us!$B$BInside the ruins of the city is where the lich - Araj the Summoner - holds dominion.  He is guarded by numerous Scourge surrounding the remains of city's center, and his personal retinue of guardians attached to him directly is formidable.  You will need numerous allies to even stand a chance of facing him successfully.$B$BDestroy Araj, $n, and bring me a shard from his phylactery as proof!

identity.title: A Meal Served Cold
identity.objectives: Kill a Cold Eye Basilisk, get a Chilled Basilisk Haunch, and return it to Angus Stern in the Blue Recluse.
identity.description: One of my most famous dishes is Chilled Basilisk in Lime Vinaigrette.  But the problem is... the meat is impossible to keep fresh, and I must serve the dish tonight for a noble's birthday!$B$BSo if you can bring me a Chilled Basilisk Haunch from a freshly-killed Cold Eye Basilisk, quickly, then I will owe you a king's feast!$B$BCold Eye Basilisks are known to roam along the beach dunes of northwestern Stranglethorn, so you have much traveling to do.  And be swift!

Objectives.text: 杀死一只冷眼蜥蜴，取一块冷蜥蜴肉并把它带给“蓝色隐士”旅店里的安古斯·斯特恩。
Objectives.english: Kill a Cold Eye Basilisk, get a Chilled Basilisk Haunch, and return it to Angus Stern in the Blue Recluse.

Description.text: 我的拿手菜之一就是橙味冻蜥肉，但现在的问题是……这种肉很容易变质，而且我今天晚上必须得在一位贵族的生日晚宴上做这道菜！$B$B救场如救火，如果你能马上从刚被宰掉的冷眼蜥蜴身上割块冷蜥蜴肉给我的话，我就给你做顿堪比国宴的美味尝尝！$B$B冷眼蜥蜴一般会在荆棘谷西北海岸的沙滩上晒太阳，离这里有点远，不是么？所以你得赶紧行动啦！
Description.english: One of my most famous dishes is Chilled Basilisk in Lime Vinaigrette.  But the problem is... the meat is impossible to keep fresh, and I must serve the dish tonight for a noble's birthday!$B$BSo if you can bring me a Chilled Basilisk Haunch from a freshly-killed Cold Eye Basilisk, quickly, then I will owe you a king's feast!$B$BCold Eye Basilisks are known to roam along the beach dunes of northwestern Stranglethorn, so you have much traveling to do.  And be swift!

CompletionLog.text: 去艾尔文森林找明镜湖的安古斯·斯特恩。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Angus Stern at the Blue Reclue in Stormwind City.

identity.title: Hostile Takeover
identity.objectives: Retrieve 8 Tumbled Crystals and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.
identity.description: He's done it this time! Bad enough that Gelriz's muscling out the moguls who were appointed by the trade princes, now he tries to cut in on the most notorious pirate!$b$bRevilgaz won't have it, and he's told me to take care of the problem in my own way.$b$bMy way? Theft. The Venture Co. geologists near Lake Nazferiti are deeply interested in those strange blue crystals they have been finding in the mines. Bring me samples of the stone from their geologists, I don't care what you have to do to get them.

Objectives.text: 给藏宝海湾的科博克带回8块打磨过的水晶。
Objectives.english: Retrieve 8 Tumbled Crystals and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.

Description.text: 太猖狂了！吉尔里兹把贸易亲王们指定的要员们都从这里赶了出去，这件事已经够糟的了，现在他居然还和那些声名狼籍的海盗们往来！$b$b里维加兹不会坐视不理的，他允许我按自己的方式来解决这些问题。$b$b我的方式是什么？偷！最近，风险投资公司的地质学家们正在研究他们从矿里挖出的一种奇怪的蓝色水晶，从那群地质学家手里搞些样本回来给我，当然，我不关心你用怎样的手段去搞。
Description.english: He's done it this time! Bad enough that Gelriz's muscling out the moguls who were appointed by the trade princes, now he tries to cut in on the most notorious pirate!$b$bRevilgaz won't have it, and he's told me to take care of the problem in my own way.$b$bMy way? Theft. The Venture Co. geologists near Lake Nazferiti are deeply interested in those strange blue crystals they have been finding in the mines. Bring me samples of the stone from their geologists, I don't care what you have to do to get them.

identity.title: Red Silk Bandanas
identity.objectives: Scout Riell at the Sentinel Hill Tower wants you to bring her 10 Red Silk Bandanas.
identity.description: It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas.  But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.$b$bThat being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can.  The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout.  When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you.  Good luck, $n.

Objectives.text: 给哨兵岭哨塔的哨兵瑞尔带回10条红色丝质面罩。
Objectives.english: Scout Riell at the Sentinel Hill Tower wants you to bring her 10 Red Silk Bandanas.

Description.text: 迪菲亚兄弟会的人都会戴着一种红色的面罩，这显然已经是个尽人皆知的秘密了。但我们又了解到，这个面罩的材料是他们的成员在帮会内部地位的象征。$b$b既然如此，那么我希望你出马杀死一些兄弟会的高阶成员。他们的最高阶成员无疑都躲在范克里夫的秘密藏身处附近。作为证据，你要给我带回10条红色丝质面罩来，这样我才能给你奖励。祝你好运，$n。
Description.english: It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas.  But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.$b$bThat being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can.  The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout.  When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you.  Good luck, $n.

identity.title: Jungle Secrets
identity.objectives: Speak with Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
identity.description: Thank you for saving me, $n.  I know how this looks, but...allow me to explain.$B$BI was charged by Lieutenant Doren to re-enlist with Kurzen's men, so that I might spy on them and bring sorely needed intelligence to the rebels.  You saw here what I had thought would be my chance to infiltrate Kurzen's Compound.  I was wrong, and again, thanks for saving me.$B$BThis was a top secret mission, so you must tell no one.  But if you speak with Doren he will explain.

Objectives.text: 与反抗军营地里的多伦上尉谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.

Description.text: 谢谢你救了我的命，$n。我知道这听起来有点奇怪，但……请听我解释。$B$B多伦上尉让我和库尔森的手下一起重新回到军队里，让我扮演卧底的角色，为我们反抗军搞一些有用的情报。我原本以为这里很适合我渗透入库尔森的营地，但我错了。再次感谢你救了我一命。$B$B这是个机密任务，所以你千万不能把它告诉任何人。但如果你去和多伦上尉谈谈的话，他会给你一个解释的。
Description.english: Thank you for saving me, $n.  I know how this looks, but...allow me to explain.$B$BI was charged by Lieutenant Doren to re-enlist with Kurzen's men, so that I might spy on them and bring sorely needed intelligence to the rebels.  You saw here what I had thought would be my chance to infiltrate Kurzen's Compound.  I was wrong, and again, thanks for saving me.$B$BThis was a top secret mission, so you must tell no one.  But if you speak with Doren he will explain.

CompletionLog.text: 去荆棘谷找反抗军营地的多伦上尉。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

identity.title: A Decisive Strike
identity.objectives: Kill the trogg leader, Grawmug, and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler, and then report back to Captain Rugelfuss in Thelsamar.
