Description.text: 达克萨隆要塞曾经是达卡莱王国最值得骄傲的堡垒。现在，那里只不过是巫妖王攻占祖达克、窃取巨魔诸神能量的基地。$B$B如果我们能杀死他们的首领——先知萨隆亚，或许就能切断天灾巨魔的后援。这至少能让祖达克的银色北伐军少一点麻烦。$B$B把先知的蒂基面具带回来给我，以此证明你已经把他干掉了。
Description.english: Drak'Tharon Keep once stood as a proud bastion of the Drakkari nation. Now it is nothing more than a stepping stone for the Lich King in his fight to put an end to Zul'Drak and steal the powers of the troll gods.$B$BBut if we were to eliminate their leader, the Prophet Tharon'ja, perhaps we could stop the flow of Scourge troll reinforcements. At the very least this would give the Argent Crusade in Zul'Drak one less thing to worry about.$B$BReturn to me with his tiki so I will know the prophet is slain.

identity.title: Proof of Demise: Gal'darah
identity.objectives: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Mojo Remnant of Akali.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
identity.description: The Drakkari prophets of Zul'Drak have done the unthinkable: they've slain most of their gods to absorb their powers! The most dangerous of all is the High Prophet of Akali, Gal'darah.$B$BSequestered within the bowels of Gundrak, Gal'darah has absorbed almost all of the mojo from slain Akali and now stands poised to erupt with his followers from the city. If we do not kill him now, we will be awash in a sea of madness and unthinkable power!$B$BHurry, $n, bring me what's left of Akali's mojo.

Objectives.text: 达拉然的大法师兰达洛克要你将阿卡里的魔精残渣交给他。$B$B该任务必须在英雄难度下完成。
Objectives.english: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Mojo Remnant of Akali.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.

Description.text: 祖达克的达卡莱先知们做出了一件不可思议的事：他们杀死了大部分神灵，吸取了他们的能量！阿卡里的高阶先知迦尔达拉是他们当中最危险的一个。$B$B迦尔达拉就躲藏在古达克里面，他吸取了阿卡里的大部分魔精，现在正准备和他的追随者们冲出那座城市。如果我们不立刻杀了他，就会被这股疯狂而不可思议的力量淹没！$B$B快一点，$n，去把阿卡里残余的魔精给我带回来。
Description.english: The Drakkari prophets of Zul'Drak have done the unthinkable: they've slain most of their gods to absorb their powers! The most dangerous of all is the High Prophet of Akali, Gal'darah.$B$BSequestered within the bowels of Gundrak, Gal'darah has absorbed almost all of the mojo from slain Akali and now stands poised to erupt with his followers from the city. If we do not kill him now, we will be awash in a sea of madness and unthinkable power!$B$BHurry, $n, bring me what's left of Akali's mojo.

identity.title: Proof of Demise: Mal'Ganis
identity.objectives: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Artifact from the Nathrezim Homeworld.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
identity.description: $n, a friend within the bronze dragonflight has given me information that we must exploit.$B$BThe mysterious beings of the Burning Legion called the dreadlords are also known racially as the Nathrezim. Little is known of their homeworld and even that is rumor.$B$BHowever, it is known that Mal'Ganis of the past has made a critical error: he left behind an artifact from his homeworld!$B$BThrough the Caverns of Time, you must travel back to the time known as the Culling of Stratholme. Recover the artifact.

Objectives.text: 达拉然的大法师兰达洛克要你将纳斯雷兹姆家园的圣物交给他。$B$B该任务必须在英雄难度下完成。
Objectives.english: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Artifact from the Nathrezim Homeworld.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.

Description.text: $n，一位青铜龙军团的朋友向我传达了一个很有价值的情报。$B$B被燃烧军团称为恐惧魔王的那种神秘生物，也就是魔族纳斯雷兹姆，关于他们生存的那个世界呢，人们知之甚少，而且可以说几乎都是无凭无据的传言。$B$B但玛尔加尼斯曾犯过一个致命的错误：他留下了一件来自他们世界的圣物！$B$B你要进入时光之穴，返回阿尔萨斯王子净化斯坦索姆的那个时刻，拿到那件圣物。
Description.english: $n, a friend within the bronze dragonflight has given me information that we must exploit.$B$BThe mysterious beings of the Burning Legion called the dreadlords are also known racially as the Nathrezim. Little is known of their homeworld and even that is rumor.$B$BHowever, it is known that Mal'Ganis of the past has made a critical error: he left behind an artifact from his homeworld!$B$BThrough the Caverns of Time, you must travel back to the time known as the Culling of Stratholme. Recover the artifact.

identity.title: Proof of Demise: Sjonnir The Ironshaper
identity.objectives: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Curse of Flesh Disc.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
identity.description: Little is understood about the condition known as the Curse of Flesh. However, there is information to be had within the Halls of Stone.$B$BSjonnir The Ironshaper seems to know a great deal with regard to the curse. We have it on good authority that he is carrying a Titan disc of information upon him that could answer all of our questions.$B$BRetrieve this disc for me, $n, so that we may learn.

Title.text: 死亡证明：塑铁者斯约尼尔
Title.english: Proof of Demise: Sjonnir The Ironshaper

Objectives.text: 达拉然的大法师兰达洛克要你将血肉诅咒圆盘交给他。$B$B该任务必须在英雄难度下完成。
Objectives.english: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Curse of Flesh Disc.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.

Description.text: 我们对于所谓“血肉诅咒”的情况知之甚少，不过岩石大厅里保存着与之相关的信息。$B$B塑铁者斯约尼尔似乎相当了解这种诅咒。我们有充分的证据表明，他身上有着一块泰坦制造的信息圆盘，上面的信息足以解答我们的所有疑问。$B$B帮我把圆盘拿来，$n，这样我们就能对血肉诅咒进行研究了。
Description.english: Little is understood about the condition known as the Curse of Flesh. However, there is information to be had within the Halls of Stone.$B$BSjonnir The Ironshaper seems to know a great deal with regard to the curse. We have it on good authority that he is carrying a Titan disc of information upon him that could answer all of our questions.$B$BRetrieve this disc for me, $n, so that we may learn.

identity.title: Proof of Demise: Loken
identity.objectives: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Celestial Ruby Ring.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
identity.description: Within the Halls of Lightning, Loken is poised to put an end to our world. Need I say more, $n?$B$BHe sits there listening to the mad whisperings of the Old God trapped beneath Northrend. You and your friends must travel to the Storm Peaks immediately!$B$BConfront Loken within the Terrestrial Watchtower and stop him before it is too late! Bring me his ruby ring so that I will know we are safe once more.

Objectives.text: 达拉然的大法师兰达洛克要你将天界红宝石戒指交给他。$B$B该任务必须在英雄难度下完成。
Objectives.english: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Celestial Ruby Ring.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.

Description.text: 闪电大厅的洛肯正在密谋毁灭我们的世界。还用得着我多说吗，$n？$B$B他对那位被囚禁在诺森德的上古之神言听计从。你和你的朋友必须立刻前往风暴峭壁！$B$B进入大地瞭望塔，与洛肯交战，阻止他的计划，不然一切就都完蛋了！把他的红宝石戒指带回来给我，这样我才能确信我们已经没有危险了。
Description.english: Within the Halls of Lightning, Loken is poised to put an end to our world. Need I say more, $n?$B$BHe sits there listening to the mad whisperings of the Old God trapped beneath Northrend. You and your friends must travel to the Storm Peaks immediately!$B$BConfront Loken within the Terrestrial Watchtower and stop him before it is too late! Bring me his ruby ring so that I will know we are safe once more.

identity.title: Proof of Demise: Anub'arak
identity.objectives: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Idle Crown of Anub'arak.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
identity.description: The Scourged nerubians are a plague upon our forces.$B$BWhile we are safe from them here, floating above the world, when we set foot upon the land below, it is always with the thought that the undead nerubians could burrow up from the depths of Azjol-Nerub and attack.$B$BIt's in the best interests of everyone if they are thrown into a state of disarray. Kill their former king, and major-domo to the Lich King, the crypt lord, Anub'arak.$B$BPlease bring me his crown... not that he wears it any longer.

Objectives.text: 达拉然的大法师兰达洛克要你将阿努巴拉克的王冠交给他。$B$B该任务必须在英雄难度下完成。
Objectives.english: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Idle Crown of Anub'arak.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.

Description.text: 天灾蛛魔对我们的部队是一个巨大的威胁。$B$B虽然我们飘浮在天空中时是很安全的，但是如果我们将落到地面上，就要担心那些亡灵蛛怪会从艾卓-尼鲁布钻出来攻击我们。$B$B如果能让它们陷入混乱，对大家都有好处。去杀死它们的前任国王，地穴领主阿努巴拉克。他也是巫妖王的得力助手之一。$B$B把阿努巴拉克的王冠带回来……它已经不再戴着那东西了。
Description.english: The Scourged nerubians are a plague upon our forces.$B$BWhile we are safe from them here, floating above the world, when we set foot upon the land below, it is always with the thought that the undead nerubians could burrow up from the depths of Azjol-Nerub and attack.$B$BIt's in the best interests of everyone if they are thrown into a state of disarray. Kill their former king, and major-domo to the Lich King, the crypt lord, Anub'arak.$B$BPlease bring me his crown... not that he wears it any longer.

identity.title: Proof of Demise: Herald Volazj
identity.objectives: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Faceless One's Withered Brain.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
identity.description: The nerubians of Ahn'kahet dug too deep during their attempt to escape the invasion of the Scourge. They got too close to the Old God under Northrend.$B$BRousing its awareness, the Old God sent its insane creatures against them, and the nerubians were caught between the proverbial rock and a hard place.$B$BThe leader of the Old Gods' forces, Herald Volazj is one of the nightmarish beings known as The Faceless. Put an end to him and bring me his withered brain.$B$BJust please, try to keep your sanity.

Title.text: 死亡证明：传令官沃拉兹

Objectives.text: 达拉然的大法师兰达洛克要你将无面者的萎缩大脑交给他。$B$B该任务必须在英雄难度下完成。
Objectives.english: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Faceless One's Withered Brain.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.

Description.text: 安卡赫特的蛛怪通过挖掘地洞躲避天灾军团的入侵，结果挖得太深了，过于靠近诺森德地下的上古之神。$B$B被惊醒的上古之神派出了疯狂的怪物去攻击他们，这些蛛怪可真是进退两难。$B$B上古之神的部队首领——传令官沃拉兹是一种名为无面者的可怕生物。去杀了他，把他的萎缩大脑带回来。$B$B但在执行这个任务的时候，你一定要保持清醒。
Description.english: The nerubians of Ahn'kahet dug too deep during their attempt to escape the invasion of the Scourge. They got too close to the Old God under Northrend.$B$BRousing its awareness, the Old God sent its insane creatures against them, and the nerubians were caught between the proverbial rock and a hard place.$B$BThe leader of the Old Gods' forces, Herald Volazj is one of the nightmarish beings known as The Faceless. Put an end to him and bring me his withered brain.$B$BJust please, try to keep your sanity.

identity.title: Proof of Demise: Cyanigosa
identity.objectives: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Head of Cyanigosa.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
identity.description: We're being invaded! The blue dragonflight has teleported into the Violet Hold and they're planning on breaking out from there into the rest of Dalaran!$B$BThere have already been reports of prisoners inadvertently being freed by their actions. It wouldn't surprise me if they're purposefully letting some of them free.$B$B$n, can you assemble your team quickly and get in there? Cyanigosa is the leader of their invasion force. Bring me her head!

Objectives.text: 达拉然的大法师兰达洛克要你将塞安妮苟萨的徽记交给他。$B$B该任务必须在英雄难度下完成。
Objectives.english: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Head of Cyanigosa.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.

Description.text: 我们遭到了入侵！蓝龙军团已经传送进了紫罗兰监狱，正计划从那里冲进达拉然！$B$B有报告说，他们已经不小心释放了一些囚犯。不过就算他们是故意放出那些囚犯，我也不会感到意外的。$B$B$n，你能否迅速召集一支队伍赶到那里去？塞安妮苟萨是这些入侵者的首领，把她的徽记给我带回来！
Description.english: We're being invaded! The blue dragonflight has teleported into the Violet Hold and they're planning on breaking out from there into the rest of Dalaran!$B$BThere have already been reports of prisoners inadvertently being freed by their actions. It wouldn't surprise me if they're purposefully letting some of them free.$B$B$n, can you assemble your team quickly and get in there? Cyanigosa is the leader of their invasion force. Bring me her head!

identity.title: Herald of War
identity.objectives: Report to Thrall at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: The Warchief needs you, champion. Orgrimmar is in a state of martial law. All merchants and services have been shut down as the Warchief prepares for an unavoidable conflict.$B$BI cannot tell you much more - not now. Not in this place.$B$BThe Warchief commands that our strongest champions report to his throne room. Go now, $n! Take the portal back to Orgrimmar and seek out Thrall.

Objectives.text: 前往奥格瑞玛的格罗玛什堡垒，向萨尔报到。
Objectives.english: Report to Thrall at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

Description.text: 酋长需要你，勇士。奥格瑞玛进入了全城戒严状态，一场不可避免的冲突迫在眉睫。酋长已经下令关闭所有的商店和服务设施，全面备战。$B$B我不能透露更多的消息了——至少现在不能。在这样的场合跟你谈论局势也不合适。$B$B酋长传下令来，部落最强大的勇士必须立即赶往王座厅向他报到。去吧，$n！穿过传送门返回奥格瑞玛，向萨尔报到。
Description.english: The Warchief needs you, champion. Orgrimmar is in a state of martial law. All merchants and services have been shut down as the Warchief prepares for an unavoidable conflict.$B$BI cannot tell you much more - not now. Not in this place.$B$BThe Warchief commands that our strongest champions report to his throne room. Go now, $n! Take the portal back to Orgrimmar and seek out Thrall.

identity.title: Blow it Up!
identity.objectives: Go to the nearby Saronite Bomb Stack to light the fuse.
identity.description: This is probably as under-control as this situation is going to get.  Let's do this, $n.$B$BI need someone to light the fuse on those bombs and it looks like you're the one to do it.

Objectives.text: 前往附近的萨隆邪铁炸弹堆旁边，点燃引线。
Objectives.english: Go to the nearby Saronite Bomb Stack to light the fuse.

Description.text: 照目前的情况看，局势已经得到了有效的控制。动手吧，$n。$B$B得派个人去点燃引线，你看来就是最佳人选。
Description.english: This is probably as under-control as this situation is going to get.  Let's do this, $n.$B$BI need someone to light the fuse on those bombs and it looks like you're the one to do it.

identity.title: A Life Without Regret
identity.objectives: Take the portal to Undercity located in Grommash Hold and report to Vol'jin.
identity.description: On the day of my death I wish to be able to say that I lived a life without regret. Those who mourn my passing will know that I was a Warchief who made decisions that best served his people.$B$BBut this betrayal by Varimathras and Putress... All that we have worked for is for nothing.$B$B<Thrall's chest heaves with a heavy sigh.>$B$BJustice must be served.$B$BPortals to Undercity will be active momentarily. Vol'jin will be waiting for you. I will meet you there soon. Together we will make it right, $n.

Objectives.text: 從葛羅瑪許堡的傳送門前往幽暗城，並向沃金報到。
Objectives.english: Take the portal to Undercity located in Grommash Hold and report to Vol'jin.

Description.text: 我希望，在我大去之日，我可以昂然地說此生無悔。為我哀悼的人，將知道我身為大酋長，每個決斷都是為了我的子民。$B$B但是瓦里瑪薩斯和普崔司的叛變...我們過去的努力都白費了。$B$B<伴隨著沉重的吐息，索爾的胸口無力地起伏著。>$B$B正義必須被伸張。$B$B往幽暗城的傳送門隨時開著，沃金在那裡等著你。我很快就會在那裡與你相會。我們一起糾正錯誤，$n。
Description.english: On the day of my death I wish to be able to say that I lived a life without regret. Those who mourn my passing will know that I was a Warchief who made decisions that best served his people.$B$BBut this betrayal by Varimathras and Putress... All that we have worked for is for nothing.$B$B<Thrall's chest heaves with a heavy sigh.>$B$BJustice must be served.$B$BPortals to Undercity will be active momentarily. Vol'jin will be waiting for you. I will meet you there soon. Together we will make it right, $n.

identity.title: The Battle For The Undercity
identity.objectives: Assist Thrall and Sylvanas in retaking the Undercity for the Horde.$B$BReport to Thrall should you succeed.
identity.description: The entirety of the Undercity is controlled by Varimathras. Our soldiers stand ready, waiting for the Warchief to give the attack orders.$B$BHelp the Horde take back the Undercity and earn your place among our greatest champions! Should you survive the assault, report to Thrall.$B$BCheck in with the Warchief when you are ready to begin.

Objectives.text: 帮助萨尔和希尔瓦娜斯为部落夺回幽暗城。$B$B完成任务后向萨尔复命。
Objectives.english: Assist Thrall and Sylvanas in retaking the Undercity for the Horde.$B$BReport to Thrall should you succeed.

Description.text: 瓦里玛萨斯已经控制了整座幽暗城。我们的士兵整装待发，只等酋长发出进攻的指令。$B$B只要帮助我们夺回幽暗城，你就可以跻身部落最伟大的勇士之列！如果你能从战场上活着回来，就去向萨尔复命吧。$B$B准备就绪后和酋长谈一谈。
Description.english: The entirety of the Undercity is controlled by Varimathras. Our soldiers stand ready, waiting for the Warchief to give the attack orders.$B$BHelp the Horde take back the Undercity and earn your place among our greatest champions! Should you survive the assault, report to Thrall.$B$BCheck in with the Warchief when you are ready to begin.

identity.title: A Voice in the Dark
identity.objectives: Investigate the nearby voice in Naz'anak, the Forgotten Depths.
identity.description: The object is not a crystal at all, but some form of organ, encased in ice.$B$BAs you touch it, your hand reels in horrible pain.  You feel as if your hand has been cut, yet there is no visible wound.$B$BAs you collect your thoughts, you hear a young boy's voice nearby.$B$B"You really shouldn't have done that."

Objectives.text: 在纳扎纳克：遗忘深渊里调查这个声音的来源。
Objectives.english: Investigate the nearby voice in Naz'anak, the Forgotten Depths.

Description.text: 这东西根本不是水晶，而是某种被寒冰包裹的器官。$B$B当你碰到它的时候，你的手上传来一阵剧痛。你觉得自己的手仿佛被砍掉了一样，但却看到不任何伤口。$B$B当你再次集中精神时，你听见附近有一个小男孩的声音在飘荡。$B$B“你真的不该那么做的。”
Description.english: The object is not a crystal at all, but some form of organ, encased in ice.$B$BAs you touch it, your hand reels in horrible pain.  You feel as if your hand has been cut, yet there is no visible wound.$B$BAs you collect your thoughts, you hear a young boy's voice nearby.$B$B"You really shouldn't have done that."

identity.title: Time to Hide
identity.objectives: Matthias Lehner wants you to obtain 3 Faceless One's Blood.
identity.description: You shouldn't have touched it.  But now that you did, he's going to come looking for you.$B$BAnd he'll find you.  Unless you hide yourself from him.$B$BBring me blood from the faceless ones if you want to live!

Objectives.text: 米斯希尔萨·阿奈尔要你收集3份无面者之血。
Objectives.english: Matthias Lehner wants you to obtain 3 Faceless One's Blood.

Description.text: 你不该碰它的。但你已经碰过了，他很快就会来找你。$B$B他一定会找到你，除非你能躲藏起来，不让他发现。$B$B如果你还想活下去，就去弄一些无面者的鲜血回来！
Description.english: You shouldn't have touched it.  But now that you did, he's going to come looking for you.$B$BAnd he'll find you.  Unless you hide yourself from him.$B$BBring me blood from the faceless ones if you want to live!

identity.title: Return to the Surface
identity.objectives: Return to Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
identity.description: You should leave now.  You'll find a portal behind me.  It'll take you to the surface.$B$BWe'll meet again.  He'll be looking for you.$B$BIt's only a matter of time until he finds you.

Objectives.text: 返回奥格瑞姆之锤，向库尔迪拉·织亡者复命。
Objectives.english: Return to Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer.

Description.text: 现在你该走了。我身后有一道传送门，它可以把你送到地面上去。$B$B我们还会见面的。他会来找你。$B$B他迟早会找到你。
Description.english: You should leave now.  You'll find a portal behind me.  It'll take you to the surface.$B$BWe'll meet again.  He'll be looking for you.$B$BIt's only a matter of time until he finds you.

identity.title: Keeping the Alliance Blind
identity.objectives: Use the SGM-3 to destroy 6 Skybreaker Recon Fighters, then report back to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
identity.description: The Alliance is tenacious, I'll give them that, but it'll take more than that to stop us. Take this SGM-3 with you and shoot down the Skybreaker's recon fighters once again.$B$BI doubt the message will get through their thick skulls, but there are enough missiles to keep trying to get our point across. Go and find their fighters flying above the Valley of Fallen Heroes, west of Aldur'thar, and don't come back until you've made wreckage of them.

Objectives.text: 使用SGM-3摧毁6架破天号侦查机，然后向奥格瑞姆之锤的掠天者考尔姆·黑痕复命。
Objectives.english: Use the SGM-3 to destroy 6 Skybreaker Recon Fighters, then report back to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar aboard Orgrim's Hammer.

Description.text: 联盟真是百折不挠，有骨气！但是如果他们想要阻止我们的话，就要付出更大的代价。带上这套SGM-3，再去打下来几架破天号侦查机。$B$B我很怀疑他们那可怜的头脑够不够用，不过足够的导弹应该可以清楚地表达我们的立场了。到奥尔杜萨西面的陨落英雄之谷去，找到他们的侦察机。不把它们打下来，就别回来见我。
Description.english: The Alliance is tenacious, I'll give them that, but it'll take more than that to stop us. Take this SGM-3 with you and shoot down the Skybreaker's recon fighters once again.$B$BI doubt the message will get through their thick skulls, but there are enough missiles to keep trying to get our point across. Go and find their fighters flying above the Valley of Fallen Heroes, west of Aldur'thar, and don't come back until you've made wreckage of them.

identity.title: Reborn From The Ashes
identity.objectives: Gather Fordragon's Shield from the field of battle at Angrathar the Wrath Gate and return it to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
identity.description: Our fate is emblazoned upon our souls at birth. Bolvar's fall, while tragic, was unavoidable.$B$BAll that you can do now is honor your hero, $n. Collect Bolvar's shield from the field of battle and return it to your king. When you present the shield to Varian, tell him this: "All is not lost. From the ashes of the fallen will rise a force that will unite nations and purge the evil from this world."$B$BHe mustn't lose faith. Go now, $n. Your people need a hero. They need you.

Objectives.text: 从天谴之门安加萨的战场上取回弗塔根之盾，把它交给暴风城要塞中的瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王。
Objectives.english: Gather Fordragon's Shield from the field of battle at Angrathar the Wrath Gate and return it to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.

Description.text: 我们的命运在出生时就已注定。伯瓦尔之死虽然是一场悲剧，但这也是不可避免的。$B$B现在你所能做的，就是向英雄致敬，$n。从战场上把伯瓦尔的盾牌拿回来，将其交给你的国王。在你将盾牌交给瓦里安的时候，告诉他：“我们并没有失去一切。死去的英雄将会使我们变得更加团结，齐心协力将邪恶从这个世界中驱赶出去。”$B$B他一定不能失去信仰。去吧，$n。你的人民需要一个英雄，他们需要你。
Description.english: Our fate is emblazoned upon our souls at birth. Bolvar's fall, while tragic, was unavoidable.$B$BAll that you can do now is honor your hero, $n. Collect Bolvar's shield from the field of battle and return it to your king. When you present the shield to Varian, tell him this: "All is not lost. From the ashes of the fallen will rise a force that will unite nations and purge the evil from this world."$B$BHe mustn't lose faith. Go now, $n. Your people need a hero. They need you.

CompletionLog.text: 去暴风城找暴风要塞的瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王。
CompletionLog.english: Return to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind.

identity.title: Argent Aid
identity.objectives: Speak to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Crusader's Pinnacle.
identity.description: There were rumors about the events you speak of among the death knights.  I always expected the story to be more... symbolic.$B$BWe must warn others, but we must be discreet.  As soon as the Lich King knows we're making our move, he'll move the location of the heart -- we'll never get a chance like this again.$B$BThe Horde and the Alliance have been infiltrated by the Cult of the Damned before.  The Ebon Blade operates too close to the Scourge.$B$BWe have to speak to Tirion Fordring and his Argent Crusade.

Objectives.text: 与北伐军之峰的大领主提里奥·弗丁谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Crusader's Pinnacle.

Description.text: 以前，死亡骑士们一直把你说的这些事当作故事来讲，而我总觉得它并不仅仅是一个象征性的故事那么简单……果不其然。$B$B我们必须警告其他人，但你我必须分头行动。一旦巫妖王知晓了我们的计划，他就会把那颗心转移到其它地方去——那样一来，我们就再也等不到这么好的机会了。$B$B诅咒教派已经渗透了部落和联盟，黑锋骑士团和天灾军团的关系又太过密切。$B$B我们要去和提里奥·弗丁及他的银色北伐军谈一谈。
Description.english: There were rumors about the events you speak of among the death knights.  I always expected the story to be more... symbolic.$B$BWe must warn others, but we must be discreet.  As soon as the Lich King knows we're making our move, he'll move the location of the heart -- we'll never get a chance like this again.$B$BThe Horde and the Alliance have been infiltrated by the Cult of the Damned before.  The Ebon Blade operates too close to the Scourge.$B$BWe have to speak to Tirion Fordring and his Argent Crusade.

identity.title: Fate, Up Against Your Will
identity.objectives: Assist Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Orgrimmar. Speak to the Warchief of the Horde, Thrall, at Orgrimmar on the continent of Kalimdor.
identity.description: At the behest of Lady Proudmoore, I will allow a diplomatic mission to Orgrimmar to question the Horde's Warchief, Thrall. You will assist her in this journey and keep her safe from harm. Return to me with news from Orgrimmar.$B$BSpeak to Jaina when you are ready to leave.

Objectives.text: 陪同吉安娜·普罗德摩尔前往卡利姆多大陆的奥格瑞玛，与部落的萨尔酋长交谈。
Objectives.english: Assist Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Orgrimmar. Speak to the Warchief of the Horde, Thrall, at Orgrimmar on the continent of Kalimdor.

Description.text: 根据普罗德摩尔女士的要求，我允许她作为外交使节前往奥格瑞玛，质问部落的萨尔酋长。我会派你协助她，保证她的安全。把奥格瑞玛的消息带回来告诉我。$B$B等你做好出发的准备之后，就去跟吉安娜谈谈吧。
Description.english: At the behest of Lady Proudmoore, I will allow a diplomatic mission to Orgrimmar to question the Horde's Warchief, Thrall. You will assist her in this journey and keep her safe from harm. Return to me with news from Orgrimmar.$B$BSpeak to Jaina when you are ready to leave.

identity.title: A Royal Coup
identity.objectives: Use the portal in Grommash Hold to return to Stormwind Keep and deliver Thrall's message to King Varian Wrynn.
identity.description: Your champion, Bolvar, died in defense of our world. The Horde is saddened by the loss of such a great hero, but the Horde was not responsible for the cowardly attacks made by Putress at the Wrath Gate. We have also lost mighty heroes because of this betrayal.$B$BTell your king that we will do everything in our power to bring the perpetrators of this cowardly act to justice. We will do all that we can to avoid conflict with the Alliance, but we will not hesitate to defend ourselves if provoked.

Objectives.text: 使用格罗玛什堡垒中的传送门返回暴风要塞，把萨尔的讯息转达给瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王。
Objectives.english: Use the portal in Grommash Hold to return to Stormwind Keep and deliver Thrall's message to King Varian Wrynn.

Description.text: 你们的勇士伯瓦尔为保卫我们这个世界而牺牲了。我们部落同样为了失去这样一位伟大的英雄而感到悲伤，但部落并不应该为普特雷斯在天谴之门发动的偷袭而负责。我们也因为这次背叛失去了一位伟大的英雄。$B$B告诉你的国王，我们会尽一切努力将这次事件的主谋绳之以法。我们也会尽全力避免与联盟发生冲突，不过如果我们受到挑衅，部落也会毫不犹豫地进行自卫。
Description.english: Your champion, Bolvar, died in defense of our world. The Horde is saddened by the loss of such a great hero, but the Horde was not responsible for the cowardly attacks made by Putress at the Wrath Gate. We have also lost mighty heroes because of this betrayal.$B$BTell your king that we will do everything in our power to bring the perpetrators of this cowardly act to justice. We will do all that we can to avoid conflict with the Alliance, but we will not hesitate to defend ourselves if provoked.

identity.title: The Killing Time
identity.objectives: Use the Portal to the Undercity inside Stormwind Keep to teleport to the Undercity. Report to Broll Bearmantle when you arrive at your destination.
identity.description: I sent Broll and Valeera to the Undercity before you left for Orgrimmar. In fact, they're now stationed outside the sewer entrance to the ruins, awaiting orders.$B$BLady Proudmoore will open a portal to our forces outside the Undercity. Go there and report to Broll. Jaina and I will be close behind.

Objectives.text: 使用暴风要塞内的通往幽暗城的传送门前往幽暗城。到达目的地之后，向布罗尔·熊皮报到。
Objectives.english: Use the Portal to the Undercity inside Stormwind Keep to teleport to the Undercity. Report to Broll Bearmantle when you arrive at your destination.

Description.text: 在你从奥格瑞玛回来之前，我就派了布罗尔和瓦莉拉前往幽暗城。事实上，他们现在已经驻扎在通往废墟的下水道入口外面，等待着我的命令。$B$B普罗德摩尔女士会开启一道传送门，穿过它就可以直达幽暗城外，与我们的部队汇合。去向布罗尔和瓦莉拉报到吧，我稍后就到。
Description.english: I sent Broll and Valeera to the Undercity before you left for Orgrimmar. In fact, they're now stationed outside the sewer entrance to the ruins, awaiting orders.$B$BLady Proudmoore will open a portal to our forces outside the Undercity. Go there and report to Broll. Jaina and I will be close behind.

identity.title: Fringe Science Benefits
identity.objectives: Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 40 Bombardment Infantry, 8 Bombardment Captains and 15 Gargoyle Ambushers.
identity.description: I installed our infra-green technology into commandeered bombers; it'll protect you on your first mission into enemy territory!  Speak with Rizzy Ratchwiggle to get a bomber, then fly into The Bombardment!$B$BYou'll have bombs and rockets and shields.  Keep the shields charged and use bombs on the ground Scourge at The Bombardment.  Come back after you hit your targets, and more work will await you.

Objectives.text: 边缘技师塔兹拉要你去杀死40个轰炸场步兵、80个轰炸场军官和15只石像鬼伏击者。
Objectives.english: Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 40 Bombardment Infantry, 8 Bombardment Captains and 15 Gargoyle Ambushers.

Description.text: 我在征用来的轰炸机上安装了绿外线装置，它可以在你进入敌占区执行任务时保护你！去向莉兹·拉齐维格要一架轰炸机，然后飞向轰炸场！$B$B我们会给你配备轰炸机、火箭和护盾。你要保持护盾处于激活状态，并用炸弹攻击轰炸场中的天灾军团。击中目标后立即回来，这里还有很多工作等着你呢。
Description.english: I installed our infra-green technology into commandeered bombers; it'll protect you on your first mission into enemy territory!  Speak with Rizzy Ratchwiggle to get a bomber, then fly into The Bombardment!$B$BYou'll have bombs and rockets and shields.  Keep the shields charged and use bombs on the ground Scourge at The Bombardment.  Come back after you hit your targets, and more work will await you.

CompletionLog.text: 去冰冠冰川找荒凉之门奥尔杜萨的边缘技师塔兹拉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Fringe Engineer Tezzla at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.

identity.title: Total Ohmage: The Valley of Lost Hope!
identity.objectives: Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 20 Gargoyle Ambushers, 12 Frostbrood Sentries and 12 Scourge War Machines.
identity.description: $n, the struggle continues.  Lucky for us, we're stocked up on bombs and rockets!  Time for another bombing mission  --  this one's a long one, through the Bombardment and into the Valley of Lost Hope.  Head back out with an infra-green bomber and blow those Scourge into little scourge-lets!

Title.english: Total Ohmage: The Valley of Lost Hope!

Objectives.text: 偏激工程師泰茲菈要你殺掉50個轟炸地步兵、20個石像鬼伏擊者、12個霜育哨兵與12部天譴戰爭機器。
Objectives.english: Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 20 Gargoyle Ambushers, 12 Frostbrood Sentries and 12 Scourge War Machines.

Description.text: $n，對方還在垂死掙扎。幸運地，我們庫存的彈藥還不少!再來一趟轟炸 -- 這次，沿途要經過轟炸地深入逝望山谷。掉頭回來順便用綠外線炸彈把那些天譴軍團通通炸成天譴碎片。
Description.english: $n, the struggle continues.  Lucky for us, we're stocked up on bombs and rockets!  Time for another bombing mission  --  this one's a long one, through the Bombardment and into the Valley of Lost Hope.  Head back out with an infra-green bomber and blow those Scourge into little scourge-lets!

CompletionLog.text: 到寒冰皇冠的奧多薩:荒寂之門找偏激工程師泰茲菈。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Fringe Engineer Tezzla at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.

identity.title: The Battle For The Undercity
identity.objectives: Assist King Varian Wrynn and Lady Jaina Proudmoore in bringing Grand Apothecary Putress to justice! Report to King Varian Wrynn should you succeed.
identity.description: Deep inside the bowels of the Undercity hides the assassin responsible for the deaths of Bolvar and our brave soldiers at the Wrath Gate.$B$BVarian has brought the full might of the Alliance with him to assist in the take down. Join him and Lady Proudmoore in the manhunt and earn your place among the greatest champions of the Alliance!$B$BSpeak to King Varian Wrynn when you are ready.

Objectives.text: 协助瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王和吉安娜·普罗德摩尔，剿灭大药剂师普特雷斯！$B$B成功之后，向瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王报告。
Objectives.english: Assist King Varian Wrynn and Lady Jaina Proudmoore in bringing Grand Apothecary Putress to justice! Report to King Varian Wrynn should you succeed.

Description.text: 在天谴之门杀害伯瓦尔和勇敢的联盟士兵的罪魁祸首，眼下就躲藏在幽暗城的深处。$B$B瓦里安已经带着联盟最强大的部队前来支援这次行动了。加入他和普罗德摩尔女士的队伍，与这些最伟大的联盟勇士们并肩战斗！$B$B等你准备好了之后，就去告诉瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王。
Description.english: Deep inside the bowels of the Undercity hides the assassin responsible for the deaths of Bolvar and our brave soldiers at the Wrath Gate.$B$BVarian has brought the full might of the Alliance with him to assist in the take down. Join him and Lady Proudmoore in the manhunt and earn your place among the greatest champions of the Alliance!$B$BSpeak to King Varian Wrynn when you are ready.

CompletionLog.text: 去暴风城找暴风要塞的瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王。
CompletionLog.english: Return to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.

identity.title: Chief Engineer Copperclaw
identity.objectives: Speak with Chief Engineer Copperclaw.
identity.description: Speak with Chief Engineer Copperclaw.

Objectives.text: 与首席技师考伯克拉谈谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Chief Engineer Copperclaw.

Description.text: 与首席技师考伯克拉谈谈。
Description.english: Speak with Chief Engineer Copperclaw.

identity.title: Green Technology
identity.objectives: Speak with Fringe Engineer Tezzla.
identity.description: Tezzla is the one you want to meet, yes she is... she mastered a new wavelength, infra-green, and used it to hide herself near the Scourge!  Near enough to bomb them!$B$BI'll give you infra-green vision so you can find her hiding above Aldur'thar, the Desolation Gate.  Go, go... I know she has work for brave heroes eager to blow up!  I mean... eager to blow up the Scourge!$B$BAnd $n, the Alliance has stolen our technology and has their own hidden airport nearby.  Avoid the dome with the Alliance banners!

Objectives.text: 与边缘技师塔兹拉谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Fringe Engineer Tezzla.

Description.text: 你应该去见一见塔兹拉。嗯，你真的应该去见见她。她掌握了一种被称为“绿外线”的新波长。她可以使用这种光波在天灾军团的眼皮底下隐藏行迹！距离之近，足够轰炸他们了！$B$B我会给你绿外线视界，这样你就可以找到她了。她就藏身在荒凉之门奥尔杜萨上面。去吧，去吧……我知道她一直在为那些急着上西天的英雄提供帮助！我是说……急着把天灾军团送上西天！$B$B另外，$n，联盟剽窃了我们的技术，他们的隐形机场也在附近。你要绕开那座插着联盟旗帜的圆顶！
Description.english: Tezzla is the one you want to meet, yes she is... she mastered a new wavelength, infra-green, and used it to hide herself near the Scourge!  Near enough to bomb them!$B$BI'll give you infra-green vision so you can find her hiding above Aldur'thar, the Desolation Gate.  Go, go... I know she has work for brave heroes eager to blow up!  I mean... eager to blow up the Scourge!$B$BAnd $n, the Alliance has stolen our technology and has their own hidden airport nearby.  Avoid the dome with the Alliance banners!

identity.title: Leading the Charge
identity.objectives: Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill 40 Bombardment Infantry, 8 Bombardment Captains and 15 Gargoyle Ambushers.
identity.description: Infra-green technology allows us to stay hidden here, right over the Scourge's nose!  What's more, we installed infra-green in specially constructed bombers... but not to hide them, no!  We use infra-green tech to shield them!$B$BSpeak with Karen No and request a bomber.  Fly it over the Bombardment... use its shields and turret to protect yourself, and use the bomb launcher to hit Scourge targets.  Practice well, then return to me and I'll have an even more vital mission for you!

Objectives.text: 吉普利·基罗赫斯要你去杀死40个轰炸场步兵、8个轰炸场军官和15只石像鬼伏击者。
Objectives.english: Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill 40 Bombardment Infantry, 8 Bombardment Captains and 15 Gargoyle Ambushers.

Description.text: 绿外线技术可以让我们在天灾军团的鼻子底下大摇大摆地行动！而且，我们把这种技术应用到了专门制造的轰炸机上……但不是为了隐藏它们，完全不是那么回事！我们用绿外线技术来保护它们！$B$B去向卡伦·诺尔要一架轰炸机，然后飞到轰炸场上空……用它的护盾和炮台保护自己，并使用投弹器攻击天灾军团。好好练习一下，然后再回来找我。我还有很多更重要的任务要交给你呢！
Description.english: Infra-green technology allows us to stay hidden here, right over the Scourge's nose!  What's more, we installed infra-green in specially constructed bombers... but not to hide them, no!  We use infra-green tech to shield them!$B$BSpeak with Karen No and request a bomber.  Fly it over the Bombardment... use its shields and turret to protect yourself, and use the bomb launcher to hit Scourge targets.  Practice well, then return to me and I'll have an even more vital mission for you!

CompletionLog.text: 去冰冠冰川找荒凉之门奥尔杜萨的吉普利·基罗赫斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kibli Killohertz at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.

identity.title: Watts My Target
identity.objectives: Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill Bombardment Infantry, Gargoyle Ambushers, Frostbrood Sentries and Scourge War Machines.
identity.description: Put on your lucky socks, $n, and say your favorite prayers.  This next mission will test your wit and fortitude like a visit from the in-laws!$B$BRequest another bomber from Karen No.  Take it beyond The Bombardment and over the Valley of Lost Hope.  You have more targets this time, both on the land an in the air.  Keep your shields charged and your ammo loaded, $n!  I'll see you when it's over.

Description.text: 帶好你的幸運符，$n，選篇你最喜歡的禱告辭。下個任務就要測試你的反應跟耐性，好像你丈母娘要來一樣! $B$B找凱倫·諾談話再索取一架轟炸機。駕著它飛越轟炸地深入逝望山谷。這次的目標更多，天上飛的跟地上爬的都有。看好你的護盾，子彈通通上膛，$n！結束以後回來找我。
Description.english: Put on your lucky socks, $n, and say your favorite prayers.  This next mission will test your wit and fortitude like a visit from the in-laws!$B$BRequest another bomber from Karen No.  Take it beyond The Bombardment and over the Valley of Lost Hope.  You have more targets this time, both on the land an in the air.  Keep your shields charged and your ammo loaded, $n!  I'll see you when it's over.

Objectives.text: 碁伯里·基羅赫茲要你殺掉轟炸地步兵、石像鬼伏擊者、霜育哨兵與天譴戰爭機器。
Objectives.english: Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill Bombardment Infantry, Gargoyle Ambushers, Frostbrood Sentries and Scourge War Machines.

identity.title: Putting the Hertz: The Valley of Lost Hope
identity.objectives: Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 20 Gargoyle Ambushers, 12 Frostbrood Sentries and 12 Scourge War Machines.
identity.description: The fight goes on!  Your new orders arrived for a long-range bombing mission through the Bombardment and into the Valley of Lost Hope -- when you're ready, ask Karen for a bomber and pour those bombs and rockets onto the Scourge!

Title.text: 长途轰炸：失落希望之谷
Title.english: Putting the Hertz: The Valley of Lost Hope

Objectives.text: 吉普利·基罗赫斯要你去杀死50个轰炸场步兵、20只石像鬼伏击者和12条霜巢斥候，并摧毁12架天灾战车。
Objectives.english: Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 20 Gargoyle Ambushers, 12 Frostbrood Sentries and 12 Scourge War Machines.

Description.text: 战争还在继续！我有新指令要下达给你。这次轰炸任务的航线很长，你要飞过轰炸场，进入失落希望之谷——你准备好了之后，就去向卡伦领一架轰炸机，对那些天灾军团狂轰滥炸一番吧！
Description.english: The fight goes on!  Your new orders arrived for a long-range bombing mission through the Bombardment and into the Valley of Lost Hope -- when you're ready, ask Karen for a bomber and pour those bombs and rockets onto the Scourge!

CompletionLog.text: 去冰冠冰川找荒凉之门奥尔杜萨的吉普利·基罗赫斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kibli Killohertz at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.

identity.title: Killohertz
identity.objectives: Chief Engineer Boltwrench wants you to find Kibli Killohertz at the hidden Alliance airport above Aldur'thar, the Desolation Gate.
identity.description: The goblins got lucky and found a new energy.  They call it infra-green, and I'll be a one-eyed ogre if those psychos didn't strike green gold.$B$BGo find Kibli Killohertz.  He's leading the reverse engineering efforts of infra-green, at a small, hidden Alliance airport above Aldur'thar, the Desolation Gate.  I'll give you infra-green vision to help you find it.  Go to the dome with our Alliance banners -- if you fly near the Horde airport then you'll be in a load of green trouble.

Objectives.text: 首席技师波尔维克要你前往荒凉之门奥尔杜萨上空的联盟隐形机场，并与吉普利·基罗赫斯谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Chief Engineer Boltwrench wants you to find Kibli Killohertz at the hidden Alliance airport above Aldur'thar, the Desolation Gate.

Description.text: 地精们幸运地发现了一种新能量。他们管这种能量叫“绿外线”。怎么说呢……如果这些疯子发现了一种新的金子，而它居然不是绿的，那我都能变成独眼食人魔了。$B$B我要你去找吉普利·基罗赫斯。他在荒凉之门奥尔杜萨上空的一座小型隐形联盟机场上，领导着绿外线的逆向工程研究。我会给你绿外线视界，这样你就可以找到他了。到插着联盟旗帜的那座圆顶上去吧——但是如果你飞到部落的机场附近的话，你就会遇到大麻烦了，而且还是绿色的麻烦。
Description.english: The goblins got lucky and found a new energy.  They call it infra-green, and I'll be a one-eyed ogre if those psychos didn't strike green gold.$B$BGo find Kibli Killohertz.  He's leading the reverse engineering efforts of infra-green, at a small, hidden Alliance airport above Aldur'thar, the Desolation Gate.  I'll give you infra-green vision to help you find it.  Go to the dome with our Alliance banners -- if you fly near the Horde airport then you'll be in a load of green trouble.

identity.title: Riding the Wavelength: The Bombardment
identity.objectives: Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 10 Bombardment Captains and 20 Gargoyle Ambushers.
identity.description: Ready to warm up with a short bombing mission?  You have your orders, and we have our bombers stocked and ready.

Objectives.text: 偏激工程師泰茲菈要你殺掉50個轟炸地步兵、10個轟炸地隊長與20個石像鬼伏擊者。
Objectives.english: Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 10 Bombardment Captains and 20 Gargoyle Ambushers.

Description.text: 準備暖個身進行個短程任務嗎?你應該已經接到指令，你的轟炸機已經準備就緒了。
Description.english: Ready to warm up with a short bombing mission?  You have your orders, and we have our bombers stocked and ready.

identity.title: The Brothers Bronzebeard
identity.objectives: Accompany Brann Bronzebeard and his flying machine to Frosthold.
identity.description: That does it! We finally have the keystone... It's beautiful! I've been around the world more than once, but this thing's got me all jittery with excitement again. I suppose now's not the time to stop and admire though, we need to get the heck out of here.$B$BHop on my flying machine and help keep us covered from those iron dwarves on the way out!

Objectives.text: 陪同布萊恩·銅鬚，搭乘其飛行器前往霜堡。
Objectives.english: Accompany Brann Bronzebeard and his flying machine to Frosthold.

Description.text: 成功了!我們終於拿到拱心石了...它好美啊!我曾經多次環遊世界，但這東西又再次喚起了我的不安與興奮。不過，我想現在不是呆呆的站著看的時候了，我們得快點逃出去。$B$B跳上我的飛行器，在出去的路上幫忙掩護我!
Description.english: That does it! We finally have the keystone... It's beautiful! I've been around the world more than once, but this thing's got me all jittery with excitement again. I suppose now's not the time to stop and admire though, we need to get the heck out of here.$B$BHop on my flying machine and help keep us covered from those iron dwarves on the way out!

CompletionLog.text: 去风暴峭壁找冰霜堡的维罗格·冰啸。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Velog Icebellow at Frosthold in The Storm Peaks.

identity.title: Back to the Pit
identity.objectives: Gretta the Arbiter, in Brunnhildar Village, wants you to use the Reins of the Icemaw Matriarch inside the Pit of the Fang and defeat 6 Hyldsmeet Warbears.
identity.description: To truly stay in your best riding shape you'll want to test yourself against the other Hyldnir every day.$B$BHead back into the Pit of the Fang and show them what you're capable of.  They'll appreciate suffering defeat to one as skilled as yourself.

Objectives.text: 布伦希尔达村的仲裁者格蕾塔要你在利齿之坑内使用冰喉母熊的缰绳，击败6头海德比武会战熊。
Objectives.english: Gretta the Arbiter, in Brunnhildar Village, wants you to use the Reins of the Icemaw Matriarch inside the Pit of the Fang and defeat 6 Hyldsmeet Warbears.

Description.text: 为了保持巅峰状态，每天你都必须与别的海德尼尔人战斗，以此磨练自己。$B$B请你返回利齿之坑，向她们展示一下你的力量。能被你这样出色的战士击败，是她们的荣幸。
Description.english: To truly stay in your best riding shape you'll want to test yourself against the other Hyldnir every day.$B$BHead back into the Pit of the Fang and show them what you're capable of.  They'll appreciate suffering defeat to one as skilled as yourself.

identity.title: Call to Arms: Alterac Valley
identity.objectives: Win an Alterac Valley battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran or Shattrath.
identity.description: The reality of fighting on multiple fronts, $g lad : lass;, is that we cannot spread our forces too thin or we risk losing it all!$B$BCritical troop deployments are necessary on a day by day basis.  Today it is the battle for Alterac Valley that's in most need of brave combatants.$B$BGo now, $n, and aid the Stormpike Expedition.  We cannot allow the Frostwolf Clan to get away with the violence they've inflicted on our brethren!

Title.text: 战斗的召唤：奥特兰克山谷

Objectives.text: 在奥特兰克山谷战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意联盟主城、达拉然、冬拥湖或沙塔斯城中的联盟准将复命。
Objectives.english: Win an Alterac Valley battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran or Shattrath.

Description.text: 事实上，我们在多线作战，$g小子:小姑娘;，而且我们不能把军队部署得太过分散，否则我们可能会全盘皆输！$b$b我们需要以天为单位来部署最关键的部队，今天，奥特兰克山谷的战斗最需要勇敢的士兵们！$b$b现在就出发吧，$n，去帮助雷矛远征军。我们不能就这么看着霜狼氏族逃脱他们应受的惩罚。
Description.english: The reality of fighting on multiple fronts, $g lad : lass;, is that we cannot spread our forces too thin or we risk losing it all!$B$BCritical troop deployments are necessary on a day by day basis.  Today it is the battle for Alterac Valley that's in most need of brave combatants.$B$BGo now, $n, and aid the Stormpike Expedition.  We cannot allow the Frostwolf Clan to get away with the violence they've inflicted on our brethren!

CompletionLog.text: 去找联盟准将。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

identity.title: Escape from Silverbrook
identity.objectives: Open the Wooden Cage and help the Freed Alliance Scout escape from Silverbrook.  Report to Lieutenant Dumont when you reach Amberpine Lodge.
identity.description: You... you're not one of them?  Quick!  Let me out!$B$BWe have to get to Amberpine Lodge immediately!  Once Lieutenant Dumont finds out who these people really are, this town will be reduced to rubble!

Objectives.text: 打开木笼，帮助联盟斥候逃出银溪镇。抵达琥珀松木营地后向杜蒙特中尉汇报情况。
Objectives.english: Open the Wooden Cage and help the Freed Alliance Scout escape from Silverbrook.  Report to Lieutenant Dumont when you reach Amberpine Lodge.

Description.text: 你……你不是他们的人？快！快把我放出来！$B$B我们必须马上逃往琥珀松木营地！一旦杜蒙特中尉发现这些家伙的真面目，就会夷平这个镇子！
Description.english: You... you're not one of them?  Quick!  Let me out!$B$BWe have to get to Amberpine Lodge immediately!  Once Lieutenant Dumont finds out who these people really are, this town will be reduced to rubble!

CompletionLog.text: 去灰熊丘陵找琥珀松木营地的杜蒙特中尉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Lieutenant Dumont in Grizzly Hills.

identity.title: Defense of the Stonewrought Dam
identity.objectives: Seek out Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII at the Stonewrought Dam.
identity.description: We appreciate all of your help. We'll regain control of the excavation with a little bit of time, I'm just glad to know that all of our work wasn't destroyed in the process of this occupation.$B$BWe've been greedy enough with your time. I have a friend who could really use some of your help if you have any to lend. Go to the far side of the Loch and you'll find Stonewrought Dam. Once you're there, seek out Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII.

Objectives.text: 去找巨石水坝的主工程师辛德维尔七世。
Objectives.english: Seek out Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII at the Stonewrought Dam.

Description.text: 我们十分感谢你的帮助。不久我们将重新控制挖掘场，很高兴知道在它被占领的时候，我们的心血没有损失。$B$B我们已经占用了你太多的时间了。如果你有意，我还有个朋友非常需要你的帮助。洛克湖的另一头就是巨石水坝，主工程师辛德维尔七世就在那儿等着你。
Description.english: We appreciate all of your help. We'll regain control of the excavation with a little bit of time, I'm just glad to know that all of our work wasn't destroyed in the process of this occupation.$B$BWe've been greedy enough with your time. I have a friend who could really use some of your help if you have any to lend. Go to the far side of the Loch and you'll find Stonewrought Dam. Once you're there, seek out Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII.

identity.title: A Valiant Of Ironforge
identity.objectives: Speak with Lana Stouthammer at the Argent Tournament Grounds to become a valiant of Ironforge.
identity.description: You've proven yourself worthy of competing under the banner of Ironforge, $n. Now, you should introduce yourself to Lana Stouthammer, who leads the Ironforge delegation. As Ironforge's grand champion, she will enter you into the tournament on behalf of the city and oversee your training and testing as valiant.$B$BIt has been an honor working with you, $n, and I wish you luck in the competition ahead.

Objectives.text: 与银色比武场的拉娜·硬锤谈一谈，成为铁炉堡的勇士。
Objectives.english: Speak with Lana Stouthammer at the Argent Tournament Grounds to become a valiant of Ironforge.

Description.text: $n，你证明了自己有资格代表铁炉堡作战。现在你应该去和兰娜·硬锤谈一谈，她是铁炉堡代表团的领队。作为铁炉堡的总冠军，她会安排你代表铁炉堡参加锦标赛，并监督你进行训练，以通过勇士的考验。$B$B和你一起工作是我的荣耀，$n，在今后的战斗中也祝你好运。

identity.description: My sword was lost at sea.  Catch it and bring it back!

Objectives.text: 晶歌森林的老渔夫巴尔洛要你把骑士之剑交给他。
Objectives.english: Old Man Barlo in Crystalsong Forest wants you to bring him the Sword of Knighthood.

Description.text: 我的剑掉到海里去了。帮我找回来吧！
Description.english: My sword was lost at sea.  Catch it and bring it back!

CompletionLog.text: 去找泰罗卡森林的老渔夫巴尔洛。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Old Man Barlo in Terokkar Forest.

identity.objectives: Speak with Eressea Dawnsinger again if you wish to become a valiant of Silvermoon.
identity.description: So, you have become a champion? Then, you have proven yourself a worthy combatant and I would proudly welcome you into Silvermoon's delegation.$B$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Silvermoon, your gruntling will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.

Objectives.text: 如果你想要成为银月城的勇士，就再找伊蕾希亚·晨歌谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Eressea Dawnsinger again if you wish to become a valiant of Silvermoon.

Description.text: 这么说来，你已经成为冠军了？这说明你是一名称职的斗士，我很荣幸地邀请你参加银月城的代表团。$B$B你可以像以前一样训练并提升自己的级别，不过如果你获得了银月城冠军的称号，就可以在参赛时让你的侍从打出我们的旗帜。
Description.english: So, you have become a champion? Then, you have proven yourself a worthy combatant and I would proudly welcome you into Silvermoon's delegation.$B$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Silvermoon, your gruntling will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.

identity.title: A Champion Rises
identity.objectives: Speak with Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
identity.description: Congratulations, $n. You have mastered many kinds of combat and overcome all the challenges you've faced. There can be no doubt that you are ready to compete with the best warriors who have gathered at the tournament, against the champions of the capital cities.$B$BJusticar Mariel Trueheart has asked to speak with you, $n, and to formally enter you in the grand melee.

Objectives.text: 与银色比武场的裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.

Description.text: 恭喜你，$n。你已经掌握了多种战斗技巧，完成了你遇到的所有挑战。毫无疑问，你已经做好了准备，可以迎战来自各个主城的冠军了。$B$B裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特要与你谈谈，$n，她会正式批准你参加总冠军的角逐。

I have no doubt that you are ready to face down the champions of other cities for the glory of Orgrimmar!$B$BJusticar Mariel Trueheart has asked to speak with you, $n, and to formally enter you in the champions' grand melee.

Objectives.text: 与银色比武场的裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.

Description.text: 你赢得了我的尊重，也赢得了高层的认可。你已经击败了所有的挑战者，掌握了在锦标赛中作战的方法。毫无疑问，你已经准备就绪，有能力面对其它主城的冠军，捍卫暗矛巨魔的荣誉！$B$B裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特要与你谈谈，$n，她会正式批准你参加总冠军的角逐。
Description.english: You have earned my respect and the respect of your peers. You defeated all who challenged you and mastered the ways of tournament combat. I have no doubt that you are ready to face down the champions of other cities for the glory of the Darkspear!$B$BJusticar Mariel Trueheart has asked to speak with you, $n, and to formally enter you in the champions' grand melee.
