identity.title: A Blade Fit For A Champion
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Runok Wildmane at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
identity.description: I've heard that the Alliance champions are seeking after ancient blades for their warriors. We can't afford to let them have that kind of advantage.$B$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, $n. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.

Title.english: A Blade Fit For A Champion

Objectives.text: 找到灰木之剑，把它交给带给银色比武场的鲁诺克·蛮鬃。
Objectives.english: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Runok Wildmane at the Argent Tournament Grounds.

Description.text: 听说联盟的冠军都在为他们的战士寻找古代的兵器，我们可不能让他们占这个便宜。$B$B一个流传于灰熊丘陵的古老传说中提到，那里有位女士为了守护一把剑受到诅咒，变成了一只青蛙。现在她就住在灰木哨站东边的灰木湖岸上，和其它的湖蛙生活在一起。根据传说，唯一能够解除这道诅咒的方法，是有人自愿去亲吻她。不过呢，你要记得先在嘴唇上涂抹这种药膏，然后再去亲吻湖蛙，不然你的嘴上会长疣的。
Description.english: I've heard that the Alliance champions are seeking after ancient blades for their warriors. We can't afford to let them have that kind of advantage.$B$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, $n. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.

identity.title: Where Are My Keys?
identity.objectives: Dr. Fingers wants you to kill his evil clone, Evil Fingers, and retrieve his keys.
identity.description: I can't find my keys -- I suspect my evil twin is at fault. "Take care" of him for me, $n.

Objectives.text: 芬格醫生希望你殺了他的邪惡複製人，邪惡芬格，並取回他的鑰匙。
Objectives.english: Dr. Fingers wants you to kill his evil clone, Evil Fingers, and retrieve his keys.

Description.text: 我找不到我的鑰匙－我猜這是我那一個邪惡雙胞胎的錯。好好幫我「照顧」一下他，$n。
Description.english: I can't find my keys -- I suspect my evil twin is at fault. "Take care" of him for me, $n.

identity.title: The Goblin with Two Brains
identity.objectives: Bring a Slobberfang Murloc Brain Stem to Professor Flozz along the coast.
identity.description: Do you see them, along the shore? Such magnificent specimens! Look at their primitive society in action, working like a well-oiled machine from the lowliest grunt to their leader, who I've named "King Burgrurble."$B$BI must study their brains.$B$BCan you procure an intact Slobberfang Murloc brain stem for me? Kill them - for science!

Objectives.text: 將一個涎牙魚人腦幹帶去海岸給弗洛茲教授。
Objectives.english: Bring a Slobberfang Murloc Brain Stem to Professor Flozz along the coast.

Description.text: 你有看到他們嗎，在岸邊那裡?好令人讚嘆啊!你看這個原始社會的運作，就像上好油的機器一樣，從最低層的蠻兵上至他們的領袖。我把這領袖稱為「布格博王」。$B$B我一定要研究他們的大腦。$B$B你可以拿到一個完整的涎牙魚人的腦幹給我嗎?為了科學，殺了他們!
Description.english: Do you see them, along the shore? Such magnificent specimens! Look at their primitive society in action, working like a well-oiled machine from the lowliest grunt to their leader, who I've named "King Burgrurble."$B$BI must study their brains.$B$BCan you procure an intact Slobberfang Murloc brain stem for me? Kill them - for science!

identity.title: The Blastbolt Brothers
identity.objectives: Speak with Bezzle Blastbolt at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
identity.description: The highlord has tasked me with getting that coliseum completed as soon as possible. We've put our own masons to work on the project, but we found out very quickly that we were going to need help procuring materials. I've hired a couple of goblins, Bezzle Blastbolt and his brother, Bozzle.$B$BThey're supervising construction at the southeastern end of the tournament grounds. Speak with Bezzle and see if he and his brother could use any more help getting the building materials we need.

Objectives.text: 与银色比武场的贝兹尔·布拉斯波谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Bezzle Blastbolt at the Argent Tournament Grounds.

Description.text: 大领主命令我尽快完成这座体育馆。我们派出了所有的石匠加班加点工作，但很快就发现没有足够的建筑材料。我雇了两个地精来帮忙，也就是贝兹尔·布拉斯波和他的兄弟波兹尔·布拉斯波。$B$B他们负责监督比武场东南区域的工程进度。去和贝兹尔谈谈，看看他们兄弟能不能帮我们找些材料来。
Description.english: The highlord has tasked me with getting that coliseum completed as soon as possible. We've put our own masons to work on the project, but we found out very quickly that we were going to need help procuring materials. I've hired a couple of goblins, Bezzle Blastbolt and his brother, Bozzle.$B$BThey're supervising construction at the southeastern end of the tournament grounds. Speak with Bezzle and see if he and his brother could use any more help getting the building materials we need.

identity.title: The Scrapbot Construction Kit
identity.objectives: Interact with the Prototype Console in The Inventor's Library.
identity.description: Searching the databanks of the prototype console reveals schematics for a scrapbot construction kit. With your engineering expertise, you could learn this schematic and produce scrapbot construction kits of your own.

Title.text: 废物贩卖机器人制造器

Objectives.text: 使用创世者的图书馆中的原型机控制台。
Objectives.english: Interact with the Prototype Console in The Inventor's Library.

Description.text: 在数据库中搜索了一番之后，你找到了一张有关废物贩卖机器人制造器的结构图。正好你自己也是工程学方面的专家，因此你可以学习这张结构图，以备将来制造自己的废物贩卖机器人制造器。
Description.english: Searching the databanks of the prototype console reveals schematics for a scrapbot construction kit. With your engineering expertise, you could learn this schematic and produce scrapbot construction kits of your own.

identity.title: Searing Roc Feathers
identity.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to get 5 pieces of Searing Roc Plumage.
identity.description: The hatchling looks at you for a moment, almost as if wondering whether you'll understand. It scrawls a picture of a pair of feathers in the dirt, then points with one claw to the bindings at its elbows and knees.$B$BIt doesn't seem hungry, but what could the feathers be for?$B$BIt must want them for adornments like the ones you've seen on other raptors. The largest feathers come from the searing rocs that congregate around the bones of large creatures in western Tanaris, northeast of Thistleshrub Valley.

Objectives.text: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你给它弄来5根炎鹏的羽毛。
Objectives.english: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to get 5 pieces of Searing Roc Plumage.

Description.text: 这只幼崽一直在看着你，仿佛正在考虑你是否能明白它的意思。它在土地上用爪子画出两根羽毛的图案，然后又指了指绑在它臂肘和膝盖上的东西。$B$B它看上去并不饿，那么它要羽毛干什么？$B$B它一定是想用羽毛做装饰，就像你在其它暴掠龙身上见到过的那样。炎鹏身上的羽毛是所有羽毛之中最大的。这种猛禽生活在塔纳利斯西部，灌木谷的东北方。它们总喜欢聚集在巨大野兽的尸骨周围。
Description.english: The hatchling looks at you for a moment, almost as if wondering whether you'll understand. It scrawls a picture of a pair of feathers in the dirt, then points with one claw to the bindings at its elbows and knees.$B$BIt doesn't seem hungry, but what could the feathers be for?$B$BIt must want them for adornments like the ones you've seen on other raptors. The largest feathers come from the searing rocs that congregate around the bones of large creatures in western Tanaris, northeast of Thistleshrub Valley.

CompletionLog.text: 去找毒皮暴掠幼龙。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.

identity.title: Hungry, Hungry Hatchling
identity.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 15 pieces of Fresh Dinosaur Meat.
identity.description: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe drawings are rough, but you can make out the shapes of diemetradons, stegodons, and pterrordaxes. As the raptor finishes the sketch, it looks up at you, bares its teeth, and makes a biting motion.$B$BYour venomhide hatchling must be craving fresh meat from these animals. Find and kill any type of diematradon, stegodon, or pterrordax in Un'Goro Crater and feed its meat to your hungry hatchling.

Objectives.text: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你喂它15片鲜嫩的恐龙肉。
Objectives.english: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 15 pieces of Fresh Dinosaur Meat.

Description.text: 这只毒皮暴掠龙幼崽用期待的眼神看着你，然后又在土地上画出了一些图案。$B$B这些图案都很粗糙，不过你还是能依稀从里面看出双帆龙，剑龙和翼手龙的形象。这只龙崽画完之后，又向你抬起了头，还露出了牙齿，做了一个咬的动作。$B$B你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽一定是想要吃这些恐龙的肉了。你要在安戈洛环形山找到并猎杀这些双帆龙、剑龙和翼手龙，取得恐龙肉，喂饱你饥饿的龙崽。
Description.english: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe drawings are rough, but you can make out the shapes of diemetradons, stegodons, and pterrordaxes. As the raptor finishes the sketch, it looks up at you, bares its teeth, and makes a biting motion.$B$BYour venomhide hatchling must be craving fresh meat from these animals. Find and kill any type of diematradon, stegodon, or pterrordax in Un'Goro Crater and feed its meat to your hungry hatchling.

identity.title: Poached, Scrambled, Or Raw?
identity.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 12 Silithid Eggs.
identity.description: The venomhide hatchling's stomach growls as it gestures to get your attention. It begins scratching pictures of silithids into the dirt, adding small ovals underneath them. It looks at you hopefully and gestures at the circles.$B$BThey can only mean silithid eggs. The Noxious Lair, in western Tanaris and near the border with Un'Goro Crater, would probably be a great place to find the eggs your little hatchling wants.

Objectives.text: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你喂它12枚异种蝎卵。
Objectives.english: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 12 Silithid Eggs.

Description.text: 这只毒皮暴掠龙崽的肚皮发出“咕咕”的响声。它挥舞胳膊，引起了你的注意。然后它在土地上画出一些异种蝎，又在蝎子下面画了一些小的椭圆形。$B$B那一定是异种蝎的卵。你可以到位于塔纳利斯西部，靠近安戈洛环形山边界的腐化之巢去。那里可是一个收集异种蝎卵的好地方。
Description.english: The venomhide hatchling's stomach growls as it gestures to get your attention. It begins scratching pictures of silithids into the dirt, adding small ovals underneath them. It looks at you hopefully and gestures at the circles.$B$BThey can only mean silithid eggs. The Noxious Lair, in western Tanaris and near the border with Un'Goro Crater, would probably be a great place to find the eggs your little hatchling wants.

CompletionLog.text: 去找毒皮暴掠幼龙。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.

identity.title: Gorishi Grub
identity.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 10 Silithid Meat.
identity.description: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe hatchling's drawings seem to resemble various types of large insects, perhaps the gorishi silithids. The hatchling finishes his picture, then gestures at it with one short arm, snaps its jaws, and licks its lips.$B$BIt must want you to go to the Slithering Scar, in the center of the southern part of Un'Goro Crater, and gather silithid meat. When you have the meat, feed it to your hungry hatchling.

Objectives.text: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你喂它10块异种蝎肉。
Objectives.english: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 10 Silithid Meat.

Description.text: 这只毒皮暴掠龙幼崽用期待的眼神看着你，然后又在土地上画出了一些图案。$B$B这些图案所表现的似乎是一些大型昆虫，一些格里什异种蝎。龙崽画完以后，就用前臂指指图画，凭空猛咬了一口，又舔舔嘴唇。$B$B它一定是想让你去位于安戈洛环形山南部中心处的巨痕谷，在那里收集一些异种蝎肉。得到异种蝎肉之后，就用它来喂养你饥饿的龙崽吧。
Description.english: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe hatchling's drawings seem to resemble various types of large insects, perhaps the gorishi silithids. The hatchling finishes his picture, then gestures at it with one short arm, snaps its jaws, and licks its lips.$B$BIt must want you to go to the Slithering Scar, in the center of the southern part of Un'Goro Crater, and gather silithid meat. When you have the meat, feed it to your hungry hatchling.

CompletionLog.text: 去找毒皮暴掠幼龙。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.

identity.title: Little Orphan Roo Of The Oracles
identity.objectives: Speak to Orphan Matron Aria, then use the Oracle Orphan Whistle to call the orphan you will be taking care of during Children's Week.
identity.description: The orphans have been looking forward to the opportunity to meet friends like you, $n. It's wonderful that you've agreed to take one into your care.$B$BTake this whistle.  With it, you will be able to call for the orphan you have agreed to sponsor.  It will only last for a limited time - not much longer than Children's Week itself, in fact.$B$BPlease, $n, call upon your orphan.  He will be excited to meet you and see the sights of Northrend with you.

Title.english: Little Orphan Roo Of The Oracles

Objectives.text: 同孤儿监护员艾蕊娅交谈，然后使用神谕者孤儿哨召唤你要在儿童周照顾的孤儿。
Objectives.english: Speak to Orphan Matron Aria, then use the Oracle Orphan Whistle to call the orphan you will be taking care of during Children's Week.

Description.text: 孤儿们一直都很期待能有像你这样的朋友，$n。我非常高兴你能答应照顾他们其中的一个。$B$B带上这只哨子。有了它，你随时都能召唤受你照顾的孤儿。你不需要照顾他太久——大概也就是儿童周这段时间。$B$B好了，$n，请召唤你的孤儿吧。他一定会非常喜欢你的。你们一定会在诺森德各处渡过不少愉快的旅程。
Description.english: The orphans have been looking forward to the opportunity to meet friends like you, $n. It's wonderful that you've agreed to take one into your care.$B$BTake this whistle.  With it, you will be able to call for the orphan you have agreed to sponsor.  It will only last for a limited time - not much longer than Children's Week itself, in fact.$B$BPlease, $n, call upon your orphan.  He will be excited to meet you and see the sights of Northrend with you.

identity.title: The Biggest Tree Ever!
identity.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit Grizzlemaw. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you enter the trunk of the great tree.
identity.description: Before there was a big war and we left the village, we remember Soo-say telling us all about the biggest tree ever!$B$BSoo-say call it Grizzlemaw or something. Soo-say tell us it in the middle Grizzle Hills. No, wait, that not what Soo-say say. Soo-say say Grizzly Hills. Now we remember! Tree is big and right in middle of Grizzly Hills. Can't miss!$B$BYou take us there, oki? We see inside of giant tree? Soo-say tell us big bear men live in tree too. Maybe we see them.

Objectives.text: 带着你的孤儿鲁鲁前往灰喉堡。当你进入到那棵大树的树干里时，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
Objectives.english: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit Grizzlemaw. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you enter the trunk of the great tree.

Description.text: 在大战爆发，我们离开自己的村庄之前，索乌塞和我们讲过历史上最巨大的树！$B$B索乌塞管那棵树叫灰喉堡。索乌塞告诉我们，它就在灰熊丘陵的中央。不，等等，这不是索乌塞说的。索乌塞说的是灰熊丘陵。肯定没错！那棵好大的树就在灰熊丘陵的中央。绝对没有错！$B$B你带我们去那里好不好？我们要好好看看那棵大树。索乌塞告诉我们，有许多大熊怪就住在那棵树里。也许我们还能看见他们呢。
Description.english: Before there was a big war and we left the village, we remember Soo-say telling us all about the biggest tree ever!$B$BSoo-say call it Grizzlemaw or something. Soo-say tell us it in the middle Grizzle Hills. No, wait, that not what Soo-say say. Soo-say say Grizzly Hills. Now we remember! Tree is big and right in middle of Grizzly Hills. Can't miss!$B$BYou take us there, oki? We see inside of giant tree? Soo-say tell us big bear men live in tree too. Maybe we see them.

CompletionLog.text: 去找神谕者孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的神谕者孤儿哨。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

identity.title: Home Of The Bear-Men
identity.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Grizzlemaw. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you enter the trunk of the great tree.
identity.description: High Shaman Rakjak always tell stories of mighty warriors, even ones far away. Sometimes he tell stories about giant bear-men fighting great battle for tree-city.$B$BMaybe you take Kekek there, see tree, see battle! High Shaman Rakjak tell Kekek that giant tree-city Grizzlemaw stand in the middle of Grizzly Hills.$B$BKekek never see a city before meeting orphan lady, but this city have no warriors, only men in purple dresses. Kekek want to see real warriors fight for real city.

Objectives.text: 带着你的孤儿科科前往灰喉堡。当你进入那棵巨树的树干时，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
Objectives.english: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Grizzlemaw. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you enter the trunk of the great tree.

Description.text: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克总是向我们讲强大武士的故事。其中有些故事发生在很远的地方。有时候，他会讲巨大的熊怪为了保卫树城而英勇战斗的故事。$B$B也许你能带科科到那里去，去看看那些大树，还有那里的战场！高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克告诉科科，那座巨大的树城灰喉堡就矗立在灰熊丘陵的正中心。$B$B科科在遇到监护员之前从没有见过一座城市。但这座城市里没有战士，只有穿着紫袍子的人。科科想去看看真正的战士为了真正的城市作战的样子！
Description.english: High Shaman Rakjak always tell stories of mighty warriors, even ones far away. Sometimes he tell stories about giant bear-men fighting great battle for tree-city.$B$BMaybe you take Kekek there, see tree, see battle! High Shaman Rakjak tell Kekek that giant tree-city Grizzlemaw stand in the middle of Grizzly Hills.$B$BKekek never see a city before meeting orphan lady, but this city have no warriors, only men in purple dresses. Kekek want to see real warriors fight for real city.

CompletionLog.text: 去找狼獾人孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的狼獾人孤儿哨。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

identity.title: Another Year, Another Souvenir.
identity.objectives: Redeem the Brewfest Stein Voucher with Blix Fixwidget in the back of the Brewfest camp.
identity.description: Not only are we supplying brew to everyone, we also have steins to give out!  Beautiful, commemorative steins all obtained by the most legal of means!  Here's a voucher for one.$b$bTalk to Blix near the back of the Brewfest camp.  He's pretty strange, even more so now that he's always wearing those goggles.  He'll handle the voucher for you, and any other Brewfest transaction.

Objectives.text: 在美酒节营地背后的布利克斯·菲克维特处兑换礼品券。
Objectives.english: Redeem the Brewfest Stein Voucher with Blix Fixwidget in the back of the Brewfest camp.

Description.text: 我们不仅供应美酒，还独家出售啤酒杯呢！瞧这些漂亮的杯子，非常具有纪念意义哦！这是一张礼品券。$B$B与美酒节营地背后的布利克斯谈一谈。他是个古怪的家伙，总是带着一副护目镜。他负责兑换礼品券，以及出售各类美酒。
Description.english: Not only are we supplying brew to everyone, we also have steins to give out!  Beautiful, commemorative steins all obtained by the most legal of means!  Here's a voucher for one.$b$bTalk to Blix near the back of the Brewfest camp.  He's pretty strange, even more so now that he's always wearing those goggles.  He'll handle the voucher for you, and any other Brewfest transaction.

identity.title: Another Year, Another Souvenir.
identity.objectives: Redeem the Brewfest Stein Voucher with Belbi Quikswitch in the Brewfest camp.
identity.description: Brewfest isn't just about racing rams, it's also about drinking!  When you have a moment, take this voucher to Belbi Quikswitch.  She's near the back of the Brewfest camp.  If you can't see her, don't worry, she'll be sure to see you.$b$bIn any case, take this voucher to her to get your free Brewfest stein.  She'll also be more than happy to handle any and all other Brewfest transactions.

Objectives.text: 在美酒节营地的贝尔比处兑换礼品券。
Objectives.english: Redeem the Brewfest Stein Voucher with Belbi Quikswitch in the Brewfest camp.

Description.text: 美酒节除了赛羊会外，还有一项传统，那就是饮酒狂欢！如果你有时间的话，就将这张礼品券交给贝尔比吧。她就在美酒节营地的后面。要是你看不见她，没关系，她一定会看见你的。$B$B无论如何，将礼品券交给她，你就能免费领到一只美酒节酒杯。她还出售各种美酒哦。
Description.english: Brewfest isn't just about racing rams, it's also about drinking!  When you have a moment, take this voucher to Belbi Quikswitch.  She's near the back of the Brewfest camp.  If you can't see her, don't worry, she'll be sure to see you.$b$bIn any case, take this voucher to her to get your free Brewfest stein.  She'll also be more than happy to handle any and all other Brewfest transactions.

CompletionLog.text: 去找丹莫罗的贝尔比。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Belbi Quikswitch in Dun Morogh.

identity.title: The Bronze Dragonshrine
identity.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit the Bronze Dragonshrine. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
identity.description: Sometimes High-Oracle Soo-say tell stories about a shrine to dragon-things, not like great rain stone, but different. Soo-say tell us maybe we see ourselves there, but not like in a shiny. Soo-say mean we could see what we are like many years from now.$B$BYou take us there? We remember shrine to bronze dragon-things in place called Dragonblight. Soo-say say great rain stone show him shrine to northeast of Wyrmrest Temple, or northwest of place dryskins call Wintergarde Keep. We go?

Objectives.text: 带上你的孤儿鲁鲁前往青铜巨龙圣地。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
Objectives.english: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit the Bronze Dragonshrine. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.

Description.text: 有时候，高阶神谕者索乌塞会讲一些关于一座巨龙祭坛的故事。那和雨水巨石可不一样。索乌塞告诉我们，也许我们能在那里看到我们自己，只不过不会像我们现在这样闪光光。索乌塞的意思是说，我们能在那里看到自己许多年以后的样子。$B$B你要带我们去那里？我们记得青铜巨龙圣地是在一个叫龙骨荒野的地方。索乌塞说，雨水巨石让他知道，那个圣地就在龙眠神殿的东北方，或者是暮冬要塞的西北方。我们现在出发吗？
Description.english: Sometimes High-Oracle Soo-say tell stories about a shrine to dragon-things, not like great rain stone, but different. Soo-say tell us maybe we see ourselves there, but not like in a shiny. Soo-say mean we could see what we are like many years from now.$B$BYou take us there? We remember shrine to bronze dragon-things in place called Dragonblight. Soo-say say great rain stone show him shrine to northeast of Wyrmrest Temple, or northwest of place dryskins call Wintergarde Keep. We go?

CompletionLog.text: 去找神谕者孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的神谕者孤儿哨。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

identity.title: The Bronze Dragonshrine
identity.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit the Bronze Dragonshrine. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
identity.description: When Kekek was a pup, he sometimes heard elders talking about a far-off shrine. Sometimes they say that bronze dragon-things there know all about future.$B$BKekek tell you he be great warrior, now we go see. Bronze dragon-thing shrine somewhere in Dragonblight, northeast of dragon-thing temple called Wyrmrest, also northwest of man-town called Wintergarde.$B$BWe go there, see future. Prove orphan-lady wrong about Kekek. Kekek warrior, not bully.

Objectives.text: 带上你的孤儿科科前往青铜巨龙圣地。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
Objectives.english: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit the Bronze Dragonshrine. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.

Description.text: 当科科还是小孩子的时候，他经常会听长者们说起一个遥远的圣地。有时候，长者们会说，在青铜巨龙圣地能知道关于未来的一切事情。$B$B科科要告诉你，他要成为强大的战士。所以我们现在就要到那里去看看。青铜巨龙圣地就在龙骨荒野，在一个被称作龙眠神殿的东北方，一座被称为暮冬要塞的人类城镇的西北方。$B$B我们要到那里去，看看未来。我要让监护员知道，她是错的。科科是战士，不是傻瓜。
Description.english: When Kekek was a pup, he sometimes heard elders talking about a far-off shrine. Sometimes they say that bronze dragon-things there know all about future.$B$BKekek tell you he be great warrior, now we go see. Bronze dragon-thing shrine somewhere in Dragonblight, northeast of dragon-thing temple called Wyrmrest, also northwest of man-town called Wintergarde.$B$BWe go there, see future. Prove orphan-lady wrong about Kekek. Kekek warrior, not bully.

CompletionLog.text: 去找狼獾人孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的狼獾人孤儿哨。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

identity.title: A Trip To The Wonderworks
identity.objectives: Purchase a Small Paper Zeppelin at the Wonderworks and then throw it to your orphan, Roo.
identity.description: We have time for one more stop? We heard Dalaran has toy store, but we never get to go there. Orphan mistress says too many orphans would crowd the store. Maybe we can go, just us?$B$BWe can have a small paper zeppelin? We think they have those at Wonderworks in Dalaran. We always wanted to play with one. Maybe you throw one to us?

Title.text: 前往奇妙玩具店的旅行

Objectives.text: 在奇妙玩具店购买一只小型纸飞艇，然后把它掷给你的孤儿鲁鲁。
Objectives.english: Purchase a Small Paper Zeppelin at the Wonderworks and then throw it to your orphan, Roo.

Description.text: 我们还有时间去下一站？我们听说达拉然有一间玩具店，但我们从来没有去过那里。监护员说，如果大家都要去那里的话，那里就会被挤爆了。也许我们可以去那里？只有我们？我们可以在那里得到一只小型纸飞艇吗？他们就会把那种小飞艇送到达拉然的奇妙玩具店去。我们一直都想要一只那样的小飞艇。也许你能给我们一只？
Description.english: We have time for one more stop? We heard Dalaran has toy store, but we never get to go there. Orphan mistress says too many orphans would crowd the store. Maybe we can go, just us?$B$BWe can have a small paper zeppelin? We think they have those at Wonderworks in Dalaran. We always wanted to play with one. Maybe you throw one to us?

identity.title: A Visit To The Wonderworks
identity.objectives: Purchase a Small Paper Zeppelin at The Wonderworks and then throw it to your orphan, Kekek.
identity.description: You take Kekek one more place? Orphan lady say Dalaran have toy store called Wonderworks, but Kekek never seen it. She say that if one orphan go, she have to take everyone. Maybe you take Kekek?$B$BKekek seen other children playing with small paper zeppelin? Kekek hear those come from Wonderworks. Maybe you get one and throw it around with Kekek?

Title.text: 前往奇妙玩具店的旅行

Objectives.text: 在奇妙玩具店购买一只小型纸飞艇，再将小飞艇丢给你的孤儿科科。
Objectives.english: Purchase a Small Paper Zeppelin at The Wonderworks and then throw it to your orphan, Kekek.

Description.text: 你还要带科科去另一个地方？监护员说达拉然有一个奇妙玩具店。但科科从没有去过那里。保姆说，如果有一个孤儿去了，她就必须带所有孤儿都去那里了。你能带科科去那里吗？$B$B科科看到过其他孩子玩折纸飞艇。科科听说那些飞艇都是从奇妙玩具店里飞出来的。也许你能在那里弄到一只折纸飞艇，然后和科科一起玩？
Description.english: You take Kekek one more place? Orphan lady say Dalaran have toy store called Wonderworks, but Kekek never seen it. She say that if one orphan go, she have to take everyone. Maybe you take Kekek?$B$BKekek seen other children playing with small paper zeppelin? Kekek hear those come from Wonderworks. Maybe you get one and throw it around with Kekek?

identity.title: Fel Moss Corruption
identity.objectives: Collect 6 Fel Moss.
identity.description: I'd hoped to never return to Teldrassil for such grim business. I'd hoped that its corruption had been wiped away completely.  Something fowl lingers.$B$BThe corruption of the wicked fel moss still threatens to turn peaceful creatures against us. The grells and gellkin still infest the area and threaten Shadowglen's residents.$B$BEngage these grells and grellkin, $n, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked fel moss. Once we know for certain, we will know how to proceed.

Objectives.text: 收集6份魔苔。
Objectives.english: Collect 6 Fel Moss.

Description.text: 某些邪恶的东西正在泰达希尔的森林中酝酿。沿着山脚前进，到那些生性平和的熊怪曾经居住过的地方去吧。他们已经遗弃了自己的家园，以瘤背部族的名义聚集了起来。$B$B只有邪恶的魔苔才能造成这样的转变。劣魔已经侵染了这个地区，并威胁到了幽影谷的居民。$B$B去跟那些劣魔交战，$n，看看它们是不是真的受到了魔苔的影响。
Description.english: I'd hoped to never return to Teldrassil for such grim business. I'd hoped that its corruption had been wiped away completely.  Something fowl lingers.$B$BThe corruption of the wicked fel moss still threatens to turn peaceful creatures against us. The grells and gellkin still infest the area and threaten Shadowglen's residents.$B$BEngage these grells and grellkin, $n, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked fel moss. Once we know for certain, we will know how to proceed.

CompletionLog.text: 回影月谷找塔琳德拉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Tarindrella in Shadowglen.

identity.title: Playmates!
identity.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit Winterfin Retreat. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
identity.description: Orphanage gets real lonely, you know? Sometimes we want to go places, meet new friends.$B$BMaybe you can take us somewheres with other hatchlings? We heard about a place called Winterfin Retreat, in the big Borean Tundra. We think it's way in the northwest, near the edge of the Coldarra-island.$B$BThe orphan lady say someone brave save a bunch of hatchlings there. We think they lonely, too. We think they need friends. You take us there?

Objectives.text: 带领你的孤儿鲁鲁前去拜访冬鳞避难所。当你到达那里的时候，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
Objectives.english: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit Winterfin Retreat. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.

Description.text: 你要知道，孤儿们都是很孤独的。有时候，我们很想去别的地方看看，结交一些新的朋友。$B$B也许你能带我们去闯一闯？我们听说有一个叫冬鳞避难所的地方。那就在北风苔原里面。要去那里，我们应该向西北方前进，走到靠近考达拉岛边缘的地方。$B$B监护员说有一个勇敢的人也在那里养育着一群孤儿。他们一定也很孤单，一定也需要朋友。你愿意带我们去那里吗？
Description.english: Orphanage gets real lonely, you know? Sometimes we want to go places, meet new friends.$B$BMaybe you can take us somewheres with other hatchlings? We heard about a place called Winterfin Retreat, in the big Borean Tundra. We think it's way in the northwest, near the edge of the Coldarra-island.$B$BThe orphan lady say someone brave save a bunch of hatchlings there. We think they lonely, too. We think they need friends. You take us there?

CompletionLog.text: 去找神谕者孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的神谕者孤儿哨。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

identity.title: The Grateful Dead
identity.objectives: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Human Spirit in Stormwind's graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.
identity.description: It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!$B$BMight I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...$B$BChapman there sells the recipe, I think.

Objectives.text: 弄到悼念糕饼，并把它交给暴风城墓地的欢快的人类灵魂。$B$B你必须使用一朵橙菊，才能看到那个隐形的灵魂。
Objectives.english: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Human Spirit in Stormwind's graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.

Description.text: 真高兴能再次见到朋友和亲人，不过也许我做得有些太夸张了……我已经吃光了他们为我准备的一切！$B$B能不能帮我一个忙，再给我拿来一些那种美味的悼念糕饼？我会非常感激你的……$B$B我想，那边的查普曼正在出售食谱。
Description.english: It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!$B$BMight I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...$B$BChapman there sells the recipe, I think.

identity.title: The Dragon Queen
identity.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at the top of Wyrmrest Temple. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
identity.description: One of High-Oracle Soo-say's stories says Great Ones made all the dragons and a queen for the dragons, too. We want to see her! Would you take us to the top of Wyrmrest Temple? We remember Soo-say telling us the temple-thing was in the middle of Dragonblight.$B$BWe really want to meet dragon queen. She must be so big and pretty. Maybe she help us find new parents.$B$BYou take us?

Objectives.text: 带上你的孤儿鲁鲁去拜访阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者，她就在龙眠神殿的顶端。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
Objectives.english: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at the top of Wyrmrest Temple. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.

Description.text: 高阶神谕者索乌塞有一个故事，说的是造物主造出了所有的龙和一位统驭所有巨龙的女王。我们想看一看那位女王！你能带我们去龙眠神殿的最高处吗？索乌塞告诉我过我们，那个神庙就在龙骨荒野的中心。$B$B我们真的很想见到红龙女王。她一定又大又美丽。也许她能帮助我们找到新的爸爸妈妈。$B$B你会带我们去吗？
Description.english: One of High-Oracle Soo-say's stories says Great Ones made all the dragons and a queen for the dragons, too. We want to see her! Would you take us to the top of Wyrmrest Temple? We remember Soo-say telling us the temple-thing was in the middle of Dragonblight.$B$BWe really want to meet dragon queen. She must be so big and pretty. Maybe she help us find new parents.$B$BYou take us?

CompletionLog.text: 去找神谕者孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的神谕者孤儿哨。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

identity.title: The Dragon Queen
identity.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at the top of Wyrmrest Temple. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
identity.description: Kekek always liked dragons. Always wanted to be one, but orphan-lady said no. But she did say maybe you take Kekek to meet dragon queen.$B$BKekek think orphan-lady have good idea for once. You take Kekek to Wyrmrest Temple in the middle of Dragonblight? Fly all the way to top to meet dragon queen. She must be really big, to be queen of all dragons. Kekek can't wait to see!

Objectives.text: 带上你的孤儿科科去拜访阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者，她就在龙眠神殿的顶端。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
Objectives.english: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at the top of Wyrmrest Temple. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.

Description.text: 科科一直都很喜欢巨龙。科科一直都想有一条龙。但监护员不让科科这样做。不过她说了，你可以带科科去看看红龙女王。$B$B科科终于听监护员说了一句也有道理的话。你愿意带科科去龙骨荒野中心的龙眠神殿吗？我们一同飞到那座神庙顶上，去看看红龙女王。她一定非常非常巨大。这样她才能成为所有巨龙的女王。科科已经等不及想要见她了！
Description.english: Kekek always liked dragons. Always wanted to be one, but orphan-lady said no. But she did say maybe you take Kekek to meet dragon queen.$B$BKekek think orphan-lady have good idea for once. You take Kekek to Wyrmrest Temple in the middle of Dragonblight? Fly all the way to top to meet dragon queen. She must be really big, to be queen of all dragons. Kekek can't wait to see!

CompletionLog.text: 去找狼獾人孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的狼獾人孤儿哨。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

identity.title: The Mighty Hemet Nesingwary
identity.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Base Camp. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
identity.description: Know who Kekek always wanted to meet? Hemet Nesingwary.$B$BMaybe you take Kekek to see him? Elder Harkek tell us all about him. He come to Sholazar to hunt biggest creatures anywhere! Even Frenzyheart elders respect Hemet Nesingwary as great hunter.$B$BElder Harkek tell Kekek that Nesingwary Base Camp in the middle of west side of Sholazar, right on river called Seabreach Flow. We go visit and learn how to hunt like Hemet?

Title.text: 强大的赫米特·奈辛瓦里

Objectives.text: 带着你的孤儿科科去拜访赫米特·奈辛瓦里。他就在奈辛瓦里营地。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
Objectives.english: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Base Camp. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.

Description.text: 你知道科科一直想要见到的人是谁吗？赫米特·奈辛瓦里。$B$B也许你能带科科去见他？长者哈尔卡克把他的所有事情都告诉我们了。他来到索拉查就是为了猎捕当地最大的怪物！就连狂心氏族的长老们也尊敬赫米特·奈辛瓦里，称他为伟大的猎人。$B$B长者哈尔卡克告诉科科，奈辛瓦里营地就在索拉查西侧的中部，碎浪河附近。我们去那里拜访他，学习如何像赫米特那样狩猎好不好？
Description.english: Know who Kekek always wanted to meet? Hemet Nesingwary.$B$BMaybe you take Kekek to see him? Elder Harkek tell us all about him. He come to Sholazar to hunt biggest creatures anywhere! Even Frenzyheart elders respect Hemet Nesingwary as great hunter.$B$BElder Harkek tell Kekek that Nesingwary Base Camp in the middle of west side of Sholazar, right on river called Seabreach Flow. We go visit and learn how to hunt like Hemet?

CompletionLog.text: 去找狼獾人孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的狼獾人孤儿哨。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

identity.title: Back To The Orphanage
identity.objectives: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Oracle Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
identity.description: We had the best time with you, $n. We wish you could be our $g daddy : mama; now, but you have to take us back to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.$B$BMaybe you could come visit us again sometime? We loved meeting Winterfin hatchlings and getting to see the dragon queen. No one will believe us when we say we met a Great One!$B$BWe going to miss you, $n. We promise to write letter sometime, oki?

Objectives.text: 将你的监护对象送回到达拉然孤儿院，把神谕者孤儿哨交给达拉然的孤儿监护员艾蕊娅。
Objectives.english: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Oracle Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

Description.text: 我们和你一起渡过了一段最美好的时光$n。真希望你会是我们的$g爸爸:妈妈;。但你现在必须带我回达拉然的孤儿院里。$B$B也许你什么时候能再来看我们？我们喜欢去看冬鳞小鱼人和红龙女王。绝不会有人相信，我们竟然见到了造物主！$B$B我们会想念你的，$n。一定要给我们写信，我们也会给你写信的，好吗？
Description.english: We had the best time with you, $n. We wish you could be our $g daddy : mama; now, but you have to take us back to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.$B$BMaybe you could come visit us again sometime? We loved meeting Winterfin hatchlings and getting to see the dragon queen. No one will believe us when we say we met a Great One!$B$BWe going to miss you, $n. We promise to write letter sometime, oki?

CompletionLog.text: 去找达拉然的孤儿监护员艾蕊娅。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

identity.title: Back To The Orphanage
identity.objectives: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Wolvar Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
identity.description: Know what? You not so bad after all, $n. You take Kekek a lot of fun places. Kekek meet a lot of new friends and do things no other pup get to do.$B$BYou, and Hemet Nesingwary, and Snowfall Glade pups all new best friends. Maybe sometime you bring Kekek that green hills book? Kekek promise to write sometimes, too, tell you how things go. Maybe even be nice to big-tongue kids sometimes.$B$BKekek gotta go back to orphan-lady Aria now, back in purple human city.

Objectives.english: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Wolvar Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

Description.text: 你知道吗？你不是个坏人，$n。你带着科科去了许多有趣的地方。科科遇到了不少新朋友，还经历了一些其他孩子根本想象不到的事情。$B$B你与赫米特·奈辛瓦里和飘雪林地的小孩全都成了科科最好的朋友。也许你能把那本绿色山丘书带给科科？科科答应了要不时给你写一些东西，让你知道他的情况。也许，作为一个大舌头怪的孩子也是有些好处的。$B$B科科现在要回到孤儿监护员艾蕊娅那里去了，要回到紫色人的城市去了。
Description.english: Know what? You not so bad after all, $n. You take Kekek a lot of fun places. Kekek meet a lot of new friends and do things no other pup get to do.$B$BYou, and Hemet Nesingwary, and Snowfall Glade pups all new best friends. Maybe sometime you bring Kekek that green hills book? identity.title: Among Humans Again
identity.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Grimmburg.
identity.description: Finally!  It looks like Grennan's potion worked on at least one of you ferals.$B$BYou should be able to stay in control for the most part -- just watch your temper.$B$BMajor Arsmtead's going to want to speak to you.  Gilneas is under attack and we need every able-bodied combatant to take up arms.

Objectives.text: 在葛林堡和葛玟·阿姆史特談話。
Objectives.english: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Grimmburg.

Description.text: 終於!至少能在其中一隻野獸身上看到卡瑞南藥水的效果。$B$B在大多數情況下，你應該都能控制住自己，但要注意一下脾氣。$B$B阿姆史特少校想要和你說話。吉爾尼斯正受到攻擊，我們需要每一個好手好腳的戰鬥人員上場作戰。

It looks like Grennan's potion worked on at least one of you ferals.$B$BYou should be able to stay in control for the most part -- just watch your temper.$B$BMajor Arsmtead's going to want to speak to you. identity.title: An Injured Colleague
identity.objectives: Take the Battered Tribal Shield to Aponi Brightmane on Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff.
identity.description: The fight's been hard up here, $c, as I'm sure you know. We're holding out, but not everyone has gone unscathed.$b$bA warrior in our band, Aponi Brightmane, was taken ill by an infected wound in her arm. She's been taken back to Thunder Bluff for recuperation. It seems she left her shield here at the front in the confusion, however - could you take it to her, along with our well-wishes? Her smile is missed around here.$b$bYou can find her on Elder Rise on the Bluff.

Objectives.text: 将破旧的部族护盾交给奥伯妮·亮鬃。她就在雷霆崖里的长者高地。
Objectives.english: Take the Battered Tribal Shield to Aponi Brightmane on Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff.

Description.text: $c，相信你已经知道，这里的战斗相当艰苦。我们还能守住战线，但我们的战士已死伤惨重。$b$b我们的一个名叫奥伯妮·亮鬃的战士手臂上的伤口感染了。她被送回到雷霆崖进行急救。不过，她在混乱中把盾牌遗失在了这里。你能把这面盾牌连同我们的祝福一起给她带过去么？我们非常想念她的微笑。$b$b你可以在雷霆崖的长者高地那里找到她。

identity.title: If You're Reading This While I'm In Combat...
identity.objectives: ELM Daze Target wants you to kill 5 ELM Attackers for Dan and Great Justice!
identity.description: Dan is the most awesome programmer in the world... the World of Warcraft!$B$BIsn't it weird that you used to not be able to talk with me at all while I was fighting?  No longer, my friend, now that Dan has made significant improvements to one of my creature flags!$B$BCelebrate with me by snuffing out the lives of these awful creatures that perpetually have me in combat.

Title.text: 如果在我战斗的时候，你读到了这个……
Title.english: If You're Reading This While I'm In Combat...

Objectives.text: ELM Daze Target想要你为Dan和Great Justice消灭5个ELM Attacker
Objectives.english: ELM Daze Target wants you to kill 5 ELM Attackers for Dan and Great Justice!

Description.text: Dan是全世界最可怕的程序员……我说的是魔兽世界！$B$B当我战斗的时候，你却没办法和我说话，难道这不是很奇怪的事情吗？而现在这种怪事已经不会再发生了，我的朋友。Dan对我的一个生物特性做了大规模改进！$B$B和我一起庆祝吧，消灭这些可怕的怪物。正是它们让我陷入了永远无法停息的战斗之中。
Description.english: Dan is the most awesome programmer in the world... the World of Warcraft!$B$BIsn't it weird that you used to not be able to talk with me at all while I was fighting?  No longer, my friend, now that Dan has made significant improvements to one of my creature flags!$B$BCelebrate with me by snuffing out the lives of these awful creatures that perpetually have me in combat.

CompletionLog.text: 到設計者之島找ELM暈眩目標。

Description.text: 这是女神的声音在月亮井中与你交谈，$n。蕾拉的解药就在东边林中树塔，那个坠入堕落的人手上。$B$B阿夫鲁斯·病语正在寻求原谅和救赎。帮助他的任务就交给你了，希望这么做也能救助我的孩子。

identity.title: The Grateful Dead
identity.objectives: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Dwarf Spirit in Ironforge's graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.
identity.description: It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!$B$BMight I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...$B$BChapman there sells the recipe, I think.

Description.text: 真高興能再次見到朋友和親人，不過也許我做得有些太誇張了……我已經吃光了他們為我準備的一切！$B$B能不能幫我一個忙，再給我拿來一些那種美味的悼念糕餅？我會非常感激你的……$B$B我想，那邊的查普曼正在出售食譜。

identity.title: Call to Arms: Arathi Basin
identity.objectives: Win an Arathi Basin battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
identity.description: The reality of fighting on multiple fronts, $g lad : lass;, is that we cannot spread our forces too thin or we risk losing it all!$B$BCritical troop deployments are necessary on a day by day basis.  Today it is the battle of Arathi Basin that demands immediate reinforcements.$B$BReturn to me with news of victory, $n.  We cannot allow the Horde scum to secure the resources that are rightfully ours!

Title.text: 战斗的召唤：阿拉希盆地

Objectives.text: 在阿拉希盆地战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意联盟主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的联盟准将复命。
Objectives.english: Win an Arathi Basin battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.

Description.text: $g小伙子:姑娘;，在多条战线上同时进行战争的关键在于我们不能让军力过于分散，否则我们就会面临全面溃败的风险。$B$B每一天，我们都要对关键的军力布置进行调整。今天我们必须派遣援军的地方是阿拉希盆地。$B$B赶快到那里去，并带着胜利的消息回来见我，$n决不能允许那些部落的恶徒占据那里本应属于我们的资源！
Description.english: The reality of fighting on multiple fronts, $g lad : lass;, is that we cannot spread our forces too thin or we risk losing it all!$B$BCritical troop deployments are necessary on a day by day basis.  Today it is the battle of Arathi Basin that demands immediate reinforcements.$B$BReturn to me with news of victory, $n.  We cannot allow the Horde scum to secure the resources that are rightfully ours!

CompletionLog.text: 去找联盟准将。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

identity.description: The fight against the Horde knows no boundaries, $n.  Even in Outland, territorial disputes and old hatreds are enough to tip the scales in favor of war.$B$BGo into the Eye of the Storm and make sure the Alliance prevails in Outland just like it has in Azeroth.

Title.english: Call to Arms: Eye of the Storm

Objectives.text: 在风暴之眼战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意联盟主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的联盟准将复命。
Objectives.english: Win an Eye of the Storm battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.

Description.text: 对抗部落的战斗是没有尽头的，$n。即使在外域，对于地盘的争夺和世代积累的仇恨同样引发了一场场战斗。$B$B现在，进入风暴之眼，为联盟夺取辉煌的胜利，就像我们在艾泽拉斯做的一样。
Description.english: The fight against the Horde knows no boundaries, $n.  Even in Outland, territorial disputes and old hatreds are enough to tip the scales in favor of war.$B$BGo into the Eye of the Storm and make sure the Alliance prevails in Outland just like it has in Azeroth.

CompletionLog.text: 去找联盟准将。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

identity.title: Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch
identity.objectives: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
identity.description: The Silverwing Sentinels fight to protect the forest in Warsong Gulch.  We aid them, not because we're tree-lovers, but because the forest forms a natural protective barrier for Alliance territory.$B$BTheir need is greater today than it's ever been.  We need to deploy reinforcements right away unless we want to see Ashenvale annexed to the Barrens!

Objectives.text: 在战歌峡谷战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意联盟主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的联盟准将复命。
Objectives.english: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.

Description.text: 银翼哨兵正在竭尽全力保卫战歌峡谷中的森林。我们必须援助他们，不只是因为我们热爱森林，更因为那片森林是守护联盟领土的天然屏障。$B$B现在我们比以往任何时候都更需要它们。所以我们必须立刻向那里派遣援军。否则灰谷森林很快就会被部落砍成荒芜地了！
Description.english: The Silverwing Sentinels fight to protect the forest in Warsong Gulch.  We aid them, not because we're tree-lovers, but because the forest forms a natural protective barrier for Alliance territory.$B$BTheir need is greater today than it's ever been.  We need to deploy reinforcements right away unless we want to see Ashenvale annexed to the Barrens!

CompletionLog.text: 去找联盟准将。

identity.description: Arathi Basin is on the verge of being lost to Alliance forces.  We must send reinforcements at this very moment or all our efforts will have been in vain.$B$BDo not delay, $c, go to Arathi Basin and crush the enemy.  Victory to the Horde!

Description.english: Arathi Basin is on the verge of being lost to Alliance forces.  We must send reinforcements at this very moment or all our efforts will have been in vain.$B$BDo not delay, $c, go to Arathi Basin and crush the enemy.  Victory to the Horde!

CompletionLog.english: Return to Horde Warbringer.

Objectives.text: 在战歌峡谷的战场上赢得一场竞赛，然后去见任意部落主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或者沙塔斯的部落战争使者。
Objectives.english: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.

Description.text: 联盟真是一群阴险的敌人，$n。他们竟然以保卫灰谷森林的名义入侵了我们在贫瘠之地的领土。$B$B今天，我们要将敌人彻底从我们的土地上赶走。赶快到战歌峡谷去，夺回本应属于我们的东西！
Description.english: The Alliance is an insidious enemy, $n.  They claim to defend the Ashenvale forests to justify their acts of aggression against our territories in the Barrens.$B$BToday we have an opportunity to drive the enemy from our lands once and for all.  Go to Warsong Gulch and take back what is rightfully ours!

CompletionLog.text: 去找部落战争使者。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Horde Warbringer.

identity.title: Proof of Demise: The Black Knight
identity.objectives: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with a Fragment of the Black Knight's Soul.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
identity.description: My counterpart, Archmage Timear, has asked me to warn you of something dire. Soon, you will be participating in the Trial of the Champions at the Argent Coliseum in Icecrown. You must beware of interference from one known only as the Black Knight.$B$BBring me a fragment of his soul that the Kirin Tor will know he is dealt with. I am told that failing to do so will be your own undoing.

Title.english: Proof of Demise: The Black Knight

Objectives.text: 达拉然的大法师兰达洛克希望你能带给他一片黑骑士的灵魂碎片。$B$B这个任务只能在英雄难度中完成。
Objectives.english: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with a Fragment of the Black Knight's Soul.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.

Description.text: 我的同事大法师提迈尔要求我给你一个重要的警告。你很快就将参与冰冠冰川中银色演武场的冠军的试炼。所以你必须时刻警惕一个可怕的敌人。我们只知道他是黑骑士。$B$B如果你能带来他的灵魂碎片，肯瑞托就会知道这个可怕的敌人已经被除掉了。但如果你失败了，那么你将要付出的很可能是生命的代价。
Description.english: My counterpart, Archmage Timear, has asked me to warn you of something dire. Soon, you will be participating in the Trial of the Champions at the Argent Coliseum in Icecrown. You must beware of interference from one known only as the Black Knight.$B$BBring me a fragment of his soul that the Kirin Tor will know he is dealt with. I am told that failing to do so will be your own undoing.

identity.title: Waterlogged Recipe
identity.objectives: Bring the Waterlogged Recipe to Christi Stockton in the Dalaran city.
identity.description: This appears to be the remains of a mixture for potent wine.  Perhaps the proprietor of One More Glass in Dalaran would be interested in it....

Objectives.text: 将被浸透的配方交给达拉然城中的克莉丝蒂·斯多克顿。
Objectives.english: Bring the Waterlogged Recipe to Christi Stockton in the Dalaran city.

Description.text: 看起来，这张被水浸透的纸上应该是记录着一种烈性酒的酿造配方。也许达拉然“再来一杯”的店主会对这个感兴趣……
Description.english: This appears to be the remains of a mixture for potent wine.  Perhaps the proprietor of One More Glass in Dalaran would be interested in it....

identity.title: Charge
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Practice using Charge against a Bloodfang Worgen.
identity.description: You're alive, $n!  That must mean I did something right.$B$BIt's a shame our lessons were cut off a little short.  But, as you go and learn on your own, you'll start to discover new techniques.$B$BGo get some more experience, learn something new, and then try it out against the bloodfang worgen to our west.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冲锋。然后对一个血牙狼人进行冲锋。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Practice using Charge against a Bloodfang Worgen.

Description.text: $n，你还活着！总算没出什么纰漏。$B$B我们的课程被迫中断了一阵子，真是可惜。但是，随着你不断进行自我修炼，你会开始发现新的技巧。$B$B去吧，多积累些经验，学习新技能。然后找西边的血牙狼人练练手。
Description.english: You're alive, $n!  That must mean I did something right.$B$BIt's a shame our lessons were cut off a little short.  But, as you go and learn on your own, you'll start to discover new techniques.$B$BGo get some more experience, learn something new, and then try it out against the bloodfang worgen to our west.

CompletionLog.text: 去军事区找克利希中士。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Sergeant Cleese in the Military District.

identity.title: Eviscerate
identity.objectives: Reach Level 3 to Learn Eviscerate, then practice using Eviscerate against a Bloodfang Worgen.
identity.description: Good to see you alive!$B$BNo, of course I don't have that gold I owe you.  Now's not really the time to bring that up is it?$B$BListen, maybe I can show you the ropes, save your skin with all the carnage going on. $B$BAs you learn how to fight, you'll start to learn new things. Go get some more experience, and then when you figure out something new, try it on the Bloodfang Worgen. I'll be watching

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习刺骨。然后对一个血牙狼人使用刺骨。
Objectives.english: Reach Level 3 to Learn Eviscerate, then practice using Eviscerate against a Bloodfang Worgen.

Description.text: 你还活着！真好！$B$B那个，我身上没钱，还不了债。我们还是别谈这事儿吧，你说呢？$B$B听着，或许我可以教你一两招，说不定日后还能救你一命呢。$B$B在你学习如何战斗的过程中，你会开始领悟新的东西。去吧，多积累些经验。等你领会到一些新东西，就去找血牙狼人练练手。我会关照你的。
Description.english: Good to see you alive!$B$BNo, of course I don't have that gold I owe you.  Now's not really the time to bring that up is it?$B$BListen, maybe I can show you the ropes, save your skin with all the carnage going on. $B$BAs you learn how to fight, you'll start to learn new things. Go get some more experience, and then when you figure out something new, try it on the Bloodfang Worgen. I'll be watching

CompletionLog.text: 去军事区找侠盗萝伦。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Loren the Fence in the Military District.

identity.title: Corruption
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption. Practice casting it on a Bloodfang Worgen.
identity.description: It is true then!  You live!$B$BI never got a chance to share my greatest discovery with you.  After I began my training, and began to become accomplished, I heard the voice Balcephoth of the felshadows in my head... he taught me the forbidden secrets of...$B$BCorruption!$B$BGo now, gain some more experience, maybe you'll learn a new spell, too. You can go use it against the Bloodfang Worgen to our west.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习腐蚀术。然后对一个血牙狼人施放腐蚀术。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption. Practice casting it on a Bloodfang Worgen.

Description.text: 你果然还活着！$B$B在此之前，我一直没有机会和你分享我最伟大的发现。之前在我开始我的训练，并在训练完成之后，我听到邪能暗影巴尔塞普洛斯的声音萦绕在我心头……他教会了我禁忌之术……$B$B腐蚀术！$B$B现在去多积累些经验，或许你也会学得一招新法术。然后你可以拿西边的血牙狼人来练练手。
Description.english: It is true then!  You live!$B$BI never got a chance to share my greatest discovery with you.  After I began my training, and began to become accomplished, I heard the voice Balcephoth of the felshadows in my head... he taught me the forbidden secrets of...$B$BCorruption!$B$BGo now, gain some more experience, maybe you'll learn a new spell, too. You can go use it against the Bloodfang Worgen to our west.

CompletionLog.text: 去军事区找维图斯·暗行者。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Vitus Darkwalker in the Military District.

identity.title: Steady Shot
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Practice using Steady Shot 2 times against a Bloodfang Worgen.
identity.description: So I've got good news and bad news.$B$BThe bad news is that there are more worgen in the woods than in here... so we really have no safe place to go to.$B$BThe good news is that you're starting to get the hang of this. As you get more experience, you'll start to learn how to do new things.$B$BOnce you learn your first new ability, try your hand at it against the bloodfang worgen to our west.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习稳固射击。然后对一个血牙狼人使用2次稳固射击。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Practice using Steady Shot 2 times against a Bloodfang Worgen.

Description.text: 我有一个好消息和一个坏消息。$B$B坏消息是，丛林中的狼人比这里的更多……我们已经没有安全的去处了。$B$B好消息是你变得越来越得心应手。随着你的经验不断增加，你会开始领悟新的技巧。$B$B一旦你学会了第一个新技能，就拿西边的血牙狼人来练练手吧。
Description.english: So I've got good news and bad news.$B$BThe bad news is that there are more worgen in the woods than in here... so we really have no safe place to go to.$B$BThe good news is that you're starting to get the hang of this. As you get more experience, you'll start to learn how to do new things.$B$BOnce you learn your first new ability, try your hand at it against the bloodfang worgen to our west.

CompletionLog.text: 去军事区找猎手布雷克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Huntsman Blake in the Military District.

identity.title: Learning the Word
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Use it 2 times on a bloodfang worgen.
identity.description:
You have much to learn, $n.  And I've much to teach you.$B$BThese are perilous times, however, and I fear that you may need to learn much on your own$B$BHave no fear, $g brother:sister;.  The Light will guide us through this.

Go, get more experience, and learn a new skill. Use it against the bloodfang worgen nearby.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习暗言术：痛。然后对一个血牙狼人施放2次暗言术：痛。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Use it 2 times on a bloodfang worgen.

Description.text:
学海无涯，$n，我还有很多知识可以传授给你。$B$B但在这种危急关头，我恐怕你得靠你自己了。$B$B别害怕，我的$g兄弟:姐妹;，圣光将指引我们渡过难关。

去吧，多积累些经验，学会一个新法术。然后拿附近的血牙狼人来练练手。
Description.english:
You have much to learn, $n.  And I've much to teach you.$B$BThese are perilous times, however, and I fear that you may need to learn much on your own$B$BHave no fear, $g brother:sister;.  The Light will guide us through this.

Go, get more experience, and learn a new skill. Use it against the bloodfang worgen nearby.

CompletionLog.text: 去军事区找艾尔米拉修女。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Sister Almyra in the Military District.

identity.title: Frost Nova
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Use it against a Bloodfang Worgen.
identity.description:
The path ahead is difficult, $n.  We must devote the entirety of our mental power to the task at hand.$B$BAs you begin to grow in power, new pathways to the arcane will begin to materialize in your mind. You'll begin to develop spells you did not know before.

Go, get more experience, and then use what you learn against the Bloodfang Worgen.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冰霜新星。然后对一个血牙狼人施放冰霜新星。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Use it against a Bloodfang Worgen.

Description.text:
前方的道路充满艰辛，$n。我们必须竭尽所能，处理好眼前的任务。$B$B随着你的力量不断成长，全新的奥术之道将会呈现在你的脑海中。你将开发出前所未有的新法术。

去吧，多积累些经验，然后用你所学到的法术去对抗血牙狼人。
Description.english:
The path ahead is difficult, $n.  We must devote the entirety of our mental power to the task at hand.$B$BAs you begin to grow in power, new pathways to the arcane will begin to materialize in your mind. You'll begin to develop spells you did not know before.

Go, get more experience, and then use what you learn against the Bloodfang Worgen.

CompletionLog.text: 去军事区找猎手米莉安·唤法者。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Myriam Spellwaker in the Military District.

identity.title: Moonfire
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Moonfire, then use it against a Bloodfang Worgen.
identity.description:
We were driven to the edge of extinction once before, $n.  But we druids, keepers of the old ways, saved our people from famine.$B$BWhen we cut ourselves off from the outside world and our crops failed, it was our order who called upon the earth's blessings and restored the harvest.$B$BJust as our powers restored the crops, your growth in power will develop your connection to our ancient arts.

Go, develop your powers, and use what you learn against the Bloodfang Worgen.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习月火术。然后对一个血牙狼人施放月火术。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Moonfire, then use it against a Bloodfang Worgen.

Description.text:
之前我们也曾濒临灭亡，$n。但是作为传统之道的守护者，我们德鲁伊将人民从饥荒中拯救了出来。$B$B当我们面临着孤立无援、谷物欠收的窘境时，是德鲁伊教会求告了大地的祝福，令粮食的收成恢复正常。$B$B就在我们的力量恢复了收成时，你不断提升的力量也增强了你与我们古老技法之间的联系。

去吧，提升你的力量，然后用你所学到的法术去对抗血牙狼人。
Description.english:
We were driven to the edge of extinction once before, $n.  But we druids, keepers of the old ways, saved our people from famine.$B$BWhen we cut ourselves off from the outside world and our crops failed, it was our order who called upon the earth's blessings and restored the harvest.$B$BJust as our powers restored the crops, your growth in power will develop your connection to our ancient arts.

Go, develop your powers, and use what you learn against the Bloodfang Worgen.

CompletionLog.text: 去军事区找丰收女巫塞莱斯廷。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Celestine of the Harvest in the Military District.

identity.title: The Crimson Courier
identity.objectives: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.$B$BTake the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.
identity.description: We cannot attack the Scarlet Crusade's command directly; they are too well defended. But there's more than one way to skin a cat. They'll be nothing without their main force.$B$BThe Deathstalkers have been collecting data on the activity of the Crusade outside of Stratholme. Each day, a report is sent from their central command to Tyr's Hand. This report is the key, $r! Find the Crimson Courier and recover that report. Bring it to Nathanos.

Description.text: 我們不能直接攻擊血色十字軍的指揮官，他們身邊的防禦力量太強大了。不過，抓住貓的辦法並不只一個。如果沒有了軍隊，他們也就沒有了作惡的力量。$B$B亡靈哨兵們一直在搜索那些十字軍在斯坦索姆週邊進行活動的情報。每天都有一份報告從他們的指揮中心被送往提爾之手。$r,那些報告就是我們取勝的關鍵！找到紅衣信使，取得那份報告。將它交給納薩諾斯。
Description.english: We cannot attack the Scarlet Crusade's command directly; they are too well defended. But there's more than one way to skin a cat. They'll be nothing without their main force.$B$BThe Deathstalkers have been collecting data on the activity of the Crusade outside of Stratholme. Each day, a report is sent from their central command to Tyr's Hand. This report is the key, $r! Find the Crimson Courier and recover that report. Bring it to Nathanos.

Objectives.text: 返回東瘟疫之地，找到並殺死紅衣信使，拿到大十字軍的命令。$B$B把命令交給納薩諾斯·凋零者，並等待進一步的指示。
Objectives.english: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.$B$BTake the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

identity.title: Into The Scarlet Monastery
identity.objectives: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
identity.description: One of my duties while I'm stationed here is to help the Forsaken take care of their borders, and that, $c, is exactly what you're going to do for me.$b$bI might live and breathe, but the Scarlet Crusade will cut down my people as quickly as they will one of the undead. They're a problem here, a big one, and you're going to do something about it.$b$bGo to the Monastery and slay High Inquisitor Whitemane and her lieutenants.

Objectives.text: 消灭大检察官怀特迈恩、血色十字军指挥官莫格莱尼、血色十字军勇士赫洛德和驯犬者洛克希，然后向幽暗城的布拉贡·血拳。
Objectives.english: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.

Description.text: 我驻扎在这的任务之一便是帮助被遗忘者守好边境，而这，$c，也正是你要为我做的事情。$b$b我本可以继续在这过活，但血色十字军会马不停蹄的袭击我的人，把他们的头一个个砍下来。他们在这是个麻烦，大麻烦，而你要对此做点什么。$b$b到修道院去，杀死大检察官怀特迈恩和她的军官们。
Description.english: One of my duties while I'm stationed here is to help the Forsaken take care of their borders, and that, $c, is exactly what you're going to do for me.$b$bI might live and breathe, but the Scarlet Crusade will cut down my people as quickly as they will one of the undead. They're a problem here, a big one, and you're going to do something about it.$b$bGo to the Monastery and slay High Inquisitor Whitemane and her lieutenants.

identity.title: The Power to Destroy...
identity.objectives: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Bragor Bloodfist in Undercity.
identity.description: Listen up, $c.$b$bYou may not know this, but Orgrimmar's got a problem. Deep in Ragefire Chasm, a sect of the Shadow Council called the Searing Blade performs their sinister work. They're mainly orcs, and I can't trust sensitive information in the hands of the grunts there. That's where you come in.$b$bThey should have two books in their possession. I want them kept out of the hands of the Searing Blade and the Forsaken alike. Bring them to me directly.

Objectives.text: 将《暗影法术研究》和《扭曲虚空的魔法》这两本书交给幽暗城的布拉贡·血拳。
Objectives.english: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Bragor Bloodfist in Undercity.

Description.text: 仔细听着， $c。$b$b也许你还不知道，奥格瑞玛现在有了麻烦。在怒焰裂谷深处，一个名为燃刃的阴影议会氏族正在做着各种邪恶的事情。他们主要由兽人组成，我不相信那些连话都说不清楚的粗笨家伙能够妥善利用宝贵的知识。所以你要到那里去，把他们解决掉。$b$b他们应该有两本书。不能让那两本书继续留在燃刃氏族的手里，也不能让它们落尽被遗忘者的手中。你要把它们直接交给我。
Description.english: Listen up, $c.$b$bYou may not know this, but Orgrimmar's got a problem. Deep in Ragefire Chasm, a sect of the Shadow Council called the Searing Blade performs their sinister work. They're mainly orcs, and I can't trust sensitive information in the hands of the grunts there. That's where you come in.$b$bThey should have two books in their possession. I want them kept out of the hands of the Searing Blade and the Forsaken alike. Bring them to me directly.

CompletionLog.text: 去幽暗城找皇家区的布拉贡·血拳。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at the Royal Quarter in Undercity.

identity.title: A Cautious Return
identity.objectives: Bring Daros' Journal to Mordent Evenshade in Darnassus.
identity.description: A moment of your time, $c.$b$bChange is coming. It has drawn us out of the ruins of Eldre'Thalas and into the wide world once more. I have come to research this city and cannot stray from it, but if you are inclined, I have an errand for you.$b$bMy colleague set out for Darnassus to speak with the High Priestess there, that we might come to an understanding. Take this journal to Mordent Evenshade in the temple. It may help in his diplomacy mission.

Objectives.text: 将达罗斯的日记带给身处达纳苏斯的莫丹特·永影。
Objectives.english: Bring Daros' Journal to Mordent Evenshade in Darnassus.

Description.text: 占用你一点时间，$c。$b$b世事无常。我们又一次被迫离开了埃雷萨拉斯废墟，走入外面的世界。我是来研究这座城市的，我不想走远，但是也许你会对这个差事感兴趣。$b$b我的同事准备前往达纳苏斯去找那里的高阶祭司谈谈，希望能借此与他们达成共识。带上这本日记去找神殿中的莫丹特·永影。这东西也许会对他的外交任务有帮助。
Description.english: A moment of your time, $c.$b$bChange is coming. It has drawn us out of the ruins of Eldre'Thalas and into the wide world once more. I have come to research this city and cannot stray from it, but if you are inclined, I have an errand for you.$b$bMy colleague set out for Darnassus to speak with the High Priestess there, that we might come to an understanding. Take this journal to Mordent Evenshade in the temple. It may help in his diplomacy mission.

identity.title: The Deathstalkers
identity.objectives: Get Astor's Letter of Introduction and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter.
identity.description: If you wish to join the Deathstalkers, the Dark Lady's elite guard, you will have to prove your worth.$b$bI will not lie to you, $n, this task could mean your death.$b$bI have some things that need attending to. I require the personal effects of Astor Hadren, a messenger who travels between Silverpine and the Undercity. I will leave the method of procurement to your discretion.$b$bIt will be better for you if you know less of the nature of this business. Succeed and I shall tell you more.

Objectives.text: 得到阿斯托的介绍信，并将其交给盗贼区的米奈特·卡加德。
Objectives.english: Get Astor's Letter of Introduction and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter.

Description.text: 想加入黑暗女王的精英卫队——亡灵哨兵的话，你首先必须证明自己的价值。$b$b坦城地说吧，$n，你很可能在这种证明自己价值的任务中丧命，所以我劝你最好三思而行。$b$b现在，我有一个任务要你去完成。有一位来往于银松森林与幽暗城之间的信使，他叫阿斯托·哈德恩，由于特殊的公务需要，我必须得到他身上的一些私人物品。至于采用怎样的策略去得到这些物品，那是你的事情，不要问我。$b$b如果你的好奇心能小一点，不那么关心这些物品的用途的话，你会过得更自在一些。完成这个任务之后，我会再和你谈的。
Description.english: If you wish to join the Deathstalkers, the Dark Lady's elite guard, you will have to prove your worth.$b$bI will not lie to you, $n, this task could mean your death.$b$bI have some things that need attending to. I require the personal effects of Astor Hadren, a messenger who travels between Silverpine and the Undercity. I will leave the method of procurement to your discretion.$b$bIt will be better for you if you know less of the nature of this business. Succeed and I shall tell you more.

CompletionLog.text: 去提瑞斯法林地找洛丹伦废墟的米奈特·卡加德。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Mennet Carkad at Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades.

identity.title: The First Quest
identity.objectives: Test Thrall wants you to kill something.
identity.description: Greetings, $n, this is a test.  Accept and kill stuff

Objectives.text: 測試索爾希望你殺點什麼。
Objectives.english: Test Thrall wants you to kill something.

Description.text: 歡迎，$n，這是個測試。接受任務然後去殺點什麼吧。
Description.english: Greetings, $n, this is a test.  Accept and kill stuff

identity.title: Dwarven Digging
identity.objectives: Collect 5 Prospector's Picks.$B$BAt a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools.$B$BBring 5 Broken Tools to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
identity.description: There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest.  They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.$B$BCollect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.$B$BYou can smash the tools at a forge.  You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.

Objectives.text: 收集5个勘察员的锄头。$B$B在铁匠铺砸碎这些勘察员的锄头。$B$B把5件损坏的工具交给血蹄村的艾莫·雷角。
Objectives.english: Collect 5 Prospector's Picks.$B$BAt a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools.$B$BBring 5 Broken Tools to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.

Description.text: 西北部有些矮人正在准备修建一座挖掘场。他们认为地下埋藏着某些秘密，事实也的确如此，不过挖掘和污染大地并不是获得这些秘密的正确途径。$B$B收集矮人的挖掘工具，把它们全都毁掉，然后把这些被损坏的工具带给我。$B$B要毁掉这些工具的话，你必须得找到一块铁砧才行。在雷霆崖就有一处铁匠铺，不过任何铁砧——包括矮人营地里的——都可以用来毁掉工具。
Description.english: There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest.  They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.$B$BCollect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.$B$BYou can smash the tools at a forge.  You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.

CompletionLog.text: 去莫高雷找血蹄村的艾莫·雷角。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Ahmo Thunderhorn at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

identity.title: Rites of the Earthmother
identity.objectives: Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of Camp Narache.
identity.description: For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, $n.$b$bTravel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Ahmo Thunderhorn. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.$b$bTake this totem to Ahmo. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.$b$bFollow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.

Objectives.text: 順著離開納拉其營地的路將鷹風圖騰帶給血蹄村的奧莫·雷角。
Objectives.english: Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of Camp Narache.

Description.text: 要想繼續大地之母祭儀，你必須先通過兩個小試煉。現在也正好是你去積累積累經驗的時候了，$n。$b$b到血蹄村去找奧莫·雷角吧。你可以在那兒繼續你的冒險歷程並得到雷霆崖的長老們的承認。$b$b把這個圖騰帶給奧莫。他會讀懂我刻在上面的符號，並幫助你繼續修行。$b$b順著這條從納拉其營地通向外面的路快點出發吧，千萬別迷路了。
Description.english: For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, $n.$b$bTravel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Ahmo Thunderhorn. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.$b$bTake this totem to Ahmo. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.$b$bFollow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.

CompletionLog.text: 到莫高雷的血蹄村找奧莫·雷角。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Ahmo Thunderhorn at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

identity.title: Cataclysm!
identity.objectives: Nambria wants you to peer into the Waters of Farseeing.
identity.description: Hear my words, $c!$b$bThe winds of change have gathered into a violent storm that sweeps across Azeroth.$b$bHave you the courage to face the true cause of our plight?$b$bMuster your resolve, $r, and pray for the strength and fortune to see you through the trials that await.$b$bAn unexpected ally has issued a call for all that would hear. Peer into the Waters of Farseeing and behold the fate of the world!

Objectives.text: 娜布莉亚希望你观察先知之水中的景象。
Objectives.english: Nambria wants you to peer into the Waters of Farseeing.

Description.text: 听听我的话，$c！$B$B危急的形势已经化为摧枯拉朽的风暴，即将横扫艾泽拉斯。$B$B你有没有勇气去了解我们所处困境的真正原因？$B$B鼓起勇气来，$r，祈祷你有足够的力量和运气渡过难关吧。$B$B一位意料之外的盟友已经发出了召唤，所有明智之人都应侧耳聆听。向先知之水中望去吧，亲眼目睹这个世界所面临的命运！
Description.english: Hear my words, $c!$b$bThe winds of change have gathered into a violent storm that sweeps across Azeroth.$b$bHave you the courage to face the true cause of our plight?$b$bMuster your resolve, $r, and pray for the strength and fortune to see you through the trials that await.$b$bAn unexpected ally has issued a call for all that would hear. Peer into the Waters of Farseeing and behold the fate of the world!

identity.title: A Humble Task
identity.objectives: Chief Hawkwind wants you to search for his mother near the water well to the southeast of Camp Narache.
identity.description: All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.$b$bOur commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.$b$bMy mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?

Objectives.text: 鷹風酋長要求你去納拉其營地東南方的水井處尋找他的母親。
Objectives.english: Chief Hawkwind wants you to search for his mother near the water well to the southeast of Camp Narache.

Description.text: 部族中所有成員都分享著生命的和諧。我們居住在一起，工作在一起。$b$b我們的社群在彼此間有著高度的責任分擔。現在我要請求你幫一個小小的忙。$b$b我的母親今天早上出發到納拉其東南方的井邊取水了，至今已經有相當長的時間。也許你能當我在這處理部族事務的時候幫我去看看她的狀況?
Description.english: All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.$b$bOur commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.$b$bMy mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?

identity.title: You've Been Served
identity.objectives: Serve the Court Subpoena to Apothecary Hummel in Shadowfang Keep.
identity.description: You made it, huh? Good. I've been waiting for help. No time like the present to act, right?$b$bTake this kit and head deeper inside to serve papers to the leader of that scumbag chemical company, Hummel. The paper's inside. So's a little something to protect you from any chemical tricks they might pull. Use one of the neutralizers when the time comes, all right?

Objectives.text: 将法庭传票送给影牙城堡的药剂师汉摩尔。
Objectives.english: Serve the Court Subpoena to Apothecary Hummel in Shadowfang Keep.

Description.text: 你做到了？太好了。我一直在等待你来帮忙。现在你就需要去跑一趟了。$b$b穿上这个，然后去找那个药剂公司的头领汉摩尔。这套服装里的纸能够保护你免受他们化学药剂的伤害。记得及时使用这种中和剂，明白吗？
Description.english: You made it, huh? Good. I've been waiting for help. No time like the present to act, right?$b$bTake this kit and head deeper inside to serve papers to the leader of that scumbag chemical company, Hummel. The paper's inside. So's a little something to protect you from any chemical tricks they might pull. Use one of the neutralizers when the time comes, all right?

identity.title: Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch
identity.objectives: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
identity.description: The Silverwing Sentinels fight to protect the forest in Warsong Gulch.  We aid them, not because we're tree-lovers, but because the forest forms a natural protective barrier for Alliance territory.$B$BTheir need is greater today than it's ever been.  We need to deploy reinforcements right away unless we want to see Ashenvale annexed to the Barrens!

Objectives.text: 在战歌峡谷战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意联盟主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的联盟准将复命。
Objectives.english: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.

Description.text: 银翼哨兵通过战斗来保护战歌峡谷的森林。我们帮助他们，并不是因为我们爱好树木，而是因为森林为联盟领地提供了天然的屏障。$B$B今天他们那里的情势非常危急，远远超过以往任何时候。我们必须立刻派出援军，除非我们希望看到灰谷成为贫瘠之地的附属地！
Description.english: The Silverwing Sentinels fight to protect the forest in Warsong Gulch.  We aid them, not because we're tree-lovers, but because the forest forms a natural protective barrier for Alliance territory.$B$BTheir need is greater today than it's ever been.  We need to deploy reinforcements right away unless we want to see Ashenvale annexed to the Barrens!

CompletionLog.text: 去找联盟准将。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

identity.title: Call to Arms: Arathi Basin
identity.objectives: Win an Arathi Basin battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
identity.description: The reality of fighting on multiple fronts, $g lad : lass;, is that we cannot spread our forces too thin or we risk losing it all!$B$BCritical troop deployments are necessary on a day by day basis.  Today it is the battle of Arathi Basin that demands immediate reinforcements.$B$BReturn to me with news of victory, $n.  We cannot allow the Horde scum to secure the resources that are rightfully ours!

Title.text: 战斗的召唤：阿拉希盆地

Objectives.text: 在阿拉希盆地战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意联盟主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的联盟准将复命。
Objectives.english: Win an Arathi Basin battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.

Description.text: 事实上，我们在多线作战，$g小子:小姑娘;，而且我们不能把军队部署得太过分散，否则我们可能会全盘皆输！$b$b我们需要以天为单位来部署最关键的部队，今天，阿拉希盆地的战斗最需要勇敢的士兵！$b$b带着胜利的消息回来吧，$n。我们不允许部落狗来威胁属于我们的资源！
Description.english: The reality of fighting on multiple fronts, $g lad : lass;, is that we cannot spread our forces too thin or we risk losing it all!$B$BCritical troop deployments are necessary on a day by day basis.  Today it is the battle of Arathi Basin that demands immediate reinforcements.$B$BReturn to me with news of victory, $n.  We cannot allow the Horde scum to secure the resources that are rightfully ours!

CompletionLog.text: 去找联盟准将。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.
