identity.title: Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch
identity.objectives: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
identity.description: The Alliance is an insidious enemy, $n.  They claim to defend the Ashenvale forests to justify their acts of aggression against our territories in the Barrens.$B$BToday we have an opportunity to drive the enemy from our lands once and for all.  Go to Warsong Gulch and take back what is rightfully ours!

Objectives.text: 在战歌峡谷战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意部落主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的部落战争使者复命。
Objectives.english: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.

Description.text: 联盟真是个阴险的敌人，$n。他们张口闭口说在保护灰谷的森林，以此证明他们对我们贫瘠之地领土的进攻行动是正当的。$B$B今天，我们有机会把敌人彻底赶出部落的领土。去战歌峡谷，夺回一切本属于我们的东西！
Description.english: The Alliance is an insidious enemy, $n.  They claim to defend the Ashenvale forests to justify their acts of aggression against our territories in the Barrens.$B$BToday we have an opportunity to drive the enemy from our lands once and for all.  Go to Warsong Gulch and take back what is rightfully ours!

CompletionLog.text: 去找部落战争使者。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Horde Warbringer.

identity.title: Call to Arms: Alterac Valley
identity.objectives: Win an Alterac Valley battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran or Shattrath.
identity.description: We've recently come extremely close to driving the Stormpike invaders from Alterac Valley.  As a result we're redirecting all our reinforcements to aid the Frostwolf Clan.$B$BA decisive victory there would free up the resources we need to crush the Alliance scum on all the other battlefronts.$B$BGo, $n.  Earn great honor by heeding the call of the brave Frostwolf warriors.

Title.text: 战斗的召唤：奥特兰克山谷

Objectives.text: 在奥特兰克山谷战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意部落主城、达拉然、冬拥湖或沙塔斯城中的部落战争使者复命。
Objectives.english: Win an Alterac Valley battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran or Shattrath.

Description.text: 我们就快要把雷矛入侵者从奥特兰克山谷赶走了，因此我们必须调动一切可能的增援力量来帮助霜狼氏族。$B$B一场决定性的胜利可以让我们腾出足够的资源在其它战场上消灭联盟的那些混蛋。$B$B出发吧，$n。听从霜狼氏族的号令，去赢得无上的荣耀吧！
Description.english: We've recently come extremely close to driving the Stormpike invaders from Alterac Valley.  As a result we're redirecting all our reinforcements to aid the Frostwolf Clan.$B$BA decisive victory there would free up the resources we need to crush the Alliance scum on all the other battlefronts.$B$BGo, $n.  Earn great honor by heeding the call of the brave Frostwolf warriors.

CompletionLog.text: 去找部落战争使者。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Horde Warbringer.

identity.title: Call to Arms: Alterac Valley
identity.objectives: Win an Alterac Valley battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran or Shattrath.
identity.description: The reality of fighting on multiple fronts, $g lad : lass;, is that we cannot spread our forces too thin or we risk losing it all!$B$BCritical troop deployments are necessary on a day by day basis.  Today it is the battle for Alterac Valley that's in most need of brave combatants.$B$BGo now, $n, and aid the Stormpike Expedition.  We cannot allow the Frostwolf Clan to get away with the violence they've inflicted on our brethren!

Title.text: 战斗的召唤：奥特兰克山谷

Objectives.text: 在奥特兰克山谷战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意联盟主城、达拉然、冬拥湖或沙塔斯城中的联盟准将复命。

CompletionLog.english: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

identity.title: Empowered Rune
identity.objectives: Read the Empowered Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
identity.description: $n, this rune was given to me to pass on to ye. Take some time to read it when ye have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the shaman trainer Teo. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar.

Objectives.text: 阅读注能符文石，然后与安威玛尔里面的提欧·暴风之锤交谈。
Objectives.english: Read the Empowered Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

Description.text: $n，有人让我把这枚符文交给你。有空的话就看一下吧。我估计是萨满祭司训练师提欧给你的。看看上面说了些什么，然后去安威玛尔里面找他吧。
Description.english: $n, this rune was given to me to pass on to ye. Take some time to read it when ye have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the shaman trainer Teo. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar.

CompletionLog.text: 阅读注能符文石，然后与安威玛尔里面的提欧·暴风之锤交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Read the Empowered Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

identity.title: Arcane Rune
identity.objectives: Read the Arcane Rune and speak to Teegli Merrowith in Coldridge Valley.
identity.description: $n, this rune was given to me to pass on to ye. Take some time to read it when ye have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the mage trainer Teegli. Take a gander at it and go find her inside Anvilmar.

Objectives.text: 阅读奥术符文，然后与寒脊山谷中的泰格莉·梅乐薇丝交谈。
Objectives.english: Read the Arcane Rune and speak to Teegli Merrowith in Coldridge Valley.

Description.text: $n，有人让我把这枚符文交给你。有空的话就看一下吧。我估计是法师训练师泰格莉给你的。看看上面说了些什么，然后去安威玛尔里面找她吧。
Description.english: $n, this rune was given to me to pass on to ye. Take some time to read it when ye have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the mage trainer Teegli. Take a gander at it and go find her inside Anvilmar.

CompletionLog.text: 阅读奥术符文，然后与寒脊山谷中的泰格莉·梅乐薇丝交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Read the Arcane Rune and speak to Teegli Merrowith in Coldridge Valley.

identity.title: Filling Up the Spellbook
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Successfully cast it 2 times on the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.
identity.description:
Excellent!  Let's get started.$b$bAs you grow in power, your connection to the arcane arts will deepen, and you'll gain access to new spells and abilities.

Go, get some more experience, and you'll see what I mean. Come back when you learn something new and demonstrate it on the training dummies here.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冰霜新星。然后对安威玛尔入口处的训练假人成功施放2次冰霜新星。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Successfully cast it 2 times on the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.

Description.text:
太好了！让我们开始吧。$b$b随着你的力量不断增强，你与奥术之间的联系也在不断加深，由此你将会领悟新的法术和技能。

去吧，多积累些经验，之后你就会明白我的意思了。等你学会了新法术，记得回来拿这里的训练假人来向我露两手。
Description.english:
Excellent!  Let's get started.$b$bAs you grow in power, your connection to the arcane arts will deepen, and you'll gain access to new spells and abilities.

Go, get some more experience, and you'll see what I mean. Come back when you learn something new and demonstrate it on the training dummies here.

CompletionLog.text: 去找安威玛尔的泰格莉·梅乐薇丝。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Teegli Merrowith at Anvilmar.

identity.title: Your Path Begins Here
identity.objectives: Reach Level 3 to learn Primal Strike, and then use Primal Strike 2 times on a Training Dummy near the entrance of Anvilmar.
identity.description:
Excellent!  Let us begin.$b$bAs you grow along your journey, you will unlocked the ancient secrets of shamans. 

Primal Strike is the first such skill.  The primal spirits, when called upon, will strengthen your arm to deliver a mighty blow.$b$bHelpful, isn't it?

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习根源打击。然后对安威玛尔入口处附近的训练假人使用2次根源打击。
Objectives.english: Reach Level 3 to learn Primal Strike, and then use Primal Strike 2 times on a Training Dummy near the entrance of Anvilmar.

Description.text:
好极了！让我们开始吧。$b$b随着你在修炼过程中不断成长，你将揭开萨满的古老秘密。

根源打击是你要学习的第一个技能。当你召唤原始的灵魂时，它们可以强化你的臂膀，使你挥出强力的一击。$b$b很带劲，不是吗？
Description.english:
Excellent!  Let us begin.$b$bAs you grow along your journey, you will unlocked the ancient secrets of shamans. 

Primal Strike is the first such skill.  The primal spirits, when called upon, will strengthen your arm to deliver a mighty blow.$b$bHelpful, isn't it?

CompletionLog.text: 去找安威玛尔的提欧·暴风之锤。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

identity.title: The Power of the Light
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Seal of Command. Use Seal of Command on yourself, and then hit one of the Training Dummies at the entrance to Anvilmar.
identity.description: Are ye ready to start?  Wonderful!  We're glad to have ye.$b$bAs ye get stronger, it brings ye closer to the light, and ye learn new techniques. Go ahead and get some more experience, and show me what ye learn.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习命令圣印。对你自己施放命令圣印，然后击打安威玛尔入口处的一个训练假人。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Seal of Command. Use Seal of Command on yourself, and then hit one of the Training Dummies at the entrance to Anvilmar.

Description.text: 你准备开始了吗？好极了！很高兴有你加入。$b$b随着你的实力越来越强，你也越来越接近圣光，并领悟到全新的技巧。去吧，多积累些经验，然后回来给我露两手。
Description.english: Are ye ready to start?  Wonderful!  We're glad to have ye.$b$bAs ye get stronger, it brings ye closer to the light, and ye learn new techniques. Go ahead and get some more experience, and show me what ye learn.

CompletionLog.text: 去找安威玛尔的布罗莫斯·格鲁诺尔。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Bromos Grummner at Anvilmar.

identity.title: Oh, A Hunter's Life For Me
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot, then use Steady Shot 5 times on the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.
identity.description:
The life of a hunter is steeped in tradition, ye know.  Trackin' mighty beasts through rugged terrain.  Drinkin'.  Travelin' the land, yer gun at yer side.  Drinkin'.  Survivin' on wits and courage and cunning, followed by a good stiff drink.$b$bBut before we get to the good stuff, though, ye'll need to learn how to do the beginner stuff.

Go and get some more experience, and ye'll figure out how to do more things. Then ye' drink.

Title.english: Oh, A Hunter's Life For Me

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习稳固射击。然后对安威玛尔入口处的训练假人使用5次稳固射击。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot, then use Steady Shot 5 times on the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.

Description.text:
你知道的，猎人的生活方式总是一成不变。在崎岖坎坷之地追踪强大的野兽，累了喝口烈酒。四处旅行，猎枪傍身，偶尔再来口烈酒。靠智慧、勇气和狡诈生存，狩猎之余再喝上几杯。$b$b但在真刀真枪地动手之前，你得先学会初学者要掌握的本领。

去丰富自己的经验吧，你将会明白如何学会处理更多的事情。然后就可以开怀畅饮了。
Description.english:
The life of a hunter is steeped in tradition, ye know.  Trackin' mighty beasts through rugged terrain.  Drinkin'.  Travelin' the land, yer gun at yer side.  Drinkin'.  Survivin' on wits and courage and cunning, followed by a good stiff drink.$b$bBut before we get to the good stuff, though, ye'll need to learn how to do the beginner stuff.

Go and get some more experience, and ye'll figure out how to do more things. Then ye' drink.

CompletionLog.text: 回安威玛尔找索加斯·格瑞姆森。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thorgas Grimson at Anvilmar.

identity.title: Getting Battle-Ready
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge, then use Charge on one of the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.
identity.description:
Lesson one.  Aside from your sword and shield, what's the most important tool you have in your arsenal?$b$b<Thran awaits your response.>$b$bOh never mind, I'll answer it for you.  It's experience.

As you get more experience, you'll discover new techniques, which means you can be much more effective than you imagined.

Go, get some experience, and learn something new. Then come back and demonstrate.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冲锋。然后对安威玛尔入口处的一个训练假人进行冲锋。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Charge, then use Charge on one of the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.

Description.text:
第一课。除了你的剑和盾之外，你最重要的武器是什么？$b$b<斯兰等待着你的回答。>$b$b啊，算了。我来替你回答吧，是经验。

随着你的经验日渐丰富，你会发现新的技巧。这意味着你将比之前你所想象的还要高效。

去吧，多积累些经验，学会新招。然后回来给我露两手。
Description.english:
Lesson one.  Aside from your sword and shield, what's the most important tool you have in your arsenal?$b$b<Thran awaits your response.>$b$bOh never mind, I'll answer it for you.  It's experience.

As you get more experience, you'll discover new techniques, which means you can be much more effective than you imagined.

Go, get some experience, and learn something new. Then come back and demonstrate.

CompletionLog.text: 去找安威玛尔的斯兰·库尔曼。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thran Khorman in Anvilmar.

identity.title: Evisceratin' the Enemy
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Eviscerate, then use Eviscerate 3 times on the Training Dummies near the entrance to Anvilmar.
identity.description:
When you get to be more experienced, you'll start to find you can take advantage of new abilities. 

One of the things that you'll learn is the ability to use combat maneuvers to weaken an opponent, and then hit them with a devastating technique.

Go and get some experience, figure out how to do it, and then try it out on some of the dummies here.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习刺骨。然后对安威玛尔入口处的训练假人使用3次刺骨。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Eviscerate, then use Eviscerate 3 times on the Training Dummies near the entrance to Anvilmar.

Description.text:
当你的经验变得越来越丰富，你会发现你可以开发出新技巧。

你将学会的其中一个技巧便是利用战斗技能先削弱敌人，然后再以毁灭性的技能施以打击。

去吧，多积累些经验，弄明白如何做到这一点。然后找这里的训练假人来练练手。
Description.english:
When you get to be more experienced, you'll start to find you can take advantage of new abilities. 

One of the things that you'll learn is the ability to use combat maneuvers to weaken an opponent, and then hit them with a devastating technique.

Go and get some experience, figure out how to do it, and then try it out on some of the dummies here.

CompletionLog.text: 去找安威玛尔的索姆·哈格林。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Solm Hargrin in Anvilmar.

identity.title: Words of Power
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain, then cast it 5 times on training dummies.
identity.description:
Now, if ya DO want to become somethin' special, ye'll need to talk to me.  A priest is nothin' without his spells.  And how do you learn new spells?

Ya go and get more experience. So go out, get stronger, and then come show me what ya learn.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习暗言术：痛。然后对训练假人施放5次暗言术：痛。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain, then cast it 5 times on training dummies.

Description.text:
现在，如果你真的想成为一个特别的人，就跟我谈谈吧。牧师没了法术就什么都不是，而你又如何学得新法术呢？

你得多积累些经验。所以出去溜溜，让自己变得更强大，然后回来给我露两手。
Description.english:
Now, if ya DO want to become somethin' special, ye'll need to talk to me.  A priest is nothin' without his spells.  And how do you learn new spells?

Ya go and get more experience. So go out, get stronger, and then come show me what ya learn.

CompletionLog.text: 去找安威玛尔的布兰斯托克·卡德尔。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Branstock Khalder at Anvilmar.

identity.title: Shadowmourne...
identity.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to bring him Shadow's Edge.

Objectives.text: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼想要你将影锋带给他。
Objectives.english: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to bring him Shadow's Edge.

identity.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
identity.objectives: Immerse your Tainted Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
identity.description: I admit, I was skeptical that you had actually re-forged Quel'Delar and I did not expect Thalorien's spirit to reveal itself to you. You cannot understand what it means to my people that Quel'Delar has been recovered.$B$BAs promised, I will admit you to the Sunwell and you will find the leaders of Silvermoon within. Carry the sword to the chamber of the Sunwell and immerse it. Once the blade is restored, return with it to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest.

Objectives.text: 将被污染的奎尔德拉放入太阳之井。准备好进入太阳之井高地后，就同太阳之井守卫交谈。
Objectives.english: Immerse your Tainted Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

Description.text: 我承认，我一直怀疑你不可能重铸奎尔德拉，也不相信萨洛瑞安的灵魂会赐予你祝福。你不可能明白，奎尔德拉的重生对于我们一族意味着什么。$B$B我会履行诺言，让你进入太阳之井。你将在那里找到银月的领导者。将这把剑浸入到太阳之井中。你最好将这件武器托付给银色十字军，它将成为反抗巫妖王的力量团结一致的标志。
Description.english: I admit, I was skeptical that you had actually re-forged Quel'Delar and I did not expect Thalorien's spirit to reveal itself to you. You cannot understand what it means to my people that Quel'Delar has been recovered.$B$BAs promised, I will admit you to the Sunwell and you will find the leaders of Silvermoon within. Carry the sword to the chamber of the Sunwell and immerse it. Once the blade is restored, return with it to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest.

identity.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
identity.objectives: Immerse your Tainted Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
identity.description: The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, $n.$B$BYou will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary of them and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.$B$BInstead, remain focused on your task here. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete the its restoration, then speak with Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

Objectives.text: 将被污染的奎尔德拉放入太阳之井。准备好进入太阳之井高地后，就同太阳之井守卫交谈。
Objectives.english: Immerse your Tainted Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

Description.text: $n，你的面前就是太阳之井和奎尔德拉流亡的终点。$B$B你会在太阳之井中找到奎尔萨拉斯的摄政王洛瑟玛·塞隆和大法师罗曼斯。一定要对他们保持警惕，不要掉进他们的政治陷阱中。$B$B但你主要的精力必须集中在你的任务上。将新的奎尔德拉放进太阳之井中，完成这把神剑的重生。当你准备进入太阳之井高地时，就和一名太阳之井守卫谈谈。
Description.english: The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, $n.$B$BYou will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary of them and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.$B$BInstead, remain focused on your task here. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete the its restoration, then speak with Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

CompletionLog.text: 去冰冠冰川找奎尔德拉之冢的麦雷昂·阳炎。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest in Icecrown.

identity.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
identity.objectives: Immerse your Tempered Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
identity.description: The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, $n.$B$BYou will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary of them and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.$B$BInstead, remain focused on your task here. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete its restoration, then show it to Myralio Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

Objectives.text: 将被污染的奎尔德拉放入太阳之井。准备好进入太阳之井高地后，就同太阳之井守卫交谈。
Objectives.english: Immerse your Tempered Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

Description.text: $n，你的面前就是太阳之井和奎尔德拉流亡的终点。$B$B你会在太阳之井中找到奎尔萨拉斯的摄政王洛瑟玛·塞隆和大法师罗曼斯。一定要对他们保持警惕，不要掉进他们的政治陷阱中。$B$B但你主要的精力必须集中在你的任务上。将新的奎尔德拉放进太阳之井中，完成这把神剑的重生。当你准备进入太阳之井高地时，就和太阳之井守卫谈谈。
Description.english: The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, $n.$B$BYou will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary of them and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.$B$BInstead, remain focused on your task here. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete its restoration, then show it to Myralio Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

CompletionLog.text: 去冰冠冰川找奎尔德拉之冢的麦雷昂·阳炎。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest in Icecrown.

identity.title: A Gift for the Prophet
identity.objectives: Present a Lovely Charm Bracelet to Prophet Velen in the Exodar.
identity.description: Did you want to make a Lovely Charm Bracelet for the Prophet of the Exodar? I'm sure he'd be thrilled.$B$BDo you already have a Lovely Charm Collector's Kit?

Objectives.text: 向埃索达的先知维伦献上一件可爱的情人符手镯。
Objectives.english: Present a Lovely Charm Bracelet to Prophet Velen in the Exodar.

Description.text: 你想要为埃索达先知制作一款可爱的情人符手镯吗？我相信他一定会非常喜欢这样的礼物。$B$B你已经有可爱的情人符工具箱了吗？
Description.english: Did you want to make a Lovely Charm Bracelet for the Prophet of the Exodar? I'm sure he'd be thrilled.$B$BDo you already have a Lovely Charm Collector's Kit?

identity.title: Crushing the Crown
identity.objectives: Kill 5 Crown Lackeys and use Snagglebolt's Khorium Bomb to damage one Chemical Wagon just west of Orgrimmar's gates in Durotar, then return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.$b$bHere's an entry I want you to check out: it's right outside Orgrimmar's gates, to the west! That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up.$b$bOh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

Objectives.text: 消灭5个皇冠仆从，并使用滑栓的氪金炸弹摧毁在杜隆塔尔的奥格瑞玛大门西方的一台药剂车。然后返回奥格瑞玛，去见侦探斯奈普·滑栓。
Objectives.english: Kill 5 Crown Lackeys and use Snagglebolt's Khorium Bomb to damage one Chemical Wagon just west of Orgrimmar's gates in Durotar, then return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.

Description.text: 这账本上提到了多处地点，我需要你前去调查并采取相应的行动，伙计。不能再拖下去了。$b$b这是我要你调查的一处地点：就在奥格瑞玛大门外，西面！他们肯定不会干什么好事。到那儿去解决掉他们。$b$b噢，对了，如果你发现了某些危险的大玩意儿需要当场销毁的话，就朝它丢这个炸弹。
Description.english: This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.$b$bHere's an entry I want you to check out: it's right outside Orgrimmar's gates, to the west! That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up.$b$bOh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.

identity.title: The Arts of a Warrior
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Practice using Charge against a Tiki Target.
identity.description: As ya get bettah' at fightin', you'll start to find new tings that ya nevah knew you could do.$B$BWanna see? Go, train up some, and learn someting new.$B$B'Den come back and ya can show me.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冲锋。然后对一个蒂基面具假人进行冲锋。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Practice using Charge against a Tiki Target.

Description.text: 随着你的战斗技巧越来越娴熟，你会开始发现一些之前你从未想到过的新技巧。$B$B想见识下吗？去吧，多进行些训练，学会新技巧。$B$B然后回来露两手给我瞧瞧。
Description.english: As ya get bettah' at fightin', you'll start to find new tings that ya nevah knew you could do.$B$BWanna see? Go, train up some, and learn someting new.$B$B'Den come back and ya can show me.

CompletionLog.text: 去找回音群岛暗矛训练场的诺泰特。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Nortet at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

identity.title: Returning A-Me 01
identity.objectives: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile.
identity.description: Greetings.  I unit A-Me 01.  You... $r?$B$BA-Me's mission to study the local gorillas was success.  A-Me has gathered data and now will bring to Karna.$b$bIt time for A-Me to return to Karna.  You come with?  We embark right away, so make sure you ready first.

Objectives.text: 護送艾米01回去苔蘚堆找卡爾納·雷姆塔維爾。
Objectives.english: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile.

Description.text: 歡迎。我，單位艾米01。你...$r?$B$B艾米研究當地猩群的任務已成功。艾米收集資料，現在帶回去給卡爾納。$b$b該是艾米回去找卡爾納的時間了。你一起來嗎?我們馬上出發，確定你準備好了。
Description.english: Greetings.  I unit A-Me 01.  You... $r?$B$BA-Me's mission to study the local gorillas was success.  A-Me has gathered data and now will bring to Karna.$b$bIt time for A-Me to return to Karna.  You come with?  We embark right away, so make sure you ready first.

CompletionLog.text: 回去苔蘚堆找卡爾納·雷姆塔維爾。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile.

identity.title: Williden's Journal
identity.objectives: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.
identity.description: You have uncovered a mangled journal.  Parts of it remain legible, with a Williden Marshal claiming ownership over the contents therein.  If the journal is accurate, then Williden may be found somewhere in the central part of the Crater; according to the journal, he and his companions sought to take a more offensive stance once their refuge was attacked.

Objectives.text: 将日记还给安戈洛环形山某处的威利德·马绍尔。
Objectives.english: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.

Description.text: 你找到了一本被撕破的日记，其中的某些部分仍然清晰可辨，目录中有威利德·马绍尔的署名。如果日记上面的记载没错的话，那么你可以在环形山的中部地区找到威利德。根据日记中所说的，他和他的同伴们的营地被袭击了，所以他们打算找个更容易占据主动的落脚点。
Description.english: You have uncovered a mangled journal.  Parts of it remain legible, with a Williden Marshal claiming ownership over the contents therein.  If the journal is accurate, then Williden may be found somewhere in the central part of the Crater; according to the journal, he and his companions sought to take a more offensive stance once their refuge was attacked.

CompletionLog.text: 向马绍尔哨站的霍莱伊·马绍尔复命。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Williden Marshal at Un'Goro Crater.

identity.title: The Arts of a Mage
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Practice using it 2 times against a Tiki Target.
identity.description:
As ya' develop ya' powah, ya' gonna start to tink of new spells, new ways to use ya' arcane talents. 

Go now, grow ya' skills, and 'den come back an' show me what 'cha figure out.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冰霜新星。然后对一个蒂基面具假人施放2次冰霜新星。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Practice using it 2 times against a Tiki Target.

Description.text:
随着你的力量不断提升，你会开始思索出全新的法术，用以延伸奥术天赋的新领域。

去吧，多积累些经验，然后回来露两手给我瞧瞧。
Description.english:
As ya' develop ya' powah, ya' gonna start to tink of new spells, new ways to use ya' arcane talents. 

Go now, grow ya' skills, and 'den come back an' show me what 'cha figure out.

CompletionLog.text: 去找回音群岛暗矛训练场的索拉萨。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Soratha at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

identity.title: The Arts of a Shaman
identity.objectives: Reach Level 3 to learn Primal Strike, and then use Primal Strike 3 times against a Tiki Target.
identity.description:
As ya grow in powah, you begin ta discovah the voices of da ancestahs speakin' to ya, teachin' you dere secrets.

Tha first of 'dese is to focus tha power of da elements into yer weapon. It allows ya to unleash a quick, vicious attack on your enemies. Dis should be easy enough for ya to make a lot of use of it.$B$BTry it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习根源打击。然后对一个蒂基面具假人使用3次根源打击。
Objectives.english: Reach Level 3 to learn Primal Strike, and then use Primal Strike 3 times against a Tiki Target.

Description.text:
随着你的力量不断提升，你开始发现远古之魂的声音在你耳旁低语，教你领会萨满的秘密。

其中第一个秘密就是将元素的力量灌注在武器中，可使你对敌人进行迅捷而致命的打击。你应该很容易就能掌握它的使用方法。$B$B试试看吧。等你准备好了就告诉我。
Description.english:
As ya grow in powah, you begin ta discovah the voices of da ancestahs speakin' to ya, teachin' you dere secrets.

Tha first of 'dese is to focus tha power of da elements into yer weapon. It allows ya to unleash a quick, vicious attack on your enemies. Dis should be easy enough for ya to make a lot of use of it.$B$BTry it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.

CompletionLog.text: 去找回音群岛暗矛训练场的奈卡利。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Nekali at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

identity.title: The Arts of a Druid
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Moonfire. Practice using it on a Tiki target in the Darkspear Training Grounds.
identity.description:
As ya grow in powah, ya ability to call on nature gets strongah, too. Ya wanna see?

Go get some experience and show me what ya' learn.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习月火术。然后对暗矛训练场的一个蒂基面具假人施放月火术。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Moonfire. Practice using it on a Tiki target in the Darkspear Training Grounds.

Description.text:
随着你的力量不断提升，你召唤自然的能力也不断增强。想见识一下吗？

去积累些经验，然后回来给我露两手。
Description.english:
As ya grow in powah, ya ability to call on nature gets strongah, too. Ya wanna see?

Go get some experience and show me what ya' learn.

CompletionLog.text: 去找回音群岛暗矛训练场的岑塔布拉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Zen'Tabra at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

identity.title: The Arts of a Rogue
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Eviscerate, then use Eviscerate 3 times against a Tiki Target.
identity.description:
As ya fight ya enemies, ya will learn new tricks you use ta be even bettah'. 

There's one ya should be learnin' soon to let ya see dere weaknesses and set up for devastating combo attacks. After ya've struck a few blows to weaken ya foe, finish dem off with a vicious evisceration attack.

When ya learn it, try it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习刺骨。然后对一个蒂基面具假人使用3次刺骨。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Eviscerate, then use Eviscerate 3 times against a Tiki Target.

Description.text:
当你和你的敌人战斗时，你会学到前所未有的新诀窍。

其中有个诀窍你必须尽快掌握，那就是看清敌人的弱点，并伺机发动毁灭性的连击。当你通过一连串攻击削弱对手后，用威力十足的刺骨来终结他们。

一旦你学会了，就试试看。等你准备好了就告诉我。
Description.english:
As ya fight ya enemies, ya will learn new tricks you use ta be even bettah'. 

There's one ya should be learnin' soon to let ya see dere weaknesses and set up for devastating combo attacks. After ya've struck a few blows to weaken ya foe, finish dem off with a vicious evisceration attack.

When ya learn it, try it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.

CompletionLog.text: 去找回音群岛暗矛训练场的雷加提。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Legati at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

identity.title: The Arts of a Hunter
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Use Steady Shot 5 times on a Tiki Target.
identity.description: As ya' start to get da hang of tings, ya gonna figure out how ta do new tricks.$B$BOne of da' first ya gonna learn is to keep a steady hand between shots, or else ya gonna find yaself exhausted and not really managin' to kill much.$B$BGo get some more experience 'till ya figure it out, 'den come back and try it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习稳固射击。然后对一个蒂基面具假人使用5次稳固射击。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Use Steady Shot 5 times on a Tiki Target.

Description.text: 由于你已经开始掌握这些事情的诀窍，你将会明白如何使用新的技巧。$B$B你要学习的第一件事情是在射击间隙保持手臂的稳定，否则如果气力不济，将很难杀死很多敌人。$B$B多锻炼一下吧，明白之后再回来找我，然后向我演示。当你认为自己已经明白时，记得告诉我。
Description.english: As ya' start to get da hang of tings, ya gonna figure out how ta do new tricks.$B$BOne of da' first ya gonna learn is to keep a steady hand between shots, or else ya gonna find yaself exhausted and not really managin' to kill much.$B$BGo get some more experience 'till ya figure it out, 'den come back and try it out. Let me know when ya tink you have it down.

identity.title: Learnin' tha Word
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Use it 5 times on 5 Tiki training dummies.
identity.description: As ya get more skill out there in tha' world, you'll start to discovah' new powahs.$B$BWhy dontcha go out an' go get yaself stronger, and come back when ya learn sometin' new. You can show me what ya learn.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习暗言术：痛。然后对5个蒂基面具假人施放5次暗言术：痛。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Use it 5 times on 5 Tiki training dummies.

Description.text: 当你的技巧变得越来越娴熟，你会开始发现一些新的力量。$B$B你为什么不出去修行，让自己变得更强大呢。等你学会了新法术，记得回来给我露两手，让我瞧瞧你都学到了些什么。
Description.english: As ya get more skill out there in tha' world, you'll start to discovah' new powahs.$B$BWhy dontcha go out an' go get yaself stronger, and come back when ya learn sometin' new. You can show me what ya learn.

CompletionLog.text: 去找回音群岛暗矛训练场的图娜尼。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Tunari at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

identity.title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
identity.objectives: Bring the Restored Quel'Delar to Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
identity.description: At last, Quel'Delar is restored for the glory of the Sunreavers and the sin'dorei!$B$BAll of Silvermoon will celebrate you as a hero, $n.$B$BAs a $c, the sword seems to know you lack the training to wield it and hasn't bonded to you. Where, then, will its next master come from? No worthy sin'dorei has come forward. Let us seek the Argent Crusade's counsel. Go north to the Argent Tournament Grounds and present the sword to Justicar Mariel Trueheart on behalf of the Sunreavers.

Objectives.text: 将奎尔德拉交给银色比武场的裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特。
Objectives.english: Bring the Restored Quel'Delar to Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.

Description.text: 奎尔德拉终于回到了我们的手中，这是夺日者和辛多雷的光荣！$B$B银月城的全部居民都会将你视为英雄，$n。$B$B奎尔德拉似乎知道你是一名$c，无法使用它。那么它的下一个主人该是谁？我们这里没有找到有此能力的辛多雷。让我们去银色十字军那里看看吧。到北边的银色比武场去，代表夺日者将这把剑交给裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特。
Description.english: At last, Quel'Delar is restored for the glory of the Sunreavers and the sin'dorei!$B$BAll of Silvermoon will celebrate you as a hero, $n.$B$BAs a $c, the sword seems to know you lack the training to wield it and hasn't bonded to you. Where, then, will its next master come from? No worthy sin'dorei has come forward. Let us seek the Argent Crusade's counsel. Go north to the Argent Tournament Grounds and present the sword to Justicar Mariel Trueheart on behalf of the Sunreavers.

CompletionLog.text: 去找银色比武场中银色大帐的裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Justicar Mariel Trueheart in the Argent Pavilion at the Argent Tournament Grounds.

identity.title: Attack on Camp Narache
identity.objectives: Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
identity.description: After carefully evaluating the map, you realize that what you discovered are the plans made by the Bristleback warchief for an extended siege on Camp Narache.$b$bSurely Chief Hawkwind could use this information!

Objectives.text: 将刺背野猪人的进攻计划交给纳拉其营地的鹰风酋长。
Objectives.english: Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.

Description.text: 在仔细查看了地图之后，你意识到刺背野猪人的酋长正计划着对纳拉其营地展开进一步攻击。$b$b鹰风酋长必须马上得知这个消息。
Description.english: After carefully evaluating the map, you realize that what you discovered are the plans made by the Bristleback warchief for an extended siege on Camp Narache.$b$bSurely Chief Hawkwind could use this information!

CompletionLog.text: 去莫高雷找纳拉其营地的鹰风酋长。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Chief Hawkwind at Camp Narache in Mulgore.

identity.title: Deprogramming
identity.objectives: Defeat Lady Deathwhisper while ensuring that Darnavan survives.
identity.description: We had hoped to place a man on the inside of the Cult of the Damned, to give us an inside angle on the Lich King's machinations, but we... underestimated the persuasive powers of Arthas and his dark minister, Lady Deathwhisper.$B$BOur man, Darnavan, is one of them now.$B$BIf you plan on fighting your way through the Oratory ahead, please keep your eyes peeled for Darnavan. If you can bring him back to us alive, we can attempt to reverse the Cult's brainwashing.

Objectives.text: 击败亡语者女士，同时确保达尔纳文活着。
Objectives.english: Defeat Lady Deathwhisper while ensuring that Darnavan survives.

Description.text: 我们本打算在诅咒教派中安排一名线人，以刺探巫妖王的计划，但是，我们……低估了阿尔萨斯和他的黑暗部下，亡语者女士，的煽动能力。$B$B我们的线人，达尔纳文，现在已经投靠他们了。$B$B请务必留意达尔纳文的踪迹。如果你能将他活着带回来，我们可以尝试解除诅咒教派对他所做的洗脑工作。
Description.english: We had hoped to place a man on the inside of the Cult of the Damned, to give us an inside angle on the Lich King's machinations, but we... underestimated the persuasive powers of Arthas and his dark minister, Lady Deathwhisper.$B$BOur man, Darnavan, is one of them now.$B$BIf you plan on fighting your way through the Oratory ahead, please keep your eyes peeled for Darnavan. If you can bring him back to us alive, we can attempt to reverse the Cult's brainwashing.

identity.title: Securing the Ramparts
identity.objectives: Slay the Rotting Frost Giant.
identity.description: As if this place weren't enough of a madhouse to begin with, we're fighting a war on two fronts up here, with the Scourge on one side and those blasted Horde dogs on our other flank!$B$BWe are here to clear a safe landing for our vessels, but a behemoth of a giant on the other side of the Ramparts is hurling debris at anything that comes close and keeping our smaller ships at bay.$B$BI'll be honest -- he's a bit much for us to handle, but you and your companions look up to the task.

Objectives.text: 消灭腐烂的冰霜巨人。
Objectives.english: Slay the Rotting Frost Giant.

Description.text: 仿佛现在的局势还不够疯狂一样，我们又要在两条战线上作战了！我们面前是天灾军团，而那些该死的部落却在偷袭我们的后方！$B$B我们在这里的任务是为我们的飞艇清理出一片安全的着陆点，但在那道城垒的另一侧，一个大家伙正在向所有靠近的东西投掷弹药。这让我们的小型船只根本无法着陆。$B$B说实话，它对于我们来说的确是有些太大了。但你和你的朋友们似乎能够对付它。
Description.english: As if this place weren't enough of a madhouse to begin with, we're fighting a war on two fronts up here, with the Scourge on one side and those blasted Horde dogs on our other flank!$B$BWe are here to clear a safe landing for our vessels, but a behemoth of a giant on the other side of the Ramparts is hurling debris at anything that comes close and keeping our smaller ships at bay.$B$BI'll be honest -- he's a bit much for us to handle, but you and your companions look up to the task.

CompletionLog.text: 去找破天号将领。
CompletionLog.english: Return to the Skybreaker Lieutenant.

identity.title: Respite for a Tormented Soul
identity.objectives: Use the Life Crystals to preserve Sindragosa's Essence.
identity.description: Take this Life Crystal, and have your companions take one as well. It contains potent energies from the verdant Dragonshrine in Dragonblight, and it was my own secret to resisting the dark magics of this place for so long.$B$BWhen you face Sindragosa, battle her until she is weakened, and then have your companions use these Crystals to coax out the essence that is dormant within her. If you then defeat her, you should be able to recover it and return it to Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

Objectives.text: 使用生命水晶，保护辛达苟萨的灵魂。
Objectives.english: Use the Life Crystals to preserve Sindragosa's Essence.

Description.text: 带上这颗生命水晶，也让你的同伴们都各拿上一颗。它蕴含着龙骨荒野巨龙圣地的力量。正是靠着这种力量，我才能抵抗黑暗魔法这么长的时间。$B$B当你与辛达苟萨作战的时候，要先尽量削弱他，然后让你们队伍中的四个人一同使用生命水晶，吸出被封锁在她躯体内的灵魂。然后当你击败辛达苟萨之后，就可以收取她的灵魂，并将这个灵魂送到龙骨荒野的龙眠神殿。
Description.english: Take this Life Crystal, and have your companions take one as well. It contains potent energies from the verdant Dragonshrine in Dragonblight, and it was my own secret to resisting the dark magics of this place for so long.$B$BWhen you face Sindragosa, battle her until she is weakened, and then have your companions use these Crystals to coax out the essence that is dormant within her. If you then defeat her, you should be able to recover it and return it to Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

CompletionLog.text: 将辛达苟萨的灵魂交给龙骨荒野中龙眠神殿的卡雷苟斯。
CompletionLog.english: Deliver Sindragosa's Essence to Kalecgos at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

identity.title: Residue Rendezvous
identity.objectives: Return to Alchemist Adrianna while infected with Orange and Green Blight.
identity.description: Professor Putricide has been holed up in his foul laboratory, experimenting and refining increasingly lethal strains of blight to be used against us. If only we could obtain pure samples of the toxins, our researchers could concoct an antidote that would save countless lives.$B$BBut there's a catch -- a proper sample will need to mix two active strains within a living host. Should you have the... misfortune... of becoming such a host, please return here immediately so that we can harvest you for study.

Objectives.text: 承受了橙色和绿色毒气之后，返回到采炼师阿德里安娜那里。
Objectives.english: Return to Alchemist Adrianna while infected with Orange and Green Blight.

Description.text: 普崔塞德教授一直藏在他肮脏的实验室里，配制各种可怕的药剂来戕害我们。如果我们能取得他的药剂样品，我们的研究人员就能研制出解药。无数生命都将因此而得救。$B$B但问题是，这种药剂样品需要让两种成份在一个不幸的活体中融合。如果你……不幸成为了这样的活体，请立刻回到这里来，让我们能借助你进行研究。
Description.english: Professor Putricide has been holed up in his foul laboratory, experimenting and refining increasingly lethal strains of blight to be used against us. If only we could obtain pure samples of the toxins, our researchers could concoct an antidote that would save countless lives.$B$BBut there's a catch -- a proper sample will need to mix two active strains within a living host. Should you have the... misfortune... of becoming such a host, please return here immediately so that we can harvest you for study.

CompletionLog.text: 去找冰冠堡垒的阿德里安娜。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Adrianna inside Icecrown Citadel.

identity.title: Blood Quickening
identity.objectives: Rescue Infiltrator Minchar before he is executed.
identity.description: These Scourge bloodsuckers -- San'layn they call themselves - give me the creeps. We've had one of our best men keeping an eye on them. But this morning he got sloppy and got himself taken prisoner. He's being interrogated by the Queen herself right now, and his cries echo through the Crimson Halls. Please, save him before it's too late!

Objectives.text: 在内线米查尔被处死之前将他救出来。
Objectives.english: Rescue Infiltrator Minchar before he is executed.

Description.text: 这些自称萨莱因的天灾吸血者们真让我毛骨悚然。我们原本派了一名优秀的部下去监视他们，但是今天早上他一时疏忽被那些怪物给抓住了。他现在正在被女王亲自刑审，他的凄惨叫声一直回荡在血色厅堂。拜托你了，救救他，否则一切都晚了！
Description.english: These Scourge bloodsuckers -- San'layn they call themselves - give me the creeps. We've had one of our best men keeping an eye on them. But this morning he got sloppy and got himself taken prisoner. He's being interrogated by the Queen herself right now, and his cries echo through the Crimson Halls. Please, save him before it's too late!

CompletionLog.text: 去找米查尔。
CompletionLog.english: Talk to Minchar.

identity.title: Trail-Worn Scroll
identity.objectives: Read the Trail-Worn Scroll and speak to Xavier the Huntsman in Deathknell.
identity.description: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the hunter trainer Xavier. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.

Objectives.text: 阅读字迹模糊的卷轴，然后与丧钟镇的猎手哈维尔交谈。
Objectives.english: Read the Trail-Worn Scroll and speak to Xavier the Huntsman in Deathknell.

Description.text: 啊，你在外面对付那些无脑的天灾士兵时，有人给你送来了这张卷轴。卷轴上有猎人训练师哈维尔的徽记，所以我觉得这事可能挺重要的。你最好先看看上面说了些什么。
Description.english: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the hunter trainer Xavier. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.

identity.title: The Thrill of the Hunt
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot, then practice using Steady Shot 5 times on a Training Dummy.
identity.description: I've been told that I'm supposed to train you how to be a hunter.  That's all well and good, but in my opinion, you'll get more training out in the field than you will talking about theories with me.$b$bGo out, get some more experience, and see if you learn any new tricks. Then you can come back and show me.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习稳固射击。然后对一个训练假人使用5次稳固射击。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot, then practice using Steady Shot 5 times on a Training Dummy.

Description.text: 有人嘱咐我说，一定要把你训练成合格的猎人。说得倒是没错啦，不过依我之见，与其跟我纸上谈兵，不如去外面真刀实枪地演练。$b$b快去野外，多积累些经验，看看你是否能学会新技巧。然后你就可以回来给我露两手瞧瞧了。
Description.english: I've been told that I'm supposed to train you how to be a hunter.  That's all well and good, but in my opinion, you'll get more training out in the field than you will talking about theories with me.$b$bGo out, get some more experience, and see if you learn any new tricks. Then you can come back and show me.

CompletionLog.text: 去找提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇的猎手哈维尔。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Xavier the Huntsman at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

identity.title: Magic Training
identity.objectives: Reach Level 3 to learn Frost Nova, then practice using it 2 times against a Training Dummy.
identity.description:
Let's get some work done, shall we?

As you grow in power, your connection to the arcane will deepen, granting you access to new spells.

You'll see. Go, get some more experience, then come back and demonstrate what you've learned.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冰霜新星。然后对一个训练假人施放2次冰霜新星。
Objectives.english: Reach Level 3 to learn Frost Nova, then practice using it 2 times against a Training Dummy.

Description.text:
咱们先把正事办了吧，怎么样？

随着你的力量不断提升，你与奥术之间的联系也在不断加强，由此你可以习得新法术。

等着瞧吧。去多积累些经验，然后回来向我展示一下，你都学到了些什么。
Description.english:
Let's get some work done, shall we?

As you grow in power, your connection to the arcane will deepen, granting you access to new spells.

You'll see. Go, get some more experience, then come back and demonstrate what you've learned.

CompletionLog.text: 去找提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇的伊莎贝拉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Isabella at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

identity.title: Of Light and Shadows
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Then, practice casting it 5 times on training dummies.
identity.description:
A Forsaken priest is a curious beast,$b$g his: her; path an unusual course.$b$G His: Her; shadowy rites cannot come from the Light, so $g he: she; seeks a more sinister source.$b$bNot only has the world forsaken us, $n... it seems the Light has left us as well.  As the poem hints, however... we are not without power.

Go, get more experience, grow your power. Return to me, and demonstrate what you have learned.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习暗言术：痛。然后对训练假人施放5次暗言术：痛。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Then, practice casting it 5 times on training dummies.

Description.text:
被遗忘者牧师是一头求知若渴的猛兽，$b$g他:她;要走的路与众不同。$b$G他:她;那阴影般的力量无法从光明而来，因此$g他:她;必须追随邪恶的源泉。$b$b抛弃我们的并不只是这个世界，$n……连圣光都离弃了我们。不过正像上面那首诗说的……我们并不是没有力量。

去吧，多积累些经验，提升你的力量。之后回来见我，让我瞧瞧你都学到了些什么。
Description.english:
A Forsaken priest is a curious beast,$b$g his: her; path an unusual course.$b$G His: Her; shadowy rites cannot come from the Light, so $g he: she; seeks a more sinister source.$b$bNot only has the world forsaken us, $n... it seems the Light has left us as well.  As the poem hints, however... we are not without power.

Go, get more experience, grow your power. Return to me, and demonstrate what you have learned.

CompletionLog.text: 去找提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇的黑暗牧师杜斯滕。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Dark Cleric Duesten at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

identity.title: Stab!
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Eviscerate, then practice using Eviscerate 3 times on a Training Dummy.
identity.description:
Quiet down!  I don't want these novices around us to hear what we're about to discuss.$b$bListen up... $n, is it? Soon, you'll learn something that'll change the way you operate as a rogue.  You'll be able to follow up on your attacks with a deadly finishing move. Maybe even slide a dagger between their vertebrae.

To learn it, you just gotta get some more experience. Don't worry, you'll figure it out.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习刺骨。然后对一个训练假人使用3次刺骨。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Eviscerate, then practice using Eviscerate 3 times on a Training Dummy.

Description.text:
安静！我可不想让周围这些菜鸟听到我们的讨论。$b$b听好了……你是叫$n，对吧？很快，你将会学到一种格斗技巧，可以改变你作为潜行者的战斗方式。你可以在一连串攻击后使出致命的终结技，甚至能将匕首刺入他们的要害。

想要学会此技巧，你得多积累些经验。不用担心，你会有办法的。
Description.english:
Quiet down!  I don't want these novices around us to hear what we're about to discuss.$b$bListen up... $n, is it? Soon, you'll learn something that'll change the way you operate as a rogue.  You'll be able to follow up on your attacks with a deadly finishing move. Maybe even slide a dagger between their vertebrae.

To learn it, you just gotta get some more experience. Don't worry, you'll figure it out.

CompletionLog.text: 去找提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇的大卫·提亚斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to David Trias at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

identity.title: Dark Deeds
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption, then practice casting Corruption 5 times on a Training Dummy.
identity.description:
As you continue your career as a warlock, you'll begin to hear the voices of fel power... they will reveal their secrets, teaching you new spells.

I want to see you learn a new spell and try it out on one of the dummies here.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习腐蚀术。然后对一个训练假人使用5次腐蚀术。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption, then practice casting Corruption 5 times on a Training Dummy.

Description.text:
随着你继续沿着术士之路成长，你会开始听到邪恶力量的低语……他们会揭示他们的秘密，传授新法术给你。

我想看到你学会一门新法术，并拿这里的训练假人来练练手。
Description.english:
As you continue your career as a warlock, you'll begin to hear the voices of fel power... they will reveal their secrets, teaching you new spells.

I want to see you learn a new spell and try it out on one of the dummies here.

identity.title: Charging into Battle
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge, then practice using Charge on a Training Dummy.
identity.description: If you want to become a stronger warrior, you'll need to work on your weapons.  You'll find stronger swords and larger shields out on your adventures, that I have no doubt about.$b$bBut it isn't just your physical armory that will get stronger - you'll also begin to discover new techniques. Go, get some experience, learn something new, then come back and show me.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冲锋。然后对一个训练假人进行冲锋。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Charge, then practice using Charge on a Training Dummy.

Description.text: 如果你想成为一名更加强大的战士，就需要改善你的武器。将来你肯定会找到更锋利的剑，更大的盾牌，这一点我毫不怀疑。$B$B但不仅仅是你的武器装备越来越好——同时你也会发现新的技巧。去吧，多积累些经验，学习新技巧。然后回来露两手给我瞧瞧。
Description.english: If you want to become a stronger warrior, you'll need to work on your weapons.  You'll find stronger swords and larger shields out on your adventures, that I have no doubt about.$b$bBut it isn't just your physical armory that will get stronger - you'll also begin to discover new techniques. Go, get some experience, learn something new, then come back and show me.

CompletionLog.text: 去找提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇的丹纳尔·斯特恩。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Dannal Stern at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

identity.title: The Red Messenger
identity.objectives: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, and obtain any information you can find.
identity.description: Reports from my superiors in Brill indicate that an agent of the Scarlet Crusade was dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!$b$bYou're the most qualified person I have to send, $n. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.

Objectives.text: 在十字军营地里杀死信使迈文·考加尔，搜获他身上的情报。
Objectives.english: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, and obtain any information you can find.

Description.text: 据布瑞尔的上级发来的报告称，有一名血色十字军的特使从血色修道院出发，到丧钟镇来了。根据报告上的描述，这名信使随身携带着重要的情报。我手头上没有更多细节了，但不管他带着什么情报，我们都必须得到它！$B$B你是我能派出的最靠谱的人，$n。找到这个信使，把你能搞到手的情报都给我带回来。
Description.english: Reports from my superiors in Brill indicate that an agent of the Scarlet Crusade was dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!$b$bYou're the most qualified person I have to send, $n. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.

CompletionLog.text: 去找提瑞斯法林地的丧钟镇里的执行官阿伦。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Executor Arren at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

identity.title: Have You Seen Anything Weird Out There?
identity.objectives: Speak with Executor Zygand about your encounter with the worgen.
identity.description: $R!  Listen up, I got somethin'... odd to discuss.$b$bI was out fishin' by Brightwater Lake when I saw the darnedest thing... some sorta wolf-man, running around Tirisfal.  Ya don't suppose that could be a... worgen, do ya?$b$bAnyway, I keep tellin' myself I should tell Executor Zygand about it, but I just get so scared when I talk to that guy.  Maybe you could talk with him?

Title.text: 你在外面见过什么奇怪的事情吗？
Title.english: Have You Seen Anything Weird Out There?

Objectives.text: 跟执行官塞加德谈一谈遇见狼人的事情。
Objectives.english: Speak with Executor Zygand about your encounter with the worgen.

Description.text: $R！听好，我有一件……奇怪的事情要谈谈。$b$b我正在澈水湖边钓鱼呢，突然看见一个超吓人的东西……某种半狼半人的东西，在提瑞斯法的树林中跑来跑去。你想那该不会是……狼人吧？$b$b总而言之，我一直对自己说，我该把这事告诉执行官塞加德，但我害怕跟那人说话。也许你能跟他谈谈？
Description.english: $R!  Listen up, I got somethin'... odd to discuss.$b$bI was out fishin' by Brightwater Lake when I saw the darnedest thing... some sorta wolf-man, running around Tirisfal.  Ya don't suppose that could be a... worgen, do ya?$b$bAnyway, I keep tellin' myself I should tell Executor Zygand about it, but I just get so scared when I talk to that guy.  Maybe you could talk with him?

identity.title: Subduing the Elements
identity.objectives: Gavan Grayfeather wants you to use the elemental sapta and cleansing totem from the Earthen Ring supplies to subdue 20 Agitated Earth Spirits.
identity.description: The elements are restless, $c.  The earthquakes that plague the land and threaten to collapse Ironforge are not normal.  The Earthen Ring are convinced that we must put the elements to rest before they tear Azeroth apart.  We need your help, $n.$b$bI will give you a bag of Earthen Ring supplies.  In it you will find two items, elemental sapta and a cleansing totem.  Use the sapta to see into the elemental world.  Then use the cleansing totem to subdue the agitated earth spirits.

Objectives.text: 加文·灰羽要你使用大地之环补给品中的元素灵契和净化图腾，制服20个激动的大地之魂。
Objectives.english: Gavan Grayfeather wants you to use the elemental sapta and cleansing totem from the Earthen Ring supplies to subdue 20 Agitated Earth Spirits.

Description.text: $c，元素的动荡永不会止歇。正在危害这片土地，甚至可能摧毁铁炉堡的地震并不寻常。大地之环相信，我们必须在元素彻底撕裂艾泽拉斯之前让它们恢复平静。我们需要你的帮助，$n。$b$b我会给你一口袋大地之环的补给品。你能在其中找到两件物品——元素灵契和净化图腾。你可以用灵契看到元素世界。然后你就要使用净化图腾制服躁动的大地之魂。
Description.english: The elements are restless, $c.  The earthquakes that plague the land and threaten to collapse Ironforge are not normal.  The Earthen Ring are convinced that we must put the elements to rest before they tear Azeroth apart.  We need your help, $n.$b$bI will give you a bag of Earthen Ring supplies.  In it you will find two items, elemental sapta and a cleansing totem.  Use the sapta to see into the elemental world.  Then use the cleansing totem to subdue the agitated earth spirits.

identity.title: Subduing the Elements
identity.objectives: Seer Bahura wants you to use the elemental sapta and cleansing totem from the Earthen Ring supplies to subdue 20 Agitated Fire Spirits.
identity.description: The elements are restless, $c.  The earthquakes that plague the land and the fires that threaten to burn down Orgrimmar are not normal.  The Earthen Ring are convinced that we must put the elements to rest before they tear Azeroth apart.  We need your help, $n.$b$bI will give you a bag of Earthen Ring supplies.  In it you will find two items, elemental sapta and a cleansing totem.  Use the sapta to see into the elemental world.  Then use the cleansing totem to subdue the agitated fire spirits.

Objectives.text: 先知巴胡拉要你使用大地之环补给品中的元素灵契和净化图腾，制服20个激动的火焰之魂。
Objectives.english: Seer Bahura wants you to use the elemental sapta and cleansing totem from the Earthen Ring supplies to subdue 20 Agitated Fire Spirits.

Description.text: $c，元素的动荡永不会止歇。正在危害这片土地的地震和随时可能烧毁奥格瑞玛的大火并不寻常。大地之环相信，我们必须在元素彻底撕裂艾泽拉斯之前让它们恢复平静。我们需要你的帮助，$n。$b$b我会给你一口袋大地之环的补给品。你能在其中找到两件物品——元素灵契和净化图腾。你可以用灵契看到元素世界。然后你就要使用净化图腾制服躁动的火焰之魂。
Description.english: The elements are restless, $c.  The earthquakes that plague the land and the fires that threaten to burn down Orgrimmar are not normal.  The Earthen Ring are convinced that we must put the elements to rest before they tear Azeroth apart.  We need your help, $n.$b$bI will give you a bag of Earthen Ring supplies.  In it you will find two items, elemental sapta and a cleansing totem.  Use the sapta to see into the elemental world.  Then use the cleansing totem to subdue the agitated fire spirits.

CompletionLog.text: 去找奥格瑞玛的先知巴胡拉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Seer Bahura in Orgrimmar.

identity.title: Little Sumpthin'
identity.objectives: Drazzit Dripvalve wants you to talk to Vern Futzwidget in Thousand Needles.
identity.description: Lissen, pal.$b$bI got a friend, who knows a fella, who might just be lookin' for a $c that knows $ghis:her; way around a fight.$b$bIf you're not afraid to get your hands dirty, head south over the mountains and look for a goblin named Vern.$b$bTell him Drazz sent ya...

Objectives.text: 德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔要你跟千针石林的韦恩·法兹维吉谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Drazzit Dripvalve wants you to talk to Vern Futzwidget in Thousand Needles.

Description.text: 听着，伙计。$b$b我有个朋友，他认识一个家伙，正在找一名对战斗在行的$c。$b$b如果你不怕把手弄脏的话，就往南穿过山脉去找一个叫做韦恩的地精。$b$b告诉他是德拉兹派你去的。
Description.english: Lissen, pal.$b$bI got a friend, who knows a fella, who might just be lookin' for a $c that knows $ghis:her; way around a fight.$b$bIf you're not afraid to get your hands dirty, head south over the mountains and look for a goblin named Vern.$b$bTell him Drazz sent ya...

identity.title: Friend of a Friend
identity.objectives: Smiling Jim wants you to talk to Vern Futzwidget in Thousand Needles.
identity.description: Say, you look like a frisky sort...$b$bI know a guy who knows a fella that might be lookin' for a $c who knows $ghis:her; way around a fight.$b$bIf you're not afraid to get your hands a little dirty, make your way south across the mountains and look for a goblin by the name of Vern.$b$bTell him Smiling Jim sent ya.

Objectives.text: 微笑的吉姆要你跟千针石林的韦恩·法兹维吉谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Smiling Jim wants you to talk to Vern Futzwidget in Thousand Needles.

Description.text: 嗯，你看起来像是个精神充沛的家伙……$b$b我正好认识一个人，需要一名对战斗在行的$c。$b$b如果你不怕把手弄脏的话，就往南穿过山脉去找一个叫做韦恩的地精。$b$b告诉他是微笑的吉姆派你去的。
Description.english: Say, you look like a frisky sort...$b$bI know a guy who knows a fella that might be lookin' for a $c who knows $ghis:her; way around a fight.$b$bIf you're not afraid to get your hands a little dirty, make your way south across the mountains and look for a goblin by the name of Vern.$b$bTell him Smiling Jim sent ya.

identity.title: Lazy Peons
identity.objectives: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on 4 Lazy Peons when they're sleeping.
identity.description: Cursed peons!  They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps!  I need someone to help keep the peons in line.$B$BYou look like the right $r for my task.  Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job.  A good smack will get them right back to work!  Return the blackjack when you're done.$B$BLook for them underneath the trees in the valley.  Lousy slacking peons...

Objectives.text: 在懒惰的苦工睡觉时，用工头的木棒敲醒4个苦工。
Objectives.english: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on 4 Lazy Peons when they're sleeping.

Description.text: 该死的苦工！我叫他们在山谷里伐木，但他们总是见缝插针地打盹！我需要找个人帮我去叫醒他们。$B$B你看上去挺适合这差事的。给你，拿着这根棍子，看到偷懒睡觉的苦工就打醒他。只要狠狠地敲他们一下就能让他们乖乖回去工作了！别忘了把棍子还给我。$B$B到山谷中的树荫下去找他们。这些该死的懒汉……
Description.english: Cursed peons!  They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps!  I need someone to help keep the peons in line.$B$BYou look like the right $r for my task.  Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job.  A good smack will get them right back to work!  Return the blackjack when you're done.$B$BLook for them underneath the trees in the valley.  Lousy slacking peons...

identity.title: Glyphic Parchment
identity.objectives: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Acrypha in the Valley of Trials.
identity.description: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $n.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Acrypha. She would have words with you when you're ready.

Objectives.text: 阅读雕文羊皮纸，然后与试炼谷的奥克莱法谈谈。
Objectives.english: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Acrypha in the Valley of Trials.

Description.text: 啊，你刚才外出的时候，有人给你送来了一张羊皮纸，$n。$B$B有时间就读一下吧。如果我没搞错的话，是法师训练师奥克莱法给你的。等你准备好了，她想跟你谈谈。
Description.english: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $n.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Acrypha. She would have words with you when you're ready.

identity.title: Steady Shot
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.
identity.description:
You already know how to fire an arcane shot. Good. But doing so depletes your focus. To gain your focus back you will need to switch to a second type of ranged attack.

Go out and get some more experience. As you do, you'll learn some new abilities. The first of these will help you get your focus back.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习稳固射击。找一个训练假人，对其使用5次稳固射击。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.

Description.text:
你已经知道如何打出奥术射击了，很好。不过这样一来，你很快就会耗尽集中值。为了回复集中值，你需要另一种远程攻击的手法。

出去再积累一些经验。当你这么做的时候，你会学到一些新技能。其中的第一项技能将帮助你回复集中值。
Description.english:
You already know how to fire an arcane shot. Good. But doing so depletes your focus. To gain your focus back you will need to switch to a second type of ranged attack.

Go out and get some more experience. As you do, you'll learn some new abilities. The first of these will help you get your focus back.

identity.title: Eviscerate
identity.objectives: Reach Level 3 to Learn Eviscerate, then locate a Training Dummy and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.
identity.description: Let's start with the basics, shall we?  I'm the only rogue trainer in town, so you're going to have to learn it from me.$b$bGo get some more experience, figure out how to eviscerate your foes, and then show me on the training dummies here. I'll evaluate your form.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习刺骨。然后找一个训练假人，对其使用3次刺骨。
Objectives.english: Reach Level 3 to Learn Eviscerate, then locate a Training Dummy and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.

Description.text: 我们从基础知识开始吧，可以吗？我是这里唯一的潜行者训练师，所以你只能跟我学了。$b$b出去再积累一些经验，弄明白怎样对敌人使用刺骨，然后对着这些训练假人给我展示一下你的本事。我会点评你的套路。
Description.english: Let's start with the basics, shall we?  I'm the only rogue trainer in town, so you're going to have to learn it from me.$b$bGo get some more experience, figure out how to eviscerate your foes, and then show me on the training dummies here. I'll evaluate your form.

identity.title: Primal Strike
identity.objectives: Learn Primal Strike by reaching Level 3, then look for a training dummy near Shikrik and practice using Primal Strike 3 times.
identity.description:
As you grow in power by gaining levels, you will discover the power to use new abilities. The first you will discover on your journey is Primal Strike.

Use it to deliver a strike with your weapon, infused with the power of the elements.$B$BIt is time to learn and master your new skill. Practice using it on the training dummies outside the Den.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习根源打击，然后在史克里克附近找一个训练假人，对其使用3次根源打击。
Objectives.english: Learn Primal Strike by reaching Level 3, then look for a training dummy near Shikrik and practice using Primal Strike 3 times.

Description.text:
当力量随着等级的提升而逐渐增强时，你会发现你可以使用新的技能了。在这个过程中，你首先领悟到的便是根源打击。

将你的武器注入元素的力量，然后用这个技能施展一次打击。$B$B是时候学习并掌握你的新技能了。去洞穴外找个训练假人练习这个技能。
Description.english:
As you grow in power by gaining levels, you will discover the power to use new abilities. The first you will discover on your journey is Primal Strike.

Use it to deliver a strike with your weapon, infused with the power of the elements.$B$BIt is time to learn and master your new skill. Practice using it on the training dummies outside the Den.

identity.title: Corruption
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption. Locate a Training Dummy and practice casting Corruption 5 times.
identity.description:
It is my duty to train you, and I intend to do just that.$B$BAs you become more powerful, you will begin to hear the fel voices revealing new spells to you.

Go, get more experience, learn a new spell, and then practice your new spell against one of the training dummies around here.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习腐蚀术。然后对一个训练假人使用5次腐蚀术。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption. Locate a Training Dummy and practice casting Corruption 5 times.

Description.text:
训练你是我的职责所在，也是我自己的意愿。$B$B当你变得更加强大后，你会开始听到邪恶的力量向你昭示新的法术。

去吧，再积累一些经验，学习一项新的法术，并且用新法术在这附近的训练假人身上进行练习。
Description.english:
It is my duty to train you, and I intend to do just that.$B$BAs you become more powerful, you will begin to hear the fel voices revealing new spells to you.

Go, get more experience, learn a new spell, and then practice your new spell against one of the training dummies around here.

CompletionLog.text: 回杜隆塔尔的试炼谷找纳托克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Nartok at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

identity.title: Charge
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Charge.
identity.description: I've been instructed to prepare you for battle. Though, from the look of you, it looks like you've already spent a little time out in the field. Good.$b$bAs you continue your journey, you'll discover that you can begin to use new techniques$b$bGo, get some more experience, and teach yourself how to Charge, then show me what you've learned.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冲锋。找一个训练假人，对其使用冲锋。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Charge.

Description.text: 我的任务是帮你做好战斗准备。不过看样子你已经在战场上度过一小段时间了。很好。$b$b在你继续训练的过程当中，会慢慢发现你能使用新的技巧了。$b$b出去再积累一些经验，然后自己学习如何施展冲锋，最后向我展示一下你学到了什么。
Description.english: I've been instructed to prepare you for battle. Though, from the look of you, it looks like you've already spent a little time out in the field. Good.$b$bAs you continue your journey, you'll discover that you can begin to use new techniques$b$bGo, get some more experience, and teach yourself how to Charge, then show me what you've learned.

identity.title: Frost Nova
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Frost Nova 2 times.
identity.description:
Alright, here's the easy part.

All you have to do to deepen your connection to the arcane is to get more experience and grow your power. You'll begin to find that you can cast new spells.

You'll see. Go try it, and show me what you learn.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冰霜新星。在一个训练假人身上练习2次冰霜新星。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Frost Nova 2 times.

Description.text:
好了，这事其实很简单。

你所要做的就是再积累一些经验，然后增强你的能量，这样就可以加深你与奥术之间的联系了。慢慢你会发现你能施展新的法术了。

你就等着瞧吧。去尝试一下，然后向我展示一下你的学习成果。
Description.english:
Alright, here's the easy part.

All you have to do to deepen your connection to the arcane is to get more experience and grow your power. You'll begin to find that you can cast new spells.

You'll see. Go try it, and show me what you learn.

CompletionLog.text: 回杜隆塔尔的试炼谷找奥克莱法。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Acrypha at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

identity.title: Spirits Be Praised
identity.objectives: Escort Grandmatron Tekla to Raggaran.
identity.description: Who are you?  What happened?$b$bI was alone in my hut, meditating, when...$b$bAhh, I remember now.  The spirits cried out, and the river swept in.  I'm lucky that you found me here.  I am old, and no longer physically able to endure the elements like this.  Will you lead me out of here?

Objectives.text: 护送特克拉主母到拉格兰那里去。
Objectives.english: Escort Grandmatron Tekla to Raggaran.

Description.text: 你是谁？这是怎么回事？$b$b我正在自己的棚屋里独自冥想，突然……$b$b啊，我想起来了。万灵发出悲鸣，河水灌了进来。能被你找到是我走运了。我年事已高，身体已经不是很听使唤啦。你能带我出去吗？
Description.english: Who are you?  What happened?$b$bI was alone in my hut, meditating, when...$b$bAhh, I remember now.  The spirits cried out, and the river swept in.  I'm lucky that you found me here.  I am old, and no longer physically able to endure the elements like this.  Will you lead me out of here?

CompletionLog.text: 与杜隆塔尔怒水河流域盆地的拉格兰交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Raggaran at the Southfury Watershed in Durotar.

identity.title: Winnoa Pineforest
identity.objectives: Speak to Winnoa Pineforest at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.
identity.description: While we've accomplished much here, it would be a tragedy if part of this corruption has escaped our notice.  The corridors of the Wailing Cavern stretch throughout the entire Barrens, and if another spot of wild energy has made its way to the surface...$B$BYou've done enough for me, though. I would simply ask that you let a fellow druid of mine know of what's happened here. You will find Winnoa Pineforest at the Fields of Blood, southwest of here.

Objectives.text: 跟南贫瘠之地世仇哨站的温诺亚·松林谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Winnoa Pineforest at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.

Description.text: 尽管我们在这里收获颇丰，但如果让这腐蚀趁我们的不注意的时候散布出去，那可就真是一场悲剧了。哀嚎洞穴的走廊蜿蜒在整个贫瘠之地里，如果狂野的能量找到了另一个可以冒头的地方……$B$B不过，你为我做的已经够多了。我只能要求你把这里的事情去告诉我的一个德鲁伊同伴。你可以在西南边的鲜血旷野找到温诺亚·松林。
Description.english: While we've accomplished much here, it would be a tragedy if part of this corruption has escaped our notice.  The corridors of the Wailing Cavern stretch throughout the entire Barrens, and if another spot of wild energy has made its way to the surface...$B$BYou've done enough for me, though. I would simply ask that you let a fellow druid of mine know of what's happened here. You will find Winnoa Pineforest at the Fields of Blood, southwest of here.

identity.title: Basic Orders
identity.objectives: Follow Drill Sergeant Steamcrank's cues and then report back to Captain Tread Sparknozzle.
identity.description: Hey! You look like you could give us a hand!$B$BIf you're willing to help our cause, we have to get you through training.  Gnome training is brutal and rigorous, so I hope you're ready.$B$BHead over to Drill Sergeant Steamcrank and he'll walk you through what you need to know.  Make sure you follow his orders when he gives them, or else you'll never make it$B$BI'm warning you though, it's tough over there.  Come back to see me, if you make it.

Objectives.text: 完成教官汽轴的命令，然后回去向崔德·火钻队长报告。
Objectives.english: Follow Drill Sergeant Steamcrank's cues and then report back to Captain Tread Sparknozzle.

Description.text: 嗨！看样子你能帮我们一把！$B$B如果你真的愿意帮助我们，我们就要先对你进行训练。侏儒训练相当严格，强度也相当大。所以我希望你对此有所准备。$B$B去找教官汽轴，他会向你提供你需要知道的一切。记住，一定要严格按照他的命令行动，否则你将无法完成任务。$B$B虽然我已经警告过你，但你也许还不了解你将面对怎样的困难。等你完成任务之后再来见我吧。
Description.english: Hey! You look like you could give us a hand!$B$BIf you're willing to help our cause, we have to get you through training.  Gnome training is brutal and rigorous, so I hope you're ready.$B$BHead over to Drill Sergeant Steamcrank and he'll walk you through what you need to know.  Make sure you follow his orders when he gives them, or else you'll never make it$B$BI'm warning you though, it's tough over there.  Come back to see me, if you make it.

identity.title: Vent Horizon
identity.objectives: Use Pilot Muzzlesprock's flying machine to toss Radiageigatrons at the vents surrounding Gnomeregan.
identity.description: We thought that we could wait for the radiation to subside around Gnomeregan, but it doesn't appear to be getting better.$B$BIf we want to take back our city, we need to make sure it's safe for our troops to enter.$B$BTake these Radiageigatrons, hop in 'Thunderflash' here,  and toss them at the ventilation shafts outside of Gnomeregan. They'll report the radiation levels directly to me.

Objectives.text: 使用飞行员杰夫·玛兹斯波克的飞行工具，将辐射计量仪投放到诺莫瑞根周围的通风口去。
Objectives.english: Use Pilot Muzzlesprock's flying machine to toss Radiageigatrons at the vents surrounding Gnomeregan.

Description.text: 我们本以为只要耐心等待，诺莫瑞根的辐射自然会渐渐衰弱。但现在这一情况仍然没有得到改善。$B$B如果要夺回我们的城市，我们至少需要确保我们的部队能够安全进入那里。$B$B带上这些辐射计量仪，登上这里的“雷光号”，将它们投放到诺莫瑞根外面的通风口附近。它们会测量那里的辐射水平，并将相关信息传回给我。
Description.english: We thought that we could wait for the radiation to subside around Gnomeregan, but it doesn't appear to be getting better.$B$BIf we want to take back our city, we need to make sure it's safe for our troops to enter.$B$BTake these Radiageigatrons, hop in 'Thunderflash' here,  and toss them at the ventilation shafts outside of Gnomeregan. They'll report the radiation levels directly to me.

identity.title: Prophecies Of Doom
identity.objectives: Listen to a speech given by a Doomsayer in the Drag and obtain copies of the pamphlets "Elemental Fire for the Soul", "What Does 'The End of All Things' Mean for Me?", and "Finding Security and Comfort in a Doomed World".
identity.description: Harbingers of doom are nothing new on the streets of Orgrimmar, but I'm worried about this latest batch. These people are organized and they've attracted a lot of attention in the Drag, where they seem to congregate.$B$BI've thought about rounding them up or otherwise disrupting their activities, but that will just drive them underground. We need to find out more about them. Would you go to the Drag, listen to what these doomsayers are spreading, and gather any literature you can find about their ideas?

Objectives.text: 在暗巷区听取一名末日预言者的演讲，并取得名为《灵魂之元素火焰》、《万物的终结对我有何意义？》和《在毁灭的世界中寻找安全与舒适》的小册子。
Objectives.english: Listen to a speech given by a Doomsayer in the Drag and obtain copies of the pamphlets "Elemental Fire for the Soul", "What Does 'The End of All Things' Mean for Me?", and "Finding Security and Comfort in a Doomed World".

Description.text: 奥格瑞玛的街道上出现了一帮家伙，他们满嘴都是灾难即将降临的蠢话。这在奥格瑞玛本不算什么新鲜事。但这帮家伙却让我相当担忧。他们的行动很有组织性。暗巷区的许多人都受到了他们的影响。他们的势力在那里发展得相当迅速。$B$B我考虑过将他们剿除，或者制止他们的活动。但贸然行动只会让他们转入地下。我们需要对他们有更多了解。你能不能到暗巷区去，听听那些末日预言者都在传播些什么？你最好能找到一些与他们的理念相关的文字情报。
Description.english: Harbingers of doom are nothing new on the streets of Orgrimmar, but I'm worried about this latest batch. These people are organized and they've attracted a lot of attention in the Drag, where they seem to congregate.$B$BI've thought about rounding them up or otherwise disrupting their activities, but that will just drive them underground. We need to find out more about them. Would you go to the Drag, listen to what these doomsayers are spreading, and gather any literature you can find about their ideas?

CompletionLog.text: 返回奥格瑞玛的力量谷，去找血卫士托雷克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

identity.title: Prophecies Of Doom
identity.objectives: Listen to a speech given by a Doomsayer in Old Town and obtain copies of the pamphlets "Elemental Fire for the Soul", "What Does 'The End of All Things' Mean for Me?", and "Finding Security and Comfort in a Doomed World".
identity.description: Harbingers of doom are nothing new on the streets of Stormwind, but I'm worried about the most recent ones. They've set up shop all over Old Town and they seem well coordinated.$B$BI've thought about rounding them up or otherwise disrupting their activities, but that will just drive them underground. We need to find out as much as we can about them. Would you go to Old Town, hear what idea these doomsayers are spreading, and see if you can collect any of their leaflets?

CompletionLog.text: 回到暴風要塞向安東上尉回報。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

identity.title: Signs Of The Times
identity.objectives: Setup 5 Warning Posters around the Valley of Strength, the Drag, or the Valley of Honor.
identity.description: We've got to do something to reduce interest in this doomsday cult, but I'm hesitant to take much action until we know more about who is behind this group.$B$BI've had my men place markers around heavily traveled areas in Orgrimmar. Take these posters and set them up where you see the markers. They won't discourage the most determined of seekers, but it's a first step in exposing this cult. The Horde has enough to deal with as it is, without people wilfully spreading lies too.

Objectives.text: 在力量谷、暗巷区或者荣誉谷各处张贴5张警示布告。
Objectives.english: Setup 5 Warning Posters around the Valley of Strength, the Drag, or the Valley of Honor.

Description.text: 我们要采取行动，让公众对那个预言毁灭的教派失去兴趣。但在我了解这个组织的幕后操控者之前，我很难决定该如何对这个组织下手。$B$B我已经让我的部下在奥格瑞玛行人最密集的地方做好了标记。带上这些布告，把它们张贴在有这种标记的地方。它们对于那些下定决心的追随者们不会有多大作用。但它毕竟是揭露这个教派邪恶面的第一步。部落的敌人已经很多了。所以我们现在更不能任由这些家伙四处散布谎言。
Description.english: We've got to do something to reduce interest in this doomsday cult, but I'm hesitant to take much action until we know more about who is behind this group.$B$BI've had my men place markers around heavily traveled areas in Orgrimmar. Take these posters and set them up where you see the markers. They won't discourage the most determined of seekers, but it's a first step in exposing this cult. The Horde has enough to deal with as it is, without people wilfully spreading lies too.

identity.title: Signs Of The Times
identity.objectives: Set up 5 Warning Posters in the Trade District, Cathedral Square, Old Town, or Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
identity.description: We've got to do something to reduce interest in this doomsday cult, but I'm hesitant to take much action until we know more about who is behind this group.$B$BI've had my men place markers around heavily traveled areas of the city. Take these posters and set them up where you see the markers. They won't discourage the most determined of seekers, but it's a first step in exposing this cult. The king already has enough enemies without his own people turning against him.

Objectives.text: 在貿易區、教堂廣場、舊城區或是法師區設置5塊警告告示。
Objectives.english: Set up 5 Warning Posters in the Trade District, Cathedral Square, Old Town, or Mage Quarter of Stormwind.

Description.text: 我們必須要做點什麼，好降低末日教派的影響力，不過我還在猶豫，在想要不要等到我們揪出這個團體的幕後黑手之後，再進一步採取行動。$B$B我已經派人在暴風城人潮擁擠的區域設好標記了。你先拿著這些，去標記地點設置告示。告示對那些決心堅定的跟隨者來說八成起不了作用，但至少這是一個開始，揭露這個教派的開始。國王的敵人已經夠多了，別讓人民都起來反抗自己的國王。
Description.english: We've got to do something to reduce interest in this doomsday cult, but I'm hesitant to take much action until we know more about who is behind this group.$B$BI've had my men place markers around heavily traveled areas of the city. Take these posters and set them up where you see the markers. They won't discourage the most determined of seekers, but it's a first step in exposing this cult. The king already has enough enemies without his own people turning against him.

CompletionLog.text: 到暴風要塞找安東上尉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

identity.title: Prepping the Speech
identity.objectives: Use the Gnomish Playback Device in front of Ozzie Togglevolt north of Kharanos, Milli Featherwhistle at Steelgrill Depot and Tog Rustsprocket outside the Kharanos Inn.  Return to Toby Ziegear when all the speeches have been given.
identity.description: High Tinker Mekkatorque asked me to write a speech that he could give before the battle starts, but I can't tell which draft is good and which ones just stink.$B$BCould you try some of them out on some of the local gnome residents?  This device creates an image of Mekkatorque saying a few lines from each of my speech drafts.$B$BLet me know which one works, okay?

Objectives.text: 分别在卡拉诺斯北边的奥齐·电环面前，钢架补给站的米利·羽哨面前和卡拉诺斯旅店外面的托格·锈链面前使用侏儒播放器。当所有演讲都播放完毕之后，回去见托比·速轮。
Objectives.english: Use the Gnomish Playback Device in front of Ozzie Togglevolt north of Kharanos, Milli Featherwhistle at Steelgrill Depot and Tog Rustsprocket outside the Kharanos Inn.  Return to Toby Ziegear when all the speeches have been given.

Description.text: 梅卡托克国王要我写一份战前演讲稿，但我还无法确定哪些话的演讲效果好，哪些的演讲效果会很糟糕。$B$B你能不能在本地侏儒居民面前试一下这些演讲？这个装置能产生一个梅卡托克的影像，并说出几句我写的演讲稿。$B$B让我知道演讲稿的哪部分比较好，行不？
Description.english: High Tinker Mekkatorque asked me to write a speech that he could give before the battle starts, but I can't tell which draft is good and which ones just stink.$B$BCould you try some of them out on some of the local gnome residents?  This device creates an image of Mekkatorque saying a few lines from each of my speech drafts.$B$BLet me know which one works, okay?

identity.title: In and Out
identity.objectives: Test out the ejection system in the Ejector Mechano-Tank.
identity.description: We've gotta get these new mechano-tanks ready for the assault.  You ready to help test these bad boys out?!
