Of course you are!$b$bFirst, we need to make sure that once you're in, you can get out.  In battle, if you think your tank is going to explode, get out!  I've seen many a gnome stay in 'til the bitter end... the tank blows up, and them along with it.$B$BWell, I've upgraded this tank with an ejection seat.  Try it out for me, will ya?

Objectives.text: 测试弹射型步行坦克的弹射系统。
Objectives.english: Test out the ejection system in the Ejector Mechano-Tank.

Description.text: 我们的新型步行坦克已经做好了出击准备。想不想帮我们测试一下这些小混蛋？！你当然想！$b$b首先，我们需要确认你钻进坦克之后，还能钻出来。在战场上，如果你觉得自己的坦克要爆炸了，那就得赶快出来！我见到过许多侏儒被困在爆炸的坦克里……$B$B所以，我在坦克里安装了一个弹射椅。去试试它好用不？
Description.english: We've gotta get these new mechano-tanks ready for the assault.  You ready to help test these bad boys out?!  Of course you are!$b$bFirst, we need to make sure that once you're in, you can get out.  In battle, if you think your tank is going to explode, get out!  I've seen many a gnome stay in 'til the bitter end... the tank blows up, and them along with it.$B$BWell, I've upgraded this tank with an ejection seat.  Try it out for me, will ya?

identity.title: Words for Delivery
identity.objectives: Give the speech to Captain Tread Sparknozzle at Steelgrill Depot.
identity.description: Here we go.  This is the speech, $n!$B$BIt has everything to be a great battle starter: It's inspirational, has eloquent language and speaks directly to gnomes.  Never has a finer speech been written!$B$BTurn this in to Captain Tread Sparknozzle and get some transportation to High Tinker Mekkatorque!

Objectives.text: 將演說稿交給鋼架補給站的特瑞德·炫鼻上尉。
Objectives.english: Give the speech to Captain Tread Sparknozzle at Steelgrill Depot.

Description.text: 來吧，演說稿在這，$n!$B$B以一場戰爭的開場白來說，這篇演說稿該有的都有了:以動人的語言直接向地精們演說，這能大大地激勵人心。從來從沒有人寫出如此完美的演說稿!$B$B回到特瑞德·炫鼻上尉那，將這篇稿子送去給大工匠梅卡托克!
Description.english: Here we go.  This is the speech, $n!$B$BIt has everything to be a great battle starter: It's inspirational, has eloquent language and speaks directly to gnomes.  Never has a finer speech been written!$B$BTurn this in to Captain Tread Sparknozzle and get some transportation to High Tinker Mekkatorque!

CompletionLog.text: 到鋼架補給站找特瑞德·炫鼻上尉。
CompletionLog.english: Talk to Captain Tread Sparknozzleat Steelgrill Depot.

identity.title: Infiltrating The Cult
identity.objectives: Go to Orgrimmar's Drag and speak to a Doomsayer or take a robe from the crate near a Doomsayer to join the cult, then put on your Recruit's Robe.
identity.description: The streets of Orgrimmar are wild with rumors about the cult's origins and practices. There's only one way to know the truth about this group, $n. You're going to join them.$B$BApproach one of the Doomsayers in the Drag and tell them you wish to join their group. With any luck, they will give you instructions to introduce yourself to one of the group's leaders and tell you where the group is hiding. Don any clothing given to you by the doomsayer; you'll need it to gain entry to the group's hideout.

Objectives.text: 到奧格瑪的暗巷區和末日預言者交談，或是從末日預言者附近的貨箱取得一件袍子來入教，然後穿上新教徒長袍。
Objectives.english: Go to Orgrimmar's Drag and speak to a Doomsayer or take a robe from the crate near a Doomsayer to join the cult, then put on your Recruit's Robe.

Description.text: 奧格瑪的街上充滿了流言，討論著這教派的起源和信念。要得知這群人的真正目的，只有一個方法了，$n。你得加入他們。$B$B去暗巷區和其中一名末日預言者接觸，告訴他們你想入教。幸運的話，他們會給你指示，把你介紹給上面的人，並且告訴你他們躲在哪裡。穿上他們給你的衣物，要進入他們的藏身之處，這些東西會派上用場的。
Description.english: The streets of Orgrimmar are wild with rumors about the cult's origins and practices. There's only one way to know the truth about this group, $n. You're going to join them.$B$BApproach one of the Doomsayers in the Drag and tell them you wish to join their group. With any luck, they will give you instructions to introduce yourself to one of the group's leaders and tell you where the group is hiding. Don any clothing given to you by the doomsayer; you'll need it to gain entry to the group's hideout.

CompletionLog.text: 到奧格瑪外面的野豬農場找監督者金塔克。
CompletionLog.english: Report to Overseer Jintak at the Jaggedswine Farm outside Orgrimmar.

identity.title: One Step Forward...
identity.objectives: Test the Scuttling Mechano-Tank's maneuverability.
identity.description: With the ejection system working, I think we're ready to test out movement.  This tank has an extra special feature: Automatic Evasive Maneuvers!$b$bI want you to check out the servos on the left leg, the right leg and the Automatic Evasive Maneuver system.$b$bThis is easy stuff, so it shouldn't take too long.

Objectives.text: 测试高机动型步行坦克的可操控性。
Objectives.english: Test the Scuttling Mechano-Tank's maneuverability.

Description.text: 既然弹射系统性能可靠了，那么我们就可以进行下一步的测试了。这辆坦克有一个特殊功能：自动规避能力！$b$b我想要你检查一下它左腿和右腿的伺服系统，还有它的自动规避系统。$b$b这很容易，要不了多久。
Description.english: With the ejection system working, I think we're ready to test out movement.  This tank has an extra special feature: Automatic Evasive Maneuvers!$b$bI want you to check out the servos on the left leg, the right leg and the Automatic Evasive Maneuver system.$b$bThis is easy stuff, so it shouldn't take too long.

identity.title: Infiltrating the Cult
identity.objectives: Go to Stormwind's Old Town and either speak to a Doomsayer or take a robe from the crate near a Doomsayer to join the doomsday cult, then equip the Doomsday Recruit's Robe you receive.
identity.description: It's getting difficult to keep the cultists out of the public eye and rumors are spreading across the city. I want you to join the cult and learn as much as you can.$B$BApproach one of the doomsayers in Old Town and tell them you wish to join their group. The doomsayer will likely give you clothing and instructions to meet with other cultists in one of the group's hideouts. Follow those instructions, $n. It's the only way to gain their confidence.

Objectives.text: 到暴風城的舊城區和末日預言者交談，或是從末日預言者附近的貨箱取得一件袍子來加入末日教徒，然後穿上你所獲得的末日預言新教徒長袍。
Objectives.english: Go to Stormwind's Old Town and either speak to a Doomsayer or take a robe from the crate near a Doomsayer to join the doomsday cult, then equip the Doomsday Recruit's Robe you receive.

Description.text: 要避免教徒出現在大眾面前實在是越來越困難了，這城市中充斥著流言。我要你加入教派，盡可能去收集情報。$B$B和舊城區的末日預言者接觸，告訴他們你想入教。末日預言者很可能會給你衣服和指示，讓你到他們的藏身處和其他教徒碰面。依照指示行動，$n，這是贏得他們信任的唯一方式。
Description.english: It's getting difficult to keep the cultists out of the public eye and rumors are spreading across the city. I want you to join the cult and learn as much as you can.$B$BApproach one of the doomsayers in Old Town and tell them you wish to join their group. The doomsayer will likely give you clothing and instructions to meet with other cultists in one of the group's hideouts. Follow those instructions, $n. It's the only way to gain their confidence.

CompletionLog.text: 到艾爾文森林的明鏡湖果園找監督者賽倫德拉。
CompletionLog.english: Report to Overseer Sylandra at the Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest.

identity.title: The Missing
identity.objectives: While wearing your Cult Disguise, speak to Cultist Kagarn, Cultist Agtar, Cultist Tokka, and Cultist Rokaga at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.
identity.description: Aside from the disturbances and the paranoia spread by the cult, we've been inundated with reports of missing people. Mothers, fathers, brothers, and sisters have seemingly disappeared, but I have a feeling that they can be found in one of the cult's compounds outside the city. If I give you the names of some of the missing people, would you try to locate them in the cultist camp at the Jaggedswine Farm south of Orgrimmar? To blend in, you'll need to get a robe from one of the doomsayers in the Drag.

Objectives.text: 穿上教徒偽裝時，到杜洛塔的野豬農場和教徒卡嘎恩、教徒阿格塔、教徒托卡、及教徒羅卡嘎交談。
Objectives.english: While wearing your Cult Disguise, speak to Cultist Kagarn, Cultist Agtar, Cultist Tokka, and Cultist Rokaga at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.

Description.text: 先把這個教派散佈的紛擾和偏執多疑放到一邊去，因為關於失蹤人口的報告有如潮水般湧來，媽媽爸爸兄弟姊妹全都不見蹤影。不過我覺得，也許在城外圍起來的那塊教徒集會場所可以找到他們。如果我給你失蹤人口清單，你可不可以去奧格瑪南邊的野豬農場看看?在那邊有個教徒聚會營地，幫我查一下這些不見的人在哪。不過你得先跑一趟暗巷區，從末日預言者那邊拿件袍子，這樣才有辦法混進去。
Description.english: Aside from the disturbances and the paranoia spread by the cult, we've been inundated with reports of missing people. Mothers, fathers, brothers, and sisters have seemingly disappeared, but I have a feeling that they can be found in one of the cult's compounds outside the city. If I give you the names of some of the missing people, would you try to locate them in the cultist camp at the Jaggedswine Farm south of Orgrimmar? To blend in, you'll need to get a robe from one of the doomsayers in the Drag.

CompletionLog.text: 到奧格瑪找血衛士托雷克。
CompletionLog.english: Report back to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar.

identity.title: Press Fire
identity.objectives: Test out the Shooting Mechano-Tank weapon systems on the nearby targets.
identity.description: Safety systems, online!  Motor functions, functioning!  Now all we need is to make sure that the guns will fire.$b$bThis shouldn't be too hard, $n.  The mechano-tank on the hill behind us has been loaded with harmless pellets. Just fire off a couple rounds at the nearby targets and report back to me.

Objectives.text: 利用附近的目标来测试射击型步行坦克的武器系统。
Objectives.english: Test out the Shooting Mechano-Tank weapon systems on the nearby targets.

Description.text: 安全系统连通！马达启动！现在我们只需要确认它的火炮能正常射击。$b$b这应该不太难，$n。我们背后山丘上的步行坦克已经填装好教练弹。你只需要向附近的目标发射几轮炮火，然后就可以向我报告了。
Description.english: Safety systems, online!  Motor functions, functioning!  Now all we need is to make sure that the guns will fire.$b$bThis shouldn't be too hard, $n.  The mechano-tank on the hill behind us has been loaded with harmless pellets. Just fire off a couple rounds at the nearby targets and report back to me.

identity.title: Never Look Back
identity.objectives: Kill 10 Hatecrest Naga and slay their leader.
identity.description: Our settlement on Sardor Isle was lost to the Hatecrest naga. Overwhelmed by their numbers, we fell back to the mainland. While they coveted their newly-gained sandbar, we raised New Feathermoon on the shore and amassed an even greater army.$B$BNow, the Hatecrest will be driven back into the sea. Speak with Sentinel Ranadae to join our forces at Sardor. Slay the naga, and make sure whichever foul snake they take orders from is killed as well.

Objectives.text: 杀死10条憎世纳迦以及他们的首领。
Objectives.english: Kill 10 Hatecrest Naga and slay their leader.

Description.text: 我们在萨尔多岛的殖民地被憎世纳迦夺走了。在寡不敌众的情况下，我们只好撤回大陆。就在他们垂涎自己刚刚获得的沙洲时，我们已经在海岸上建立了新羽月要塞，召集了一支规模更大的军队。$B$B现在，憎世纳迦将被赶回海里去。跟哨兵兰娜黛谈谈，加入我们在萨尔多的大军。杀掉纳迦，不管是哪条肮脏的蛇在给他们发号施令，也一并给宰掉。
Description.english: Our settlement on Sardor Isle was lost to the Hatecrest naga. Overwhelmed by their numbers, we fell back to the mainland. While they coveted their newly-gained sandbar, we raised New Feathermoon on the shore and amassed an even greater army.$B$BNow, the Hatecrest will be driven back into the sea. Speak with Sentinel Ranadae to join our forces at Sardor. Slay the naga, and make sure whichever foul snake they take orders from is killed as well.

CompletionLog.text: 去找新羽月要塞的珊蒂斯·羽月。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Shandris Feathermoon at New Feathermoon.

identity.title: Fiery Inscriptions
identity.objectives: Speak to Hamuul Runetotem in Hyjal.
identity.description: The medallion is unlike any you've seen before.  Its runes appear to glow in conjunction with the near fire elementals.$B$BPerhaps you should tell Hamuul Runetotem about this.

Objectives.text: 跟海加尔山的哈缪尔·符文图腾谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Hamuul Runetotem in Hyjal.

Description.text: 这枚徽章同你以往所见的均有不同。上面的符文似乎同附近的火元素一脉相应。$B$B也许你该把这件事告诉哈缪尔·符文图腾。
Description.english: The medallion is unlike any you've seen before.  Its runes appear to glow in conjunction with the near fire elementals.$B$BPerhaps you should tell Hamuul Runetotem about this.

identity.title: Grandma's Cat
identity.objectives: Grandma Wahl at the Wahl cottage wants you to retrieve Chance the Cat.
identity.description: Right!  About the evacuation, dear.$B$BI just cannot leave without my cat.  He's an adorable orange tabby.$B$BChance's favorite spot to play is a broken down cart near an arbor northeast of here.$B$BBring him here and we'll be on our way.

Objectives.text: 薇儿外婆要你找回黑猫小运。
Objectives.english: Grandma Wahl at the Wahl cottage wants you to retrieve Chance the Cat.

Description.text: 嗯哼！撤退。$B$B我要我的猫咪，不然我就不走。他是一只黄色的虎斑猫，非常可爱。$B$B这里的东北边有一棵大树，树下有一辆破损的货车，小运最喜欢在那里玩耍了。$B$B你去把他找回来，然后我们就可以动身了。
Description.english: Right!  About the evacuation, dear.$B$BI just cannot leave without my cat.  He's an adorable orange tabby.$B$BChance's favorite spot to play is a broken down cart near an arbor northeast of here.$B$BBring him here and we'll be on our way.

identity.title: Natural Materials
identity.objectives: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.
identity.description: I will need certain materials to complete my endeavor... You may do this alongside the other tasks I will give you.$B$BI'll need a splintered log from a treant of Feralas. Encrusted minerals, these can be found on the mountain giants and faerie dragons to the west. Also, find me some resilient sinew from the owlbeasts of the Hinterlands or hippogryphs of Feralas. Finally, I'll need a large amount of metallic fragments from any of these creatures I mentioned.

Objectives.text: 将两块断裂的原木、6块包壳矿石、20条有弹性的肌腱，以及40片金属碎片交给莫沙彻营地的巫医尤克里。
Objectives.english: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.

Description.text: 我需要某些材料，才能完成我的工作……也许可以把这事和我交给你的其它任务一起办了。$B$B我需要菲拉斯树人身上的一块断裂的原木。包壳矿石，这些可以在西边的山岭巨人和精灵龙身上找到。还有，给我弄些有弹性的肌腱来，必须是辛特兰的枭兽或菲拉斯的角鹰兽身上的。最后，我还需要大量的金属碎片，在上述这些生物身上都有。
Description.english: I will need certain materials to complete my endeavor... You may do this alongside the other tasks I will give you.$B$BI'll need a splintered log from a treant of Feralas. Encrusted minerals, these can be found on the mountain giants and faerie dragons to the west. Also, find me some resilient sinew from the owlbeasts of the Hinterlands or hippogryphs of Feralas. Finally, I'll need a large amount of metallic fragments from any of these creatures I mentioned.

CompletionLog.text: 去菲拉斯，找莫沙彻营地的巫医尤克里。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

identity.title: The Master's Plan
identity.objectives: Learn more about the cult's plans at the altar in the eastern part of the Jaggedswine Farm.
identity.description: You're fitting in well here, $n, but there is more to us than daily chores and spreading the message. I'm sure you heard a little bit about it when you first joined.$B$BAs you know, this world is ending and the unprepared will die painful deaths.$B$BWe have been given a gift, an opportunity to become something greater and more powerful. Overseer Golbaz is preparing a ritual before the altar at the eastern end of the farm. Wait there for him, and learn more of your new brothers and sisters.

Objectives.text: 在野豬農場東邊的祭壇收集資訊，看看這個教派在策劃些什麼。
Objectives.english: Learn more about the cult's plans at the altar in the eastern part of the Jaggedswine Farm.

Description.text: 你表現得不錯，$n，不過除了例行瑣事和傳播訊息之外，還有更重要的活等著我們。我相信你當初加入的時候已經略知一二。$B$B正如你所知，這世界正邁向毀滅，屆時尚未做好準備的人終將死於無盡苦痛之中。$B$B我們收到一份禮物，這是一個機會，讓我們變得更強更大。監督者勾貝茲正在農場東邊的祭壇準備一項儀式。去那等他，多去認識你的新兄弟姊妹們。
Description.english: You're fitting in well here, $n, but there is more to us than daily chores and spreading the message. I'm sure you heard a little bit about it when you first joined.$B$BAs you know, this world is ending and the unprepared will die painful deaths.$B$BWe have been given a gift, an opportunity to become something greater and more powerful. Overseer Golbaz is preparing a ritual before the altar at the eastern end of the farm. Wait there for him, and learn more of your new brothers and sisters.

CompletionLog.text: 到野豬農場找監督者金塔克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Overseer Jintak at the Jaggedswine Farm.

identity.title: The Doomsday Plan
identity.objectives: Take the Elemental Devices to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
identity.description: The first batch of elemental devices are ready. Your task will be to conceal them inside the city of Orgrimmar. The devices will unleash their fire elementals at the proper time. Don't worry, $n, you'll be safely away before that happens.$B$BDo not do anything that would draw attention to yourself.$B$B<The overseer hands you a package containing several of the elemental devices. This is just the kind of proof that Blood Guard Torek was hoping you'd uncover. You should probably bring the devices to him.>

Objectives.text: 帶著元素裝置到奧格瑪的力量谷找血衛士托雷克。
Objectives.english: Take the Elemental Devices to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

Description.text: 第一批元素裝置已經準備就緒。你的任務就是要把它們藏在奧格瑪內人口稠密的區域。這些裝置將會在適當的時間放出內部的火元素。不用怕，$n，在釋放出元素之前你會有足夠的時間可以離開。$B$B不要引起任何注意。$B$B<監督者交給你一包裝有數個元素裝置的包裹。這正是血衛士托雷克希望你找到的證據。你應該立即把這些裝置帶回去給他。>
Description.english: The first batch of elemental devices are ready. Your task will be to conceal them inside the city of Orgrimmar. The devices will unleash their fire elementals at the proper time. Don't worry, $n, you'll be safely away before that happens.$B$BDo not do anything that would draw attention to yourself.$B$B<The overseer hands you a package containing several of the elemental devices. This is just the kind of proof that Blood Guard Torek was hoping you'd uncover. You should probably bring the devices to him.>

CompletionLog.text: 帶著元素裝置到奧格瑪的力量谷找血衛士托雷克。
CompletionLog.english: Take the Elemental Devices to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

identity.title: Thwarting Twilight's Hammer
identity.objectives: Break Elemental Devices to release their elementals. You must defeat 5 Raging Fire Elementals.
identity.description: You can't have been the only person sent into Orgrimmar to deploy those devices containing fire elementals. We have to find and disable the rest of the devices before they set their captive elementals free and burn down the city.$B$BAre you familiar enough with the devices to destroy them? You need to break them open before the fire elementals inside have had time to reach full strength. They should be easy to defeat if you open the devices early. The cultists have probably put them all over the city.

Objectives.text: 破壞元素裝置、釋放被囚禁其中的元素並殺死5個狂怒火元素。
Objectives.english: Break Elemental Devices to release their elementals. You must defeat 5 Raging Fire Elementals.

Description.text: 被派進奧格瑪設置這些火元素裝置的人絕對不只你一個。在裡面的元素被釋放出來，讓這座城市化為火海之前，我們得趕快找出其它裝置並且全部關掉。$B$B你對這些裝置熟不熟悉?你有沒有辦法毀掉它們?最好的作法，你必須在裡頭的元素力量達到最高點之前先行將裝置毀掉。若是趁這些元素力量還不完全時釋放它們，你應該就可以輕易地將他們擊敗。那些教徒八成在整座城市都安裝了這種裝置。
Description.english: You can't have been the only person sent into Orgrimmar to deploy those devices containing fire elementals. We have to find and disable the rest of the devices before they set their captive elementals free and burn down the city.$B$BAre you familiar enough with the devices to destroy them? You need to break them open before the fire elementals inside have had time to reach full strength. They should be easy to defeat if you open the devices early. The cultists have probably put them all over the city.

CompletionLog.text: 到奧格瑪的力量谷找血衛士托雷克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

identity.title: Alert Our Leaders
identity.objectives: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
identity.description: You have successfully defended Orgrimmar from the threat posed by this Twilight's Hammer cult, $n, and without shedding the blood of our own people. Our enemy will not rest for long. I cannot imagine that Cho'Gall will accept defeat so easily.$B$BGarrosh Hellscream is a well-known hero of the Horde and he will know how to deal with this matter. Go to the Valley of Wisdom and speak to him in Grommash Hold. Tell young Hellscream that our enemies have shown themselves and we must be prepared for their return.

Objectives.text: 到奧格瑪葛羅瑪許堡的智慧谷和卡爾洛斯·地獄吼交談。
Objectives.english: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

Description.text: 你成功地在暮光之錘帶來的威脅中保護了奧格瑪，$n，而且沒讓我們的子民流下一滴血。我們的敵人不會安分太久的。我無法想像，丘加利會這麼簡單地承認失敗。$B$B卡爾洛斯·地獄吼是眾人皆知的部落英雄，他會知道該如何處理這件事情。去葛羅瑪許堡的智慧谷找他，去告訴年輕的地獄吼，敵人現身了，為了因應他們的捲土重來，我們必須做好準備。
Description.english: You have successfully defended Orgrimmar from the threat posed by this Twilight's Hammer cult, $n, and without shedding the blood of our own people. Our enemy will not rest for long. I cannot imagine that Cho'Gall will accept defeat so easily.$B$BGarrosh Hellscream is a well-known hero of the Horde and he will know how to deal with this matter. Go to the Valley of Wisdom and speak to him in Grommash Hold. Tell young Hellscream that our enemies have shown themselves and we must be prepared for their return.

identity.title: Spreading The Word
identity.objectives: While wearing your Doomsday Message, visit the East Zeppelin Tower, the West Zeppelin Tower, and the town square of Razor Hill.
identity.description: Welcome to the farm, $n. Everyone here works to earn $g his:her; keep. For some, that means caring for the animals. Others are responsible for working on our construction projects. Still others work to spread our message among the people and I think that's a good place for you to start.$B$BTake this board. It bears a short message about our beliefs. While wearing the board, visit the eastern and western zeppelin towers outside Orgrimmar's gates, as well as the town square of Razor Hill, to the south.

Objectives.text: 戴上末日訊息板，拜訪東飛艇塔、西飛艇塔、以及剃刀嶺。
Objectives.english: While wearing your Doomsday Message, visit the East Zeppelin Tower, the West Zeppelin Tower, and the town square of Razor Hill.

Description.text: 歡迎來到我們的農場，$n。在這邊每個人藉由工作維持$g他的:她的;生活所需。有些人會照料牲畜，有些人會負責建築方面的事情，也有一些人會去人群中傳佈我們的訊息，我覺得這個地方對你來說是個很好的出發點。$B$B拿著這塊板子，上面寫的是闡述我們信念的簡短文字。戴上這塊板子，去拜訪奧格瑪城門外面的東飛艇塔和西飛艇塔、以及南邊的剃刀嶺。
Description.english: Welcome to the farm, $n. Everyone here works to earn $g his:her; keep. For some, that means caring for the animals. Others are responsible for working on our construction projects. Still others work to spread our message among the people and I think that's a good place for you to start.$B$BTake this board. It bears a short message about our beliefs. While wearing the board, visit the eastern and western zeppelin towers outside Orgrimmar's gates, as well as the town square of Razor Hill, to the south.

CompletionLog.text: 到野豬農場找監督者金塔克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Overseer Jintak at the Jaggedswine Farm.

identity.title: The Missing
identity.objectives: While wearing your Doomdsay Recruit's Robe, speak to Cultist Lethelyn, Cultist Kaima, Cultist Wyman, and Cultist Orlunn at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elywnn Forest.
identity.description: The cult isn't just spreading fear and paranoia anymore. Now, I'm receiving reports of missing people. Mothers, fathers, brothers, and sisters have seemingly disappeared, but I have a feeling they can be found in one of the cult's camps outside the city. If I give you the names of some of the missing people, would you try to locate them in the cultist camp at Mirror Lake Orchard? It's southwest of the city gates. To blend in, you'll need join the cult and get a robe from one of the doomsayers in Old Town.

Objectives.text: 穿上末日預言新教徒長袍，到艾爾文森林的明鏡湖果園和教徒蕾瑟琳、教徒卡伊瑪、教徒威曼、及教徒奧盧恩交談。
Objectives.english: While wearing your Doomdsay Recruit's Robe, speak to Cultist Lethelyn, Cultist Kaima, Cultist Wyman, and Cultist Orlunn at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elywnn Forest.

Description.text: 現在，這些教徒已經不只是散佈恐懼和偏執的妄想了。我拿到一些有關失蹤人口的報告，父親、母親、兄弟、姊妹似乎全都人間蒸發。不過我覺得，也許在城外的那塊教徒集會場所可以找到他們。如果我給你失蹤人口名單，你可不可以去明鏡湖果園幫我找找看?就在城市大門西南邊。那裡有個教徒聚會營地，幫我查一下這些不見的人在哪。不過你得先跑一趟舊城區，從末日預言者那邊拿件袍子，這樣才有辦法混進去。
Description.english: The cult isn't just spreading fear and paranoia anymore. Now, I'm receiving reports of missing people. Mothers, fathers, brothers, and sisters have seemingly disappeared, but I have a feeling they can be found in one of the cult's camps outside the city. If I give you the names of some of the missing people, would you try to locate them in the cultist camp at Mirror Lake Orchard? It's southwest of the city gates. To blend in, you'll need join the cult and get a robe from one of the doomsayers in Old Town.

CompletionLog.text: 到暴風城的暴風要塞向安東上尉回報。
CompletionLog.english: Report back to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

identity.title: Spreading The Word
identity.objectives: While wearing your Doomsday Message, visit the Westbrook Garrison, the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind, and the town square of Goldshire.
identity.description: Welcome to our orchard, $n. Everyone here works to earn $g his:her; keep. For some, that means tending the fruit trees. Others are responsible for working on our construction projects. Still others work to spread our message among the people and I think that's a good place for you to start.$B$BTake this board. It bears a short message about our beliefs. While wearing it, visit the Westbrook Garrison, southwest of here, the town square of Goldshire just to the east, and the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind.

Objectives.text: 戴上末日訊息板，拜訪西泉要塞、暴風城的英雄谷、以及附近的閃金鎮。
Objectives.english: While wearing your Doomsday Message, visit the Westbrook Garrison, the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind, and the town square of Goldshire.

Description.text: 歡迎來到我們的果園，$n。在這邊每個人藉由工作維持$g他的:她的;生活所需。有些人會照料果樹，有些人會負責建築方面的事情，也有一些人會去人群中傳佈我們的訊息，我覺得這個地方對你來說是個很好的出發點。$B$B拿著這塊板子，上面寫的是闡述我們信念的簡短文字。戴上這塊板子，去拜訪西南邊的西泉要塞、東邊的閃金鎮、以及暴風城的英雄谷。
Description.english: Welcome to our orchard, $n. Everyone here works to earn $g his:her; keep. For some, that means tending the fruit trees. Others are responsible for working on our construction projects. Still others work to spread our message among the people and I think that's a good place for you to start.$B$BTake this board. It bears a short message about our beliefs. While wearing it, visit the Westbrook Garrison, southwest of here, the town square of Goldshire just to the east, and the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind.

CompletionLog.text: 到明鏡湖果園找監督者賽倫德拉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Overseer Sylandra at Mirror Lake Orchard.

identity.title: The Master's Plan
identity.objectives: Learn more about the cult's plans at the altar in the westerm part of Mirror Lake Orchard.
identity.description: You're fitting in well here, $n, but there is more to us than daily chores and spreading the message. I'm sure you heard a little bit about it when you first joined.$B$BAs you know, this world is ending and the unprepared will die painful deaths.$B$BWe have been given a gift, an opportunity to become something greater and more powerful. Overseer Talathor is preparing for a ritual at the altar just west of the orchard. Wait there for him, and learn more of your new brothers and sisters.

Objectives.text: 在明鏡湖果園西邊的祭壇收集資訊，看看這個教派在策劃些什麼。
Objectives.english: Learn more about the cult's plans at the altar in the westerm part of Mirror Lake Orchard.

Description.text: 你表現得不錯，$n，不過除了例行瑣事和傳播訊息之外，還有更重要的活等著我們。我相信你當初加入的時候已經略知一二。$B$B正如你所知，這世界正邁向毀滅，屆時尚未做好準備的人終將死於無盡苦痛之中。$B$B我們收到一份禮物，這是一個機會，讓我們變得更強更大。監督者塔拉梭爾正在果園西邊的祭壇準備一項儀式。去那等他，多去認識你的新兄弟姊妹們。
Description.english: You're fitting in well here, $n, but there is more to us than daily chores and spreading the message. I'm sure you heard a little bit about it when you first joined.$B$BAs you know, this world is ending and the unprepared will die painful deaths.$B$BWe have been given a gift, an opportunity to become something greater and more powerful. Overseer Talathor is preparing for a ritual at the altar just west of the orchard. Wait there for him, and learn more of your new brothers and sisters.

CompletionLog.text: 到明鏡湖果園找監督者賽倫德拉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Overseer Sylandra at Mirror Lake Orchard.

identity.title: The Doomsday Plan
identity.objectives: Take the Elemental Devices to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.
identity.description: The first batch of elemental devices are ready. Your task will be to conceal them inside populated areas of Stormwind. The devices will unleash their elementals at the proper time. Don't worry, $n, you'll be safely away before that happens.$B$BDo not do anything that would draw attention to yourself.$B$B<The overseer hands you a package containing several of the elemental devices. This is just the kind of proof that Captain Anton was hoping you'd uncover. You should probably bring the devices to him.>

Objectives.text: 帶著元素裝置到暴風要塞找安東上尉。
Objectives.english: Take the Elemental Devices to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

Description.text: 第一批元素裝置已經準備就緒。你的任務就是要把它們藏在暴風城內人口稠密的區域。這些裝置將會在適當的時間放出內部的元素。不用怕，$n，發生這種事情之前，你有足夠的時間可以離開。$B$B不要引起任何注意。$B$B<監督者交給你一包裝有數個元素裝置的包裹。這正是安東上尉希望你找到的證據。你應該立即把這些裝置帶回去給他。>
Description.english: The first batch of elemental devices are ready. Your task will be to conceal them inside populated areas of Stormwind. The devices will unleash their elementals at the proper time. Don't worry, $n, you'll be safely away before that happens.$B$BDo not do anything that would draw attention to yourself.$B$B<The overseer hands you a package containing several of the elemental devices. This is just the kind of proof that Captain Anton was hoping you'd uncover. You should probably bring the devices to him.>

CompletionLog.text: 帶著元素裝置到暴風要塞找安東上尉。
CompletionLog.english: Take the Elemental Devices to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

identity.title: Thwarting Twilight's Hammer
identity.objectives: Destroy Elemental Devices to release their captive elementals. Defeat 5 Raging Wind Elementals.
identity.description: You can't have been the only person sent into Stormwind to deploy those devices containing wind elementals. We have to find and disable the rest of the devices before they set their captive elementals free to create storms in the city.$B$BAre you familiar enough with the devices to destroy them? Our best chance is to break the devices before the elementals inside can reach full strength. Look for the devices in the Trade District, Cathedral Square and the Mage Quarter. Hurry!

Objectives.text: 毀掉元素裝置以釋放被囚禁其中的元素。殺死5個狂怒風元素。
Objectives.english: Destroy Elemental Devices to release their captive elementals. Defeat 5 Raging Wind Elementals.

Description.text: 被派進暴風城設置這些風元素裝置的人絕對不只你一個。在裡面的元素被釋放出來肆虐這座城市之前，我們得趕快找出其它裝置並且全部關掉。$B$B你對這些裝置熟不熟悉?你有沒有辦法毀掉它們?最好的作法，就是在裡頭的元素達到最高的力量之前先毀掉裝置。去貿易區、教堂廣場、以及法師區找出這些裝置。快去!
Description.english: You can't have been the only person sent into Stormwind to deploy those devices containing wind elementals. We have to find and disable the rest of the devices before they set their captive elementals free to create storms in the city.$B$BAre you familiar enough with the devices to destroy them? Our best chance is to break the devices before the elementals inside can reach full strength. Look for the devices in the Trade District, Cathedral Square and the Mage Quarter. Hurry!

CompletionLog.text: 到暴風要塞找安東上尉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Captain Anton in Stormwind Keep.

identity.title: Warn King Wrynn
identity.objectives: Speak with King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
identity.description: You have successfully defended Stormwind from the threat posed by this Twilight's Hammer cult, $n, and without harming our own citizens. Our enemy will not rest for long. Indeed, Cho'Gall must already be busy planning his next move.$B$BYou must take word to King Varian Wrynn. Go directly to him in the throne room of Stormwind Keep. Tell the king that our enemies have shown themselves and we must be prepared for their return.

Objectives.text: 到暴風要塞和瓦里安·烏瑞恩國王交談。
Objectives.english: Speak with King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.

Description.text: 你成功地在暮光之錘帶來的威脅中保護了暴風城，$n，而且沒有任何子民受傷。我們的敵人不會安分太久的。的確，丘加利必定正忙於策劃下一波攻擊。$B$B你必須去警告瓦里安·烏瑞恩國王。前往暴風要塞的王座廳，告訴國王，敵人現身了，為了因應他們的捲土重來，我們必須做好準備。
Description.english: You have successfully defended Stormwind from the threat posed by this Twilight's Hammer cult, $n, and without harming our own citizens. Our enemy will not rest for long. Indeed, Cho'Gall must already be busy planning his next move.$B$BYou must take word to King Varian Wrynn. Go directly to him in the throne room of Stormwind Keep. Tell the king that our enemies have shown themselves and we must be prepared for their return.

identity.title: The Name Never Spoken
identity.objectives: Assemble the true name by examining the three Firestones in the Inferno.
identity.description: Did my drought work? You spoke with one of them?$B$BThen you know what to do. The name of their elemental master is written on three firestones scattered throughout the Inferno. Examine each of these stones and we will have the name we need.$B$BHurry! Your precious forest burns!

Objectives.text: 在炼狱火海中检查三块火焰石，找出真名。
Objectives.english: Assemble the true name by examining the three Firestones in the Inferno.

Description.text: 我的药水起作用了吗？你跟他们说过话了吗？$B$B那么你就知道该怎么办了。他们的元素领主的名字就写在三块火焰石上，而那些石头分散在炼狱火海中。去查查这些石头，我们就可以得到这个名字。$B$B快一点！你们的宝贝森林正在燃烧！
Description.english: Did my drought work? You spoke with one of them?$B$BThen you know what to do. The name of their elemental master is written on three firestones scattered throughout the Inferno. Examine each of these stones and we will have the name we need.$B$BHurry! Your precious forest burns!

CompletionLog.text: 去找海加尔山黑角赎罪地的泰拉斯·黑角。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Tyrus Blackhorn at Blackhorn's Penance in Hyjal.

identity.title: Zalazane's Fall
identity.objectives: Help Vol'jin take back the Echo Isles and kill Zalazane.
identity.description: De time for battle is now!  We'd be headin' ova to da islands soon, so you'd betta be ready.$B$BZalazane doesn't have much time left.

Objectives.text: 帮助沃金夺回回音群岛，消灭扎拉赞恩。
Objectives.english: Help Vol'jin take back the Echo Isles and kill Zalazane.

Description.text: 战斗就要开始了！我们即将向那座岛屿发起攻击。所以你应该尽快做好准备。$B$B扎拉赞恩猖獗的日子不多了。
Description.english: De time for battle is now!  We'd be headin' ova to da islands soon, so you'd betta be ready.$B$BZalazane doesn't have much time left.

identity.title: Frogs Away!
identity.objectives: While riding a bat, use the Sack o' Frogs to place 12 attuned frogs on the markers in the Echo Isles.
identity.description: Wit de frogs ready to go, I be needin' ya to help me send 'em out to the isles.$B$BOn de eastern side of Sen'jin Village, ya can find Handler Marnlek. He be handlin' all the bats for Vol'jin's scouts and he can loan ya a bat to get ya out to de isles.$B$BTake dis sack' o frogs with ya. I been askin' de spirits for guidance. Dey've sent smoke to show ya where I need de eyes most. While ridin' de bat, reach into de sack and toss de frogs toward de white smoke.

Objectives.text: 骑在蝙蝠背上，使用青蛙口袋，将12只被施法的青蛙投放到回音群岛的标志地点。
Objectives.english: While riding a bat, use the Sack o' Frogs to place 12 attuned frogs on the markers in the Echo Isles.

Description.text: 这些青蛙都已经准备好了，我需要你帮我把它们送到那些岛屿上去。$B$B在森金村的东边，你能找到管理员曼雷克。他负责照管所有沃金哨兵的蝙蝠。所以他可以给你一只蝙蝠，让你飞到那些岛屿上空去。$B$B带上这口袋青蛙。我已经请求了英灵的指引。他们会升起烟雾，让你知道我需要探查哪些地方。你可以在蝙蝠背上将这些青蛙扔到冒白烟的地方。
Description.english: Wit de frogs ready to go, I be needin' ya to help me send 'em out to the isles.$B$BOn de eastern side of Sen'jin Village, ya can find Handler Marnlek. He be handlin' all the bats for Vol'jin's scouts and he can loan ya a bat to get ya out to de isles.$B$BTake dis sack' o frogs with ya. I been askin' de spirits for guidance. Dey've sent smoke to show ya where I need de eyes most. While ridin' de bat, reach into de sack and toss de frogs toward de white smoke.

identity.title: Trollin' For Volunteers
identity.objectives: Use Vol'jin's War Drums to recruit 5 Troll Citizens in Razor Hill.$B$BYou can speak to Handler Marnlek for a bat ride to Razor Hill.
identity.description: Vol'jin has given me his war drums and put  me in charge of trainin' da new recruits here. Only problem is we be short on new recruits.$B$BSupposin' I loaned ya dis drum, would ya use it to sound de call to war on Vol'jin's behalf in Razor Hill? If ya could even inspire just a few trolls to join da cause, it would make a difference. Once ya've convinced dem to volunteer, bring dem back to me for trainin'. Go over an' talk to Handler Marnlek to de south. He can lend you a bat for de ride to Razor Hill.

Objectives.text: 使用沃金战鼓，在剃刀岭招募5名巨魔平民。$B$B你可以从管理员曼雷克那里借来一只蝙蝠，飞往剃刀岭。
Objectives.english: Use Vol'jin's War Drums to recruit 5 Troll Citizens in Razor Hill.$B$BYou can speak to Handler Marnlek for a bat ride to Razor Hill.

Description.text: 沃金将他的战鼓交给我，让我负责训练这里的新兵。现在我唯一的问题就是找不到新兵。$B$B如果我把这面鼓借给你，你能不能在剃刀岭敲响它，代表沃金发布战争号召？只要你能激励几个巨魔来追随你，情况就完全不一样了。召集到志愿者以后，就把他们带回来，让我能训练他们。去找南边的管理员曼雷克谈谈。他会借给你一只蝙蝠，载你飞往剃刀岭。
Description.english: Vol'jin has given me his war drums and put  me in charge of trainin' da new recruits here. Only problem is we be short on new recruits.$B$BSupposin' I loaned ya dis drum, would ya use it to sound de call to war on Vol'jin's behalf in Razor Hill? If ya could even inspire just a few trolls to join da cause, it would make a difference. Once ya've convinced dem to volunteer, bring dem back to me for trainin'. Go over an' talk to Handler Marnlek to de south. He can lend you a bat for de ride to Razor Hill.

identity.title: Lady Of Da Tigers
identity.objectives: While imbued with the Spirit of the Tiger, lure the Tiger Matriarch out of hiding and use your new abilities to best it in combat.
identity.description: Remember de frogs ya made into me eyes and ears? Well, dey've found somethin' interestin'.$B$BOn an island to de southeast, dey've spied a tiger even de other cats seem to fear. Dis tiger, I've never seen anythin' like it.$B$BIt hunts wit' da instincts of a cat, but de mind of a person. It could be a powerful spirit and a strong ally.$B$BI'll be callin' down the spirit o' the tiger upon ya. Use its gifts to locate this cat and challenge it. See if ya can win its aid in our battle for the isles.

Objectives.text: 在被注入猛虎之魂以后，将猛虎女王从它的藏身之地引诱出来，利用你的新能力战胜它。
Objectives.english: While imbued with the Spirit of the Tiger, lure the Tiger Matriarch out of hiding and use your new abilities to best it in combat.

Description.text: 还记得那些你帮我制作的间谍青蛙吗？现在它们发现了一些非常有趣的信息。$B$B在东南方的一座岛上，它们发现了一头猛虎。我从没有见过那样的猛虎，就算是其它老虎在它面前也都噤若寒蝉。$B$B而且，它不但有猫科动物的野性直觉，还有人类的心智。这头强大的野兽会成为我们有力的盟友。$B$B我会为你召唤那头猛虎之魂，利用它找到那头猛虎。这样你就能向那头猛虎发起挑战。如果你能战胜它，我们夺回家园的战役就会多一份战力。
Description.english: Remember de frogs ya made into me eyes and ears? Well, dey've found somethin' interestin'.$B$BOn an island to de southeast, dey've spied a tiger even de other cats seem to fear. Dis tiger, I've never seen anythin' like it.$B$BIt hunts wit' da instincts of a cat, but de mind of a person. It could be a powerful spirit and a strong ally.$B$BI'll be callin' down the spirit o' the tiger upon ya. Use its gifts to locate this cat and challenge it. See if ya can win its aid in our battle for the isles.

identity.title: Dance Of De Spirits
identity.objectives: Talk to Witch Doctor Hez'tok near the circle of ritual dancers outside Sen'jin Village when you're ready to consult the omens.
identity.description: De time has come to start thinkin' about when to make our move. Champion Uru'zin tells me his men be ready. You and Vanira done good work gatherin' information on de enemy and findin' us new allies.$B$BNow, we read de omens. We find out when to launch de attack.$B$BFind Witch Doctor Hez'tok near the circle of ritual dancers. He be startin' de ritual as soon as ya be ready.

Objectives.text: 做好解读预兆的准备之后，就前往森金村外，同祭祀舞蹈者组成的圆环旁边的巫医赫兹托克交谈。
Objectives.english: Talk to Witch Doctor Hez'tok near the circle of ritual dancers outside Sen'jin Village when you're ready to consult the omens.

Description.text: 我们需要考虑该何时采取行动。勇士乌拉金告诉我，他的部下已经做好了准备。你和瓦妮拉则为我们搜集到了重要的情报，并找到了新的盟友。$B$B现在，我们要解读预兆，确认该何时发动进攻。$B$B在祭祀舞蹈者组成的圆环旁边找到巫医赫兹托克。只要你做好准备，他就会开始仪式。
Description.english: De time has come to start thinkin' about when to make our move. Champion Uru'zin tells me his men be ready. You and Vanira done good work gatherin' information on de enemy and findin' us new allies.$B$BNow, we read de omens. We find out when to launch de attack.$B$BFind Witch Doctor Hez'tok near the circle of ritual dancers. He be startin' de ritual as soon as ya be ready.

identity.title: Words for Delivery
identity.objectives: Give the speech to Captain Tread Sparknozzle at Steelgrill Depot.
identity.description: Here we go.  This is the speech, $n!$B$BIt has everything to be a great battle starter: It's inspirational, has eloquent language and speaks directly to gnomes.  Never has a finer speech been written!$B$BTurn this in to Captain Tread Sparknozzle and see if there's anything else he needs of you.

Objectives.text: 將演說稿交給鋼架補給站的特瑞德·炫鼻上尉。
Objectives.english: Give the speech to Captain Tread Sparknozzle at Steelgrill Depot.

Description.text: 來吧，演說稿在這，$n!以一場戰爭的開場白來說，這篇演說稿該有的都有了:以動人的語言直接向地精們演說，這能大大地激勵人心。從來從沒有人寫出如此完美的演說稿!$B$B把這交給特瑞德·炫鼻上尉，看看他那裡是不是還有什麼地方需要幫忙!
Description.english: Here we go.  This is the speech, $n!$B$BIt has everything to be a great battle starter: It's inspirational, has eloquent language and speaks directly to gnomes.  Never has a finer speech been written!$B$BTurn this in to Captain Tread Sparknozzle and see if there's anything else he needs of you.

CompletionLog.text: 將演說稿交給大工匠梅卡托克。
CompletionLog.english: Give the Speech to High Tinker Mekkatorque.

identity.title: Poaching for Dummies
identity.objectives: Use the Butcherbot on the corpse of 20 Glasshide Basilisks, Scorpid Tail Lashers, or Blisterpaw Hyenas.
identity.description: A new face around here, huh? You're in luck, making coin's easy thanks to my butcherbots. You go out and hunt some scorpids, some hyenas, maybe a few basilisks, set the butcherbot down, and let him do his thing! I've programmed him to extract all the valuable parts and place it safely in his hopper.$B$BIf you're interested, take him out to the northwest near Sandsorrow Watch first. Just bring him back once he's full and I'll pay you for the contents.

Objectives.text: 在20具晶鳞蜥蜴、沙漠鞭尾蝎和疱爪土狼尸体上使用收集机器人。
Objectives.english: Use the Butcherbot on the corpse of 20 Glasshide Basilisks, Scorpid Tail Lashers, or Blisterpaw Hyenas.

Description.text: 新面孔，是吗？你走运了，多亏我的收集机器人，现在赚钱可容易了。你出去杀掉一些蝎子、土狼，也许还有几只蜥蜴，把收集机器人放下来，接下来的事情让他处理便是！我为他编好了程，可以收集所有值钱的器官，安全放到他的料斗里去。$B$B如果你有兴趣，就先把他带到西北边的流沙岗哨去。满了以后再带回来，我按量付你钱。
Description.english: A new face around here, huh? You're in luck, making coin's easy thanks to my butcherbots. You go out and hunt some scorpids, some hyenas, maybe a few basilisks, set the butcherbot down, and let him do his thing! I've programmed him to extract all the valuable parts and place it safely in his hopper.$B$BIf you're interested, take him out to the northwest near Sandsorrow Watch first. Just bring him back once he's full and I'll pay you for the contents.

CompletionLog.text: 去找塔纳利斯加基森的卡崔娜·特纳尔。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Driz Plunkbow at Gadgetzan in Feralas.

identity.title: Circle the Wagons... er, Boats
identity.objectives: Sink 15 Southsea Rowboats.
identity.description: The fires may be dealt with, but those Southsea pirates are still getting ready to board the Speedbarge!$B$B$n, you need to go back to Mazzer Stripscrew and get on your boat. Use the cannon to sink them before it's too late!

Objectives.text: 击沉15艘南海划艇。
Objectives.english: Sink 15 Southsea Rowboats.

Description.text: 火算是扑灭了，可南海海盗还是打算接舷登上赛艇平台！$B$B$n，你得赶紧到玛兹尔·螺钉那儿拿你的船，趁还来得及，用炮击沉他们！
Description.english: The fires may be dealt with, but those Southsea pirates are still getting ready to board the Speedbarge!$B$B$n, you need to go back to Mazzer Stripscrew and get on your boat. Use the cannon to sink them before it's too late!

CompletionLog.text: 去找位于千针石林菲兹尔和普兹克的赛艇平台的金克·铁钩。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Jinky Twizzlefixxit on Fizzle & Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles.

identity.title: Circle the Wagons... er, Boats
identity.objectives: Sink 15 Southsea Rowboats.
identity.description: The fires may be dealt with, but those Southsea pirates are still getting ready to board the Speedbarge!$B$B$n, you need to go back to Griznak and get on your boat. Use the cannon to sink them before it's too late!

Objectives.text: 击沉15艘南海划艇。
Objectives.english: Sink 15 Southsea Rowboats.

Description.text: 火算是扑灭了，可南海海盗还是打算接舷登上赛艇平台！$B$B$n，你得赶紧到格里兹纳克那儿登上你的船，趁还来得及，用炮击沉他们！
Description.english: The fires may be dealt with, but those Southsea pirates are still getting ready to board the Speedbarge!$B$B$n, you need to go back to Griznak and get on your boat. Use the cannon to sink them before it's too late!

CompletionLog.text: 去找位于千针石林菲兹尔和普兹克的赛艇平台的拉泽瑞克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Razzeric on Fizzle & Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles.

identity.title: Your Underwater Mount (Temp)
identity.objectives: Lure and subdue an Abyssal Manta.$B$B[Note: There is a lot pending for this quest - the end result will be much quicker and much cleaner]
identity.description: I set up some ropes on the ledge below.  Just tie off your lure to one of the ropes and release it into the abyssal stream. If all goes well, one of the rays should come up for it almost immediately.$B$BI don't expect this to be even remotely easy, so hold on tight and keep an eye ahead at all times. If you should succeed in subduing one of the rays, bring it back here immediately so that we can feed it and cement the bond.$B$BI have a good feeling this time. I think this is it, $n.

Objectives.text: 引誘並壓伏住1隻深海魟魚。$B$B【注意:這個任務有很多未決定的事物...結局會更快、更簡潔】
Objectives.english: Lure and subdue an Abyssal Manta.$B$B[Note: There is a lot pending for this quest - the end result will be much quicker and much cleaner]

Description.text: 我在下面的岩架設了一些繩索。你只需用其中一根繩索捆好你的誘餌，並將他放到那深淵的蒸汽之中。順利的話，其中一隻鰭刺會立刻現身上鉤。$B$B我一點都不認為這會是件簡單的事，所以隨時做好準備，提高警覺。如果你成功征服了其中一隻鰭刺，馬上將牠帶回這裡，讓我們可以餵養牠並強化和牠的連結。$B$B我有個不錯的預感。我想這次會成功的，$n。
Description.english: I set up some ropes on the ledge below.  Just tie off your lure to one of the ropes and release it into the abyssal stream. If all goes well, one of the rays should come up for it almost immediately.$B$BI don't expect this to be even remotely easy, so hold on tight and keep an eye ahead at all times. If you should succeed in subduing one of the rays, bring it back here immediately so that we can feed it and cement the bond.$B$BI have a good feeling this time. I think this is it, $n.

identity.title: Into the Maw!
identity.objectives: Step through the flamegate atop the Lightning Ledge in Mount Hyjal, and speak with Jordan Olafson within.
identity.description: $n, there you are! Goldrinn has a mission that only his champion can accomplish. Atop the Lightning Ledge, Twilight's Hammer has erected a flamegate. We don't know where it leads, but Goldrinn can't enter. The ancient needs you to be his fangs.$B$BStep into the flamegate and talk to Jordan Olafson when you get inside. He'll give you a token to allow you to use Goldrinn's power in that realm. Find out where the flamegate leads!

Objectives.text: 跨过海加尔山闪电崖顶端的火焰之门，跟乔丹·奥拉夫森谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Step through the flamegate atop the Lightning Ledge in Mount Hyjal, and speak with Jordan Olafson within.

Description.text: $n，你来了！只有戈德林选中的英雄才有可能完成他交代的这项任务。暮光之锤在闪电崖顶端创造了一道火焰之门。我们不知道它通往哪里，连戈德林也进不去。狼神希望你成为他的利齿。$B$B跨过火焰之门，与J乔丹·奥拉夫森谈一谈。他会给你一件器物，可以让你在那个位面使用戈德林的力量。查明火焰之门通往哪里！
Description.english: $n, there you are! Goldrinn has a mission that only his champion can accomplish. Atop the Lightning Ledge, Twilight's Hammer has erected a flamegate. We don't know where it leads, but Goldrinn can't enter. The ancient needs you to be his fangs.$B$BStep into the flamegate and talk to Jordan Olafson when you get inside. He'll give you a token to allow you to use Goldrinn's power in that realm. Find out where the flamegate leads!

CompletionLog.text: 跨过海加尔山闪电崖顶端的火焰之门，跟乔丹·奥拉夫森谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Step through the flamegate atop the Lightning Ledge in Mount Hyjal, and speak with Jordan Olafson within.

identity.title: Into the Maw!
identity.objectives: Step through the flamegate atop the Lightning Ledge in Mount Hyjal, and speak with Jordan Olafson within.
identity.description: $n! Lo'Gosh needs you. Atop the Lightning Ledge, Twilight's Hammer has erected a flamegate. We don't know where it leads, but nobody who's gone through has returned. You are to venture inside and be the fangs of Lo'Gosh within.$B$BStep into the flamegate and talk to Jordan Olafson when you get inside. He'll give you a token to allow you to use Lo'Gosh's power inside that realm. Find out where the flamegate leads!

Objectives.text: 穿过海加尔山闪电崖上的火焰之门，跟里面的乔丹·奥拉夫森谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Step through the flamegate atop the Lightning Ledge in Mount Hyjal, and speak with Jordan Olafson within.

Description.text: $n！洛戈什需要你。暮光之锤在闪电崖上树立起了一座巨大的火焰之门。我们不知道它通往哪里，但过去的人没有一个能回来。你得进去，成为洛戈什在那里的利齿。$B$B穿过火焰之门，进入后去和乔丹·奥拉夫森谈一谈。他会将一个徽章交给你，能让你在那个领域里使用洛戈什的力量。搞明白火焰之门通往何处！
Description.english: $n! Lo'Gosh needs you. Atop the Lightning Ledge, Twilight's Hammer has erected a flamegate. We don't know where it leads, but nobody who's gone through has returned. You are to venture inside and be the fangs of Lo'Gosh within.$B$BStep into the flamegate and talk to Jordan Olafson when you get inside. He'll give you a token to allow you to use Lo'Gosh's power inside that realm. Find out where the flamegate leads!

CompletionLog.text: 穿过海加尔山闪电崖上的火焰之门，跟里面的乔丹·奥拉夫森谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Step through the flamegate atop the Lightning Ledge in Mount Hyjal, and speak with Jordan Olafson within.

identity.title: Caught Off-Guard
identity.objectives: Kill 10 Azsh'ir Patrollers.
identity.description: I can't imagine that our escape from the shell went unnoticed, but either the naga at these ruins were not informed or don't consider us a threat. I do not intend to take such opportunities for granted - we must strike now.$B$BI need you to slip into the lower level of the ruins and take out as many of their patrols as you can. We cannot risk any of those patrols finding out about our occupation of this cave - make sure none escape.

Objectives.text: 消滅10個艾薩伊爾巡邏者。
Objectives.english: Kill 10 Azsh'ir Patrollers.

Description.text: 我想像不到我們從殼裡逃出來竟然沒人發現。要不是在那些遺跡裡的納迦不知情，就是他們不覺得我們是個威脅。我可不想把這種機會當成理所當然－我們現在必須突擊。$B$B我需要你溜到遺跡的下層，打倒越多巡邏隊越好。我們不能冒險讓巡邏隊發現我們在洞穴裡的任務－不要放過任何一個。
Description.english: I can't imagine that our escape from the shell went unnoticed, but either the naga at these ruins were not informed or don't consider us a threat. I do not intend to take such opportunities for granted - we must strike now.$B$BI need you to slip into the lower level of the ruins and take out as many of their patrols as you can. We cannot risk any of those patrols finding out about our occupation of this cave - make sure none escape.

identity.title: Swift Approach
identity.objectives: Destroy 10 Azsh'ir Sentry Wards.
identity.description: I've taken the liberty of performing some preliminary scouting. The naga may not be aware of out position, but they are not entirely unprepared for intruders.$B$BBeyond their patrols, they have set up magical sentry devices that will warn them of unwelcome guests. Fortunately, they seem to have sacrificed quality for quantity, and there is definitely a window in which the devices can be destroyed before their alarms are answered.$B$BI trust that you can see to this before our other soldiers arrive.

Objectives.text: 摧毀10個艾薩伊爾哨衛結界。
Objectives.english: Destroy 10 Azsh'ir Sentry Wards.

Description.text: 我有機會進行了一些初步的偵查。納迦或許不知道我們的位置，但他們並非完全沒有對付入侵者的準備。$B$B除了巡邏隊，他們還設置了能夠通知他們有不速之客來訪的魔法哨戒裝置。幸運的是，他們似乎犧牲了品質來遷就數量，所以絕對有方法在觸動警報之前先破壞掉那些裝置。$B$B我相信你能在我們剩下的士兵到達這裡前完成這件事。
Description.english: I've taken the liberty of performing some preliminary scouting. The naga may not be aware of out position, but they are not entirely unprepared for intruders.$B$BBeyond their patrols, they have set up magical sentry devices that will warn them of unwelcome guests. Fortunately, they seem to have sacrificed quality for quantity, and there is definitely a window in which the devices can be destroyed before their alarms are answered.$B$BI trust that you can see to this before our other soldiers arrive.

identity.title: An Occupation of Time
identity.objectives: Investigate the 6 in-tact statues in the Vashj'ir Gardens.
identity.description: Look--$n is it?--I need your help. I know most everyone in this cave thinks that we're not in a position to be worrying about anything but our own hides right now, but we have an amazing opportunity here.$B$BThis was one of the royal cities of the elves in the days when Azshara was queen. In this city lie the keys to lore long lost and artifacts of unimaginable historical value. All I want from you, while you're out on your little jaunt, is to keep an eye out for exactly those kinds of things.

Objectives.text: 在瓦許伊爾花園搜尋6個完好無缺的雕像。
Objectives.english: Investigate the 6 in-tact statues in the Vashj'ir Gardens.

Description.text: 聽著...$n是嗎?...我需要你的幫助。我知道幾乎這個洞穴裡的每個人都認為我們現在除了自己躲好外，沒有立場擔心其他任何事，但是我不能這麼快地拋棄我的祖先。$B$B這是當艾薩拉仍是女王時，對她效忠的眾多精靈城市之一。在這城市裡藏有取得失落已久的知識和具有無法想像的歷史價值的神器的關鍵。我希望你做的，是當你到達那座城市時，留意一下那些具有重要意義的東西。
Description.english: Look--$n is it?--I need your help. I know most everyone in this cave thinks that we're not in a position to be worrying about anything but our own hides right now, but we have an amazing opportunity here.$B$BThis was one of the royal cities of the elves in the days when Azshara was queen. In this city lie the keys to lore long lost and artifacts of unimaginable historical value. All I want from you, while you're out on your little jaunt, is to keep an eye out for exactly those kinds of things.

identity.title: A Better Vantage
identity.objectives: Scout out the Garden Plaza, the Main Road, and the Temple District.
identity.description: This cave is our only refuge. There's no place to which we can retreat. There's no help on the way. Whatever happens, this cave must remain safe or we are all sure to die down here.$B$BI have no intention of standing idle. The best way to keep the naga from finding us is to keep them off-balance, but we can't risk them following us back here between strikes. We need a forward post to launch or attacks from.$B$BI'd like you scout the ruins for a suitable base of operation. Something defensible.

Objectives.text: 偵查花園廣場、主要道路，以及神廟區。
Objectives.english: Scout out the Garden Plaza, the Main Road, and the Temple District.

Description.text: 這個洞穴是我們唯一的避難所。我們沒有其他地方可退，也沒有正在前來的援軍。無論如何，這個洞穴都必須保持安全，否則我們全都會死在這下面。$B$B我不想要呆站著什麼都不做。讓納迦無法找到我們的最好方法就是打破他們的平衡，但我們不能冒在出擊時被他們反跟蹤到這裡的風險。我們需要一個前哨站來發動攻擊。$B$B我希望你偵查這處廢墟，找到一個合適的行動基地。一個易於防守的位置。
Description.english: This cave is our only refuge. There's no place to which we can retreat. There's no help on the way. Whatever happens, this cave must remain safe or we are all sure to die down here.$B$BI have no intention of standing idle. The best way to keep the naga from finding us is to keep them off-balance, but we can't risk them following us back here between strikes. We need a forward post to launch or attacks from.$B$BI'd like you scout the ruins for a suitable base of operation. Something defensible.

identity.title: Upon the Scene of Battle
identity.objectives: Bring the broken shard back to THE CAVE.
identity.description: All around you lie the remnants of a fierce battle. The naga skeletons are no surprise, but the weapons and remains of their apparent opponents are somewhat more unexpected.$B$BAmidst the bones, you spot a strangely prominent piece of metal jutting out from one of the skulls. It's difficult to tell what sort of weapon it might have once been part of, but it stands out sufficiently to prompt you to retrieve it as evidence.$B$BSurely someone back at the cave would be interested in this revelation.

Objectives.text: 將破損的碎片帶回洞穴。
Objectives.english: Bring the broken shard back to THE CAVE.

Description.text: 在你四周的是一場激戰的遺跡。納迦的骨骸不令人驚訝，但他們敵人的武器和遺骸卻頗出人意料之外。$B$B在骨骸之間，你看見一個相當顯眼的金屬碎片從其中一顆頭骨上露了出來。很難說那曾是哪類型武器的一部分，但也足以吸引你將它取走當作證據。$B$B想必在洞穴那邊會有人對這項意外的發現很有興趣。
Description.english: All around you lie the remnants of a fierce battle. The naga skeletons are no surprise, but the weapons and remains of their apparent opponents are somewhat more unexpected.$B$BAmidst the bones, you spot a strangely prominent piece of metal jutting out from one of the skulls. It's difficult to tell what sort of weapon it might have once been part of, but it stands out sufficiently to prompt you to retrieve it as evidence.$B$BSurely someone back at the cave would be interested in this revelation.

identity.title: Curious Distraction
identity.objectives: Transcribe the 4 Highborne Tablets.
identity.description: Hah! Did you see the Admiral giving me dirty looks and decide to throw some sympathy my way? I've pretty much lost hope of making him understand that these ruins offers us some opportunity to salvage some usefulness out of this whole  mess.$B$BI'd actually hoped that you might turn up again - you seem like the only one I can rely on. I've seen a few tablets like this one spread about the nearby ruins and I put together a rubbing kit for transcribing them. Up to the task?

Objectives.text: 誊抄4块上层精灵石板。
Objectives.english: Transcribe the 4 Highborne Tablets.

Description.text: 哈！你看到没有，将军瞪了我一眼，满是同情和不屑。我这下丧失信心了，要让他明白这些废墟是我们挽救有用信息的最后机会——是不可能的。$B$B事实上我希望你能重振旗鼓——你看来是我唯一可以依赖的人了。我见到过许多像这样的石板散落在附近的废墟里，我还准备了一套拓印包准备誊抄。你能帮忙吗？
Description.english: Hah! Did you see the Admiral giving me dirty looks and decide to throw some sympathy my way? I've pretty much lost hope of making him understand that these ruins offers us some opportunity to salvage some usefulness out of this whole  mess.$B$BI'd actually hoped that you might turn up again - you seem like the only one I can rely on. I've seen a few tablets like this one spread about the nearby ruins and I put together a rubbing kit for transcribing them. Up to the task?

CompletionLog.text: 去找瓦丝琪尔废墟南部平台下的波涛语者瓦罗伦。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Levia Dreamwaker under the southern terrace in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

identity.title: Hammering It Out
identity.objectives: Take the Mysterious Device to Orgrimmar, Undercity, Silvermoon City or Thunder Bluff and show it to an Earthen Ring Representative.
identity.description: The rift that was here left behind this strange device, but why?$B$BSomeone in a capital city may have more information.

Objectives.text: 將這件神秘的裝置帶到奧格瑪、幽暗城、銀月城或是雷霆崖，給陶土議會代表看看。
Objectives.english: Take the Mysterious Device to Orgrimmar, Undercity, Silvermoon City or Thunder Bluff and show it to an Earthen Ring Representative.

Description.text: 之前位於這裡的裂隙留下了這個奇怪的裝置，但是為什麼?$B$B也許位在主城裡的某個人可以提供更多的資訊。
Description.english: The rift that was here left behind this strange device, but why?$B$BSomeone in a capital city may have more information.

identity.title: A Natural Occurrence
identity.objectives: Take the Elemental Shard to an Earthen Ring Emissary in Ironforge, Stormwind, Exodar or Darnassus.
identity.description: This shard is all that is left from the rift that stood here before.  The connection between the shard and the rift is unknown, but perhaps someone more versed in the elements would know more.$B$BSeek out an Earthen Ring Emissary at any capital city.  This could be exactly what they are looking for.

Objectives.text: 将元素碎片交给铁炉堡、暴风城、埃索达或达纳苏斯的大地之环使者。
Objectives.english: Take the Elemental Shard to an Earthen Ring Emissary in Ironforge, Stormwind, Exodar or Darnassus.

Description.text: 曾经出现在这里的裂隙已经消失，只剩下了这块碎片。我完全不知道这块碎片和裂隙之间有什么联系。但也许会有精通元素知识的人能告诉你更多关于它的知识。$B$B你可以去各个首都找到大地之环使者。他们应该正在搜寻这样的东西。
Description.english: This shard is all that is left from the rift that stood here before.  The connection between the shard and the rift is unknown, but perhaps someone more versed in the elements would know more.$B$BSeek out an Earthen Ring Emissary at any capital city.  This could be exactly what they are looking for.

identity.title: Hammering It Out
identity.objectives: Take the Mysterious Device to Orgrimmar, Undercity, Silvermoon City or Thunder Bluff and show it to an Earthen Ring Representative.
identity.description: The rift that was here left behind this strange device, but why?$B$BSomeone in a capital city may have more information.

Objectives.text: 将神秘的装置带到奥格瑞玛、幽暗城、银月城或雷霆崖，让那些地方的大地之环代表看看它。
Objectives.english: Take the Mysterious Device to Orgrimmar, Undercity, Silvermoon City or Thunder Bluff and show it to an Earthen Ring Representative.

Description.text: 曾经出现在这里的裂隙留下了这个奇怪的装置。这到底是怎么回事？$B$B也许都城里有人能对此有更多了解。
Description.english: The rift that was here left behind this strange device, but why?$B$BSomeone in a capital city may have more information.

identity.title: Orders from Base Camp
identity.objectives: Deliver the Orders from Base Camp to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
identity.description: Paltrow, establish a foothold in Windshear Valley. A strong ground assault is vital to our campaign! When we make our assault against Krom'gar, your men will provide the chaos and confusion that the gnome flying machines will need to get close enough to bomb the orc fortress.$B$BThe flying machines will detonate the Krom'gar bomb while it's sitting in their base, taking out the entire fortress in the process.$B$BBurn after reading.$B$B-Force Commander Valen$B$BNorthwatch Expedition Base Camp

Objectives.text: 将营地发来的命令交给石爪山脉克罗姆加壁垒的克罗姆加大王。
Objectives.english: Deliver the Orders from Base Camp to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

Description.text: 帕特劳，到风剪山谷去建立一座先头堡。强力的地面进攻对我们的战役至关重要！我们攻打克罗姆加的时候，你的人负责扰乱敌人的注意力，让侏儒飞行器得以靠近兽人壁垒进行轰炸。$B$B飞行器将引爆基地里的克罗姆加炸弹，端掉整个壁垒。$B$B阅后即焚。$B$B——北卫远征军营地$B$B部队指挥官范伦。
Description.english: Paltrow, establish a foothold in Windshear Valley. A strong ground assault is vital to our campaign! When we make our assault against Krom'gar, your men will provide the chaos and confusion that the gnome flying machines will need to get close enough to bomb the orc fortress.$B$BThe flying machines will detonate the Krom'gar bomb while it's sitting in their base, taking out the entire fortress in the process.$B$BBurn after reading.$B$B-Force Commander Valen$B$BNorthwatch Expedition Base Camp

identity.title: Here Fishie Fishie 2: Eel-Egg-Trick Boogaloo
identity.objectives: Use the Eel-splosive Device near a Devious Great-eel in Underlight Canyon, then defeat the Weakened Great-Eel.
identity.description: <Orako removes an explosive trap from his sack and shoves it through the egg's outer membrane.>$b$bThis will make the egg explode.  Place the egg down next to one of those giant eels, and wait for them to come close.  When the egg explodes, the big fish will be almost dead, and you can finish killing it.$b$bSave my wolf!  With this egg, you can do it.

Title.text: 鱼儿鱼儿看过来2：鳗鱼卵大爆炸

Objectives.text: 在光渊海峡的扭曲的巨海鳗附近使用鳗鱼爆破装置，然后击败被削弱的巨鳗。
Objectives.english: Use the Eel-splosive Device near a Devious Great-eel in Underlight Canyon, then defeat the Weakened Great-Eel.

Description.text: <欧纳柯从包里掏出一套爆炸陷阱来，把它附在了鱼卵外面。>$b$b这样就可以使鱼卵爆炸了。把这枚卵放在某条巨海鳗旁边，然后等它们靠近。一旦鱼卵爆炸，巨海鳗多半会被炸得奄奄一息，然后你就过去杀了它。$b$b救救我的狼！有这枚鱼卵在手，你一定行的。
Description.english: <Orako removes an explosive trap from his sack and shoves it through the egg's outer membrane.>$b$bThis will make the egg explode.  Place the egg down next to one of those giant eels, and wait for them to come close.  When the egg explodes, the big fish will be almost dead, and you can finish killing it.$b$bSave my wolf!  With this egg, you can do it.

identity.title: Land Ho!
identity.objectives: Talk to Captain O'Breen at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.
identity.description: Lolo sees a tiny $r! Always on the lookout, Lolo is!$b$bWelcome to Faldir's Cove.  Captain O'Breen said we'd only be here for a few hours.  Just long enough to gather the treasure and get back to Booty Bay.$b$bBut Lolo thinks we're going to be here a lot longer than that.  We lost the other two ships from our formation.  Poor Spirit of Silverpine and Maiden's Folly.  On the bottom of the sea they rest now!$b$bLolo suggests you talk to Captain O'Breen if you plan on sticking around here.

Objectives.text: 跟阿拉希高地法迪尔海湾的奥布里船长谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Talk to Captain O'Breen at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.

Description.text: 鲁鲁看见了一个小$r！鲁鲁总是待在哨所上！$b$b欢迎来到法迪尔海湾。奥布里船长说过，我们在这里待不了多久。我们只要搜集宝藏然后返回藏宝海湾就行了。$b$b但是鲁鲁认为我们要在这儿待很长很长的时间，我们失去了两艘船。可怜的银松之魂号和处女号！她们长眠在海底！$b$b鲁鲁说，如果你想在这逗留的话，就去和奥布里船长谈谈吧。
Description.english: Lolo sees a tiny $r! Always on the lookout, Lolo is!$b$bWelcome to Faldir's Cove.  Captain O'Breen said we'd only be here for a few hours.  Just long enough to gather the treasure and get back to Booty Bay.$b$bBut Lolo thinks we're going to be here a lot longer than that.  We lost the other two ships from our formation.  Poor Spirit of Silverpine and Maiden's Folly.  On the bottom of the sea they rest now!$b$bLolo suggests you talk to Captain O'Breen if you plan on sticking around here.

identity.title: Claim Korthun's End
identity.objectives: Kill 7 Hellscream Seadogs in Korthun's End.
identity.description: You are seeink spies up above?  This is not good... not good at all, comrade.$b$bReturn to Korthun's End and destroy them, my friend.

Objectives.text: 在库图恩之末杀死7名地狱咆哮水兵。
Objectives.english: Kill 7 Hellscream Seadogs in Korthun's End.

Description.text: 你在上面看到了间谍？这可真不妙……非常糟糕，同志。$B$B回到库图恩之末去干掉他们吧，我的朋友。
Description.english: You are seeink spies up above?  This is not good... not good at all, comrade.$b$bReturn to Korthun's End and destroy them, my friend.

identity.title: When in Vashj'ir...
identity.objectives: Use the Seahorse Lasso near the kelp atop the pillars in Seabrush to capture 5 Panicked Seahorses.
identity.description: Welcome, friend!$b$bReinforcements have arrived, and they've brought food, orcs, and fresh mounts.  Wait a minute... mounts?!$b$bHow are we supposed to get around underwater on WOLFBACK?!$b$b<Captain Verne sighs.>$b$bDirectly above this cave, in Seabrush, you will find tall pillars with red, leafy kelp on their tops.  Seahorses hide in the kelp.  Throw this lasso into the kelp and catch us some USEFUL mounts.

Objectives.text: 在画笔海岭台柱顶端的海藻丛附近使用海马套索，捕获5只惊慌的海马。
Objectives.english: Use the Seahorse Lasso near the kelp atop the pillars in Seabrush to capture 5 Panicked Seahorses.

Description.text: 朋友，你好！$b$b援军已经到了，他们还带来了食物和坐骑。等等……坐骑？$b$b那些座狼能下水吗？！$b$b<凡尔纳船长叹了口气。>$b$b洞穴正上方就是画笔海岭，那里的高柱顶端生长着红色的海藻。海马就藏身在那些海藻丛中。抛出套索，捕获一些能派上用场的坐骑来。
Description.english: Welcome, friend!$b$bReinforcements have arrived, and they've brought food, orcs, and fresh mounts.  Wait a minute... mounts?!$b$bHow are we supposed to get around underwater on WOLFBACK?!$b$b<Captain Verne sighs.>$b$bDirectly above this cave, in Seabrush, you will find tall pillars with red, leafy kelp on their tops.  Seahorses hide in the kelp.  Throw this lasso into the kelp and catch us some USEFUL mounts.

CompletionLog.text: 去找瓦丝琪尔阴暗洞穴的凡尔纳·“珍宝”船长。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Captain "Jewels" Verne at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

identity.title: Secure Seabrush
identity.objectives: Kill 7 Alliance Sea-Scouts in Seabrush.
identity.description: You saw spies up above?  This is not good... I won't have it.$b$bReturn to Seabrush and get rid of them before they start trickling into our hideout.

Objectives.text: 在画笔海岭杀死7名联盟海军斥候。
Objectives.english: Kill 7 Alliance Sea-Scouts in Seabrush.

Description.text: 你在上面看到了间谍？这可真不妙……不能放任他们不管。$B$B回到画笔海岭去，在他们潜入我们的藏身之地前除掉他们。
Description.english: You saw spies up above?  This is not good... I won't have it.$b$bReturn to Seabrush and get rid of them before they start trickling into our hideout.

identity.title: Ferilon Leafborn
identity.objectives: Find Ferilon Leafborn at Greenwarden's Grove.
identity.description: There's a group of night elves that call the wetlands home now. A bunch of them shipped in from Kalimdor to study the land here, look at the plants, that sort of stuff.$B$BOne of the druids by the name of Ferilon stopped by here a while back. He was nice enough to give us a hand with some raptors, and he mentioned something about needing more folk to help out with his duties.$B$BIf you've got the time, you'll find him at the place they call Greenwarden's Grove, to the northeast.

Objectives.text: 到绿色守卫者林地去找费里隆·叶生。
Objectives.english: Find Ferilon Leafborn at Greenwarden's Grove.

Description.text: 有群暗夜精灵最近来湿地定居，一些是从卡利姆多坐船过来研究这儿的风土，瞧瞧植物什么的，就是类似的事情啦。$B$B有个叫作费里隆的德鲁伊前阵子来这儿待下了。人还不错，帮我们处理了迅猛龙的事儿，他提到过想要人帮忙。$B$B要是你有空，可以去东北边他们叫做绿色守卫者林地的地方找他。
Description.english: There's a group of night elves that call the wetlands home now. A bunch of them shipped in from Kalimdor to study the land here, look at the plants, that sort of stuff.$B$BOne of the druids by the name of Ferilon stopped by here a while back. He was nice enough to give us a hand with some raptors, and he mentioned something about needing more folk to help out with his duties.$B$BIf you've got the time, you'll find him at the place they call Greenwarden's Grove, to the northeast.

identity.title: Dark Letter
identity.objectives: Read the Dark Letter and speak to Drusilla La Salle at the graveyard in Northshire Valley.
identity.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of the void - no doubt a message from our local warlock trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

Objectives.text: 阅读这封黑色信件，然后与北郡山谷墓地中的杜希拉·拉萨雷交谈。
Objectives.english: Read the Dark Letter and speak to Drusilla La Salle at the graveyard in Northshire Valley.

Description.text: 有人把这封信交给我，说是等你从狗头人营地回来之后立即交给你，$n。信封上盖着虚空的印记——肯定是这里的术士训练师写给你的。如果我是你的话肯定会毫不犹豫的先看看这信里写了些什么。
Description.english: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of the void - no doubt a message from our local warlock trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

identity.title: Planning for the Future
identity.objectives: Collect 12 Snowfall Glade Pups. Deliver them to Trapper Mau'i at Moa'ki Harbor.
identity.description: We must move decisively against the wolvar if we're to have a chance of survival. However, I worry that in our zeal, too many of them will be slain.$B$BThe Snowfall Glade wolvar have as much right to exist as do we. You and I will see to it that they get that chance.$B$BIf Elder Ko'nani hasn't asked you already, he will ask you to deal with them.  While you're upon the glade to the north, I'd like you to bag up their pups and bring them back to me.

Objectives.text: 收集12只飘雪林地幼崽，把它们交给莫亚基港口的猎手莫伊。
Objectives.english: Collect 12 Snowfall Glade Pups. Deliver them to Trapper Mau'i at Moa'ki Harbor.

Description.text: 如果我们想活下来，就必须对狼獾人采取果断的措施。但是，我担心在这种狂热的气氛下，我们会杀死太多的狼獾人。$B$B别忘了飘雪林地狼獾人和我们一样，同样拥有生存的权利。咱们必须想办法保护它们的生存权利。$B$B长者库纳尼早晚会要求你除掉它们的。当你前往北边的林地时，我希望你将它们的幼崽装到包里带回来给我。
Description.english: We must move decisively against the wolvar if we're to have a chance of survival. However, I worry that in our zeal, too many of them will be slain.$B$BThe Snowfall Glade wolvar have as much right to exist as do we. You and I will see to it that they get that chance.$B$BIf Elder Ko'nani hasn't asked you already, he will ask you to deal with them.  While you're upon the glade to the north, I'd like you to bag up their pups and bring them back to me.

CompletionLog.text: 回龙骨荒野找莫亚基港口的猎手莫伊。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Trapper Mau'i at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

identity.title: The Arts of a Mage
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Once you've learned the spell, successfully cast it twice at a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown.
identity.description:
As you go on wild adventures and grow your power, you'll start to develop new connections to the arcane, granting you new spells.

You'll see. Go do it! Show me what you learn! I'll be here.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冰霜新星。一旦你学会该技能，去对新工匠镇的训练假人成功施放2次冰霜新星。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Once you've learned the spell, successfully cast it twice at a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown.

Description.text:
随着你的野外经历和实力的不断增加，你与奥术之间的联系也在不断加强，由此你可以习得新法术。

等着瞧吧。快去吧！回头给我露两手瞧瞧！我就在这。
Description.english:
As you go on wild adventures and grow your power, you'll start to develop new connections to the arcane, granting you new spells.

You'll see. Go do it! Show me what you learn! I'll be here.

CompletionLog.text: 去找新工匠镇的贝西·冰雹。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Bipsi Frostflinger in New Tinkertown.

identity.title: The Arts of a Priest
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Use it 5 times on training dummies in New Tinkertown.
identity.description: You know, as you go out into this crazy world and get more powerful, you'll also start to discover new powers that you didn't know before.$B$BWhy don't you go out, get some more experience, and then come back and show me what you've learned!

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习暗言术：痛。然后对新工匠镇的训练假人使用5次暗言术：痛。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Use it 5 times on training dummies in New Tinkertown.

Description.text: 知道吗，当你深入那个疯狂的世界并变得越来越强时，你会开始发现之前闻所未闻的新力量。$B$B你为什么不出去跑跑，多积累些经验呢。然后回来给我露两手，让我瞧瞧你都学到了些什么！
Description.english: You know, as you go out into this crazy world and get more powerful, you'll also start to discover new powers that you didn't know before.$B$BWhy don't you go out, get some more experience, and then come back and show me what you've learned!

CompletionLog.text: 去找新工匠镇的“怪医”克斯宾。
CompletionLog.english: Return to "Doc" Cogspin in New Tinkertown.

identity.title: The Power of a Warlock
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption, then cast it on a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown 5 times.
identity.description:
I'm not at all surprised that a warlock like you fought your way out of Gnomeregan. Few people, even among the gnomes, truly understand the nature of the power we wield.

As you become more powerful, you're going to start hearing the fel voices revealing their secrets to you, teaching you new spells.

I want you to go get some more experience. Once you learn something new, show me.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习腐蚀术。然后对新工匠镇的训练假人施放5次腐蚀术。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption, then cast it on a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown 5 times.

Description.text:
像你这样的术士可以一路杀出诺莫瑞根，这一点我并不惊讶。很少有人，即便在侏儒群体中，可以理解我们所驾驭的力量有多么强大。

等你变得越来越厉害时，你会开始听到邪恶力量向你揭示他们的秘密，传授你新的法术。

我要你去积累更多的经验。一旦你学有所成后，回来展示给我看。
Description.english:
I'm not at all surprised that a warlock like you fought your way out of Gnomeregan. Few people, even among the gnomes, truly understand the nature of the power we wield.

As you become more powerful, you're going to start hearing the fel voices revealing their secrets to you, teaching you new spells.

I want you to go get some more experience. Once you learn something new, show me.

CompletionLog.text: 回新工匠镇找阿拉玛尔·格里姆。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Alamar Grimm in New Tinkertown.

identity.title: The Arts of a Warrior
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Locate a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown and use Charge on it.
identity.description: Learning is the best way to improve. As you learn more, you'll start to discover you can do things you never realized!$B$BGo, get some more experience, and learn a new technique. Then, come back and demonstrate it on a training dummy.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冲锋。然后对新工匠镇的一个训练假人进行冲锋。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Locate a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown and use Charge on it.

Description.text: 学习是最好的自我提升之道。在你学得越来越多时，你会开始发现你能做些意想不到的事情来！$B$B去吧，多积累些经验，学会一个新技巧。然后回来找一个训练假人来练练手。
Description.english: Learning is the best way to improve. As you learn more, you'll start to discover you can do things you never realized!$B$BGo, get some more experience, and learn a new technique. Then, come back and demonstrate it on a training dummy.

CompletionLog.text: 去找新工匠镇的教官汽轴。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Drill Sergeant Steamcrank in New Tinkertown.

identity.title: The Arts of a Rogue
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Eviscerate, then find a training dummy in New Tinkertown and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.
identity.description:
As you learn more and become a better rogue, you'll start to learn new abilities.$B$BOne of the most potent ones is to chain together moves in a combination, exploiting your enemy's weakness and opening up the opportunity to use stronger maneuvers.

Go, get some more experience and figure out how to do it. Once you can, come back here and try it out.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习刺骨。然后对新工匠镇的训练假人使用3次刺骨。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Eviscerate, then find a training dummy in New Tinkertown and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.

Description.text:
在你学得越来越多，并成长为一个更优秀的潜行者时，你会开始领悟新的技能。$B$B其中最强大的能力之一，就是可以将攻击招式组合起来，使敌人的弱点暴露无余，为你提供使用更强大的杀招的机会。

去吧，多积累些经验，搞清楚该如何做到。一旦你学成了，就回来露两手试试看。
Description.english:
As you learn more and become a better rogue, you'll start to learn new abilities.$B$BOne of the most potent ones is to chain together moves in a combination, exploiting your enemy's weakness and opening up the opportunity to use stronger maneuvers.

Go, get some more experience and figure out how to do it. Once you can, come back here and try it out.

identity.title: The World Pillar
identity.objectives: Ask Maruut Stonebinder about the World Pillar.
identity.description: The pillar in this room holds up more than just the Temple of Earth.$B$BThis entire plane of existence will soon collapse into our world if we fail to restore it.$B$BThe time to act will come soon, $n.  But first you must listen to what I have to tell you.

Objectives.text: 向玛鲁特·缚石询问关于世界之柱的事情。
Objectives.english: Ask Maruut Stonebinder about the World Pillar.

Description.text: 这间屋子里的柱子支撑的不仅仅是大地神殿。$B$B如果我们没能将它恢复原样，这整个位面都将塌陷到我们的世界里来。$B$B行动的时候就要到了，$n。但首先我有些事情必须要告诉你，你得听好。
Description.english: The pillar in this room holds up more than just the Temple of Earth.$B$BThis entire plane of existence will soon collapse into our world if we fail to restore it.$B$BThe time to act will come soon, $n.  But first you must listen to what I have to tell you.

identity.title: The Arts of a Warlock
identity.objectives: Reach Level 3 to Learn Corruption. Practice using Corruption 5 times against a Tiki Target.
identity.description: I tink I have something I should let ya know.$B$BAs ya' get more powahful, yo' gonna staht hearin' da voices - teachin' you new tings, new spells.$B$BGo, get some more experience, 'den come back an show me what ya learned.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习腐蚀术。然后对一个蒂基面具假人使用5次腐蚀术。
Objectives.english: Reach Level 3 to Learn Corruption. Practice using Corruption 5 times against a Tiki Target.

Description.text: 我有一些事情想要告诉你。$B$B当你变得越来越强时，你会开始听到一些声音——传授你新法术。$B$B去吧，多积累些经验。然后回来给我露两手，让我瞧瞧你都学到了些什么。
Description.english: I tink I have something I should let ya know.$B$BAs ya' get more powahful, yo' gonna staht hearin' da voices - teachin' you new tings, new spells.$B$BGo, get some more experience, 'den come back an show me what ya learned.

CompletionLog.text: 去回音群岛的暗矛训练场找沃德雷卡。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Voldreka at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

identity.title: In Aid of the Refugees
identity.objectives: Sentinel Lendra at Lor'danel wants you to speak to Priestess Alinya at the Refugee Camp.
identity.description: You're come to help, I hope? You have no idea what I'm talking about, do you...$B$BI don't have time to fill you in on all of the details, but we had a town in Darkshore, Auberdine, that took some of the worst of the Cataclysm. We're in the process of rescuing some of the survivors, but I need someone with a bit more experience--someone like you--to check in on a refugee camp that we heard about in the south.$B$BLeave things to us up north. Head straight down there and help the refugees however you can.

Objectives.text: 洛达内尔的哨兵兰德拉要你跟难民营的女祭司艾琳雅谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Sentinel Lendra at Lor'danel wants you to speak to Priestess Alinya at the Refugee Camp.

Description.text: 我想，你是来帮忙的？你不知道我在说什么，是吧……$B$B我没时间给你详述细节了，我们在黑海岸有个镇子，奥伯丁，大灾变时遭受的破坏最严重。我们正在着手营救幸存者，听说南边还有一个难民营，我需要一些更有经验的人——比如你——去看一看。$B$B把北方的事情交给我们吧，直接去那儿，尽可能地帮助那些难民。
