Description.english: You're come to help, I hope? You have no idea what I'm talking about, do you...$B$BI don't have time to fill you in on all of the details, but we had a town in Darkshore, Auberdine, that took some of the worst of the Cataclysm. We're in the process of rescuing some of the survivors, but I need someone with a bit more experience--someone like you--to check in on a refugee camp that we heard about in the south.$B$BLeave things to us up north. Head straight down there and help the refugees however you can.

identity.title: Walk With The Earth Mother
identity.objectives: Take the Mark of Bloodhoof to High Overlord Saurfang, located in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.$B$BYou may speak with Tal the Wind Rider Master to travel there, or wait for the zeppelin.
identity.description: You have fought bravely alongside me, $n, and done much for my people. If every $r could be as noble, the future of the Horde might not disturb me so much.$B$BI would ask you to ease my worries further. Go to Orgrimmar. Tell High Overlord Saurfang how the Grimtotem were driven out. Let him know our pride and discipline, our strength and sorrow.$B$BTal at the Skytower will send you on your way. Go in peace, friend.

Objectives.text: 把血蹄的印记带到奥格瑞玛，交给格罗玛什要塞里的萨鲁法尔大王。$B$B你可以跟双足飞龙管理员塔尔交谈飞到那里，也可以等飞艇。
Objectives.english: Take the Mark of Bloodhoof to High Overlord Saurfang, located in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.$B$BYou may speak with Tal the Wind Rider Master to travel there, or wait for the zeppelin.

Description.text: 你英勇地与我并肩作战，$n，还为我的人民做了不少事。如果每个$r都和你一样高尚，我就不用如此担忧部落的未来了。$B$B我想请你进一步减轻我的烦恼。到奥格瑞玛去，告诉萨鲁法尔大王，恐怖图腾是如何被赶出去的。让他知道我们的骄傲和纪律，我们的力量和悲哀。$B$B天空塔的塔尔会送你上路。一路平安，朋友。
Description.english: You have fought bravely alongside me, $n, and done much for my people. If every $r could be as noble, the future of the Horde might not disturb me so much.$B$BI would ask you to ease my worries further. Go to Orgrimmar. Tell High Overlord Saurfang how the Grimtotem were driven out. Let him know our pride and discipline, our strength and sorrow.$B$BTal at the Skytower will send you on your way. Go in peace, friend.

identity.title: The Mosh'Ogg Bounty
identity.objectives: Obtain the Mosh'Ogg Bounty from the ruins behind the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound.
identity.description: Say... have you heard about the ogres?  I got a hot tip from some fella' named Mok'thardin that they're hiding some special, magical artifact in their cave.  Skeezy knows better, though.  I can smell money from a Mulgore mile away, and I'll bet that ogre doodad's worth a fortune.$b$bHere's a hint: I've seen them guarding a chest up in some ruins behind their mound.  Care to fetch it for me?

Objectives.text: 从莫什奥格食人魔山后的废墟里获得莫什奥格的馈赠。
Objectives.english: Obtain the Mosh'Ogg Bounty from the ruins behind the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound.

Description.text: 喂……听说过食人魔的事吗？我从一个叫摩克萨尔丁的家伙那儿得到内部消息，他们在洞里藏了件特别的魔法神器。不过，斯奇兹知道得更详细。我隔着莫高雷都能闻到钱味，我打赌食人魔那单货准能值一大笔钱。$b$b给你个提示：我看见他们在山后面的废墟里守着一口箱子。想不想去帮我拿过来啊？
Description.english: Say... have you heard about the ogres?  I got a hot tip from some fella' named Mok'thardin that they're hiding some special, magical artifact in their cave.  Skeezy knows better, though.  I can smell money from a Mulgore mile away, and I'll bet that ogre doodad's worth a fortune.$b$bHere's a hint: I've seen them guarding a chest up in some ruins behind their mound.  Care to fetch it for me?

CompletionLog.text: 去找北荆棘谷邦巴拉的斯奇兹·维尔扎普。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Skeezy Whillzap at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

identity.title: Researching the Corruption
identity.objectives: Relwyn Shadestar at the Blackfathom Camp wants 8 Corrupt Brain stems.
identity.description: Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of Kalimdor?$b$bI fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. Azeroth cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters.$b$bI wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the sin'dorei are headed toward. In Blackfathom Deeps, just to the west, you will find both satyr and naga.

Objectives.text: 黑澗營地裡的芮爾溫·影星想要8份墮落者的腦幹。
Objectives.english: Relwyn Shadestar at the Blackfathom Camp wants 8 Corrupt Brain stems.

Description.text: 這些被惡魔魔法給控制住的愚蠢血精靈。他們沒見到在卡林多的納迦和薩特們身上發生了什麼事嗎?$b$b我害怕血精靈們將會遭遇到同樣的變形命運。艾澤拉斯承受不了另外一支邪惡怪物種族的誕生。$b$b我希望學習納迦與薩特的腦幹組織，這樣我就能推斷出辛多雷正在步向什麼樣的命運。就在此地西邊的黑澗深淵，你可以同時找到薩特和納迦。
Description.english: Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of Kalimdor?$b$bI fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. Azeroth cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters.$b$bI wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the sin'dorei are headed toward. In Blackfathom Deeps, just to the west, you will find both satyr and naga.

identity.title: It's You!!
identity.objectives: Obtain 6 Akiris Reeds from Naga Explorers.
identity.description: Yes, can I help...$b$b<Sassy's jaw drops to the floor.>$b$b$n!  Is it really you?!  Look how big and strong you've gotten!  Let me feel that bicep!$b$bMe?  I've been trying to make my gold here in the jungle.  We're mainly in resource acquisition, but we also do tourism.$b$bI know, genius, right?$b$bHey, listen.  I was thinking... the naga explorers to the south carry Akiris reeds, which we could sell, and use to stuff visitor mattresses.  You interested in killing some naga?  It'll be just like old times!

Objectives.text: 从纳迦探险者身上获得6捆海蛇草。
Objectives.english: Obtain 6 Akiris Reeds from Naga Explorers.

Description.text: 是的，我能帮你什……$b$b<莎希的下巴都掉到地板上了。>$b$b$n!真的是你吗？看你变得多高多壮？！让我摸摸这二头肌！$b$b我吗？我一直尝试在丛林里寻财路。我们主要从事资源采取，但也做些旅游生意。$b$b我知道，很天才，不是吗？$b$b嘿，听着。我在想……南边那些纳迦探险者带着的海蛇草，我们能卖啊，还能给游客们塞褥子。你有兴趣杀几只纳迦吗？就像以前那样！
Description.english: Yes, can I help...$b$b<Sassy's jaw drops to the floor.>$b$b$n!  Is it really you?!  Look how big and strong you've gotten!  Let me feel that bicep!$b$bMe?  I've been trying to make my gold here in the jungle.  We're mainly in resource acquisition, but we also do tourism.$b$bI know, genius, right?$b$bHey, listen.  I was thinking... the naga explorers to the south carry Akiris reeds, which we could sell, and use to stuff visitor mattresses.  You interested in killing some naga?  It'll be just like old times!

identity.title: Faces of Evil
identity.objectives: Use the Tiki Torch to set fire to 8 Tiki Masks at Jintha'Alor.
identity.description: The Vilebranch have hung their tiki masks all across the walls of Jintha'Alor. The spirits not gonna be watchin' over them much longer.$B$BTake this torch with ya as ya fight through the Vilebranch, $c. Set fire to their tiki masks. I'll be watchin' from here as their wards and hexes fade away, an' their heretical dark voodoo goes up in smoke.

Objectives.text: 在辛萨罗用蒂基之炬点燃8张蒂基面具。
Objectives.english: Use the Tiki Torch to set fire to 8 Tiki Masks at Jintha'Alor.

Description.text: 邪枝巨魔在辛萨罗的墙上到处挂着蒂基面具。神灵已经看不下去了。$B$B带上这把火炬，杀到邪枝中去，$c。点燃他们的蒂基面具。我会在这儿看着他们的结界和妖术消失，看着他们异端的黑巫毒飘散在烟雾中。
Description.english: The Vilebranch have hung their tiki masks all across the walls of Jintha'Alor. The spirits not gonna be watchin' over them much longer.$B$BTake this torch with ya as ya fight through the Vilebranch, $c. Set fire to their tiki masks. I'll be watchin' from here as their wards and hexes fade away, an' their heretical dark voodoo goes up in smoke.

CompletionLog.text: 去找辛特兰辛萨罗的科图卡。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kotonga at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

identity.title: A Furious Catch (REMOVED)
identity.objectives: Catch a Furious Pike in the Southfury River.  The Southfury River can be found just outside Orgrimmar's western gate. Return to Razgar in the Valley of Honor once you are done.
identity.description: Are you up for a challenge, $n?  Good, I was hoping you would be.  The southfury river flows just west of Orgrimmar and your challenge can be found within it's mighty flow.$b$bWe are looking for a furious pike.  This mighty fish used to be prevalent in these areas but ever since the floods hit, they have been much harder to find.  Head out to the river and let's see just how good of an angler you really are.

Objectives.text: 在怒水河中釣取一隻狂暴狗魚。怒水河就在奧格瑪西門的外面。一旦完成這項任務，回去榮譽谷找拉茲嘎爾。
Objectives.english: Catch a Furious Pike in the Southfury River.  The Southfury River can be found just outside Orgrimmar's western gate. Return to Razgar in the Valley of Honor once you are done.

Description.text: 你想接受些挑戰嗎，$n?很好，我就希望你願意。怒水河就在奧格瑪的西邊奔流，而你在那強大的水流中可以找到挑戰的對象。$b$b我們在找一個狂暴的狗魚。這種強大的魚類過去在這區域中很普遍，但在洪水襲擊之後，這種大型的魚類就很難找到了。前往那條河流，看看你究竟是多好的釣手。
Description.english: Are you up for a challenge, $n?  Good, I was hoping you would be.  The southfury river flows just west of Orgrimmar and your challenge can be found within it's mighty flow.$b$bWe are looking for a furious pike.  This mighty fish used to be prevalent in these areas but ever since the floods hit, they have been much harder to find.  Head out to the river and let's see just how good of an angler you really are.

identity.title: REUSE - BREADCRUMB
identity.objectives: Bring the Mistmantle Family Ring to Madame Eva.
identity.description: This can't be. My brother was strong-willed, but such vileness... such sickness and violent, bloody evil...$B$B<Tobias brings a hand to his face, averting his gaze.>I must have answers. I need to know how I got that letter. I need to know if Stalvan really did this.$B$BI need to know why...$B$BTake my ring, $n. Bring it to Madame Eva. That woman is a follower of old arts and makes no secret of it... call it madness, but I'll try anything at this point.

Objectives.text: 将密斯特曼托家族戒指交给伊瓦夫人。
Objectives.english: Bring the Mistmantle Family Ring to Madame Eva.

Description.text: 这不可能。我的兄弟意志坚强，可如此邪恶……如此病态和暴力，血腥的邪恶……$B$B<托比亚斯用手捂着脸，避开了他的目光。>$B$B我必须找到答案。我需要知道那封信是怎么寄到我手上的。我需要知道斯塔文是不是真的这么做了。$B$B我需要知道为什么……$B$B把我的戒指拿去，$n。将它交给伊瓦夫人。那个女人对古物十分在行，什么都明白……是很疯狂，但事到如今我什么都得试试。
Description.english: This can't be. My brother was strong-willed, but such vileness... such sickness and violent, bloody evil...$B$B<Tobias brings a hand to his face, averting his gaze.>I must have answers. I need to know how I got that letter. I need to know if Stalvan really did this.$B$BI need to know why...$B$BTake my ring, $n. Bring it to Madame Eva. That woman is a follower of old arts and makes no secret of it... call it madness, but I'll try anything at this point.

identity.title: The Value of Trust
identity.description: The troubles of this world seem to never fade. They shift, change, and reform, but they are ever-present.$B$BThe wind brought us whispers of a traitor in our midst. We sent one of our best sentinels to investigate, and now she has turned up dead. I did her disservice in assuming that the traitor would not be aware of our movements... I was brash, and she paid for my folly.$B$BI need a new face to pick up the trail. Someone the people of the city won't know. This is a dangerous request. Will you help me?

Description.text: 这个世界的麻烦似乎永不消退。它们不断变化、改变、重生，但永续长存。$B$B风声给我们带来了一个叛徒的低语，此人就在我们中间。我们派了一名最好的哨兵去进行调查，而现在她死了。我以为叛徒不知道我们的行动，却因此害了她……我过于轻率，而她为我的愚昧付出了代价。$B$B我需要一个新面孔来继承她的遗志。一个城里的人所不认识的面孔。这是一个危险的任务。你愿意帮助我吗？
Description.english: The troubles of this world seem to never fade. They shift, change, and reform, but they are ever-present.$B$BThe wind brought us whispers of a traitor in our midst. We sent one of our best sentinels to investigate, and now she has turned up dead. I did her disservice in assuming that the traitor would not be aware of our movements... I was brash, and she paid for my folly.$B$BI need a new face to pick up the trail. Someone the people of the city won't know. This is a dangerous request. Will you help me?

identity.title: Malfurion Stormrage
identity.objectives: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
identity.description: I've spoken to Malfurion of your coming. He seemed very interested in meeting you himself.$B$BYou should go to him in the Temple of the Moon. You'll find him standing beside our beloved Tyrande Whisperwind, where he's remained diligently ever since his return.$B$BI must warn you... Malfurion has his reservations. You may be carrying a great burden for your people by being the one to meet with him.

Objectives.text: 跟达纳苏斯月神殿的玛法里奥·怒风谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

Description.text: 我向玛法里奥提起过你要来。他似乎非常想要亲自见你。$B$B你应该去月神殿找他。他就站在我们敬爱的泰兰德·语风身边，他归来之后就一直在这个位置上尽职尽责。$B$B我必须提醒你……玛法里奥有他自己的保留意见。你作为你们人民的代表，跟他会晤可谓责任重大。
Description.english: I've spoken to Malfurion of your coming. He seemed very interested in meeting you himself.$B$BYou should go to him in the Temple of the Moon. You'll find him standing beside our beloved Tyrande Whisperwind, where he's remained diligently ever since his return.$B$BI must warn you... Malfurion has his reservations. You may be carrying a great burden for your people by being the one to meet with him.

identity.title: Nessa Shadowsong
identity.objectives: Speak with Nessa Shadowsong.
identity.description: A friend of mine, Nessa Shadowsong, is a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village.  She needs a parcel taken to Darkshore, and is looking for someone to help her.$B$BIf you're interested, then to reach Nessa you must take the portal in Darnassus to Rut'theran Village.  You will find the portal west of the Temple Gardens.

Objectives.text: 和奈莎·影歌說話。
Objectives.english: Speak with Nessa Shadowsong.

Description.text: 我的一個朋友，奈莎·影歌，是魯瑟蘭村裡的漁獲商人。她需要將一箱包裹送到黑海岸，所以正在找人幫助她。$B$B如果你有興趣，那你必須經過位於達納蘇斯的傳送門才能前往魯瑟蘭村並連絡到奈莎。你會在神殿花園的西邊找到那座傳送門。
Description.english: A friend of mine, Nessa Shadowsong, is a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village.  She needs a parcel taken to Darkshore, and is looking for someone to help her.$B$BIf you're interested, then to reach Nessa you must take the portal in Darnassus to Rut'theran Village.  You will find the portal west of the Temple Gardens.

identity.title: The Bounty of Teldrassil
identity.objectives: Bring Nessa's Collection to Vesprystus.
identity.description: The fishermen of Rut'theran village do very well, for the fish here are extremely large and abundant.  I would like to compare the bounty here with that of the mainland.$B$BI have a collection of fish bones and scales that I would like taken to a colleague of mine in Darkshore.  His name is Laird, he is a fish vendor in the village of Auberdine.$B$BBring my collection to our hippogryph master, Vesprystus, and speak to him about traveling to Auberdine.

Objectives.text: 帶著奈莎的收集品去找維斯派塔斯。
Objectives.english: Bring Nessa's Collection to Vesprystus.

Description.text: 魯瑟蘭村的漁人生活得很好，因為這裡的魚極大又極多。我想把這裡的收穫拿去和主大陸的收穫做比較。$b$b我收集了一些魚骨和魚鱗，想送去給我在黑海岸的一位同事。他的名字叫賴爾德，是奧伯丁裡的漁販。$B$B把我的收集品送去給我們的角鷹獸管理員維斯派塔斯，並和他討論前往奧伯丁的事情。
Description.english: The fishermen of Rut'theran village do very well, for the fish here are extremely large and abundant.  I would like to compare the bounty here with that of the mainland.$B$BI have a collection of fish bones and scales that I would like taken to a colleague of mine in Darkshore.  His name is Laird, he is a fish vendor in the village of Auberdine.$B$BBring my collection to our hippogryph master, Vesprystus, and speak to him about traveling to Auberdine.

identity.title: Flight to Auberdine
identity.objectives: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.
identity.description: From Rut'theran, there are two methods of travel to Auberdine: by ferry and by hippogryph.  Both are quick and reliable, but if you have not yet flown to Auberdine by hippogryph, then I suggest you do.$B$BIt is sound advice to speak with the hippogryph master in every town that has one.  Once you speak to the master, you can then fly there from other towns.$B$BHere is Nessa's collection.  Speak with me again when you are ready to fly to Auberdine and deliver Nessa's collection to Laird.

Objectives.text: 在角鷹獸管理員維斯派塔斯那裡乘坐角鷹獸前往奧伯丁，然後將奈莎的收集品帶去給賴爾德。
Objectives.english: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.

Description.text: 從魯瑟蘭出發，有兩種方法能前往奧伯丁:渡船和角鷹獸。兩種都十分快速而可靠，但如果你還不曾利用角鷹獸飛去奧伯丁，我建議你先這樣做。$B$B最好在每個擁有角鷹獸管理員的城鎮裡和每一位管理員說話。只要和管理員說過話，你就能從另一座城鎮飛回那邊。$B$B這就是奈莎的收集品。在你準備好時再次跟我說話，以飛到奧伯丁將奈莎的收集品帶給賴爾德。
Description.english: From Rut'theran, there are two methods of travel to Auberdine: by ferry and by hippogryph.  Both are quick and reliable, but if you have not yet flown to Auberdine by hippogryph, then I suggest you do.$B$BIt is sound advice to speak with the hippogryph master in every town that has one.  Once you speak to the master, you can then fly there from other towns.$B$BHere is Nessa's collection.  Speak with me again when you are ready to fly to Auberdine and deliver Nessa's collection to Laird.

identity.title: Return to Nessa
identity.objectives: Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.
identity.description: I must send a response to Nessa.  She'll be very interested to know how different the fish here are from those along Teldrassil's coastline.  We can only guess the cause, but it is my suspicion that the world tree itself is affecting the wildlife around it!$B$BPlease, take this response to Nessa.  If you wish to take a hippogryph back to Rut'theran then speak with the hippogryph master Caylais Moonfeather.  If you wish to take the ferry, then one regularly departs from the dock to the northwest.

Objectives.text: 將賴爾德的訊息帶去給奈莎·影歌。
Objectives.english: Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.

Description.text: 有些消息得讓奈莎知道才行。她一定會很有興趣知道，這裡的魚和泰達希爾海岸周邊的有多不一樣。我們只能夠猜測原因，但我懷疑是世界樹本身影響了周遭的野生動物!$B$B請你將這些訊息帶給奈莎。如果你希望乘角鷹獸回去魯瑟蘭，那就和角鷹獸管理員凱萊絲·月羽說話。如果你希望利用渡船，西北方的碼頭有個固定的航班。
Description.english: I must send a response to Nessa.  She'll be very interested to know how different the fish here are from those along Teldrassil's coastline.  We can only guess the cause, but it is my suspicion that the world tree itself is affecting the wildlife around it!$B$BPlease, take this response to Nessa.  If you wish to take a hippogryph back to Rut'theran then speak with the hippogryph master Caylais Moonfeather.  If you wish to take the ferry, then one regularly departs from the dock to the northwest.

identity.title: Figuring out how to make quests
identity.objectives: Make a breadcrumb quest.
identity.description: Whee!  You get to make a breadcrumb quest!  Now figure out what to do next.

Title.english: Figuring out how to make quests

Objectives.text: 制作一个索引任务。
Objectives.english: Make a breadcrumb quest.

Description.text: 好耶！你要学会如何制作一个索引任务！现在想想下面该做什么。
Description.english: Whee!  You get to make a breadcrumb quest!  Now figure out what to do next.

identity.title: Forbidden Sigil
identity.objectives: Speak to Rhyanda inside Aldrassil in Shadowglen.
identity.description: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our mage trainer, Rhyanda. It seems Rhyanda would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.

Objectives.text: 与幽影谷中奥达希尔里面的莱恩达交谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Rhyanda inside Aldrassil in Shadowglen.

Description.text: 这个魔符是由我们的法师训练师莱恩达派来的信使交给我的。看样子莱恩达希望你能抽空过去与她会面。你读一下魔符上说了些什么吧，读完之后把魔符交给她。
Description.english: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our mage trainer, Rhyanda. It seems Rhyanda would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.

identity.title: Enemies Below
identity.objectives: Speak with Stone Guard Kurjack.
identity.description: With all his usual grace, Warchief Garrosh has kindly requested your presence in Ragefire Chasm to help retake it from the Searing Blade. Apparently, his reinforced city isn't as impenetrable as he thought.$B$BGo speak with Stone Guard Kurjack just inside Ragefire, I'm sure he'll be glad to have competent help.

Objectives.text: 跟石头守卫库尔加克谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Stone Guard Kurjack.

Description.text: 加尔鲁什以一贯的优雅好言请你将怒焰裂谷从燃刃的手里收复过来。显然，他的城防并不如他所想得那样坚不可破。$B$B去跟怒焰里的石头守卫库尔加克谈一谈，我肯定有个强力的帮手，他会高兴的。
Description.english: With all his usual grace, Warchief Garrosh has kindly requested your presence in Ragefire Chasm to help retake it from the Searing Blade. Apparently, his reinforced city isn't as impenetrable as he thought.$B$BGo speak with Stone Guard Kurjack just inside Ragefire, I'm sure he'll be glad to have competent help.

identity.title: Awakening Naralex
identity.objectives: Speak with Muyoh.
identity.description: Now that the Fanglords are dead, speak with Muyoh. He will help you awaken Naralex and end this nightmare.

Objectives.text: 跟穆约谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Muyoh.

Description.text: 毒牙之王们已经死了，你去跟穆约谈一谈吧。他会帮你唤醒纳拉雷克斯，结束这场噩梦。
Description.english: Now that the Fanglords are dead, speak with Muyoh. He will help you awaken Naralex and end this nightmare.

identity.title: Blackfathom Villainy
identity.objectives: Get the head of Twilight Lord Kelris.
identity.description: My strength has left me. I need your help!$b$bLong ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from below and tainted the sacred moonwell.$b$bAku'Mai, a servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.$b$bThe Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.$b$bSlay Kelris and bring his head to Ashelan.

Objectives.text: 获得暮光领主克尔里斯的徽记
Objectives.english: Get the head of Twilight Lord Kelris.

Description.text: 我失去了力量，需要你的帮助！$b$b很久以前这里曾是艾露恩的宏伟神殿。但上古之神的腐化从地底加速蔓延，污染了神圣的月亮井，这里就不幸成为了废墟。$b$b上古之神的仆从阿库麦尔，从井水中复活了。$b$b暮光之锤邪教徒们同纳迦联手，占领了这些地方。一群邪教徒在暮光领主克尔里斯的带领下，把无辜的人献给阿库麦尔以求获得力量。$b$b杀掉克尔里斯，并将他的徽记交给阿舍兰。
Description.english: My strength has left me. I need your help!$b$bLong ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from below and tainted the sacred moonwell.$b$bAku'Mai, a servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.$b$bThe Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.$b$bSlay Kelris and bring his head to Ashelan.

identity.title: Blackfathom Deeps
identity.objectives: Speak with Je'neu Sancrea.
identity.description: There's a task to be done that you're perfect for, $c. We need to secure the area around Blackfathom Deeps to help with the Alliance that are threatening Zoram'gar Outpost west of here.$B$BGo to Blackfathom Deeps, north of Zoram'gar Outpost, and speak with Je'neu of the Earthen Ring. He will have plenty for you to do.

Objectives.text: 与耶努萨克雷交谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Je'neu Sancrea.

Description.text: 有一件非常适合你的差事要办，$c。我们必须占领黑暗深渊周边的区域，以对付那些威胁到西面的佐拉姆加前哨站的联盟。$B$B到佐拉姆加前哨站北边的黑暗深渊去，与大地之环的耶努萨克雷谈一谈。他肯定有很多事情要交给你去做。
Description.english: There's a task to be done that you're perfect for, $c. We need to secure the area around Blackfathom Deeps to help with the Alliance that are threatening Zoram'gar Outpost west of here.$B$BGo to Blackfathom Deeps, north of Zoram'gar Outpost, and speak with Je'neu of the Earthen Ring. He will have plenty for you to do.

identity.title: The Enemy of My Enemy
identity.objectives: Obtain the head of Twilight Lord Kelris.
identity.description: Cultists...sacrifice...power...$B$BEnemy...awaken...$B$BOld God...imprison...me...$B$BLord...Kelris...$B$BBring head...revenge...$B$BERADICATE!!!

Objectives.text: 获得暮光领主克尔里斯的徽记。
Objectives.english: Obtain the head of Twilight Lord Kelris.

Description.text: 教徒……祭祀……力量……$B$B敌人……觉醒……$B$B上古之神……禁锢……我……$B$B暮光领主克尔里斯……$B$B拿来徽记……复仇……$B$B消灭他！！！
Description.english: Cultists...sacrifice...power...$B$BEnemy...awaken...$B$BOld God...imprison...me...$B$BLord...Kelris...$B$BBring head...revenge...$B$BERADICATE!!!

identity.title: Willix the Importer
identity.objectives: Escort Willix the Importer to the exit of Razorfen Kraul.
identity.description: At last, help has arrived!$b$bYou have no clue how long I've been held prisoner here. I can't remember the last time I saw the outside of this place.$b$bYou see, I am an entrepreneur. Always out for a copper, as they say. I caught wind that pig snouts were selling outrageously high in the market. I figured it would be an easy in, easy out kind of affair. As you can see, I was a bit wrong!$b$bAnyway, if you'd be so kind as to help me get out of here, I'll make it worth your while.

Objectives.text: 护送进口商威利克斯前往剃刀沼泽入口。
Objectives.english: Escort Willix the Importer to the exit of Razorfen Kraul.

Description.text: 救援，可算到了！$b$b你根本不知道我在这里被关了多久，我都记不得上次看到外面是什么时候了。$b$b你瞧，我是一个企业家。常言道，一个铜子儿忙死英雄汉。我听到风声，猪嘴在市场上卖价高得离谱。我以为这件事情来得容易走得快。你也看出来了，我有点搞错了！$b$b总而言之，如果你能好心帮我离开这里，我不会让你白干的。
Description.english: At last, help has arrived!$b$bYou have no clue how long I've been held prisoner here. I can't remember the last time I saw the outside of this place.$b$bYou see, I am an entrepreneur. Always out for a copper, as they say. I caught wind that pig snouts were selling outrageously high in the market. I figured it would be an easy in, easy out kind of affair. As you can see, I was a bit wrong!$b$bAnyway, if you'd be so kind as to help me get out of here, I'll make it worth your while.

CompletionLog.text: 跟进口商威利克斯谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Willix the Importer.

identity.title: Corruption
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption, then cast it 5 times on a Training Dummy near the entrance to Anvilmar.
identity.description:
Few people, especially among our allies, truly understand the nature of the power we wield. They shun us for pursuing knowledge that they are too weak to use properly.$B$BAs you become more powerful, you will begin to discover new spells, further magnifying your power.

Go, get more experience, then return once you've learned a new spell. We'll see if you have it in you to truly master the dark arts.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习腐蚀术。然后对安威玛尔入口附近的训练假人施放5次腐蚀术。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption, then cast it 5 times on a Training Dummy near the entrance to Anvilmar.

Description.text:
在这些盟友中，只有极少数人能真正了解我们所驾驭的能量的本质。大多数人对我们避而不见，因为他们没有能力正确地运用这种知识。$B$B当你变得越来越厉害时，你会开始领悟新法术，使你变得更加强大。

去吧，多积累些经验，一旦学成后就回来见我。届时我们要看看你是否真正掌握了这门黑暗的艺术。
Description.english:
Few people, especially among our allies, truly understand the nature of the power we wield. They shun us for pursuing knowledge that they are too weak to use properly.$B$BAs you become more powerful, you will begin to discover new spells, further magnifying your power.

Go, get more experience, then return once you've learned a new spell. We'll see if you have it in you to truly master the dark arts.

CompletionLog.text: 去找安威玛尔的莎莉帕·石酒。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Saripal Smolderbrew at Anvilmar.

identity.title: Etched Letter
identity.objectives: Read the Etched Letter and speak to Ashley Blank in Northshire Valley.
identity.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from dealing with the Blackrock spies, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Ashley Blank, our local hunter trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

Objectives.text: 阅读风蚀的信件，然后与北郡山谷中的阿什莉·布兰克交谈。
Objectives.english: Read the Etched Letter and speak to Ashley Blank in Northshire Valley.

Description.text: 有人把这封信交给我，说是等你消灭黑石间谍之后立即交给你，$n。信封上盖着阿什莉·布兰克的印记，她是这里的猎人训练师。如果我是你的话肯定会毫不犹豫的先看看这信里写了些什么，再去做别的事情。
Description.english: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from dealing with the Blackrock spies, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Ashley Blank, our local hunter trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

identity.title: Charging into Battle
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge, then practice using Charge on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.
identity.description:
Now that you've had the chance to test your abilities in battle, it's time to explain one more reason why training is so important.$B$BAs you get more experience, you'll be able to do new techniques you never thought of.

Go, get some experience, learn a new skill, and demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冲锋。然后在北郡修道院入口处的南边找一个训练假人，对它进行冲锋。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Charge, then practice using Charge on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.

Description.text:
现在，你已经通过实战检验了自己的能力，是时候向你解释一下训练为何如此重要的另一个原因了。$B$B随着你的经验不断增长，你可以做到之前想都想不到的新技巧。

去吧，多积累些经验，学习一个新技能。然后找一个训练假人来练练手。
Description.english:
Now that you've had the chance to test your abilities in battle, it's time to explain one more reason why training is so important.$B$BAs you get more experience, you'll be able to do new techniques you never thought of.

Go, get some experience, learn a new skill, and demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

identity.title: Corruption
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn the Corruption ability, then practice casting Corruption 5 times on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.
identity.description:
We must take care in how we speak around the abbey and its environs, but don't let that deter you from the path of power.$B$BAs you become more powerful, you will begin to hear the fel voices, granting you their power in the dark arts.

Go, get more experience and learn a new spell. Once you have, practice it on the training dummies.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习腐蚀术。然后在北郡修道院入口处的南边找一个训练假人，对它使用5次腐蚀术。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn the Corruption ability, then practice casting Corruption 5 times on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.

Description.text:
在修道院周围行事，不免要谨慎一点，但是这点小问题不应该阻碍你追求力量的步伐。$B$B在你变得越来越强大时，你会开始听到邪恶力量的声音，传授你他们威力无比的黑暗法术。

去吧，多积累些经验并学习一门新法术。一旦你学会了，就找训练假人多练习练习。
Description.english:
We must take care in how we speak around the abbey and its environs, but don't let that deter you from the path of power.$B$BAs you become more powerful, you will begin to hear the fel voices, granting you their power in the dark arts.

Go, get more experience and learn a new spell. Once you have, practice it on the training dummies.

CompletionLog.text: 去找北郡修道院外的杜希拉·拉萨雷。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Drusilla La Salle outside Northshire Abbey.

identity.title: Mastering the Arcane
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova, then practice casting it 2 times on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.
identity.description:
As a mage, you will learn a variety of spells as your understanding grows. All you need to do is get some more experience, and the secrets of the arcane will reveal themselves to you.

You'll see. Go develop your powers, and show me what you learn.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冰霜新星。然后在北郡修道院入口处的南边找一个训练假人，对它使用2次冰霜新星。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova, then practice casting it 2 times on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.

Description.text:
作为一名法师，随着你对魔法的深入了解，你将学到多种多样的法术。你所要做的就是获取更多的经验，之后奥术之门便会向你打开，揭示出更多的奥秘。

等着瞧吧。去提升你的力量，然后向我展示你都学到了些什么。
Description.english:
As a mage, you will learn a variety of spells as your understanding grows. All you need to do is get some more experience, and the secrets of the arcane will reveal themselves to you.

You'll see. Go develop your powers, and show me what you learn.

CompletionLog.text: 去北郡修道院的藏书房找凯尔登·布雷门。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Khelden Bremen in the Library Wing of Northshire Abbey.

identity.title: The Hunter's Path
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot, then find a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.
identity.description: I've heard about your help in clearing out some of the orcs. You've shown that you can handle yourself in combat.$B$BAs you get more experience in combat, you'll start learning how to do new things. I want you to go, get some more experience, then try the new abilities you learn on one of the training dummies south of the entrance to the abbey.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习稳固射击。然后在北郡修道院入口处的南边找一个训练假人，对它使用5次稳固射击。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot, then find a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.

Description.text: 我听说你帮忙清理了一些兽人，看来你确实有两把刷子。$B$B当你在战斗中积累更多的经验时，你将开始学习如何掌握新技巧。我要你去积累更多的经验，然后找修道院入口处南边的训练假人来试一下你的新技能。
Description.english: I've heard about your help in clearing out some of the orcs. You've shown that you can handle yourself in combat.$B$BAs you get more experience in combat, you'll start learning how to do new things. I want you to go, get some more experience, then try the new abilities you learn on one of the training dummies south of the entrance to the abbey.

identity.title: The Power of the Light
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Seal of Command. Cast Seal of Command on yourself and then hit a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.
identity.description:
As you continue in your journey as a Paladin, you'll become closer to the light, learning new abilities.

Go, get more experience, and learn a new ability. Demonstrate it for me, and we will continue your training.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习命令圣印。对你自己施放命令圣印，然后击打北郡修道院入口处南边的一个训练假人。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Seal of Command. Cast Seal of Command on yourself and then hit a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.

Description.text:
当你作为一个圣骑士在修业之旅上奋勇前行时，你离圣光也变得越来越近，由此便可掌握新技能。

去吧，多积累些经验，学习一个新技能。然后回来向我展示一下，我们再继续你的训练。
Description.english:
As you continue in your journey as a Paladin, you'll become closer to the light, learning new abilities.

Go, get more experience, and learn a new ability. Demonstrate it for me, and we will continue your training.

CompletionLog.text: 去找北郡修道院武器大厅里的萨缪尔修士。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Brother Sammuel inside the Hall of Arms at Northshire Abbey.

identity.title: Learning the Word
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain, then use it 5 times on training dummies near Northshire Abbey.
identity.description:
One of your responsibilities as a priest is caring for the wounded. Another is to go out into the world and be more... proactive about defending them.$B$BAs you do so, you'll grow in power and learn all sorts of new things.

Why don't you go out, get more experience, and then return to demonstrate what you've learned?

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习暗言术：痛。然后对北郡修道院附近的训练假人施放5次暗言术：痛。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain, then use it 5 times on training dummies near Northshire Abbey.

Description.text:
作为牧师，你的其中一个职责就是治愈伤者，而另外一个职责则是深入这个混乱的世界，并变得更加……主动地去保护他们。$B$B当你这么做时，你的力量会随之增强，你还能学会各种类型的新法术。

你为什么不出去多积累些经验，然后回来向我展示一下你都学到了些什么呢？
Description.english:
One of your responsibilities as a priest is caring for the wounded. Another is to go out into the world and be more... proactive about defending them.$B$BAs you do so, you'll grow in power and learn all sorts of new things.

Why don't you go out, get more experience, and then return to demonstrate what you've learned?

identity.title: Frost Nova
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Look for a Training Dummy near, and practice using it twice.
identity.description:
We are the heirs to a legacy of arcane magic and your path will not be an easy one. Many still hold us responsible for the actions of our forebears, but our talents are needed.$B$BThough you must be cautious, it is important to develop your powers, as that will deepen your connection to the arcane and grant you access to new spells.

Go - get more experience with your spells, and demonstrate what you learn for me.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冰霜新星。然后在附近找一个训练假人，对它施放2次冰霜新星。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Look for a Training Dummy near, and practice using it twice.

Description.text:
我们是古老奥术魔法的传承者，你未来的道路会非常艰辛。许多人仍然认为我们应该为那些前辈所犯下的错误负责，但他们也确实需要我们的帮助。$B$B尽管你必须谨言慎行，但提升力量还是非常重要的。那将使你与奥术之间的联系更加紧密，并由此习得新法术。

去吧——为你的法术积累更多的经验，然后向我展示你都学到了些什么。
Description.english:
We are the heirs to a legacy of arcane magic and your path will not be an easy one. Many still hold us responsible for the actions of our forebears, but our talents are needed.$B$BThough you must be cautious, it is important to develop your powers, as that will deepen your connection to the arcane and grant you access to new spells.

Go - get more experience with your spells, and demonstrate what you learn for me.

CompletionLog.text: 去找奥达希尔的莱恩达。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Rhyanda in Aldrassil.

identity.title: Learning New Techniques
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Look for a Training Dummy and practice using Charge.
identity.description: As you overcome the challenges before you, you'll begin to learn new techniques.$B$BGo, get more experience, and learn a new skill. Then demonstrate it for me on one of the training dummies.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冲锋。然后在附近找一个训练假人，对它进行冲锋。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Look for a Training Dummy and practice using Charge.

Description.text: 在你逐一击溃你的挑战者后，你将开始学习新技巧。$B$B去吧，多积累些经验，并学习新技能。然后找一个训练假人来露两手给我瞧瞧。
Description.english: As you overcome the challenges before you, you'll begin to learn new techniques.$B$BGo, get more experience, and learn a new skill. Then demonstrate it for me on one of the training dummies.

CompletionLog.text: 去找泰达希尔的奥莉希亚。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Alyissia in Teldrassil.

identity.title: A Rogue's Advantage
identity.objectives: Reach Level 3 and Learn Eviscerate. Look for a Training Dummy southeast of Aldrassil and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.
identity.description: I'm certain that by now, you've mastered using Sinister Strike against your enemies. But, as you learn more and advance as a rogue, you'll start to figure out new techniques. One you should figure out soon is called Eviscerate. It can be a strong way to end a combination of attacks.$B$BI want you to get some more experience, figure it out, then try it on a training dummy near the southeastern edge of Aldrassil.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习刺骨。然后在奥达希尔东南面找一个训练假人，对它使用3次刺骨。
Objectives.english: Reach Level 3 and Learn Eviscerate. Look for a Training Dummy southeast of Aldrassil and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.

Description.text: 我相信，你现在已经是运用影袭作战的高手了。但是，随着你作为潜行者的经验日渐丰富，你会开始探索出新的技巧。你很快会领悟到的一招叫“刺骨”，这是一种杀伤力巨大的终结技。$B$B我要你去多积累些经验，领悟该技能。然后找奥达希尔东南侧附近的一个训练假人来练练手。
Description.english: I'm certain that by now, you've mastered using Sinister Strike against your enemies. But, as you learn more and advance as a rogue, you'll start to figure out new techniques. One you should figure out soon is called Eviscerate. It can be a strong way to end a combination of attacks.$B$BI want you to get some more experience, figure it out, then try it on a training dummy near the southeastern edge of Aldrassil.

CompletionLog.text: 去找泰达希尔的弗拉胡恩·影语者。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Frahun Shadewhisper in Teldrassil.

identity.title: A Woodsman's Training
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Look for a Training Dummy southeast of Aldrassil, and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.
identity.description: When most people think of the kaldorei, they conjure visions of druids and sentinels, but the way of the hunter is just as ancient and just as venerable.$B$BI've been observing you, and you've had quite a bit of experience handling that bow. As you gain more, you'll start to learn some new abilities.$B$BI want you to go out, get some more experience, and figure out how to do something new. Then go use it on a training dummy near the southeastern edge of Aldrassil.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习稳固射击。然后在奥达希尔东南面找一个训练假人，对它使用5次稳固射击。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Look for a Training Dummy southeast of Aldrassil, and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.

Description.text: 绝大部分人一想起卡多雷，就会想起德鲁伊和哨兵，但是猎人的传统与他们同样古老，也同样值得尊敬。$B$B我一直在观察你，看样子你是个搭弓射箭的好手。随着你的经验日渐丰富，你会开始学习某些新技能。$B$B我要你到野外多积累一些经验，搞明白如何做到这一点。然后到奥达希尔的东南侧去找一个训练假人来练练手。
Description.english: When most people think of the kaldorei, they conjure visions of druids and sentinels, but the way of the hunter is just as ancient and just as venerable.$B$BI've been observing you, and you've had quite a bit of experience handling that bow. As you gain more, you'll start to learn some new abilities.$B$BI want you to go out, get some more experience, and figure out how to do something new. Then go use it on a training dummy near the southeastern edge of Aldrassil.

CompletionLog.text: 去找奥达希尔的阿亚娜·远途。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Ayanna Everstride in Aldrassil.

identity.title: Moonfire
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Moonfire. Use it on a training dummy in Aldrassil.
identity.description:
Druids play an important role in our society, but all too often we are seen as passive dreamers in a world that is changing around us.$B$BThe truth is, though, we must actively practice and go out onto the world to develop our connection to nature.

So go, get some more experience. You will begin to feel your connection deepen, learning new skills. Demonstrate the first you learn for me.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习月火术。然后对奥达希尔的一个训练假人施放月火术。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Moonfire. Use it on a training dummy in Aldrassil.

Description.text:
德鲁伊在我们的社会中扮演着重要的角色，但是就在我们消极地沉睡的同时，这个世界也在不断改变。$B$B事实是，尽管如此，我们还得积极地训练，深入这个纷乱的世界并加强我们与自然之间的联系。

那么去吧，多积累一些经验。你会发现你与自然的联系更加紧密，从而悟出新技能。学会第一招后回来展示给我看。
Description.english:
Druids play an important role in our society, but all too often we are seen as passive dreamers in a world that is changing around us.$B$BThe truth is, though, we must actively practice and go out onto the world to develop our connection to nature.

So go, get some more experience. You will begin to feel your connection deepen, learning new skills. Demonstrate the first you learn for me.

CompletionLog.text: 去找奥达希尔的玛丹特·硬木。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Mardant Strongoak in Aldrassil.

identity.title: Learning the Word
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain, then use it 5 times on training dummies.
identity.description:
As you venture out into the world and develop your skills, you will begin to learn new abilities that you never knew you had within you.

I'd like you to go out, get some more experience, and then show me the first new ability you learn.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习暗言术：痛。然后对训练假人施放5次暗言术：痛。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain, then use it 5 times on training dummies.

Description.text:
在你深入这个纷乱的世界并不断拓展你的技巧时，你会开始领悟之前你意想不到的全新技能。

我要你到野外去多积累一些经验，然后回来向我展示一下你学到的第一个新技能。
Description.english:
As you venture out into the world and develop your skills, you will begin to learn new abilities that you never knew you had within you.

I'd like you to go out, get some more experience, and then show me the first new ability you learn.

CompletionLog.text: 向奥达希尔的珊达复命。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Shanda in Aldrassil.

identity.title: The Dark Side of the Light
identity.objectives: Kill Interrogator Vishas and Bloodmage Thalnos.
identity.description: The Scarlet Crusade lures in anxious young warriors with their promise to eradicate the undead. What they don't see is the dark underbelly of the entire operation.$B$BInterrogator Vishas is the cruelest man I've ever had the displeasure to meet - he 'extracted' information from my mother during the initial outbreak of the plague. The merciless Bloodmage Thalnos watches over their graveyard.$B$BThe crusaders' zealous holy rage blinds them from their own darkness. Make them regret their hypocrisy.

Title.english: The Dark Side of the Light

Objectives.text: 杀死审讯员韦沙斯和血法师萨尔诺斯。
Objectives.english: Kill Interrogator Vishas and Bloodmage Thalnos.

Description.text: 血色十字军向年轻的战士许下消灭亡灵的承诺，引诱他们加入组织。但是他们看不到这个组织的幕后有多么黑暗。$B$B审讯员韦沙斯是我见过的最残忍的人——当天灾瘟疫刚刚爆发时，他严刑拷打我的母亲以获取情报。无情的血法师萨尔诺斯监管着他们的墓地。$B$B血色十字军的狂热使他们看不到自己的黑暗面。让他们为这伪善的嘴脸付出代价吧。
Description.english: The Scarlet Crusade lures in anxious young warriors with their promise to eradicate the undead. What they don't see is the dark underbelly of the entire operation.$B$BInterrogator Vishas is the cruelest man I've ever had the displeasure to meet - he 'extracted' information from my mother during the initial outbreak of the plague. The merciless Bloodmage Thalnos watches over their graveyard.$B$BThe crusaders' zealous holy rage blinds them from their own darkness. Make them regret their hypocrisy.

identity.title: Cleanup on Isle E.
identity.objectives: Gather 8 Disenchanted Tiki Masks.
identity.description: The Battle to reclaim the Echo Isles was a costly one.  But well worth it, $c.  The great spirit, Bwonsamdi, helped our warriors defeat the foul Zalazane.  He protected our warriors with spirits from the island.  But some of those spirits fell in battle.  Help put those spirits to rest.  On the Echo Isles, you will find masks laying about gather them and bring them here.

Objectives.text: 收集8个褪魔的蒂基面具。
Objectives.english: Gather 8 Disenchanted Tiki Masks.

Description.text: 夺取回音群岛的战役让我们付出了沉重的代价。但这样的牺牲是值得的，$c。伟大的祖灵邦桑迪帮助我们的战士击败了邪恶的扎拉赞恩。他让这座岛的灵魂保护了我们的战士。但这些灵魂之中有不少都在战斗中消亡了。请帮我让这些灵魂得到安息。在回音群岛上，你会找到一些面具，收集它们，将它们交给我。
Description.english: The Battle to reclaim the Echo Isles was a costly one.  But well worth it, $c.  The great spirit, Bwonsamdi, helped our warriors defeat the foul Zalazane.  He protected our warriors with spirits from the island.  But some of those spirits fell in battle.  Help put those spirits to rest.  On the Echo Isles, you will find masks laying about gather them and bring them here.

identity.title: Your First Lesson
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using Charge.
identity.description: Let's start your training right away. As you get more experience in combat, you'll start to develop new techniques.$B$BGo, get some more experience, learn something new, and demonstrate it on the dummies to the northwest.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冲锋。然后在坠毁点西北侧找一个训练假人，对它进行冲锋。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using Charge.

Description.text: 让我们现在就开始你的训练吧。随着你在战斗中的经验越来越丰富，你会开始探索出新技巧。$B$B去吧，多积累一些经验，学习一些新技能。然后去西北面找训练假人来练练手。
Description.english: Let's start your training right away. As you get more experience in combat, you'll start to develop new techniques.$B$BGo, get some more experience, learn something new, and demonstrate it on the dummies to the northwest.

CompletionLog.text: 去找坠毁点的库勒。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kore at the Crash Site.

identity.title: My Son, the Prince
identity.objectives: Introduce yourself to Prince Anduin in Stormwind Keep. Speak with King Wrynn once you are both acquainted.
identity.description: Great burdens have been placed on my son's shoulders in his short lifetime, and I fear his responsibilities are only going to grow.$B$BHe will never learn leadership confined to the keep, but I am loath to send him forth without escort.$B$B$n, your deeds in the wake of this cataclysm are already legendary. You would be an excellent mentor for young Prince Anduin.$B$BPlease, introduce yourself to him. There is some pressing city business that you both can attend to for me.

Objectives.text: 向暴风城堡里的安度因王子自我介绍，互相认识后再同乌瑞恩国王交谈。
Objectives.english: Introduce yourself to Prince Anduin in Stormwind Keep. Speak with King Wrynn once you are both acquainted.

Description.text: 我的儿子生来就责任重大，恐怕随着时日增长，这些负担有增无减。$B$B呆在城堡里如何能修习帝王之术，无人护卫我又于心难安。$B$B$n，你在大灾变后的作为已经被奉为传奇。你若能担任年轻王子安度因的导师再好不过。$B$B请前去与他相见。城中事务迫切，你俩可一同为我分忧。
Description.english: Great burdens have been placed on my son's shoulders in his short lifetime, and I fear his responsibilities are only going to grow.$B$BHe will never learn leadership confined to the keep, but I am loath to send him forth without escort.$B$B$n, your deeds in the wake of this cataclysm are already legendary. You would be an excellent mentor for young Prince Anduin.$B$BPlease, introduce yourself to him. There is some pressing city business that you both can attend to for me.

identity.title: Stripping Their Offense
identity.objectives: Kill Herod.
identity.description: As you can see, $n, our first assault on the Armory did not go as planned. We had taken the nearby courtyard until the Scarlet Champion, Herod, showed up.$B$BWe must continue our assault. The Scarlet Crusade will never be allowed to train another warrior here, let alone launch an attack on the Undercity.$B$BYour task should be obvious. Down the Scarlet Champion.

Objectives.text: 杀死赫洛德。
Objectives.english: Kill Herod.

Description.text: 正如你所见，$n，我们对军械库发动的第一轮突袭不是很顺利。我们攻占了旁边的庭院，但血色勇士赫洛德又把它夺了回去。$B$B我们必须继续进攻。绝对不能允许血色十字军再训练出一名战士来，更不能让他们对幽暗城发动攻击。$B$B你的任务简单明了，去干掉这个血色勇士。
Description.english: As you can see, $n, our first assault on the Armory did not go as planned. We had taken the nearby courtyard until the Scarlet Champion, Herod, showed up.$B$BWe must continue our assault. The Scarlet Crusade will never be allowed to train another warrior here, let alone launch an attack on the Undercity.$B$BYour task should be obvious. Down the Scarlet Champion.

identity.title: Steadying Your Shot
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.
identity.description: Let's start your training right away. It's going to be a struggle to survive here, and you'll play an important role in making sure our people are safe and well-supplied.$B$BAs you become more experiened, you'll begin to discover new abilities. Go ahead and go out, learn something new, and try it out. Return to me when you think you've mastered it.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习稳固射击。然后在坠毁点西北侧找一个训练假人，对它使用5次稳固射击。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.

Description.text: 让我们现在就开始你的训练吧。要在这里生存下去是很艰难的，在确保我们的人民可以安居乐业这件事上，你将扮演非常重要的角色。$B$B随着你的经验越来越丰富，你会开始探索出新技能。到野外去，学些新东西回来。等你觉得自己能熟练掌握了，就回来找我。
Description.english: Let's start your training right away. It's going to be a struggle to survive here, and you'll play an important role in making sure our people are safe and well-supplied.$B$BAs you become more experiened, you'll begin to discover new abilities. Go ahead and go out, learn something new, and try it out. Return to me when you think you've mastered it.

CompletionLog.text: 去找坠毁点的基尔尼。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Keilnei at the Crash Site.

identity.title: The Light's Power
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Seal of Command. Apply Seal of Command, find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and hit it with an attack.
identity.description:
As a paladin, you're no stranger to the Light that touches all of us. But you also have the unique power to call upon the Light to help you in battle.$B$BAs you gain more experience, you'll grow even closer to the Light and be able to call upon new powers in battle.

Go, grow in experience until you have learned a new power, and then demonstrate it for me.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习命令圣印。对你自己施放命令圣印，然后在坠毁点西北侧找一个训练假人并击打它。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Seal of Command. Apply Seal of Command, find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and hit it with an attack.

Description.text:
身为一名圣骑士，你对眷顾我们所有人的圣光并不陌生。但你同样拥有召唤圣光助战的特殊力量。$B$B在你获得越来越多的经验后，你会发现自己离圣光也越来越近，进而可以召唤新的力量运用到战斗中来。

去吧，多积累些经验直到你学会一个新力量，然后回来展示给我看。
Description.english:
As a paladin, you're no stranger to the Light that touches all of us. But you also have the unique power to call upon the Light to help you in battle.$B$BAs you gain more experience, you'll grow even closer to the Light and be able to call upon new powers in battle.

Go, grow in experience until you have learned a new power, and then demonstrate it for me.

identity.title: Battle for the Scarlet Monastery
identity.objectives: Kill Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane.
identity.description: Behold the might of the Forsaken! The unstoppable will of the Dark Lady flows through our bodies! $B$BThe vast majority of the crusade's remaining forces have fled. Some, however, remain defiant.$B$BYou have been instrumental in this campaign's success. Sylvanas extends the honor of slaying her last remaining enemies to you, $n.$B$BShow no mercy.

Objectives.text: 杀死血色十字军指挥官莫格莱尼和大检察官怀特迈恩。
Objectives.english: Kill Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane.

Description.text: 看吧，被遗忘者的力量！黑暗女王那无坚不摧的意志在我们体内流淌！$B$B十字军的残部大多逃命去了，但仍有一些人在负隅顽抗。$B$B你在这场大捷中出了不少力，希尔瓦娜斯将消灭最后一股顽抗之敌的荣耀留给了你，$n。$B$B不要手下留情。
Description.english: Behold the might of the Forsaken! The unstoppable will of the Dark Lady flows through our bodies! $B$BThe vast majority of the crusade's remaining forces have fled. Some, however, remain defiant.$B$BYou have been instrumental in this campaign's success. Sylvanas extends the honor of slaying her last remaining enemies to you, $n.$B$BShow no mercy.

identity.title: Frost Nova
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using it 2 times.
identity.description:
In your future as a mage, you'll want to master a wide variety of spells. To do so, you need to deepen your connection by the arcane by growing in power.

Go, get more experience as a mage, and demonstrate what you learn for me.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冰霜新星。然后在坠毁点西北侧找一个训练假人，对它施放2次冰霜新星。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using it 2 times.

Description.text:
在你未来的法师生涯中，你会想要掌握大量各式各样的法术。为了做到这一点，你需要提高自身实力来深化你与奥术之间的联系。

去吧，以法师的身份多积累些经验，然后回来向我展示一下你都学到了些什么。
Description.english:
In your future as a mage, you'll want to master a wide variety of spells. To do so, you need to deepen your connection by the arcane by growing in power.

Go, get more experience as a mage, and demonstrate what you learn for me.

identity.title: Primal Strike
identity.objectives: Learn Primal Strike by reaching Level 3, and then find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using Primal Strike 3 times.
identity.description:
Your walk with the elemental powers will take you to many places. As you grow in power, you will begin to learn new abilities. 

Let us start your journey with a simple, but useful, lesson.

Learn the secret of Primal Strike, and then practice your new skill using the training dummies to the northwest of the Crash Site. Return to me when you are finished.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习根源打击。然后在坠毁点西北侧找一个训练假人，对其使用3次根源打击。
Objectives.english: Learn Primal Strike by reaching Level 3, and then find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using Primal Strike 3 times.

Description.text:
元素之力将伴随你走遍天涯海角。随着你的力量不断提升，你会开始领悟出新技能。

让我们以一场简单而极具价值的课程来开启你的旅途吧。

学习根源打击的奥义，然后到坠毁点西北侧找训练假人，用你学会的新技能练练手。当你完成后，记得回来找我。
Description.english:
Your walk with the elemental powers will take you to many places. As you grow in power, you will begin to learn new abilities. 

Let us start your journey with a simple, but useful, lesson.

Learn the secret of Primal Strike, and then practice your new skill using the training dummies to the northwest of the Crash Site. Return to me when you are finished.

CompletionLog.text: 去找坠毁点的费曼瓦尔。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Firmanvaar at the Crash Site.

identity.title: Learning the Word
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain, then use it 5 times on target dummies near the crash site.
identity.description:
As a priest, one of your most important duties is to use the Light's power to aid the wounded.

Another is to use your power offensively, to protect them.

As you grow more experienced, you will begin to uncover new abilities that you can use in your charge. Go, gain more experience, and then demonstrate the abilities you have learned to me.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习暗言术：痛。然后对坠毁点附近的训练假人使用5次暗言术：痛。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain, then use it 5 times on target dummies near the crash site.

Description.text:
作为一名牧师，你最重要的职责之一，就是借助圣光的力量来治愈伤者。

另一个职责则是借助攻击性的力量来保护他们。

随着你的经验日渐丰富，你会开始发现一些全新的能力来为己所用。去吧，多积累一些经验，然后把你学到的新技能展示给我看。
Description.english:
As a priest, one of your most important duties is to use the Light's power to aid the wounded.

Another is to use your power offensively, to protect them.

As you grow more experienced, you will begin to uncover new abilities that you can use in your charge. Go, gain more experience, and then demonstrate the abilities you have learned to me.

CompletionLog.text: 去找坠毁点的扎尔杜。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Zalduun at the Crash Site.

identity.title: The Dark Side of the Light
identity.objectives: Kill Interrogator Vishas and Bloodmage Thalnos.
identity.description: I joined the Scarlet Crusade as a young paladin, eager to cleanse the world of evil. Little did I know of the dark truth to these fanatics.$B$BInterrogator Vishas and Bloodmage Thalnos oversee this graveyard. They take great pleasure in torturing new recruits endlessly to ensure that they are 'pure'. It is an affront to the light, $c!$B$BNo longer can I be a part of this corrupt organization. You're going to have to kill them both, so that others will never endure the same pain I did.

Title.english: The Dark Side of the Light

Objectives.text: 杀死审讯员韦沙斯和血法师萨尔诺斯。
Objectives.english: Kill Interrogator Vishas and Bloodmage Thalnos.

Description.text: 当我还是一名渴望净化一切邪恶的年轻圣骑士的时候，就加入了血色十字军。当时我对这些狂热之徒的黑暗真相一无所知。$B$B审讯员韦沙斯和血法师萨尔诺斯是这座墓地的主管。他们乐此不疲、永不停歇地折磨新兵，以确保他们是“纯净”的。这是对圣光的侮辱，$c！$B$B我不能继续待在这个堕落的组织里了。你必须把他们两个都干掉，这样其他人就不会再承受我所承受的痛苦折磨了。
Description.english: I joined the Scarlet Crusade as a young paladin, eager to cleanse the world of evil. Little did I know of the dark truth to these fanatics.$B$BInterrogator Vishas and Bloodmage Thalnos oversee this graveyard. They take great pleasure in torturing new recruits endlessly to ensure that they are 'pure'. It is an affront to the light, $c!$B$BNo longer can I be a part of this corrupt organization. You're going to have to kill them both, so that others will never endure the same pain I did.

identity.title: The Only True Path
identity.objectives: Eliminate Houndmaster Loksey and Arcanist Doan.
identity.description: I think that the root of the crusade's corruption can be found here. Arcanist Doan watches over the library, and teaches many young recruits to wield the arcane arts.$B$BThe Light is the only true path! You must kill him, $c, and redeem this glorious movement!$B$B<Joseph the Awakened shifts nervously.>$B$BYou'll want to dispose of Loksey as well. His hounds seem to disapprove of our noble intent.

Objectives.text: 杀死驯犬者洛克希和奥法师杜安。
Objectives.english: Eliminate Houndmaster Loksey and Arcanist Doan.

Description.text: 我觉得十字军堕落的根源就在这里。奥法师杜安管理着图书馆，向新学员传授奥术知识。$B$B圣光才是唯一正确的道路！你必须杀掉他，$c，拯救这场光荣的运动！$B$B<醒悟的约瑟夫紧张地改变了语气。>$B$B另外，你还要除掉洛克希。他的猎犬好像不认同我们崇高的理想。
Description.english: I think that the root of the crusade's corruption can be found here. Arcanist Doan watches over the library, and teaches many young recruits to wield the arcane arts.$B$BThe Light is the only true path! You must kill him, $c, and redeem this glorious movement!$B$B<Joseph the Awakened shifts nervously.>$B$BYou'll want to dispose of Loksey as well. His hounds seem to disapprove of our noble intent.

identity.title: The False Champion
identity.objectives: Kill Herod.
identity.description: We...we...we had to kill them! They were coming right for us!$B$BYou believe me, don't you $n?$B$BHerod is not the true champion of the Scarlet Crusade. I am! He took what was rightfully mine!$B$BYou should kill him. He's...a menace! Trains the soldiers to kill anyone instead of just the undead!$B$BI'll reward you handsomely...

Objectives.text: 杀死赫洛德。
Objectives.english: Kill Herod.

Description.text: 我们……我们必须杀掉他们！他们冲过来了！$B$B你是相信我的，对吧？$B$B赫洛德不是血色十字军里真正的头号勇士。我才是！他夺走了本该属于我的东西！$B$B你必须杀了他。他是……一个威胁！他训练那些士兵杀死一切活物，而不仅仅是亡灵！$B$B我会给你重赏的……
Description.english: We...we...we had to kill them! They were coming right for us!$B$BYou believe me, don't you $n?$B$BHerod is not the true champion of the Scarlet Crusade. I am! He took what was rightfully mine!$B$BYou should kill him. He's...a menace! Trains the soldiers to kill anyone instead of just the undead!$B$BI'll reward you handsomely...

identity.title: Rallying the Fleet
identity.objectives: Escort Prince Anduin to the Stormwind Docks and talk to Supply Sergeant Graves. If you get separated from the Prince, you'll find him in the Stormwind throne room.
identity.description: I am amassing a warfleet to assault Twilight Highlands and bring an end to Deathwing's lackeys. My soldiers are ready but fleet preparations lag behind.$B$BMy men at the docks need some inspiration and motivation. A visit from the Prince here should lift their spirits and remind them of the bright future they're fighting for.$B$BTake Prince Anduin to the docks with you and speak with Supply Sergeant Graves. I want Anduin to observe how a natural leader handles the situation.

Objectives.text: 护送安度因王子前往暴风城码头，并同供应军士格雷夫斯交谈。假如你同王子走散了，可以在暴风城王座找到他。
Objectives.english: Escort Prince Anduin to the Stormwind Docks and talk to Supply Sergeant Graves. If you get separated from the Prince, you'll find him in the Stormwind throne room.

Description.text: 我正组织舰队准备攻打暮光高地，消灭死亡之翼的爪牙。我的人马已经备好，但舰队却迟迟未能就位。$B$B码头上的人需要激励。安度因王子如若能亲自驾临，则必将振奋军民士气。$B$B陪同安度因王子前往码头，同供应军士格雷夫斯交谈。我想让安度因学学一个天生的领袖是如何处理问题的。
Description.english: I am amassing a warfleet to assault Twilight Highlands and bring an end to Deathwing's lackeys. My soldiers are ready but fleet preparations lag behind.$B$BMy men at the docks need some inspiration and motivation. A visit from the Prince here should lift their spirits and remind them of the bright future they're fighting for.$B$BTake Prince Anduin to the docks with you and speak with Supply Sergeant Graves. I want Anduin to observe how a natural leader handles the situation.

identity.title: Battle for the Scarlet Monastery
identity.objectives: Kill Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane.
identity.description: Oh, it's great to see you again $n! I'm afraid I'm going to need your help.$B$BYou see, Mograine's the Commander here along with High Inquisitor Whitemane, and they tried telling me that I wasn't really the new Scarlet Champion! 'Course, the boys and I didn't take kindly to that.$B$BWe're taking the Scarlet Monastery for our own and re-establishing the order as it always should have been - with me at the head of things! I'll take care of the Forsaken and the Scourge for good.$B$BHelp an old friend out?

Objectives.text: 杀死血色十字军指挥官莫格莱尼和大检察官怀特迈恩。
Objectives.english: Kill Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane.

Description.text: 哦，很高兴再见到你，$n！恐怕我正巧需要你的帮助。$B$B你瞧，莫格莱尼和大检察官怀特迈恩是这里的头儿，他们跟我说，我不是新的血色勇士！当然了，我跟我的伙计们可不是好糊弄的。$B$B我们打算夺取血色修道院，重建这个组织，让事情回到正轨上——也就是一切都由我说了算的状态！我会好好对付被遗忘者和天灾军团的。$B$B帮老朋友一个忙吧？
Description.english: Oh, it's great to see you again $n! I'm afraid I'm going to need your help.$B$BYou see, Mograine's the Commander here along with High Inquisitor Whitemane, and they tried telling me that I wasn't really the new Scarlet Champion! 'Course, the boys and I didn't take kindly to that.$B$BWe're taking the Scarlet Monastery for our own and re-establishing the order as it always should have been - with me at the head of things! I'll take care of the Forsaken and the Scourge for good.$B$BHelp an old friend out?

CompletionLog.text: 去找癫狂的约瑟夫。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Joseph the Insane.

identity.title: Twilight Investigation
identity.objectives: Speak with Major Samuelson in Stormwind Keep.
identity.description: The city is still reeling from the seditious acts of the Twilight's Hammer in recent months. They prey on peasant fears and corrupt our most important citizens. We need to find out how deep the conspiracy runs.$B$BI've tasked Major Samuelson of the Stormwind City Guard to head up an investigation. He's right here in the throne room. See if you can assist his efforts.

Objectives.text: 同暴风城堡里的萨缪尔森少校交谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Major Samuelson in Stormwind Keep.

Description.text: 暮光之锤的煽动让城里一片混乱。他们掠夺农民，教唆我们最重要的市民。我们得弄明白这个阴谋到底有多大。$B$B我已任命暴风城卫兵队的萨缪尔森少校着手调查。他就在王座这儿，看看你是不是能帮什么忙。
Description.english: The city is still reeling from the seditious acts of the Twilight's Hammer in recent months. They prey on peasant fears and corrupt our most important citizens. We need to find out how deep the conspiracy runs.$B$BI've tasked Major Samuelson of the Stormwind City Guard to head up an investigation. He's right here in the throne room. See if you can assist his efforts.

CompletionLog.text: 同暴风城堡里的萨缪尔森少校交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Major Samuelson in Stormwind Keep.

identity.title: The Scarlet Monastery
identity.objectives: Visit Joseph the Awakened.
identity.description: The same Monastery in Tirisfal Glades that the Scarlet Crusaders now occupy used to be a major training ground for our paladins. Now the Forsaken loom over it from the Undercity and the Crusade prevents us from utilizing it to train the very soldiers we need to deal with the Forsaken!$B$BLook, I don't trust him, but Joseph the Awakened waits inside the graveyard. Go speak with him - although he is a crusader, he says he now rebels against them, providing us with an opportunity to take back what's ours.

Objectives.text: 拜访醒悟的约瑟夫。
Objectives.english: Visit Joseph the Awakened.

Description.text: 提瑞斯法林地的那座修道院现在是血色十字军的地盘，但那里以前是我们训练圣骑士的基地。眼下，幽暗城中的被遗忘者对它虎视眈眈，那些十字军却不允许我们用它来训练士兵，对抗被遗忘者！$B$B听着，我不相信这个醒悟的约瑟夫，但他正在墓地里等着呢。去跟他聊聊——尽管他是一个十字军成员，但他说自己已经起义了，这也许是我们夺回修道院的好机会。
Description.english: The same Monastery in Tirisfal Glades that the Scarlet Crusaders now occupy used to be a major training ground for our paladins. Now the Forsaken loom over it from the Undercity and the Crusade prevents us from utilizing it to train the very soldiers we need to deal with the Forsaken!$B$BLook, I don't trust him, but Joseph the Awakened waits inside the graveyard. Go speak with him - although he is a crusader, he says he now rebels against them, providing us with an opportunity to take back what's ours.

CompletionLog.text: 去找醒悟的约瑟夫。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Joseph the Awakened.

identity.title: Just Close Enough
identity.objectives: Visit Joseph the Awakened.
identity.description: Make no mistake - there is a ton of stuff to be done here! However, we also need to strike at the Forsaken where it hurts. The Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades is the perfect distance from the Undercity and Brill.$B$BReport to Joseph the Awakened in their Library. He's a rebel crusader that can hopefully help us take the Monastery as our base of operations in that region, and maybe take out Arcanist Doan, one of their most powerful mages, in the process.

Objectives.text: 拜访醒悟的约瑟夫。
Objectives.english: Visit Joseph the Awakened.

Description.text: 别误解了我的意思——这里还有许多事情要处理！但是我们也必须看清被遗忘者的软肋，并准确地发动反击。提瑞斯法林地的血色修道院到幽暗城和布瑞尔的距离都很近。$B$B到图书馆去找醒悟的约瑟夫。他是一名起义的十字军成员，也许可以帮助我们夺取修道院，将其作为我们的前哨基地。没准还可以顺便干掉奥法师杜安，血色十字军中最强大的法师之一。
Description.english: Make no mistake - there is a ton of stuff to be done here! However, we also need to strike at the Forsaken where it hurts. The Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades is the perfect distance from the Undercity and Brill.$B$BReport to Joseph the Awakened in their Library. He's a rebel crusader that can hopefully help us take the Monastery as our base of operations in that region, and maybe take out Arcanist Doan, one of their most powerful mages, in the process.

CompletionLog.text: 去找醒悟的约瑟夫。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Joseph the Awakened.

identity.title: An Old, Crazed Friend
identity.objectives: Visit Joseph the Crazed.
identity.description: Joseph the Crazed was one of my good friends before he joined the Scarlet Crusade up in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. I heard that he's in the Armory there trying some ridiculous attempt at taking over Herod's position as Scarlet Champion.$B$BIt's a death wish to challenge Herod like that! Go up there and try to talk him out of it.

Objectives.text: 拜访发疯的约瑟夫。
Objectives.english: Visit Joseph the Crazed.

Description.text: 发疯的约瑟夫曾是我的好朋友，后来他在提瑞斯法林地的血色修道院里加入了血色十字军。我听说他躲在军械库里，想要夺取赫洛德的“血色十字军勇士”的名号。$B$B他简直是活得不耐烦了！去跟他谈谈吧，免得他自寻短见。
Description.english: Joseph the Crazed was one of my good friends before he joined the Scarlet Crusade up in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. I heard that he's in the Armory there trying some ridiculous attempt at taking over Herod's position as Scarlet Champion.$B$BIt's a death wish to challenge Herod like that! Go up there and try to talk him out of it.

identity.title: Pitting Madness Against Madness
identity.objectives: Visit Joseph the Insane.
identity.description: Our renewed forces can handle the situation here for a while without you. I've received reports that Joseph the Insane, a former Scarlet Crusade officer, is in the Scarlet Monastery Cathedral and is taking his band of renegades to strike out against Scarlet Commander Mograine.$B$BThis is an excellent opportunity. Go there and help him with his insane task, and maybe we can use the Monastery as an excellent stronghold right at Sylvanas' doorstep!

Objectives.text: 拜访癫狂的约瑟夫。
Objectives.english: Visit Joseph the Insane.

Description.text: 我们新近休整过的部队暂时可以独自控制这里的局势了。我收到报告说，有一个名叫癫狂的约瑟夫的家伙，他曾担任血色十字军的官员，眼下正在血色修道院的大教堂里，准备率队攻打血色十字军指挥官莫格莱尼。$B$B这是一个难得的好机会。到那里去帮助他完成这个癫狂的任务，也许这座修道院可以成为我们的前沿要塞，希尔瓦娜斯的眼中钉！
Description.english: Our renewed forces can handle the situation here for a while without you. I've received reports that Joseph the Insane, a former Scarlet Crusade officer, is in the Scarlet Monastery Cathedral and is taking his band of renegades to strike out against Scarlet Commander Mograine.$B$BThis is an excellent opportunity. Go there and help him with his insane task, and maybe we can use the Monastery as an excellent stronghold right at Sylvanas' doorstep!

CompletionLog.text: 去找醒悟的约瑟夫。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Joseph the Awakened.

identity.title: Into the Scarlet Monastery
identity.objectives: Report to Dark Ranger Velonara.
identity.description: Oftentimes the best way to ensure our men sustain as few injuries as possible is to cause great harm to our enemies in their very homes and prevent battles from ever occurring!$B$BTravel to the Scarlet Monastery and speak with Dark Ranger Velonara in their graveyard. She is leading a Forsaken assault there and could benefit from a seasoned $c such as yourself.

Objectives.text: 向黑暗游侠维罗娜拉报到。
Objectives.english: Report to Dark Ranger Velonara.

Description.text: 血色十字军一直毫无顾忌地占据着幽暗城旁边的血色修道院，这样便宜他们的事情不能再继续了！$B$B到修道院的墓地去找黑暗游侠维罗娜拉，她负责被遗忘者部队在那边的行动，你这样训练有素的$c肯定可以帮她不少忙。
Description.english: Oftentimes the best way to ensure our men sustain as few injuries as possible is to cause great harm to our enemies in their very homes and prevent battles from ever occurring!$B$BTravel to the Scarlet Monastery and speak with Dark Ranger Velonara in their graveyard. She is leading a Forsaken assault there and could benefit from a seasoned $c such as yourself.

identity.title: The Right Way
identity.objectives: Speak to Dark Ranger Velonara.
identity.description: My people are not generally fond of the arcane arts that so many other races abuse. Thankfully the wizards within the Scarlet Monastery library are separated from us by considerable land, but their ability to transcend the physical realm concerns me and, ultimately, my tribe's survival.$B$BTravel far to the west to the monastery's library and speak with Dark Ranger Velonara there. Her forces are already poised to strike at Arcanist Doan himself, head magi for the crusade.

Objectives.text: 与黑暗游侠维罗娜拉交谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Dark Ranger Velonara.

Description.text: 我们的人民通常对其他种族热衷的奥术魔法不太感兴趣。谢天谢地，血色修道院中的巫师与我们离得很远，但他们穿越物理空间的能力让我感到非常担忧，这最终会威胁到我们族人的生存。$B$B到西边的修道院图书馆去，与黑暗游侠维罗娜拉谈谈。她的部队正在准备进攻奥法师杜安，那个人是血色十字军的巫师头目。
Description.english: My people are not generally fond of the arcane arts that so many other races abuse. Thankfully the wizards within the Scarlet Monastery library are separated from us by considerable land, but their ability to transcend the physical realm concerns me and, ultimately, my tribe's survival.$B$BTravel far to the west to the monastery's library and speak with Dark Ranger Velonara there. Her forces are already poised to strike at Arcanist Doan himself, head magi for the crusade.

CompletionLog.text: 去找醒悟的约瑟夫。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Joseph the Awakened.

identity.title: Moving Things Along
identity.objectives: Visit Dark Ranger Velonara.
identity.description: I'm waitin' on some very powerful reagents I ordered from the Undercity not long ago. I heard that the shipment is late because the Scarlet Monastery's crusaders are blocking its passage. Da Scarlet Champion, Herod, is likely to blame for dis annoyance.$B$BPlease go speak to Dark Ranger Velonara in the Scarlet Monastery's armory, she is goin' to 'take care' of Herod, which means my shipment will arrive safely!

Objectives.text: 拜访黑暗游侠维罗娜拉。
Objectives.english: Visit Dark Ranger Velonara.

Description.text: 不久前，我从幽暗城订购了一批威力巨大的施法材料，但是我听说货物一直没送来的原因，是那些血色修道院里的十字军截断了商道。一个名叫赫洛德的血色十字军勇士似乎应该对此负责。$B$B请到血色修道院的军械库去一趟，找黑暗游侠维罗娜拉谈谈。她正要“处理”赫洛德的问题，我的货物看来很快就要安全送达了！
Description.english: I'm waitin' on some very powerful reagents I ordered from the Undercity not long ago. I heard that the shipment is late because the Scarlet Monastery's crusaders are blocking its passage. Da Scarlet Champion, Herod, is likely to blame for dis annoyance.$B$BPlease go speak to Dark Ranger Velonara in the Scarlet Monastery's armory, she is goin' to 'take care' of Herod, which means my shipment will arrive safely!

CompletionLog.text: 去找醒悟的约瑟夫。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Joseph the Awakened.

identity.title: Enemies Abroad
identity.objectives: Find Dark Ranger Velonara.
identity.description: Sometimes we must acknowledge the need to protect our allies so that they may protect us. This is one such occasion, $r.$B$BTravel to the Scarlet Monastery near the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades. Once you arrive, go to the Cathedral and speak with Dark Ranger Velonara. She is leading the final assault against the crusade there, and it would benefit us all greatly to ensure our undead allies secure the monastery before the crusaders have a chance to attack their capital.

Objectives.text: 找到黑暗游侠维罗娜拉。
Objectives.english: Find Dark Ranger Velonara.

Description.text: 有时候，我们必须承认有必要保护盟友，这样他们以后才可能保护我们。现在就是这样的情况，$r。$B$B到提瑞斯法林地的幽暗城旁边的血色修道院去，在大教堂找黑暗游侠维罗娜拉谈谈。她正在指挥对那里的十字军发动总攻，如果在我们的亡灵盟友的主城受到攻击之前，就把那些十字军彻底消灭，对我们来说也是件好事。
Description.english: Sometimes we must acknowledge the need to protect our allies so that they may protect us. This is one such occasion, $r.$B$BTravel to the Scarlet Monastery near the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades. Once you arrive, go to the Cathedral and speak with Dark Ranger Velonara. She is leading the final assault against the crusade there, and it would benefit us all greatly to ensure our undead allies secure the monastery before the crusaders have a chance to attack their capital.

identity.title: Without Rhyme or Reason
identity.objectives: Kill 3 Scarlet Myrmidons, 3 Scarlet Protectors, 3 Scarlet Guardsmen, and 3 Scarlet Evokers.
identity.description: I heard that Joseph the Crazed wants you to kill Herod. While you're at it, how about you slaughter their top soldiers? I'll pay you well for your work.$B$BDon't worry about the why, just worry about the how.

Objectives.text: 杀死3个血色仆从、3个血色保卫者、3个血色卫兵和3个血色招魂师。
Objectives.english: Kill 3 Scarlet Myrmidons, 3 Scarlet Protectors, 3 Scarlet Guardsmen, and 3 Scarlet Evokers.

Description.text: 我听说维罗娜拉要你去杀死赫洛德。那你不如顺便也处理掉他们的精锐部队如何？我会好好奖赏你的。$B$B不要关心理由，只管去想办法。
Description.english: I heard that Joseph the Crazed wants you to kill Herod. While you're at it, how about you slaughter their top soldiers? I'll pay you well for your work.$B$BDon't worry about the why, just worry about the how.

identity.title: Right Under Their Noses
identity.objectives: Kill High Inquisitor Fairbanks.
identity.description: In the right side-room of the accursed cathedral ahead there is a torch on the wall. Move it and a secret door will open. Inside is High Inquisitor Fairbanks. He is now an undead.$B$BI need him taken care of. Kill him in his own room if possible, I'd strongly prefer the crusaders not see him. You know the deal - kill him, and I'll reward you. No other words are necessary between us.

Objectives.text: 杀死大检察官法尔班克斯。
Objectives.english: Kill High Inquisitor Fairbanks.

Description.text: 在前面那座该死的大教堂的右侧偏房里，墙上镶着一把火炬。扳动火炬就可以打开一道秘门，大检察官法尔班克斯就在里面。他是个亡灵。$B$B我要你去解决他。如果可能的话，让他死在自己的房间里，我强烈建议不要让十字军看到他。你知道怎么办吧——把他干掉，我就奖赏你。不用多说废话。
Description.english: In the right side-room of the accursed cathedral ahead there is a torch on the wall. Move it and a secret door will open. Inside is High Inquisitor Fairbanks. He is now an undead.$B$BI need him taken care of. Kill him in his own room if possible, I'd strongly prefer the crusaders not see him. You know the deal - kill him, and I'll reward you. No other words are necessary between us.

identity.title: The Usual Suspects
identity.objectives: Grill 6 Stormwind Dock Workers in Stormwind Harbor.
identity.description: <Samuelson scratches his chin, absently.>$B$BMy investigations reveal, ah, it's likely that there's trouble brewing among the Stormwind dock workers. Shifty lot. Don't trust 'em.$B$BYou should go there and shake the place down. Start grilling those longshoremen. That should keep you busy.$B$BGo rout out those Twilight infidels!

Objectives.text: 在暴风城码头讯问6名暴风城码头工人。
Objectives.english: Grill 6 Stormwind Dock Workers in Stormwind Harbor.

Description.text: <萨缪尔森漫不经心地挠着下巴。>$B$B我的调查表明，啊，貌似暴风城码头工人之间在酝酿着什么骚动。一群鼠辈。别信任他们。$B$B你应该去给他们来个敲山震虎，逼问那些搬运工。这应该够你忙一阵子了。$B$B把暮光异教徒赶出去！
Description.english: <Samuelson scratches his chin, absently.>$B$BMy investigations reveal, ah, it's likely that there's trouble brewing among the Stormwind dock workers. Shifty lot. Don't trust 'em.$B$BYou should go there and shake the place down. Start grilling those longshoremen. That should keep you busy.$B$BGo rout out those Twilight infidels!

identity.title: The Coldbringer
identity.objectives: Kill Amnennar the Coldbringer.
identity.description: Amnennar the Coldbringer rules over the Razorfen Downs with very dark and powerful Scourge magic. I have managed to clear an opening in the thorns just above his seat of power, but his sorcery prevents me from launching an assault.$B$BIf you venture up the Spiral of Thorns and engage him, he will be distracted long enough for me to attack him briefly, weakening him before he can use his most deadly spells. Once he is weakened, destroy him without mercy.

Objectives.text: 杀掉寒冰之王亚门纳尔。
Objectives.english: Kill Amnennar the Coldbringer.

Description.text: 寒冰之王亚门纳尔用非常黑暗强大的天灾魔法统治着剃刀高地。我已经成功地在他宝座上方的荆棘里打开了一个缺口，但他的巫术让我无法发动进攻。$B$B如果你能前往荊棘螺旋同他交手，分散他的注意力，足以让我短暂地对他发动进攻，我就能在他使用最致命的魔法之前将其削弱。一旦他被削弱，你就要无情地将其摧毁。
Description.english: Amnennar the Coldbringer rules over the Razorfen Downs with very dark and powerful Scourge magic. I have managed to clear an opening in the thorns just above his seat of power, but his sorcery prevents me from launching an assault.$B$BIf you venture up the Spiral of Thorns and engage him, he will be distracted long enough for me to attack him briefly, weakening him before he can use his most deadly spells. Once he is weakened, destroy him without mercy.

identity.title: Hallowed Note
identity.objectives: Speak to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.
identity.description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $n. I believe she was sent by the priest trainer, Seer Ravenfeather. If this note is from the seer, I would go looking for her immediately.

Objectives.text: 与纳拉其营地中的鸦羽先知交谈。
