Objectives.english: Speak to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.

Description.text: 就在刚才，有一位信使来找过你，$n。我相信是牧师训练师鸦羽先知派她来的。如果这封信是鸦羽先知写给你的，那么我建议你尽快去找她。
Description.english: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $n. I believe she was sent by the priest trainer, Seer Ravenfeather. If this note is from the seer, I would go looking for her immediately.

identity.title: Consecrated Note
identity.objectives: Speak to Sunwalker Helaku in Camp Narache.
identity.description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $n. I believe she was sent by the paladin trainer, Sunwalker Helaku. If this note is from the sunwalker, I recommend going to see him immediately.

Objectives.text: 与纳拉其营地中的烈日行者赫拉库交谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Sunwalker Helaku in Camp Narache.

Description.text: 就在刚才，有一位信使来找过你，$n。我相信是圣骑士训练师烈日行者赫拉库派她来的。如果这封信是烈日行者写给你的，那么我建议你尽快去找他。
Description.english: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $n. I believe she was sent by the paladin trainer, Sunwalker Helaku. If this note is from the sunwalker, I recommend going to see him immediately.

identity.title: Scourge of the Downs
identity.objectives: If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.
identity.description: Outstanding!  My name is Belnistrasz, and I thank you for rescuing me.  I had given myself up for dead... or worse, as a meal for these Scourge-infested vermin.$B$BListen... rather than just flee, I want to make a difference for all of our sakes.  Would you be up to helping me out to that end?  It's probably dangerous, but somebody needs to do it and I seriously doubt other adventurers will wander into this desolate place.

Objectives.text: 如果你同意协助奔尼斯特拉兹，就再跟他谈谈，把他给你的誓言石还给他。
Objectives.english: If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.

Description.text: 干得漂亮！我的名字叫奔尼斯特拉兹，我谢谢你把我救出来。我本已经准备等死……或者更糟：被这些天灾感染的畜生当成美餐。$B$B听着……与其逃跑，我宁愿为了我们搏一把。你是否愿意与我一同坚持到底？也许事情十分危险，但总有人得去做，而且我严重怀疑其他的冒险者是否会游荡到这凄凉的地方来。
Description.english: Outstanding!  My name is Belnistrasz, and I thank you for rescuing me.  I had given myself up for dead... or worse, as a meal for these Scourge-infested vermin.$B$BListen... rather than just flee, I want to make a difference for all of our sakes.  Would you be up to helping me out to that end?  It's probably dangerous, but somebody needs to do it and I seriously doubt other adventurers will wander into this desolate place.

identity.title: The First Lesson
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using Charge.
identity.description:
You have done well. As you continue along your path, you will grow, learning new techniques that you couldn't have imagined before.

Your first lesson is the power of experience. Go, learn a new ability, and demonstrate it for me.

CompletionLog.text: 去找纳拉其营地的哈鲁特·雷角。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Harutt Thunderhorn at Camp Narache.

identity.title: The Hunter's Path
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.
identity.description: It is time for your first lesson, $n. You have a long way to go to master the ways of the hunter, but as you complete more of your journey, you begin to take new steps on that path.$B$BGo, get more experience, and figure out a new ability. Then, use it on the training dummies here.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习稳固射击。然后在纳拉其营地里找一个训练假人，对它使用5次稳固射击。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.

Description.text: 是时候开始你的第一堂课了，$n。要成为一名真正强大的猎人，你还有很长的路要走，不过每一个新技能都是迈向那个目标的台阶。$B$B去吧，多积累一些经验，并探索出一个新技能。之后，用这里的训练假人来练练手。
Description.english: It is time for your first lesson, $n. You have a long way to go to master the ways of the hunter, but as you complete more of your journey, you begin to take new steps on that path.$B$BGo, get more experience, and figure out a new ability. Then, use it on the training dummies here.

CompletionLog.text: 去找纳拉其营地的兰卡·远箭。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Lanka Farshot at Camp Narache.

identity.title: Extinguishing the Idol
identity.objectives: Protect Belnistrasz.
identity.description: Near the entrance is an idol that functions as a macabre oven for the Quilboar; they...they literally consume their abductees from the Barrens.  I can shut down the idol and render it useless, but I need your aid in doing so.  My plan: escort me to the idol.  Once we arrive, I'll commence the ritual.  I'll barely be able to communicate with you, let alone defend myself.  Protect me while I shut down the idol.$B$BAre you with me, $r? Can I count on you to help me end their atrocities?

Objectives.text: 保护奔尼斯特拉兹。
Objectives.english: Protect Belnistrasz.

Description.text: 在入口处有一个骇人的神像，野猪人用它来做烤炉。他们……事实上，他们把从贫瘠之地绑来的人都吃掉了。我可以关闭神像，让它无法再度使用，但我需要你的协助。我的计划是：护送我到神像那儿去。抵达以后，我将举行一个仪式。到时我将门户大开，几乎无法与你交流。在我关闭神像的时候，你要保护我。$B$B你干不干，$r？我是否能指望你，帮我结束他们的暴行？
Description.english: Near the entrance is an idol that functions as a macabre oven for the Quilboar; they...they literally consume their abductees from the Barrens.  I can shut down the idol and render it useless, but I need your aid in doing so.  My plan: escort me to the idol.  Once we arrive, I'll commence the ritual.  I'll barely be able to communicate with you, let alone defend myself.  Protect me while I shut down the idol.$B$BAre you with me, $r? Can I count on you to help me end their atrocities?

CompletionLog.text: 回到奔尼斯特拉兹的火盆处。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Belnistrasz's Brazier.

identity.title: The Way of the Sunwalkers
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Seal of Command. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache, cast Seal of Command on yourself and hit the dummy.
identity.description:
It is always a pleasure to meet a fellow Sunwalker. We are not as numerous as some of the more ancient orders, but our ways are no less powerful and our members no less respected.$B$BAs you continue on your journey, you will grow closer to the light and gain abilities you couldn't have imagined.

Go, get more experience, and return when you've learned a new ability. Demonstrate it to me.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习命令圣印。然后在纳拉其营地里找一个训练假人，对你自己施放命令圣印并击打它。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Seal of Command. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache, cast Seal of Command on yourself and hit the dummy.

Description.text:
能见到新的烈日行者总是让人欣喜的。我们的人数比不上那些历史悠久的骑士团，但我们的力量并不弱，我们的成员也备受尊敬。$B$B随着你的旅程不断前行，你会离圣光越来越近，并获得你无法想象的新力量。

去吧，多积累些经验。当你学会一个新技能时，回来展示给我看。
Description.english:
It is always a pleasure to meet a fellow Sunwalker. We are not as numerous as some of the more ancient orders, but our ways are no less powerful and our members no less respected.$B$BAs you continue on your journey, you will grow closer to the light and gain abilities you couldn't have imagined.

Go, get more experience, and return when you've learned a new ability. Demonstrate it to me.

identity.title: Partners in Crime
identity.objectives: Kill Glutton, Mordresh Fire Eye, and Tuten'kash.
identity.description: Although Amnennar is the primary threat here, he is far from the only. You need to slay his lieutenants as well if their hold on the Downs is to be released.$B$BGlutton guards the beginning of the Spiral of Thorns.$B$BMordesh stands atop The Bone Pile inciting the Scourge into a ravenous frenzy.$B$BTuten'kash resides underground. In order to bring him out, you must strike the gong in The Caller's Chamber three times.$B$BGood luck, brave hero.

Objectives.text: 杀掉暴食者、火眼莫德雷斯，以及图特卡什。
Objectives.english: Kill Glutton, Mordresh Fire Eye, and Tuten'kash.

Description.text: 尽管亚门纳尔是这里的主要威胁，但他并不是唯一一个。你必须把他的副手们也都干掉，才能将高地从他们的掌握中解放出来。$B$B暴食者守卫着荆棘螺旋的根源部分。$B$B莫德雷斯站在白骨之堆上，把天灾军团煽动得极度狂热。$B$B图特卡什居住在地下。为了把他引出来，你必须在召唤者之厅的锣上敲三下。$B$B祝你好运，勇敢的英雄。
Description.english: Although Amnennar is the primary threat here, he is far from the only. You need to slay his lieutenants as well if their hold on the Downs is to be released.$B$BGlutton guards the beginning of the Spiral of Thorns.$B$BMordesh stands atop The Bone Pile inciting the Scourge into a ravenous frenzy.$B$BTuten'kash resides underground. In order to bring him out, you must strike the gong in The Caller's Chamber three times.$B$BGood luck, brave hero.

identity.title: Primal Strike
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Primal Strike, and then locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using Primal Strike 3 times.
identity.description:
I know you've been busy helping the braves protect Camp Narache from the bristlebacks. We're going to need all the hammers and all the luck we can get.

As your skills increase, so does your connection to the elements. This gives you access to new abilities.

The first of these that we learn is Primal Strike. It should help you fell your enemies faster. Learn it, and then try it out.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习根源打击。然后在纳拉其营地里找一个训练假人，对它使用3次根源打击。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Primal Strike, and then locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using Primal Strike 3 times.

Description.text:
我知道你正忙着协助大家保卫纳拉其营地，抵御刺背野猪人的进攻。我们需要借助一切力量来保卫家园。

随着你的技巧越来越娴熟，你与元素之间的联系也变得更加紧密，由此你可以掌握新的技巧。

我们首先要学的便是根源打击，它将帮助你迅速击打敌人。试着先学会它，然后勤加练习。
Description.english:
I know you've been busy helping the braves protect Camp Narache from the bristlebacks. We're going to need all the hammers and all the luck we can get.

As your skills increase, so does your connection to the elements. This gives you access to new abilities.

The first of these that we learn is Primal Strike. It should help you fell your enemies faster. Learn it, and then try it out.

CompletionLog.text: 去找纳拉其营地的米拉·晨行者。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Meela Dawnstrider at Camp Narache.

identity.title: Cure the Scourge
identity.objectives: Collect 20 Withered Tusks.
identity.description: Far more effective than killing swarm after swarm of Scourge is finding a method to prevent living creatures from ever being turned into them. I have an idea for a fine powder that, when inhaled, may stop the entire process.$B$BI need withered tusks off the unliving Quilboar here to make this powder. Bring me an ample amount, and we may be able to stop the Scourge's growth for good.

Objectives.text: 收集20根枯缩的獠牙。
Objectives.english: Collect 20 Withered Tusks.

Description.text: 比起杀掉一拨又一拨的天灾来，找到一个办法防止活物被转化，将更为有效。我想到了一种粉剂，吸入后或许能阻止整个进程。$B$B我需要死去的野猪人身上枯缩的獠牙来制作这种粉末。给我多找些来，我们或许能永远制止天灾的扩张。
Description.english: Far more effective than killing swarm after swarm of Scourge is finding a method to prevent living creatures from ever being turned into them. I have an idea for a fine powder that, when inhaled, may stop the entire process.$B$BI need withered tusks off the unliving Quilboar here to make this powder. Bring me an ample amount, and we may be able to stop the Scourge's growth for good.

identity.title: Missing Parts
identity.objectives: Gather up 5 Missing Parts from around the Stormwind Harbor.
identity.description: <The Sergeant turns his attention to you.>$B$BLook here, if you want to help speed things up around here, get Flintlocke off my back. A whole shipment of siege engine parts was misplaced and now it's scattered all up and down the dock.$B$BGather up the missing parts and get them to Flintlocke so he can finish construction. He's just across the road from me, waiting.

Objectives.text: 从暴风城港口收集5个遗失的零件。
Objectives.english: Gather up 5 Missing Parts from around the Stormwind Harbor.

Description.text: <军士把注意力转向你。>$B$B你瞧，要是你真的想加快进度，就让弗林特洛克别来烦我。一整船攻城坦克的零件都装错地方了，现在遗落在码头上到处都是。$B$B把遗失的零件收集起来交给弗林特洛克让他赶紧完活。他就在路对面那头等着呢。
Description.english: <The Sergeant turns his attention to you.>$B$BLook here, if you want to help speed things up around here, get Flintlocke off my back. A whole shipment of siege engine parts was misplaced and now it's scattered all up and down the dock.$B$BGather up the missing parts and get them to Flintlocke so he can finish construction. He's just across the road from me, waiting.

identity.title: Peasant Problems
identity.objectives: Escort Prince Anduin to Farmer Wollerton at the Wollerton Stead within Stormwind City. If he's no longer with you, you can find him in Stormwind Keep.
identity.description: I'm not quite ready to go back to the keep yet. Would you like to help me with something?$B$BRecently some of the local farmers were petitioning the King about some missing livestock. My father promised someone would investigate, but the city guard is stretched so thin it'll take weeks.$B$BI thought I would help! It'll encourage the farmers to see someone take action, especially from the royal family. Besides, it's just some missing cows. Nothing dangerous.$B$BTake me to Farmer Wollerton here in the city!

Objectives.text: 护送安度因王子去找暴风城沃勒顿农场的沃勒顿。假如你同他走散了，可以在暴风城王座找到他。
Objectives.english: Escort Prince Anduin to Farmer Wollerton at the Wollerton Stead within Stormwind City. If he's no longer with you, you can find him in Stormwind Keep.

Description.text: 我还没准备好回城堡。你能不能帮我个忙？$B$B最近有些当地的农夫向国王请愿，说是牲畜不见了。父王应允会去调查，但卫兵人手不足，得花上好几个星期。$B$B我想我能帮上忙，只要让农民知道有人，尤其是皇室成员在操心他们的事情就很是宽慰他们了。再说了，不就是牛丢了么，又不危险。$B$B带我去找沃勒顿吧！
Description.english: I'm not quite ready to go back to the keep yet. Would you like to help me with something?$B$BRecently some of the local farmers were petitioning the King about some missing livestock. My father promised someone would investigate, but the city guard is stretched so thin it'll take weeks.$B$BI thought I would help! It'll encourage the farmers to see someone take action, especially from the royal family. Besides, it's just some missing cows. Nothing dangerous.$B$BTake me to Farmer Wollerton here in the city!

identity.title: Unholy Cow
identity.objectives: While escorting Anduin Wrynn, follow the trail of gore from Farmer Wollerton's Stead to the crime scene. Keep Anduin alive. If he's not with you, he will be waiting in Stormwind Keep.
identity.description: <Farmer Wollerton tries to pull himself together.>$B$BCows? You're asking about the missing livestock?$B$BI normally just let the cows graze north of the house here. Occasionally one gets spirited away. Leaves a trail of gore. Who would do such a thing?$B$BI'm afraid to follow that trail myself... something sick is happening in Stormwind!

Objectives.text: 护送安度因·乌瑞恩沿着血迹从沃勒顿的农场前往犯罪现场。确保安度因的安全。假如你同他走散了，可以在暴风城王座找到他。
Objectives.english: While escorting Anduin Wrynn, follow the trail of gore from Farmer Wollerton's Stead to the crime scene. Keep Anduin alive. If he's not with you, he will be waiting in Stormwind Keep.

Description.text: <沃勒顿试图恢复镇静。>$B$B牛？您是说失踪的牲畜一事？$B$B平常我就将牛放养在房子北边。突然有一只走丢了，留下一道血迹。谁会做那样的事情？$B$B我是不敢沿着血迹去找……暴风城里有些病态的东西！
Description.english: <Farmer Wollerton tries to pull himself together.>$B$BCows? You're asking about the missing livestock?$B$BI normally just let the cows graze north of the house here. Occasionally one gets spirited away. Leaves a trail of gore. Who would do such a thing?$B$BI'm afraid to follow that trail myself... something sick is happening in Stormwind!

identity.title: He's Holding Out on Us
identity.objectives: Escort Anduin Wrynn to the third floor of SI:7 Headquarters in the Old Town district of Stormwind. If he is no longer with you, you can find Anduin in Stormwind Keep.
identity.description: $n, it almost seems like Samuelson is trying to intentionally waste your time. The dockworkers don't know anything. More importantly, explosives are missing from Stormwind Harbor!$B$BYou know what I think? I bet Samuelson knows more than he's letting on. He probably has a lead on Twilight's Hammer and wants all the credit and glory for himself.$B$BWe should peek through his records at the SI:7 headquarters. Take me there and I should be allowed to look at his files and find out what he really knows.

Objectives.text: 护送安度因·乌瑞恩前往暴风城旧城区军情七处总部三楼。假如你同他走散了，可以在暴风城王座找到他。
Objectives.english: Escort Anduin Wrynn to the third floor of SI:7 Headquarters in the Old Town district of Stormwind. If he is no longer with you, you can find Anduin in Stormwind Keep.

Description.text: $n，看来萨缪尔森是故意要浪费我们的时间。码头工人什么都不知道。更重要的是，暴风城港口丢了炸药！$B$B知道我在想什么吗？我打赌萨缪尔森所知的要比他告诉我们得多。他可能已经有了暮光之锤的头绪，想把功劳独吞。$B$B我们应该偷偷查查他在军情七处总部的档案，看看他到底知道些什么。带我过去，他们应该拦不住我。
Description.english: $n, it almost seems like Samuelson is trying to intentionally waste your time. The dockworkers don't know anything. More importantly, explosives are missing from Stormwind Harbor!$B$BYou know what I think? I bet Samuelson knows more than he's letting on. He probably has a lead on Twilight's Hammer and wants all the credit and glory for himself.$B$BWe should peek through his records at the SI:7 headquarters. Take me there and I should be allowed to look at his files and find out what he really knows.

identity.title: Learning the Word
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Practice using it 5 times on Training Dummies in Camp Narache.
identity.description:
As you become more skilled, your skills will expand, and you will gain access to many new powers.

Go - get some experience out there, and come back to me when you've learned something new. You can demonstrate on the training dummies nearby.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习暗言术：痛。然后对纳拉其营地里的训练假人施放5次暗言术：痛。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Practice using it 5 times on Training Dummies in Camp Narache.

Description.text:
随着你的技巧越来越娴熟，你的技能也将得到延伸，并由此领悟出新的力量。

去吧——到野外多积累些经验，等你学到新法术后回来见我。你可以拿附近的训练假人来露两手给我瞧瞧。
Description.english:
As you become more skilled, your skills will expand, and you will gain access to many new powers.

Go - get some experience out there, and come back to me when you've learned something new. You can demonstrate on the training dummies nearby.

CompletionLog.text: 去找纳拉其营地的鸦羽先知。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Seer Ravenfeather at Camp Narache.

identity.title: Moonfire
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Moonfire. Practice using it on a Training Dummy in Camp Narache.
identity.description:
As you develop your skills, druid, you will begin to feel your connection to the Earthmother deepening. You will begin to understand new secrets of nature, and learn to cast new spells.

Go now, get more experience, and return to me when you've learned a new spell. Demonstrate what you've learned.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习月火术。然后在纳拉其营地中对一个训练假人施放月火术。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Moonfire. Practice using it on a Training Dummy in Camp Narache.

Description.text:
德鲁伊，随着你的技巧越来越娴熟，你会开始感受到你与大地之母的联系变得越来越紧密。你将逐步开始领悟自然的奥秘，学会使用新法术。

去吧，多积累一些经验。当你学会新法术后，记得回来找我，并向我展示一下你都学到了些什么。
Description.english:
As you develop your skills, druid, you will begin to feel your connection to the Earthmother deepening. You will begin to understand new secrets of nature, and learn to cast new spells.

Go now, get more experience, and return to me when you've learned a new spell. Demonstrate what you've learned.

identity.title: The Old Barracks
identity.objectives: Go to the Old Barracks and slay 6 Crazed Cultists, then locate Jack Bauden.
identity.description: I recognize the symbol on these badges from before Deathwing's attack on the city. It belonged to soldiers in the old barracks, west of town overlooking the harbor.$B$BYour timing couldn't be better. One of my top agents, Jack Bauden, has been trying to infiltrate the Twilight's Hammer cult for me. Last night he went missing. If you and Anduin are right, the cultists are holed up in the old barracks. Time is urgent! Assault the old barracks, take out those cultists, and rescue Jack Bauden.

Objectives.text: 前往旧兵营杀死6名发疯的异教徒，找到杰克·伯登。
Objectives.english: Go to the Old Barracks and slay 6 Crazed Cultists, then locate Jack Bauden.

Description.text: 我记得这徽章是死亡之翼攻击城市之前的东西，属于旧兵营的士兵。那地方就在城西，俯瞰港口。$B$B你来的正是时候，我手下最棒的探员杰克·伯登正在暮光之锤教派中做卧底。昨晚他失去消息了。如果你和安度因是对的，那些邪教徒就窝藏在旧兵营里。时间不多了！攻击旧兵营，解决教徒，救出杰克·伯登。
Description.english: I recognize the symbol on these badges from before Deathwing's attack on the city. It belonged to soldiers in the old barracks, west of town overlooking the harbor.$B$BYour timing couldn't be better. One of my top agents, Jack Bauden, has been trying to infiltrate the Twilight's Hammer cult for me. Last night he went missing. If you and Anduin are right, the cultists are holed up in the old barracks. Time is urgent! Assault the old barracks, take out those cultists, and rescue Jack Bauden.

identity.title: Charge!
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Locate a Training Dummy outside the Sunspire and practice using Charge.
identity.description: Good. You are off to a bright start. This road will be long, and as you become more accomplished, you will begin to discover that you can do things you could never have imagined before.$B$BGo, get more experience, and learn a new technique. Once you have, demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级，学习冲锋。然后在太阳之塔外面找一个训练假人，对它进行冲锋。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Locate a Training Dummy outside the Sunspire and practice using Charge.

Description.text: 好的开始是成功的一半，这条路会很长。在你越来越得心应手之后，你会开始发现你能做到之前无法想象的事情。$B$B去吧，多积累一些经验，学习一门新技巧。一旦你学成了，就找一个训练假人来给我露两手。
Description.english: Good. You are off to a bright start. This road will be long, and as you become more accomplished, you will begin to discover that you can do things you could never have imagined before.$B$BGo, get more experience, and learn a new technique. Once you have, demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

CompletionLog.text: 去找逐日者之岛的太阳之塔里的德利奥斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Delios in the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.

identity.title: Cataclysm in the Catacombs
identity.objectives: Enter the Cathedral of Light and descend into the catacombs below. Slay the Black Bishop and disarm the Pile of Explosives nearby.
identity.description: Don't worry about me, $c. I've uncovered the Twilight's Hammer plot. They've been stealing and stockpiling explosives coming into Stormwind harbor. Somehow, they've gotten access to the catacombs underneath the Cathedral of Light. I've heard talk of someone called "The Black Bishop."$B$BThere's no time to warn the guard, $n! You've got just minutes to get into the catacombs and disarm that bomb. Go! Now! Or THOUSANDS of PEOPLE will DIE!

Objectives.text: 进入光明大教堂地下陵墓。杀掉黑主教，熄灭附近的炸药堆。
Objectives.english: Enter the Cathedral of Light and descend into the catacombs below. Slay the Black Bishop and disarm the Pile of Explosives nearby.

Description.text: 别担心我，$c。我发现了暮光之锤的阴谋。他们一直在偷窃并通过暴风城港口运输囤积炸药。不知是怎么回事，他们打通了光明大教堂下面的墓道。我听人提到什么“黑主教”。$B$B通知警卫已经来不及了，$n！你必须赶快赶到墓室去，拆除炸弹，快！赶紧去！否则成千上万的人都难逃一死！
Description.english: Don't worry about me, $c. I've uncovered the Twilight's Hammer plot. They've been stealing and stockpiling explosives coming into Stormwind harbor. Somehow, they've gotten access to the catacombs underneath the Cathedral of Light. I've heard talk of someone called "The Black Bishop."$B$BThere's no time to warn the guard, $n! You've got just minutes to get into the catacombs and disarm that bomb. Go! Now! Or THOUSANDS of PEOPLE will DIE!

identity.title: A Villain Unmasked
identity.objectives: Unmask and slay Major Samuelson in the Stormwind Keep Throne Room.
identity.description: <You find a complete list of all the Twilight's Hammer cultists in Stormwind.>$B$B<More importantly, you discover a letter from Major Samuelson to his compatriots outlining this entire scheme. The Prince was right: Samuelson is the real villain here, using his connections as commander of the city guard to disguise cult activity.>$B$B<It's time to return to Stormwind Keep and bring Samuelson to justice!>

Objectives.text: 在暴风城堡王座揭露萨缪尔森上校的真面目并将他就地处决。
Objectives.english: Unmask and slay Major Samuelson in the Stormwind Keep Throne Room.

Description.text: <你发现了一份暴风城暮光之锤教徒成员名单。>$B$B<更重要的是，你找到了一封萨缪尔森上校写给同伙的信，信内详述了整个阴谋。王子是对的：萨缪尔森才是真正的坏人，用他在卫兵中的指挥地位来掩护邪教的活动。>$B$B<是回到暴风城堡，将萨缪尔森绳之以法的时候了！>
Description.english: <You find a complete list of all the Twilight's Hammer cultists in Stormwind.>$B$B<More importantly, you discover a letter from Major Samuelson to his compatriots outlining this entire scheme. The Prince was right: Samuelson is the real villain here, using his connections as commander of the city guard to disguise cult activity.>$B$B<It's time to return to Stormwind Keep and bring Samuelson to justice!>

identity.title: Alexi's Gambit
identity.objectives: Place the Gambit in the Viewing Room and slay Vectus and Marduk.
identity.description: I require your assistance, $c. Find the undead mage Vectus and the warrior Marduk deep within here. They run the scourge's plagued dragon operation and must be destroyed.$B$BPlace this Gambit in the viewing room where they are located. Hopefully, it will react with their forces and utterly destroy them!$B$BOh, defeating Vectus and Marduk afterward shouldn't be a problem.  Right?

Objectives.text: 将阿莱克斯的谋略箱放在观察室里，然后杀死维克图斯和玛杜克。
Objectives.english: Place the Gambit in the Viewing Room and slay Vectus and Marduk.

Description.text: 我需要你的帮助，$c。找到这里深处的亡灵法师维克图斯和战士玛杜克。他们负责天灾军团的瘟疫之龙相关的计划，因此你必须除掉他们。$B$B把这个谋略箱放在观察室里，一切顺利的话，它会与他们手下的爪牙发生反应，并彻底地消灭他们！$B$B哦，当然，在这之后顺便干掉维克图斯和玛杜克对你来说根本不是问题，对吧？
Description.english: I require your assistance, $c. Find the undead mage Vectus and the warrior Marduk deep within here. They run the scourge's plagued dragon operation and must be destroyed.$B$BPlace this Gambit in the viewing room where they are located. Hopefully, it will react with their forces and utterly destroy them!$B$BOh, defeating Vectus and Marduk afterward shouldn't be a problem.  Right?

identity.title: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
identity.objectives: Destroy Ras Frostwhisper.
identity.description: One of Kel'Thuzad's most trusted students oversees the operations in Scholomance. You must confront the lich, Ras Frostwhisper, in his lair. The door to his chamber is adjacent to the viewing room.$B$BDestroy him, $n. Leave no trace of his existence so that he may never again bring such horrors into our world.

Objectives.text: 消灭莱斯·霜语。
Objectives.english: Destroy Ras Frostwhisper.

Description.text: 克尔苏加德最信任的学生之一正在监管通灵学院的运作。你必须前往巫妖莱斯·霜语的老巢，并向他发起挑战。只有在你杀死黑暗院长加丁之后，从观察室通往巫妖房间的大门才会打开。$B$B消灭他，$n。将他的存在彻底抹消掉，这样才能确保他不再重返我们的世界。
Description.english: One of Kel'Thuzad's most trusted students oversees the operations in Scholomance. You must confront the lich, Ras Frostwhisper, in his lair. The door to his chamber is adjacent to the viewing room.$B$BDestroy him, $n. Leave no trace of his existence so that he may never again bring such horrors into our world.

identity.title: Barov Family Fortune
identity.objectives: Recover The Deed to Caer Darrow, The Deed to Brill, The Deed to Tarren Mill, and The Deed to Southshore.
identity.description: Within Scholomance lays the Barov family fortune. Alexi and I are the last two Barovs in existence.$B$BHowever, I am the only living Barov, so our family's vast empire belongs to me! Find me the deeds to Caer Darrow, Brill, Tarren Mill, and Southshore and I will repay you generously. The Barov estate will be reborn at long last!

Objectives.text: 取回凯尔达隆地契、布瑞尔地契、塔伦米尔地契，以及南海镇地契。
Objectives.english: Recover The Deed to Caer Darrow, The Deed to Brill, The Deed to Tarren Mill, and The Deed to Southshore.

Description.text: 通灵学院中藏着巴罗夫家族的遗产。我和阿莱克斯是这个家族硕果仅存的两名后嗣。$B$B不过呢，我是巴罗夫家唯一的活人，所以我们家族的庞大帝国现在就是我的啦！去帮我找到凯尔达隆、布瑞尔、塔伦米尔和南海镇的地契，我会好好奖赏你的。巴罗夫家道中兴的日子就要来临了！
Description.english: Within Scholomance lays the Barov family fortune. Alexi and I are the last two Barovs in existence.$B$BHowever, I am the only living Barov, so our family's vast empire belongs to me! Find me the deeds to Caer Darrow, Brill, Tarren Mill, and Southshore and I will repay you generously. The Barov estate will be reborn at long last!

identity.title: Plagued Hatchlings...For Now
identity.objectives: Kill 10 Plagued Hatchlings and Rattlegore.
identity.description: One of the 'projects' underway here is the plagued dragonflight. Thankfully, they're only hatchlings right now, but if we wait much longer they will become one of the scourge's most powerful weapons and a major threat to all of Azeroth, especially my family's land!$B$BSlay ten of their whelps and be sure to take care of Rattlegore as well. He is in the small space beneath where the whelps are housed and prepares supplements to catalyze their growth. Hurry...before they get any bigger!

Objectives.text: 杀死血骨傀儡和10只天灾龙崽。
Objectives.english: Kill 10 Plagued Hatchlings and Rattlegore.

Description.text: 这里进行的若干“项目”之一就是瘟疫之龙。谢天谢地，它们眼下还只是小龙崽子，但是如果我们袖手旁观，它们就会变成天灾军团最强大的武器之一，对艾泽拉斯造成巨大的威胁，尤其是我家的地产！$B$B去干掉十只小龙崽子，顺便也把血骨傀儡除掉。它就在那些幼龙所在房间的下方，为它们准备着成长所需的食品。快一点……趁它们还没长大！
Description.english: One of the 'projects' underway here is the plagued dragonflight. Thankfully, they're only hatchlings right now, but if we wait much longer they will become one of the scourge's most powerful weapons and a major threat to all of Azeroth, especially my family's land!$B$BSlay ten of their whelps and be sure to take care of Rattlegore as well. He is in the small space beneath where the whelps are housed and prepares supplements to catalyze their growth. Hurry...before they get any bigger!

identity.title: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
identity.objectives: Destroy Doctor Theolen Krastinov, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff.
identity.description: Doctor Theolen Krastinov is responsible for the deaths of thousands. His nickname, The Butcher, is well earned for the atrocities he takes joy in executing. He must be punished, justice must be meted out.$B$BFind him and exact upon him the agony he has inflicted upon countless innocents, including me and my husband. Once he is destroyed, burn our remains. Turn them to ashes, $n. Release our grieving souls.

Title.text: 瑟尔林·卡斯迪诺夫教授

Objectives.text: 消灭瑟尔林·卡斯迪诺夫教授，并烧毁艾瓦·萨克霍夫和卢森·萨克霍夫的遗体。
Objectives.english: Destroy Doctor Theolen Krastinov, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff.

Description.text: 瑟尔林·卡斯迪诺夫教授杀死了数千条生命。他的绰号“屠夫”就是由于他非常乐于此道而得的。他必须得到惩罚，正义必须得到伸张。$B$B找到他，让他也尝尝他给那些无辜者带来的痛苦，包括我和我的丈夫。在他死掉之后，烧毁我们的遗体，让它们都化为灰烬，$n。让我们悲伤的灵魂得到安息。
Description.english: Doctor Theolen Krastinov is responsible for the deaths of thousands. His nickname, The Butcher, is well earned for the atrocities he takes joy in executing. He must be punished, justice must be meted out.$B$BFind him and exact upon him the agony he has inflicted upon countless innocents, including me and my husband. Once he is destroyed, burn our remains. Turn them to ashes, $n. Release our grieving souls.

identity.title: Kirtonos the Herald
identity.objectives: Destroy Kirtonos.
identity.description: With blood, Kirtonos may be summoned. It is with blood, then, that Kirtonos must be destroyed.$B$BWithin the Chamber of Summoning, you will find a brazier, upon which you shall place a drop of your own blood. Kirtonos will come - he cannot resist. When he appears, unleash the fury and wrath of a thousand innocent deaths upon him.$B$BShould you succeed, you will earn more than just our gratitude.

Objectives.text: 杀死基尔图诺斯。
Objectives.english: Destroy Kirtonos.

Description.text: 鲜血将唤来基尔图诺斯，鲜血亦将毁灭基尔图诺斯。$B$B前往召唤大厅，将一滴你自己的鲜血滴入火盆中。基尔图诺斯会出现的——他无法抵抗这血液的诱惑。当他出现时，释放出那些愤怒的无辜者的魂。$B$B如果你成功的话，你所能得到的不仅仅是我们的感激之情。
Description.english: With blood, Kirtonos may be summoned. It is with blood, then, that Kirtonos must be destroyed.$B$BWithin the Chamber of Summoning, you will find a brazier, upon which you shall place a drop of your own blood. Kirtonos will come - he cannot resist. When he appears, unleash the fury and wrath of a thousand innocent deaths upon him.$B$BShould you succeed, you will earn more than just our gratitude.

identity.title: School's Out Forever
identity.objectives: Kill Darkmaster Gandling.
identity.description: Darkmaster Gandling serves as headmaster of Scholomance, and is therefore responsible for countless deaths at the hands of his students. For that he must be punished.$B$BHe will not come out easily. Lure him out by slaying his six professors whose rooms connect to the Headmaster's Study. Be wary, for when the last falls he will come, and he will come infuriated with vast magic backing his assault. Don't let him make it out of here alive.

Objectives.text: 杀死黑暗院长加丁。
Objectives.english: Kill Darkmaster Gandling.

Description.text: 黑暗院长加丁是通灵学院的领导者，因此他必须为死在他的学生手上的无数生命负责，得到应有的惩罚。$B$B他不会轻易现身。你必须把他手下的六名教授全部干掉，他们的房间全都与院长的书房相连。这样一来，他就会被引诱出来。你要多加小心，当最后一名教授倒下时，他就会出现，并且会怒不可遏地使用强大的魔法。不要让他活着走出这里。
Description.english: Darkmaster Gandling serves as headmaster of Scholomance, and is therefore responsible for countless deaths at the hands of his students. For that he must be punished.$B$BHe will not come out easily. Lure him out by slaying his six professors whose rooms connect to the Headmaster's Study. Be wary, for when the last falls he will come, and he will come infuriated with vast magic backing his assault. Don't let him make it out of here alive.

identity.title: School of the Damned
identity.objectives: Speak to Walden Barov in Scholomance.
identity.description: Greetings! As you can see, the Western Plaguelands is very nearly free of the last remnants of the scourge. However, their school of necromancy, Scholomance, still sits full of lost young souls training to become scourge sorcerers! Our work here will be for naught if we do not stop this flow of fresh, not to mention very powerful, necromancers.$B$BTravel southeast to Scholomance and find Weldon Barov. He is the last living member of the Barov line that once owned all these lands and is our current contact.

Objectives.text: 与通灵学院里的维尔顿·巴罗夫交谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Walden Barov in Scholomance.

Description.text: 你好！正如你所见，西瘟疫之地几乎要彻底摆脱天灾军团的威胁了。但是，他们的亡灵巫术学校——通灵学院，却仍然充斥着想要成为天灾巫师的迷途青年！如果我们不阻止这批新鲜而且强大的亡灵巫师，那我们的努力可就算是白费了。$B$B到东南方的通灵学院去，找到维尔顿·巴罗夫。他是曾拥有这片土地的巴罗夫家族的唯一幸存者，也是我们的线人。
Description.english: Greetings! As you can see, the Western Plaguelands is very nearly free of the last remnants of the scourge. However, their school of necromancy, Scholomance, still sits full of lost young souls training to become scourge sorcerers! Our work here will be for naught if we do not stop this flow of fresh, not to mention very powerful, necromancers.$B$BTravel southeast to Scholomance and find Weldon Barov. He is the last living member of the Barov line that once owned all these lands and is our current contact.

identity.title: The Menders' Stead
identity.objectives: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.
identity.description: It's likely that the battle for Andorhal will start up again soon.  In the meantime, you could probably stand to practice your skills as a $c.$b$bEast of here is a large farm that has been taken over by the Argent Dawn and the Cenarion Circle.  I don't doubt that they'll have some work for you.

Objectives.text: 向西瘟疫之地治愈者营地的战地特工卡尔缇舍报告。
Objectives.english: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

Description.text: 看来安多哈尔的战斗又要开始了。与此同时，你可能准备好磨练自己作为$c的技艺。$b$b从这儿往西有一个大农场，被银色黎明和塞纳里奥议会当作据点。我想他们会有活可以让你干。
Description.english: It's likely that the battle for Andorhal will start up again soon.  In the meantime, you could probably stand to practice your skills as a $c.$b$bEast of here is a large farm that has been taken over by the Argent Dawn and the Cenarion Circle.  I don't doubt that they'll have some work for you.

CompletionLog.text: 向西瘟疫之地治愈者营地的战地特工卡尔缇舍报告。
CompletionLog.english: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

identity.title: The Menders' Stead
identity.objectives: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.
identity.description: I can handle training from here.  If you're looking for something else to do, I recommend heading up the road to the northwest.  The Cenarion druids and Argent Crusade have a small camp set up there, at Dalson's old farm.  Maybe they can keep you busy until we need your help again.

Objectives.text: 向西瘟疫之地治愈者营地的战地特工卡尔缇舍报告。
Objectives.english: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

Description.text: 我可以接手这里的训练。要是你想找事情做的话，我建议你去西北边。塞纳里奥德鲁伊和银色黎明十字军设立了一处营地，就在达尔松的旧农场。也许他们能让你忙上一阵子，直到我们再度需要人手。
Description.english: I can handle training from here.  If you're looking for something else to do, I recommend heading up the road to the northwest.  The Cenarion druids and Argent Crusade have a small camp set up there, at Dalson's old farm.  Maybe they can keep you busy until we need your help again.

CompletionLog.text: 向西瘟疫之地治愈者营地的战地特工卡尔缇舍报告。
CompletionLog.english: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

identity.title: REUSE - BAD COPY
identity.objectives: Speak with Vincent Hyal in Menethil Harbor.
identity.description: Before working here at the Blue Recluse, I was trained by one of the best chefs and innkeepers I'd ever met. His name was James Hyal. Everything I have and everywhere I've gotten in life is thanks to him.$b$bI wonder how he's doing. His brother Vincent and he went to work in a tavern in Menethil Harbor, but I haven't heard from him recently.$b$bIf you ever happen to be headed in that direction, maybe you could say hello to him for me?

Objectives.text: 和米奈希尔港的文森特·海厄尔谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Vincent Hyal in Menethil Harbor.

Description.text: 在蓝色隐士旅店干活之前，我曾在一个最棒的厨师兼旅店老板手下学艺，他的名字是詹姆斯·海厄尔。我今天能有这样的成就都得归功于他。$b$b不知道他现在在干什么，他和他的兄弟文森特到米奈希尔港的一家旅店去工作了，不过最近我一直没听到他的消息。$b$b你要是碰巧要往米奈希尔去的话，能不能帮我问候他一下？
Description.english: Before working here at the Blue Recluse, I was trained by one of the best chefs and innkeepers I'd ever met. His name was James Hyal. Everything I have and everywhere I've gotten in life is thanks to him.$b$bI wonder how he's doing. His brother Vincent and he went to work in a tavern in Menethil Harbor, but I haven't heard from him recently.$b$bIf you ever happen to be headed in that direction, maybe you could say hello to him for me?

identity.title: The Chief Surgeon
identity.objectives: Speak to Chief Surgeon Gashweld in Stormwind's Dwarven District.
identity.description: I have an urgent message for you from Stormwind, $n. Chief Surgeon Gashweld has asked to meet with you in Stormwind. The message didn't say what the chief surgeon wanted to discuss, but you should make your way to Stormwind as quickly as you can. Look for Chief Surgeon Gashweld in the Dwarven District of the city.

Objectives.text: 跟暴风城矮人区的首席外科医生焊创谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Chief Surgeon Gashweld in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

Description.text: $n，我收到一条来自暴风城的紧急消息。首席外科医生焊创要你去暴风城会面。信使没提到具体的谈话内容，但是你最好尽快赶往暴风城。去矮人区找首席外科医生焊创吧。
Description.english: I have an urgent message for you from Stormwind, $n. Chief Surgeon Gashweld has asked to meet with you in Stormwind. The message didn't say what the chief surgeon wanted to discuss, but you should make your way to Stormwind as quickly as you can. Look for Chief Surgeon Gashweld in the Dwarven District of the city.

identity.title: The Elements Cry Out
identity.objectives: Speak with Erunak Stonespeaker in Stormwind.
identity.description: Do you feel it, $c?  The elements are uneasy. We members of the Earthen Ring have struggled to find the cause of the unrest.  Thus far we have been unsuccessful and now turn to others that may aid us.  Speak with Erunak Stonespeaker in Stormwind and see how you might be able to aid us.

Objectives.text: 跟暴风城的石语者埃鲁纳克谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Erunak Stonespeaker in Stormwind.

Description.text: 你感觉到了吗，$c？元素生物陷入焦虑难安的状态。大地之环的成员正在努力查明这场动乱的真相。但是迄今为止我们仍一无所获，只能求助于一切可能的援助力量。跟暴风城的石语者埃鲁纳克谈一谈，看看你能不能帮上忙。
Description.english: Do you feel it, $c?  The elements are uneasy. We members of the Earthen Ring have struggled to find the cause of the unrest.  Thus far we have been unsuccessful and now turn to others that may aid us.  Speak with Erunak Stonespeaker in Stormwind and see how you might be able to aid us.

CompletionLog.text: 跟暴风城的石语者埃鲁纳克谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Erunak Stonespeaker in Stormwind.

identity.title: The Elements Cry Out
identity.objectives: Speak to Earthmender Norsala in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: Do you feel it, $c?  The elements are uneasy. We members of the Earthen Ring have struggled to find the cause of the unrest.  Thus far we have been unsuccessful and now turn to others that may aid us.  Speak with Earthmender Norsala in Orgrimmar and see what tasks she may have for you.

Objectives.text: 跟奥格瑞玛的大地治愈者诺莎拉谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Earthmender Norsala in Orgrimmar.

Description.text: 你感觉到了吗，$C？元素生物陷入焦虑难安的状态。大地之环的成员正在努力查明这场动乱的真相。但是迄今为止我们仍一无所获，只能求助于一切可能的援助力量。跟奥格瑞玛的大地治愈者诺莎拉谈一谈，看看你能不能帮上忙。
Description.english: Do you feel it, $c?  The elements are uneasy. We members of the Earthen Ring have struggled to find the cause of the unrest.  Thus far we have been unsuccessful and now turn to others that may aid us.  Speak with Earthmender Norsala in Orgrimmar and see what tasks she may have for you.

CompletionLog.text: 跟奥格瑞玛的大地治愈者诺莎拉谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Earthmender Norsala in Orgrimmar.

identity.title: The Grimtotem Plot
identity.objectives: Collect 4 Grimtotem Notes from Grimtotem Elders and combine them to form the full Grimtotem Battle Plan.
identity.description: With the activities of the Grimtotems in Thousand Needles brought to light, many tauren now regard them with suspicion.  We've seen high-ranking Grimtotems engage in murder and kidnapping to advance their interests and I fear we may become their next target.$B$BBlackhoof Village, to the northeast, near Bluefen, is a large new Grimtotem settlement. Their leaders, the elders, will all have orders from Thunder Bluff. See if you can capture the orders and piece them together to learn the Grimtotems' plans.

Objectives.text: 從恐怖圖騰長者那裡收集4份恐怖圖騰的註記，並合成完整的恐怖圖騰的作戰計畫。
Objectives.english: Collect 4 Grimtotem Notes from Grimtotem Elders and combine them to form the full Grimtotem Battle Plan.

Description.text: 自從恐怖圖騰在千針石林的活動曝光以後，許多牛頭人都對他們抱著猜忌的心態。我們曾經看過恐怖圖騰的高階成員犯下謀殺和綁架的罪行以達成他們的目的，而我擔心我們將會是他們的下一個目標。$B$B恐怖圖騰在這裡的東北方，藍色沼地附近建立了一座新的營地: 黑蹄村。他們的領導人，也就是長者們將會從雷霆崖接獲命令。看看你是否能搶奪這些命令，並且把它們整合起來以洞悉恐怖圖騰的計畫。
Description.english: With the activities of the Grimtotems in Thousand Needles brought to light, many tauren now regard them with suspicion.  We've seen high-ranking Grimtotems engage in murder and kidnapping to advance their interests and I fear we may become their next target.$B$BBlackhoof Village, to the northeast, near Bluefen, is a large new Grimtotem settlement. Their leaders, the elders, will all have orders from Thunder Bluff. See if you can capture the orders and piece them together to learn the Grimtotems' plans.

CompletionLog.text: 到塵泥沼澤找克羅格。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Krog in Dustwallow Marsh.

identity.title: Seek the Shadow-Walker
identity.objectives: Speak with Shadow-Walker Zuru in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
identity.description: Shadow-Walker Zuru requires your presence in Orgrimmar right away, $n. Do not keep him waiting, as it sounds like a matter of some importance.$B$BYou can find the shadow-walker in the Valley of Spirits inside Orgrimmar.

Objectives.text: 跟奥格瑞玛精神谷的暗影行者祖鲁谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Shadow-Walker Zuru in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.

Description.text: 暗影行者祖鲁要你立即赶往奥格瑞玛，$n。看来是什么重要的事情，别让他久等。$B$B你可以在奥格瑞玛的精神谷找到暗影行者。
Description.english: Shadow-Walker Zuru requires your presence in Orgrimmar right away, $n. Do not keep him waiting, as it sounds like a matter of some importance.$B$BYou can find the shadow-walker in the Valley of Spirits inside Orgrimmar.

identity.title: The Call of the Blade
identity.objectives: Investigate the battle site at the southern end of the Ruins of Vashj'ir.
identity.description: I sense a strong power calling to me from the ruins. Can you check again on that southern battle site for me?  I'm certain that there's something there.

Objectives.text: 调查瓦丝琪尔废墟南端的战斗现场。
Objectives.english: Investigate the battle site at the southern end of the Ruins of Vashj'ir.

Description.text: 我感应到废墟中有一股强大力量在召唤我。你能再帮我去查查南部战斗现场吗？我敢肯定那儿有东西。
Description.english: I sense a strong power calling to me from the ruins. Can you check again on that southern battle site for me?  I'm certain that there's something there.

identity.title: Army of the Black Dragon
identity.objectives: Tharg in Brackenwall Village wants you to kill 10 Firemane Scouts, 10 Firemane Ash Tails, and 5 Firemane Scalebanes.
identity.description: Mok'Morokk was made Overlord by Rexxar. He care more for power than he care for ogres.$b$bBlack dragons kill many ogre. Kill Tharg's wife. Mok'Morokk tell us to run. Make us come here.$b$bOgre should fight. Ogres not good at running. Mok'Morokk care only about Mok'Morokk.$b$bMe call Stonemaul Ruins home. Me like it in the south. This place not home.$b$bHelp ogres fight army of the black dragon. Me want revenge. Me want to go home.

Objectives.text: 蕨墙村的萨尔格要你去杀掉10个火鬃斥候，10个火鬃灰尾龙人和5个火鬃守卫。
Objectives.english: Tharg in Brackenwall Village wants you to kill 10 Firemane Scouts, 10 Firemane Ash Tails, and 5 Firemane Scalebanes.

Description.text: 雷克萨让莫格穆洛克做大王。莫格穆洛克只知道权力，很少关心食人魔。$b$b黑龙杀了很多食人魔，还杀了萨尔格的妻子。莫格穆洛克叫我们逃跑，让我们到这儿来。$b$b食人魔应该战斗。食人魔不逃跑。莫格穆洛克只关心他自己。$b$b我只把石槌村叫做家。我喜欢南边。这地方不是家。$b$b帮食人魔打黑龙军团。我们要复仇。我们要回家。
Description.english: Mok'Morokk was made Overlord by Rexxar. He care more for power than he care for ogres.$b$bBlack dragons kill many ogre. Kill Tharg's wife. Mok'Morokk tell us to run. Make us come here.$b$bOgre should fight. Ogres not good at running. Mok'Morokk care only about Mok'Morokk.$b$bMe call Stonemaul Ruins home. Me like it in the south. This place not home.$b$bHelp ogres fight army of the black dragon. Me want revenge. Me want to go home.

CompletionLog.text: 去尘泥沼泽，找蕨墙村的萨尔格。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Tharg at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

identity.title: A Seer's Staff
identity.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Commander's Holy Symbol from Commander Springvale, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
identity.description: In the eyes of the Earthmother, you are ready to become a full seer. You have completed your early training with skill and dedication.$B$BTo mark this occasion, the warchief has commissioned his master enchanter to create a staff for you.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials you'll need. Travel there and find the lost holy symbol of Commander Springvale, a supply of moontouched wood, and the essence of the ghosts that haunt the keep.

Objectives.text: 去影牙城堡指挥官斯普林瓦尔处收集指挥官的神圣符记，还有5捆月触之木和5份幽灵精华。
Objectives.english: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Commander's Holy Symbol from Commander Springvale, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Ghostly Essence.

Description.text: 在大地母亲的眼里，你已经准备好成为一名完完全全的先知了。凭着技巧和热诚，你完成了你的早期训练。$B$B为了纪念这一时刻，酋长已经委托他的大附魔师为你制造一柄法杖。$B$B银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡是唯一一个可以获得你所需材料的地方。去那里将失落的指挥官的神圣符记找来，并收集一些月触之木，以及在城堡里游荡的鬼魂的精华来。
Description.english: In the eyes of the Earthmother, you are ready to become a full seer. You have completed your early training with skill and dedication.$B$BTo mark this occasion, the warchief has commissioned his master enchanter to create a staff for you.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials you'll need. Travel there and find the lost holy symbol of Commander Springvale, a supply of moontouched wood, and the essence of the ghosts that haunt the keep.

identity.title: The Situation So Far
identity.objectives: Speak with Gotura Fourwinds in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: No doubt you've felt the earthquakes.  You may even have seen elementals attacking the lands or towns.  The Earthen Ring struggles to understand what is going on.  We've been fortunate to have one of the greatest shaman as our Warchief.$b$bThrall has been consulting with his advisors, and we don't want to interrupt his council.  But perhaps our brother, Gotura Fourwinds, has learned of Thrall's plans.

Objectives.text: 跟奥格瑞玛格罗玛什要塞的戈图拉·林风谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Gotura Fourwinds in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

Description.text: 毫无疑问，你感觉到了剧烈的地震活动。或许你也看到了元素生物向陆地和城镇发动了攻击。大地之环正在努力调查这场动乱的真相。幸运的是，最伟大的萨满祭司萨尔酋长站了出来。$b$b萨尔一直在询问他的顾问，我们不想打断议事会。或许我们的兄弟戈图拉·林风知道萨尔的计划。
Description.english: No doubt you've felt the earthquakes.  You may even have seen elementals attacking the lands or towns.  The Earthen Ring struggles to understand what is going on.  We've been fortunate to have one of the greatest shaman as our Warchief.$b$bThrall has been consulting with his advisors, and we don't want to interrupt his council.  But perhaps our brother, Gotura Fourwinds, has learned of Thrall's plans.

CompletionLog.text: 跟奥格瑞玛格罗玛什要塞的戈图拉·林风谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Gotura Fourwinds in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

identity.title: Signal the Attack
identity.objectives: Use the Attack Signal from atop one of the towers at the Twilight Gate.
identity.description: Now that you've lured Skullcrusher the Mountain away from the Twilight Gate, I need you to signal our forces to attack!

Objectives.text: 到暮光之门中的某座哨塔顶部去，发出攻击信号。
Objectives.english: Use the Attack Signal from atop one of the towers at the Twilight Gate.

Description.text: 既然你已经把碎颅者魔山从暮光之门引开了，现在就赶快发信号通知我们的部队发起进攻吧！
Description.english: Now that you've lured Skullcrusher the Mountain away from the Twilight Gate, I need you to signal our forces to attack!

identity.title: Signal the Attack
identity.objectives: Use the Attack Signal from atop one of the towers at the Twilight Gate.
identity.description: Now that you've lured Skullcrusher the Mountain away from the Twilight Gate, I need you to signal our forces to attack!

Objectives.text: 到暮光之门中的某座哨塔顶部去，发出攻击信号。
Objectives.english: Use the Attack Signal from atop one of the towers at the Twilight Gate.

Description.text: 既然你已经把碎颅者魔山从暮光之门引开了，现在就赶快发信号通知我们的部队发起进攻吧！
Description.english: Now that you've lured Skullcrusher the Mountain away from the Twilight Gate, I need you to signal our forces to attack!

identity.title: Four Heads are Better than None
identity.objectives: Collect the four heads of Za'brox and Beeble'phod.
identity.description: We're about to launch the attack upon the Twilight Gate, but there is one last loose end to tie up: Za'brox and Beeble'phod, the disciples of Cho'gall.$B$BIntelligence has placed them within the Den of the Disciples, a small ogre cave at the southwest corner of the Twilight Gate.$B$BWould you go back in there and kill them?

Title.english: Four Heads are Better than None

Objectives.text: 收集扎布鲁克斯和毕布伏德的四枚徽记。
Objectives.english: Collect the four heads of Za'brox and Beeble'phod.

Description.text: 进攻暮光之门的战斗即将打响，还有最后一点小麻烦要处理：扎布鲁克斯和毕布伏德，古加尔的信徒。$B$B情报显示，他们就在信徒之穴里面，那是暮光之门西南角的一座小型的食人魔洞穴。$B$B你能回去把他们除掉吗？
Description.english: We're about to launch the attack upon the Twilight Gate, but there is one last loose end to tie up: Za'brox and Beeble'phod, the disciples of Cho'gall.$B$BIntelligence has placed them within the Den of the Disciples, a small ogre cave at the southwest corner of the Twilight Gate.$B$BWould you go back in there and kill them?

identity.title: Just You and Mathias
identity.objectives: Find Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
identity.description: That's a blow to our efforts. Damn Cho'gall!$B$BIt's a good thing that the squad commander told you where to find Master Shaw.

Objectives.text: 在暮光高地的暮光堡垒中找到马迪亚斯·肖尔。
Objectives.english: Find Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

Description.text: 真是给了我们当头一棒。该死的古加尔！$B$B幸好，小队指挥官告诉过你去哪里可以找到马迪亚斯·肖尔。
Description.english: That's a blow to our efforts. Damn Cho'gall!$B$BIt's a good thing that the squad commander told you where to find Master Shaw.

identity.title: Just You and Garona
identity.objectives: Find Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
identity.description: That's a heavy blow to our efforts. Damn that Cho'gall!$B$BIt's a good thing that the squad commander told you where to find Garona.

Objectives.text: 到暮光高地的暮光城塞找迦羅娜·半血。
Objectives.english: Find Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

Description.text: 那真是對我們的一大打擊。該死的丘加利!$B$B幸好小隊指揮官和你說了迦羅娜·半血的確切所在。
Description.english: That's a heavy blow to our efforts. Damn that Cho'gall!$B$BIt's a good thing that the squad commander told you where to find Garona.

identity.title: The Platinum Discs
identity.objectives: Speak with stone watcher and learn what ancient lore it keeps. Then, tell Lead Prospector Durdin what you found out!
identity.description: The centerpieces of this treasure chamber are four huge platinum discs, each adorned with numerous sigils of an unknown origin.  Touching them makes your hand tingle.  Just after touching the discs, the visage of a large stone watcher springs forth.$B$B"Salutations.  I am a keeper of knowledge.  The Creators' synthesis of the Earthen has been chronicled and stored here for this world in the Discs of Norgannon."$B$BYou have uncovered a wealth of previously undiscovered worldly lore!

Objectives.text: 同石头守卫交谈，了解他守护着怎样的古代知识。然后将你的发现告诉首席勘探员杜尔林！
Objectives.english: Speak with stone watcher and learn what ancient lore it keeps. Then, tell Lead Prospector Durdin what you found out!

Description.text: 这间藏宝室里装饰着四只巨大的白金圆盘，上面都雕满了无法解读的符号。碰触到这些盘子的时候，你的手上传来一阵刺痛。而一个石头守卫的巨大面孔随之出现在你眼前。$B$B“向你致敬，我是知识的守护者。造物者对这个世界大地的塑造都被记录在这诺甘农圆盘中。”$B$B你发现了一个从未被开启过的世界知识宝藏！
Description.english: The centerpieces of this treasure chamber are four huge platinum discs, each adorned with numerous sigils of an unknown origin.  Touching them makes your hand tingle.  Just after touching the discs, the visage of a large stone watcher springs forth.$B$B"Salutations.  I am a keeper of knowledge.  The Creators' synthesis of the Earthen has been chronicled and stored here for this world in the Discs of Norgannon."$B$BYou have uncovered a wealth of previously undiscovered worldly lore!

identity.title: Show Me Your Papers
identity.objectives: Go to the front gates of Stormwind, read King Wrynn's Proclamation and search 5 Stormwind Citizens. Keep anything suspicious that you find.
identity.description: After your work in dealing with the Twilight's Hammer cult, Captain Anton recommended you for a delicate assignment.$B$BMy men recently discovered a group of cultists attempting to sneak into the city. The flow of traffic into the Stormwind has come to a halt. The king has decreed that all visitors must be searched before they can enter the gates. Take this copy of his proclamation and read it to the people assembled at the front gates, then assist the guards there in searching those who wish to enter.

Objectives.text: 前往暴風城的前門，朗讀烏瑞恩王的宣言並搜檢5名暴風城居民。留下你搜查到的每一個可疑事務。
Objectives.english: Go to the front gates of Stormwind, read King Wrynn's Proclamation and search 5 Stormwind Citizens. Keep anything suspicious that you find.

Description.text: 在你處理掉暮光之錘教團後，安東上尉推薦你去進行一項困難的任務。$B$B最近，我的人發現有一群教徒企圖潛入城市。進入暴風城的人流因此被迫停止。國王下令，所有訪客都必須在進入大門前經過搜身。將這份聲明帶去前門，朗誦給集合在那裡的人群聽，然後協助守衛搜檢想要進入的那些人。
Description.english: After your work in dealing with the Twilight's Hammer cult, Captain Anton recommended you for a delicate assignment.$B$BMy men recently discovered a group of cultists attempting to sneak into the city. The flow of traffic into the Stormwind has come to a halt. The king has decreed that all visitors must be searched before they can enter the gates. Take this copy of his proclamation and read it to the people assembled at the front gates, then assist the guards there in searching those who wish to enter.

CompletionLog.text: 到暴風城的貿易區找加斯汀·德瑪利。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Justine Demalier in Stormwind's Trade Quarter.

identity.title: Arrest the Infiltrators
identity.objectives: Use the Heavy Manacles to arrest 5 Cultist Infiltrators and bring them to Warden Thelwater at the Stockade. After you've returned with your prisoners, question one of the Detained Cultists in the Stockade.
identity.description: You were right to bring this note to me, $n. The king's proclamation came too late; they already have infiltrators at work in the city.$B$BThis note contains instructions and locations for cultists to meet, but it doesn't say what they're doing. Our enemies have grown smarter. It's going to be tough to track down all the infiltrators, but we have to get as many as we can. Use these cuffs to restrain any agents you find, bring them to the entrance of the Stockade, and report to me when you're finished.

Objectives.text: 使用沉重的鐐銬來逮捕5名教徒滲透者，並將他們帶去監獄給典獄官塞爾沃特。帶回囚犯之後，在監獄裡質問其中一名拘留的教徒。
Objectives.english: Use the Heavy Manacles to arrest 5 Cultist Infiltrators and bring them to Warden Thelwater at the Stockade. After you've returned with your prisoners, question one of the Detained Cultists in the Stockade.

Description.text: 你帶這份筆記來給我是對的，$n。國王的聲明來得太晚了，他們的滲透人員已經進入了城市。$B$B這份記錄上包含了教徒會面的指示和地點，但沒有說明他們企圖。我們的敵人變聰明了。要揪出所有的滲透人員會是件困難的事，但我們必須盡力而為。用這些手銬來拘捕被你找到的所有間諜，將他們帶去監獄的入口，並在完成後向我回報。
Description.english: You were right to bring this note to me, $n. The king's proclamation came too late; they already have infiltrators at work in the city.$B$BThis note contains instructions and locations for cultists to meet, but it doesn't say what they're doing. Our enemies have grown smarter. It's going to be tough to track down all the infiltrators, but we have to get as many as we can. Use these cuffs to restrain any agents you find, bring them to the entrance of the Stockade, and report to me when you're finished.

CompletionLog.text: 到暴風城的貿易區找加斯汀·德瑪利。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Justine Demalier in Stormwind's Trade District.

identity.title: Back Under Cover
identity.objectives: Put on your Recruit's Robe, go to Mirror Lake Orchard and get the Book of Incantations from Overseer Sylandra. Read from the Book of Incantations near the Cultist Altar to practice the ritual.
identity.description: The cultists seem assured of their victory, even as we detain more and more of them. We must find out more about the ritual mentioned by the cultist you questioned.$B$BThese rituals seem to be the core of the cult's plan to attack Stormwind. I'm going to give you one of the robes taken from the arrested cultists. Put it on and go back to the cultist outpost at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest and see if you can get the cultists there to let you in on the plan.

Objectives.text: 穿上你的新教徒長袍，前往明鏡湖果園，從監督者賽倫德拉那裡取得咒術之書。在邪教祭壇附近朗讀咒術之書來進行儀式的練習。
Objectives.english: Put on your Recruit's Robe, go to Mirror Lake Orchard and get the Book of Incantations from Overseer Sylandra. Read from the Book of Incantations near the Cultist Altar to practice the ritual.

Description.text: 不管他們被我們拘留了多少人，這些教徒似乎仍確信自己能獲得勝利。受你審問的那些教徒提到了一個儀式，我們必須深入了解。$B$B這些儀式似乎在教徒進攻暴風城的計畫裡佔了至關緊要的地位。我會給你一件被捕教徒的長袍。把它穿起來，然後回到艾爾文森林，前往明鏡湖果園的教徒崗哨。看看你能否說服那邊的教徒讓你成為計畫的一員。
Description.english: The cultists seem assured of their victory, even as we detain more and more of them. We must find out more about the ritual mentioned by the cultist you questioned.$B$BThese rituals seem to be the core of the cult's plan to attack Stormwind. I'm going to give you one of the robes taken from the arrested cultists. Put it on and go back to the cultist outpost at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest and see if you can get the cultists there to let you in on the plan.

CompletionLog.text: 到艾爾文森林的明鏡湖果園找監督者賽倫德拉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Overseer Sylandra at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest.

identity.title: I Said the Words...
identity.objectives: Disrupt the cultist rituals in the Dwarven District, the Park, and the Cathedral District by reading the incorrect words from the Book of Incantations.
identity.description: Now that you're familiar with the ritual, it's time for you to perform it in the city. Dozens of our brethren have already infiltrated the city and made their way to the ritual sites.$B$BI want you to visit the portal ritual sites in Stormwind's Dwarven District, Park district, and Cathedral Square. The teams there will have made most of the preparations and all you need to is read the last part of the incantation from the book.$B$BVery soon, $n, Stormwind will find itself awash in wind and water.

Objectives.text: 從咒術之書裡閱讀錯誤的咒文，以在矮人區、花園和教堂廣場裡干擾邪教儀式的執行。
Objectives.english: Disrupt the cultist rituals in the Dwarven District, the Park, and the Cathedral District by reading the incorrect words from the Book of Incantations.

Description.text: 你熟悉了儀式的進行方法，現在你要進到城市裡去執行。我們已有許多兄弟滲透到城市裡，前往執行儀式的位置。$B$B我要你過去暴風城的矮人區、花園，還有教堂廣場。那裡的小隊會做好大部分的準備工作，你只要唸出書上最後一段咒文即可。$B$B要不了多久，$n，暴風城將發現自己受到狂風暴雨的衝擊。
Description.english: Now that you're familiar with the ritual, it's time for you to perform it in the city. Dozens of our brethren have already infiltrated the city and made their way to the ritual sites.$B$BI want you to visit the portal ritual sites in Stormwind's Dwarven District, Park district, and Cathedral Square. The teams there will have made most of the preparations and all you need to is read the last part of the incantation from the book.$B$BVery soon, $n, Stormwind will find itself awash in wind and water.

CompletionLog.text: 到暴風城的貿易區找加斯汀·德瑪利。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Justine Demalier in Stormwind's Trade District.

identity.title: I Said the Words...
identity.objectives: Disrupt the cultist rituals in the Drag, the Valley of Honor, and near the city's West Gate by reading the incorrect words from the Book of Incantations.
identity.description: Now that you're familiar with the ritual, it's time for you to perform it in the city. Dozens of our brethren have already made their way to the ritual sites.$B$BI want you to visit the portal ritual sites on the second level of the Drag, in the Valley of Honor near the Hall of the Brave, and near Orgrimmar's west gate. The teams there will have made most of the preparations and all you need to do is read the last part of the incantation from the book.$B$BVery soon the city will be consumed in flame.

Objectives.text: 從咒術之書裡閱讀錯誤的咒文，以在暗巷區、榮譽谷和城市西門的附近干擾邪教儀式的執行。
Objectives.english: Disrupt the cultist rituals in the Drag, the Valley of Honor, and near the city's West Gate by reading the incorrect words from the Book of Incantations.

Description.text: 你熟悉了儀式的進行方法，現在你要進到城市裡去執行。我們已有許多兄弟滲透到城市裡，前往執行儀式的位置。$B$B我要你過去勇者大廳和奧格瑪西門附近的暗巷區，前往該處第二層的傳送門儀式。那裡的小隊會做好大部分的準備工作，你只要唸出書上最後一段咒文即可。$B$B要不了多久，那座城市將遭到火焰的吞噬。
Description.english: Now that you're familiar with the ritual, it's time for you to perform it in the city. Dozens of our brethren have already made their way to the ritual sites.$B$BI want you to visit the portal ritual sites on the second level of the Drag, in the Valley of Honor near the Hall of the Brave, and near Orgrimmar's west gate. The teams there will have made most of the preparations and all you need to do is read the last part of the incantation from the book.$B$BVery soon the city will be consumed in flame.

CompletionLog.text: 到奧格瑪的力量谷找血衛士托雷克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

identity.title: Back Under Cover
identity.objectives: Put on your Recruit's Robe, go to the Jaggedswine Farm and get the Book of Incantations from Overseer Jintak. Read from the Book of Incantations near the Cultist Altar to practice the ritual.
identity.description: The cultists seem assured of their victory, although we have captured many of them. We must find out more about the ritual mentioned by the cultist you questioned.$B$BThese rituals must be the core of their plans to attack Orgrimmar.$B$BTake one of the robes from the arrested cultists; it's not like they're going to need them anymore. Put it on and go back to the cultist outpost at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar and see what you can learn about these rituals and their place in the cult's plans.

Objectives.text: 穿上你的新教徒長袍，前往明鏡湖果園，從監督者金塔克那裡取得咒術之書。在邪教祭壇附近朗讀咒術之書來進行儀式的練習。
Objectives.english: Put on your Recruit's Robe, go to the Jaggedswine Farm and get the Book of Incantations from Overseer Jintak. Read from the Book of Incantations near the Cultist Altar to practice the ritual.

Description.text: 儘管我們逮捕了很多人，這些教徒似乎仍確信自己能獲得勝利。受你審問的那些教徒提到了一個儀式，我們必須深入了解這點。$B$B這些儀式一定是在教徒進攻奧格瑪的計畫裡扮演核心的地位。$B$B拿一件被捕教徒的長袍。穿起來然後回到杜洛塔，前往野豬農場的教徒崗哨。看看你能否搜集到這些儀式和教徒的計畫有什麼關係。
Description.english: The cultists seem assured of their victory, although we have captured many of them. We must find out more about the ritual mentioned by the cultist you questioned.$B$BThese rituals must be the core of their plans to attack Orgrimmar.$B$BTake one of the robes from the arrested cultists; it's not like they're going to need them anymore. Put it on and go back to the cultist outpost at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar and see what you can learn about these rituals and their place in the cult's plans.

CompletionLog.text: 到杜洛塔的野豬農場找監督者金塔克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Overseer Jintak at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.

identity.title: Show Me Your Papers
identity.objectives: Go to the front gates of Orgrimmar, read the Warchief's Proclamation and search 5 Orgrimmar Citizens. Keep anything suspicious that you find.
identity.description: My men recently discovered a group of cultists attempting to sneak into the city. The flow of traffic into Orgrimmar has come to a halt. The Warchief has decreed that all visitors must be searched before they can enter the gates. Take this copy of his proclamation and read it to the people assembled at the front gates, then assist the guards there in searching those who wish to enter.

Objectives.text: 前往奧格瑪的前門，朗讀大酋長的宣言並搜檢5名奧格瑪居民。留下你搜查到的每一個可疑事物。
Objectives.english: Go to the front gates of Orgrimmar, read the Warchief's Proclamation and search 5 Orgrimmar Citizens. Keep anything suspicious that you find.

Description.text: 最近，我的人發現有一群教徒企圖潛入城市。進入奧格瑪的人流因此被迫停止。大酋長下令，所有訪客都必須在進入大門前經過搜身。將這份聲明帶去前門，朗誦給集合在那裡的人群聽，然後協助守衛搜檢想要進入的那些人。
Description.english: My men recently discovered a group of cultists attempting to sneak into the city. The flow of traffic into Orgrimmar has come to a halt. The Warchief has decreed that all visitors must be searched before they can enter the gates. Take this copy of his proclamation and read it to the people assembled at the front gates, then assist the guards there in searching those who wish to enter.

CompletionLog.text: 到力量谷找血衛士托雷克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Blood Guard Torek in the Valley of Strength.

identity.title: Arrest the Infiltrators
identity.objectives: Use the Heavy Manacles to arrest 5 Cultist Infiltrators and bring them to Warden Gartok Ragefist at the Ring of Valor in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. After you've returned with your prisoners, question the Detained Cultist.
identity.description: The note you found can only mean one thing. The warchief's proclamation was too late; they already have infiltrators at work in the city.$B$BThis note contains instructions and locations for cultists to meet, but it doesn't say what they're doing. Our enemies have grown smarter. It's going to be tough to track down all of them, but we have to get as many as we can. Use these cuffs to arrest the infiltrators and then deliver them to Warden Gartok Ragefist at the Ring of Valor in the Valley of Honor.

Objectives.text: 使用沉重的鐐銬來逮捕5名教徒滲透者，並將他們帶去榮譽谷的勇武競技場，交給看守者卡爾吐克·怒拳。帶回囚犯之後，審問其中一名被拘留的教徒。
Objectives.english: Use the Heavy Manacles to arrest 5 Cultist Infiltrators and bring them to Warden Gartok Ragefist at the Ring of Valor in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. After you've returned with your prisoners, question the Detained Cultist.

Description.text: 你找到的這份筆記只代表著一個意義，$n。大酋長的聲明來得太晚了，他們的滲透人員已經進入了城市。$B$B這份記錄上包含了教徒會面的指示和地點，但沒有說明他們的企圖。我們的敵人變聰明了。要將每一個滲透人員都揪出會是件困難的事，但我們必須盡力而為。用這些手銬來拘捕被你找到的所有間諜，將他們帶去榮譽谷的勇武競技場，交給看守者卡爾吐克·怒拳。
Description.english: The note you found can only mean one thing. The warchief's proclamation was too late; they already have infiltrators at work in the city.$B$BThis note contains instructions and locations for cultists to meet, but it doesn't say what they're doing. Our enemies have grown smarter. It's going to be tough to track down all of them, but we have to get as many as we can. Use these cuffs to arrest the infiltrators and then deliver them to Warden Gartok Ragefist at the Ring of Valor in the Valley of Honor.

CompletionLog.text: 到奧格瑪的力量谷找血衛士托雷克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

identity.title: The Grateful Dead
identity.objectives: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Goblin Spirit in Orgrimmar's graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.
identity.description: It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!$B$BMight I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...$B$BChapman there sells the recipe, I think.

Objectives.text: 拿一些亡者麵包給奧格瑪墓地中興奮的哥布林靈魂。$B$B使用橘色金盞花可以看見這些隱形的靈魂。
Objectives.english: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Goblin Spirit in Orgrimmar's graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.

Description.text: 能再次看看朋友和家人的感覺真好，雖然我或許有點太超過了...我已經把他們今天給我準備的東西全吃光了!$B$B我能麻煩你幫我找些美味的亡者麵包嗎?我會非常感激...$B$B我想，那邊的小販有在賣食譜。
Description.english: It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!$B$BMight I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...$B$BChapman there sells the recipe, I think.

CompletionLog.text: 到杜洛塔找興奮的哥布林靈魂。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Cheerful Goblin Spirit in Durotar.

identity.title: The Grateful Dead
identity.objectives: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Worgen Spirit in Darnassus' graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.
identity.description: It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!$B$BMight I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...$B$BChapman there sells the recipe, I think.

Objectives.text: 获取一些悼念糕饼，将它交给达纳苏斯墓地的欢快的狼人灵魂。$B$B用橙菊可以看到其他隐形的幽灵。
Objectives.english: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Worgen Spirit in Darnassus' graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.

Description.text: 能再度拜访亲朋好友可真不错，不过我好像做的有点过了……我把他们给我做的所有东西都吃光了！$B$B能不能麻烦你给我弄些美味的悼念糕饼来？我会非常感谢的……$B$B我想食谱在查普曼那儿有卖。
Description.english: It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!$B$BMight I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...$B$BChapman there sells the recipe, I think.

identity.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
identity.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!
identity.description: I was wondering when you'd show up, $n! Having a past champion of the Ring of Blood here will be a huge draw! We're gonna be rich, buddy! RICH!$B$BAnyway, this is some old Dragonmaw fighting pit. Didn't take much modification to tune it up to our uses. I put out a few feelers, and got some heavy hitters from all around Azeroth to join in the carnage. Bout time to make some gold!$B$BYou know the drill, $n. When you're ready, let me know and we'll get this show on the road!

Title.text: 杀戮熔炉竞技场：血眼斗士！
Title.english: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!

Objectives.text: 进入杀戮熔炉竞技场，击败胡尔德普！
Objectives.english: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!

Description.text: 我还在想你什么时候才会出现呢，$n！鲜血竞技场的前任冠军在这里参赛可是大事一桩哩！我们都会发财的，朋友！发大财！$B$B总之，这是一座古老的龙喉竞技场，没花多少工夫改造就可以拿来用了。我派了些人四处吆喝，就有来自艾泽拉斯各个角落的强力党来参赛。是时候赚些大钱啦！$B$B你知道规矩的，$n。等你准备好了就告诉我，让我们拉开这场大戏的帷幕吧！
Description.english: I was wondering when you'd show up, $n! Having a past champion of the Ring of Blood here will be a huge draw! We're gonna be rich, buddy! RICH!$B$BAnyway, this is some old Dragonmaw fighting pit. Didn't take much modification to tune it up to our uses. I put out a few feelers, and got some heavy hitters from all around Azeroth to join in the carnage. Bout time to make some gold!$B$BYou know the drill, $n. When you're ready, let me know and we'll get this show on the road!

CompletionLog.text: 去找暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.

identity.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
identity.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!
identity.description: Well well, if it isn't the once champion of anguish, $n! I'm seeing good money in the future now that you're here! We're gonna be rollin in the dough, buddy! Filthy RICH!$B$BAnyway, this is some old Dragonmaw fighting pit. Didn't take much modification to tune it up to our uses. I put out a few feelers, and got some heavy hitters from all around Azeroth to join in the carnage. Bout time to make some gold!$B$BYou know the drill, $n. When you're ready, let me know and we'll get this show on the road!

Title.text: 杀戮熔炉竞技场：血眼斗士！
Title.english: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!

Objectives.text: 进入杀戮熔炉竞技场，击败胡尔德普！
Objectives.english: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!

Description.text: 哎哟，这不是痛苦斗兽场的前任冠军，$n嘛！有你在这里，我很快就能大赚一笔啦！我们要在钱堆里打滚啦，伙计！富得流油！$B$B总之，这是一座古老的龙喉竞技场，没花多少工夫改造就可以拿来用了。我派了些人四处吆喝，就有来自艾泽拉斯各个角落的强力党来参赛。是时候赚些大钱啦！$B$B你知道规矩的，$n。等你准备好了就告诉我，让我们拉开这场大戏的帷幕吧！
Description.english: Well well, if it isn't the once champion of anguish, $n! I'm seeing good money in the future now that you're here! We're gonna be rollin in the dough, buddy! Filthy RICH!$B$BAnyway, this is some old Dragonmaw fighting pit. Didn't take much modification to tune it up to our uses. I put out a few feelers, and got some heavy hitters from all around Azeroth to join in the carnage. Bout time to make some gold!$B$BYou know the drill, $n. When you're ready, let me know and we'll get this show on the road!

CompletionLog.text: 去找暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.

identity.title: Dirty Birds
identity.objectives: You are to slay 8 Diseased Vultures.
identity.description: The sky above the Shriveled Oasis is littered with these nasty vultures.$b$bLike infectious rodents with wings, these creatures serve no great purpose and inflict untold misery.$b$bRid the skies of this nuisance and leave the region better than you found it.

Objectives.text: 你要杀掉8只染病的兀鹫。
Objectives.english: You are to slay 8 Diseased Vultures.

Description.text: 干枯的绿洲的天空中充斥着这些可恶的秃鹫。$b$b它们就像是传播疾病的啮齿动物，只不过带着翅膀，这些生物没有一点好处，只会造成难以名状的痛苦。$b$b把这些祸害从天上除掉，让这里变得更加美好。
Description.english: The sky above the Shriveled Oasis is littered with these nasty vultures.$b$bLike infectious rodents with wings, these creatures serve no great purpose and inflict untold misery.$b$bRid the skies of this nuisance and leave the region better than you found it.

identity.title: To the Withering
identity.objectives: Speak with Magatha Grimtotem at the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.
identity.description: You should not keep the Elder Crone waiting, $n.$B$BShe said that she'd be up top and just outside of the Twilight Withering to the east.

Objectives.text: 跟千针石林暮光凋零法阵的玛加萨·恐怖图腾谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Magatha Grimtotem at the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.

Description.text: 别让巫婆长老等太久，$n。$B$B她让你去东边的暮光凋零法阵找她。
Description.english: You should not keep the Elder Crone waiting, $n.$B$BShe said that she'd be up top and just outside of the Twilight Withering to the east.

identity.title: Seek Brother Silverhallow
identity.objectives: Speak with Brother Silverhallow in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar.
identity.description: I just received word that you are needed in Orgrimmar, $n. Brother Silverhallow has asked for you to return to the city as quickly as you are able. His message didn't include any other information, and the matter seemed urgent.$B$BLook for Brother Silverhallow in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar.

Objectives.text: 跟奥格瑞玛大使馆的圣银币修士谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Brother Silverhallow in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar.

Description.text: 奥格瑞玛有人想见你，$n。圣银币修士要你尽快返回奥格瑞玛找他。口信上没有说具体什么事，但是看来挺紧急的。$B$B去奥格瑞玛的大使馆找圣银币修士吧。
Description.english: I just received word that you are needed in Orgrimmar, $n. Brother Silverhallow has asked for you to return to the city as quickly as you are able. His message didn't include any other information, and the matter seemed urgent.$B$BLook for Brother Silverhallow in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar.

identity.title: The Lost Brother
identity.objectives: Find Bahrum Forgehammer.
identity.description: Me brother Bahrum has gone missing!$b$bHe was one of the first scouts in the area.  All the others have returned safely, but there be no sign of him.  Da says he's just dawdling somewhere, but he's me only brother, and I promised me mum that I would keep him safe.  Will you please find him?

Objectives.text: 找到巴盧姆·爐錘。
Objectives.english: Find Bahrum Forgehammer.

Description.text: 我的兄弟巴盧姆失蹤了!$b$b他本來是最先來到這區域的斥候之一。其他人全都平安回來了，只有他至今仍沒有蹤影。他們說他只是在什麼地方打混罷了，但他是我唯一的兄弟，我曾答應老媽會好好保護他的。拜託你，去找他好嗎?
Description.english: Me brother Bahrum has gone missing!$b$bHe was one of the first scouts in the area.  All the others have returned safely, but there be no sign of him.  Da says he's just dawdling somewhere, but he's me only brother, and I promised me mum that I would keep him safe.  Will you please find him?

CompletionLog.text: <完成文字>
CompletionLog.english: <completion text>

identity.title: Tapped Out
identity.objectives: Harrison Jones wants you to talk to him again in a week or two.
identity.description: Listen, $n.$b$bYou know I live to entertain you, and that I strive to keep you pleasantly occupied and whatnot.$b$bBut it just so happens that I've completely run out of ideas.$b$bThat was it!$b$bUsusally as I'm questing with you I can think of a few things to have you do next, which buys me time to cook up some grand objective, but no more.$b$bI'm tapped out. Completely uninspired. Couldn't muster up another idea to save my life.$b$bOh, wait!I know what we can do!$b$bTalk to me in a week or two...

Objectives.text: 哈里森·琼斯要你在一周或两周之后再和他说话。
Objectives.english: Harrison Jones wants you to talk to him again in a week or two.

Description.text: 听着，$n。$b$b你知道我生存的目的就是给你们带来娱乐，你们的欢愉就是我毕生的追求。$b$b但现在的问题是，我已经没有可以供你们取乐的好点子了。$b$b事情就是这样！$b$b通常来说，我都会让你们做东做西，忙乎上一段时间，以使我能鼓捣出那么几个绝妙的任务。但是现在不行了。$b$b我认输了。我的灵感彻底枯竭了。我死定了。$b$b哦，等等！我知道我们还能干什么！$b$b一周或两周之后再和我说话…
Description.english: Listen, $n.$b$bYou know I live to entertain you, and that I strive to keep you pleasantly occupied and whatnot.$b$bBut it just so happens that I've completely run out of ideas.$b$bThat was it!$b$bUsusally as I'm questing with you I can think of a few things to have you do next, which buys me time to cook up some grand objective, but no more.$b$bI'm tapped out. Completely uninspired. Couldn't muster up another idea to save my life.$b$bOh, wait!I know what we can do!$b$bTalk to me in a week or two...

identity.title: Meet with Ander Germaine
identity.objectives: Speak with Ander Germaine at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.
identity.description: Ander Germaine sent a message for you. He wants you to join him at his headquarters in the Command Center in Stormwind's Old Town as quickly as you can. It sounded important, $n.

Objectives.text: 前往暴风城旧城区南边的指挥中心，跟安德尔·杰曼谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Ander Germaine at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.

Description.text: 安德尔·杰曼捎来口信。他要你尽快前往暴风城旧城区的指挥中心找他。听上去很紧急，$n。
Description.english: Ander Germaine sent a message for you. He wants you to join him at his headquarters in the Command Center in Stormwind's Old Town as quickly as you can. It sounded important, $n.

CompletionLog.text: 前往暴风城旧城区南边的指挥中心，跟安德尔·杰曼谈一谈。
