CompletionLog.english: Speak with Ander Germaine at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.

identity.title: Meet with Wulf Hansreim
identity.objectives: Speak with Wulf Hansreim in the Command Center to the south of Stormwind's Old Town.
identity.description: Wulf Hansreim sends word from Stormwind -- he wants to meet with you right away. He'll be in the Command Center just to the south of Stormwind's Old Town.

Title.text: 与乌尔夫·哈斯雷姆会晤

Objectives.text: 前往暴风城旧城区南边的指挥中心，跟乌尔夫·哈斯雷姆谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Wulf Hansreim in the Command Center to the south of Stormwind's Old Town.

Description.text: 暴风城的乌尔夫·哈斯雷姆捎来口信——要你立即去见他。你可以在暴风城旧城区南边的指挥中心找到他。
Description.english: Wulf Hansreim sends word from Stormwind -- he wants to meet with you right away. He'll be in the Command Center just to the south of Stormwind's Old Town.

CompletionLog.text: 前往暴风城旧城区南边的指挥中心，跟乌尔夫·哈斯雷姆谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Wulf Hansreim at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.

identity.title: Meet with Grezz Ragefist
identity.objectives: Speak with Grezz Ragefist in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.
identity.description: Grezz Ragefist sent an urgent message for you, $n. He wants you to join him immediately in Orgrimmar's Valley of Heroes. He must have a mission of importance for you.

Objectives.text: 跟奥格瑞玛荣誉谷的格雷兹·怒拳谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Grezz Ragefist in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

Description.text: 格雷兹·怒拳送来一条紧急的口信，$n。他要你立即前往奥格瑞玛的英雄谷找他。想必是有重要的任务要交代你。
Description.english: Grezz Ragefist sent an urgent message for you, $n. He wants you to join him immediately in Orgrimmar's Valley of Heroes. He must have a mission of importance for you.

CompletionLog.text: 跟奥格瑞玛荣誉谷的格雷兹·怒拳谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Grezz Ragefist in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

identity.title: Meet with Terga Earthbreaker
identity.objectives: Speak with Terga Earthbreaker in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
identity.description: An urgent message just arrived for you, $n.  It's from Terga Earthbreaker, one of the shaman trainers in Orgrimmar.  She requests your presence as soon as possible.

Title.text: 與卡德里斯·尋夢者會面

Objectives.text: 在奧格瑪的智慧谷裡和卡德里斯·尋夢者談話。
Objectives.english: Speak with Terga Earthbreaker in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

Description.text: 我剛收到一份指名給你的緊急訊息，$n。訊息來自奧格瑪的一名薩滿訓練師，卡德里斯·尋夢者。她希望你儘快前往奧格瑪的智慧谷和她談話。
Description.english: An urgent message just arrived for you, $n.  It's from Terga Earthbreaker, one of the shaman trainers in Orgrimmar.  She requests your presence as soon as possible.

CompletionLog.text: 到奧格瑪的智慧谷和卡德里斯·尋夢者談話。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Terga Earthbreaker in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

identity.title: Meet with Tyelis
identity.objectives: Speak with Tyelis at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
identity.description: Tyelis, a member of the Silvermoon delegation to Orgrimmar, has requested to meet with you next time you're in the city. You can find him inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. It must be an important matter for him to send for you so directly, $n.

Objectives.text: 前往奥格瑞玛的力量谷，与格罗玛什要塞的提耶利斯谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Tyelis at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

Description.text: 提耶利斯，是被派往奥格瑞玛的银月城代表团成员，他希望你下次进城的时候和他见一面。你可以在奥格瑞玛力量谷的格罗玛什要塞里找到他。他这么着急派人找你，一定是有非常重要的事情，$n。
Description.english: Tyelis, a member of the Silvermoon delegation to Orgrimmar, has requested to meet with you next time you're in the city. You can find him inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. It must be an important matter for him to send for you so directly, $n.

CompletionLog.text: 前往奥格瑞玛的力量谷，与格罗玛什要塞的提耶利斯谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Tyelis at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

identity.title: Meet with Seer Liwatha
identity.objectives: Speak with Seer Liwatha in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
identity.description: Seer Liwatha sends her greetings from the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar, $n. She asked me to convey an invitation to visit her next time you're in the city. It sounded like she has something of importance to discuss with you.

Objectives.text: 跟奥格瑞玛智慧谷的先知利瓦萨谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Seer Liwatha in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

Description.text: 先知利瓦萨从奥格瑞玛的智慧谷发来问候，$n。她要你下次前往奥格瑞玛时顺道去拜访她。听起来像是有重要的事情要跟你商量。
Description.english: Seer Liwatha sends her greetings from the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar, $n. She asked me to convey an invitation to visit her next time you're in the city. It sounded like she has something of importance to discuss with you.

CompletionLog.text: 跟奥格瑞玛智慧谷的先知利瓦萨谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Seer Liwatha in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

identity.title: Meet with Shadow-Walker Zuru
identity.objectives: Speak with Shadow-Walker Zuru in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
identity.description: Shadow-Walker Zuru, a revered priest trainer, has asked to meet with you in Orgrimmar. You can find him in the Valley of Spirits with the other Darkspear trainers. It must be an important matter for him to send for you so directly, $n.

Objectives.text: 前往奥格瑞玛的力量谷，与精神谷的暗影行者祖鲁谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Shadow-Walker Zuru in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.

Description.text: 暗影行者祖鲁要你下次前往奥格瑞玛时去拜访他，他就在精神谷，和其他的暗矛部族训练师在一起。想必是重要的事情吧，不然也不会直接找你了，$n。
Description.english: Shadow-Walker Zuru, a revered priest trainer, has asked to meet with you in Orgrimmar. You can find him in the Valley of Spirits with the other Darkspear trainers. It must be an important matter for him to send for you so directly, $n.

CompletionLog.text: 前往奥格瑞玛的精神谷，与暗影行者祖鲁谈谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Shadow-Walker Zuru in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.

identity.title: Meet with Brother Silverhallow
identity.objectives: Speak with Brother Silverhallow in Orgrimmar's Goblin Slums.
identity.description: Brother Silverhallow sent word that he wishes to speak with you. Next time you're in Orgrimmar, visit him in the Goblin Slums.  It sounded like he had something important on his mind.

Objectives.text: 跟奥格瑞玛大使馆的圣银币修士谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Brother Silverhallow in Orgrimmar's Goblin Slums.

Description.text: 圣银币修士捎信来说，他想跟你谈谈。下次你前往奥格瑞玛时，不妨去大使馆拜访他。听起来他像是有重要的事情找你。
Description.english: Brother Silverhallow sent word that he wishes to speak with you. Next time you're in Orgrimmar, visit him in the Goblin Slums.  It sounded like he had something important on his mind.

CompletionLog.text: 跟奥格瑞玛大使馆的圣银币修士谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Brother Silverhallow in Orgrimmar's Goblin Slums.

identity.title: Fourth and Goal
identity.objectives: Get in the Bilgewater Buccaneer and score the winning goal by kicking the Footbomb through the smokestacks behind the opposing goal.
identity.description: It's all up to you, kid. You demolished the Steamwheedle Sharks, so now all that's left to do is to kick the winning goal.$B$B<The coach leans in close and whispers in your ear.>$B$BNow, just between you and me, I think we should do this one right. I don't want you to just kick a goal... I want you to kick it so far it sails between the two smokestacks behind the goal!$B$BI've modified the footbomb to give you the extra power that you'll need.$B$BNow get out there and make me proud!

Objectives.text: 钻进锈水海盗队伐木机，将足球炸弹踢过对方的烟囱球门，赢得比赛。
Objectives.english: Get in the Bilgewater Buccaneer and score the winning goal by kicking the Footbomb through the smokestacks behind the opposing goal.

Description.text: 全都看你的了，孩子。你摧毁了热砂港大鲨鱼队，现在剩下来要做的就是破门。$B$B<教练靠过来在你耳边低语道。>$B$B现在，你我之间私下说说，我想只是进球也太容易了。我要你不止是破门……我要你把它踢得更远，直穿过球门后面的两根烟囱！$B$B我已经把足球炸弹调整过了，可以给你提供所需要的额外动力。$B$B现在上场去给我争光吧！
Description.english: It's all up to you, kid. You demolished the Steamwheedle Sharks, so now all that's left to do is to kick the winning goal.$B$B<The coach leans in close and whispers in your ear.>$B$BNow, just between you and me, I think we should do this one right. I don't want you to just kick a goal... I want you to kick it so far it sails between the two smokestacks behind the goal!$B$BI've modified the footbomb to give you the extra power that you'll need.$B$BNow get out there and make me proud!

identity.title: A Perfect Costume
identity.objectives: Bring the appropriate amount of supplies from the Tailoring Table to Thelaron Direneedle at Chiselgrip.
identity.description: Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as a goblin.  The Blackrocks have been known to hire goblin mercenaries to fill their ranks, so you'll fit right in.$b$bDo you know much about tailoring?  If not, then consider this your first lesson.  My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.$b$bGo ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here.  Thelaron will fix you right up.

Objectives.text: 从裁缝桌上拿取适当数量的材料，交给凿握据点的萨拉隆·巨钉。
Objectives.english: Bring the appropriate amount of supplies from the Tailoring Table to Thelaron Direneedle at Chiselgrip.

Description.text: 根据你的体重、体格和体型，我们要把你假扮成一个地精。黑石兽人一直拿地精雇佣兵来填补兵力空缺，所以你很容易混进去。$b$b你对裁缝有了解吗？如果没有的话，就把这个当成你的第一课吧。我的工作台就在那边，上面有所有必要的材料。$b$b去拿一些你觉得有用的东西，把它们拿来交给我。萨拉隆会帮你料理一切。
Description.english: Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as a goblin.  The Blackrocks have been known to hire goblin mercenaries to fill their ranks, so you'll fit right in.$b$bDo you know much about tailoring?  If not, then consider this your first lesson.  My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.$b$bGo ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here.  Thelaron will fix you right up.

identity.title: Winterfall Firewater
identity.objectives: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
identity.description: This vial that you picked up from the Winterfall furbolg is empty, but you can detect a few drops of a strange green liquid inside; it almost glows.$B$BIs it something important?$B$BDonova Snowden would probably be able to tell you more, since she has been camped by the hot springs in Winterspring for some time now.

Objectives.text: 将空的火酒瓶交给冬泉谷的多诺瓦·雪山。
Objectives.english: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

Description.text: 你从冬泉熊怪那儿拣来的这只小瓶子是空的，但是里面有一些奇怪的绿色液体，它甚至发出了微微的光芒。$B$B这会是什么重要的东西吗？$B$B多诺瓦·雪山可能会告诉你更多的信息，她在冬泉谷的温泉附近有个营地。
Description.english: This vial that you picked up from the Winterfall furbolg is empty, but you can detect a few drops of a strange green liquid inside; it almost glows.$B$BIs it something important?$B$BDonova Snowden would probably be able to tell you more, since she has been camped by the hot springs in Winterspring for some time now.

identity.title: Twilight Scheming
identity.objectives: Use the Glowing Torch to destroy 8 copies of The Twilight Creed in the Domicile of Blackrock Depths.
identity.description: Our enemies be plottin' against us in the halls of Blackrock Depths. The Twilight's Hammer cultists, they be busy preaching and handin' out books to the Dark Irons, tellin' them that it's time for war. Wit' a Dark Iron army at their backs, the Twilight's Hammer be a formidable force. We must put an end to the agitation!$B$BI be wantin' you to go into Domicile of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn those Twilight's Hammer books!

Objectives.text: 用发光的火炬点燃黑石深渊住宅区的8本暮光教义。
Objectives.english: Use the Glowing Torch to destroy 8 copies of The Twilight Creed in the Domicile of Blackrock Depths.

Description.text: 我们的敌人们在黑石深渊的大厅里阴谋对付我们。暮光之锤的邪教徒们，正忙着向黑铁矮人传道，分发书籍，煽动他们发动战争。有了黑铁大军撑腰，暮光之锤就变成了一股可怕的势力。我们必须阻止这一煽动行为！$B$B我要你到黑石深渊的住宅区去，用这把火炬点燃那些暮光之锤的书籍！
Description.english: Our enemies be plottin' against us in the halls of Blackrock Depths. The Twilight's Hammer cultists, they be busy preaching and handin' out books to the Dark Irons, tellin' them that it's time for war. Wit' a Dark Iron army at their backs, the Twilight's Hammer be a formidable force. We must put an end to the agitation!$B$BI be wantin' you to go into Domicile of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn those Twilight's Hammer books!

identity.title: Twilight Scheming
identity.objectives: Use the Glowing Torch to destroy 8 copies of The Twilight Creed in the Domicile of Blackrock Depths.
identity.description: It wasn't enough for their master to break the world, no! Twilight's Hammer is doing its best to unite our enemies against us, particularly in Blackrock Depths. They've got a whole team of emissaries down there spreading propaganda aimed at starting a joint campaign.$B$BI've always heard that the medium's the message. Well, it's time to destroy the message!$B$BI want you to go into the Domicile of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn those Twilight's Hammer books!

Objectives.text: 用发光的火炬点燃黑石深渊住宅区的8本暮光教义。
Objectives.english: Use the Glowing Torch to destroy 8 copies of The Twilight Creed in the Domicile of Blackrock Depths.

Description.text: 他们的主子把世界破坏成这样还嫌不够，不！暮光之锤在竭尽所能联合我们的敌人对付我们，尤其是在黑石深渊。他们组织了一队使节，下去大肆宣传，目的是发动一场联合战役。$B$B我总听人说媒介就是讯息。那么，就该把那讯息给摧毁掉！$B$B我要你到黑石深渊的住宅区去，用这把火炬点燃那些暮光之锤的书籍！
Description.english: It wasn't enough for their master to break the world, no! Twilight's Hammer is doing its best to unite our enemies against us, particularly in Blackrock Depths. They've got a whole team of emissaries down there spreading propaganda aimed at starting a joint campaign.$B$BI've always heard that the medium's the message. Well, it's time to destroy the message!$B$BI want you to go into the Domicile of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn those Twilight's Hammer books!

identity.title: Centuries of Suffering
identity.objectives: Speak with the Kaldorei Spirit at the center of Lake Kel'theril.
identity.description: I only agreed to even consider cooperating with night elves and the alliance on rumors that the Crystal of Zin-Malor was found here.$B$BThe crystal is a powerful and ancient artifact, whose destruction cursed this land, and whose reassembly has caused little relief.$B$BBut I cannot face the hauntings that dwell here. Mock me if you must, but if you do, try your own hand. Perhaps the placid spirits that sit at the center of the lake will speak with you...

Objectives.text: 跟凯斯利尔湖中心的卡多雷之魂谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with the Kaldorei Spirit at the center of Lake Kel'theril.

Description.text: 谣传辛玛洛水晶是在这里被发现的，因此我勉强答应了与暗夜精灵以及联盟合作。$B$B这颗水晶是一件古老而强大的生物，它的毁灭诅咒了这片大地，它的重生却并未带来多大的慰藉。$B$B我已无法面对徘徊在此地的灵魂。尽情地嘲笑我吧，如果你真的这么想，不妨亲自试试。或许湖中央温和的灵魂会开口跟你谈谈……
Description.english: I only agreed to even consider cooperating with night elves and the alliance on rumors that the Crystal of Zin-Malor was found here.$B$BThe crystal is a powerful and ancient artifact, whose destruction cursed this land, and whose reassembly has caused little relief.$B$BBut I cannot face the hauntings that dwell here. Mock me if you must, but if you do, try your own hand. Perhaps the placid spirits that sit at the center of the lake will speak with you...

identity.title: A Special Surprise
identity.objectives: Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame has ordered you to execute Gally Lumpstain, an Argent Dawn prisoner inside the nearby prison house.
identity.description: We got here, tore the place apart, and headed toward the prison house. We weren't expecting what we found in there, $n. Seems the Crusade's been real busy. That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. Most of them were already dead by the time we arrived, but a few were still breathing.$B$BI was about to go in there and execute the rest of them, but I think you should have the honors. In particular, there's a real feisty goblin in there that I think you'll take great pleasure in executing.

Objectives.text: 赤色烈焰礼拜堂的骑士团指挥官普雷菲斯特希望你去处决牢房里的银色黎明俘虏，加里·顽渍。
Objectives.english: Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame has ordered you to execute Gally Lumpstain, an Argent Dawn prisoner inside the nearby prison house.

Description.text: 我们来这儿之后，把这个地方夷为了平地，然后我们又向牢房进发。在那里看到的一切完全出乎我们的意料，$n。看来血色十字军真的很忙。那里塞满了银色黎明的俘虏，我们到那儿的时候，大部分俘虏都已经死了，只剩少数几个奄奄一息。$B$B我本来准备去那儿解决剩下的那几个的，但是我想这份荣耀应该让给你。尤其是，里面有一个感染了瘟疫的地精，我想你一定会在处决中寻找到的极大的快感的。
Description.english: We got here, tore the place apart, and headed toward the prison house. We weren't expecting what we found in there, $n. Seems the Crusade's been real busy. That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. Most of them were already dead by the time we arrived, but a few were still breathing.$B$BI was about to go in there and execute the rest of them, but I think you should have the honors. In particular, there's a real feisty goblin in there that I think you'll take great pleasure in executing.

identity.title: Tailgunner!
identity.objectives: Shoot down 15 Schnottz Aces.
identity.description: You up for a little hunting, $n?$b$bHop in! I'll fly, you shoot!

Objectives.text: 击落15个司克诺兹王牌飞行员。
Objectives.english: Shoot down 15 Schnottz Aces.

Description.text: 你想打猎玩玩吗，$n？$b$b跳进来吧！我来飞，你来打！
Description.english: You up for a little hunting, $n?$b$bHop in! I'll fly, you shoot!

CompletionLog.text: 与维尔纳尔水坝的哈里森·琼斯交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Harrison Jones at Vir'naal Dam.

identity.title: Expert Opinion
identity.objectives: Bring the Suspicious Badges to Mathias Shaw at SI:7 Headquarters in Stormwind.
identity.description: <Anduin holds up the matching badges.>$B$BThe medallion we found on the farm is identical to the one in Samuelson's notes! It can't be a coincidence. I think Samuelson is up to something, but we need a smoking gun before we can accuse one of my father's most trusted guards.$B$BThere's only one person I trust to sort this all out: Mathias Shaw, the director of SI:7. Show him these badges and see what he thinks. Meanwhile, I'll go back to the keep and watch Samuelson like a hawk!

Objectives.text: 把可疑的徽章交给暴风城军情七处总部的马迪亚斯·肖尔。
Objectives.english: Bring the Suspicious Badges to Mathias Shaw at SI:7 Headquarters in Stormwind.

Description.text: <安度因拿起匹配的徽章。>$B$B我们在农场发现的徽章和在萨缪尔森的档案堆里找到那个一样！这不可能是个巧合。我认为萨缪尔森在谋划什么，但在指控父王最信任的守卫之前，我们需要如山的铁证。$B$B我只相信一个人能把事情办妥：马迪亚斯·肖尔，军情七处处长。把徽章拿给他看，听听他怎么说。同时，我会回到城堡，盯着萨缪尔森！
Description.english: <Anduin holds up the matching badges.>$B$BThe medallion we found on the farm is identical to the one in Samuelson's notes! It can't be a coincidence. I think Samuelson is up to something, but we need a smoking gun before we can accuse one of my father's most trusted guards.$B$BThere's only one person I trust to sort this all out: Mathias Shaw, the director of SI:7. Show him these badges and see what he thinks. Meanwhile, I'll go back to the keep and watch Samuelson like a hawk!

CompletionLog.text: 把可疑的徽章交给暴风城军情七处总部的马迪亚斯·肖尔。
CompletionLog.english: Bring the Suspicious Badges to Mathias Shaw at SI:7 Headquarters in Stormwind.

identity.title: They Call Him Swiftdagger. He Kills Harpies.
identity.objectives: Locate Darsok Swiftdagger in Northern Barrens.
identity.description: There's an orc who lives in the west. At the frayed edge of the cataclysm's swath of destruction.$B$BThey call him Swiftdagger, $n. They call him that because ... his ... actually I think that's just his name.$B$B<Nozzlepot shrugs.>$B$BAnyway, he's a harpy-killing machine. He kills harpies. Loves it. It's a living. Go and see him! See how it's done. Live the dream. You might make a career out of it.

Title.text: 人们叫他快刀。他专杀鹰身人。
Title.english: They Call Him Swiftdagger. He Kills Harpies.

Objectives.text: 去北贫瘠之地找到达索克·快刀。
Objectives.english: Locate Darsok Swiftdagger in Northern Barrens.

Description.text: 西边住着一位兽人，紧挨着大灾变破坏地带的边缘。$B$B人们叫他快刀，$n。这是因为……他的……其实我觉得那只是名字而已。$B$B<诺兹波特耸了耸肩。>$B$B总之，他就是鹰身人杀戮机器啦。达索克很喜欢杀鹰身人，并以此为生。去找他吧！了解他的手法，体验他的梦想。你说不定也会考虑将其作为自己的事业的。
Description.english: There's an orc who lives in the west. At the frayed edge of the cataclysm's swath of destruction.$B$BThey call him Swiftdagger, $n. They call him that because ... his ... actually I think that's just his name.$B$B<Nozzlepot shrugs.>$B$BAnyway, he's a harpy-killing machine. He kills harpies. Loves it. It's a living. Go and see him! See how it's done. Live the dream. You might make a career out of it.

identity.title: Back To The Orphanage
identity.objectives: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Oracle Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
identity.description: We had the best time with you, $n. We wish you could be our $g daddy : mama; now, but you have to take us back to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.$B$BMaybe you could come visit us again sometime? We loved meeting Winterfin hatchlings and getting to see the dragon queen. No one will believe us when we say we met a Great One!$B$BWe going to miss you, $n. We promise to write letter sometime, oki?

Objectives.text: 将你的监护对象送回到达拉然孤儿院，把神谕者孤儿哨交给达拉然的孤儿监护员艾蕊娅。
Objectives.english: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Oracle Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

Description.text: 我们和你一起渡过了一段最美好的时光$n。真希望你会是我们的$g爸爸:妈妈;。但你现在必须带我回达拉然的孤儿院里。$B$B也许你什么时候能再来看我们？我们喜欢去看冬鳞小鱼人和红龙女王。绝不会有人相信，我们竟然见到了造物主！$B$B我们会想念你的，$n。一定要给我们写信，我们也会给你写信的，好吗？
Description.english: We had the best time with you, $n. We wish you could be our $g daddy : mama; now, but you have to take us back to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.$B$BMaybe you could come visit us again sometime? We loved meeting Winterfin hatchlings and getting to see the dragon queen. No one will believe us when we say we met a Great One!$B$BWe going to miss you, $n. We promise to write letter sometime, oki?

CompletionLog.text: 去找达拉然的孤儿监护员艾蕊娅。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

identity.title: Wasteland
identity.objectives: Deliver Rabine's Letter to Laylo Starstrike near Southwind Village.
identity.description: This is Silithus, $c... a harsh and brutal wasteland. Few know that an ancient war was waged here between the night elves and a malign, alien power. The evil was sealed, but now we suspect that forces work to stir this... unspeakable horror.$B$BSeek out Layo Starstrike, one of my agents. I have sent him to the southeast to investigate the ruins of Southwind Village.$B$BGive him this letter, and he will give you his trust accordingly.

Objectives.text: 把拉比恩的信交给南风村附近的莱耶·星击。
Objectives.english: Deliver Rabine's Letter to Laylo Starstrike near Southwind Village.

Description.text: 这里是希利苏斯，$c……一片荒芜严酷的废土。现在已经很少有人知道，在古老的年代中，这里曾经爆发过一场宏大的战争，对阵双方是暗夜精灵和一股邪恶的异界力量。现在，这股邪恶力量已经被封印，但我们怀疑它依旧在努力散播……无可形容的恐怖。$B$B找到我的斥候莱耶·星击。我派他去了东南方的南风村遗迹。$B$B把这封信交给他，他就会完全信任你了。
Description.english: This is Silithus, $c... a harsh and brutal wasteland. Few know that an ancient war was waged here between the night elves and a malign, alien power. The evil was sealed, but now we suspect that forces work to stir this... unspeakable horror.$B$BSeek out Layo Starstrike, one of my agents. I have sent him to the southeast to investigate the ruins of Southwind Village.$B$BGive him this letter, and he will give you his trust accordingly.

identity.title: Befoulers of the Wind
identity.objectives: Destroy 10 Desert Rumblers.
identity.description: You are foolish to even have come to a place such as this, $c. But I might have use for even a fool.$B$BI stand vigil here over my master's prison, keeping watch across the years. Nothing may interrupt me. Not even the disgusting minions of the earth that roam here, intruders upon the territory of wind...$B$BI despise them! I destroy those that venture close, but I cannot allow myself to waste time on such pests. If you were to do so, however, I could reward you for it...

Objectives.text: 消灭10个沙漠奔行者。
Objectives.english: Destroy 10 Desert Rumblers.

Description.text: 你居然愚蠢到来这里，$c。但即便是蠢货可能也有用武之地。$B$B多年来，我一直警觉地站在这里，守护着我主人的牢笼。没有什么可以打扰我，即使是肆虐此地的大地爪牙也不允许打搅风的领土……$B$B我藐视他们！我可以轻易毁灭所有胆敢靠近的敌人，但我可不能允许我在那些小虫子身上浪费时间。当然了，如果你有兴趣帮忙，我会大大奖励你…
Description.english: You are foolish to even have come to a place such as this, $c. But I might have use for even a fool.$B$BI stand vigil here over my master's prison, keeping watch across the years. Nothing may interrupt me. Not even the disgusting minions of the earth that roam here, intruders upon the territory of wind...$B$BI despise them! I destroy those that venture close, but I cannot allow myself to waste time on such pests. If you were to do so, however, I could reward you for it...

CompletionLog.text: 回到德米提恩身边，他就在希利苏斯毁坏的暮光营地那里。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Highlord Demitrian at the Ravaged Twilight Camp in Silithus.

identity.title: Prisoners of Madness
identity.objectives: Rescue 5 Hive'Ashi Prisoners.
identity.description: You! Come here! Yes, to the egg! I can just barely see you.$B$BIt looks like Baristolth improved his disguise before you tried it... I'm still stuck in this thing. I'm the scout he sent ahead here.$B$BNo, no, there's no time to assist me! You have to help the others! They've got prisoners all throughout this hive... Find them and rescue them.$B$BI'll get out of this thing myself... how hard could it be?

Objectives.text: 救出5名亚什虫巢囚犯。
Objectives.english: Rescue 5 Hive'Ashi Prisoners.

Description.text: 你！到这边来！是的，到蛋这边来！让我能把你看清楚一点。$B$B看样子，巴里斯托尔斯在给你的伪装上做了一些改进……我却只能在这种破玩意里凑合。我是他之前派到这里的探子。$B$B不，不，你没有时间帮助我了！你必须去帮助其他人！他们全都被抓住，囚禁在这个虫巢里……赶快找到并救出他们。$B$B我自己能从这东西里钻出来……这有什么难的？
Description.english: You! Come here! Yes, to the egg! I can just barely see you.$B$BIt looks like Baristolth improved his disguise before you tried it... I'm still stuck in this thing. I'm the scout he sent ahead here.$B$BNo, no, there's no time to assist me! You have to help the others! They've got prisoners all throughout this hive... Find them and rescue them.$B$BI'll get out of this thing myself... how hard could it be?

CompletionLog.text: 去希利苏斯，找塞纳里奥要塞的指挥官玛尔利斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

identity.title: Alliance Breadcrumb
identity.objectives: Talk to Lady Gurga in Faldir's Cove.
identity.description: Monsters!  They were monsters I tell you!$B$B Our ship pulled into port just south of Stromgarde, but the coast there is infested with strange creatures. $B$B Other than seeing their ugly mugs and hearing strange gurgling noises, I didn't wait to find out what they wanted. You'd better go help my shipmates, $n!

Objectives.text: 去法迪爾海灣與女神格卡說話。
Objectives.english: Talk to Lady Gurga in Faldir's Cove.

Description.text: 怪獸!我告訴你他們是怪獸!$B$B我們的船剛才停靠在激流堡南邊的港口，但是沿海已經到處有奇怪的生物出沒。$B$B除了看到醜陋的鬼臉還有聽見奇怪咕嚕的聲響以外，我沒待在那裡去研究他們到底想要幹嘛。你去幫幫我的水手們吧，$n!
Description.english: Monsters!  They were monsters I tell you!$B$B Our ship pulled into port just south of Stromgarde, but the coast there is infested with strange creatures. $B$B Other than seeing their ugly mugs and hearing strange gurgling noises, I didn't wait to find out what they wanted. You'd better go help my shipmates, $n!

identity.title: Dying Knowledge
identity.objectives: Take the filled canteen to Andalar Shadevale.
identity.description: <The corrupted water bubbles and froths, as if trying to break free from itself.>$B$BTake this water to our scout in the field. He should be able to purify it for our attack on the Shadow Hold's defenses!

Objectives.text: 将装满的水壶交给安达拉尔·荫谷。
Objectives.english: Take the filled canteen to Andalar Shadevale.

Description.text: <腐败的水泛着泡沫，仿佛是想从现有的状态中挣脱出来。>$B$B将这种水交给我们在战场上的斥候。他应该能将这种水净化，为我们进攻暗影堡做好准备！
Description.english: <The corrupted water bubbles and froths, as if trying to break free from itself.>$B$BTake this water to our scout in the field. He should be able to purify it for our attack on the Shadow Hold's defenses!

CompletionLog.text: 将装满的水瓶带给安达拉尔·荫谷。
CompletionLog.english: Take the filled canteen to Andalar Shadevale.

identity.title: Welcome to Paradise
identity.objectives: Kill 6 Flamekin Firestarters
identity.description: Eaaaauuuugggghhhh!$B$BOh my goodness, I thought you were one of THEM.$B$BWho are you? $n? Look, we could really use your help.$B$B<Lasha listens as you ask what's going on.>$B$BAre you blind? The entire resort's on fire! These pesky little Flamekin Firestarters are running around the place, torching everything they can get their grubby little claws on. Kill them all before our profits suffer!

Objectives.text: 消灭6只纵火焰鬼
Objectives.english: Kill 6 Flamekin Firestarters

Description.text: 啊哈哈！$B$B哦我的天哪，我还以为你和他们是一伙的。$B$B你是谁？$n？知道吗，我们正迫切需要你的帮助。$B$B<拉珊听你询问这里到底出了什么事。>$B$B你瞎了吗？难道没有看见整个度假地都已经燃烧起来了！那些可恶的小纵火焰鬼在这里到处乱跑，用他们肮脏的小爪子点燃了这里的每一样东西。赶快消灭他们，否则我们的利润就要受到严重损失了！
Description.english: Eaaaauuuugggghhhh!$B$BOh my goodness, I thought you were one of THEM.$B$BWho are you? $n? Look, we could really use your help.$B$B<Lasha listens as you ask what's going on.>$B$BAre you blind? The entire resort's on fire! These pesky little Flamekin Firestarters are running around the place, torching everything they can get their grubby little claws on. Kill them all before our profits suffer!

CompletionLog.text: 去菲拉斯的蒸汽之池，找拉珊·轴轮
CompletionLog.english: Return to Lasha Gearwheel at The Steam Pools in Feralas

identity.title: 'Borrowing' From the Winterfall
identity.objectives: Obtain 6 pieces of Smoked Meat from either Winterfall furbolg camp in Winterspring and feed them to your Winterspring Cub.
identity.description: Your cub looks at you expectantly. What could it want now?$B$BThe little cat licks its lips. It must be meal time again! As the cub's surrogate $gfather:mother; you're responsible for providing meat until it can hunt on its own.$B$BBut what if you let someone else do the hunting? The Winterfall furbolg of Winterspring usually have a lot of smoked meat on hand in both of their camps. Surely, they wouldn't miss a few pieces and your cub would get to try something new.

Objectives.text: 从冬泉谷的两处冬泉熊怪营地中取得6块熏肉，把它们喂给你的冬泉豹幼崽。
Objectives.english: Obtain 6 pieces of Smoked Meat from either Winterfall furbolg camp in Winterspring and feed them to your Winterspring Cub.

Description.text: 你的幼崽期待地看着你。它想要什么？$B$B这只小猫舔着嘴唇。一定是又到它的吃饭时间了！作为它的代理$g父亲:母亲;，你有责任为它提供肉食，直到它能够自己狩猎。$B$B不过你也可以让其他人完成狩猎工作。冬泉谷的两座冬泉熊怪营地里，冬泉熊怪们通常都会在手边准备许多熏肉。当然，他们不会在乎少几块肉。而你的幼崽也可以尝试一下新食物。
Description.english: Your cub looks at you expectantly. What could it want now?$B$BThe little cat licks its lips. It must be meal time again! As the cub's surrogate $gfather:mother; you're responsible for providing meat until it can hunt on its own.$B$BBut what if you let someone else do the hunting? The Winterfall furbolg of Winterspring usually have a lot of smoked meat on hand in both of their camps. Surely, they wouldn't miss a few pieces and your cub would get to try something new.

CompletionLog.text: 同你的冬泉豹幼崽交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

identity.title: Out of This World
identity.objectives: Destroy 6 Twilight Totems
identity.description: We've had no end of trouble here, $n! Sabotaged food shipments, tampered water supply, and now this! You can't send a more unsubtle message than fire. We clearly aren't wanted here!$B$BBut first things first. Whoever is trying to get rid of us has summoned vile totems all around the grounds. If we destroy those totems, those blasted Flamekin demons will stop appearing.$B$BDestroy any totems that you see before we're overrun!

Objectives.text: 摧毁6只暮光图腾
Objectives.english: Destroy 6 Twilight Totems

Description.text: 我们这里的麻烦真是无穷无尽，$n！食物和用水供给不断遭到破坏。而现在，又出了这种事！火灾这种事情实在是难以预料。我们当然不想让这种事发生在这里！$B$B现在最大的问题是，想要除掉我们的那个恶棍在这里布置了许多图腾。如果我们摧毁了这些图腾，那些该死的喷火魔鬼就不会持续不断地在这里出现了。$B$B摧毁你看到的所有图腾，不要等到我们被彻底毁灭的时候！
Description.english: We've had no end of trouble here, $n! Sabotaged food shipments, tampered water supply, and now this! You can't send a more unsubtle message than fire. We clearly aren't wanted here!$B$BBut first things first. Whoever is trying to get rid of us has summoned vile totems all around the grounds. If we destroy those totems, those blasted Flamekin demons will stop appearing.$B$BDestroy any totems that you see before we're overrun!

CompletionLog.text: 去菲拉斯的蒸汽之池，找拉珊·轴轮
CompletionLog.english: Return to Lasha Gearwheel at The Steam Pools in Feralas

Description.english: Rocco Whipshank waits for you at the road north out of the Crossroads. Let him know you are ready to accompany the caravan.

CompletionLog.text: 同罗克·维普杉克交谈，然后随同莫尔杉商队向北进发。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Rocco Whipshank and ride north with the Mor'shan Caravan.
