identity.title: Follow That Cat
identity.objectives: Find where Mauti has taken Grent Direhammer.
identity.description: The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him.  Find Direhammer before it's too late!

Objectives.text: 找出玛乌提把格伦特·恐锤藏在了哪里。
Objectives.english: Find where Mauti has taken Grent Direhammer.

Description.text: 真正的玛乌提已经把格伦特·恐锤抓走了，但作为一个聪明的猎手，他发射了信号弹以便我们追踪他的行迹。赶快去找恐锤吧，否则一切都晚了！
Description.english: The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him.  Find Direhammer before it's too late!

CompletionLog.text: 和布温巴交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Bwemba.

identity.title: The Power of Malorne
identity.objectives: Use the Guardian's Staff to summon and defeat Galenges.
identity.description: <Matoclaw's voice continues.>$b$bThe portal that opened up to our east is guarded by a powerful flamewaker by the name of Galenges. We will need all of Malorne's help in defeating him.$b$bDo you remember the staff that I gave you? Place it in the pile of ash in front of the portal. Then pray that Malorne comes to your aid.

Objectives.text: 使用守护者之杖来召唤玛洛恩并击败盖伦格斯。
Objectives.english: Use the Guardian's Staff to summon and defeat Galenges.

Description.text: <麦托克劳的声音继续响起。>$b$b我们东边有一面已经开启了的传送门，它的守护者是一名强大的火妖，叫做盖伦格斯。想要击败他，我们需要玛洛恩的全力支持。$b$b你还记得我之前给你的那根法杖吗？把它插在传送门前的灰烬堆里。然后祈求玛洛恩来协助你。
Description.english: <Matoclaw's voice continues.>$b$bThe portal that opened up to our east is guarded by a powerful flamewaker by the name of Galenges. We will need all of Malorne's help in defeating him.$b$bDo you remember the staff that I gave you? Place it in the pile of ash in front of the portal. Then pray that Malorne comes to your aid.

identity.title: The Zandalar Representative
identity.objectives: Meet Bwemba at Stormwind Harbor.
identity.description: $C!  Heed my call.  Stranglethorn Vale has need of your assistance! Long ago you helped da Zandalar out before.  We not be forgetting your deeds.  It be because of your past help dat we come to you for help.  Come to me at the harbor.

Objectives.text: 到暴风城港口见布温巴。
Objectives.english: Meet Bwemba at Stormwind Harbor.

Description.text: $C！响应我的号召，荆棘谷需要你的援助！很久以前你帮助过赞达拉。我们不会忘记你的英勇事迹，所以我们希望再次请求你的援助。到港口找我。
Description.english: $C!  Heed my call.  Stranglethorn Vale has need of your assistance! Long ago you helped da Zandalar out before.  We not be forgetting your deeds.  It be because of your past help dat we come to you for help.  Come to me at the harbor.

identity.title: The Call of the Pack
identity.objectives: Use the Fang of the Wolf to summon and defeat Lylagar.
identity.description: <Matoclaw continues:>$b$bThe easternmost portal of flame is the domain of Lylagar. Stand before the portal, deliver a challenging howl, and then force the fiery beast to submit.

Objectives.text: 使用狼的尖牙来召唤并击败莱拉克斯。
Objectives.english: Use the Fang of the Wolf to summon and defeat Lylagar.

Description.text: <麦托克劳继续说道：>$b$b最东边的烈焰传送门是莱拉克斯的地盘。你站在传送门前，然后发出挑衅的吼声，引诱那只烈焰猛兽出来与你一战。
Description.english: <Matoclaw continues:>$b$bThe easternmost portal of flame is the domain of Lylagar. Stand before the portal, deliver a challenging howl, and then force the fiery beast to submit.

identity.title: Secondary Targets
identity.objectives: Kill Kaulema the Mover, Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and Mortaxx, the Tolling Bell inside of Zul'Gurub.
identity.description: The Gurubashi trolls have gathered their most powerful allies to rebuild Zul'Gurub and re-take Stranglethorn Vale.$B$BChief among them are two monstrous trolls: Kaulema the Mover and Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and a powerful soul-stealer called Mortaxx.$B$BThough they are not the leaders of Zul'Gurub, defeating these powerful minions will aid us greatly preventing the rise of the Gurubashi.

Objectives.text: 在祖尔格拉布中消灭搬运者伽乌里马、撕裂者莫尔雷克和死亡丧钟莫尔塔克斯。
Objectives.english: Kill Kaulema the Mover, Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and Mortaxx, the Tolling Bell inside of Zul'Gurub.

Description.text: 古拉巴什巨魔已经召集起他们最强大的盟友，重新建起祖尔格拉布，占据了荆棘谷。$B$B他们的头领是两个巨大恐怖的巨魔：搬运者伽乌里马和撕裂者莫尔雷克，以及一个被称为莫尔塔克斯的强大窃魂者。$B$B虽然他们并不是祖尔格拉布的统治者，但打败这些强大的巨魔爪牙能够有力地帮助我们阻止古拉巴什崛起。
Description.english: The Gurubashi trolls have gathered their most powerful allies to rebuild Zul'Gurub and re-take Stranglethorn Vale.$B$BChief among them are two monstrous trolls: Kaulema the Mover and Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and a powerful soul-stealer called Mortaxx.$B$BThough they are not the leaders of Zul'Gurub, defeating these powerful minions will aid us greatly preventing the rise of the Gurubashi.

identity.title: The Beasts Within
identity.objectives: Kill the Florawing Hive Queen, Tor-Tun the Slumberer, and a Lost Offspring of Ghaz'Ranka inside of Zul'Gurub.
identity.description: <Maywiki shuffles nervously.>$B$BAfter the fall of Hakkar, the city of the Gurubashi fell into disrepair, and the jungle claimed most of Zul'Gurub for its own.  Several powerful beasts now reside in the cracks and hollows of the ancient city.$B$BWe have seen the powers that the Gurubashi priests wield - they turn the very plantlife against us with their venomous concoctions.  Please, heroes, dispose of these beasts, before they become mindless agents of Jin'Do and his minions!

Objectives.text: 消灭祖尔格拉布中的花翼巢穴女王、沉睡者托尔图恩和一个加兹兰卡的失落后裔。
Objectives.english: Kill the Florawing Hive Queen, Tor-Tun the Slumberer, and a Lost Offspring of Ghaz'Ranka inside of Zul'Gurub.

Description.text: <梅维克紧张得有些坐立不安。>$B$B哈卡败亡之后，都市古拉巴什也逐渐破败坍塌，丛莽覆盖了祖尔格拉布的大部分地区。现在，一些强大的猛兽正潜伏在这座古代都市的残垣断壁中。$B$B我们已经见到过那些古拉巴什牧师的力量——他们利用剧毒调和物，让植物成为我们的敌人。英雄们，请赶快行动，除掉那些猛兽，不要让它们失去自我意识，成为金度以及其爪牙的奴仆！
Description.english: <Maywiki shuffles nervously.>$B$BAfter the fall of Hakkar, the city of the Gurubashi fell into disrepair, and the jungle claimed most of Zul'Gurub for its own.  Several powerful beasts now reside in the cracks and hollows of the ancient city.$B$BWe have seen the powers that the Gurubashi priests wield - they turn the very plantlife against us with their venomous concoctions.  Please, heroes, dispose of these beasts, before they become mindless agents of Jin'Do and his minions!

CompletionLog.text: 同北荆棘谷中祖尔格拉布里面的梅维克交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Maywiki inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.

identity.title: Break Their Spirits
identity.objectives: Kill Gub and the Gurubashi Master Chef inside of Zul'Gurub.
identity.description: A city like Zul'Gurub is similar to one of the many towering trees you see nearby.$B$BThe trunk may be thick, and the canopy vast and leafy, but without nutrients from the roots far below, the tree will wither and fall.$B$BJin'Do's army is fed largely by the actions of two minor Gurubashi trolls.  Sever these roots, and the city will fall all the easier.

Objectives.text: 消灭祖尔格拉布中的伽布和古拉巴什厨师长。
Objectives.english: Kill Gub and the Gurubashi Master Chef inside of Zul'Gurub.

Description.text: 祖尔格拉布这种城市就像你在这里看到的那些参天大树。$B$B也许它的树干粗大坚固，树冠遮天蔽日，但如果没有遥远下方的根系提供营养，这棵树就会枯萎死亡。$B$B金度的军队给养很大一部分来自于两个古拉巴什巨魔小分队。切断这些根系，这座城市就会轻易崩塌。
Description.english: A city like Zul'Gurub is similar to one of the many towering trees you see nearby.$B$BThe trunk may be thick, and the canopy vast and leafy, but without nutrients from the roots far below, the tree will wither and fall.$B$BJin'Do's army is fed largely by the actions of two minor Gurubashi trolls.  Sever these roots, and the city will fall all the easier.

CompletionLog.text: 同北荆棘谷中祖尔格拉布里面的阿塔比姆交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Al'tabim inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.

identity.title: Promises, Promises...
identity.objectives: Retrieve Budd's Map of Zul'Aman from High Priest Nalorakk's terrace in Zul'Aman.
identity.description: My inscrutable theories confirm rumors of vast treasure in Zul'Aman. There'll be mounts and mansions for everyone! First things first, though. You must earn your share, after all....$b$bOur initial efforts here haven't gone as well as I hoped. In fact, my map, and the recruits I lent it to, have gone missing. They were after a troll-beast named Nalorakk.$b$bForget the crew, I need that map! Succeed, and you'll go down in history as the one who helped Budd Nedreck unlock the secrets of Zul'Aman!

Objectives.text: 在祖阿曼的高階祭司納羅拉克殿堂找回霸德的祖阿曼地圖。
Objectives.english: Retrieve Budd's Map of Zul'Aman from High Priest Nalorakk's terrace in Zul'Aman.

Description.text: 我高深的理論證實了祖阿曼大量寶藏的傳言。每個人都有坐騎跟豪宅!但首先第一件事。你總是也要分一杯羹的嘛...。$b$b我們初期的努力並沒有像預期一樣的發展的那麼好。事實上，我的地圖，還有那些我借出去的新成員都不見了。他們都跟一個叫做納羅拉克的食人妖野獸跑了。$b$b那些新成員不重要，我需要的是那張地圖!你要是成功的話，你將會被寫入到協助霸德·奈德瑞克解開祖阿曼秘密的歷史之中!
Description.english: My inscrutable theories confirm rumors of vast treasure in Zul'Aman. There'll be mounts and mansions for everyone! First things first, though. You must earn your share, after all....$b$bOur initial efforts here haven't gone as well as I hoped. In fact, my map, and the recruits I lent it to, have gone missing. They were after a troll-beast named Nalorakk.$b$bForget the crew, I need that map! Succeed, and you'll go down in history as the one who helped Budd Nedreck unlock the secrets of Zul'Aman!

identity.title: Malfurion's Breach
identity.objectives: Secure a foothold in the Firelands.

Objectives.text: 在火源之界佔據一座堡壘。
Objectives.english: Secure a foothold in the Firelands.

identity.title: Follow That Cat
identity.objectives: Find where Mauti has taken Grent Direhammer.
identity.description: Well, that explains why Mauti seemed smaller...  The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him.  Find Direhammer before it's too late!

Objectives.text: 找出玛乌提把格伦特·恐锤藏在了哪里。
Objectives.english: Find where Mauti has taken Grent Direhammer.

Description.text: 好吧，这才是玛乌提体型会变小的原因……真正的玛乌已经把格伦特·恐锤抓走了，但作为一个聪明的猎手，他发射了信号弹以便我们可以追踪他的行迹。赶快去找恐锤吧，否则一切都晚了！
Description.english: Well, that explains why Mauti seemed smaller...  The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him.  Find Direhammer before it's too late!

CompletionLog.text: 和布温巴交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Bwemba.

identity.title: How's the Hunter Holding Up?
identity.objectives: Check on Grent Direhammer.
identity.description: Tings ain't looking good.  Dat panther was under some powerful magic.  We better check on dat hunter an' see how he be doin'.

Objectives.text: 查看格伦特·恐锤是否安好。
Objectives.english: Check on Grent Direhammer.

Description.text: 情况看起来不妙，那猎豹拥有强大的魔法能力。我们最好快去看看那猎手现在怎么样了。
Description.english: Tings ain't looking good.  Dat panther was under some powerful magic.  We better check on dat hunter an' see how he be doin'.

identity.title: Defend Grom'gol
identity.objectives: Help defend Grom'gol Base Camp for three minutes.
identity.description: I hope you like to fight, $n.  Your troll friend has been through here and warned us that the Gurubashi were on the rampage.  I never thought the battle would be this glorious though.$b$bCome, join in our fight and let's show these Gurubashi trolls the might of the Horde!

Objectives.text: 坚守格罗姆高营地三分钟。
Objectives.english: Help defend Grom'gol Base Camp for three minutes.

Description.text: 但愿你擅长战斗，$n。你的巨魔朋友来过此地，警告我们古拉巴什正在疯狂进攻，但我可没预料到战斗会如此惨烈。$b$b来吧，加入到战斗中来，让这些古拉巴什巨魔见识下部落的力量！
Description.english: I hope you like to fight, $n.  Your troll friend has been through here and warned us that the Gurubashi were on the rampage.  I never thought the battle would be this glorious though.$b$bCome, join in our fight and let's show these Gurubashi trolls the might of the Horde!

CompletionLog.text: 同指挥官阿格罗戈什交谈
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Commander Aggro'gosh

identity.title: To Hardwrench Hideaway
identity.objectives: Head to Hardwrench Hideaway in The Cape of Stranglethorn.
identity.description: Bwemba...  Is that you?$b$bYour contact was here.  He was eager to get to the next location and warn them.  And really, who could blame him?  I gave him use of a wyvern to reach the goblins of Hardwrench Hideaway, in the Cape of Stranglethorn.$b$bI will give you use of one of my wyverns to reach Hardwrench.$b$bTalk to me when you are ready to go, $n.

Objectives.text: 前往荆棘谷海角的硬钳避世乐园。
Objectives.english: Head to Hardwrench Hideaway in The Cape of Stranglethorn.

Description.text: 布温巴……是你吗？$b$b你的联络人来过这里，他着急赶往下一站目的地去警告其他人了，但说实在的，谁能怪他呢？我借了他一只双足飞龙，让他飞去荆棘谷海角的硬钳避世乐园去警告地精。$b$b我会让你使用我其中一只双足飞龙，这样你可以直飞目的地。$b$b准备好了就和我说一声，$n。
Description.english: Bwemba...  Is that you?$b$bYour contact was here.  He was eager to get to the next location and warn them.  And really, who could blame him?  I gave him use of a wyvern to reach the goblins of Hardwrench Hideaway, in the Cape of Stranglethorn.$b$bI will give you use of one of my wyverns to reach Hardwrench.$b$bTalk to me when you are ready to go, $n.

identity.title: The Mysterious Seed
identity.objectives: Take the Acorn to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.
identity.description: A small, dried acorn has fallen out of the Flame Druid's robe.$B$BWhy would a Druid of the Flame be carrying it around?$B$BPerhaps someone at Malfurion's Breach would like to see it.

Objectives.text: 把橡子交给熔火前线，玛法里奥突破口的艾薇尔拉。
Objectives.english: Take the Acorn to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

Description.text: 烈焰德鲁伊的袍子里掉出一粒干燥的小橡子。$B$B一名烈焰德鲁伊怎么会带着这样的东西？$B$B也许你应该把它交给玛法里奥突破口的什么人瞧瞧。
Description.english: A small, dried acorn has fallen out of the Flame Druid's robe.$B$BWhy would a Druid of the Flame be carrying it around?$B$BPerhaps someone at Malfurion's Breach would like to see it.

CompletionLog.text: 把橡子交给熔火前线的玛法里奥突破口的艾薇尔拉。
CompletionLog.english: Take the acorn to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

identity.title: Planting Season
identity.objectives: Plant the Acorn in the Un'Goro Soil at Malfurion's Breach.
identity.description: The acorn seems to be unharmed.$B$B<Avrilla shrugs.>$B$BNo point in beating around the bush. Let's plant it and see what comes out.$B$BLuckily for you, we brought some leftover soil with us to help establish our base.$B$BYou'll find the soil at the graveyard directly east.

Objectives.text: 把橡子种到玛法里奥突破口的安戈洛的泥土里。
Objectives.english: Plant the Acorn in the Un'Goro Soil at Malfurion's Breach.

Description.text: 这颗橡子似乎完好无损。$B$B<艾薇尔拉耸了耸肩。>$B$B我就直说了吧。咱们把它种下去，看看会长出什么来。$B$B你很走运，我们为了建立基地，正好带着安戈洛的泥土。$B$B泥土就在正东边的坟场那儿。
Description.english: The acorn seems to be unharmed.$B$B<Avrilla shrugs.>$B$BNo point in beating around the bush. Let's plant it and see what comes out.$B$BLuckily for you, we brought some leftover soil with us to help establish our base.$B$BYou'll find the soil at the graveyard directly east.

identity.title: Little Lasher
identity.objectives: Bring the Crimson Lasher to Avrilla.
identity.description: The little red flower wiggles its tendrils happily. It seems to like you!$B$BPerhaps Avrilla would like to see what grew out of the acorn.

Objectives.text: 把火红鞭笞者交给艾薇尔拉。
Objectives.english: Bring the Crimson Lasher to Avrilla.

Description.text: 小红花开心地挥舞着触须，好像很喜欢你！$B$B或许该让艾薇尔拉看看这株从橡子里长出来的植物。
Description.english: The little red flower wiggles its tendrils happily. It seems to like you!$B$BPerhaps Avrilla would like to see what grew out of the acorn.

CompletionLog.text: 去熔火前线的玛法里奥突破口找艾薇尔拉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

identity.title: A Bitter Pill
identity.objectives: Find the Subterranean Magma Worm's breath bubbles, then defeat it by making it swallow the Bitter Pill.
identity.description: As far as I'm concerned, there's no problem that can't be solved with bombs. And if a bomb doesn't solve your problem on the first try... use a bigger bomb.$b$bSo there's this big worm that's been eating people near the lava pools up north. Search for breath bubbles to find it. Attack it until it prepares to bite, then place this bomb down in front of it. Then sit back and watch the fireworks.$b$bHmm... there was one other thing I wanted to say... oh yeah! Don't get eaten.

Objectives.text: 找到潜地熔岩虫的呼吸气泡，然后让它吞下苦果炸弹，将其击败。
Objectives.english: Find the Subterranean Magma Worm's breath bubbles, then defeat it by making it swallow the Bitter Pill.

Description.text: 就我所知，没有炸弹解决不了的问题。要是你的第一颗炸弹没能解决问题……那么下回就换个大点儿的炸弹。$b$b说来北边的岩浆池那儿有条大虫子，一直在吃人。你可以通过它呼吸产生的气泡找出它的藏身之处。攻击它，直到它要张嘴咬人的时候，就把这枚炸弹放在它面前，然后就坐下来等着看焰火吧。$b$b嗯……我还想提醒你一件事……哦，对了！就是，别被吃掉了。
Description.english: As far as I'm concerned, there's no problem that can't be solved with bombs. And if a bomb doesn't solve your problem on the first try... use a bigger bomb.$b$bSo there's this big worm that's been eating people near the lava pools up north. Search for breath bubbles to find it. Attack it until it prepares to bite, then place this bomb down in front of it. Then sit back and watch the fireworks.$b$bHmm... there was one other thing I wanted to say... oh yeah! Don't get eaten.

identity.title: Some Good Will Come
identity.objectives: Care for the panther cub, after all, you did kill it's mother.
identity.description: So much violence, so much death.  Brothers have died, a mother has died, and now a panther cub will die if there is no one to take care of it.$b$bWill you take a break from the violence and help care for a panther cub?

Objectives.text: 照顾这只豹崽，毕竟是你杀死了它的母亲。
Objectives.english: Care for the panther cub, after all, you did kill it's mother.

Description.text: 这样多的暴力，这样多的死亡。兄弟们死去了，母亲死去了。而现在，如果没有人照顾这只豹崽，它同样会死去。$b$b你能不能暂停一下暴力的行为，来照顾一下豹子的幼崽？
Description.english: So much violence, so much death.  Brothers have died, a mother has died, and now a panther cub will die if there is no one to take care of it.$b$bWill you take a break from the violence and help care for a panther cub?

identity.title: Bound for Warmer Weather
identity.objectives: Speak to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.
identity.description: We should be okay here for now, and they have need of you in the Firelands. You should go through the portal and help them out.

Objectives.text: 到熔岩前線上的瑪法里恩突破口和泰爾迪斯·月落將軍談話。
Objectives.english: Speak to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

Description.text: 我們這裡大概暫時沒問題了，火源之界那邊需要你。你應該穿過傳送門去向他們伸出援手。
Description.english: We should be okay here for now, and they have need of you in the Firelands. You should go through the portal and help them out.

identity.title: Nourishing Waters
identity.objectives: Speak to Ayla Shadowstorm at Malfurion's Breach.
identity.description: I have dispatched the sacred moonwell waters to Malfurion's Breach, as you requested. Ayla is well trained in tending to them. You should return to her and see the boons she weaves for you there.

Objectives.text: 去跟玛法里奥突破口的艾拉·影暴谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Ayla Shadowstorm at Malfurion's Breach.

Description.text: 按照你的要求，我已经将月亮井的圣水送往玛法里奥突破口了。艾拉接受过这类工作的专门训练。你应该去找她，看看她为你准备了什么惊喜。
Description.english: I have dispatched the sacred moonwell waters to Malfurion's Breach, as you requested. Ayla is well trained in tending to them. You should return to her and see the boons she weaves for you there.

identity.title: Animate Embers
identity.objectives: Retrieve 6 Animate Embers.
identity.description: Several of our scouts have reported seeing what seemed to be living flames skittering around the surfaces of Fireplume Peak.$B$BIf the reports are accurate, we need these for study immediately. We've yet to fully understand where all of the attacking elementals come from, and these could well lend us significant insight.

Objectives.text: 取回6個活化餘燼。
Objectives.english: Retrieve 6 Animate Embers.

Description.text: 根據回報，有幾名斥候看見彷彿擁有生命的火焰在火羽峰的地表附近出沒。$B$B若這份報告屬實，取得這些火焰來進行研究便是首要之務。我們還沒真正了解這些進攻的元素來自何方，這種火焰或許能提供有用的線索。
Description.english: Several of our scouts have reported seeing what seemed to be living flames skittering around the surfaces of Fireplume Peak.$B$BIf the reports are accurate, we need these for study immediately. We've yet to fully understand where all of the attacking elementals come from, and these could well lend us significant insight.

CompletionLog.text: 到熔岩前線上的熔爐北端找亞索·風歌。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

identity.title: Pining for Nuts
identity.objectives: Obtain 30 Pine Nuts by toasting Mulgore Pine Cones from Thunder Bluff.  Deliver the nuts to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
identity.description: The Shu'halo use pine nuts in so MANY dishes: meat, fish, vegetables, even baked into breads or sprinkled over sweet pastries.$B$BThe Earth Mother has blessed us in that the very BEST pine nuts come from the trees upon these very mesas. Simply gather pine cones and toast them over a cooking fire to release the nuts within.$B$BWould you please be so kind as to gather some? There are hardly ever enough to go around...

Objectives.text: 通过火烤莫高雷松果取得30份松仁。将它们交给雷霆崖的阿丝卡·迷雾行者。
Objectives.english: Obtain 30 Pine Nuts by toasting Mulgore Pine Cones from Thunder Bluff.  Deliver the nuts to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

Description.text: 舒哈鲁的许多菜肴中都要用到松仁，无论是鱼、肉还是蔬菜。松仁甚至会被加在烤面包里和撒到甜馅饼上面。$B$B大地母亲保佑我们，这些台地的松树上生长着最好的松果。只要把松果放在烹饪用火上稍微烤一烤，松仁就会掉出来。$B$B你是否能帮我从那上面收集一些松仁过来？我的松仁总是不够用……
Description.english: The Shu'halo use pine nuts in so MANY dishes: meat, fish, vegetables, even baked into breads or sprinkled over sweet pastries.$B$BThe Earth Mother has blessed us in that the very BEST pine nuts come from the trees upon these very mesas. Simply gather pine cones and toast them over a cooking fire to release the nuts within.$B$BWould you please be so kind as to gather some? There are hardly ever enough to go around...

identity.title: Hero's Call: Mount Hyjal!
identity.objectives: Speak to Cenarion Emissary Jademoon to secure transportation to Moonglade.
identity.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.$B$BOur brothers in the Cenarion Circle report that Deathwing's minions have launched a destructive offensive against the world tree and threaten to burn it to the ground!$B$BSpeak with Cenarion Emissary Jademoon in Stormwind Keep to gain entry into Moonglade.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance! Fight on, $g brother:sister;!

Objectives.text: 与塞纳里奥使者安亚·碧月交谈，前往月光林地。
Objectives.english: Speak to Cenarion Emissary Jademoon to secure transportation to Moonglade.

Description.text: 奉瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，所有身强力壮的联盟公民都要前往月光林地的永夜港，向风歌使者报到。$B$B我们在塞纳里奥议会中的兄弟报告说，死亡之翼的爪牙向世界之树发起了毁灭性的进攻，试图将其夷为平地！$B$B与暴风要塞中的塞纳里奥使者安亚·碧月交谈，前往月光林地。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！英勇战斗吧，我的$g兄弟:姐妹;!
Description.english: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.$B$BOur brothers in the Cenarion Circle report that Deathwing's minions have launched a destructive offensive against the world tree and threaten to burn it to the ground!$B$BSpeak with Cenarion Emissary Jademoon in Stormwind Keep to gain entry into Moonglade.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance! Fight on, $g brother:sister;!

CompletionLog.text: 与月光林地永夜港的风歌使者交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

identity.title: The Lesson of the Iron Staff
identity.objectives: Loot a training weapon from a weapon rack and then equip it.
identity.description: To train, first you must be properly equipped. Retrieve a weapon from one of the weapon racks below, bring it to me, and show me that you know how to hold it properly.

Title.english: The Lesson of the Iron Staff

Objectives.text: 從武器架上取得訓練用的兵器，並裝備上它。
Objectives.english: Loot a training weapon from a weapon rack and then equip it.

Description.text: 修行欲有成，必先取其器。到下面去，從兵器架上取一樣兵器來給我，讓我看看你有能力適當地掌握他。
Description.english: To train, first you must be properly equipped. Retrieve a weapon from one of the weapon racks below, bring it to me, and show me that you know how to hold it properly.

CompletionLog.text: 到尚羲訓練營找尚羲大師。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Master Shang Xi within the Shang Xi Training Grounds.

identity.title: The Creepy Crate
identity.description: It's been sought after, stolen, and sold. Anyone who tried to tap the magic held within has seen that power turn against him.$B$BYet, the crate itself appears unscathed and suffused with magical energy. From time to time, it shakes or bobs as if its contents were alive.$B$BIt seems bonded to you and now it's yours.

Description.text: 箱子几经偷盗、买卖和追寻。凡是打算解开其中封存的魔法之人，都遭到了其力量的反噬。$B$B饶是如此，箱子本身还是毫发未伤，充盈着魔法能量。偶尔，它还会震动一两下子，仿佛其中装着什么活物一般。$B$B貌似它已经同你绑定在了一起，如今是你的东西了。
Description.english: It's been sought after, stolen, and sold. Anyone who tried to tap the magic held within has seen that power turn against him.$B$BYet, the crate itself appears unscathed and suffused with magical energy. From time to time, it shakes or bobs as if its contents were alive.$B$BIt seems bonded to you and now it's yours.

identity.title: What Now?
identity.objectives: You may return the crate to either Edgar Goodwin at the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.$B$B-OR-$B$BReturn the crate to Delian Sunshade at the Wyvern's Tail in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.
identity.description: You've finally found the crate that Edgar Goodwin sent you to retrieve. However, it appears the Reliquary representative's warnings about the nature of the crate's contents were correct.$B$BThere's no doubt that your employer lied to you about the dangers involved in the job. Do you really want to hand the crate over to him, or would you rather give it to Delian Sunshade, who believes it better to keep the crate's contents locked away?

Objectives.text: 去奥格瑞玛力量谷的“破裂的獠牙”把箱子还给埃德加·古德温。$B$B-或者-$B$B去奥格瑞玛荣誉谷的“飞龙之尾”把箱子交给德利安·日影。
Objectives.english: You may return the crate to either Edgar Goodwin at the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.$B$B-OR-$B$BReturn the crate to Delian Sunshade at the Wyvern's Tail in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

Description.text: 你终于找到了埃德加·古德温要你拿回来的箱子。但是，正如神圣遗物学会的代表警告过你的那样，箱子里装的不是什么好东西。$B$B他说的没错，看来你的雇主没有把这份工作的危险性跟你明说。你真的想把箱子交给他吗，还是说你宁可把它交给德利安·日影？至少后者愿意把箱子里的东西封存于世。
Description.english: You've finally found the crate that Edgar Goodwin sent you to retrieve. However, it appears the Reliquary representative's warnings about the nature of the crate's contents were correct.$B$BThere's no doubt that your employer lied to you about the dangers involved in the job. Do you really want to hand the crate over to him, or would you rather give it to Delian Sunshade, who believes it better to keep the crate's contents locked away?

identity.title: The Creepy Crate
identity.description: It's been sought after, stolen, and sold. Anyone who tried to tap the magic held within has seen that power turn against him.$B$BYet, the crate itself appears unscathed and suffused with magical energy. From time to time, it shakes or bobs as if its contents were alive.$B$BIt seems bonded to you and now it's yours.

Description.text: 箱子几经偷盗、买卖和追寻。凡是打算解开其中封存的魔法之人，都遭到了其力量的反噬。$B$B饶是如此，箱子本身还是毫发未伤，充盈着魔法能量。偶尔，它还会震动一两下子，仿佛其中装着什么活物一般。$B$B貌似它已经同你绑定在了一起，如今是你的东西了。
Description.english: It's been sought after, stolen, and sold. Anyone who tried to tap the magic held within has seen that power turn against him.$B$BYet, the crate itself appears unscathed and suffused with magical energy. From time to time, it shakes or bobs as if its contents were alive.$B$BIt seems bonded to you and now it's yours.

identity.title: Delegation Tracker
identity.objectives: Recover the Branch of Nordrassil from the Firelands.
identity.description: I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, $r, which means my mission here now must fall to you.$b$bA surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here. I have since discovered a most troubling development.$b$bA bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame.$b$bYou must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the world tree's branch.

Objectives.text: 去火焰之地夺回诺达希尔的分枝。
Objectives.english: Recover the Branch of Nordrassil from the Firelands.

Description.text: 我有责任对你的发现进行调查，$r，这也就意味着我的任务现在只能交给你了。$b$b一股远非天然生成的强大魔力将我引来此地，我这才发现事态大为不妙。$b$b有人将诺达希尔的一根树枝折了下来，带到了火焰之地的深处。在那里，敌人正利用它进行邪恶的仪式，以腐蚀诺达希尔，试图用大火烧毁它。$b$b你必须想办法干扰仪式，将世界之树的树枝夺回来。
Description.english: I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, $r, which means my mission here now must fall to you.$b$bA surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here. I have since discovered a most troubling development.$b$bA bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame.$b$bYou must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the world tree's branch.

CompletionLog.text: 去北风苔原的琥珀崖，跟卡雷苟斯谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Kalecgos at Amber Ledge in Borean Tundra.

identity.title: A Captured Banner
identity.objectives: Bring the Banner of the Fallen to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
identity.description: This tattered banner bears a faded guild crest. This old banner must've seen more than its share of battles.$B$BProfessor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire collects banners and other relics of combat and he might be interested in acquiring this one.

Objectives.text: 将阵亡者的旗帜交给暗月岛上暗月马戏团的萨杜斯·帕雷教授。
Objectives.english: Bring the Banner of the Fallen to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.

Description.text: 这面破烂的旗帜上有一个褪色的公会徽章。这面陈旧的旗帜肯定见证过无数大战。$B$B暗月马戏团的萨杜斯·帕雷教授一直在收集旗帜和其他的战争遗物。他或许会对这件东西感兴趣的。
Description.english: This tattered banner bears a faded guild crest. This old banner must've seen more than its share of battles.$B$BProfessor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire collects banners and other relics of combat and he might be interested in acquiring this one.

identity.title: Plenty of Plump Frogs
identity.objectives: Catch 5 Plump Frogs near Stonebull Lake.
identity.description: Just about everyone in Azeroth has heard of our world famous crunchy frogs. We can barely keep up with the demand!$B$BYou look like a decent angler and a spry $r. Would you help me restock my frog supply?$B$BThe ones that make the best crunchy frogs are the plump ones that live down near Stonebull Lake. I'll make it worthwhile for you.

Objectives.text: 在石牛湖附近抓5只肥美的青蛙。
Objectives.english: Catch 5 Plump Frogs near Stonebull Lake.

Description.text: 我们的脆青蛙肉是艾泽拉斯妇孺皆知的美味，简直供不应求！$B$B你这个$r看起来眼疾手快啊，一定是个垂钓高手。不如帮我弄些青蛙来？$B$B石牛湖的肥美青蛙是脆青蛙肉的上佳原料。帮帮忙吧，我一定不会亏待你的。
Description.english: Just about everyone in Azeroth has heard of our world famous crunchy frogs. We can barely keep up with the demand!$B$BYou look like a decent angler and a spry $r. Would you help me restock my frog supply?$B$BThe ones that make the best crunchy frogs are the plump ones that live down near Stonebull Lake. I'll make it worthwhile for you.

CompletionLog.text: 把肥美的青蛙带给暗月马戏团的斯塔姆·雷角。
CompletionLog.english: Bring the Plump Frogs to Stamp Thunderhorn at the Darkmoon Faire.

identity.title: Baby Needs Two Pair of Shoes
identity.objectives: Use the Iron Stock to craft 4 Horseshoes, then apply the Horseshoes to Baby at the Darkmoon Faire.
identity.description: You may have seen my horse, Baby, over near the wagons. She pulls the cart that hauls all the animals in our Zoo Bizarre.$B$BShe's a hard worker and she tears through shoes like you wouldn't believe. It's about time for a new set. I've already bought the raw materials.$B$BAll you need to do is shape them over an anvil and apply them to Baby's feet. It's a quick job and worth some tickets, wouldn't you say?

Title.english: Baby Needs Two Pair of Shoes

Objectives.text: 使用储备铁块制造4块马蹄铁，然后给暗月马戏团的贝贝安上马蹄铁。
Objectives.english: Use the Iron Stock to craft 4 Horseshoes, then apply the Horseshoes to Baby at the Darkmoon Faire.

Description.text: 你可能已经在马车这边见过我的马驹贝贝了。她拉的马车把一些动物运送到珍奇馆里。$B$B她干活可卖力了，你可能不会相信她的蹄铁损耗得多么快。现在是时候给她换双新鞋了。我已经把所有的原材料购齐了。$B$B你需要做的就是把它们在铁砧上定型，然后安在贝贝的蹄子上。这事不会用掉你太多时间，还能换取一些奖券，何乐而不为呢？
Description.english: You may have seen my horse, Baby, over near the wagons. She pulls the cart that hauls all the animals in our Zoo Bizarre.$B$BShe's a hard worker and she tears through shoes like you wouldn't believe. It's about time for a new set. I've already bought the raw materials.$B$BAll you need to do is shape them over an anvil and apply them to Baby's feet. It's a quick job and worth some tickets, wouldn't you say?

CompletionLog.text: 向暗月马戏团的亚布·尼比盖尔复命。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Yebb Neblegear at the Darkmoon Faire.

identity.title: Rearm, Reuse, Recycle
identity.objectives: Collect 6 pieces of Tonk Scrap from around the Darkmoon Faire grounds.
identity.description: Faire-goers just love the steam tonks! And when the Darkmoon Faire closes, these grounds will be littered with tonk scrap.$B$BIt'd be a shame to let all that good metal just sit in the dirt.$B$BIf you help me collect some of the larger scraps, I can use them to reforge broken tonk parts. It's a lot less expensive than buying new metal every time. What do you say?

Objectives.text: 在暗月马戏团周围的地上收集6块坦克碎片。
Objectives.english: Collect 6 pieces of Tonk Scrap from around the Darkmoon Faire grounds.

Description.text: 马戏团的常客都很喜欢蒸汽坦克！而等马戏团关闭时，地上到处都是坦克的残骸。$B$B这些金属还能用，就这么丢了怪可惜的。$B$B如果你能帮我一起收集大块的碎片，我就可以用它们来修补破损的坦克部件。相比每次都要买新的材料，这可要节省不少。你说呢？
Description.english: Faire-goers just love the steam tonks! And when the Darkmoon Faire closes, these grounds will be littered with tonk scrap.$B$BIt'd be a shame to let all that good metal just sit in the dirt.$B$BIf you help me collect some of the larger scraps, I can use them to reforge broken tonk parts. It's a lot less expensive than buying new metal every time. What do you say?

CompletionLog.text: 去暗月马戏团找瑞林。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

identity.title: Tan My Hide
identity.objectives: Scrape 4 Staked Skins around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
identity.description: The Darkmoon Faire always needs more leather for tents, boots, and just about anything you can imagine! I've trapped some creatures and staked the skins out for the next part of their treatment.$B$BYou seem to have some knowledge of skinning. I'll reward you if you help me with the job of scraping some of those new skins.

Objectives.text: 从暗月马戏团周围弄到4张剥好的兽皮。
Objectives.english: Scrape 4 Staked Skins around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.

Description.text: 暗月马戏团总是需要更多的皮革来制作帐篷、靴子，以及一切你所能想到的东西！我抓了些动物，准备用它们的皮来做点什么。$B$B你看起来好像会剥皮。只要你能帮我剥几块新皮我就会给你一些报酬。
Description.english: The Darkmoon Faire always needs more leather for tents, boots, and just about anything you can imagine! I've trapped some creatures and staked the skins out for the next part of their treatment.$B$BYou seem to have some knowledge of skinning. I'll reward you if you help me with the job of scraping some of those new skins.

CompletionLog.text: 去暗月马戏团找克洛诺斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

identity.title: Putting the Carnies Back Together Again
identity.objectives: Use the Darkmoon Bandage to heal 4 Injured Carnies.
identity.description: Working the Darkmoon Faire is a dangerous job, $n. It's no surprise that many of our workers get injured setting up, taking down, and transporting all of its attractions.$B$BWe send the most gravely wounded to the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff for help, but many still have minor hurts that can be tended to here. Would you take these bandages and see if you can help any of the injured workers?

Title.english: Putting the Carnies Back Together Again

Objectives.text: 用暗月绷带治疗4个受伤的艺人。
Objectives.english: Use the Darkmoon Bandage to heal 4 Injured Carnies.

Description.text: 在暗月马戏团工作可是很危险的，$n。所以我们的员工在装配、拆卸和运送各种游乐设施时，经常会有人受伤。$B$B我们已经把重伤员送去雷霆崖的灵魂高地寻求帮助了，不过还有些受了轻伤的人留在这里修养。你能不能用这些绷带去帮助那些受伤的工人？
Description.english: Working the Darkmoon Faire is a dangerous job, $n. It's no surprise that many of our workers get injured setting up, taking down, and transporting all of its attractions.$B$BWe send the most gravely wounded to the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff for help, but many still have minor hurts that can be tended to here. Would you take these bandages and see if you can help any of the injured workers?

CompletionLog.text: 去暗月马戏团找克洛诺斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

identity.title: Fun for the Little Ones
identity.objectives: Bring 15 Fossil Fragments to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire.
identity.description: Children are always full of questions about what an archaeologist does and how it works, so I prepared a demonstration for them.$B$BI take artifacts and fossils and bury them in the sand behind the tent. The children get to dig and make their own discoveries, learn how bones fit together, and see how archaeology can teach them about history.$B$BIf you have any spare fossils, would you consider donating them to my side project?

Objectives.text: 把15个化石碎片交给暗月马戏团的萨杜斯·帕雷教授。
Objectives.english: Bring 15 Fossil Fragments to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire.

Description.text: 孩子们总是会问很多诸如“考古学家是干什么的？”或是“考古有什么用？”等等问题，于是我为他们准备了一场演示。$B$B我把神器和化石埋在帐篷后面的沙地里，孩子们可以自行挖掘，了解骨头是如何拼接起来，并通过考古学学习历史。$B$B如果你有多余的化石，是否愿意为我的这个方案捐献一点出来呢？
Description.english: Children are always full of questions about what an archaeologist does and how it works, so I prepared a demonstration for them.$B$BI take artifacts and fossils and bury them in the sand behind the tent. The children get to dig and make their own discoveries, learn how bones fit together, and see how archaeology can teach them about history.$B$BIf you have any spare fossils, would you consider donating them to my side project?

identity.title: Take Care of It
identity.objectives: Resolve the dispute any way you see fit.
identity.description: This looks bad... you'd better do something.

Objectives.text: 用任何你感覺合適的方法解決爭論。
Objectives.english: Resolve the dispute any way you see fit.

Description.text: 這看起來很糟...你最好做點什麼。
Description.english: This looks bad... you'd better do something.

identity.title: Safety Is Job One
identity.objectives: Artificer Morphalius wants you to kill 10 Ethereal Crypt Raiders, 5 Ethereal Sorcerers, 5 Nexus Stalkers and 5 Ethereal Spellbinders.$B$BOnce that's done, find the Ethereal Transporter in the chamber before Shaffar's and activate it.
identity.description: Shaffar's ethereals have completely blocked us out of the Mana-Tombs. Thankfully, I've got a plan. While we can't go in through the front door, there are sure to be several transporters inside.$B$BI want you to clear the way for my crew first and then I want you to activate one of their transporters to teleport us inside.$B$BActivate the teleporter in the chamber right before Shaffar's chambers when the way has been cleared. Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while...

Objectives.text: 工匠莫法鲁斯要你杀死10个虚灵盗墓者、5个虚灵巫师、5个节点潜行者和5个虚灵缚法者。$B$B全部搞定之后，激活沙法尔房间的前一个房间中的虚灵传送器。
Objectives.english: Artificer Morphalius wants you to kill 10 Ethereal Crypt Raiders, 5 Ethereal Sorcerers, 5 Nexus Stalkers and 5 Ethereal Spellbinders.$B$BOnce that's done, find the Ethereal Transporter in the chamber before Shaffar's and activate it.

Description.text: 沙法尔手下的虚灵将我们完全隔绝在了法力陵墓外。不过我已经想好了对付他的法子。虽然我们无法从正门进入，但是陵墓内应该设有好几台传送器。$B$B我要你去替我的手下清理陵墓的通路，然后激活传送器，将我们传送到法力陵墓中。$B$B通路清理完毕后，直接激活沙法尔的房间前面那个房间中的传送器就可以了。放心吧，我不会让你白跑这一趟的……
Description.english: Shaffar's ethereals have completely blocked us out of the Mana-Tombs. Thankfully, I've got a plan. While we can't go in through the front door, there are sure to be several transporters inside.$B$BI want you to clear the way for my crew first and then I want you to activate one of their transporters to teleport us inside.$B$BActivate the teleporter in the chamber right before Shaffar's chambers when the way has been cleared. Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while...

CompletionLog.text: 去希尔斯布莱德丘陵找希尔斯布莱德农场的虚灵传送器控制台。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Ethereal Transporter Control Panel at Hillsbrad Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

identity.title: The Opening of the Dark Portal
identity.objectives: Sa'at inside the Black Morass of the Caverns of Time has tasked you with defending Medivh until he succeeds in opening the Dark Portal.$B$BReturn to Sa'at should you succeed in your task.
identity.description: Here the Guardian Medivh feverishly works to open the Dark Portal.$B$BScattered across the morass, rifts will materialize. Infinite will pour out of the rifts and attempt to destroy Medivh's shields and, ultimately, Medivh.$B$BKill their rift lords and leaders until Medivh succeeds!

Title.english: The Opening of the Dark Portal

Objectives.text: 时光之穴黑色沼泽的萨艾特要求你保护麦迪文，直到他成功开启黑暗之门。$B$B任务完成后向萨艾特复命。
Objectives.english: Sa'at inside the Black Morass of the Caverns of Time has tasked you with defending Medivh until he succeeds in opening the Dark Portal.$B$BReturn to Sa'at should you succeed in your task.

Description.text: 守护者麦迪文正在这里兴奋地忙碌着，想要打开黑暗之门。$B$B但沼泽四周将会出现许多裂隙。永恒之龙会涌出裂隙，试图破坏麦迪文的法力护盾，最终杀死麦迪文。$B$B消灭裂隙领主和他们的首领！保护麦迪文，直到黑暗之门成功开启。
Description.english: Here the Guardian Medivh feverishly works to open the Dark Portal.$B$BScattered across the morass, rifts will materialize. Infinite will pour out of the rifts and attempt to destroy Medivh's shields and, ultimately, Medivh.$B$BKill their rift lords and leaders until Medivh succeeds!

CompletionLog.text: 去找黑色沼泽的萨艾特。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Sa'at in The Black Morass.

identity.title: The Scryer's Scryer
identity.objectives: Tyrith wants you to use the orb on the balcony in Magisters' Terrace.
identity.description: <Tyrith winces in pain as he speaks.>$b$bGo to the terrace... use the orb.$b$b...They're...feeding the sunwell....$b$b <Tyrith gasps for breath.>$b$bHurry... They must be stopped... before they can....$b$b<Tyrith dies.>

Objectives.text: 塔雷斯要求你使用魔导师平台内的阳台上的宝珠。
Objectives.english: Tyrith wants you to use the orb on the balcony in Magisters' Terrace.

Description.text: <塔雷斯一边说话，一边痛苦地抽搐。>$b$b去……去平台上，使用那颗宝珠。$b$b……它们正在……为太阳之井输送能量……$b$b<塔雷斯艰难地喘着气。>$b$b快点……必须马上阻止他们……不要等到他们……$b$b<塔雷斯咽下了最后一口气。>
Description.english: <Tyrith winces in pain as he speaks.>$b$bGo to the terrace... use the orb.$b$b...They're...feeding the sunwell....$b$b <Tyrith gasps for breath.>$b$bHurry... They must be stopped... before they can....$b$b<Tyrith dies.>

CompletionLog.text: 去找魔导师平台的卡雷苟斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kalecgos in Magisters' Terrace.

identity.title: The General's Edge
identity.objectives: Bring Nazgrim's axe to General Nazgrim.
identity.description: As you gradually gather your senses and begin to take in your surroundings, this object stands out amongst the strewn wreckage.$b$bIt occurs to you that this is the first time you've seen Nazgrim's axe outside of his tight grasp. Somehow, this fact makes your predicament even more unsettling...$b$bYou know that dead or alive, the General would want his weapon back in his possession.

Objectives.text: 把纳兹戈林的斧子给纳兹戈林将军带去。
Objectives.english: Bring Nazgrim's axe to General Nazgrim.

Description.text: 当你逐渐恢复知觉，眼前的一切渐渐清晰起来时，这件东西在四散开来的残骸中格外引人注目。$b$b你突然想到，那是一直被纳兹戈林紧紧握在手中的斧子，你从未见过这柄斧子离开他的身侧。莫名地，这个事实让你更加不安……$b$b你知道，不管是生是死，将军肯定希望他的武器能回到他的手里。
Description.english: As you gradually gather your senses and begin to take in your surroundings, this object stands out amongst the strewn wreckage.$b$bIt occurs to you that this is the first time you've seen Nazgrim's axe outside of his tight grasp. Somehow, this fact makes your predicament even more unsettling...$b$bYou know that dead or alive, the General would want his weapon back in his possession.

identity.title: The Witch in the Woods
identity.objectives: Find An Windfur on the road north of the Jade Witch Hut.
identity.description: Oh please $r!  Can you help me?$b$bSome of the village children were playing in the woods and haven't come back. Could you please keep an eye out for them if you are going out there?$b$bI told those village rascals to leave that old widow up in the woods alone. My guess is they are probably harassing her. They think she is a witch.

Objectives.text: 去青玉巫婆的小屋北边，找到路上的安·风裘。
Objectives.english: Find An Windfur on the road north of the Jade Witch Hut.

Description.text: 求求你，$r！你能帮帮我吗？$b$b村里有些孩子进了林子里玩耍，但到现在还没有回来。如果你出去的话能不能帮我留意一下他们？$b$b我跟村子里的那些淘气鬼说过，不要去招惹林子里的那个老寡妇。我猜他们可能去招惹她了。他们认为她是个巫婆。
Description.english: Oh please $r!  Can you help me?$b$bSome of the village children were playing in the woods and haven't come back. Could you please keep an eye out for them if you are going out there?$b$bI told those village rascals to leave that old widow up in the woods alone. My guess is they are probably harassing her. They think she is a witch.

CompletionLog.text: 找到安·风裘。
CompletionLog.english: Find An Windfur.

identity.title: Some "Pupil of Nature"
identity.objectives: Investigate the Woods of the Lost, northeast of the Greenstone Quarry.
identity.description: Wood sprites are not prone to wandering, so I'm surprised they ventured down as far as the mason's quarter. Something must be forcing them out of their natural habitat.$B$BThese particular sprites are native to the Woods of the Lost, just north of here. I'd go myself, but I've heard those woods are haunted.$B$BSo yeah, that's out.$B$BI guess we'll never know.$B$B<Weng coughs.>$B$BOrrrr... A big brave adventurer like YOU could go check it out! What do you say?

Objectives.text: 调查绿石采掘场东北方向的失落林地。
Objectives.english: Investigate the Woods of the Lost, northeast of the Greenstone Quarry.

Description.text: 林精平时是不会随意乱跑的，所以我很吃惊他们竟然会大老远地跑来矿工区。一定有什么东西迫使它们离开了原本的栖息地。$B$B这些林精的老家在北方的失落林地。我本来是要亲自去一趟的，不过我听说林子里闹鬼。$B$B所以，这计划就搁浅了。$B$B我猜我们就没法知道了。$B$B<老翁开始咳嗽。>$B$B或者……像你这样勇敢的冒险者可以去查探一下！你觉得呢？
Description.english: Wood sprites are not prone to wandering, so I'm surprised they ventured down as far as the mason's quarter. Something must be forcing them out of their natural habitat.$B$BThese particular sprites are native to the Woods of the Lost, just north of here. I'd go myself, but I've heard those woods are haunted.$B$BSo yeah, that's out.$B$BI guess we'll never know.$B$B<Weng coughs.>$B$BOrrrr... A big brave adventurer like YOU could go check it out! What do you say?

identity.title: Efficient Excavations
identity.objectives: Bring 'Efficient Excavations' to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.
identity.description: This manual describes outlandish theories on how to most efficiently manage large groups of workers as they engage in massive excavation projects.$b$bAfter a quick skim of the material, it becomes clear to you that the author of the book is the figure in charge of the over-aggressive pillagers here.$b$bA map on the back cover indicates that the author has a bunker in the southwest region of Uldum.$b$bPerhaps an introduction is in order.

Objectives.text: 把《高效挖掘技巧》交给司克诺兹登陆点的贝洛克·辉刃。
Objectives.english: Bring 'Efficient Excavations' to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.

Description.text: 这本手册描述了诸多古怪的理论，关于在大群工人从事大规模挖掘作业时，如何进行最为有效的管理。$b$b稍稍把材料阅读了一遍，你就明白过来，这本册子的作者就是此地那些过于积极的掠夺者们的头领。$b$b封底的一张地图表明作者在奥丹姆西南地区有一座碉堡。$b$b也许该跟他见上一见。
Description.english: This manual describes outlandish theories on how to most efficiently manage large groups of workers as they engage in massive excavation projects.$b$bAfter a quick skim of the material, it becomes clear to you that the author of the book is the figure in charge of the over-aggressive pillagers here.$b$bA map on the back cover indicates that the author has a bunker in the southwest region of Uldum.$b$bPerhaps an introduction is in order.

identity.title: The Faceless Ones
identity.objectives: Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun wants you to kill Herald Volazj and the three Forgotten Ones that accompany him in Ahn'Kahet.
identity.description: In my peoples' struggle against the forces of the undead, they dug deeper as they lost ground. In desperation, they dug too deep.$b$bWe inadvertently exposed a tendril of the old god's will, which was made manifest in the creatures known only as the Faceless.$b$bIn the end, we could not fight on two fronts against such powerful enemies. Our misfortune cost us the war against the undead, and ultimately, our home.$b$bEnter Ahn'kahet, $c, and cleanse our former home of these Faceless atrocities.

Objectives.text: 纳尔苏深渊的拆解者基里克斯要你去杀死传令官沃拉兹和他身边的3个被遗忘的无面者。
Objectives.english: Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun wants you to kill Herald Volazj and the three Forgotten Ones that accompany him in Ahn'Kahet.

Description.text: 我的同胞们在对抗亡灵天灾的战斗中，一旦遭到失败，就会采取往深处挖洞的办法躲避敌人。可在绝望的驱使下，他们挖得太深了。$B$B我们不小心放出了一群古神的爪牙，一种名为无面者的生物。$B$B最终，我们无法面对两个如此强大的敌人。这场灾难导致我们输掉了对亡灵的战争，并最终失去了我们的家园。$B$B进入安卡赫特吧，$c，把这些无面者暴徒清除出我们的故园。
Description.english: In my peoples' struggle against the forces of the undead, they dug deeper as they lost ground. In desperation, they dug too deep.$b$bWe inadvertently exposed a tendril of the old god's will, which was made manifest in the creatures known only as the Faceless.$b$bIn the end, we could not fight on two fronts against such powerful enemies. Our misfortune cost us the war against the undead, and ultimately, our home.$b$bEnter Ahn'kahet, $c, and cleanse our former home of these Faceless atrocities.

CompletionLog.text: 去龙骨荒野的纳尔苏深渊向拆解者基里克斯复命。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in Dragonblight.

identity.title: Save the Cuddlies
identity.objectives: Lasso 5 Drunk Red Pandas in Fox Grove and bring them to Apprentice Ji Alerage.
identity.description: The Fox Grove has become a dangerous place for the local red pandas. $b$bSadly due to my actions helping that crazy Brewmaster Shadowpour, the foxes of the grove have developed an inebriation bite.  The result is the little red pandas keep getting drunk until they can no longer defend themselves.  $b$bPlease!  Can you help me?$b$bIf you round up some of them I have an aroma about this fire that will help sober them up.  That should keep them safe for at least a short while.

Objectives.text: 套住5只狐狸森林里喝醉的红色熊猫，然后把他们带到徒弟季·酒怒身边。
Objectives.english: Lasso 5 Drunk Red Pandas in Fox Grove and bring them to Apprentice Ji Alerage.

Description.text: 狐狸森林已经成为了本地红色熊猫的危险之地。$b$b都怪我帮了那个疯狂的酒仙影斟，森林里的狐狸才学会了酩酊之咬。于是这些年幼的红色熊猫一直处于酒醉的状态，毫无反击之力。$b$b请帮帮我！你能帮帮我吗？$b$b如果你能把他们中的一些聚拢过来，我就可以用这堆火的芳香让他们清醒过来。这样应该可以暂时保证他们的安全。
Description.english: The Fox Grove has become a dangerous place for the local red pandas. $b$bSadly due to my actions helping that crazy Brewmaster Shadowpour, the foxes of the grove have developed an inebriation bite.  The result is the little red pandas keep getting drunk until they can no longer defend themselves.  $b$bPlease!  Can you help me?$b$bIf you round up some of them I have an aroma about this fire that will help sober them up.  That should keep them safe for at least a short while.

CompletionLog.text: 和学徒季·酒怒谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Apprentice Ji Alerage.

identity.title: Lethal Hangovers
identity.objectives: Kill 8 intoxicated foxes in the Fox Grove.
identity.description: I told him not to do it!  But "no one stands in the way of Brewmaster Shadowpour".$b$BMy master went and contaminated the local water supply trying to "add flavor" to the water. The toxins trickled down here to the Fox Grove where the brew has an irreversible effect on the foxes. $b$BIt warps their minds and sends them into a frenzy.  Now they are a permanent danger to any travelers and local wildlife.$b$BCan you help me cull some of their numbers please?

Objectives.text: 杀死狐狸森林里8只醉酒狂暴的狐狸。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 intoxicated foxes in the Fox Grove.

Description.text: 我劝过他别这样做！但是他却说“没人能阻止酒仙影斟”。$b$B我师父污染了本地水源，居然是为了往水里“添加酒香”。酒毒从这里流进了狐狸森林，对那里的狐狸产生了难以逆转的影响。$b$B酒毒扭曲了它们的思想，并让他们变得狂暴。现在，它们威胁到了旅行者和本地的野生生物。$b$B你能帮我削减它们的数量吗？
Description.english: I told him not to do it!  But "no one stands in the way of Brewmaster Shadowpour".$b$BMy master went and contaminated the local water supply trying to "add flavor" to the water. The toxins trickled down here to the Fox Grove where the brew has an irreversible effect on the foxes. $b$BIt warps their minds and sends them into a frenzy.  Now they are a permanent danger to any travelers and local wildlife.$b$BCan you help me cull some of their numbers please?

CompletionLog.text: 和学徒季·酒怒谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Apprentice Ji Alerage.

identity.title: Tracking Event: Spies Leave
identity.objectives: See the scouts off, then speak to Big Lu.
identity.description: It's time for Sully and I to leave. We'll keep our eyes out for any sign of the White Pawn and report back shortly.$B$BI'm afraid I must leave you in charge while Admiral Taylor is recovering. Learn as much as you can from these jinyu while we are away. I expect a full report when we return.

Objectives.text: 目送斥候离开，然后与卢山大哥谈一谈。
Objectives.english: See the scouts off, then speak to Big Lu.

Description.text: 我和苏利该出发了。我们会注意寻找白卒留下的一切痕迹并尽快回报。$B$B在海军上将泰勒康复期间，我恐怕只能让你留下来主持大局了。在我们离开的期间，你要尽可能多地多了解这些锦鱼人。我希望当我们回来的时候能得到一份详细的报告。
Description.english: It's time for Sully and I to leave. We'll keep our eyes out for any sign of the White Pawn and report back shortly.$B$BI'm afraid I must leave you in charge while Admiral Taylor is recovering. Learn as much as you can from these jinyu while we are away. I expect a full report when we return.

identity.title: Broken Earthen Figurine
identity.objectives: Repair the broken figurine using your skill and materials.
identity.description: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner.  However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.

Objectives.text: 运用你的技能和材料，修复破损的雕像。
Objectives.english: Repair the broken figurine using your skill and materials.

Description.text: 这只破损的雕像被它的主人扔掉了。不过，只要有合适的材料，再加上你的珠宝加工技能，就可以完全修复它。
Description.english: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner.  However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.

CompletionLog.text: 任务完成文本。
CompletionLog.english: Completion text.

identity.title: The Darkness Around Us
identity.objectives: Kill 15 sha invaders.
identity.description: Despite our best efforts, the sha broke the seals around the main temple.$B$BIf we cannot hold them back here, their darkness will spread to the rest of the Jade Forest.$B$BWe need your help immediately. Kill any sha creatures that you see. They should not be difficult to find.

Objectives.text: 杀死15个煞魔侵略者。
Objectives.english: Kill 15 sha invaders.

Description.text: 尽管我们已竭尽全力，但煞魔还是破坏了主殿周围的封印。$B$B如果我们不能击退他们，黑暗力量势必蔓延至整个翡翠林。$B$B我们急需你的帮助。杀死你见到的所有煞魔。这些家伙并不难找。
Description.english: Despite our best efforts, the sha broke the seals around the main temple.$B$BIf we cannot hold them back here, their darkness will spread to the rest of the Jade Forest.$B$BWe need your help immediately. Kill any sha creatures that you see. They should not be difficult to find.

identity.title: Much to Learn
identity.objectives: Speak to Master Shang Xi.
identity.description: Freshly arrived for your training, your first task is simple: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

Objectives.text: 与尚喜师父交谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

Description.text: 初来乍到，你的第一个任务很简单：与尚喜师父交谈。
Description.english: Freshly arrived for your training, your first task is simple: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

identity.objectives: Speak to Master Shang Xi.
identity.description: Fresh to your training, your first task is simple: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

Objectives.text: 跟尚羲大師談話。
Objectives.english: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

Description.text: 在訓練初期，你的第一項任務很簡單:去跟尚羲大師談話。
Description.english: Fresh to your training, your first task is simple: Speak to Master Shang Xi.

identity.title: Behind the Masks
identity.objectives: Collect 8 Masks of Doubt.
identity.description: The sha may seem unstoppable, but this is not true.$B$BTheir masks seem to be the source of their power. When a sha and its mask are separated, the creature's essence is banished back to its own realm.$B$BBring me intact masks, for I wish to study them further. Do be careful. I'm sure the sha will not part with them easily.

Objectives.text: 收集8个怀疑面具。
Objectives.english: Collect 8 Masks of Doubt.

Description.text: 煞魔看似势不可挡，其实不然。$B$B它们的力量似乎来自它们的面具。当煞魔的面具被摘除后，它们的精魄就会被放逐回自己的世界。$B$B给我带些完好的面具回来，我想更仔细地研究一下。一定要当心，煞魔肯定不会乖乖地交出面具的。
Description.english: The sha may seem unstoppable, but this is not true.$B$BTheir masks seem to be the source of their power. When a sha and its mask are separated, the creature's essence is banished back to its own realm.$B$BBring me intact masks, for I wish to study them further. Do be careful. I'm sure the sha will not part with them easily.

identity.title: Saving the Sutras
identity.objectives: Collect 6 Ancient Sutras.
identity.description: My adepts had to abandon their studies when the sha invasion began.$B$BUnfortunately, they left their books scattered around the temple grounds. These priceless works of knowledge must be saved!$B$BThe sutras can be found near the Training Pit and the Adept's Ring to the northeast.

Objectives.text: 收集6本古旧的经书。
Objectives.english: Collect 6 Ancient Sutras.

Description.text: 煞魔入侵时，我的助祭们不得不中断了研究。$B$B糟糕的是，他们把经书遗落在了寺庙庭院中。我们必须抢救这些知识瑰宝！$B$BT你可以在东北部的助祭之环和训练场附近找到这些经书。
Description.english: My adepts had to abandon their studies when the sha invasion began.$B$BUnfortunately, they left their books scattered around the temple grounds. These priceless works of knowledge must be saved!$B$BThe sutras can be found near the Training Pit and the Adept's Ring to the northeast.

identity.title: Arrows of Fortune
identity.objectives: Collect 8 Defender's Arrows.
identity.description: Our war supplies grow low, but especially needed are additional arrows.$B$BOur serpent riders are skilled marksmen, but they can do little without ammunition.$B$BWe need someone to brave the battlefields and retrieve any undamaged arrows to refill our stores.$B$BEvery arrow you retrieve will be used wisely.

Objectives.text: 收集8支防御者的箭。
Objectives.english: Collect 8 Defender's Arrows.

Description.text: 我们的战争物资越来越少了，其中最缺乏的是箭矢。$B$B虽然我们的翔龙骑士个个都是神射手，但如果没有弹药，他们什么也做不了。$B$B我们需要有人能冒死潜入战场，收集完好无损的箭矢来补充我们的物资。$B$B你所收集的每一支箭都不会被浪费的。
Description.english: Our war supplies grow low, but especially needed are additional arrows.$B$BOur serpent riders are skilled marksmen, but they can do little without ammunition.$B$BWe need someone to brave the battlefields and retrieve any undamaged arrows to refill our stores.$B$BEvery arrow you retrieve will be used wisely.

identity.title: Hidden Power
identity.objectives: Deliver Ancient Mantras to 6 Yu'lon Guardians or Yu'lon Adepts.
identity.description: Our temple defenders have battled relentlessly for hours. No doubt they grow tired.$B$BI will give you mantras to deliver to our fighters.$B$BDo not be fooled by these pieces of paper. These ancient scriptures hold words of untold power.

Objectives.text: 把古老的真言交给6个玉珑守护者或玉珑助祭。
Objectives.english: Deliver Ancient Mantras to 6 Yu'lon Guardians or Yu'lon Adepts.

Description.text: 我们的寺庙卫士顽强奋战了好几个小时。他们一定疲惫不堪了。$B$B把这些真言给我们的战士送去。$B$B可不要以为它们只是几页破纸。这些古老经文里蕴含了强大的力量。
Description.english: Our temple defenders have battled relentlessly for hours. No doubt they grow tired.$B$BI will give you mantras to deliver to our fighters.$B$BDo not be fooled by these pieces of paper. These ancient scriptures hold words of untold power.

identity.title: Flames of the Void
identity.objectives: Fly your War Serpent near Pure Water Springs, then douse 6 Void Flames with the water carried in its mouth.
identity.description: Do you see the violent black and white flames erupting all around the temple?$B$BThe greater our doubt, the stronger they rage. Unchecked, they will devour the entire temple.$B$BWe have but one hope.$B$BTake flight on one of our war serpents. Fly it near the pure springs of water, and then douse the fires with water from the pools.

Objectives.text: 驾乘作战翔龙飞到纯净泉水附近，然后让翔龙衔水扑灭6堆虚空烈焰。
Objectives.english: Fly your War Serpent near Pure Water Springs, then douse 6 Void Flames with the water carried in its mouth.

Description.text: 你看到那些在寺庙里到处肆虐、黑白相间的烈焰了吗？$B$B我们越是动摇，它就越是狂暴。如不加以制止，它们会吞噬掉整座寺庙。$B$B我们只有一个希望了。$B$B请你驾乘一条作战翔龙，飞到纯净泉水附近，然后用圣池中的水扑灭火焰。
Description.english: Do you see the violent black and white flames erupting all around the temple?$B$BThe greater our doubt, the stronger they rage. Unchecked, they will devour the entire temple.$B$BWe have but one hope.$B$BTake flight on one of our war serpents. Fly it near the pure springs of water, and then douse the fires with water from the pools.

identity.title: FLAG - Kung Fu Intro
identity.objectives: Listen to Xiao and his companions.
identity.description: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

Objectives.text: 倾听晓和他同伴们的谈话。
Objectives.english: Listen to Xiao and his companions.

Description.text: 嘿，你好。你在寻找这片地方的主人吗？那就去见见楼梯上面的那位熊猫人吧。跟你一样，我也是访客。$b$b不好意思，我跟我朋友现在要商量点事情。我们稍后再聊。
Description.english: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

identity.title: Well of Eternity RP Tracker
identity.objectives: Recover the Branch of Nordrassil from the Firelands.
identity.description: I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, $r, which means my mission here now must fall to you.$b$bA surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here. I have since discovered a most troubling development.$b$bA bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame.$b$bYou must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the world tree's branch.

Title.text: 永恆之井代表隊追蹤者

Objectives.text: 去火焰之地夺回诺达希尔的分枝。
Objectives.english: Recover the Branch of Nordrassil from the Firelands.

Description.text: 我有责任对你的发现进行调查，$r，这也就意味着我的任务现在只能交给你了。$b$b一股远非天然生成的强大魔力将我引来此地，我这才发现事态大为不妙。$b$b有人将诺达希尔的一根树枝折了下来，带到了火焰之地的深处。在那里，敌人正利用它进行邪恶的仪式，以腐蚀诺达希尔，试图用大火烧毁它。$b$b你必须想办法干扰仪式，将世界之树的树枝夺回来。
Description.english: I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, $r, which means my mission here now must fall to you.$b$bA surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here. I have since discovered a most troubling development.$b$bA bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame.$b$bYou must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the world tree's branch.

CompletionLog.text: 去北风苔原的琥珀崖，跟卡雷苟斯谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Kalecgos at Amber Ledge in Borean Tundra.

identity.title: Profit Mastery
identity.objectives: Obtain 12 Vials of Tiger Blood.
identity.description: Two words: Tiger Blood!$b$bThis is gonna sell better than saronite back on the black market. Especially once I finish spreading a rumor about how it makes you all buff and stuff.$b$bThing is, I ran out of ammo. Can you round up a few vials of tiger blood for me? I'll cut you in on the scam.

Objectives.text: 获得12瓶虎血。
Objectives.english: Obtain 12 Vials of Tiger Blood.

Description.text: 我就说两个字：虎血！$b$b在炼金业界里，它的价值可比萨隆邪血还高。尤其是我在外面放话说了，它还有着强身健体的功效。$b$b问题是现在我没有弹药了，你能帮我收集几瓶虎血吗？我可以算你一份。
Description.english: Two words: Tiger Blood!$b$bThis is gonna sell better than saronite back on the black market. Especially once I finish spreading a rumor about how it makes you all buff and stuff.$b$bThing is, I ran out of ammo. Can you round up a few vials of tiger blood for me? I'll cut you in on the scam.

CompletionLog.text: 和卡桑琅丛林里的达格·自走炸弹谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Daggle Bombstrider within the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Crane Mastery
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Carp Hunters.
identity.description: Thing about hunting birds is you need ammo - and I ain't got any. Thing about hunting with Nesingwary is you need to prove you can keep your tally and bragging rights up.$b$bCan't hunt, can't brag. And I like bragging so this is no good.$b$bCan I hire you to go kill me some carp hunters? You'll find them up and down the river west of here.

Objectives.text: 杀死8个鲤鱼猎手。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Carp Hunters.

Description.text: 打鸟的时候当然需要弹药——不过我可没有。而要跟着奈辛瓦里一起打猎，那就得证明你是有真材实料的，而不能只会夸夸其谈。$b$b不会打猎，就不要吹牛。可我这个人就喜欢吹牛，所以这就比较麻烦了。$b$b我可以雇你去帮我杀些鲤鱼猎手吗？你可以在西边的河面上找到它们。
Description.english: Thing about hunting birds is you need ammo - and I ain't got any. Thing about hunting with Nesingwary is you need to prove you can keep your tally and bragging rights up.$b$bCan't hunt, can't brag. And I like bragging so this is no good.$b$bCan I hire you to go kill me some carp hunters? You'll find them up and down the river west of here.

CompletionLog.text: 和卡桑琅丛林里的达格·自走炸弹谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Daggle Bombstrider within the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: The Rider's Journey
identity.objectives: Return to Instructor Skythorn at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
identity.description: Excellent, just excellent! I will return the other eggs to their nests, undisturbed.$B$BIn the meantime, deliver your egg to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum.

Objectives.text: 回翡翠林的百木园找天荆教头。
Objectives.english: Return to Instructor Skythorn at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.

Description.text: 很好，非常好！我会把剩下的龙蛋完好无损地送回它们的巢穴去。$B$B同时，你也要把你的龙蛋带回百木园给天荆教头。
Description.english: Excellent, just excellent! I will return the other eggs to their nests, undisturbed.$B$BIn the meantime, deliver your egg to Instructor Skythorn at The Arboretum.

identity.title: Feeding Time
identity.objectives: Collect 3 Saltback Meat and feed them to your hatchling companion.
identity.description: <The serpent darts forward and bites your fingers.>$B$BOuch! It seems, without a doubt, that the little beast is hungry. You recall that some meaty-looking turtles can be found on the wild cloud serpent island to the northeast.$B$BPerhaps some turtle meat will fill the hatchling's voracious appetite.

Objectives.text: 收集3块盐背肉，并用来喂食你的雏龙小伙伴。
Objectives.english: Collect 3 Saltback Meat and feed them to your hatchling companion.

Description.text: <翔龙一个箭步猛冲向前，并撕咬你的手指。>$B$B哎呦！毫无疑问，小家伙这是饿了。你回想起在东北面的野生翔龙岛上，有一些看上去肉质肥厚的乌龟。$B$B或许弄点龟肉回来，可以让小家伙大快朵颐一顿。
Description.english: <The serpent darts forward and bites your fingers.>$B$BOuch! It seems, without a doubt, that the little beast is hungry. You recall that some meaty-looking turtles can be found on the wild cloud serpent island to the northeast.$B$BPerhaps some turtle meat will fill the hatchling's voracious appetite.

identity.title: Disarming the Enemy
identity.objectives: Collect 5 Slitherscale Harpoons.
identity.description: If we are to stop the poachers, we need to take more aggressive action.$B$BIf we can remove the enemies' primary tools for killing and capturing serpents, we may be able to stop their operation altogether.$B$BI need you to go into their territory on the eastern end of Windward Isle and steal their weapons.$B$BA cat without claws cannot strike.

Objectives.text: 收集5支滑鳞鱼叉。
Objectives.english: Collect 5 Slitherscale Harpoons.

Description.text: 要想阻止这些偷猎者，我们就得采取更加主动的方式。$B$B如果我们能夺走敌人捕杀翔龙的重要工具，或许能从根本上阻止他们的行为。$B$B我要你进入他们位于临风岛东端的领地，并偷走他们的武器。$B$B老虎没了牙，也就威风不起来了。
Description.english: If we are to stop the poachers, we need to take more aggressive action.$B$BIf we can remove the enemies' primary tools for killing and capturing serpents, we may be able to stop their operation altogether.$B$BI need you to go into their territory on the eastern end of Windward Isle and steal their weapons.$B$BA cat without claws cannot strike.

identity.title: Labor for Labor
identity.objectives: Gather 8 pieces of Fire Wood.
identity.description: My wife, Leza, is going into labor but she is very very sick. I need to keep her warm but we've exhausted our supply of dry firewood.$b$bCould you grab some twigs and branches from the nearby trees for me? Time is of the essence!

Objectives.text: 收集8根柴火。
Objectives.english: Gather 8 pieces of Fire Wood.

Description.text: 我的妻子莱莎快要分娩了，但她现在病得很厉害。我想让她暖和点，不过我们准备的干柴已经用光了。$b$b你能从附近的树上帮我摘些嫩条和树枝吗？时间就是生命！
Description.english: My wife, Leza, is going into labor but she is very very sick. I need to keep her warm but we've exhausted our supply of dry firewood.$b$bCould you grab some twigs and branches from the nearby trees for me? Time is of the essence!

CompletionLog.text: 去卡桑琅丛林的雷霆裂口和烈日行者德兹科谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at Thunder Cleft in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Sprite Plight
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Slateskin Troublemakers.
identity.description: Sprites again! I hate these things. We need to stop them before they hurt someone or burn down half of the village!$B$BIf you see any of the pests, please deal with them!

Objectives.text: 击败8个岩肤捣乱者。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Slateskin Troublemakers.

Description.text: 又是林精！我恨死这种东西了。我们要阻止他们伤害其他人或烧掉半个村庄！$B$B如果你看到了这种害虫，杀掉他们！
Description.english: Sprites again! I hate these things. We need to stop them before they hurt someone or burn down half of the village!$B$BIf you see any of the pests, please deal with them!

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的雾临村找诗游村长。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Mayor Shiyo at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Steer Clear of the Beer Here
identity.objectives: Recover 10 Stolen Mistfall Kegs.
identity.description: Someone left some beer out up on the southern rise and now the sprites have developed a taste for our brew. They've been sneaking into town all morning, stealing whatever kegs they find.$B$BBring back what you can. A pandaren worker without brew is just... it won't be very productive. We need the men in good spirits.

Title.english: Steer Clear of the Beer Here

Objectives.text: 找回10个失窃的雾临酒桶。
Objectives.english: Recover 10 Stolen Mistfall Kegs.

Description.text: 有人把一些啤酒忘在南面的高地上了，现在林精喜欢上了我们的啤酒。他们上午偷偷溜进我们的小镇，偷走了所有酒桶。$B$B把你找到的酒桶带回来。熊猫人工人如果没有了啤酒……是没办法打起精神干活的。我们需要精神抖擞的工人。
Description.english: Someone left some beer out up on the southern rise and now the sprites have developed a taste for our brew. They've been sneaking into town all morning, stealing whatever kegs they find.$B$BBring back what you can. A pandaren worker without brew is just... it won't be very productive. We need the men in good spirits.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的雾临村找诗游村长。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Mayor Shiyo at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Meating Expectations
identity.objectives: Retrieve 10 slabs of Fairlands Gazelle Meat.
identity.description: Hard workers deserve hearty meals, but I'm all out of good meat!$B$BCan you head out into the forest and get me some fresh gazelle meat?

Objectives.text: 获得10块仙境瞪羚肉。
Objectives.english: Retrieve 10 slabs of Fairlands Gazelle Meat.

Description.text: 勤奋工作的人有权享用丰盛的大餐，但我这里的鲜肉已经没有存货了！$B$B你能不能到森林里去，帮我搞些新鲜的瞪羚肉回来？
Description.english: Hard workers deserve hearty meals, but I'm all out of good meat!$B$BCan you head out into the forest and get me some fresh gazelle meat?

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的雾临村找涂大厨。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Cook Tope at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Encroaching Storm
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Thundermaw Wolves.
identity.description: The villagers have lost another yak this morning to one of the thundermaw wolves from across the river. The wolves grow bold.$B$BThis is a sign that they are breeding beyond the vale's ability to sustain them. It's time to thin their numbers again.$B$BIf you are willing to aid me in this, you would have my sincere appreciation.

Objectives.text: 击败8只雷喉狼。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Thundermaw Wolves.

Description.text: 今天早晨，村民们又丢了一头牦牛，肯定是河对岸某只雷喉狼干的好事。这些家伙真是越来越大胆了。$B$B这说明它们的种群太过庞大，这座山谷已无法再供养它们了。是该再削减一下它们的数量了。$B$B如果你愿意帮我做这件事，我会衷心感谢你的。
Description.english: The villagers have lost another yak this morning to one of the thundermaw wolves from across the river. The wolves grow bold.$B$BThis is a sign that they are breeding beyond the vale's ability to sustain them. It's time to thin their numbers again.$B$BIf you are willing to aid me in this, you would have my sincere appreciation.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的雾临村找车·荒野行者。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Blooming Blossoms
identity.objectives: Collect 10 Eternal Blossoms.
identity.description: Would you do a humble merchant a favor? I've been needin' to refresh my stock of eternal blossoms. They grow in the woods nearby.$B$BCould you help me out, perhaps?

Objectives.text: 收集10束锦绣花。
Objectives.english: Collect 10 Eternal Blossoms.

Description.text: 能否帮我这个友善的商人一个忙呢？我需要增加锦绣花的库存。它们生长在附近的树林中。$B$B你能帮我这个忙吗？
Description.english: Would you do a humble merchant a favor? I've been needin' to refresh my stock of eternal blossoms. They grow in the woods nearby.$B$BCould you help me out, perhaps?

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的雾临村找商人班宁。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Merchant Benny at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Cart Ride
identity.objectives: Ride a delivery cart to XXX Village.
identity.description: The vale has been quiet all morning. I'm sending Rook with a cart of supplies out to the XXX Village. You should join him.

Objectives.text: 乘上推車去XXX村。
Objectives.english: Ride a delivery cart to XXX Village.

Description.text: 山谷整個早上都很安靜。我派茹克跟一輛補給貨車到XXX村去。你應該跟他一起去。
Description.english: The vale has been quiet all morning. I'm sending Rook with a cart of supplies out to the XXX Village. You should join him.

identity.title: In Ashen Webs
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Ashweb Spiders.
identity.description: We used to have the trainees clear out the ruins of spiders as part of their training, but now we send them straight to the mogu front. The spiders have gotten out of control.$B$BCare to put things back in control?

Objectives.text: 击败8个灰网蜘蛛。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Ashweb Spiders.

Description.text: 我们以前一般是让学徒们去清理遗迹的蜘蛛，这也是他们训练的一部分。但现在我们已经把他们直接派去对抗魔古族的前线了。这些蜘蛛已经失去控制了。$B$B你能帮我们维持一下秩序吗？
Description.english: We used to have the trainees clear out the ruins of spiders as part of their training, but now we send them straight to the mogu front. The spiders have gotten out of control.$B$BCare to put things back in control?

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: That's Not a Rock!
identity.objectives: Kill 50 Ashweb Spiderlings. Use Kun's torch to burn them inside their pods.
identity.description: Okay, these spiders are seriously creeping me out. Especially those egg sacs they leave lying around that I keep accidentally stepping on only to be covered in very little but very creepy spiderlings. Ug, makes me shudder just thinking about it.$B$BI say you burn them. Burn them all.

Objectives.text: 击败50只灰网幼蛛。使用奎的火炬将他们烧死在卵囊里。
Objectives.english: Kill 50 Ashweb Spiderlings. Use Kun's torch to burn them inside their pods.

Description.text: 天呐，这些蜘蛛真让我浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。尤其是四处散布的那些卵囊，经常会一不小心就踩到，然后那些恶心的小蜘蛛就会爬到你脚上。呃，光想想就会让我打个冷颤。$B$B我说，你快去把它们一把火全烧了，通通烧光。
Description.english: Okay, these spiders are seriously creeping me out. Especially those egg sacs they leave lying around that I keep accidentally stepping on only to be covered in very little but very creepy spiderlings. Ug, makes me shudder just thinking about it.$B$BI say you burn them. Burn them all.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找奎·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Runelocked
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Ancient Mogu Artifact.
identity.description: Hello, friend.$B$BOne of Leven's men brought word to me of a mogu artifact in the eastern ruins, but said he couldn't figure out how to retrieve it. I suspect it's guarded by one of their rune locks.$B$BIf you go to the artifact, you should find four runes somewhere nearby that when activated will release the lock. If you could bring the artifact back to me, I would be very grateful.

Objectives.text: 找回古代魔古神器。
Objectives.english: Retrieve the Ancient Mogu Artifact.

Description.text: 你好，我的朋友。$B$B莱文的一个手下给我带话说，东部遗迹发现了一件魔古神器，但他不知道该怎么拿回那件神器。我怀疑神器周围有符文锁的保护。$B$B如果你要去找神器，你应该可以在神器附近找到四个符文。激活全部四个符文，就可以开启符文锁。如果你可以把神器给我带回来，我会非常感激你的。
Description.english: Hello, friend.$B$BOne of Leven's men brought word to me of a mogu artifact in the eastern ruins, but said he couldn't figure out how to retrieve it. I suspect it's guarded by one of their rune locks.$B$BIf you go to the artifact, you should find four runes somewhere nearby that when activated will release the lock. If you could bring the artifact back to me, I would be very grateful.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找梦想家思南。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Sinan the Dreamer at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Runes in the Ruins
identity.objectives: Collect 12 Guo-Lai Runestones.
identity.description: In the walls of the ruins themselves, there are precious runestones that we can make use of back in the eastern vale.$B$BIf you see any while you are within the ruins, would you be so kind as to bring them back to me?

Objectives.text: 收集12块郭莱符文石。
Objectives.english: Collect 12 Guo-Lai Runestones.

Description.text: 东面河谷的遗迹中有很多珍贵的符文石，我们可以重新利用这些符文石。$B$B如果你在遗迹中看到了符文石，能否好心帮我带回一些呢？
Description.english: In the walls of the ruins themselves, there are precious runestones that we can make use of back in the eastern vale.$B$BIf you see any while you are within the ruins, would you be so kind as to bring them back to me?

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找梦想家思南。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Sinan the Dreamer at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: The Ashweb Matriarch
identity.objectives: Kill Bloodtip, the Ashweb Matriarch.
identity.description: My dear Kun spotted more spiders pouring out of the Guo-Lai Halls this morning, and when he went to investigate, he uncovered another spider matriarch inside.$B$BI need you to kill it.

Objectives.text: 击败灰网主母血尖。
Objectives.english: Kill Bloodtip, the Ashweb Matriarch.

Description.text: 我亲爱的奎今早发觉有大批蜘蛛从郭莱古厅里倾巢而出，当他过去调查的时候，他还发现里面还有一只蛛后。$B$B我要你去干掉它。
Description.english: My dear Kun spotted more spiders pouring out of the Guo-Lai Halls this morning, and when he went to investigate, he uncovered another spider matriarch inside.$B$BI need you to kill it.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Blood on the Rise
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu on Ruin's Rise.
identity.description: A small group of mogu have been sighted on Ruin's Rise, to the north.$B$BExtinguish them.

Objectives.text: 在遗迹高地击败8个韶天魔古族人。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu on Ruin's Rise.

Description.text: 一小队魔古族正在北边的遗迹高地安营扎寨。$B$B快去把它们杀光！
Description.english: A small group of mogu have been sighted on Ruin's Rise, to the north.$B$BExtinguish them.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Troubling the Troublemakers
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Stonebark sprites.
identity.description: The wood sprites are back. I need you to kill them before they cause anymore trouble.

Objectives.text: 击败8个石树林精。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Stonebark sprites.

Description.text: 林精又回来了。我要你去解决掉他们，以免他们惹出更大的麻烦来。
Description.english: The wood sprites are back. I need you to kill them before they cause anymore trouble.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Pomfruit Pickup
