identity.objectives: Gather 12 Pomfruit.
identity.description: I need more pomfruit! Go knock some loose from the trees for me, would you?$B$BTake this, I use it when I go harvesting. Things go quicker when the fruit comes to you!

Objectives.text: 收集12个梨果。
Objectives.english: Gather 12 Pomfruit.

Description.text: 我需要更多的梨果！你从树上帮我打一些下来吧，可以吗？$B$B带上这个，我摘梨果的时候都用这个。摘水果的时光总是很快乐！
Description.english: I need more pomfruit! Go knock some loose from the trees for me, would you?$B$BTake this, I use it when I go harvesting. Things go quicker when the fruit comes to you!

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的雾临村找涂大厨。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Cooke Tope at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Ruffling Some Feathers
identity.objectives: Gather 80 Silken Feathers.
identity.description: The hawk numbers in the vale are thriving. This is opportune for our fletchers, for we will need a great number of feathers if we are to keep the archers upon the wall stocked with arrows.$B$BIf you would not mind, could you aid us in gathering these feathers?

Objectives.text: 取得80根絲光羽毛。
Objectives.english: Gather 80 Silken Feathers.

Description.text: 谷中的貓頭鷹數量越來越多。這對我們的造箭師來說是個好機會，因為我們需要大量的羽毛來讓牆上的弓箭手擁有足量的箭可用。$B$B如果你不介意，可以幫我們收集這些羽毛嗎?
Description.english: The hawk numbers in the vale are thriving. This is opportune for our fletchers, for we will need a great number of feathers if we are to keep the archers upon the wall stocked with arrows.$B$BIf you would not mind, could you aid us in gathering these feathers?

CompletionLog.text: 到恆春谷的霧臨村找奇·野行者。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: The Pandaren Uprising Relived
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Ancient Mogu Spirits.
identity.description: In the Tu Shen Burial Ground to the east, the spirits of ancient mogu are locked in battle with the spirits of our pandaren ancestors that rose up against them. The spirits have seen no rest since the return of the mogu to the valley.$B$BIf you would be willing to go to the graveyard and force the mogu to relive their defeat again, we might offer some lasting peace to the spirits of our ancestors.

Objectives.text: 击败8只远古魔古之魂。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Ancient Mogu Spirits.

Description.text: 在东边的徒圣陵园，古代魔古族的灵魂和反抗他们的熊猫人先祖的灵魂陷入了一场混战。自从魔古族回到这个山谷之后，灵魂们就一直不得安宁。$B$B如果你愿意到陵园去让那些魔古族灵魂重新体验一次战败的滋味，那我们就可以让我们先祖的灵魂获得长久的安宁了。
Description.english: In the Tu Shen Burial Ground to the east, the spirits of ancient mogu are locked in battle with the spirits of our pandaren ancestors that rose up against them. The spirits have seen no rest since the return of the mogu to the valley.$B$BIf you would be willing to go to the graveyard and force the mogu to relive their defeat again, we might offer some lasting peace to the spirits of our ancestors.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的雾临村找车·荒野行者。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Roll Club: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
identity.objectives: Complete the Vale of Eternal Blossoms roll course.
identity.description: Follow the flags. Make the checkpoints. Round the loop. Get back to me before your time is up.$B$BSpeak to me when you're ready to roll.

Title.english: Roll Club: Vale of Eternal Blossoms

Objectives.text: 完成锦绣谷的翻滚路线。
Objectives.english: Complete the Vale of Eternal Blossoms roll course.

Description.text: 跟随旗帜，拜访记录点，完成巡视路线。在时间用完之前回到我这里。$B$B准备翻滚时请告诉我一声。
Description.english: Follow the flags. Make the checkpoints. Round the loop. Get back to me before your time is up.$B$BSpeak to me when you're ready to roll.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的残阳关卫戍营找科拉·羽足。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kelari Feartherfoot at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Clearing in the Forest
identity.objectives: Kill 6 Shao-Tien mogu in Winterbough Glade.
identity.description: The Shao-Tien are on their heels. Most of them retreated to Winterbough Glade after their last defeat. We should press the advantage.$B$BTake the fight to these mogu in the clearing to the northwest. Let us leave them no minute of rest as long as they remain in the Vale.

Objectives.text: 在冬花林地击败6个韶天魔古族。
Objectives.english: Kill 6 Shao-Tien mogu in Winterbough Glade.

Description.text: 韶天部族正在节节败退。他们中的大部分在上一次溃败后退回到了冬花林地。我们应该乘胜追击。$B$B快去和盘踞在西北方空地的魔古族一决高下。只要他们还在锦绣谷里逗留，我们就一刻也不能让他们安宁。
Description.english: The Shao-Tien are on their heels. Most of them retreated to Winterbough Glade after their last defeat. We should press the advantage.$B$BTake the fight to these mogu in the clearing to the northwest. Let us leave them no minute of rest as long as they remain in the Vale.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的雾临村找车·荒野行者。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Enemy at the Gates
identity.objectives: Use a Shado-Pan Sky Serpent to kill 60 Krik'thik attackers, 3 Krik'thik War Wagons, and 3 Krik'thik Catapults.
identity.description: The mantid forces are pouring against the wall. I've arranged for some flying serpents to cut away at their forces from the air.$B$BWould you be willing to take the reigns on one of them?

Objectives.text: 使用影踪派空中翔龙击败60个科里克提克攻击者，并摧毁3辆科里克提克战车和3架科里克提克弩炮。
Objectives.english: Use a Shado-Pan Sky Serpent to kill 60 Krik'thik attackers, 3 Krik'thik War Wagons, and 3 Krik'thik Catapults.

Description.text: 螳螂妖大军如潮水般涌向城墙。我已经调遣了一批翔龙从空中拦截他们的部队。$B$B你愿意骑上一只翔龙参加战斗吗？
Description.english: The mantid forces are pouring against the wall. I've arranged for some flying serpents to cut away at their forces from the air.$B$BWould you be willing to take the reigns on one of them?

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的残阳关卫戍营找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Sparkle in the Eye
identity.objectives: Recover 8 Shining Rubies.
identity.description: I've been staring down into the waters of the lake, pondering life, love, and everything beautiful, and suddenly I realized that the sparkles in the water aren't just a reflection of my radiant personality, there are actually some sort of shining objects down there! Surely valuable.$B$BWould you mind taking a drip and relieving the lake's depths of its mysterious sparkles? Pretty please?

Objectives.text: 找回8颗闪光红宝石。
Objectives.english: Recover 8 Shining Rubies.

Description.text: 我一直凝视着湖面，思索着生命、爱情和所有美好的事物。然后突然我意识到，水中泛起的辉光绝不是我光辉人格的倒影，水底下真的有东西在发光！而且肯定价值不菲。$B$B你可以潜到水下，揭开湖底深处那神秘的辉光之迷吗？拜托啦！
Description.english: I've been staring down into the waters of the lake, pondering life, love, and everything beautiful, and suddenly I realized that the sparkles in the water aren't just a reflection of my radiant personality, there are actually some sort of shining objects down there! Surely valuable.$B$BWould you mind taking a drip and relieving the lake's depths of its mysterious sparkles? Pretty please?

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的琼花湖找任·火舌。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: The Silent Approach
identity.objectives: Kill 6 Shao-Tien mogu at Whitepetal Lake.
identity.description: <He leans over and draws a picture of what can only be a mogu, points towards the lake to the west, drags the blunt side of his dagger across his throat, and looks at you expectantly. It seems he wants you to kill mogu at Whitepetal Lake.>

Objectives.text: 在琼花湖击败6个韶天魔古人。
Objectives.english: Kill 6 Shao-Tien mogu at Whitepetal Lake.

Description.text: <他弯下身子画了一个人型生物，一看就知道是魔古，然后他指了指湖的西面，又将匕首的刀背放在喉咙的位置作切割状，满心期盼地看着你。他的意思应该是让你干掉琼花湖的魔古族。>
Description.english: <He leans over and draws a picture of what can only be a mogu, points towards the lake to the west, drags the blunt side of his dagger across his throat, and looks at you expectantly. It seems he wants you to kill mogu at Whitepetal Lake.>

identity.title: Burning Away the Filth
identity.objectives: Burn 10 Shao-Tien Banners.
identity.description: The mogu have erected their filthy banners around the lake to the west, claiming it as their own. Take this torch and show them what we think of their banners.

Objectives.text: 焚烧10面韶天旗帜。
Objectives.english: Burn 10 Shao-Tien Banners.

Description.text: 魔古族在琼花胡的西岸插上了他们肮脏的旗帜，以宣示他们对这里的占领。带上这把火炬，让他们知道我们对这些旗子的态度。
Description.english: The mogu have erected their filthy banners around the lake to the west, claiming it as their own. Take this torch and show them what we think of their banners.

identity.title: A Smashing Impression
identity.objectives: Destroy the Shao-Tien Ritual Statues.
identity.description: Sometimes I feel sorry for these mogu... maybe ripping out the spirits of other races is just their way of coping with family issues at home? Maybe we should be more sympathetic to where all this aggression stems from?$B$BOr we could just smash all their soul-stealing ritual objects down at the lake. That sounds more fun to me personally.

Objectives.text: 摧毁韶天仪式雕像。
Objectives.english: Destroy the Shao-Tien Ritual Statues.

Description.text: 有时候我真为这些魔古族感到悲哀……也许抽取其他种族的灵魂只是他们处理家庭琐事的方式？也许我们应该更加体谅一下他们这些侵略活动的起因？$B$B又或许我们应该去摧毁湖边上那些用于举行灵魂盗取仪式的工具。我个人觉得这个想法听起来更有趣。
Description.english: Sometimes I feel sorry for these mogu... maybe ripping out the spirits of other races is just their way of coping with family issues at home? Maybe we should be more sympathetic to where all this aggression stems from?$B$BOr we could just smash all their soul-stealing ritual objects down at the lake. That sounds more fun to me personally.

identity.title: A Thousand Pointy Teeth
identity.objectives: Kill 9 Knifetooth Swarmers.
identity.description: The water has been frothing with danger this day! Some sort of swarming, meat-eating fishy nastiness has taken up residence in our lake! Deplorable. And just when I was considering stripping down to my nothings to take a mid-day dip!$B$BYou are adept in the ways of slaughtering any manner of nasty, are you not? Would you put your skills to use this day, in the name of pandaren everywhere desiring a swim?$B$BIt's a truly noble cause, especially with me among their ranks!

Objectives.text: 击败9个刃牙狂鱼。
Objectives.english: Kill 9 Knifetooth Swarmers.

Description.text: 如今的湖水里到处弥漫着危险的气息！某种恶心的肉食群居鱼类竟然在我们的湖里定居了下来！真是令人发指。而我刚刚正想脱光衣服，在午后的阳光下畅游一番呢！$B$B你很擅长收拾这些乱七八糟的杂碎，对吧？为了各个地方渴望游泳的熊猫人，你今天能不能大显身手呢？$B$B这绝对是项伟大的事业，尤其是我也牵涉其中！
Description.english: The water has been frothing with danger this day! Some sort of swarming, meat-eating fishy nastiness has taken up residence in our lake! Deplorable. And just when I was considering stripping down to my nothings to take a mid-day dip!$B$BYou are adept in the ways of slaughtering any manner of nasty, are you not? Would you put your skills to use this day, in the name of pandaren everywhere desiring a swim?$B$BIt's a truly noble cause, especially with me among their ranks!

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的琼花湖找任·火舌。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Wu Kao Scouting Reports
identity.objectives: Recover 3 Wu Kao Scouting Reports.
identity.description: There were some scouting reports unaccounted for after the attack. If we're lucky, they're still out in the village, but the mogu may have gotten their hands on some of them as well.$B$BIf you could bring back any scouting reports you find, it would definitely put my mind at ease. We can't afford to let the mogu in on our positions or any of the artifacts we've found, lest the men be in even more danger than they already are.

Objectives.text: 找回3份悟道者侦察报告。
Objectives.english: Recover 3 Wu Kao Scouting Reports.

Description.text: 袭击发生之后，一些侦察报告下落不明。如果我们走运的话，它们可能还散落在村子外面，但是魔古族可能已经得到了部分报告。$B$B如果你能帮我找回一些侦察报告，那我就更放心了。我们不能让魔古族得知我们的方位和我们找到的神器，让这些人变得更加危险。
Description.english: There were some scouting reports unaccounted for after the attack. If we're lucky, they're still out in the village, but the mogu may have gotten their hands on some of them as well.$B$BIf you could bring back any scouting reports you find, it would definitely put my mind at ease. We can't afford to let the mogu in on our positions or any of the artifacts we've found, lest the men be in even more danger than they already are.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的雾临村找孙·柔心。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Sun Tenderheart at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Backed Into a Corner
identity.objectives: Rescue 6 Cornered Mistfall Villagers.
identity.description: Many villagers are cornered and scared, unable to defend themselves. You will need to defend them. Rescue them.$B$BGo quickly friend, save as many as you can!

Objectives.text: 营救6个被困的雾临村民。
Objectives.english: Rescue 6 Cornered Mistfall Villagers.

Description.text: 许多村民走投无路、惊恐万分，无法保护自己。你得去保护他们、去营救他们。$B$B快点去吧，朋友，尽可能多救几个人！
Description.english: Many villagers are cornered and scared, unable to defend themselves. You will need to defend them. Rescue them.$B$BGo quickly friend, save as many as you can!

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的雾临村找孙·柔心。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Sun Tenderheart at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: My Town, It's On Fire Again
identity.objectives: Use Mistfall Water Buckets to douse 60 fires.
identity.description: I don't know if you noticed, but my town is on fire... again.$B$BWe have water buckets all over town, but no one can get out to put out the fires. Please, please, help us!

Title.english: My Town, It's On Fire Again

Objectives.text: 使用雾临水桶熄灭60处火焰。
Objectives.english: Use Mistfall Water Buckets to douse 60 fires.

Description.text: 不知你注意到没有，我们村又着火了……$B$B村里到处都有水桶，但没人能出来灭火。求求你，求求你，帮帮我们吧！
Description.english: I don't know if you noticed, but my town is on fire... again.$B$BWe have water buckets all over town, but no one can get out to put out the fires. Please, please, help us!

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的雾临村找诗游村长。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Mayor Shiyo at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Freeing Mind and Body
identity.objectives: Free 6 Dominated Guards by killing their controllers.
identity.description: Mogu stealing peoples minds! Making them do evil things.$B$BDon't kill them, just kill the mogu, then they forget about all the mogu mind stealing and stop being evil. You should fix people like Rook is.

Objectives.text: 击败卫兵的幕后操纵者，解救6个被统御的卫兵。
Objectives.english: Free 6 Dominated Guards by killing their controllers.

Description.text: 魔古族在偷取人们的心智！逼迫人们犯下罪行。$B$B不要杀死他们，只要杀死魔古族，他们就会摆脱被魔古族控制的意志不再作恶。你应该像鲁克一样治好人们。
Description.english: Mogu stealing peoples minds! Making them do evil things.$B$BDon't kill them, just kill the mogu, then they forget about all the mogu mind stealing and stop being evil. You should fix people like Rook is.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的雾临村找鲁克·石趾。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Stunning Display
identity.objectives: Collect 12 Stunned Whitepetal Carp.
identity.description: I've been talking to Tantan here... again... and he insists that fishing is some kind of fabulous. I was skeptical, but I gave it another go. I'm not a big fan of that whole holding a stick and waiting method though, so I tried something a bit more direct.$B$BWould you be a doll and go collect any of the still intact fish floating belly up in the lake for me?

Objectives.text: 收集12条昏迷的琼花鲤鱼。
Objectives.english: Collect 12 Stunned Whitepetal Carp.

Description.text: 我又跟谭坛讨论了一次……他坚持认为钓鱼是一门深奥的学问。我虽然抱着怀疑的态度，但还是再试了一次。可我对那种举着鱼竿，一动不动等鱼上钩的垂钓方式不太感冒，所以我试着用了一种更直接的方法。$B$B你能帮我个忙，去收集漂浮在湖面上的那些身体完整但已经肚皮朝上的鱼吗？
Description.english: I've been talking to Tantan here... again... and he insists that fishing is some kind of fabulous. I was skeptical, but I gave it another go. I'm not a big fan of that whole holding a stick and waiting method though, so I tried something a bit more direct.$B$BWould you be a doll and go collect any of the still intact fish floating belly up in the lake for me?

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的琼花湖找任·火舌。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Rude Awakenings
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Dominated Paleblade Flesheaters.
identity.description: The mogu are taking over the minds of the saurok at the lake to our west and turning them against us! The thing is, they were already against us, so I'm not sure they really thought this thing through fully.$B$BAnyway, Anji's the fighter in this pair, I'm more the lover, so I'm looking for someone to do all the weapon swinging and spell flinging and war crying and such.$B$BCan you go kill some saurok for me?

Objectives.text: 击败8个被控制的白刃食肉者。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Dominated Paleblade Flesheaters.

Description.text: 在西边的湖畔，魔古族控制了蜥蜴人的心智并让他们与我们为敌！事实上，那些蜥蜴人原本就跟我们作对，真不知道那些魔古族在做事之前动过脑子没有。$B$B不管怎样，在这个组合里，安济是个战士，而我只是个业余的，所以我想找个能够挥动武器、施放法术和发出战吼的全能帮手。$B$B你能替我杀死些蜥蜴人吗？
Description.english: The mogu are taking over the minds of the saurok at the lake to our west and turning them against us! The thing is, they were already against us, so I'm not sure they really thought this thing through fully.$B$BAnyway, Anji's the fighter in this pair, I'm more the lover, so I'm looking for someone to do all the weapon swinging and spell flinging and war crying and such.$B$BCan you go kill some saurok for me?

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的鎏金亭找奎·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: In Enemy Hands
identity.objectives: Beat 8 Possessed Whitepetal Defenders until they're freed of mogu possession.
identity.description: The Shao-Tien Mindbenders have taken over the minds of our defenders down at Whitepetal Lake to the west. Get down there and kill the mogu that are controlling them, but don't kill the defenders! Killing their captors should free them from their mind control.$B$BSooner would be better. Anji might try to go down there to help soon, and her ability to restrain herself when in the heat of things is not one of the qualities I married her for.

Objectives.text: 打败8个入魔的琼花守卫，直至他们摆脱魔古族的控制。
Objectives.english: Beat 8 Possessed Whitepetal Defenders until they're freed of mogu possession.

Description.text: 韶天缚灵者控制了我们在西边琼花湖地区的守卫们的思想。快去击败那些控制了守卫的魔古族，但不要误伤了我们的守卫！击败那些缚灵者应该就能解除他们的精神控制了。$B$B你的行动越快越好。安济应该很快就会去帮忙的，而她在激战中的自控能力绝对不是我当初娶她的原因之一。
Description.english: The Shao-Tien Mindbenders have taken over the minds of our defenders down at Whitepetal Lake to the west. Get down there and kill the mogu that are controlling them, but don't kill the defenders! Killing their captors should free them from their mind control.$B$BSooner would be better. Anji might try to go down there to help soon, and her ability to restrain herself when in the heat of things is not one of the qualities I married her for.

identity.title: Hard as a Rock
identity.objectives: Destroy 10 Mogu Statues.
identity.description: Hey! You know what awesome thing happened to me this morning?$B$BI was strolling through the ruins with Anji, eyes on the ground so I wouldn't step on anymore of those creepy spider pods, when one of the statues came to life and tried to smash me!$B$BAnji ended up doing the smashing. But I'm not satisfied. I think that you should go out there and smash all the statues, whether they're moving or not. It's the only way to be sure.

Objectives.text: 摧毁10座魔古石雕。
Objectives.english: Destroy 10 Mogu Statues.

Description.text: 嘿！你知道今早我碰到什么怪事吗？$B$B我当时正和安济在遗迹里散步，我眼睛一直盯着地上，防止再踩到那些恶心的蜘蛛卵囊，结果有座石雕突然复活了，还想拍死我！$B$B虽然安济最后把它给拍死了，但这个隐患必须根除。我觉得你应该出手击碎所有石雕，无论它们有没有复活。这才是万无一失的办法。
Description.english: Hey! You know what awesome thing happened to me this morning?$B$BI was strolling through the ruins with Anji, eyes on the ground so I wouldn't step on anymore of those creepy spider pods, when one of the statues came to life and tried to smash me!$B$BAnji ended up doing the smashing. But I'm not satisfied. I think that you should go out there and smash all the statues, whether they're moving or not. It's the only way to be sure.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找奎·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: The Eternal Vigil
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu on the Golden Terrace.
identity.description: Good to have you with us, $c. If you're joining the fight, I need more men out up at the Golden Stair to clear out the mogu setting up base there.$B$BCan I count on you?

Objectives.text: 在金色平台击败8个韶天魔古族人。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu on the Golden Terrace.

Description.text: 有你在真是太好了，$c。如果你想加入战斗的话，我正好需要更多的人手，去剿灭在金色阶梯上建立营地的魔古族。$B$B我能将此重任托付给你吗？
Description.english: Good to have you with us, $c. If you're joining the fight, I need more men out up at the Golden Stair to clear out the mogu setting up base there.$B$BCan I count on you?

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找莱文·黎明之刃。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Leven Dawnblade at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Stone Hard Quilen
identity.objectives: Kill 6 Granite Quilen.
identity.description: Leven always says the only good quilen is a dead quilen, and I'm inclined to agree. You here to aid the cause?

Objectives.text: 击败6个岗岩魁麟。
Objectives.english: Kill 6 Granite Quilen.

Description.text: 莱文总是说，最好的魁麟就是死了的魁麟，我也这么觉得。你是来帮我们的吗？
Description.english: Leven always says the only good quilen is a dead quilen, and I'm inclined to agree. You here to aid the cause?

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Set in Stone
identity.objectives: Destroy 6 Mogu Effigies.
identity.description: The mogu have been sending their narcissistic stone effigies onto our battlefield today. They're brining them to life up on the Golden Stair.$B$BThe bigger they are, the harder we hit'm. You in?

Objectives.text: 摧毁6座魔古石雕。
Objectives.english: Destroy 6 Mogu Effigies.

Description.text: 今天，魔古族将他们引以为傲的石雕都搬上战场了。他们正在金色阶梯上试图启动那些石雕。$B$B石雕越大，我们就会打得越狠，你要加入吗？
Description.english: The mogu have been sending their narcissistic stone effigies onto our battlefield today. They're brining them to life up on the Golden Stair.$B$BThe bigger they are, the harder we hit'm. You in?

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Thundering Skies
identity.objectives: Kill 3 Subjugated Serpents.
identity.description: The mogu have bent the will of sky serpents and turned them against us.$B$BThe defenders won't fare well against them, but you would. Head northwest towards the Golden Stair and remove them from the sky.

Objectives.text: 击败3只被制服的翔龙。
Objectives.english: Kill 3 Subjugated Serpents.

Description.text: 魔古族降服了青空翔龙，使其与我们为敌。$B$B守护者难以抵挡这些翔龙，但是你可以。快沿着西北方向前往金色阶梯，并将其击落。
Description.english: The mogu have bent the will of sky serpents and turned them against us.$B$BThe defenders won't fare well against them, but you would. Head northwest towards the Golden Stair and remove them from the sky.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的鎏金亭找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: High Standards
identity.objectives: Erect 6 Golden Lotus Standards.
identity.description: If I had to pick the most important quality for a battle standard, it would be that it's standing up... and not on fire, but mostly the first one. So needless to say, I'm a bit concerned about our standard situation at the moment.$B$BIf some unknown $c were to be so kind as to take a walk out on the battlefield to our northwest and stand our standards back up, both myself and my extremely sexy yet somewhat commanding wife would be very grateful.

Objectives.text: 竖起6面金莲军旗。
Objectives.english: Erect 6 Golden Lotus Standards.

Description.text: 如果让我来选，那么军旗最重要的一个特质就是屹立不倒……并且未被烧毁，当然最重要的还是第一点。因此，毋庸置疑的，我对于我方军旗目前的状况有点担忧。$B$B如果有哪位无名$c能前往我们西北面的战场，帮忙重新竖起我们的军旗，我本人以及我那超级性感又有点彪悍的妻子将对他感激不尽。
Description.english: If I had to pick the most important quality for a battle standard, it would be that it's standing up... and not on fire, but mostly the first one. So needless to say, I'm a bit concerned about our standard situation at the moment.$B$BIf some unknown $c were to be so kind as to take a walk out on the battlefield to our northwest and stand our standards back up, both myself and my extremely sexy yet somewhat commanding wife would be very grateful.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找奎·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Given a Second Chance
identity.objectives: Heal 6 Wounded Defenders.
identity.description: A foolish contingent attempted to mount an offensive on the Golden Stair through the eastern pass, and were bombarded by cannons. Those that made it back are in bad shape, and there are still wounded out in the field.$B$BHere are some bandages. Use these, or any other healing skills you possess, and help get our wounded defenders back to safety.$B$BPlease hurry, there is little time.

Objectives.text: 治疗6个受伤的防御者。
Objectives.english: Heal 6 Wounded Defenders.

Description.text: 有帮愚蠢的家伙试图穿过东部小径对金色阶梯发动一次突袭，结果被火炮击溃了。那些即便能活着回来的，也都伤势较重，战场上也有很多需要救助的人。$B$B这里有些绷带。用它们给伤员包扎，或是使用任何你会的治疗技能，帮助治疗受伤的防御者吧。$B$B动作要快，时间不多了。
Description.english: A foolish contingent attempted to mount an offensive on the Golden Stair through the eastern pass, and were bombarded by cannons. Those that made it back are in bad shape, and there are still wounded out in the field.$B$BHere are some bandages. Use these, or any other healing skills you possess, and help get our wounded defenders back to safety.$B$BPlease hurry, there is little time.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找孙·柔心。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: The Moving Mists
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Fog Walkers.
identity.description: <He looks down at the dead fog creature at his feet, looks up at you, then points out into the mists surrounding the lake. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these fog creatures.>

Objectives.text: 击败8个雾行鬼。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Fog Walkers.

Description.text: <他看了看脚下迷雾怪兽的尸体，又抬头看看你，然后指了指环绕于湖边的雾霭。看来他是想让你去搜寻并击败更多的迷雾怪兽。>
Description.english: <He looks down at the dead fog creature at his feet, looks up at you, then points out into the mists surrounding the lake. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these fog creatures.>

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的琼花湖找禾·软足。
CompletionLog.english: Return to He Softfoot at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: The Displaced Paleblade
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Paleblade Saurok.
identity.description: <He looks down at the dead saurok at his feet, looks up at you, then points out down the lake shore. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these saurok.>

Objectives.text: 击败8个白刃蜥蜴人。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Paleblade Saurok.

Description.text: <他低头俯视脚边死去的蜥蜴人，抬头看看你，然后用手指向湖边。看来他是想让你去找到并杀死更多的蜥蜴人。>
Description.english: <He looks down at the dead saurok at his feet, looks up at you, then points out down the lake shore. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these saurok.>

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的琼花湖找禾·软足。
CompletionLog.english: Return to He Softfoot at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Free Spirits
identity.objectives: Enter Spirit Vortexes and free 15 pandaren spirits inside.
identity.description: I came upon one of the Shao-Tien Soul-Render's daggers. It radiates a strong magic. I've been told it should allow you to enter their spirit vortexes.$B$BThe mogu use these to harvest spirits and bind them to their will, but I'm hoping you can use it to free the spirits.$B$BEnter any of the spirit vortexes you can find up on the Golden Stair, and free all the captive spirits you find.

Objectives.text: 进入灵魂漩涡，从中解救出15个熊猫人灵魂。
Objectives.english: Enter Spirit Vortexes and free 15 pandaren spirits inside.

Description.text: 我发现了一把韶天碎魂者的匕首，它散发着强大的魔力。我听说有了这把匕首就能进入灵魂漩涡。$B$B魔古族利用这些匕首采集灵魂，迫使其屈从于他们的意志，但我希望你能用它来解救灵魂。$B$B进入你能在金色阶梯上找到的所有灵魂旋涡，并释放所有被囚禁的灵魂。
Description.english: I came upon one of the Shao-Tien Soul-Render's daggers. It radiates a strong magic. I've been told it should allow you to enter their spirit vortexes.$B$BThe mogu use these to harvest spirits and bind them to their will, but I'm hoping you can use it to free the spirits.$B$BEnter any of the spirit vortexes you can find up on the Golden Stair, and free all the captive spirits you find.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找孙·柔心。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: A Weighty Task
identity.objectives: Recover 8 Mogu Artifacts.
identity.description: For the life of me, I can't figure out why the mogu would have built all their statues and such down in that lake. I'm sure there wasn't always water down there, but it still seems wickedly inconvenient should it ever have rained.$B$BAh well, who's to fathom the strange intentions of the mogu...$B$BWould you be so kind as to swim down there and bring back any artifacts that seem even vaguely carry-able? I'd certainly appreciate it.

Objectives.text: 找回8件魔古神器。
Objectives.english: Recover 8 Mogu Artifacts.

Description.text: 我就算想破了头，也想不出为什么魔古族要在湖里建造那些雕像。虽然我知道湖里也不一定总是有水的，但只要一下雨，那里的环境就会变得非常恶劣。$B$B嗯，谁又能搞懂魔古族的古怪念头呢……$B$B你可以帮忙潜到水下，带回那些看起来大概能搬动的神器吗？我定当感激不尽。
Description.english: For the life of me, I can't figure out why the mogu would have built all their statues and such down in that lake. I'm sure there wasn't always water down there, but it still seems wickedly inconvenient should it ever have rained.$B$BAh well, who's to fathom the strange intentions of the mogu...$B$BWould you be so kind as to swim down there and bring back any artifacts that seem even vaguely carry-able? I'd certainly appreciate it.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的琼花湖找任·火舌。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Getting your Hands Dirty
identity.objectives: Gather 12 Fresh Whitepetal Worms.
identity.description: Some of the best fishin' in all of pandaria in this lake right here. I brought enough brew to last me all day, but I didn't think to bring any bait.$B$BWho can really remember such things?$B$BIf you'd be willing to gather me some bait along the shore, I'd be willin' to think on you favorably when it comes time to price my merchandise. Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. $B$BHow's that sound?

Objectives.text: 收集12条新鲜的琼花虫。
Objectives.english: Gather 12 Fresh Whitepetal Worms.

Description.text: 这片湖面算是整个潘达利亚最好的几个垂钓圣地之一了。我带上了足够打发整日时光的好酒，不过却忘记带鱼饵了。$B$B谁能记得这种小事呢？$B$B如果你愿意沿着岸边帮我找些鱼饵，我可以在你来买东西的时候给你打个折。哦，当然，你的劳动是有报酬的。$B$B你觉得怎么样？
Description.english: Some of the best fishin' in all of pandaria in this lake right here. I brought enough brew to last me all day, but I didn't think to bring any bait.$B$BWho can really remember such things?$B$BIf you'd be willing to gather me some bait along the shore, I'd be willin' to think on you favorably when it comes time to price my merchandise. Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. $B$BHow's that sound?

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的琼花湖找商贩谭坛。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Merchant Tantan at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Stick in the Mud
identity.objectives: Gather 12 Whitepetal Reeds.
identity.description: I came out for a beautiful day of fishin', but I didn't think to bring a pole. There are so many things to remember for fishin', I just can't keep it all in my head.$B$BThose reeds along the river look alright for makin' a pole out of. If you'd gather me some number of them, I'd be willin' to think on you favorably when it comes time to price my merchandise. Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. $B$BHow's that sound?

Objectives.text: 收集12棵琼花芦苇。
Objectives.english: Gather 12 Whitepetal Reeds.

Description.text: 我本来是选在这个好日子出来钓鱼的，结果忘记带鱼竿了。钓个鱼要记得的事情可真多呀，脑袋里都装不下了。$B$B河边上的那些芦苇看起来正适合做根钓竿。如果你去帮我折些芦苇过来，我可以在你来买东西的时候给你打个折。哦，当然，你的劳动是有报酬的。$B$B你觉得怎么样？
Description.english: I came out for a beautiful day of fishin', but I didn't think to bring a pole. There are so many things to remember for fishin', I just can't keep it all in my head.$B$BThose reeds along the river look alright for makin' a pole out of. If you'd gather me some number of them, I'd be willin' to think on you favorably when it comes time to price my merchandise. Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. $B$BHow's that sound?

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的琼花湖找商贩谭坛。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Merchant Tantan at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Under Watchful Eyes
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Shao-Tien Surveyors.
identity.description: <He looks down at the dead mogu scout at his feet, looks up at you, then points out out down the lake shore. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these mogu scouts.>

Objectives.text: 击败8个韶天勘察者。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Shao-Tien Surveyors.

Description.text: <他看了看脚下魔古斥候的尸体，又抬头看看你，然后指了指湖岸边。看来他是想让你去搜寻并杀死更多的魔古斥候。>
Description.english: <He looks down at the dead mogu scout at his feet, looks up at you, then points out out down the lake shore. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these mogu scouts.>

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的琼花湖找禾·软足。
CompletionLog.english: Return to He Softfoot at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Fiery Tongue, Fragile Feet
identity.objectives: Kill 6 Stillwater Crocolisks.
identity.description: I was kicking the water for fun again when one of those vicious crocolisks lunged out to try to bite my foot off! Rude! I have proceeded to rest my weary soles a few feet farther from the water, but I already look back on my water-kicking days longingly.$B$BWould you be so kind as to kill a crocolisk or eight for me? I assure you they deserve it for frightening me though.

Objectives.text: 杀死6条静水鳄鱼。
Objectives.english: Kill 6 Stillwater Crocolisks.

Description.text: 我当时正在玩水嬉戏，突然有一只凶残的鳄鱼向我袭来，想一口咬掉我的脚！太野蛮了！后来我学着在离水远一点的地方歇脚，但我真的很怀念那一段在水里嬉戏打闹的日子。$B$B你能帮我去杀掉一条或八条鳄鱼吗？我向你保证这是它们吓唬我而应得的报应。
Description.english: I was kicking the water for fun again when one of those vicious crocolisks lunged out to try to bite my foot off! Rude! I have proceeded to rest my weary soles a few feet farther from the water, but I already look back on my water-kicking days longingly.$B$BWould you be so kind as to kill a crocolisk or eight for me? I assure you they deserve it for frightening me though.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的琼花湖找任·火舌。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: To the Waterline!
identity.objectives: Rig powder barrels in the hold of all six ships.
identity.description: This is Sky-Reaver Stormhowl, captain of the airship Fist of Garrosh and commander of this operation.$B$BYour first task is to burn the 7th Fleet to the waterline while it's still at anchor$B$BCaptain Drok's marines will hold the harbor entrance while your team works.$B$BRig powder barrels in the hold of every ship and then regroup at the harbor entrance to inform Blastmaster Sparkfuse, who will trigger the exposives and signal the airship forward.

Objectives.text: 将炸药桶安放在全部六艘船的船舱内。
Objectives.english: Rig powder barrels in the hold of all six ships.

Description.text: 我是掠天者雷嚎，“加尔鲁什之拳”飞艇的船长兼本次行动的指挥官。$B$B你的第一项任务是趁着第七舰队仍停泊靠岸之时把它们炸沉。$B$B在你的队伍采取行动时，德罗克船长的海军陆战队会控制海港的入口。$B$B将炸药桶安放在每艘船的船舱内，接着到海港入口处重新集合并通知爆破大师光油，他会引爆炸药并指示飞艇采取下一步行动。
Description.english: This is Sky-Reaver Stormhowl, captain of the airship Fist of Garrosh and commander of this operation.$B$BYour first task is to burn the 7th Fleet to the waterline while it's still at anchor$B$BCaptain Drok's marines will hold the harbor entrance while your team works.$B$BRig powder barrels in the hold of every ship and then regroup at the harbor entrance to inform Blastmaster Sparkfuse, who will trigger the exposives and signal the airship forward.

identity.title: Sea Snakes
identity.objectives: Gather 6 Murkscale Heads from Murkscale Strikers in Krasarang River.
identity.description: The rivers here are crawling with venomous aquatic snakes. Several evacuees were bitten as they fled from the temple, and already some are beginning to succumb to the poison.$B$BWe are administering anti-venom as quickly as possible, but we'll need more venom glands.$B$BI won't ask you to remove the glands in the field - that would take too long. Just bring back the heads and I'll take care of the rest.

Objectives.text: 从卡桑琅河的污鳞打击者身上收集6颗污鳞蛇头。
Objectives.english: Gather 6 Murkscale Heads from Murkscale Strikers in Krasarang River.

Description.text: 这里的河流爬满了有毒的水蛇。一些难民在逃离寺院的时候被它们咬伤了，并且某些人已出现了中毒症状。$B$B我们正尽全力研究抗毒血清，但我们需要更多的毒囊。$B$B我不会要求你去摘取毒囊——那太花时间了。你只需把蛇头带回来，剩下的事情就交给我吧。
Description.english: The rivers here are crawling with venomous aquatic snakes. Several evacuees were bitten as they fled from the temple, and already some are beginning to succumb to the poison.$B$BWe are administering anti-venom as quickly as possible, but we'll need more venom glands.$B$BI won't ask you to remove the glands in the field - that would take too long. Just bring back the heads and I'll take care of the rest.

CompletionLog.text: 回赤翼庄找安度因·乌瑞恩。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anduin Wynn in Redwing Refuge.

identity.title: Blanche's Boomer Brew
identity.objectives: Help create the Boomer Brew. If the Brewkegs catch on fire, fix them!
identity.description: Brew Blanche's Boomer Brew by Protecting the Brewkegs.

Objectives.text: 帮助酿造闪电陈酿。如果酒桶着火，马上扑灭！
Objectives.english: Help create the Boomer Brew. If the Brewkegs catch on fire, fix them!

Description.text: 保护酒桶，帮助布兰琪酿造闪电陈酿。
Description.english: Brew Blanche's Boomer Brew by Protecting the Brewkegs.

CompletionLog.text: 和布兰琪谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Talk to Blanche.

identity.title: Going West
identity.objectives: Travel to Dawnchaser Retreat.
identity.description: Leza now walks with the ancestors of this strange land. I must look now to the living.$b$bKor has led a group of our scouts west deeper into the jungle.$b$bTrack him down and lend what aid you can to him. We will join you as quickly as we are able.

Objectives.text: 前往逐晨者营地。
Objectives.english: Travel to Dawnchaser Retreat.

Description.text: 莱莎已经客死异乡，我现在必须以活着的人为重。$b$b科尔率领一队斥候深入进西边的丛林。$b$b去找科尔，尽可能地帮助他。我们会尽快赶上你们的。
Description.english: Leza now walks with the ancestors of this strange land. I must look now to the living.$b$bKor has led a group of our scouts west deeper into the jungle.$b$bTrack him down and lend what aid you can to him. We will join you as quickly as we are able.

CompletionLog.text: 去卡桑琅丛林的逐晨者营地和科尔·血牙谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Kor Bloodtusk at Dawnchaser Retreat in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: A Gift For Haohan
identity.objectives: Obtain an Enormous Cattail Grouper Tooth.
identity.description: Haohan Mudclaw is the big boss of the Tillers union and the richest guy in the Valley! He's been nice to let me stay here, so I want to do something nice for him.$b$bHe likes expensive stuff, like ruby shards, but I don't have a lot of money, so I need to get him something else.$b$bI know! I've seen a great big fish in Cattail Lake! We should get one of its teeth as a gift!

Objectives.text: 获得一颗巨大的香蒲湖石斑鱼牙齿。
Objectives.english: Obtain an Enormous Cattail Grouper Tooth.

Description.text: 郝瀚·泥爪是阡陌客的头领，也是四风谷里最富有的人！他曾经很友好地欢迎我的到来，我也很想报答他的善意。$b$b他喜欢那些奢侈品，例如红宝石碎片。但我没那么多钱，所以我想送点别的。$b$b我想到了！我在香蒲湖里见过一条巨大的石斑鱼！我们可以把它的牙齿作为礼物送给郝瀚！
Description.english: Haohan Mudclaw is the big boss of the Tillers union and the richest guy in the Valley! He's been nice to let me stay here, so I want to do something nice for him.$b$bHe likes expensive stuff, like ruby shards, but I don't have a lot of money, so I need to get him something else.$b$bI know! I've seen a great big fish in Cattail Lake! We should get one of its teeth as a gift!

identity.title: The Soul-Gatherer
identity.objectives: Kill Shadowmaster Sydow and recover the beads from his corpse.
identity.description: A single large mogu performing a ritual on the lake caught your attention while you were killing the other mogu in the area. It seems unwise to let his ritual complete.

Objectives.text: 击败暗影主宰塞铎，从他的尸体上取回念珠。
Objectives.english: Kill Shadowmaster Sydow and recover the beads from his corpse.

Description.text: 当你在击杀这片区域内的其他魔古族时，一个在湖边举行某种仪式的大个魔古引起了你的注意。看来让他完成仪式绝非明智之举。
Description.english: A single large mogu performing a ritual on the lake caught your attention while you were killing the other mogu in the area. It seems unwise to let his ritual complete.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的鎏金亭，将集灵者的念珠交给禾·软足。
CompletionLog.english: Bring the Soul-Gatherer's Beads to He Softfoot at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Yakity Yak
identity.objectives: Kill 9 Burilgi Despoilers at the Muskpaw Ranch.
identity.description: Yaungols! They come through here taking what they want and destroying whatever's left.$b$bI can't have these thugs destroy the last pieces of the Yak Wash here. It's all my boy and I have left.$b$bHead over to our old ranch and dish out some pain on them yaungols. I bet if you kill enough of them they'll think twice before attacking anything in this area.

Objectives.text: 在麝香爪牧场击败9个伯里尔基抢劫者。
Objectives.english: Kill 9 Burilgi Despoilers at the Muskpaw Ranch.

Description.text: 那些野牛人！他们闯进来，一通打砸抢，完全是强盗行径！$b$b我不能让这些暴徒把洗牛站彻底毁掉。我儿子和我就剩下这个地方容身了。$b$b我要你杀回我们的旧农场，然后给那些野牛人一点颜色看看。我敢肯定，只要你肯痛下杀手，他们下次想在这里撒野的时候就会有所顾忌了。
Description.english: Yaungols! They come through here taking what they want and destroying whatever's left.$b$bI can't have these thugs destroy the last pieces of the Yak Wash here. It's all my boy and I have left.$b$bHead over to our old ranch and dish out some pain on them yaungols. I bet if you kill enough of them they'll think twice before attacking anything in this area.

CompletionLog.text: 和昆莱山上父子洗牛站的老麝香爪谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Lao Muskpaw at the Lao & Son's Yak Wash in Kun-Lai Summit.

identity.title: FLAG - Weed War Training
identity.objectives: Listen to Xiao and his companions.
identity.description: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

Objectives.text: 倾听晓和他同伴们的谈话。
Objectives.english: Listen to Xiao and his companions.

Description.text: 嘿，你好。你在寻找这片地方的主人吗？那就去见见楼梯上面的那位熊猫人吧。跟你一样，我也是访客。$b$b不好意思，我跟我朋友现在要商量点事情。我们稍后再聊。
Description.english: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

identity.title: FLAG - Pest Problems Training
identity.objectives: Listen to Xiao and his companions.
identity.description: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

Objectives.text: 倾听晓和他同伴们的谈话。
Objectives.english: Listen to Xiao and his companions.

Description.text: 嘿，你好。你在寻找这片地方的主人吗？那就去见见楼梯上面的那位熊猫人吧。跟你一样，我也是访客。$b$b不好意思，我跟我朋友现在要商量点事情。我们稍后再聊。
Description.english: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

identity.title: A Zandalari Troll?
identity.objectives: Kill the Zandalari Soulraiser.
identity.description: While you've been destroying the reanimated mogu statues, the unmistakable accent of a Zandalari troll has been taunting you.$B$BIt's clear that the threat to Westerly Rest will not end until he's been dealt with.

Objectives.text: 击败赞达拉唤魂者。
Objectives.english: Kill the Zandalari Soulraiser.

Description.text: 你在痛扁那些被唤醒的魔古雕像时，有个声音一直在用显而易见的赞达拉巨魔口音嘲弄你。$B$B很明显，如果不把他解决掉，他对西风之息的威胁就永远不会消除。
Description.english: While you've been destroying the reanimated mogu statues, the unmistakable accent of a Zandalari troll has been taunting you.$B$BIt's clear that the threat to Westerly Rest will not end until he's been dealt with.

CompletionLog.text: 去昆莱山的西风之息找米希卡。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Mishka at Westerly Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.

identity.title: A Zandalari Troll?
identity.objectives: Kill the Zandalari Soulraiser.
identity.description: While you've been destroying the reanimated mogu statues, the unmistakable accent of a Zandalari troll has been taunting you.$B$BIt's clear that the threat to Westerly Rest will not end until he's been dealt with.

Objectives.text: 击败赞达拉唤魂者。
Objectives.english: Kill the Zandalari Soulraiser.

Description.text: 你在痛扁那些被唤醒的魔古雕像时，有个声音一直在用显而易见的赞达拉巨魔口音嘲弄你。$B$B很明显，如果不把他解决掉，他对东风之眠的威胁就永远不会消除。
Description.english: While you've been destroying the reanimated mogu statues, the unmistakable accent of a Zandalari troll has been taunting you.$B$BIt's clear that the threat to Westerly Rest will not end until he's been dealt with.

CompletionLog.text: 去昆莱山的东风之眠找匿踪大师琪麟。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Shademaster Kiryn at Easterly Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.

identity.title: FLAG - Player Began Finale
identity.objectives: Listen to Xiao and his companions.
identity.description: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

Objectives.text: 倾听晓和他同伴们的谈话。
Objectives.english: Listen to Xiao and his companions.

Description.text: 嘿，你好。你在寻找这片地方的主人吗？那就去见见楼梯上面的那位熊猫人吧。跟你一样，我也是访客。$b$b不好意思，我跟我朋友现在要商量点事情。我们稍后再聊。
Description.english: Oh, hello. Are you looking for the owner of this place? Then look to the pandaren up at the top of the stairs. I'm just a visitor... like you.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, my friends and I trying to decide something. We can talk again afterwards.

identity.title: Into the Vale
identity.objectives: Speak to Matron Vi Vinh at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
identity.description: Ah, I have been waiting for your arrival, traveler.$B$BI wish we could meet in better times, but alas, I fear the situation in the Vale is quite dire.$B$BBut let us not speak of that now. Go visit Matron Vi Vinh at the Shrine of Seven Stars.$B$BShe should be able to settle you in.

Objectives.text: 到锦绣谷的七星殿找瓦妮阿姨谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Matron Vi Vinh at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Description.text: 啊，我一直在等着你的到来，旅行者。$B$B真希望我们能在和平时期会面，但很可惜，现在山谷里的形势恐怕相当严峻。$B$B现在也不是说这话的时候，去七星殿找瓦妮阿姨谈一谈吧。$B$B她应该能帮你安顿下来。
Description.english: Ah, I have been waiting for your arrival, traveler.$B$BI wish we could meet in better times, but alas, I fear the situation in the Vale is quite dire.$B$BBut let us not speak of that now. Go visit Matron Vi Vinh at the Shrine of Seven Stars.$B$BShe should be able to settle you in.

identity.title: The Ruins of Guo-Lai
identity.objectives: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
identity.description: According to Zhi the Harmonious, the mogu are moving into the Vale from the Ruins of Guo-Lai to the west.$B$BI sent Anji and Kun to investigate the situation, but they have not yet returned.$B$BI need a capable $c like you to go check on them.

Objectives.text: 去锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹和安济·秋光谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Description.text: 根据和谐者智先生所述，魔古族正从西边的郭莱遗迹进入峡谷。$B$B我派了安济和奎去调查情况，但他们还没有回来。$B$B我需要一个像你这样能干的$c去查看一下他们的情况。
Description.english: According to Zhi the Harmonious, the mogu are moving into the Vale from the Ruins of Guo-Lai to the west.$B$BI sent Anji and Kun to investigate the situation, but they have not yet returned.$B$BI need a capable $c like you to go check on them.

identity.title: Out with the Scouts
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Shao-Tien Precursor.
identity.description: We'd been briefed on mogu sightings in the Vale, but the situation is worse than we had anticipated.$B$BScouts are swarming all over the ruins to the northwest, gathering intel and stealing treasures.$B$BYour objective is clear - dispatch of any scouts you see. An army cannot move if we take out its eyes.

Objectives.text: 击败8个韶天先锋。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Shao-Tien Precursor.

Description.text: 虽然我们之前已经大概了解了魔古族在山谷中的动向，但实际情形比我们的预期要更糟。$B$B西北方的遗迹中聚集着大量斥候，他们在那里收集情报并大肆掠夺。$B$B你的目标很简单，把你遇到的所有斥候大卸八块。只要我们除掉他们的耳目，魔古大军就会寸步难行。
Description.english: We'd been briefed on mogu sightings in the Vale, but the situation is worse than we had anticipated.$B$BScouts are swarming all over the ruins to the northwest, gathering intel and stealing treasures.$B$BYour objective is clear - dispatch of any scouts you see. An army cannot move if we take out its eyes.

identity.title: Barring Entry
identity.objectives: Speak to Lao Softfoot at the entrance to Ruins Rise and follow him up the trail. Then, plant the Explosive Keg at the Ruins Rise Cave Entrance.
identity.description: Lao Softfoot and I scouted up the ruins to the north.$B$BIt looks like the mogu are infiltrating the valley through a cave just up the hill, and already they are sending formidable reinforcements through.$B$BThere are too many enemies to take them head on, so you'll have to meet Lao Softfoot at the entrance to the ruins.$B$BHe'll help you sneak in under the cover of stealth. Then, plant this keg of explosives at the mouth of the cave.$B$BThe rest should take care of itself.

Objectives.text: 和遗迹高地入口处的劳·软足谈一谈，并跟随他的踪迹前进。然后，在遗迹高地洞穴入口处埋放炸药桶。
Objectives.english: Speak to Lao Softfoot at the entrance to Ruins Rise and follow him up the trail. Then, plant the Explosive Keg at the Ruins Rise Cave Entrance.

Description.text: 我和劳·软足侦察了北边的遗迹。$B$B看来魔古族是从山上的一个洞穴入侵山谷的，并且他们正派出大量的援军穿越那个洞穴。$B$B敌人的数量太多，我们没法正面迎击，你必须前往遗迹的入口处跟劳·软足会合。$B$B他会帮助你悄悄地潜入那里。然后，在洞穴的入口处埋下这桶炸药。$B$B接下来，我们就可以等着看烟火表演了。
Description.english: Lao Softfoot and I scouted up the ruins to the north.$B$BIt looks like the mogu are infiltrating the valley through a cave just up the hill, and already they are sending formidable reinforcements through.$B$BThere are too many enemies to take them head on, so you'll have to meet Lao Softfoot at the entrance to the ruins.$B$BHe'll help you sneak in under the cover of stealth. Then, plant this keg of explosives at the mouth of the cave.$B$BThe rest should take care of itself.

identity.title: Killing the Quilen
identity.objectives: Kill 9 Stone Guardians.
identity.description: We've taken care of the scout problem for now, but there are still advance mogu forces inside the Guo-Lai Halls down the hill.$B$BUnfortunately, their vicious guard dogs are protecting their operations deeper in the ruins.$B$BGo and dispatch of their beasts. Be on your guard - they can be quite good at blending into their surroundings.

Objectives.text: 击败9个石头守护者。
Objectives.english: Kill 9 Stone Guardians.

Description.text: 我们现在解决了斥候的问题，但山下的郭莱大殿中还有魔古族的前锋部队。$B$B糟糕的是，凶恶的警卫犬保护着他们在遗迹深处的行动。$B$B去干掉那些野兽。要保持警惕——它们非常善于融入四周的环境。
Description.english: We've taken care of the scout problem for now, but there are still advance mogu forces inside the Guo-Lai Halls down the hill.$B$BUnfortunately, their vicious guard dogs are protecting their operations deeper in the ruins.$B$BGo and dispatch of their beasts. Be on your guard - they can be quite good at blending into their surroundings.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Stones of Power
identity.objectives: Collect 7 Revelite Crystals.
identity.description: Many thousands of years ago, the rulers of the Vale sought energy from a powerful crystal known as Revelite.$B$BWith this substance, they were able to power cities, factories, and engines of war.$B$BZhi the Harmonious has asked us to collect some crystals and bring them back to the city.$B$BKeep an eye out for them while you are in the ruins.

Objectives.text: 收集7块梦光水晶。
Objectives.english: Collect 7 Revelite Crystals.

Description.text: 几千年前，锦绣谷的统治者从强大的梦光水晶中获得了能量。$B$B借助这种物质，他们能够驱动城市、工厂，甚至战争器械。$B$B和谐者智先生请我们帮他收集几块水晶，并把它们带回城里。$B$B去遗迹那里仔细找找吧。
Description.english: Many thousands of years ago, the rulers of the Vale sought energy from a powerful crystal known as Revelite.$B$BWith this substance, they were able to power cities, factories, and engines of war.$B$BZhi the Harmonious has asked us to collect some crystals and bring them back to the city.$B$BKeep an eye out for them while you are in the ruins.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: The Guo-Lai Halls
identity.objectives: Investigate the mogu presence in the Guo-Lai Halls.
identity.description: As you pass by the great door, you hear sounds from deep inside.$B$BAnji mentioned that advance mogu scouts had been sighted in this area. Perhaps they made their way down to the depths below.$B$BYour senses tingling, you decide to investigate.

Objectives.text: 调查魔古族在郭莱古厅中的活动。
Objectives.english: Investigate the mogu presence in the Guo-Lai Halls.

Description.text: 通过巨门时，你听到了深处传来的声音。$B$B安济说过在这片区域发现了魔古前锋斥候，他们可能已经深入了遗迹内部。$B$B你心中一动，决定去调查一下。
Description.english: As you pass by the great door, you hear sounds from deep inside.$B$BAnji mentioned that advance mogu scouts had been sighted in this area. Perhaps they made their way down to the depths below.$B$BYour senses tingling, you decide to investigate.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Leaving an Opening
identity.objectives: Speak to Leven Dawnblade at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
identity.description: This is serious.$B$BKun and I will keep an eye on things here, but you should go to the Golden Pagoda.$B$BGo, swiftly!

Objectives.text: 和锦绣谷鎏金亭的莱文·黎明之刃谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Leven Dawnblade at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Description.text: 形势严峻。$B$B奎和我会守在这里的，而你应该到鎏金亭去。$B$B去吧，要快！
Description.english: This is serious.$B$BKun and I will keep an eye on things here, but you should go to the Golden Pagoda.$B$BGo, swiftly!

identity.title: The Secrets of Guo-Lai
identity.objectives: Meet with He Softfoot in the Guo-Lai Halls and uncover the mogu's purpose in the western chamber.
identity.description: I just received information from a guard stationed near the Ruins of Guo-Lai that the Shado-Tien leader entered the halls, killing two of my men in the process. They're intent on something inside. We need to stop them.$B$BHe Softfoot has already followed them in. He should be waiting for you at the entrance to the western chambers.$B$BMove quickly, $n. I don't like the thought that the mogu may be a step ahead of us.

Objectives.text: 去郭莱古厅见禾·软足，揭露魔古族进入西边大厅的企图。
Objectives.english: Meet with He Softfoot in the Guo-Lai Halls and uncover the mogu's purpose in the western chamber.

Description.text: 我刚从郭莱遗迹附近的卫兵那里获悉，韶天头领进入了大厅，杀死了两个我们的人。他们是想夺取大厅里边的东西，我们必须阻止他们。$B$B禾·软足跟着他们进去了，他应该在西边大厅入口处等着你。$B$B快点，$n。我可不想让魔古族赶在我们前头。
Description.english: I just received information from a guard stationed near the Ruins of Guo-Lai that the Shado-Tien leader entered the halls, killing two of my men in the process. They're intent on something inside. We need to stop them.$B$BHe Softfoot has already followed them in. He should be waiting for you at the entrance to the western chambers.$B$BMove quickly, $n. I don't like the thought that the mogu may be a step ahead of us.

identity.title: Battle Spear of the Thunder King
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Battle Spear of the Thunder King.
identity.description: I have received some troubling news, $n.$B$BThe mogu are plotting to steal three artifacts of power from the Vale.$B$BWe must retrieve the artifacts immediately and hide them for safekeeping.$B$BThe first artifact is the Battle Spear of the Thunder King.$B$BUpon emperor Lei Shen's death, the spear was placed in an ancient shrine to the northwest.$B$BBring the spear back to me.

Title.english: Battle Spear of the Thunder King

Objectives.text: 取回雷电之王的战矛。
Objectives.english: Retrieve the Battle Spear of the Thunder King.

Description.text: 我听到了一些不好的消息，$n。$B$B魔古正密谋从锦绣谷窃取三件神器。$B$B我们必须立即取回神器，并把它们藏起来妥善保管。$B$B第一件神器是雷电之王的战矛。$B$B皇帝雷神死后，他的战矛被放在了西北面的古代神龛中。$B$B去把战矛给我带回来。
Description.english: I have received some troubling news, $n.$B$BThe mogu are plotting to steal three artifacts of power from the Vale.$B$BWe must retrieve the artifacts immediately and hide them for safekeeping.$B$BThe first artifact is the Battle Spear of the Thunder King.$B$BUpon emperor Lei Shen's death, the spear was placed in an ancient shrine to the northwest.$B$BBring the spear back to me.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的鎏金亭找和谐者智先生。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Zhi the Harmonious at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Battle Helm of the Thunder King
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Battle Helm of the Thunder King.
identity.description: The second artifact of power is the Battle Helm of the Thunder King.$B$BEmperor Lei Shen wore the helm into every battle. It became so well-known that his enemies would flee at the mere sight of it.$B$BWhen the Emperor died, they placed the helm in the very bottom of the Guo-Lai Halls to the west, surrounded by thousands of terracotta soldiers.$B$BThus, they could look upon their leader and follow him into death.

Title.english: Battle Helm of the Thunder King

Objectives.text: 取回雷电之王的战盔。
Objectives.english: Retrieve the Battle Helm of the Thunder King.

Description.text: 第二件强大的神器是雷电之王的战盔。$B$B雷神皇帝每场战斗都戴着那顶头盔。此事人尽皆知，他的敌人一看到那顶头盔，就会四下逃散。$B$B皇帝死后，他们把那顶头盔放置在了西边郭莱古厅的深处，由几千个陶土士兵守卫着。$B$B如此一来，他们就可以在死后继续追随他们的首领。
Description.english: The second artifact of power is the Battle Helm of the Thunder King.$B$BEmperor Lei Shen wore the helm into every battle. It became so well-known that his enemies would flee at the mere sight of it.$B$BWhen the Emperor died, they placed the helm in the very bottom of the Guo-Lai Halls to the west, surrounded by thousands of terracotta soldiers.$B$BThus, they could look upon their leader and follow him into death.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的鎏金亭找和谐者智先生。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Zhi the Harmonious at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Battle Axe of the Thunder King
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Battle Axe of the Thunder King.
identity.description: The final artifact is the Thunder King's axe.$B$BLei Shen charged into battle with his spear in one hand, and his axe in the other.$B$BIt is said that he could throw his axe with brutal accuracy, and when it hit its target, it made a sound like crashing thunder.$B$BAfter his death, the axe was placed in a ceremonial chamber to the southwest.$B$BNeedless to say, we must not let it fall into the mogu's hands.

Title.english: Battle Axe of the Thunder King

Objectives.text: 取回雷电之王的战斧。
Objectives.english: Retrieve the Battle Axe of the Thunder King.

Description.text: 最后一件神器是雷电之王的战斧。$B$B雷神每次上战场时，总是一手执矛，一手持斧。$B$B据说他投掷战斧例不虚发，而且在击中目标后，它会发出惊雷一般的巨响。$B$B雷神死后，战斧被放在了西南面的祠堂中。$B$B毫无疑问，我们不能让它落入魔古族的手中。
Description.english: The final artifact is the Thunder King's axe.$B$BLei Shen charged into battle with his spear in one hand, and his axe in the other.$B$BIt is said that he could throw his axe with brutal accuracy, and when it hit its target, it made a sound like crashing thunder.$B$BAfter his death, the axe was placed in a ceremonial chamber to the southwest.$B$BNeedless to say, we must not let it fall into the mogu's hands.

identity.title: The Mogu's Message
identity.objectives: Speak to Zhi the Harmonious at The Silent Sanctuary in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
identity.description: The battle against the mogu rages fiercely with neither side giving quarter.$B$BWe cannot hold our position forever. Something must be done to strike a blow at the mogu, a blow from which they cannot recover.$B$BGo check in with Zhi the Harmonious at The Silent Sanctuary. I wish to hear his thoughts on this matter.

Objectives.text: 和锦绣谷缄默圣地的和谐者智先生谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Zhi the Harmonious at The Silent Sanctuary in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Description.text: 与魔古族的战斗已经趋于白热化，双方互不相让，殊死搏斗。$B$B我们不可能一直坚守阵地。我们必须一举击溃魔古族，让他们永无翻身之日。$B$B去缄默圣地找和谐者智先生，我想听听他对此事的看法。
Description.english: The battle against the mogu rages fiercely with neither side giving quarter.$B$BWe cannot hold our position forever. Something must be done to strike a blow at the mogu, a blow from which they cannot recover.$B$BGo check in with Zhi the Harmonious at The Silent Sanctuary. I wish to hear his thoughts on this matter.

identity.title: What Comes to Pass
identity.objectives: Speak to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
identity.description: You had better report back to the Golden Pagoda immediately.

Objectives.text: 和锦绣谷鎏金亭的孙·柔心谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Description.text: 你最好立即返回鎏金亭进行汇报。
Description.english: You had better report back to the Golden Pagoda immediately.

identity.title: The Might of Three
identity.objectives: Slay 100 mogu invaders at the Summer Fields in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
identity.description: This is it, $n. This is the end.$B$BIf we don't drive the mogu from the valley, they will seize the remnants of their ancient power and use it to break Pandaria to their will.$B$BBut our forces are few, and tired, and small. We bleed, while their warriors are made of stone.$B$B$n, although all odds are against us, still I must ask you to go and help our forces slay the mogu invaders.$B$BI have prayed to the Celestials, begging their aid. I can only hope that they answer our call.

Objectives.text: 在锦绣谷的仲夏原击败100个魔古入侵者。
Objectives.english: Slay 100 mogu invaders at the Summer Fields in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Description.text: 就这样了，$n。结束了。$B$B如果我们无法将魔古族赶出锦绣谷，他们将夺取剩余的上古力量，并用它来肆意破坏潘达利亚。$B$B我们的军队不够强大，士兵也很疲乏。我们的军队会受伤，敌人的军队却都是石头战士。$B$B$n，尽管面临着重重困难，我还是要请求你去帮助我们的军队杀死魔古入侵者。$B$B我已经向众神祈祷过，祈求他们的帮助。我只能寄希望于他们回应我们的召唤了。
Description.english: This is it, $n. This is the end.$B$BIf we don't drive the mogu from the valley, they will seize the remnants of their ancient power and use it to break Pandaria to their will.$B$BBut our forces are few, and tired, and small. We bleed, while their warriors are made of stone.$B$B$n, although all odds are against us, still I must ask you to go and help our forces slay the mogu invaders.$B$BI have prayed to the Celestials, begging their aid. I can only hope that they answer our call.

CompletionLog.text: 和锦绣谷魔古山宫殿的梦想家思南谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Sinan the Dream at Mogu'shan Palace in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: The Final Power
identity.objectives: Kill Warlord Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter.
identity.description: I never thought it would come to this!$B$BLeven went to face Warlord Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter at the top of the palace steps, but our reinforcements cannot get through!$B$BWe are the only ones who stand between him and the Vale's greatest... and most deadly... powers.$B$BPlease, $n, you must find a way to stop him!

Objectives.text: 击败韶天军阀——放血者兆金。
Objectives.english: Kill Warlord Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter.

Description.text: 我从没想过事情会变成这样！$B$B莱文去宫殿阶梯的顶端挑战韶天军阀——放血者兆金去了，但我们的援军无法通过！$B$B只有我们能阻止他与锦绣谷最强大……也是最凶残的敌人交手。$B$B拜托了，$n，请你一定要阻止他！
Description.english: I never thought it would come to this!$B$BLeven went to face Warlord Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter at the top of the palace steps, but our reinforcements cannot get through!$B$BWe are the only ones who stand between him and the Vale's greatest... and most deadly... powers.$B$BPlease, $n, you must find a way to stop him!

identity.title: The Guo-Lai Halls
identity.objectives: Investigate the mogu presence in the Guo-Lai Halls.
identity.description: The mogu are up to something, I can feel it.$B$BThey've been sending scouts down into the Guo-Lai Halls.$B$BAccording to the caretakers, the Halls are home to ancient treasures of emperors past. Not only riches, but artifacts of great power.$B$BWe must prevent the mogu from accessing these treasures! Go down the ramp to the northwest and stop them!

Objectives.text: 调查魔古族在郭莱古厅中的活动。
Objectives.english: Investigate the mogu presence in the Guo-Lai Halls.

Description.text: 我有种感觉，魔古族正在酝酿什么阴谋。$B$B他们派斥候进入了郭莱古厅。$B$B根据金莲护法的说法，古厅里收藏着历代帝王的财宝。不仅有巨额财富，还有力量强大的神器。$B$B我们不能让这些财宝落入魔古族之手！快沿着西北方的斜坡下去，阻止他们！
Description.english: The mogu are up to something, I can feel it.$B$BThey've been sending scouts down into the Guo-Lai Halls.$B$BAccording to the caretakers, the Halls are home to ancient treasures of emperors past. Not only riches, but artifacts of great power.$B$BWe must prevent the mogu from accessing these treasures! Go down the ramp to the northwest and stop them!

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的郭莱遗迹找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: The Ordo Warbringer
identity.objectives: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.
identity.description: You've taken the shield down at Fire Camp Ordo. Go back there before the shield goes up again.$B$BTime to head into the cave and slay their chief!

Objectives.text: 击败斡耳朵战争使者。
Objectives.english: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.

Description.text: 你已经让斡耳朵火营的防护盾消失了，务必在他们重新升起防护盾之前赶回去。$B$B直捣黄龙，干掉他们的酋长！
Description.english: You've taken the shield down at Fire Camp Ordo. Go back there before the shield goes up again.$B$BTime to head into the cave and slay their chief!

identity.title: The Ordo Warbringer
identity.objectives: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.
identity.description: You've taken the shield down at Fire Camp Ordo. Get back over there before they get that shield up again.$B$BSlay the Warbringer of the Ordo!

Objectives.text: 击败斡耳朵战争使者。
Objectives.english: Kill the Ordo Warbringer.

Description.text: 你已经让斡耳朵火营的防护盾消失了，务必在他们重新升起防护盾之前赶回去。$B$B直捣黄龙，干掉斡耳朵战争使者！
Description.english: You've taken the shield down at Fire Camp Ordo. Get back over there before they get that shield up again.$B$BSlay the Warbringer of the Ordo!

CompletionLog.text: 去昆莱山的东风之眠找纳兹戈林将军。
CompletionLog.english: Return to General Nazgrim at Eastwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.

identity.title: Holed Up
identity.objectives: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
identity.description: Thank the heavenly spirits for you, $c! I don't know how much longer I could've lasted.$B$BThere are other Firebough Nook survivors, I'm sure of it. Will you help rescue them and get us to the safety of Shado-Pan Fallback?

Objectives.text: 营救金·热桶、崖·火树、方老太和钟思亚。
Objectives.english: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.

Description.text: 你真是菩萨心肠，$c！我都不知道自己还能坚持多久。$B$B火树村还有其他的幸存者，我很确定。你能否帮忙把他们救出来，然后把我们安全送到影踪别院？
Description.english: Thank the heavenly spirits for you, $c! I don't know how much longer I could've lasted.$B$BThere are other Firebough Nook survivors, I'm sure of it. Will you help rescue them and get us to the safety of Shado-Pan Fallback?

CompletionLog.text: 去昆莱山的影踪别院找影踪派翀大师。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Shado-Master Chong at Shado-Pan Fallback in Kun-Lai Summit.

identity.title: Holed Up
identity.objectives: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
identity.description: Oh thank you, thank you, thank you. If you hadn't come along...$B$BWait! There must be other survivors in the Nook like me!$B$BPlease, $c, I beg you. Rescue the rest of my citizens and deliver us safely to Shado-Pan Fallback.

Objectives.text: 营救金·热桶、崖·火树、方老太和钟思亚。
Objectives.english: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.

Description.text: 谢谢，谢谢，太感谢你了！如果不是你的话……$B$B等等！火树村一定还有其他和我一样的幸存者！$B$B拜托了，$c。我恳求你去救救他们。救出其他的村民并将我们安全护送到影踪别院。
Description.english: Oh thank you, thank you, thank you. If you hadn't come along...$B$BWait! There must be other survivors in the Nook like me!$B$BPlease, $c, I beg you. Rescue the rest of my citizens and deliver us safely to Shado-Pan Fallback.

CompletionLog.text: 去昆莱山的影踪别院找影踪派翀大师。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Shado-Master Chong at Shado-Pan Fallback in Kun-Lai Summit.

identity.title: Holed Up
identity.objectives: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.
identity.description: Oh, thank you! There's no way I could have made it back on my own.$B$BCome to think of it, there must be others around Firebough Nook that need to be rescued. Shall we go collect them and then head to the safety of Shado-Pan Fallback?

Objectives.text: 营救金·热桶、崖·火树、方老太和钟思亚。
Objectives.english: Rescue Jin Warmkeg, Ya Firebough, Old Lady Fung, and Sya Zhong.

Description.text: 哦，谢谢你！没有你的帮助，我肯定是回不来了。$B$B说到这个，附近肯定还有其他的火树村幸存者在等待救援。我们能不能把他们都接过来，然后一起送到安全的影踪别院？
Description.english: Oh, thank you! There's no way I could have made it back on my own.$B$BCome to think of it, there must be others around Firebough Nook that need to be rescued. Shall we go collect them and then head to the safety of Shado-Pan Fallback?

CompletionLog.text: 去昆莱山的影踪别院找影踪派翀大师。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Shado-Master Chong at Shado-Pan Fallback in Kun-Lai Summit.

identity.title: Provoking the Trolls
identity.objectives: Kill 10 Zandalari Stalkers and 5 Zandalari Hexers
identity.description:
We've managed to push them back this far, but I doubt that we will remain safe for long if we do not deal with them once and for all.

My husband, coward or fool that he is, does not wish to provoke them. I will not be cowed so.

We will do just that. Slay their forward scouts. Perhaps we can provoke - and then defeat - their leader.

Objectives.text: 击败10个赞达拉追踪者和5个赞达拉妖术师。
Objectives.english: Kill 10 Zandalari Stalkers and 5 Zandalari Hexers

Description.text:
我们已经暂时击退了他们，但是如果不能把他们彻底消灭，这些家伙很快就会卷土重来。

我丈夫不知道是胆小还是愚蠢，竟然主张不要激怒他们。我可不是胆小鬼！

我们不能这样就算了。杀死他们的前锋斥候。或许我们就能激怒——并消灭——他们的首领。
Description.english:
We've managed to push them back this far, but I doubt that we will remain safe for long if we do not deal with them once and for all.

My husband, coward or fool that he is, does not wish to provoke them. I will not be cowed so.

We will do just that. Slay their forward scouts. Perhaps we can provoke - and then defeat - their leader.

CompletionLog.text: 去找小孟。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Xiao Meng

identity.title: Destroy the Leaders
identity.objectives: Kill the Zandalari Blademaster and Zandalari Mage
identity.description:
And, now they fear you.

Their leaders, a Blademaster and a Mage, lie deeper in the ruins. Kill them.
Make them hurt. For us.

Objectives.text: 击败赞达拉剑圣和赞达拉法师
Objectives.english: Kill the Zandalari Blademaster and Zandalari Mage

Description.text:
现在，他们都怕了你了。

他们的首领：一个剑圣一个法师，就躲在废墟深处。去杀了他们。
把他们打痛，就算是为了我们。
Description.english:
And, now they fear you.

Their leaders, a Blademaster and a Mage, lie deeper in the ruins. Kill them.
Make them hurt. For us.

CompletionLog.text: 去找萧志海。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Xiao Zi Hai

identity.title: Fat Long-Fat
identity.objectives: Defeat Fat Long-Fat at the top of Angkhal Pavilion.
identity.description: You have been matched with a... special trainee. His name is Fat Long-Fat.$b$b<Thelonius chooses his words carefully.>$b$bFat Long-Fat... operates outside of the normal rules of combat. He does not fight every day, and when he does, he chooses his competitor. Today, for some reason... he has selected you.$b$bYou will find him atop Angkhal Pavilion.

Objectives.text: 去安卡阁的顶层击败肥龙。
Objectives.english: Defeat Fat Long-Fat at the top of Angkhal Pavilion.

Description.text: 你的下一个对手很……特殊。他的名字叫肥龙。$b$b<塞隆尼斯小心斟酌着他的用词。>$b$b肥龙……他是不受比赛规则约束的。他不会每天都来参加战斗训练，而且还要自己挑选对手。今天，不知是什么原因……他选中了你。$b$b你可以在安卡阁的顶层找到他。
Description.english: You have been matched with a... special trainee. His name is Fat Long-Fat.$b$b<Thelonius chooses his words carefully.>$b$bFat Long-Fat... operates outside of the normal rules of combat. He does not fight every day, and when he does, he chooses his competitor. Today, for some reason... he has selected you.$b$bYou will find him atop Angkhal Pavilion.

identity.title: Dextrous Izissha
identity.objectives: Defeat Dextrous Izissha.
identity.description: Jinyu normally avoid our order, but every few years, we find one that subscribes to the way of the Crane. One such jinyu is Dextrous Izissha.$b$bIzissha is your next challenger. He waits for you on the island's southwestern shore.

Objectives.text: 击败敏捷的伊兹沙。
Objectives.english: Defeat Dextrous Izissha.

Description.text: 通常来说锦鱼人是不和我们往来的，不过每隔几年我们总会收下一个敬服朱鹤之道的锦鱼人。敏捷的伊兹沙就是如此。$b$b伊兹沙就是你的下一个挑战者，他在岛屿西南面的海滩上等着你。
Description.english: Jinyu normally avoid our order, but every few years, we find one that subscribes to the way of the Crane. One such jinyu is Dextrous Izissha.$b$bIzissha is your next challenger. He waits for you on the island's southwestern shore.

CompletionLog.text: 回卡桑琅丛林的赤精栖木找塞隆尼斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Kuo-Na Quillpaw
identity.objectives: Defeat Kuo-Na Quillpaw.
identity.description: Most of the duels within the Cradle take place between two trainees. Rarely, when a trainee exhibits a rare amount of skill, they will have an opportunity to duel their trainer.$b$bToday, you duel against Kuo-Na. She will be waiting for you at the Pedestal of Hope.

CompletionLog.text: 回卡桑琅丛林的赤精栖木找塞隆尼斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Ellia Ravenmane: Revenge
identity.objectives: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane at Dome Balrissa.
identity.description: Your "rival" has appeared again. Ellia Ravenmane has been avoiding her duties on the island, instead focusing on personal training, with the intent to defeat you in battle.$b$b"I will destroy $n," she said.$b$bI have honored her request for a rematch, but I will be keeping a close eye on her. Her motives may be shifting in a dangerous direction.

CompletionLog.text: 回卡桑琅丛林的赤精栖木找塞隆尼斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Tukka-Tuk
identity.objectives: Defeat Tukka-Tuk.
identity.description: You are making a name for yourself, $n. I received a challenge from one of our more skilled competitors. He believes you are not as strong as you seem.$b$bHis name is Tukka-Tuk, the hozen. If you've ever fought against hozen before, you know that their apparent juvenility belies their battle acumen. Good luck.

CompletionLog.text: 回卡桑琅丛林的赤精栖木找塞隆尼斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Huck Wheelbarrow
identity.objectives: Defeat Huck Wheelbarrow.
identity.description: Usually our trainees are adventurers like yourself, or monks from Tian Monastery, or occasionally retired Shado-Pan. Very rarely, though, we will greet trainees that have no fighting experience whatsoever.$b$bHuck Wheelbarrow is one such trainee. He has requested a duel with you. Look for him on the island's western shore.

Objectives.text: 击败哈克·独轮。
Objectives.english: Defeat Huck Wheelbarrow.

Description.text: 通常我们的弟子要么就是像你这样的冒险家，要么就是天禅院的武僧，偶尔也有退伍的影踪派门人。极少数情况下，我们也会录取没有战斗经验的弟子。$b$b哈克·独轮就是这样的弟子，他要求跟你决斗。你可以在岛屿西面的海滩上找到他。
Description.english: Usually our trainees are adventurers like yourself, or monks from Tian Monastery, or occasionally retired Shado-Pan. Very rarely, though, we will greet trainees that have no fighting experience whatsoever.$b$bHuck Wheelbarrow is one such trainee. He has requested a duel with you. Look for him on the island's western shore.

CompletionLog.text: 回卡桑琅丛林的赤精栖木找塞隆尼斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Mindel Sunspeaker
identity.objectives: Defeat Mindel Sunspeaker.
identity.description: Our highest-ranked trainee is an outsider like you. It is both strange and exciting to live in a time when so many foreigners have embraced the way of the Crane.$b$bYour challenger's name is Mindel Sunspeaker, and he awaits you within Angkhal Pavilion.

Objectives.text: 击败米德尔·日语者。
Objectives.english: Defeat Mindel Sunspeaker.

Description.text: 我们排名最高的弟子和你一样，也是个外来人。看到有这么多的外来人信仰朱鹤之道，生活在这样一个年代既让我感到古怪，又倍感鼓舞。$b$b你的挑战者名叫米德尔·日语者，他正在安卡阁等着你。
Description.english: Our highest-ranked trainee is an outsider like you. It is both strange and exciting to live in a time when so many foreigners have embraced the way of the Crane.$b$bYour challenger's name is Mindel Sunspeaker, and he awaits you within Angkhal Pavilion.

CompletionLog.text: 回卡桑琅丛林的赤精栖木找塞隆尼斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Yan Quillpaw
identity.objectives: Defeat Yan Quillpaw at the Pedestal of Hope.
identity.description: You have already defeated Kuo-Na Quillpaw. You have not yet fought her brother, Yan.$b$bHe will meet you at the Pedestal of Hope, and he will not hold back. His reputation as a trainer is at stake.

Objectives.text: 去希冀台击败燕·翎爪。
Objectives.english: Defeat Yan Quillpaw at the Pedestal of Hope.

Description.text: 你已经打败了郭楠·翎爪，但你还没有跟她的哥哥燕·翎爪交过手。$b$b他会在希冀台上跟你碰面。他是不会退缩的，因为他已经堵上了作为师父的名誉。
Description.english: You have already defeated Kuo-Na Quillpaw. You have not yet fought her brother, Yan.$b$bHe will meet you at the Pedestal of Hope, and he will not hold back. His reputation as a trainer is at stake.

CompletionLog.text: 回卡桑琅丛林的赤精栖木找塞隆尼斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Fat Long-Fat: Rematch
identity.objectives: Defeat Fat Long-Fat atop Dome Belrissa.
identity.description: Fat Long-Fat has requested another match with you. I find this strange. And concerning.$b$bHe will be waiting atop the Dome Belrissa.

CompletionLog.text: 回卡桑琅丛林的赤精栖木找塞隆尼斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Thelonius
identity.objectives: Defeat Thelonius.
identity.description: When we last spoke, I promised to tell you the secret of Fat Long-Fat. I still plan to tell you that secret... after I determine your worth.$b$bI will meet you on the western shore, and we will duel.

Objectives.text: 击败塞隆尼斯。
Objectives.english: Defeat Thelonius.

Description.text: 上次谈话时，我答应告诉你肥龙的秘密。我还是会信守诺言的……不过要先确定你是否值得我信任。$b$b我会在西边的海滩上等你过来决斗。
Description.english: When we last spoke, I promised to tell you the secret of Fat Long-Fat. I still plan to tell you that secret... after I determine your worth.$b$bI will meet you on the western shore, and we will duel.

CompletionLog.text: 回卡桑琅丛林的赤精栖木找塞隆尼斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Ellia Ravenmane: Redemption
identity.objectives: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane atop the Pedestal of Hope.
identity.description: Ellia Ravenmane, your rival, has returned. She demands that you meet her atop the Pedestal of Hope.$b$bYou need to understand, $n... something horrible has happened to her. She has changed. You will see for yourself when you arrive at the pedestal.$b$bGood luck, $n.

Objectives.text: 在希冀台的顶层击败艾黎亚·鸦鬃。
Objectives.english: Defeat Ellia Ravenmane atop the Pedestal of Hope.

Description.text: 你的“死敌”艾黎亚·鸦鬃又回来了。她要求在希冀台的顶层跟你碰面。$b$b你要明白，$n……她做出了一些可怕的事，她已经变了。到了希冀台后，你可以自己亲眼去看看。$b$b祝你好运，$n。
