Description.english: Ellia Ravenmane, your rival, has returned. She demands that you meet her atop the Pedestal of Hope.$b$bYou need to understand, $n... something horrible has happened to her. She has changed. You will see for yourself when you arrive at the pedestal.$b$bGood luck, $n.

CompletionLog.text: 回卡桑琅丛林的赤精栖木找塞隆尼斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Champion of Chi-Ji
identity.objectives: Defeat a Champion of Chi-Ji.
identity.description: While you will always hold a place of honor among our order, you are still welcome to participate in our duels.$b$bOne of our current champions awaits you in the Dome Balrissa. I know that they would be honored to duel with you.

Objectives.text: 擊敗赤吉的高徒。
Objectives.english: Defeat a Champion of Chi-Ji.

Description.text: 儘管你在我們這裡永遠佔有榮耀的一席之地，我們仍歡迎你參與我們的決鬥。$b$b我們的一位現任冠軍正在巴爾里莎圓頂等你。若你願意與他們決鬥，將是他們的榮幸。
Description.english: While you will always hold a place of honor among our order, you are still welcome to participate in our duels.$b$bOne of our current champions awaits you in the Dome Balrissa. I know that they would be honored to duel with you.

CompletionLog.text: 到喀撒朗蠻荒的赤吉搖籃找瑟隆諾斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Regaining Honor
identity.objectives: Retrieve Zhen's Banner.
identity.description: $n, the yaungol warchief, Humongous, killed Shado-Master Zhen. He has his banner.$B$BYou have to kill Humongous and regain Zhen's honor! If you don't, I will.

Objectives.text: 夺回陈大师的旗帜。
Objectives.english: Retrieve Zhen's Banner.

Description.text: $n，野牛人的酋长胡墨戈斯杀害了影踪派陈大师，那个杂种还拿走了陈大师的旗帜。$B$B你必须杀了胡墨戈斯，夺回陈的荣耀！你要是不去，我去！
Description.english: $n, the yaungol warchief, Humongous, killed Shado-Master Zhen. He has his banner.$B$BYou have to kill Humongous and regain Zhen's honor! If you don't, I will.

CompletionLog.text: 去昆莱山的冬花关找悟道者布雷克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Wu Kao Blake  at the Gate of Winter's Blossom in Kun-Lai Summit.

identity.title: Profiting off of the Past
identity.objectives: Collect 11 more Mogu Relics.
identity.description: <A relic drops off of the statue. Hmm, these could prove to be valuable to the right person.>$B$B<There's a collector on the outskirts of the ruins. Perhaps he'd be interested in purchasing them from you?>

Objectives.text: 再收集11件魔古遗物。
Objectives.english: Collect 11 more Mogu Relics.

Description.text: <雕像上掉下一件遗物。嗯，这些东西在识货的人眼里一定价值连城。>$B$B<废墟外面就有一个收购者。可能他会愿意从你手上买下这些东西呢！>
Description.english: <A relic drops off of the statue. Hmm, these could prove to be valuable to the right person.>$B$B<There's a collector on the outskirts of the ruins. Perhaps he'd be interested in purchasing them from you?>

CompletionLog.text: 去昆莱山的魔古岬和宝剑谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Bao Jian at Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit

identity.title: The Healing of Shen-zin Su
identity.objectives: Rescue and defend healers until Shen-zin Su's wound is healed.
identity.description: This is what comes of such recklessness. How could he think this was even a possibility?$B$BNevermind, there's no time for that now. We need to act to save Shen-zin Su.$B$BFind any healers you can! Rescue them, relieve them - whatever you need to do to get them over here healing the wound.$B$BKeep the healers safe at all costs!

Objectives.text: 营救并保护治疗者，直至神真子的伤口愈合。
Objectives.english: Rescue and defend healers until Shen-zin Su's wound is healed.

Description.text: 这简直是鲁莽无谋。这怎么可能会成功呢？他到底怎么想的？$B$B算了，现在没时间了。我们必须马上行动，拯救神真子。$B$B快去把你能找到的所有治疗者都叫来！营救他们、保护他们……用尽一切办法把他们带到这儿来，治愈这个伤口。$B$B一定要不惜任何代价保证治疗者的安全。
Description.english: This is what comes of such recklessness. How could he think this was even a possibility?$B$BNevermind, there's no time for that now. We need to act to save Shen-zin Su.$B$BFind any healers you can! Rescue them, relieve them - whatever you need to do to get them over here healing the wound.$B$BKeep the healers safe at all costs!

CompletionLog.text: 和天火号坠落地的艾莎·云歌交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Aysa Cloudsinger at the Skyfire Crash-Site.

identity.title: A New Fate
identity.objectives: Return to the Temple of Five Dawns. A cart is waiting near the Skyfire Crash-Site to take you there.
identity.description: $n, I'm thankful the plan worked, but just barely. We would be sinking to the bottom of the ocean with all of Shen-zin Su if you hadn't been here. I don't think I can ever forgive Ji for this kind of recklessness.$B$BThere will be plenty of time for reflection, but for now, we need to return to the Temple of Five Dawns. We need to let them know that Shen-zin Su has been saved, and we need to sort out the fates of these new allies.

Objectives.text: 返回五晨寺。你可以搭乘天火号坠落地旁的牛车去那里。
Objectives.english: Return to the Temple of Five Dawns. A cart is waiting near the Skyfire Crash-Site to take you there.

Description.text: $n，幸好计划成功了，我们冒了极大的风险。若不是有你相助，恐怕我们都已经和神真子一起葬身海底了。我永远不会原谅季的鲁莽。$B$B以后我们会好好反省这件事，但现在我们必须返回五晨寺。我们要让大家知道神真子已经得救了，还必须决定这些新盟友的命运。
Description.english: $n, I'm thankful the plan worked, but just barely. We would be sinking to the bottom of the ocean with all of Shen-zin Su if you hadn't been here. I don't think I can ever forgive Ji for this kind of recklessness.$B$BThere will be plenty of time for reflection, but for now, we need to return to the Temple of Five Dawns. We need to let them know that Shen-zin Su has been saved, and we need to sort out the fates of these new allies.

identity.title: Round 1: Brewmaster Chani
identity.objectives: Defeat Brewmaster Chani.
identity.description: Welcome, Challenger, to my tournament of champions! Today we test the strengths of Pandaria's most dedicated heroes.$b$bYour first opponent awaits you under the eastern gazebo. Defeat her, and you may proceed to the next round.$b$bFight with strength, fight with honor.

Objectives.text: 打败酒仙倩妮。
Objectives.english: Defeat Brewmaster Chani.

Description.text: 欢迎参加勇者比武大会，挑战者！今天我们要看看潘达利亚的英雄们到底有多厉害。$b$b你的第一个对手正在东边的凉亭下等着你呢。打败她，你就能晋级下一轮。$b$b为了力量而战！为了荣誉而战！
Description.english: Welcome, Challenger, to my tournament of champions! Today we test the strengths of Pandaria's most dedicated heroes.$b$bYour first opponent awaits you under the eastern gazebo. Defeat her, and you may proceed to the next round.$b$bFight with strength, fight with honor.

identity.title: Round 2: Clever Ashyo & Ken-Ken
identity.objectives: Defeat Clever Ashyo and Ken-Ken.
identity.description: You may know your next challengers. They were arguing fiercely when they arrived, so I have charged them with fighting side by side.$b$bThis will teach them the strength of friendship, and possibly entertain me in the process.$b$bGo to the north eastern arena and face this jinyu and hozen.$b$bDo not be gentle, they need to learn to work together.

Title.text: 第2回合：聪明的阿西约和肯肯

Objectives.text: 击败聪明的阿西约和肯肯。
Objectives.english: Defeat Clever Ashyo and Ken-Ken.

Description.text: 你可能已经知道你接下来的对手是谁了。他们刚来的时候争执不休，所以我让他们俩搭档。$b$b一来让他们了解友谊的力量，二来也是给我找点乐子。$b$b到北边的东竞技场去，打败锦鱼人和猢狲。$b$b别对他们手下留情，得教他们学会并肩作战。
Description.english: You may know your next challengers. They were arguing fiercely when they arrived, so I have charged them with fighting side by side.$b$bThis will teach them the strength of friendship, and possibly entertain me in the process.$b$bGo to the north eastern arena and face this jinyu and hozen.$b$bDo not be gentle, they need to learn to work together.

identity.title: Round 3: The Wrestler
identity.objectives: Defeat The Wrestler.
identity.description: Your next challenger is a favorite of mine. He draws strength from raw force and determination.$b$bPlus he has a mask.$b$bFace him in the western arena when you are ready, and good luck.

Objectives.text: 打败摔跤手。
Objectives.english: Defeat The Wrestler.

Description.text: 你的下一位对手是我最钟爱的。他的力量来自与生俱来的蛮力和他果断的性格。$b$b而且，他还戴着一个面具。$b$b你准备好了就去西部竞技场会会他吧，祝你好运。
Description.english: Your next challenger is a favorite of mine. He draws strength from raw force and determination.$b$bPlus he has a mask.$b$bFace him in the western arena when you are ready, and good luck.

identity.title: Round 4: The P.U.G.
identity.objectives: Defeat Hackiss, Healiss and Tankiss.
identity.description: And now the final round. I have selected three challengers for you to face. This may seem unfair... to a weakling. You are not a weakling, correct?$b$bGo to the main temple, stand in the grand arena, and face these three challengers. Prove you are stronger than their combined power!$b$bGood luck, Challenger!

Objectives.text: 击败哈吉斯、希利斯和坦齐斯。
Objectives.english: Defeat Hackiss, Healiss and Tankiss.

Description.text: 现在是决胜局了！我为你挑选了三个对手。这对弱者而言是不太公平，但是你并不是弱者，不是吗？$b$b快去大殿，站上大竞技场，打败这三个对手吧。向我们证明你比他们三个加起来还要强！$b$b祝你好运，挑战者！
Description.english: And now the final round. I have selected three challengers for you to face. This may seem unfair... to a weakling. You are not a weakling, correct?$b$bGo to the main temple, stand in the grand arena, and face these three challengers. Prove you are stronger than their combined power!$b$bGood luck, Challenger!

identity.title: Greenstone Village
identity.objectives: Rescue all the villagers.
identity.description: Please help!$B$BWe paid some adventurers to run off all the elemental spirits and now they're back for revenge!

Objectives.text: 营救所有村民。
Objectives.english: Rescue all the villagers.

Description.text: 请救救我们。$B$B我们出钱聘请了一些冒险者帮我们赶走了元素之灵，现在他们竟回来报仇了！
Description.english: Please help!$B$BWe paid some adventurers to run off all the elemental spirits and now they're back for revenge!

identity.title: Hui's Vengeance
identity.objectives: Defeat Vengeful Hui.
identity.description: I am ashamed to ask, but for Greenstone's sake... might we now trouble you to face Vengeful Hui on our behalf...?

Objectives.text: 打败仇灰。
Objectives.english: Defeat Vengeful Hui.

Description.text: 虽然有点难以启齿，但为了绿石村……可以麻烦你为我们去对付仇灰吗……？
Description.english: I am ashamed to ask, but for Greenstone's sake... might we now trouble you to face Vengeful Hui on our behalf...?

identity.title: The Unending Siege
identity.objectives: Defeat 12 Sra'thik attackers at Niuzao Temple.
identity.description: The mantid continue to attack us. Their numbers ebb and flow, but they do not stop.$b$bIt is no matter. The yak is stamina embodied. We will not bend to them.  We will defend his home forever.$b$bWill you help us?

Objectives.text: 在砮皂寺击败12名瑟拉提克攻击者。
Objectives.english: Defeat 12 Sra'thik attackers at Niuzao Temple.

Description.text: 螳螂妖继续对我们发起进攻。他们的数量时多时少，但却没有停手的意思。$b$b无所谓。牦牛的耐力无穷无尽。我们不可能屈服。我们誓要保卫他的家园。$b$b你能帮我们吗？
Description.english: The mantid continue to attack us. Their numbers ebb and flow, but they do not stop.$b$bIt is no matter. The yak is stamina embodied. We will not bend to them.  We will defend his home forever.$b$bWill you help us?

identity.title: Fallen Sentinels
identity.objectives: Heal 8 Wounded Niuzao Sentinels above 50% health. You may use the Yak's Milk Flasks or your own healing spells and abilities.
identity.description: Our sentinels can fight for days on end, but even they have their limits. Since the mantid swarm began, too many of them have pushed themselves beyond their abilities.$b$bPlease, aid them in whatever way you can. If you are unable to heal them yourself, you may give them some of this. A mouthful of nutritious yak's milk will give them the strength they need.

Objectives.text: 治疗8个受伤的砮皂戒卫，让他们恢复50%以上的生命力。你可以使用牦牛乳膏或自己的魔法和能力。
Objectives.english: Heal 8 Wounded Niuzao Sentinels above 50% health. You may use the Yak's Milk Flasks or your own healing spells and abilities.

Description.text: 我们的戒卫能够连续战斗数天，但即使这样，他们的体力也有极限。由于螳螂妖大兵压境，许多戒卫早已体力不支。$b$b请尽你所能去帮帮他们吧。如果你没办法亲自治疗他们，可以给他们补充点这个。喝一口营养丰富的牦牛奶可以让他们恢复一些体力。
Description.english: Our sentinels can fight for days on end, but even they have their limits. Since the mantid swarm began, too many of them have pushed themselves beyond their abilities.$b$bPlease, aid them in whatever way you can. If you are unable to heal them yourself, you may give them some of this. A mouthful of nutritious yak's milk will give them the strength they need.

identity.title: A Blade is a Blade
identity.objectives: Obtain 10 Sra'thik Weapons.
identity.description: This is no time to hold to tradition. Our masons' calloused hands bleed and tremble. Our blacksmiths cannot forge weapons as quickly as our sentinels can break them.$b$bIt is time to fight smart.$b$bMany of the mantid come bearing weapons, and when they die, they simply leave them on the battlefield. It would be a shame to see them go to waste.

Objectives.text: 缴获10件瑟拉提克武器。
Objectives.english: Obtain 10 Sra'thik Weapons.

Description.text: 现在没时间墨守陈规了。石匠粗糙的双手已磨出血来，颤抖不已。铁匠铸造武器的速度还赶不上哨兵折断它们的速度。$b$b现在要用脑子去战斗。$b$b许多螳螂妖带着武器过来，当它们死了后，武器就草草地扔在战场上。白白浪费掉这些武器也太说不过去了。
Description.english: This is no time to hold to tradition. Our masons' calloused hands bleed and tremble. Our blacksmiths cannot forge weapons as quickly as our sentinels can break them.$b$bIt is time to fight smart.$b$bMany of the mantid come bearing weapons, and when they die, they simply leave them on the battlefield. It would be a shame to see them go to waste.

identity.title: Paying Tribute
identity.objectives: Obtain 6 stores of Niuzao Food. Your Niuzao Strongarm will carry the food for you.
identity.description: Our patron Niuzao is a mountain on wheels... very difficult to move, even more difficult to stop. My point: once we get him moving, the mantid will have their arms full trying to slow him down.$b$bThe easiest way to get him moving is to put food in front of him. Luckily for us, food in our temple is plentiful... even in wartime.$b$bI will send one of my strongarms with you, to shoulder the load.

Objectives.text: 获得6份砮皂食品存粮。你的砮皂勇夫会帮你运送食品。
Objectives.english: Obtain 6 stores of Niuzao Food. Your Niuzao Strongarm will carry the food for you.

Description.text: 我们的老主顾砮皂就像是座流动的大山……动起来难，停下来就更难了。我认为：一旦我们让他动起来，螳螂妖肯定会想方设法地阻挠他前进。$b$b让他动起来最简单的办法就是把食物摆在他面前。我们很幸运，即便在打仗时寺院里面也食物充足。$b$b我会派一位勇夫与你同行，帮你扛些重物。
Description.english: Our patron Niuzao is a mountain on wheels... very difficult to move, even more difficult to stop. My point: once we get him moving, the mantid will have their arms full trying to slow him down.$b$bThe easiest way to get him moving is to put food in front of him. Luckily for us, food in our temple is plentiful... even in wartime.$b$bI will send one of my strongarms with you, to shoulder the load.

identity.title: The Siege Swells
identity.objectives: Defeat 25 Sra'thik attackers at Niuzao Temple.
identity.description: Today's mantid swarm is among the worst I've seen. We are lucky to have Niuzao join us in battle.$b$bHelp him, $c. Return to the courtyard, and join in the defense of our temple.

Objectives.text: 在砮皂寺击败25名瑟拉提克攻击者。
Objectives.english: Defeat 25 Sra'thik attackers at Niuzao Temple.

Description.text: 今天的螳螂妖部队是我见到过的最凶残的一支。幸好有砮皂跟我们并肩战斗。$b$b帮他一把，$c。回到庭院，加入到寺院的保卫战中。
Description.english: Today's mantid swarm is among the worst I've seen. We are lucky to have Niuzao join us in battle.$b$bHelp him, $c. Return to the courtyard, and join in the defense of our temple.

identity.title: The Overwhelming Swarm
identity.objectives: Defeat 4 Sra'thik Kunchong.
identity.description: I command the sentinels of Niuzao. Every defender out there can hold his own against the mantid swarm.$b$bThe kunchong, however, are something different.$b$bThey are massive, violent, and without a question the biggest threat to my sentinels' lives. Only Niuzao stands a chance against them. Niuzao... and perhaps you.

Objectives.text: 击败4只瑟拉提克恐虫。
Objectives.english: Defeat 4 Sra'thik Kunchong.

Description.text: 由我来统率砮皂哨兵。城外的每一名守卫都能坚守岗位，抵御螳螂妖部队。$b$b但恐虫要另当别论了。$b$b它们数量众多，凶残恶毒，毫无疑问会对哨兵的安全构成最大的威胁。仅仅砮皂有机会战胜它们。砮皂……也许你也能。
Description.english: I command the sentinels of Niuzao. Every defender out there can hold his own against the mantid swarm.$b$bThe kunchong, however, are something different.$b$bThey are massive, violent, and without a question the biggest threat to my sentinels' lives. Only Niuzao stands a chance against them. Niuzao... and perhaps you.

identity.title: In Battle's Shadow
identity.objectives: Throw 10 Loose Stones up to Niuzao Stonemasons.
identity.description: Niuzao's appearance on the battlefield is a blessing... in more ways than one.$b$bWith the distraction that he's caused, our stonemasons have seized the opportunity to build up our crumbling walls. They could use your help.$b$bToss any loose bricks you find up their way. And hurry! Niuzao will not rampage forever.

Objectives.text: 将10块松动的石头扔给砮皂石匠。
Objectives.english: Throw 10 Loose Stones up to Niuzao Stonemasons.

Description.text: 砮皂能够参战真是万幸……无论是他的战斗力还是其他方面。$b$b由于他吸引了敌人的注意力，我们的石匠才有机会重建破碎的院墙。他们需要你的帮助。$b$b把你发现的任何松动的砖块都扔给石匠。动作要快！砮皂的冲杀不可能持续太久。
Description.english: Niuzao's appearance on the battlefield is a blessing... in more ways than one.$b$bWith the distraction that he's caused, our stonemasons have seized the opportunity to build up our crumbling walls. They could use your help.$b$bToss any loose bricks you find up their way. And hurry! Niuzao will not rampage forever.

identity.title: The Big Guns
identity.objectives: Destroy 3 Sra'thik War Wagons.
identity.description: The mantid now surround the Temple with their infernal war wagons. The sooner we are rid of those things, the better. You could destroy them with your own weapons and spells, but this will work much faster.$b$b<Ogo hands you a few small casks of hastily-packed explosives.>$b$bBeware of retaliation from mantid that remain be inside the war wagon when it explodes. In fact, I'd stay as far away from those things as possible.

Objectives.text: 破坏3辆瑟拉提克战车。
Objectives.english: Destroy 3 Sra'thik War Wagons.

Description.text: 螳螂妖正在用它们的地狱战车包围寺院，越快扫除这些威胁就对我们越有利。你可以使用自己的武器和魔法去摧毁它们，不过用这个应该更有效。$b$b<傲古递给你几桶简陋包装的炸药。>$b$b当心战车爆炸后，里面的螳螂妖会出来跟你拼命。事实上，我宁愿离那些东西越远越好。
Description.english: The mantid now surround the Temple with their infernal war wagons. The sooner we are rid of those things, the better. You could destroy them with your own weapons and spells, but this will work much faster.$b$b<Ogo hands you a few small casks of hastily-packed explosives.>$b$bBeware of retaliation from mantid that remain be inside the war wagon when it explodes. In fact, I'd stay as far away from those things as possible.

identity.title: Animal Control
identity.objectives: Kill Adarogg and Slagmaw.
identity.description: The chasm is overrun with flame hounds and lava worms, and they will be entrenched indefinitely with such a large supply of trogg flesh for food.$b$bThis infestation needs to be taken care of now, before they endanger the city. You look like you can handle yourself, $n.$b$bI want you to clear a path through the beasts and make certain to take out the largest threats, Adjules and Magnaw.

Objectives.text: 杀死阿达罗格和焰喉。
Objectives.english: Kill Adarogg and Slagmaw.

Description.text: 这条裂谷里到处都是烈焰猎犬和熔岩虫，他们依靠庞大的穴居人种群的肉为食维持着他们无限的繁衍生息。$b$b这种情况必须在它们破坏城市之前得到处理。你看起来可以独自解决这个问题，$n。$b$b我要你在那群野兽中杀出一条路来，而且务必要解决掉最大的麻烦——阿德杰里斯和焰喉。
Description.english: The chasm is overrun with flame hounds and lava worms, and they will be entrenched indefinitely with such a large supply of trogg flesh for food.$b$bThis infestation needs to be taken care of now, before they endanger the city. You look like you can handle yourself, $n.$b$bI want you to clear a path through the beasts and make certain to take out the largest threats, Adjules and Magnaw.

CompletionLog.text: 回怒焰裂谷里找指挥官巴格兰。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Commander Bagran inside Ragefire Chasm.

identity.title: The Alliance Way
identity.objectives: Walk with King Varian Wrynn.
identity.description: I only recently received word that some of your kind might be coming our way. I'd be glad to call you an ally, if you're willing to join our cause.$b$bWalk with me, $n.

Objectives.text: 跟着瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王。
Objectives.english: Walk with King Varian Wrynn.

Description.text: 我对你们一族知之甚少，除了有人告诉过我，说是你们中有一些人会来到我们这边。如果你们愿意加入我们的阵线，那么我也会很高兴地接纳你们作为盟友。$b$b$n，你跟我过来。
Description.english: I only recently received word that some of your kind might be coming our way. I'd be glad to call you an ally, if you're willing to join our cause.$b$bWalk with me, $n.

identity.title: An Old Pit Fighter
identity.objectives: Spar with King Varian Wrynn.
identity.description: I need to know if you can fight. There may come a time where you will be called upon for military matters, and I need to know that you can protect my kingdom.$b$bI've heard stories about pandaren fighting techniques, but I've never seen them in person.$b$bShall we?

Objectives.text: 与瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王过招。
Objectives.english: Spar with King Varian Wrynn.

Description.text: 我需要知道你是否是个合格的战士。今后也许你会受我召唤奔赴沙场，我想知道你是否有能力保护我的王国。$b$b我早已耳闻过熊猫人的“武术”技巧，却未得亲眼一见。$b$b你准备好了吗？
Description.english: I need to know if you can fight. There may come a time where you will be called upon for military matters, and I need to know that you can protect my kingdom.$b$bI've heard stories about pandaren fighting techniques, but I've never seen them in person.$b$bShall we?

CompletionLog.text: 去找暴风要塞中的瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王。
CompletionLog.english: Return to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep.

identity.title: Animal Control
identity.objectives: Kill Adarogg and Slagmaw.
identity.description: I'm glad you're here, $n. The horde is amassing an army and I'm not going to wait to find out why.$b$bWe need to strike fast and take down some of the larger beasts they have down here.$b$bI want you to head in there and take care of Adarogg and Slagmaw before the horde can use them as weapons against us.

Objectives.text: 杀死阿达罗格和焰喉。
Objectives.english: Kill Adarogg and Slagmaw.

Description.text: 我很高兴你能来，$n。部落正在集结军队，而我也不打算等查明原委后再行动。$b$b我们要先发制人，去下面干掉几个他们的大型野兽。$b$b我希望你能在部落将阿达罗格和焰喉用作对抗我们的武器之前，把这两个家伙先处理掉。
Description.english: I'm glad you're here, $n. The horde is amassing an army and I'm not going to wait to find out why.$b$bWe need to strike fast and take down some of the larger beasts they have down here.$b$bI want you to head in there and take care of Adarogg and Slagmaw before the horde can use them as weapons against us.

CompletionLog.text: 回怒焰裂谷内找军情七处指挥官德尔肯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to SI:7 Field Commander Dirken inside Ragefire Chasm.

identity.title: Hellscream's Gift
identity.objectives: Complete Garrosh's test by defeating Oggax, Gadoon, and Frozengore.
identity.description: I need to know if you can fight... that you can kill, and live. Eventually, each of you will be called upon for war, and I need to know that you can be counted on.$b$bI mentioned a gift earlier. It lies here, within the Ring of Valor. Step into the arena, right through this door behind me. I will test your skills.

Objectives.text: 打败欧戈斯、加杜恩及冻血以完成加尔鲁什的测验
Objectives.english: Complete Garrosh's test by defeating Oggax, Gadoon, and Frozengore.

Description.text: 我得知道你是否能够战斗……能够杀戮，并且活下来。也许有一天我会召唤你参战，我得确认你是否能被委以重任。$b$b如我之前说过的，我要赐给你一件礼物。而它就在这鲜血之环里。穿过我身后的门，到竞技场上去，我要试试你的功夫。
Description.english: I need to know if you can fight... that you can kill, and live. Eventually, each of you will be called upon for war, and I need to know that you can be counted on.$b$bI mentioned a gift earlier. It lies here, within the Ring of Valor. Step into the arena, right through this door behind me. I will test your skills.

identity.title: The Lorewalkers
identity.objectives: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
identity.description: Dear $p,$b$bWe have uncovered something tremendous in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. A great repository of books, scrolls, and lore that has remained untouched since the days of the mogu empire.$b$bPlease, join us at your earliest convenience. You can find this Seat of Knowledge by traveling to the infamous Mogu'shan Vaults, and then flying to the landing just above the entrance.$b$bI look forward to your arrival!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Objectives.text: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座向游学者周卓汇报。
CompletionLog.english: Report to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: The Humble Grummle
identity.objectives: Bring The Humble Grummle to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
identity.description: Dear $p,$b$bWe have received your research on the grummles and believe we have a solid idea of their etimology and history.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Objectives.text: 将《谦卑的土地精》带给闻道之座的游学者周卓。
Objectives.english: Bring The Humble Grummle to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Kowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Enemies Below
identity.objectives: Speak with Stone Guard Kurjack.
identity.description: Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm has been taken by the Searing Blade. $n, we cannot allow this to pass unpunished, lest they next set their sights on Thunder Bluff.$B$BGo speak with Stone Guard Kurjack just inside the Chasm. Help him in any way you can, for our fates are intertwined.

Objectives.text: 跟石头守卫库尔加克谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Stone Guard Kurjack.

Description.text: 奥格瑞玛的怒焰裂谷已经被燃刃氏族占领了，$n，我们不能听之任之，让他们接着觊觎雷霆崖。$B$B去跟裂谷里的石头守卫库尔加克谈一谈。尽你所能帮助他，毕竟雷霆崖与奥格瑞玛唇齿相依。
Description.english: Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm has been taken by the Searing Blade. $n, we cannot allow this to pass unpunished, lest they next set their sights on Thunder Bluff.$B$BGo speak with Stone Guard Kurjack just inside the Chasm. Help him in any way you can, for our fates are intertwined.

identity.title: Riding the Storm
identity.objectives: Use the Bronze Claws to mount 8 Shan'ze Cloudrunners. Attack them to free them of their corruption.
identity.description: Shan Bu, the leader of the Shan'ze, is performing some kind of dark ritual at the summit of the island to the northwest.$B$BWe believe that the subjugated Shan'ze Cloudrunners are powering the spell. How, we still do not know.$B$BWe believe that the Shan'ze Cloudrunners can still be saved from the corruption that taints them.$B$BTake these bronze claws. Use them to mount the back of a Shan'ze Cloudrunner.$B$BAttack them. Beat some sense back into their heads!

Objectives.text: 利用青铜爪骑在8只山泽穿云翔龙的身上。攻击它们使其恢复心智。
Objectives.english: Use the Bronze Claws to mount 8 Shan'ze Cloudrunners. Attack them to free them of their corruption.

Description.text: 山泽部族的首领山怖，正在西北面岛屿的山顶上进行某种黑暗仪式。$B$B我们相信受他摆布的山泽穿云翔龙正在给这种魔法注入能量。至于如何注入能量，我们还不太清楚。$B$B但我们肯定山泽穿云翔龙还有希望摆脱控制它们思想的魔咒。$B$B带上这些青铜爪。利用这些青铜爪骑在山泽穿云翔龙的背上。$B$B再给它们迎头痛击。将它们的脑袋打清醒点！
Description.english: Shan Bu, the leader of the Shan'ze, is performing some kind of dark ritual at the summit of the island to the northwest.$B$BWe believe that the subjugated Shan'ze Cloudrunners are powering the spell. How, we still do not know.$B$BWe believe that the Shan'ze Cloudrunners can still be saved from the corruption that taints them.$B$BTake these bronze claws. Use them to mount the back of a Shan'ze Cloudrunner.$B$BAttack them. Beat some sense back into their heads!

identity.title: Founding of the Order of the Cloud Serpent
identity.objectives: Bring Founding of the Order of the Cloud Serpent to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
identity.description: Dear $p,$b$bWe have a wonderful story assembled from the lore you recovered on the Order of the Cloud Serpent.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Title.english: Founding of the Order of the Cloud Serpent

Objectives.text: 将《云端翔龙骑士团的建立》带给闻道之座的游学者周卓。
Objectives.english: Bring Founding of the Order of the Cloud Serpent to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Kowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Klaxx Attack
identity.objectives: Bring Klaxx Attack to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
identity.description: Dear $p,$b$bWe have all been quite disturbed by your findings regarding the Klaxxi.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Objectives.text: 将《卡拉克西之战》带给闻道之座的游学者周卓。
Objectives.english: Bring Klaxx Attack to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Kowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Legends of the Brewfathers
identity.objectives: Bring Legends of the Brewfathers to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
identity.description: Dear $p,$b$bYour research in to the Brewfathers has proven most... thirstifying.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Objectives.text: 将《酒中仙传奇》带给闻道之座的游学者周卓。
Objectives.english: Bring Legends of the Brewfathers to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Kowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: The Deadtalker Cipher
identity.objectives: Collect a Scroll of Spiritbinding Rites from the yaungol at Deadtalker's Plateau.
identity.description:
We need to understand what went wrong with the Deadtalkers. 

For so many years, the Deadtalkers were simply responsible for maintaining the burial grounds and holding funerals for fallen warriors.

From a recent raid, we've recovered a tablet from the grounds that is clearly written using a cipher, but it isn't one we've encountered before. If you can gather a ciphered scroll from one of the Deadtalkers, we can begin to put together the cypher and understand what's happened.

Objectives.text: 从死语者高地的野牛人那里收集缚魂仪式卷轴。
Objectives.english: Collect a Scroll of Spiritbinding Rites from the yaungol at Deadtalker's Plateau.

Description.text:
我们得搞清楚死语者出了什么问题。

多年以来，死语者只是负责维护陵园，以及为死去的战士举行葬礼。

在最近一次行动中，我们发现了一块石板。上面显然用暗语写了些东西，但之前我们从未接触过类似东西。如果你能从死语者身上搞到一个暗语卷轴，我们就可以对这些暗语进行解码工作，看看到底发生了什么事。
Description.english:
We need to understand what went wrong with the Deadtalkers. 

For so many years, the Deadtalkers were simply responsible for maintaining the burial grounds and holding funerals for fallen warriors.

From a recent raid, we've recovered a tablet from the grounds that is clearly written using a cipher, but it isn't one we've encountered before. If you can gather a ciphered scroll from one of the Deadtalkers, we can begin to put together the cypher and understand what's happened.

identity.title: The Challenger's Ring: Chao the Voice
identity.objectives: Challenge Chao the Voice, and then defeat her in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
identity.description:
It looks like you're quite the fighter, $p.

Chao heard about it, and she's been talking about how she'd kick your...

Well, let's just say I think you should challenge her and try to get her respect.

Title.text: 挑战者之环：魔音贯耳超风
Title.english: The Challenger's Ring: Chao the Voice

Objectives.text: 挑战魔音贯耳超风，然后在螳螂高原的影踪卫戍营中打败她。
Objectives.english: Challenge Chao the Voice, and then defeat her in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

identity.title: The Challenger's Ring: Lao-Chin the Iron Belly
identity.objectives: Challenge Lao-Chen the Iron Belly and then defeat him in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
identity.description:
Lao-Chin seems to have his head in the clouds... or, rather, in his beer.

After all of his recent battles, he seems completely obsessed with with trying to develop the perfect brew for fighting. 

That's well and good, but we need him to actually do some fighting!

You should go challenge him, see if you can snap him out of his rut. 

If you beat him, he'll probably want to go out and help fight just to try to one-up you!

Title.english: The Challenger's Ring: Lao-Chin the Iron Belly

Objectives.text: 挑战铁腹老陈，然后在螳螂高原的影踪卫戍营中打败他。
Objectives.english: Challenge Lao-Chen the Iron Belly and then defeat him in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

Description.text:
老陈最近好像有点不知所谓……或者说是被啤酒冲昏了头脑。

经过最近几次战斗之后，他就好像着了魔一样，整天研究着如何酿出一种战斗美酒。

那也没什么大不了，但我们需要他去战斗！

你应该去挑战他一下，看能不能把他打醒。

如果你能打败他，他就可能会为了胜过你而重新投入战斗！
Description.english:
Lao-Chin seems to have his head in the clouds... or, rather, in his beer.

After all of his recent battles, he seems completely obsessed with with trying to develop the perfect brew for fighting. 

That's well and good, but we need him to actually do some fighting!

You should go challenge him, see if you can snap him out of his rut. 

If you beat him, he'll probably want to go out and help fight just to try to one-up you!

identity.title: Whitepetal Lake
identity.objectives: Speak to He Softfoot at Whitepetal Lake.
identity.description: Reports suggest that things are quiet at Whitepetal Lake today, but I've dispatched Ren Firetongue and He Softfoot to make sure it stays they way.$B$BIf you want to aid the effort further, head to the west to the lake, meet up with He, and help him keep things secure from any hostile threats.

Objectives.text: 和琼花湖的禾·软足谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to He Softfoot at Whitepetal Lake.

Description.text: 报告显示琼花湖今天异常平静，但我还是派了任·火舌与禾·软足去确认一下。$B$B如果你想助一臂之力的话，那就去琼花湖的西边跟禾碰面，帮助他解决任何可能的威胁，确保那里的安全。
Description.english: Reports suggest that things are quiet at Whitepetal Lake today, but I've dispatched Ren Firetongue and He Softfoot to make sure it stays they way.$B$BIf you want to aid the effort further, head to the west to the lake, meet up with He, and help him keep things secure from any hostile threats.

identity.title: The Arts of a Monk
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Once you've learned it, use it twice at a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown.
identity.description: When you fight, you grow in skill. As you grow in skill, you will begin to figure out new moves. Go, explore, learn, and show me what you figure out.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。学成之后，在新工匠镇的训练假人身上使用两次。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Once you've learned it, use it twice at a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown.

Description.text: 通过战斗，你的技能将有所提高。随着技能的提高，你将开始领悟出新的招式。去吧，去探险，去学习，然后向我展示你学到了什么。
Description.english: When you fight, you grow in skill. As you grow in skill, you will begin to figure out new moves. Go, explore, learn, and show me what you figure out.

CompletionLog.text: 去新工匠镇找侏儒之友西希。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Xi, Friend of the Small in New Tinkertown.

identity.title: Calligraphed Letter
identity.objectives: Read the Calligraphed Letter and speak to Bao in Northshire Abbey.
identity.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from dealing with the Blackrock spies, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Bao, a pandaren who is visiting us from a faraway land. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

Objectives.text: 阅读手写书信，然后和北郡修道院的阿宝谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Read the Calligraphed Letter and speak to Bao in Northshire Abbey.

Description.text: 有人托我在你处理完黑石间谍的事情之后把这个东西交给你，$n。看起来像是一封用阿宝的印章密封的书信，阿宝是从远方来到这里的一个熊猫人。我想在你处理修道院的其他事情之前尽快读一下这封信。
Description.english: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from dealing with the Blackrock spies, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Bao, a pandaren who is visiting us from a faraway land. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

identity.title: Palm of the Tiger
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm, then practice using it on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.
identity.description:
Now that you've had the chance to test your abilities in battle, it's time to explain one more reason why training is so important.$B$BAs you get more experience, you'll be able to do new techniques you never thought of.

Go, get some experience, learn a new skill, and demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级后学习“猛虎掌”，然后在北郡修道院入口南面的训练假人身上进行练习。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm, then practice using it on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.

Description.text:
既然你已有机会在战斗中测试自己的能力，那么是时候向你解释我们如此重视训练的另一个原因了。$B$B随着经验的增长，你将能够学习超出自己想象的新技能。

去吧，再积累一些经验，学习一项新技能，然后找一个训练假人进行练习。
Description.english:
Now that you've had the chance to test your abilities in battle, it's time to explain one more reason why training is so important.$B$BAs you get more experience, you'll be able to do new techniques you never thought of.

Go, get some experience, learn a new skill, and demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

CompletionLog.text: 去北郡修道院武器大厅找阿宝。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Bao in the Hall of Arms at Northshire Abbey.

identity.title: Scribbled Scroll
identity.objectives: Read the Elegant Scroll and speak to Ting, Strong of Stomach in Deathknell.
identity.description: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. The pandaren visitor, Ting, sent it for you. Maybe you monks can read this garbage, but I can't. You should go talk to her. She's in the Inn across the way.

Objectives.text: 阅读精致的卷轴，然后和丧钟镇的铁胆海胃丁绿衫谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Read the Elegant Scroll and speak to Ting, Strong of Stomach in Deathknell.

Description.text: 呃，当你在外面对付那些愚蠢的天灾军团时，我们收到一个寄给你的卷轴，是个叫丁绿衫的熊猫人寄的。或许你们武僧能看懂这种乱七八糟的东西，反正我看不懂。你应该和她谈一谈，她在街对面的旅馆里。
Description.english: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. The pandaren visitor, Ting, sent it for you. Maybe you monks can read this garbage, but I can't. You should go talk to her. She's in the Inn across the way.

identity.title: Tiger Palm
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm, then practice using it on a Training Dummy.
identity.description: As you overcome great challenges in your journey to master struggles both internal and external, you will begin to uncover new abilities hidden inside yourself. Go, now, and develop a mastery of yourself, such that you uncover the Tiger Palm technique. Then, go practice it on a training dummy.

Objectives.text: 等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌，然后在训练假人身上练习运用掌法。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm, then practice using it on a Training Dummy.

Description.text: 在你克服并突破身心内外的桎梏时，你会释放潜藏在体内的新能力。去吧，深入并掌控自我，打开通往猛虎掌绝技的大门。然后去找一个训练假人来练练手。
Description.english: As you overcome great challenges in your journey to master struggles both internal and external, you will begin to uncover new abilities hidden inside yourself. Go, now, and develop a mastery of yourself, such that you uncover the Tiger Palm technique. Then, go practice it on a training dummy.

CompletionLog.text: 回提瑞斯法林地的丧钟镇找铁胆海胃丁绿衫。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Ting, Strong of Stomach at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

identity.title: Elegant Rune
identity.objectives: Read the Elegant Rune and speak to Lo in Coldridge Valley.
identity.description: $n, this rune was given to me to pass on to ye. Take some time to read it when ye have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from our visitor from afar, Lo. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar.

Objectives.text: 阅读精致符文，然后和寒脊山谷的罗谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Read the Elegant Rune and speak to Lo in Coldridge Valley.

Description.text: $n，这些符文先是传给了我，现在又传给了你。有机会的时候要花些时间阅读。我想这些符文应该来自我们远方的客人，罗。请看一下这些符文，然后去安威玛尔找他。
Description.english: $n, this rune was given to me to pass on to ye. Take some time to read it when ye have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from our visitor from afar, Lo. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar.

identity.title: Kick, Punch, It's All in the Mind
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm, then use it on one of the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.
identity.description:
The truth is, you already have the talent and ability to learn what you need to. What I can help you do is show you where to unlock it.

First, you must practice until you begin to understand a new technique. The first technique you learn will be the Tiger Palm. Go, learn more until you have unlocked the potential within yourself, and then practice your new move!

Remember - it's all in the mind!

Title.english: Kick, Punch, It's All in the Mind

Objectives.text: 等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌，然后在安威玛尔入口处的训练假人身上练练手。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm, then use it on one of the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.

Description.text:
事实上，你已经具备了学习新功夫的天赋和能力。我能做的就是帮你找到释放潜能之道。

首先，你必须加紧练习，直到对新功夫有所感悟。你要学习的第一门功夫就是猛虎掌。去吧，直到你释放自身的全部潜能，然后再去练习你的新掌法！

记住——要心无杂念！
Description.english:
The truth is, you already have the talent and ability to learn what you need to. What I can help you do is show you where to unlock it.

First, you must practice until you begin to understand a new technique. The first technique you learn will be the Tiger Palm. Go, learn more until you have unlocked the potential within yourself, and then practice your new move!

Remember - it's all in the mind!

CompletionLog.text: 回安威玛尔找罗。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Lo in Anvilmar.

identity.title: Calligraphed Parchment
identity.objectives: Read the Calligraphed Parchment and speak with Gato in the Valley of Trials.
identity.description: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $n.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from our Pandaren friend, Gato. He visits from afar to grant us the honor of his wisdom, and to teach the ways of the monk. Do not shame your people by failing at his lessons!

Objectives.text: 阅读手写羊皮纸，然后和试炼谷的贾徒谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Read the Calligraphed Parchment and speak with Gato in the Valley of Trials.

Description.text: 呃，你不在的时候，我们收到了一封羊皮纸书信，$n。$B$B有时间的话看一下吧。如果我没有猜错，这封信是我们的熊猫人朋友贾徒寄来的。他云游四方，和我们分享他的智慧，向我们传授武僧的修行之道。要聆听他的教诲，不要让你们的族人蒙羞！
Description.english: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $n.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from our Pandaren friend, Gato. He visits from afar to grant us the honor of his wisdom, and to teach the ways of the monk. Do not shame your people by failing at his lessons!

identity.title: Tiger Palm
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Tiger Palm 2 times.
identity.description:
As you walk the road of your training, you will begin to discover within yourself the power to unlock new techniques. You need not even learn them from me, or another more experienced monk - you will find that they come to you on their own.

For now, you should go and practice the basics. Gather more experience, and develop a new technique - once you have, you can practice it on the dummies nearby to master it.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。选定一个训练假人，然后对其使用2次猛虎掌。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Tiger Palm 2 times.

Description.text:
在你不断训练的过程中，你会逐渐发现自己体内蕴藏的能量，它们足以帮你领悟新技能。你甚至不需要我或其他经验更丰富的武僧来教导你——它们自然而然就会浮现在你心中。

但现在，你还得继续练习基本要领。积累更多经验，开发新的技能——学会后，你可以在附近的假人身上练习并熟练掌握。
Description.english:
As you walk the road of your training, you will begin to discover within yourself the power to unlock new techniques. You need not even learn them from me, or another more experienced monk - you will find that they come to you on their own.

For now, you should go and practice the basics. Gather more experience, and develop a new technique - once you have, you can practice it on the dummies nearby to master it.

identity.title: The Arts of a Monk
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Practice using Tiger Palm against a Tiki Target.
identity.description: As ya get bettah' at fightin', you'll start to find new tings that ya nevah knew you could do.$B$BWanna see? Go, train up some, and learn someting new.$B$B'Den come back and ya can show me.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。在那些蒂基面具假人身上练习一下猛虎掌。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Practice using Tiger Palm against a Tiki Target.

Description.text: 随着在战斗中的表现越来越好，你将开始发现一些你从没想过自己能做到的事情。$B$B想见识一下吗？去吧，多加练习，学习一些新事物。$B$B然后回到这里向我展示。
Description.english: As ya get bettah' at fightin', you'll start to find new tings that ya nevah knew you could do.$B$BWanna see? Go, train up some, and learn someting new.$B$B'Den come back and ya can show me.

CompletionLog.text: 去回音群岛的暗矛训练场找扎布拉克斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Zabrax at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

identity.title: Calligraphed Note
identity.objectives: Read the Calligraphed Note and speak to Shoyu in Camp Narache.
identity.description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $n. I believe she was sent by our Pandaren visitor, Shoyu. You should read it.

Objectives.text: 阅读手写便笺，然后与纳拉其营地的烁雨谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Read the Calligraphed Note and speak to Shoyu in Camp Narache.

Description.text: 刚才有一个信使来找过你，$n。我相信她是熊猫人访客烁雨派来的。你最好赶快看看上面都说了些什么。
Description.english: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $n. I believe she was sent by our Pandaren visitor, Shoyu. You should read it.

identity.title: Tiger Palm
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using it.
identity.description:
You have done well. As you continue along your path, you will grow, learning new techniques that you couldn't have imagined before.

Your first lesson is the power of experience. Go, learn a new ability, and demonstrate it for me.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。在纳拉其营地里找一个训练假人，然后练习使用猛虎掌。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using it.

Description.text:
你做得不错。在你的学艺不断精进之时，你会成长并学到以前从不敢想像的新技能。

你的第一课是经验的力量。去学习新技能，并证明给我看吧。
Description.english:
You have done well. As you continue along your path, you will grow, learning new techniques that you couldn't have imagined before.

Your first lesson is the power of experience. Go, learn a new ability, and demonstrate it for me.

CompletionLog.text: 去找纳拉其营地的烁雨。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Shoyu at Camp Narache.

identity.title: Calligraphed Sigil
identity.objectives: Speak to Laoxi inside Aldrassil in Shadowglen.
identity.description: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our Pandaren visitor, Laoxi. It seems he would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.

Objectives.text: 与幽影谷中奥达希尔里面的劳希谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Laoxi inside Aldrassil in Shadowglen.

Description.text: 熊猫人访客劳希派了一位信使过来，给了我这个魔符。看来他想占用你几分钟时间谈一谈。你先看一下，接着再去他那边。
Description.english: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our Pandaren visitor, Laoxi. It seems he would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.

identity.title: The Art of the Monk
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger's Palm. Look for a Training Dummy and practice using Tiger's Palm.
identity.description: The true secret to the art of the monk is unlocking the knowledge and power hidden inside yourself.$B$BGo, get more experience, and learn a new skill. Then demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。找一个训练假人，在它身上练习使用猛虎掌。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger's Palm. Look for a Training Dummy and practice using Tiger's Palm.

Description.text: 禅道的奥义在于释放隐藏在你身体里的知识与能量。$B$B出发吧，积累经验，去学习新的技能。然后找个训练假人演练一番。
Description.english: The true secret to the art of the monk is unlocking the knowledge and power hidden inside yourself.$B$BGo, get more experience, and learn a new skill. Then demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

CompletionLog.text: 去泰达希尔找劳希。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Laoxi in Teldrassil.

identity.title: Monk Training
identity.objectives: Speak with Pao, the Monk class trainer, inside the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.
identity.description: As you advance within your class, you will want to take advantage of the training that your class trainer can provide you.  For young monks here on Sunstrider Isle, your trainer is Pao, our Pandaren visitor.  Speak with her and see what training she has available for you.$B$BPao - as with all the trainers on Sunstrider Isle - is inside the Sunspire on the lower level.

Objectives.text: 和逐日岛太阳之塔内的武僧职业训练师阿包谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Pao, the Monk class trainer, inside the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.

Description.text: 既然你已经在你所选的职业上有所进步，那么你一定会希望能够获得更多来自职业训练师的指导。我们的熊猫人访客阿包是你的训练师，她负责训练所有在逐日岛一带的年轻武僧。去和她谈一谈吧，看看她能教会你些什么。$B$B阿包和其他逐日岛上的训练师一样，都在太阳之塔的下层。
Description.english: As you advance within your class, you will want to take advantage of the training that your class trainer can provide you.  For young monks here on Sunstrider Isle, your trainer is Pao, our Pandaren visitor.  Speak with her and see what training she has available for you.$B$BPao - as with all the trainers on Sunstrider Isle - is inside the Sunspire on the lower level.

identity.title: Tiger Palm
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy outside the Sunspire and practice using it.
identity.description: Good. You are off to a bright start. This road will be long, and as you become more accomplished, you will begin to discover that you can do things you could never have imagined before.$B$BGo, get more experience, and learn a new technique. Once you have, demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。在太阳之塔外面找一个训练假人，然后练习使用猛虎掌。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy outside the Sunspire and practice using it.

Description.text: 很好，你开了个好头。路漫漫其修远兮，在你建功立业之时，你会发现自己能够做到以前从不敢想的事情。$B$B出发吧，积累经验，去学习新的技能。学完后，去找个训练假人演练一番。
Description.english: Good. You are off to a bright start. This road will be long, and as you become more accomplished, you will begin to discover that you can do things you could never have imagined before.$B$BGo, get more experience, and learn a new technique. Once you have, demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.

CompletionLog.text: 去逐日岛的太阳之塔里找阿包。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Pao in the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.

identity.title: The Tiger Palm
identity.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using it.
identity.description:
I hope your people are all alright... the crash was unbelievably loud and destructive!

<Mojo looks you over, evaluating your potential.>

Yes, you'll do fine. They've said that they need more people to fight, and they don't want me to hurt myself. I'm not afraid, but I don't want to intrude. So, I'll teach you.

As you may have discovered, your experiences in combat will unlock new potential within you. Go, see if you can master a new ability. Show it to me. You'll get the hang of things.

Objectives.text: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。在坠毁点西北侧找一个训练假人，利用它进行练习。
Objectives.english: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using it.

Description.text:
希望你的人安然无恙……坠毁的声音震耳欲聋！

<墨乔仔细打量着你，揣测你的潜力。>

对，你肯定行的。他们说需要更多人手加入战斗，他们不想我伤及自己。我并不怯战，但我也不想冒犯他们。所以，我要教你功夫。

可能你已经发现了，你的战斗经验可以进一步激发你内在的潜力。去吧，看你能否掌握新的技能，证明给我看。你会摸着窍门的。
Description.english:
I hope your people are all alright... the crash was unbelievably loud and destructive!

<Mojo looks you over, evaluating your potential.>

Yes, you'll do fine. They've said that they need more people to fight, and they don't want me to hurt myself. I'm not afraid, but I don't want to intrude. So, I'll teach you.

As you may have discovered, your experiences in combat will unlock new potential within you. Go, see if you can master a new ability. Show it to me. You'll get the hang of things.

CompletionLog.text: 回坠毁点找莫劲·风暴烈酒。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Mojo Stormstout at the Crash Site.

identity.title: The Dread Vos
identity.objectives: Kill 12 Enslaved Amberdiggers or Vos'thik Slavelashers, and release the paragon, Korven the Prime.
identity.description: Another paragon calls to us..$B$BThis time, the emanations grow from The Dread Vos, an ancient lake to the south.$B$BFinding him will not be easy, for the way is guarded by our enemies.$B$BI give you this task. If you succeed, you will live.$B$BIf you fail, I will send another.

Objectives.text: 杀死12个被奴役的琥珀挖掘者或沃斯提克鞭奴者，并释放英杰至尊者柯尔凡。
Objectives.english: Kill 12 Enslaved Amberdiggers or Vos'thik Slavelashers, and release the paragon, Korven the Prime.

Description.text: 又有一个英杰在召唤我们……$B$B这次，信息是来自恐惧沃斯，那是南面的一个远古湖泊。$B$B要找到他可能不太容易，因为那里有我们的敌人在把守。$B$B我要把这个任务交给你。如果你成功了，就可以活下来。$B$B如果失败了，我会派其他人过去。
Description.english: Another paragon calls to us..$B$BThis time, the emanations grow from The Dread Vos, an ancient lake to the south.$B$BFinding him will not be easy, for the way is guarded by our enemies.$B$BI give you this task. If you succeed, you will live.$B$BIf you fail, I will send another.

CompletionLog.text: 去恐惧废土的恐惧·沃斯找至尊者柯尔凡谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Korven the Prime at The Dread Vos in the Dread Wastes.

identity.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
identity.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!
identity.description: I'll tell you what, buddy, this place is a far cry from the rolling plains of Nagrand or the bloodbowl in Zul'Drak, but hey, I go where the gold's at! So welcome to Twi-Hi, pal.$B$BYou're new to this pit, so let me set you straight. I'm the fight promoter and this feisty troll next to me is Wodin, my bodyguard. You're the entertainment. When you wanna fight, let me know and I'll set up the match.$B$BIf you're ready and got a group of friends with you, we can start! What do you say?

Title.text: 杀戮熔炉竞技场：血眼斗士！
Title.english: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!

Objectives.text: 进入杀戮熔炉竞技场，击败胡尔德普！
Objectives.english: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!

Description.text: 我跟你说，伙计，这地方离碧野千里的纳格兰的大草原和血腥残酷的祖达克很远，但是呢，哪里有金币，哪里就有我！那么，欢迎来到暮高，朋友。$B$B你是刚来这座竞技场的，我就跟你简单明了地说吧。我是这里的竞技场组织者，旁边这位活泼的巨魔是我的保镖伍迪。你是这里的主角，当你想要作战的时候，告诉我一声，我就给你安排比赛。$B$B如果你已经准备就绪，还带来了一组伙伴，我们就可以开始了！你觉得呢？
Description.english: I'll tell you what, buddy, this place is a far cry from the rolling plains of Nagrand or the bloodbowl in Zul'Drak, but hey, I go where the gold's at! So welcome to Twi-Hi, pal.$B$BYou're new to this pit, so let me set you straight. I'm the fight promoter and this feisty troll next to me is Wodin, my bodyguard. You're the entertainment. When you wanna fight, let me know and I'll set up the match.$B$BIf you're ready and got a group of friends with you, we can start! What do you say?

CompletionLog.text: 去找暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.

identity.title: The Challenger's Ring: Tenwu of the Red Smoke
identity.objectives: Challenge Tenwu of the Red Smoke, and then defeat him in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
identity.description:
So... you've been challenged by the infamous Tenwu of the Red Smoke.

That's what he calls himself, at least. He's a good fighter, and a good rogue, but it's a wonder he manages to sneak up on anyone with how loudly he brags about himself.

Anyways, I think you should answer the challenge. Maybe it'll give him a touch of humility. Maybe not. Either way, if you win, he'll probably be willing to go with you on your missions. 

And I get some entertainment.

Title.english: The Challenger's Ring: Tenwu of the Red Smoke

Objectives.text: 在螳螂高原的影踪卫戍营中向“赤烟”腾武发起挑战并打败他。
Objectives.english: Challenge Tenwu of the Red Smoke, and then defeat him in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

Description.text:
这么说……你受到了那个臭名昭著的“赤烟”腾武的挑战。

至少，他是这么称呼自己的。他是个厉害的角色，也是个出色的潜行者，但奇怪的是他偷偷接近你时总是不停地吹嘘自己。

不管怎样，我觉得你应该接受这个挑战。或许这能让他谦虚一点，或许不行。总之，要是你赢了，他很可能愿意陪你一起去完成任务。

而我也会有热闹看了。
Description.english:
So... you've been challenged by the infamous Tenwu of the Red Smoke.

That's what he calls himself, at least. He's a good fighter, and a good rogue, but it's a wonder he manages to sneak up on anyone with how loudly he brags about himself.

Anyways, I think you should answer the challenge. Maybe it'll give him a touch of humility. Maybe not. Either way, if you win, he'll probably be willing to go with you on your missions. 

And I get some entertainment.

identity.title: Debugging the Terrace
identity.objectives: Stomp out 6 Eyes of the Empress around the Terrace of Gurthan. Killing anything will grant you Pheromone Tracking, helping you detect them.
identity.description: If this Empress is truly possessed by fear and paranoia, she will have sent scouts to every corner of the land in order to cement her control.$B$BThese scout grubs are likely everywhere, but difficult to spot with the naked eye. Better to track them by the pheromone trails they leave behind.$B$BI've already... gifted you... a reactive toxin that will reveal these trails to you for a brief time after experiencing the thrill of victory.$B$BGo now to the Terrace of Gurthan and root out these spies.

Objectives.text: 在格尔桑平台清理6只女皇之眼。杀死任何东西都可以让你获得信息素追踪的能力，以帮助你找到它们。
Objectives.english: Stomp out 6 Eyes of the Empress around the Terrace of Gurthan. Killing anything will grant you Pheromone Tracking, helping you detect them.

Description.text: 如果这个女皇真的被恐惧和妄想控制了，那她一定会向这片土地的每个角落派出斥候，以巩固自己的统治。$B$B这些斥候蛆虫到处都是，但很难用肉眼看到。最好通过它们爬过时留下的信息素痕迹进行跟踪。$B$B我已经……在你身上使用了……一种应激毒素。这种毒素可以在你体验到胜利的喜悦后，显示信息素的痕迹。$B$B现在就去格尔桑平台，找出那些间谍吧。
Description.english: If this Empress is truly possessed by fear and paranoia, she will have sent scouts to every corner of the land in order to cement her control.$B$BThese scout grubs are likely everywhere, but difficult to spot with the naked eye. Better to track them by the pheromone trails they leave behind.$B$BI've already... gifted you... a reactive toxin that will reveal these trails to you for a brief time after experiencing the thrill of victory.$B$BGo now to the Terrace of Gurthan and root out these spies.

identity.title: Mistfall Village
identity.objectives: Speak to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village.
identity.description: My scouts have spotted no mogu near Mistfall Village today, but I've been hearing of some troubles with local wildlife and spirits in the graveyard. I dispatched Che to assess the situation, but he'll most likely need your help.$B$BFind your way southwest to the village and meet Che there. Do what you can.

Objectives.text: 和雾临村的车·荒野行者谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village.

Description.text: 我的斥候今天在雾临村附近没有侦察到任何魔古族，但我听说当地的野生动物和墓地里的灵魂受到了些骚扰。我委派车去了解一下情况，但他很想得到你的帮忙。$B$B朝西南边走到村庄去，跟车碰面。尽力而为吧。
Description.english: My scouts have spotted no mogu near Mistfall Village today, but I've been hearing of some troubles with local wildlife and spirits in the graveyard. I dispatched Che to assess the situation, but he'll most likely need your help.$B$BFind your way southwest to the village and meet Che there. Do what you can.

identity.title: Attack on Mistfall Village
identity.objectives: Speak to Sun Tenderheart at Mistfall Village.
identity.description: Mogu have been sighted at Mistfall Village to the southwest. I dispatched Rook and Sun immediately, but I need another capable hand there as soon as possible.$B$BDon't delay. The villagers need you.

Objectives.text: 和雾临村的孙·柔心谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Sun Tenderheart at Mistfall Village.

Description.text: 有人在西南方的雾临村见到了魔古族。我立刻派了鲁克和孙，但那边还得尽快再找一个得力的帮手。$B$B别磨蹭了。村民需要你。
Description.english: Mogu have been sighted at Mistfall Village to the southwest. I dispatched Rook and Sun immediately, but I need another capable hand there as soon as possible.$B$BDon't delay. The villagers need you.

identity.title: Setting Sun Garrison
identity.objectives: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison.
identity.description: We've taken losses from the mogu forces descending the Golden Stair and their flanking attackers at Whitepetal Lake. Our lines are thin.$B$BI'm dispatching Anji and Kun to the Setting Sun Garrison to double our efforts at training new recruits. I'd like you there with them, $n. Show them what a true $c is made of.

Objectives.text: 和残阳关卫戍营的安济·秋光谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison.

Description.text: 从金色阶梯冲下来的魔古兵，还有他们在琼花湖的左右夹击，让我们损失了不少兵力。我们的战线日益薄弱。$B$B我正准备把安济和奎派到残阳关卫戍营去，帮助加快我们训练新兵的速度。我想让你跟他们一起去，$n。让他们见识一下什么才是真正的$c。
Description.english: We've taken losses from the mogu forces descending the Golden Stair and their flanking attackers at Whitepetal Lake. Our lines are thin.$B$BI'm dispatching Anji and Kun to the Setting Sun Garrison to double our efforts at training new recruits. I'd like you there with them, $n. Show them what a true $c is made of.

identity.objectives: Make a breadcrumb quest.
identity.description: Whee!  You get to make a breadcrumb quest!  Now figure out what to do next.

Title.english: Figuring out how to make quests

Objectives.text: 制作一个索引任务。
Objectives.english: Make a breadcrumb quest.

Description.text: 好耶！你要学会如何制作一个索引任务！现在想想下面该做什么。
Description.english: Whee!  You get to make a breadcrumb quest!  Now figure out what to do next.

identity.title: Mogu Make Poor House Guests
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Shado-Tien attackers in Mistfall Village.
identity.description: Leven sent Rook here to stop mogu, but there are more than Rook can kill alone.$B$BYou help?  Rook will tell Leven you helped.  Promise.

Objectives.text: 在雾临村击败8个韶天攻击者。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Shado-Tien attackers in Mistfall Village.

Description.text: 莱文派鲁克来这里阻挡魔古军队，但是鲁克一个人杀不完。$B$B你能帮忙吗？鲁克会告诉莱文你帮忙了的。我保证。
Description.english: Leven sent Rook here to stop mogu, but there are more than Rook can kill alone.$B$BYou help?  Rook will tell Leven you helped.  Promise.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的雾临村找鲁克·石趾。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Seeker's Folly
identity.objectives: Brave the path of Seeker's Folly to find Lorewalker Cho, stopping to reflect at the three shrines along the way.
identity.description: I'm sure your pandaren friend has some ideas about what the mogu are after.$B$BHe headed up the mountain a few days ago without a guide, and asked that only you be sent up after him. He was very specific:$B$B"The $c must endure the trek alone, with only $ghis:her; thoughts. $gHe:She; will honor each shrine before meeting me at the top."$B$BThe path is just northwest of the camp, marked by flags. Please be careful! Seeker's Folly is a dangerous trek even on a lucky day.

Objectives.text: 征服探索者末路，找到游学者周卓，并且在沿路的三个神龛稍停片刻，对自身进行一番反省。
Objectives.english: Brave the path of Seeker's Folly to find Lorewalker Cho, stopping to reflect at the three shrines along the way.

Description.text: 我肯定你的熊猫人朋友知道魔古族到底要找什么。$B$B他前几天独自上山去了，没有带向导，并且要求你自己去山上找他。他说得很详细：$B$B“$c必须独自完成这段艰难跋涉，让$g他:她;的思想指引前行之路。在山顶跟我碰面前，$g他:她;得拜祭每一个神龛。”$B$B上山的路径就在营地的西北边，已经用旗子标出来了。切记要小心！即使有老天保佑，探索者末路也是一段危险的路程。
Description.english: I'm sure your pandaren friend has some ideas about what the mogu are after.$B$BHe headed up the mountain a few days ago without a guide, and asked that only you be sent up after him. He was very specific:$B$B"The $c must endure the trek alone, with only $ghis:her; thoughts. $gHe:She; will honor each shrine before meeting me at the top."$B$BThe path is just northwest of the camp, marked by flags. Please be careful! Seeker's Folly is a dangerous trek even on a lucky day.

identity.title: The Old Map
identity.objectives: Show the map to Fish Fellreed at Cattail Lake or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
identity.description: The old, faded leather is falling apart, but still legible.$B$BScrawled on it is some kind of map, and the following lines:$B$B$BDeep in the valley where four winds blow,$BThe maiden laughs behind her golden fan.$BAt the feet of her ancestors' stair,$BShe whispers secrets into the echoing dark.

Objectives.text: 去四风谷的香蒲湖或是半山市集让玉儿·采苇看一看这张地图。
Objectives.english: Show the map to Fish Fellreed at Cattail Lake or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Description.text: 这块陈旧褪色的皮革已经四分五裂，但其上的内容仍然依稀可辨。$B$B皮革上绘制着某种地图，还有以下几行字：$B$B$B四风呼啸幽谷深，$B金扇掩面佳人存。$B先祖阶梯脚下站，$B神秘低语暗中闻。
Description.english: The old, faded leather is falling apart, but still legible.$B$BScrawled on it is some kind of map, and the following lines:$B$B$BDeep in the valley where four winds blow,$BThe maiden laughs behind her golden fan.$BAt the feet of her ancestors' stair,$BShe whispers secrets into the echoing dark.

identity.title: The Heartland Legacy
identity.objectives: Take Old Man Thistle's Almanac to Seedkeeper Shing Sing at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.
identity.description: At the very bottom of the treasure chest, you find a stack of scrolls and a soft leather sack with seeds.$B$BUnrolling the scrolls, you see they contain detailed farming notes, drawings of plants, numbers and calculations, locations of nearby water springs, and countless other snippets.$B$BThere might be someone at the Tillers Union who would like to see this.

Objectives.text: 把老农阿蓟的历书带给四风谷中半山市集的种子保管人辛辛。
Objectives.english: Take Old Man Thistle's Almanac to Seedkeeper Shing Sing at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Description.text: 在宝箱的最底层，你发现了一堆卷轴和一个装满种子的软皮袋。$B$B展开这些卷轴，你看到其中记录着详尽的耕作笔记、植物图鉴、数字和计算结果、附近水泉的分布情况以及数不胜数的其他信息。$B$B阡陌客中的某人可能会对这些东西感兴趣。
Description.english: At the very bottom of the treasure chest, you find a stack of scrolls and a soft leather sack with seeds.$B$BUnrolling the scrolls, you see they contain detailed farming notes, drawings of plants, numbers and calculations, locations of nearby water springs, and countless other snippets.$B$BThere might be someone at the Tillers Union who would like to see this.

identity.title: Figuring out how to make quests
identity.objectives: Make a breadcrumb quest.
identity.description: Whee!  You get to make a breadcrumb quest!  Now figure out what to do next.

Title.english: Figuring out how to make quests

Objectives.text: 制作一个索引任务。
Objectives.english: Make a breadcrumb quest.

Description.text: 好耶！你要学会如何制作一个索引任务！现在想想下面该做什么。
Description.english: Whee!  You get to make a breadcrumb quest!  Now figure out what to do next.

identity.title: The Tillers
identity.objectives: Speak to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.
identity.description: The Tillers do their business at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.$B$BIf you're interested in getting started, I hear there's a new farmer in town by the name of Farmer Yoon.$B$BI betcha he'll be looking for help.

Objectives.text: 去四风谷的日歌农场和农夫老愚谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Description.text: 阡陌客在四风谷的半山忙碌着。$B$B如果你有兴趣入门，我听说新来了一个名叫农夫老愚的农夫。$B$B我敢说他一定在寻求帮助。
Description.english: The Tillers do their business at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.$B$BIf you're interested in getting started, I hear there's a new farmer in town by the name of Farmer Yoon.$B$BI betcha he'll be looking for help.

identity.title: zzOld
identity.objectives: Speak to Fisherman Haito at the Anglers Wharf in the Krasarang Wilds.
identity.description: If you want to explore all the secrets of the deep ocean, and catch some big fish, speak to my brother Haito at the Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds.$B$BI'm sure he'd love to show you a thing or two about reeling!

Objectives.text: 去卡桑琅丛林的渔人码头和渔夫海涛谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Fisherman Haito at the Anglers Wharf in the Krasarang Wilds.

Description.text: 如果你想探寻深海的奥秘，或是抓一两条大鱼，就去跟我的哥哥海涛谈一谈，他就在卡桑琅丛林的渔人码头。$B$B我肯定他会很乐意向你传授一两个绝招的！
Description.english: If you want to explore all the secrets of the deep ocean, and catch some big fish, speak to my brother Haito at the Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds.$B$BI'm sure he'd love to show you a thing or two about reeling!

identity.title: A Legend in the Making
identity.objectives: Share a drink with Wrathion. He's buying.
identity.description: Our world finds itself at a crossroads. The next few months will shape everything to come - presuming we are to have a future at all.$b$bAh! But I am getting ahead of myself. Let me back up. Come, share a drink with me. Let's talk about the future of Azeroth.

Objectives.text: 和拉希奥喝一杯。他请客。
Objectives.english: Share a drink with Wrathion. He's buying.

Description.text: 我们的世界走到了十字路口。接下来的几个月中将会发生各种各样的事情——假如我们还有未来的话。$b$b啊！我好像有点跑题了，还是说回眼前的事吧。来，和我喝一杯。我们来讨论一下艾泽拉斯的未来。
Description.english: Our world finds itself at a crossroads. The next few months will shape everything to come - presuming we are to have a future at all.$b$bAh! But I am getting ahead of myself. Let me back up. Come, share a drink with me. Let's talk about the future of Azeroth.

identity.title: Fear Itself
identity.objectives: Defeat the Sha of Fear in the Terrace of Endless Spring and acquire the Chimera of Fear.
identity.description: I've picked up a few motes of pandaren wisdom during my time here. I particularly enjoy this one:$b$b"The timid feel fear before trouble starts; the cowards feel fear as trouble happens. The bravest among us feel fear only after the troubles have been taken care of."$b$bIs that true? Let's find out.$b$bThe Sha of Fear has fled into the Terrace of Endless Spring. Pursue it there, defeat it, and rip out its spirit - presuming it has one.$b$bYour bravery will be handsomely rewarded.

Objectives.text: 在永春台击败惧之煞并获得恐惧奇美拉。
Objectives.english: Defeat the Sha of Fear in the Terrace of Endless Spring and acquire the Chimera of Fear.

Description.text: 我在这里的这段时间，学习了一些熊猫人的智慧。我尤其喜欢这句话：$b$b“自卑者忧难；怯懦者畏难；勇者克难而后怕。”$b$b这句话有没有道理呢？我们来试试吧。$b$b惧之煞已经潜入了永春台。去那里找到它、击败他并抽出他的灵魂——假如它有灵魂的话。$b$b你的勇敢将会得到丰厚的奖赏的。
Description.english: I've picked up a few motes of pandaren wisdom during my time here. I particularly enjoy this one:$b$b"The timid feel fear before trouble starts; the cowards feel fear as trouble happens. The bravest among us feel fear only after the troubles have been taken care of."$b$bIs that true? Let's find out.$b$bThe Sha of Fear has fled into the Terrace of Endless Spring. Pursue it there, defeat it, and rip out its spirit - presuming it has one.$b$bYour bravery will be handsomely rewarded.

identity.title: Breath of the Black Prince
identity.objectives: Go to the top of the stone steps at Mason's Folly and meet Wrathion there to accept your reward.
identity.description: <Wrathion's piercing red eyes fixate on you.>$b$bYou are among a rare breed, $n.$b$bYou are just what I am looking for - an individual with the potential to shape events on a global scale.$b$bCome now, I promised you a reward, and you shall have it! East of this tavern is a series of stone steps leading up to a vista that the locals have named "Mason's Folly." Meet me there.

Objectives.text: 前往石阶顶端的石匠之愚，在那里会见拉希奥并接收你的奖励。
Objectives.english: Go to the top of the stone steps at Mason's Folly and meet Wrathion there to accept your reward.

Description.text: <拉希奥那血红的锐利眼睛盯着你。>$b$b你这种人很罕见，$n。$b$b你正是我要找的人——一个有能力影响全局的人。$b$b来吧，我答应过给你奖励，你有资格收下它！酒馆的东面有一条石阶，通往当地人称之为“石匠之愚”的瞭望台。我们到那里再见吧。
Description.english: <Wrathion's piercing red eyes fixate on you.>$b$bYou are among a rare breed, $n.$b$bYou are just what I am looking for - an individual with the potential to shape events on a global scale.$b$bCome now, I promised you a reward, and you shall have it! East of this tavern is a series of stone steps leading up to a vista that the locals have named "Mason's Folly." Meet me there.

CompletionLog.text: 和拉希奥谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Wration.

identity.title: Incoming...
identity.objectives: Contact Wrathion once your naval fleet makes landfall on the southern coast of Pandaria.
identity.description: The Pandaren campaign is only beginning! We turn our attention now to the ongoing conflict between the Alliance and the Horde.$b$bMy contacts in Ravenholdt tell me that the Alliance 7th Legion and a considerable Horde invasion force are converging toward Pandaria's southern shores. Like it or not, Pandaria may soon become a battlefield.$b$bWe are done for now, but I want you to contact me when your fleet arrives. Then... together we will spring into action!

Objectives.text: 当你的海军舰队在潘达利亚南部海岸登陆之后，联系拉希奥。
Objectives.english: Contact Wrathion once your naval fleet makes landfall on the southern coast of Pandaria.

Description.text: 熊猫人的战争才刚刚开始！我们现在得把注意力集中到联盟和部落之间的冲突上了。$b$b我在拉文霍德的联络人告诉我，联盟第七军团和大规模的部落侵略部队正在向潘达利亚南部海岸进发。无论你是否愿意，潘达利亚很快就会变成一个战场。$b$b我们可以暂时蛰伏，但我希望你能在你们的舰队达到之后联系我。然后……我们将采取行动！
Description.english: The Pandaren campaign is only beginning! We turn our attention now to the ongoing conflict between the Alliance and the Horde.$b$bMy contacts in Ravenholdt tell me that the Alliance 7th Legion and a considerable Horde invasion force are converging toward Pandaria's southern shores. Like it or not, Pandaria may soon become a battlefield.$b$bWe are done for now, but I want you to contact me when your fleet arrives. Then... together we will spring into action!

identity.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
identity.objectives: Seek out Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
identity.description: Excuse me, $c. Is your name $n?$b$bA figure in a dark cloak asked that I give this to you. She was a traveler from beyond the mists, like yourself, but - well, I didn't trust her.$b$bShe mentioned the name "Wrathion." Does that ring any bells for you?$b$bI'll give you the note but... you should watch your back if you're going to deal with these people.

Objectives.text: 在雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆找到拉希奥。
Objectives.english: Seek out Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

Description.text: 对不起，$c。你是$n吗？$b$b一个披着黑色斗篷的人让我把这个交给你。和你一样，她也是来自迷雾之外的旅行者，但是——我不相信她。$b$b她提到了“拉希奥”这个名字。这有没有让你想起什么？$b$b我会把信交给你的……但是你在去那里的时候一定要小心提防！
Description.english: Excuse me, $c. Is your name $n?$b$bA figure in a dark cloak asked that I give this to you. She was a traveler from beyond the mists, like yourself, but - well, I didn't trust her.$b$bShe mentioned the name "Wrathion." Does that ring any bells for you?$b$bI'll give you the note but... you should watch your back if you're going to deal with these people.

CompletionLog.text: 在雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆找到拉希奥。
CompletionLog.english: Seek out Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

identity.title: The Torch of Strength
identity.objectives: Carry the Torch of Strength to the gates of the Temple of the White Tiger without it extinguishing.
identity.description: Xuen has this challenge he says helps "refine strength." I am starting to think the word "strength" means something different to him than the rest of us.$b$bHere, take this torch to the top of the gates of the temple. If you can get it there without the torch being extinguished, you pass the challenge.$b$bWhatever you do, do not try carrying the torch on a mount. It will blow out if you do. Trust me on that one.

Objectives.text: 带着力量火炬去白虎寺的大门，别让它熄灭。
Objectives.english: Carry the Torch of Strength to the gates of the Temple of the White Tiger without it extinguishing.

Description.text: 雪怒认为这个挑战有助于“提升力量”。相对于我们其他人而言，我开始觉得“力量”这个词对他有着特殊的意义。$b$b拿着，将这个火炬放到寺庙大门上方。如果到达那里后火炬没有熄灭，你便赢得挑战。$b$b无论如何，不要拿着火炬骑在坐骑上。这样火炬会被风吹灭。相信我。
Description.english: Xuen has this challenge he says helps "refine strength." I am starting to think the word "strength" means something different to him than the rest of us.$b$bHere, take this torch to the top of the gates of the temple. If you can get it there without the torch being extinguished, you pass the challenge.$b$bWhatever you do, do not try carrying the torch on a mount. It will blow out if you do. Trust me on that one.

identity.title: Ordnance Disposal
identity.objectives: Disable 8 Pheromone Mines around the Clutches of Shek'zeer and the Heart of Fear.
identity.description: If the Grand Empress's agents are still operating under security standards from my time, they would have hidden powerful pheromone mines all around the clutches.$B$BWith mere whisper she could detonate them all simultaneously, engulfing the palace and rendering entire siege armies powerless.$B$BIf we hope to have any success in a large scale standoff, we need to disable those mines. My... "gift" to you when we met will allow you to see the mines. Disturb them and get to a safe distance.

Objectives.text: 废除夏柯希尔之巢和恐惧之心周围的8个信息素地雷。
Objectives.english: Disable 8 Pheromone Mines around the Clutches of Shek'zeer and the Heart of Fear.

Description.text: 如果大女皇的间谍仍然执行我那个年代的安全标准，他们应该在虫巢周围埋藏了强力的信息素地雷。$B$B她只需要简单的低语，就可以同时引爆所有信息素地雷，埋没整个皇宫，让攻城军队无计可施。$B$B如果我们想要在大规模的对峙中取胜，就必须废掉这些地雷。我们……见面时送给你的“礼物”可以帮你找到这些地雷。扰乱它们，然后躲到安全的地方。
Description.english: If the Grand Empress's agents are still operating under security standards from my time, they would have hidden powerful pheromone mines all around the clutches.$B$BWith mere whisper she could detonate them all simultaneously, engulfing the palace and rendering entire siege armies powerless.$B$BIf we hope to have any success in a large scale standoff, we need to disable those mines. My... "gift" to you when we met will allow you to see the mines. Disturb them and get to a safe distance.
