identity.title: Mission: The Hozen Dozen
identity.objectives: Kill 12 Springtail vermin.
identity.description: I've been watching the hozen since I arrived, and I don't like the pattern of activity that I'm seeing in their camp.$B$BMultiple hozen travel down the mountain under the cover of night, pillaging supplies from the farmlands below.$B$BWe must stop their rampant theft. I have been thinning their numbers when I can, but one soldier alone is not enough.$B$BI need your help. Kill as many of the hozen as you can.

Objectives.text: 击败12只弹尾兔妖。
Objectives.english: Kill 12 Springtail vermin.

Description.text: 从到达营地后，我就一直监视着猢狲。我不喜欢在猢狲营地所看到的活动规律。$B$B几十个猢狲在夜幕的掩护下，偷偷爬下山去，掠夺农田里的东西。$B$B我们必须阻止他们这种肆意盗窃的行为。我已经尽力减少他们的数量，但一个人势单力薄。$B$B我需要你的帮助。尽量多杀死几只猢狲。
Description.english: I've been watching the hozen since I arrived, and I don't like the pattern of activity that I'm seeing in their camp.$B$BMultiple hozen travel down the mountain under the cover of night, pillaging supplies from the farmlands below.$B$BWe must stop their rampant theft. I have been thinning their numbers when I can, but one soldier alone is not enough.$B$BI need your help. Kill as many of the hozen as you can.

CompletionLog.text: 回四风谷的昆森村或半山市集找阿烁。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Sho at Kunzen Village or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

identity.title: Staves for Tian Monastery
identity.objectives: Craft 3 Ghost Iron Staves and 2 Rain Poppy Staves. Bring them to Inkmaster Wei at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
identity.description: It seems like the Tian Monsatery is training a lot of monks this year. We've received a huge commission for staves. And by huge, I mean HUGE.$b$bCould you take on part of the commission? I'd very much appreciate it. You will receive the rewards for your portion, of course.

Objectives.text: 打造3根幽冥杖和2根雨粟杖，并将其交给翡翠林百木园的墨水大师魏。
Objectives.english: Craft 3 Ghost Iron Staves and 2 Rain Poppy Staves. Bring them to Inkmaster Wei at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.

Description.text: 今年天禅院似乎培养了很多武僧。我们已经收到大量法杖的制作委托任务。而且，这个大量指的是非常巨大的量。$b$b你能承担此项委托任务吗？我感激不尽。当然，你将得到应得的回报。
Description.english: It seems like the Tian Monsatery is training a lot of monks this year. We've received a huge commission for staves. And by huge, I mean HUGE.$b$bCould you take on part of the commission? I'd very much appreciate it. You will receive the rewards for your portion, of course.

identity.title: Set in Jade
identity.objectives: Craft an Engraved Jade Disc and bring it to Inkmaster Jo Po at the Arboretum, in the Jade Forest. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.
identity.description: One of the greatest poets of our time is Master Kwang. He has composed a poem of great beauty, and a merchant in Halfhill would like to have these words inscribed in stone, to display proudly in her home. She has requested a scribe of great skill to take on this job. Will you accept the commission?

Objectives.text: 制作一块铭文玉碟，并将其交给翡翠林百木园的墨水大师乔波。你可在铭文面板下的任务列表中找到配方。
Objectives.english: Craft an Engraved Jade Disc and bring it to Inkmaster Jo Po at the Arboretum, in the Jade Forest. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.

Description.text: 邝大师是我们这个时代最伟大的诗人之一。他为一位绝世美女作了一首诗，而半山市集的一位商人想将这些字刻在石头上，以便自豪地在她家中展示。她要求让技巧精湛的人承接这项工作。你愿意接受委托吗？
Description.english: One of the greatest poets of our time is Master Kwang. He has composed a poem of great beauty, and a merchant in Halfhill would like to have these words inscribed in stone, to display proudly in her home. She has requested a scribe of great skill to take on this job. Will you accept the commission?

identity.title: Portrait of a Lady
identity.objectives: Paint a Portrait of Madam Goya and bring it to Inkmaster Glenzu at the Arboretum, in the Jade Forest. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.
identity.description: Many great pieces of art are results of great love.  A merchant in Halfhill wishes to have a portrait made for his beloved, as a birthday present.  Will you accept this commission?

Objectives.text: 绘制一幅郭雅夫人的肖像画，并将其交给翡翠林百木园的墨水大师格伦苏。你可在铭文面板下的任务列表中找到配方。
Objectives.english: Paint a Portrait of Madam Goya and bring it to Inkmaster Glenzu at the Arboretum, in the Jade Forest. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.

Description.text: 许多伟大的艺术作品源自于伟大的爱情。半山集市的一位商人希望以他挚爱的肖像画作为生日礼物。你愿意接受这份委托吗？
Description.english: Many great pieces of art are results of great love.  A merchant in Halfhill wishes to have a portrait made for his beloved, as a birthday present.  Will you accept this commission?

identity.title: On The Mend
identity.objectives: Heal your pets to full health by visiting Seriadne the Stable Master.
identity.description: Now that you have one a battle, we need to heal up your pets so they can fight another day!  Visit Seriadne, our local stable master to heal and revive your pets.

Objectives.text: 拜访兽栏管理员瑟里亚迪，完全治愈你的宠物。
Objectives.english: Heal your pets to full health by visiting Seriadne the Stable Master.

Description.text: 既然你已经赢得了一场战斗，我们就需要治疗你的宠物，这样它们才能继续战斗！拜访我们这里的兽栏管理员瑟里亚迪，治愈和复活你的宠物。
Description.english: Now that you have one a battle, we need to heal up your pets so they can fight another day!  Visit Seriadne, our local stable master to heal and revive your pets.

CompletionLog.text: 去多兰纳尔找瑟里亚迪。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Seriadne in Dolanaar.

identity.title: On The Mend
identity.objectives: Heal your pets to full health by visiting Bezzil the Stable Master.
identity.description: Now that you have won a battle, we need to heal up your pets so they can fight another day!  Visit Bezzil, our local stable master, to heal and revive your pets.

Objectives.text: 拜访兽栏管理员巴兹尔，治疗你的宠物。
Objectives.english: Heal your pets to full health by visiting Bezzil the Stable Master.

Description.text: 既然你已经赢得了一场战斗，我们就需要治疗你的宠物，这样它们才能继续战斗！拜访一下我们这里的兽栏管理员巴兹尔，来治疗和复活你的宠物。
Description.english: Now that you have won a battle, we need to heal up your pets so they can fight another day!  Visit Bezzil, our local stable master, to heal and revive your pets.

identity.title: Got one!
identity.objectives: Catch a battle pet.
identity.description: Great work so far, $n!  You are going to be a pro at this pet stuff before you know it.  Now it's time to catch a pet of your own!$b$bHead back out and find a battle pet to fight, engage it in battle, and throw your trap once it's low on health.  Bring your catch back for me to see once you are finished.$b$bRemember, you need at least one pet at level 3 to use your trap!

Objectives.text: 捕获一只战斗宠物。
Objectives.english: Catch a battle pet.

Description.text: 你的表现到目前为止都很不错，$n。你在不知不觉中已经成了一个宠物方面的专家，现在是时候去抓一个属于你自己的宠物了！$b$b去外面找一个战斗宠物并与其交战，当它体力不支时抛出你的陷阱。一旦你完成后，记得把捕获的宠物带给我瞧瞧。$b$b记住，你至少要有一个宠物达到了3级才能使用陷阱！
Description.english: Great work so far, $n!  You are going to be a pro at this pet stuff before you know it.  Now it's time to catch a pet of your own!$b$bHead back out and find a battle pet to fight, engage it in battle, and throw your trap once it's low on health.  Bring your catch back for me to see once you are finished.$b$bRemember, you need at least one pet at level 3 to use your trap!

identity.title: Kypa'rak's Core
identity.objectives: Bring the Massive Kyparite Core to Ambersmith Zikk at Klaxxi'vess.
identity.description: <As the ringworm tumbles apart, a massive chunk of organic kyparite falls from its core. Someone at Klaxxi'vess will want to see this.>

Objectives.text: 把巨型凯帕琥珀核心交给卡拉克西维斯的琥珀匠师齐克。
Objectives.english: Bring the Massive Kyparite Core to Ambersmith Zikk at Klaxxi'vess.

Description.text: <白斑破裂之后，一大块有机凯帕琥珀从里面掉了出来。卡拉克西维斯应该有人对这个东西感兴趣。>
Description.english: <As the ringworm tumbles apart, a massive chunk of organic kyparite falls from its core. Someone at Klaxxi'vess will want to see this.>

CompletionLog.text: 把巨型凯帕琥珀核心交给卡拉克西维斯的琥珀匠师齐克。
CompletionLog.english: Bring the Massive Kyparite Core to Ambersmith Zikk at Klaxxi'vess.

identity.title: The Warlord's Ashes
identity.objectives: Bring the Ashes of Warlord Gurthan to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.
identity.description: <Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver defeated Warlord Gurthan centuries ago, but the mogu beastmaster's spirit continues to haunt the ruins of his old stronghold.$B$BShowing proof of your victory over this spirit may gain you favor in the eyes of the Klaxxi.>

Objectives.text: 将格尔桑军阀骨灰带给卡拉克西维斯的掠风者克尔鲁克。
Objectives.english: Bring the Ashes of Warlord Gurthan to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

Description.text: <掠风者克尔鲁克在几个世纪以前就击败了军阀格尔桑，但这位魔古族兽王的灵魂一直游荡于他原来的要塞附近。$B$B拿出你战胜这个灵魂的证明来，或许能让你获得卡拉克西的青睐。>
Description.english: <Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver defeated Warlord Gurthan centuries ago, but the mogu beastmaster's spirit continues to haunt the ruins of his old stronghold.$B$BShowing proof of your victory over this spirit may gain you favor in the eyes of the Klaxxi.>

CompletionLog.text: 将格尔桑军阀骨灰带给卡拉克西维斯的掠风者克尔鲁克。
CompletionLog.english: Bring the Ashes of Warlord Gurthan to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

identity.title: Crime and Punishment
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Amber Harvesters on the Stinging Trail.
identity.description: The Stinging Trail nurtures young Kypari trees. The empress drains the saplings too early, outsider. They must grow before the amber can be taken.$b$bThe Klaxxi'va demand punishment for this crime! It will please them if you rain death on the Ik'thik harvesters.

Objectives.text: 在刺芒小径杀死8个琥珀收割者。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Amber Harvesters on the Stinging Trail.

Description.text: 刺芒小径里种植着年轻的凯帕圣树。女皇很早就开始吸收这些树苗了，外来者。在其琥珀能够被采摘之前，它们必须要继续生长。$b$b卡拉克西瓦要求对这一罪行进行惩罚！如果你能杀死那些琥珀收割者们，卡拉克西瓦会非常满意的。
Description.english: The Stinging Trail nurtures young Kypari trees. The empress drains the saplings too early, outsider. They must grow before the amber can be taken.$b$bThe Klaxxi'va demand punishment for this crime! It will please them if you rain death on the Ik'thik harvesters.

identity.title: Better With Age
identity.objectives: Gather 7 Amber-Filled Jars from the Amber Collectors on the Stinging Trail.
identity.description: It is a crime to harvest the young trees, but a much bigger crime to waste the amber.$b$bYoung amber is not as strong, but the Klaxxi need it to continue the fight. We will bring them more and they will sing my praises!$b$bGather the young amber. We will store it until it is aged and can be consumed.

Objectives.text: 在刺芒小径从琥珀采集器上收集7个装满琥珀的罐子。
Objectives.english: Gather 7 Amber-Filled Jars from the Amber Collectors on the Stinging Trail.

Description.text: 收割年幼的凯帕圣树是犯罪，但浪费琥珀更是罪大恶极。$b$b嫩琥珀不够强劲，但卡拉克西也需要它来保持战斗力。我们要给他们送去更多琥珀，而他们将颂扬我的义举！$b$b去收集嫩琥珀。我们可以把它存起来，直到它变得成熟可食为止。
Description.english: It is a crime to harvest the young trees, but a much bigger crime to waste the amber.$b$bYoung amber is not as strong, but the Klaxxi need it to continue the fight. We will bring them more and they will sing my praises!$b$bGather the young amber. We will store it until it is aged and can be consumed.

identity.title: By the Sea, Nevermore
identity.objectives: Use the Klaxxi Tuning Fork on the Ocean-Worn Rocks to awaken the paragon.
identity.description: The Klaxxi'va have spoken to me, outsider. The paragon is hidden in the Briny Muck only, he is not so hidden anymore.$b$bThe lizard men surround him. He cannot fall into their scaley hands.$b$bYou will find him; you will awaken him. Do not return without him!$b$bIf you do this the Klaxxi will be pleased with us.

Objectives.text: 对海水侵蚀的岩石使用卡拉克西音叉来唤醒英杰。
Objectives.english: Use the Klaxxi Tuning Fork on the Ocean-Worn Rocks to awaken the paragon.

Description.text: 卡拉克西瓦在对我低语，外来者。在盐碱泥滩藏匿着一位英杰，他的位置已经暴露了。$b$b蜥蜴人包围了他，决不能让英杰落入他们手中。$b$b你得找到他，你得唤醒他。搞不定就别回来见我！$b$b如果你能办到，卡拉克西会对我们另眼相看的。
Description.english: The Klaxxi'va have spoken to me, outsider. The paragon is hidden in the Briny Muck only, he is not so hidden anymore.$b$bThe lizard men surround him. He cannot fall into their scaley hands.$b$bYou will find him; you will awaken him. Do not return without him!$b$bIf you do this the Klaxxi will be pleased with us.

identity.title: Valley of the Four Winds
identity.objectives: Teleport to Valley of the Four Winds and speak to Private Tim P. O'Rary.
identity.description: Yarr, the Jade Forest be goin through some violent reconstruction, but the Valley of the Four Winds is ripe for explorin.  Talk with me when ye be ready to go and I can give ye a ride ta where ya need to go.  Talk to me cohort on the other side 'ta get some equipment to aid ya on yer journey.

Objectives.text: 传送至四风谷并和列兵蒂姆·P·拉瑞谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Teleport to Valley of the Four Winds and speak to Private Tim P. O'Rary.

Description.text: 没错，翡翠林正经历一些粗暴的重建，但四风谷正适合探险。你准备好出发时就跟我说一声，我可以载你去你想去的地方。跟我旁边的同伴谈一谈，他会给你一些路上用得着的装备。
Description.english: Yarr, the Jade Forest be goin through some violent reconstruction, but the Valley of the Four Winds is ripe for explorin.  Talk with me when ye be ready to go and I can give ye a ride ta where ya need to go.  Talk to me cohort on the other side 'ta get some equipment to aid ya on yer journey.

identity.title: Inscribed Tiger Staff
identity.objectives: Bring your Inscribed Tiger Staff to Inkmaster Glenzu in the Arboretum.
identity.description: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff.  When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

Objectives.text: 把你的铭文白虎杖带给百木园里的墨水大师格伦苏。
Objectives.english: Bring your Inscribed Tiger Staff to Inkmaster Glenzu in the Arboretum.

Description.text: 这件武器威力如此强大，以至于使你认识到你将无法驾驭它。当时机成熟的时候，百木园里的墨水大师会很感兴趣从你这里把它拿走的。
Description.english: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff.  When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

identity.title: Inscribed Crane Staff
identity.objectives: Bring your Inscribed Crane Staff to Inkmaster Jo Po in the Arboretum.
identity.description: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff.  When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

Objectives.text: 把你的铭文朱鹤杖带给百木园里的墨水大师乔波。
Objectives.english: Bring your Inscribed Crane Staff to Inkmaster Jo Po in the Arboretum.

Description.text: 这件武器威力如此强大，以至于使你认识到你将无法驾驭它。当时机成熟的时候，百木园里的墨水大师会很感兴趣从你这里把它拿走的。
Description.english: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff.  When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

identity.title: Inscribed Serpent Staff
identity.objectives: Bring your Inscribed Serpent Staff to Inkmaster Wei in the Arboretum.
identity.description: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff.  When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

Objectives.text: 把你的铭文青龙杖带给百木园里的墨水大师魏。
Objectives.english: Bring your Inscribed Serpent Staff to Inkmaster Wei in the Arboretum.

Description.text: 这件武器威力如此强大，以至于使你认识到你将无法驾驭它。当时机成熟的时候，百木园里的墨水大师会很感兴趣从你这里把它拿走的。
Description.english: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff.  When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

identity.title: Thinning The Pack
identity.objectives: Kill 8 Windward Tigers or Windward Alphas.
identity.description: The past few seasons have been plentiful, and as a result, the wild tiger population on Windward Isle has exploded.$B$BThe savage creatures have hunted out all the nearby game, and are beginning to encroach upon the cloud serpent nests.$B$BAs a result, as the tigers thrive, the cloud serpents decline.$B$BIf we are not careful, the predatory cats could completely wipe them out.$B$BWe must thin the tigers' numbers, $r.

Objectives.text: 杀死8只临风幼虎或临风猛虎。
Objectives.english: Kill 8 Windward Tigers or Windward Alphas.

Description.text: 过去的几个季节风调雨顺、生机盎然。因此，临风岛上野生老虎的数量有了较大的增幅。$B$B这种残暴的食肉动物几乎猎杀了周围所有的生物，并开始威胁到云端翔龙的巢穴了。$B$B道理很简单，老虎的数量越多，云端翔龙的数量便会随之减少。$B$B要是我们放任自流的话，这些掠食者会把云端翔龙给彻底灭绝的。$B$B我们必须得削减老虎的数量了，$r。
Description.english: The past few seasons have been plentiful, and as a result, the wild tiger population on Windward Isle has exploded.$B$BThe savage creatures have hunted out all the nearby game, and are beginning to encroach upon the cloud serpent nests.$B$BAs a result, as the tigers thrive, the cloud serpents decline.$B$BIf we are not careful, the predatory cats could completely wipe them out.$B$BWe must thin the tigers' numbers, $r.

identity.title: On The Prowl
identity.objectives: Kill the Windward Saber.
identity.description: I have heard report of a great white beast that stalks the wood on the northwestern side of the wild serpent island.$B$BThis savage creature is mate to the Windward Huntress, and already he has taken down several of the adult cloud serpent matriarchs.$B$BWe cannot have such a fearsome predator roaming the island unchecked.$B$BGo and deal with this creature. Let us see if your training has paid off.

Objectives.text: 击败临风刃豹。
Objectives.english: Kill the Windward Saber.

Description.text: 我收到报告说，一头巨型的白色猛兽正在临风岛西北边的林子里游荡。$B$B这个残暴的家伙是临风女猎手的配偶，而且已经杀死了数条成年的云端翔龙龙母。$B$B我们可不能放任这么危险的掠食者在临风岛逍遥快活。$B$B去给我干掉那头野兽，让我们瞧瞧你是否学有所成。
Description.english: I have heard report of a great white beast that stalks the wood on the northwestern side of the wild serpent island.$B$BThis savage creature is mate to the Windward Huntress, and already he has taken down several of the adult cloud serpent matriarchs.$B$BWe cannot have such a fearsome predator roaming the island unchecked.$B$BGo and deal with this creature. Let us see if your training has paid off.

identity.title: Needle Me Not
identity.objectives: Use the honey at the northern clearing in The Arboretum, and then kill the Orchard Needler.
identity.description: The Arboretum is our home, a safe haven where we raise young hatchlings and train our students.$B$BUnfortunately, there are other, more dangerous creatures who wish to make this their home as well.$B$BTo the north, beyond the river, we have seen a great wasp feeding on the nectar blossoms.$B$BThis creature has already stung several of our students.$B$BUse this honey to lure the wasp out of hiding. Then, destroy it before it harms anyone else.

Objectives.text: 在百木园北面的空地上使用蜂蜜，然后杀死果园钉刺者。
Objectives.english: Use the honey at the northern clearing in The Arboretum, and then kill the Orchard Needler.

Description.text: 百木园是我们的家，也是我们抚养雏龙、训练弟子的避风港。$B$B可不幸的是，其他一些更加危险的生物也想把这里当成家。$B$B在越过河向北的地方，我们看到一只大黄蜂以花蜜为食。$B$B这家伙已经蛰伤了好几个弟子。$B$B用这蜂蜜把大黄蜂引出来，然后在它继续伤人之前消灭它。
Description.english: The Arboretum is our home, a safe haven where we raise young hatchlings and train our students.$B$BUnfortunately, there are other, more dangerous creatures who wish to make this their home as well.$B$BTo the north, beyond the river, we have seen a great wasp feeding on the nectar blossoms.$B$BThis creature has already stung several of our students.$B$BUse this honey to lure the wasp out of hiding. Then, destroy it before it harms anyone else.

identity.title: A Tangled Web
identity.objectives: Destroy Widow's Webs to free 5 Sri-La Villagers.
identity.description: We have had a disturbing report from the Anglers fishermen of Sri-La Village, $n.$B$BMany of their villagers are missing, taken by the spiders who live in The Widow's Wail, a cave along the coast to the north.$B$BThe victims are dragged into the dark depths, wrapped in cocoons, and left to become the spiders' next meal.$B$BWe believe that some of the people may still be alive. There is still time to save them! I need you to go and rescue as many villagers as you can find.

Objectives.text: 摧毁寡妇蛛网，救出5个香里拉村民。
Objectives.english: Destroy Widow's Webs to free 5 Sri-La Villagers.

Description.text: 我们从香里拉村的渔民那里得到一个令人不安的消息，$n。$B$B他们那儿有很多村民失踪了。据目击者称，他们被抓到蛛泣洞穴去了，就在沿海岸线向北的地方。$B$B那些受害者被蛛丝包裹得严严实实，并被拖进了黑暗的深渊，以作为蜘蛛们的下一顿晚餐。$B$B我们相信其中有一部分人还活着，还来得及去救他们！我要你去营救那里的村民，越多越好。
Description.english: We have had a disturbing report from the Anglers fishermen of Sri-La Village, $n.$B$BMany of their villagers are missing, taken by the spiders who live in The Widow's Wail, a cave along the coast to the north.$B$BThe victims are dragged into the dark depths, wrapped in cocoons, and left to become the spiders' next meal.$B$BWe believe that some of the people may still be alive. There is still time to save them! I need you to go and rescue as many villagers as you can find.

identity.title: Serpent's Scale
identity.objectives: Collect 25 Serpent's Scale.
identity.description: I see you have gained your own hatchling, $r.$B$BHave you been feeding it, cleaning after it, and playing with it properly? Only by doing so will it become strong and healthy.$B$BNow let me tell you a trainer's secret. To the north, in The Widow's Wail, you can find a mushroom known as Serpent's Scale.$B$BIt is difficult to acquire, but this mushroom has powerful properties and important nutrients. Your serpent won't like eating it, but who likes eating their vegetables?

Objectives.text: 收集25个龙鳞菇。
Objectives.english: Collect 25 Serpent's Scale.

Description.text: 我看到你已经拥有了自己的雏龙，$r。$B$B你有没有正确地喂养它、清洁它、陪它玩耍呢？只有这样，你的雏龙才会健康茁壮地成长。$B$B现在让我来教你一个秘诀。去北边的蛛泣洞穴，你会在那里找到一种名叫“龙鳞菇”的菌菇。$B$B龙鳞菇很难得，但其营养丰富且富含各种维生素。虽然味道不怎么样，你的翔龙不会喜欢的，但又有谁喜欢吃蔬菜呢？
Description.english: I see you have gained your own hatchling, $r.$B$BHave you been feeding it, cleaning after it, and playing with it properly? Only by doing so will it become strong and healthy.$B$BNow let me tell you a trainer's secret. To the north, in The Widow's Wail, you can find a mushroom known as Serpent's Scale.$B$BIt is difficult to acquire, but this mushroom has powerful properties and important nutrients. Your serpent won't like eating it, but who likes eating their vegetables?

identity.title: Tiny Treats
identity.objectives: Collect 100 Tiny Spider Eyes.
identity.description: As you near, your serpent opens its mouth and begins drooling. It looks quite hungry since you last left it.$B$BFrom the way it whimpers and slaps its tail, you can tell it is not looking for just any treat, but a special favorite snack.$B$BYour serpent loves to munch on tiny spider eyes, but this delicacy comes only from the Widowspawn spiders in the cave along the coast to the north.$B$BWell, what's a rider to do? Your serpent is waiting.

Objectives.text: 收集100只小蜘蛛眼。
Objectives.english: Collect 100 Tiny Spider Eyes.

Description.text: 当你走近时，你的翔龙张着嘴巴开始流口水了。自从你上次离开后，小家伙变得非常饥饿。$B$B从它不停啜泣和拍打小尾巴的动作来看，小家伙不想随随便便填饱肚子，而是想来点比较特别的美食。$B$B你的翔龙喜欢嚼小蜘蛛眼，但这东西只有小寡妇蛛身上有，沿着海岸线向北可以找到洞穴。$B$B那么，你还在等什么呐？赶紧出发吧。
Description.english: As you near, your serpent opens its mouth and begins drooling. It looks quite hungry since you last left it.$B$BFrom the way it whimpers and slaps its tail, you can tell it is not looking for just any treat, but a special favorite snack.$B$BYour serpent loves to munch on tiny spider eyes, but this delicacy comes only from the Widowspawn spiders in the cave along the coast to the north.$B$BWell, what's a rider to do? Your serpent is waiting.

identity.title: The Big Brew-haha
identity.objectives: Collect 100 Sri-La Stout.
identity.description: It's a disaster, $n!$B$BWhen I went to visit the Dancing Serpent Inn yesterday, they were all out of brew. They said the shipment from Sri-La Village had been stolen. STOLEN!$B$BTurns out those Oona hozen have been making all kinds of trouble down at the docks, including taking all the brew to their cave at Oona Kagu along the coast.$B$BI can't handle a dry spell. A life without brew is not a life worth living!$B$BSomeone needs to go and save the brew!

Objectives.text: 收集100桶香里拉烈酒。
Objectives.english: Collect 100 Sri-La Stout.

Description.text: 这简直就是一场灾难，$n！$B$B我昨天想去龙舞楼喝两杯，结果被告知没酒了。他们说从香里拉村运来的酒都被偷了。被偷了！$B$B事实证明是那群乌拿猢狲把码头搞得一团糟，其中就包括了把偷来的酒带回乌拿猴洞。$B$B我离开酒活不过两天，没酒喝的日子不过也罢！$B$B得有个人站出来把酒找回来啊！
Description.english: It's a disaster, $n!$B$BWhen I went to visit the Dancing Serpent Inn yesterday, they were all out of brew. They said the shipment from Sri-La Village had been stolen. STOLEN!$B$BTurns out those Oona hozen have been making all kinds of trouble down at the docks, including taking all the brew to their cave at Oona Kagu along the coast.$B$BI can't handle a dry spell. A life without brew is not a life worth living!$B$BSomeone needs to go and save the brew!

identity.title: Saving the Serpents
identity.objectives: Collect 10 Rescued Serpents.
identity.description: Those Oona hozen have gone too far this time.$B$BDo you know what they are doing with wild cloud serpents? Captured hatchlings are forced to fight one another in the pits, for nothing more than the Oona's amusement.$B$BSavages!$B$BIf the young hatchlings learn such aggressive behavior at a young age, they may become violent and corrupted adults. A malicious cloud serpent is not something we want to deal with.$B$BWe must save the hatchlings.

Objectives.text: 收集10条得救的翔龙。
Objectives.english: Collect 10 Rescued Serpents.

Description.text: 那些乌拿猢狲太过分了。$B$B你知道他们在对野生翔龙做什么吗？他们强迫被抓的雏龙在牢笼里决斗，而这一切只是为了娱乐消遣。$B$B暴徒！$B$B如果这些雏龙在这么小的年纪就学会了杀戮，那么它们长大成年后也将变得腐化和暴戾。残暴的云端翔龙可不是我们想要的结果。$B$B我们必须拯救这些雏龙。
Description.english: Those Oona hozen have gone too far this time.$B$BDo you know what they are doing with wild cloud serpents? Captured hatchlings are forced to fight one another in the pits, for nothing more than the Oona's amusement.$B$BSavages!$B$BIf the young hatchlings learn such aggressive behavior at a young age, they may become violent and corrupted adults. A malicious cloud serpent is not something we want to deal with.$B$BWe must save the hatchlings.

identity.title: Pooped
identity.objectives: Collect 5 Big Bags of Poop.
identity.description: <As you approach the pen, the serpent zips into a corner and hides.>$B$BAs it looks at you with bashful eyes, you can tell that someone has gotten out of its pen and had... an accident.$B$BWell, at the rate that the serpent's been eating, it had to come out the other end... somewhere.$B$BYou had better find the serpent's poop and clean it up before the Serpent Masters find out.

Objectives.text: 收集5大袋粪便。
Objectives.english: Collect 5 Big Bags of Poop.

Description.text: <当你走近小窝时，翔龙突然跳进墙角躲了起来。>$B$B从它害羞的眼神里，你看出来某个家伙从围栏里跑了出来，还制造了一起……事故。$B$B其实这也没啥，翔龙总是不停地吃，吃完的东西势必也要从另一头……排泄出来。$B$B你最好在翔龙大师发现之前，找到雏龙排出的粪便并清理干净。
Description.english: <As you approach the pen, the serpent zips into a corner and hides.>$B$BAs it looks at you with bashful eyes, you can tell that someone has gotten out of its pen and had... an accident.$B$BWell, at the rate that the serpent's been eating, it had to come out the other end... somewhere.$B$BYou had better find the serpent's poop and clean it up before the Serpent Masters find out.

identity.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Ace Longpaw
identity.objectives: Speak to Ace Longpaw, then defeat him.
identity.description: You are rising up the ranks of our students, $n.$B$BJust as a sword must be forged through fire, so must our students test themselves against one another.$B$BToday, you will spar against one of our brightest disciples, Ace Longpaw. In order to defeat him, you will need to make use of your defensive capabilities.$B$BSpeak to him in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.

Title.text: 训练师的试炼：王牌飞行员长爪

Objectives.text: 和王牌飞行员长爪谈一谈，然后击败他。
Objectives.english: Speak to Ace Longpaw, then defeat him.

Description.text: 你把我们弟子的水准又提上了一个新台阶，$n。$B$B就像一把宝剑需要千锤百炼，我们的弟子也得互相挑战，获取实战经验。$B$B今天，你将和我们中最出色的一名弟子——王牌飞行员长爪进行对决。要想击败他，你得好好利用你的防守能力。$B$B去训练之环和他谈一谈，开始挑战。祝你好运。
Description.english: You are rising up the ranks of our students, $n.$B$BJust as a sword must be forged through fire, so must our students test themselves against one another.$B$BToday, you will spar against one of our brightest disciples, Ace Longpaw. In order to defeat him, you will need to make use of your defensive capabilities.$B$BSpeak to him in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.

identity.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Ningna Darkwheel
identity.objectives: Speak to Ningna Darkwheel, then defeat her.
identity.description: You show much promise, $n. However, talent is worth little without discipline and humility.$B$BToday, you will face Ningna Darkwheel. Her natural strength makes her one of our most talented students. $B$BIf you hope to defeat her, you will need to act with the utmost control.$B$BSpeak to her in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.

Title.text: 训练师的试炼：宁纳·黑轮

Objectives.text: 和宁纳·黑轮谈一谈，然后击败她。
Objectives.english: Speak to Ningna Darkwheel, then defeat her.

Description.text: 你天赋异禀，$n。但天赋这东西一旦失去了戒律和谦卑的支撑，就会变得不堪一击。$B$B今天，你将面对的是宁纳·黑轮。她的天然优势使她成为了我们这里最具天赋的弟子之一。$B$B要想击败她，你就得严格把控自己。$B$B去训练之环和她谈一谈，开始挑战。祝你好运。
Description.english: You show much promise, $n. However, talent is worth little without discipline and humility.$B$BToday, you will face Ningna Darkwheel. Her natural strength makes her one of our most talented students. $B$BIf you hope to defeat her, you will need to act with the utmost control.$B$BSpeak to her in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.

identity.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Suchi the Sweet
identity.objectives: Speak to Suchi the Sweet, then defeat her.
identity.description: Today you will face Suchi the Sweet in the training ring. Despite her sweet exterior, she is a tough opponent.$B$BShe attacks swiftly and surely, but such potent attacks can become tiring over time.$B$BIf you hope to defeat her, you will need to concentrate your damage when she is weakened.$B$BSpeak to Suchi to begin the duel. Good luck.

Title.text: 训练师的试炼：蜜糖苏琪
Title.english: The Trainer's Challenge: Suchi the Sweet

Objectives.text: 和蜜糖苏琪谈一谈，然后击败她。
Objectives.english: Speak to Suchi the Sweet, then defeat her.

Description.text: 今天，你将在训练之环挑战蜜糖苏琪。尽管她外表看上去很甜美，但她绝对是个难缠的对手。$B$B她的攻击迅捷且犀利，但随着时间的流逝，也会成强弩之末。$B$B要想击败她，就得趁她虚弱时穷追猛打。$B$B和苏琪谈一谈，开始对决。祝你好运。
Description.english: Today you will face Suchi the Sweet in the training ring. Despite her sweet exterior, she is a tough opponent.$B$BShe attacks swiftly and surely, but such potent attacks can become tiring over time.$B$BIf you hope to defeat her, you will need to concentrate your damage when she is weakened.$B$BSpeak to Suchi to begin the duel. Good luck.

identity.title: Valley of the Four Winds
identity.objectives: Speak to Private Tim P. O'Rary in the Valley of the Four Winds.
identity.description: Yarr, the Jade Forest be goin through some violent reconstruction, but the Valley of the Four Winds is ripe for explorin.  I can help ye on yer way if ye wants to explore it.  Be sure to check out me wares for some equipment that may help ye on yer journey.

Objectives.text: 和四风谷的列兵蒂姆·P·拉瑞谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Private Tim P. O'Rary in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Description.text: 没错，翡翠林正经历一些粗暴的重建，但四风谷正适合探险。如果你想去那里探险，我可以送你一程。记得查看一下我的货物，拿些旅途上用得着的装备。
Description.english: Yarr, the Jade Forest be goin through some violent reconstruction, but the Valley of the Four Winds is ripe for explorin.  I can help ye on yer way if ye wants to explore it.  Be sure to check out me wares for some equipment that may help ye on yer journey.

identity.title: Cannonfire
identity.objectives: Destroy 7 Shao-Tien Cannons.
identity.description: Those mogu cannons up on the Golden Stair are bombarding us from a distance. Sure would be nice if they somehow spontaneously broke, don't you think?

Objectives.text: 摧毁7门韶天火炮。
Objectives.english: Destroy 7 Shao-Tien Cannons.

Description.text: 那些金色阶梯上的魔古火炮正从远距离轰击我们。如果它们以某种方式被毁掉的话，那当然再好不过了，你觉得呢？
Description.english: Those mogu cannons up on the Golden Stair are bombarding us from a distance. Sure would be nice if they somehow spontaneously broke, don't you think?

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找奎·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Acts of Cruelty
identity.objectives: Rescue 5 Golden Lotus Guards or Mistfall Villagers.
identity.description: I can hear the screams of the captured soldiers and villagers up on the Golden Stair. They're torturing them!$B$BPlease, please, you have to save them!

Objectives.text: 营救5名金莲卫士或雾临村民。
Objectives.english: Rescue 5 Golden Lotus Guards or Mistfall Villagers.

Description.text: 我能听到那些被俘的战士和村民们发出来的哀号，就在金色阶梯那里。魔古族正在折磨他们！$B$B求求你，快去救救他们！
Description.english: I can hear the screams of the captured soldiers and villagers up on the Golden Stair. They're torturing them!$B$BPlease, please, you have to save them!

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找孙·柔心。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: High Chance of Rain
identity.objectives: Destroy the Stormcaller staves.
identity.description: The mogu are conjuring some kind of sinister storm upon the Golden Stair. Generally, mogu and lightning are not a particularly pleasant mix. I say we stop them.$B$BYou should be able to find their Stormcaller staves pretty easily, considering the giant arcs of lightning extending up from them. Mind knocking them over or destroying them or something for me? I sure would sleep better.

Objectives.text: 摧毁引风杖。
Objectives.english: Destroy the Stormcaller staves.

Description.text: 金色阶梯上的魔古族正试图通过法术引来一场风暴。可想而知，魔古族和风暴结合在一起，可不是什么好事。要我说我们得阻止他们。$B$B通过那些引风杖所散发出来的巨大电弧，你应该很容易就能找到它们。能不能帮我去毁掉它们？回头我肯定能睡个好觉了。
Description.english: The mogu are conjuring some kind of sinister storm upon the Golden Stair. Generally, mogu and lightning are not a particularly pleasant mix. I say we stop them.$B$BYou should be able to find their Stormcaller staves pretty easily, considering the giant arcs of lightning extending up from them. Mind knocking them over or destroying them or something for me? I sure would sleep better.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找奎·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Unleashed Spirits
identity.objectives: Kill 12 Unleashed Spirits.
identity.description: The Shao-Tien have unleashed their captive tortured spirits upon us. They flood down from the Golden Stair, with no end in sight.$B$BKill as many of these unleashed spirits as you can. They are fragile, but if you are not alert, they can easily overrun you.$B$BGood luck.

Objectives.text: 击败12个获释的灵魂。
Objectives.english: Kill 12 Unleashed Spirits.

Description.text: 韶天放出了那些被他们俘虏且饱受摧残的灵魂，冲着我们来了。他们如洪水般从金色阶梯上涌出来，似乎无穷无尽。$B$B尽可能多杀些获释的灵魂。他们虽然不堪一击，但如果你掉以轻心，会很容易被他们淹没。$B$B祝你好运。
Description.english: The Shao-Tien have unleashed their captive tortured spirits upon us. They flood down from the Golden Stair, with no end in sight.$B$BKill as many of these unleashed spirits as you can. They are fragile, but if you are not alert, they can easily overrun you.$B$BGood luck.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Laosy Scouting
identity.objectives: Rescue Lao Softfoot.
identity.description: Lao Softfoot got himself captured again up on the Golden Stair. I'm not going to make any excuses for him, he's a lousy rogue.$B$BWe probably shouldn't just leave him there though. Could you go find him?

Objectives.text: 营救劳·软足。
Objectives.english: Rescue Lao Softfoot.

Description.text: 劳·软足又被抓了……这次是在金色阶梯。我不想为他找任何借口，这家伙实在是太差劲了。$B$B可我们也不能把他丢在那儿不管不顾，你能救他回来吗？
Description.english: Lao Softfoot got himself captured again up on the Golden Stair. I'm not going to make any excuses for him, he's a lousy rogue.$B$BWe probably shouldn't just leave him there though. Could you go find him?

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找奎·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Striking First
identity.objectives: Stop the Shao-Tien Behemoth from being empowered.
identity.description: The mogu are empowering some giant stone monstrosity up on the Golden Stair, with the sure intent of unleashing it upon us.$B$BHow about you go and let them know our opinion on the matter? Make sure the point strikes home.

Objectives.text: 阻止魔古族启动韶天巨兽。
Objectives.english: Stop the Shao-Tien Behemoth from being empowered.

Description.text: 魔古族正在金色阶梯上启动某种石像巨兽。毫无疑问，他们想拿它来对付我们。$B$B不如你去跟他们“表达”一下我们的态度？要确保我们的观点直击要害。
Description.english: The mogu are empowering some giant stone monstrosity up on the Golden Stair, with the sure intent of unleashing it upon us.$B$BHow about you go and let them know our opinion on the matter? Make sure the point strikes home.

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Crumbling Behemoth
identity.objectives: Destroy the Shao-Tien Behomoth.
identity.description: The mogu have succeeded in empowering an enormous stone statue with the intent of unleashing it upon us.$B$BIn response, I would like to unleash you upon it.$B$BIt approaches from the Golden Stair. Bring it to its knees...

Objectives.text: 摧毁韶天巨兽。
Objectives.english: Destroy the Shao-Tien Behomoth.

Description.text: 魔古族成功启动了一头凶猛无比的石像巨兽，意图用它来对付我们。$B$B作为回应，我决定派你去对付它。$B$B它就在金色阶梯附近。去征服它吧……
Description.english: The mogu have succeeded in empowering an enormous stone statue with the intent of unleashing it upon us.$B$BIn response, I would like to unleash you upon it.$B$BIt approaches from the Golden Stair. Bring it to its knees...

CompletionLog.text: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找安济·秋光。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Pristine Edicts of the Thunder King
identity.objectives: Put the artifact on display.
identity.description: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition.  Perhaps you will put it on display at the Seat of Knowledge, so that lorewalkers and archaeologists can study it.

Title.text: 古朴的雷电之王的法典
Title.english: Pristine Edicts of the Thunder King

Objectives.text: 将神器进行展览。
Objectives.english: Put the artifact on display.

Description.text: 这件神器的恢复状况极为良好。或许你该把它放在闻道之座进行展览，好让那些游学者和考古学家们进行研究。
Description.english: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition.  Perhaps you will put it on display at the Seat of Knowledge, so that lorewalkers and archaeologists can study it.

identity.title: Pristine Pandaren Tea Set
identity.objectives: Put the artifact on display.
identity.description: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition.  Perhaps you will put it on display at the Seat of Knowledge, so that lorewalkers and archaeologists can study it.

Objectives.text: 将神器进行展览。
Objectives.english: Put the artifact on display.

Description.text: 这件神器的恢复状况极为良好。或许你该把它放在闻道之座进行展览，好让那些游学者和考古学家们进行研究。
Description.english: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition.  Perhaps you will put it on display at the Seat of Knowledge, so that lorewalkers and archaeologists can study it.

identity.title: Traitor Gluk
identity.objectives: Defeat Bill the Pirate in a pet battle.
identity.description: Are you up for an adventure? Bill the Pirate, local star tamer down in the Cape of Stranglethorn, has issued an open challenge to prepared trainers!$b$bYou can find Bill the Pirate in the southern Cape of Stranglethorn, walking the local roads to find potential fights.

Objectives.text: 在宠物战斗中击败海盗比尔。
Objectives.english: Defeat Bill the Pirate in a pet battle.

Description.text: 想来点儿挑战吗？海盗比尔是荆棘谷海角的明星训练师，他公开表示接受任何训练师的挑战！$b$b你可以在荆棘谷海角的南面找到海盗比尔，他在那闲庭信步，等待挑战者呢。
Description.english: Are you up for an adventure? Bill the Pirate, local star tamer down in the Cape of Stranglethorn, has issued an open challenge to prepared trainers!$b$bYou can find Bill the Pirate in the southern Cape of Stranglethorn, walking the local roads to find potential fights.

identity.title: Level Up!
identity.objectives: Raise a pet to level 3.
identity.description: Good, good. It's important to keep your pets healthy and ready for battle.$b$bMy next task for you is to fight a few battles and raise a pet to level 3.  Once you do that, come back and see me and we can talk about catching your own pets!

Objectives.text: 将一个宠物提升至3级。
Objectives.english: Raise a pet to level 3.

Description.text: 很好，很好。让宠物保持健康以随时应对战斗，这是非常重要的。$b$b我给你安排的下一个任务是，参加几场对决，将一只宠物升到3级。等你做到之后就回来见我，我会告诉你如何捕捉属于你自己的宠物！
Description.english: Good, good. It's important to keep your pets healthy and ready for battle.$b$bMy next task for you is to fight a few battles and raise a pet to level 3.  Once you do that, come back and see me and we can talk about catching your own pets!

identity.title: The Inkmasters of the Arboretum
identity.objectives: Speak with Inkmaster Wei at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
identity.description: I have heard that the Inkmasters at the Arboretum are in need of aid from a scribe of great skill.  You should speak with Inkmaster Wei, if you wish to help.

Objectives.text: 到翠玉林的落英園找水墨大師老魏。
Objectives.english: Speak with Inkmaster Wei at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.

Description.text: 我聽說落英園的水墨大師需要一名出色的書記。若你想幫忙，你該去找水墨大師老魏。
Description.english: I have heard that the Inkmasters at the Arboretum are in need of aid from a scribe of great skill.  You should speak with Inkmaster Wei, if you wish to help.

CompletionLog.text: 到翠玉林的落英園找水墨大師老魏。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Inkmaster Wei at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.

identity.title: Audrey Burnhep
identity.objectives: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.
identity.description: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, $n. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!$B$BReport to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind. She has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

Objectives.text: 去暴风城向奥黛丽·伯恩赫普报到。
Objectives.english: Report to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind.

Description.text: 我恐怕已经没什么可教你的了，$n。但是，你作为宠物训练师的道路还远未走完！$B$B去暴风城向奥黛丽·伯恩赫普报到吧。她跟艾泽拉斯的许多顶尖训练师都有联络，她会帮助你继续前行的。
Description.english: I'm afraid I have nothing left to teach you, $n. However, your journey as a trainer is far from over!$B$BReport to Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind. She has connections with many of Azeroth's finest trainers, and will help you grow further.

identity.title: A Celestial Task
identity.objectives: Earned Revered standing with the Golden Lotus.
identity.description: Are you familiar with the August Celestials? Yu'lon, Chi-Ji, Xuen, and Niuzao watch over the four corners of Pandaria.$B$BThey watch you as well.$B$BTheir knowledge is most ancient, and most powerful. To those they favor, they can bestow enormous power.$B$BYou may seek to earn their trust, but they need you for a more important task.$B$BThe Vale of Eternal Blossoms is in danger. First, we must all defend the Vale. Then, we can turn our eyes to the Celestials themselves.

Objectives.text: 在金莲教阵营达到崇敬声望。
Objectives.english: Earned Revered standing with the Golden Lotus.

Description.text: 你了解至尊天神吗？玉珑、赤精、雪怒和砮皂分别镇守着潘达利亚的四方。$B$B他们也关注着你。$B$B他们具有最古老、最强大的智慧。那些得到他们青睐的人，将获赐强大的力量。$B$B你可以设法赢得他们的信赖，但他们需要你去去完成一个更重要的任务。$B$B锦绣谷正处在危险之中。首先，我们必须全力守卫锦绣谷。然后，我们就能回头去关注天神们本身了。
Description.english: Are you familiar with the August Celestials? Yu'lon, Chi-Ji, Xuen, and Niuzao watch over the four corners of Pandaria.$B$BThey watch you as well.$B$BTheir knowledge is most ancient, and most powerful. To those they favor, they can bestow enormous power.$B$BYou may seek to earn their trust, but they need you for a more important task.$B$BThe Vale of Eternal Blossoms is in danger.
