identity.title: Shackles of the Past
identity.objectives: Free 14 Troubled Slave Spirits.
identity.description:
The mogu are a bunch of right bastards!

They enslaved the pandaren who worked these caves even after their death. Ye' gotta go free their spirits! It's just not right.

Be careful though... so much trauma, they don't know what's a friend and what's an enemy. So they'll probably fight back.

Objectives.text: 解救14个不安的灵奴。
Objectives.english: Free 14 Troubled Slave Spirits.

Description.text:
魔古族就是一群混蛋！

在洞中干活儿的熊猫人即便在死后都要受到他们的奴役。你要去解救他们的灵魂！因为那是不对的。

但你要小心点……那些饱经创伤的灵魂已经分不清敌友了。所以他们可能会反抗。
Description.english:
The mogu are a bunch of right bastards!

They enslaved the pandaren who worked these caves even after their death. Ye' gotta go free their spirits! It's just not right.

Be careful though... so much trauma, they don't know what's a friend and what's an enemy. So they'll probably fight back.

identity.title: Work Order: Fuel
identity.objectives: Find Grizzle Gearslip in Bilgewater Beach.
identity.description: Our fuel supplies are running low. Without fuel we won't be able to operate the machinery that's building this place. They might even expect me to start helping them build!$b$bI was not built for manual labor! See these nails?! I just had them done!$b$bGet down to the refinery and get this fuel order filled! Hurry! They were fitting me for a tool-belt this morning. It didn't even match my outfit!

Objectives.text: 去锈水海滩找格里兹尔·轮滑。
Objectives.english: Find Grizzle Gearslip in Bilgewater Beach.

Description.text: 我们的燃料补给已经不多了。没有燃料我们就无法操作机器进行建设。他们还指望我去动手帮他们造房子呢！$b$b我可不是来干苦力的！看见这些指甲了吗？我刚做的！$b$b快到冶炼厂去，让他们完成这张燃料订单！快点！他们今早还让我试穿了一条工具带。它和我的衣服根本就不搭！
Description.english: Our fuel supplies are running low. Without fuel we won't be able to operate the machinery that's building this place. They might even expect me to start helping them build!$b$bI was not built for manual labor! See these nails?! I just had them done!$b$bGet down to the refinery and get this fuel order filled! Hurry! They were fitting me for a tool-belt this morning. It didn't even match my outfit!

identity.title: Runnin' On Empty
identity.objectives: Retrieve 9 "Distilled" Fuel Barrels from the Blacksand Spillway.
identity.description: I've never seen this quality of oil! Problem is the oil needed a little extra refinin'.$b$bI heard of this system where you use ocean water to speed up the process. I don't have time to waste down here, so I just threw the barrels into the bay.$b$bPretty good idea, I know. Problem is, I'm not sure how to pull it out of the bay...$b$bMaybe someone of your expertise could help me out.

Objectives.text: 从黑沙河口找回9个“纯化”燃料桶。
Objectives.english: Retrieve 9 "Distilled" Fuel Barrels from the Blacksand Spillway.

Description.text: 我从没见过这种品质的燃料！问题是，这些燃料还需要稍微精炼一下。$b$b我听说过使用海水加快精炼过程的做法。而我的时间又很紧迫，所以我就把燃料桶扔到海湾里去了。$b$b很棒的主意，对吧？我知道。问题是，我不知道怎么把他们从海湾里捞出来了……$b$b或许你的经验能够帮到我？
Description.english: I've never seen this quality of oil! Problem is the oil needed a little extra refinin'.$b$bI heard of this system where you use ocean water to speed up the process. I don't have time to waste down here, so I just threw the barrels into the bay.$b$bPretty good idea, I know. Problem is, I'm not sure how to pull it out of the bay...$b$bMaybe someone of your expertise could help me out.

CompletionLog.text: 去统御岗哨找女工头翠克西尔。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Boss-Lady Trixel in Domination Point.

identity.title: Work Order: Lumber
identity.objectives: Find Zino "The Shredder" Quickchop in the Lumber Farm.
identity.description: Everyday it's the same thing! "We're out of this!", "We need more of that!", "Why don't you ever do anything?!"$b$bI work! I do things! They can be so hurtful! I'm doin' my best down here!$b$bOh yeah, we need more lumber! Go down and tell that good for nothin' Zino to get his shredders in gear!

Objectives.text: 去伐木场找“伐木机”兹诺·快锯。
Objectives.english: Find Zino "The Shredder" Quickchop in the Lumber Farm.

Description.text: 天天都是这样！“这个没了！”，“我们还要点儿那个！”，“你怎么老不干活？！”$b$b我在干活！我在做事！他们真是太伤人了！我已经在尽力而为了！$b$b噢，对了，我们需要更多木材！快到下面去告诉那个一无是处的兹诺，让他赶紧把他的伐木机开动起来！
Description.english: Everyday it's the same thing! "We're out of this!", "We need more of that!", "Why don't you ever do anything?!"$b$bI work! I do things! They can be so hurtful! I'm doin' my best down here!$b$bOh yeah, we need more lumber! Go down and tell that good for nothin' Zino to get his shredders in gear!

identity.title: Stacked!
identity.objectives: Gather 9 Pieces of Domination Point Lumber from the Lumber Farm.
identity.description: We just filled an order this morning. How could they possibly need more already?!$b$bMy team has been workin' double-time to get these trees chopped and processed.$b$bProblem is we have an infestation of Lion's Landing troops down here. I already risked my neck once today, I'm not goin' back out there!$b$bGoob will go with you and help you fill this order. He's not the brightest, but he can do the heavy liftin'.

Objectives.text: 在伐木场收集9堆统御岗哨木材。
Objectives.english: Gather 9 Pieces of Domination Point Lumber from the Lumber Farm.

Description.text: 我们今早刚完成了一份订单。他们怎么又跑来要了？！$b$b我的团队已经在加班加点地砍伐加工树木了。问题是雄狮港的部队一直在干扰我们的工作。我今天已经冒过一次掉脑袋的风险了，我可不想再回去了！$b$b古布会跟你去，帮你完成订单的。他不是很聪明，但搬搬抗抗还是没问题的。
Description.english: We just filled an order this morning. How could they possibly need more already?!$b$bMy team has been workin' double-time to get these trees chopped and processed.$b$bProblem is we have an infestation of Lion's Landing troops down here. I already risked my neck once today, I'm not goin' back out there!$b$bGoob will go with you and help you fill this order. He's not the brightest, but he can do the heavy liftin'.

identity.title: Work Order: Iron
identity.objectives: Find Daxil "The Gem" Oregrind near Oregrind's Dig.
identity.description: When they said they found some amazing rocks in that mine I envisioned diamonds. Everyone knows all mines have diamonds, silly! At the very least rubies!$b$bInstead, all I got was this strange iron! What am I supposed to do with this?$b$bOh well, no one said this job would be glamorous. I just do what I can to add a little class.$b$bWe just got another work order for iron. Go see Daxil down near Oregrind's Dig and get it filled pronto!

Objectives.text: 去奥格林德挖掘场附近找“宝石”达克希尔·研矿。
Objectives.english: Find Daxil "The Gem" Oregrind near Oregrind's Dig.

Description.text: 当他们说自己在矿洞下发现了一些神奇的石头时，我还以为会是钻石。人人都知道，所有的矿洞都该产钻石，蠢货！至少也得有红宝石吧！$b$b结果呢，我得到的只有这些诡异的铁矿石！我要这种东西做什么？$b$b好吧，也没人保证过这个工作会很愉快。我只要尽力而为就行了。$b$b我们刚刚又收到一份铁矿的订单。快去下面的奥格林德挖掘场附近找达克希尔，让他尽快完成订单！
Description.english: When they said they found some amazing rocks in that mine I envisioned diamonds. Everyone knows all mines have diamonds, silly! At the very least rubies!$b$bInstead, all I got was this strange iron! What am I supposed to do with this?$b$bOh well, no one said this job would be glamorous. I just do what I can to add a little class.$b$bWe just got another work order for iron. Go see Daxil down near Oregrind's Dig and get it filled pronto!

identity.title: Power Metal
identity.objectives: Obtain 7 chunks of Energized Ore from Oregrind's Dig.
identity.description: <Daxil narrows her eyes and speaks in a hushed tone.>$b$bSometimes we dig too deep, $c. Sometimes, we uncover something so horrible we wish we hadn't started diggin'...$b$bJust kidding! I mean, don't get me wrong, we did find something unexpected. The ore we're finding down there is not your average run-of-the-mill iron.$b$bThere is just one problem; Shale Spiders! We're struggling to keep these orders filled.$b$bMaybe you can lend us a hand?

Objectives.text: 在奥格林德挖掘场获得7块充能铁矿石。
Objectives.english: Obtain 7 chunks of Energized Ore from Oregrind's Dig.

Description.text: <达克希尔眯起眼睛，压低声音道：>$b$b有时我们向下挖得太深了，$c。我们在下面发现了极其可怕的东西，令所有参与挖掘的人都后悔莫及……$b$b开玩笑的啦！我是说，别误会我的意思，我们真的发现了一些意想不到的东西。我们在那下面发现的东西可不是普通的矿石。$b$b但有一个问题，页岩蜘蛛！我们正在努力完成这些订单。$b$b或许你能帮帮我们？
Description.english: <Daxil narrows her eyes and speaks in a hushed tone.>$b$bSometimes we dig too deep, $c. Sometimes, we uncover something so horrible we wish we hadn't started diggin'...$b$bJust kidding! I mean, don't get me wrong, we did find something unexpected. The ore we're finding down there is not your average run-of-the-mill iron.$b$bThere is just one problem; Shale Spiders! We're struggling to keep these orders filled.$b$bMaybe you can lend us a hand?

identity.title: Siege Damage
identity.objectives: Find a Bilgewater Blasting Cap on a Bilgewater Sapper, and then plant it on a Domination Point Demolisher.
identity.description:
The Horde got the bright idea to send Bilgewater goblins to attack our quarry.

They've been packing heavy explosives - heavy explosives that will react with the ammunition in their demolishers.

Kill the Bilgewater goblins until you find an explosive, plant it on one of the demolishers... and BOOM! Siege ended.

CompletionLog.text: 去卡桑琅丛林的雄狮港找托德曼元帅。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

identity.title: Burn Out!
identity.objectives: Use the Unstable Explosive to destroy the Northestern Fuel Tank, Northern Fuel Tank, and the Northwestern Fuel Tank.
identity.description: Those goblins are gettin' out of hand! First they level the forest and set up that abomination of a rig. Then, they start dumpin' their oil barrels into the bay!$b$bWe got to put a stop to this madness! At the very least we need ta set them back.$b$bWe need to take out their fuel supply! Maybe you'll even get to kill a few goblins in the process!

Objectives.text: 使用不稳定的炸药摧毁东北方油罐、西北方油罐以及北方油罐。
Objectives.english: Use the Unstable Explosive to destroy the Northestern Fuel Tank, Northern Fuel Tank, and the Northwestern Fuel Tank.

Description.text: 那些地精真是无法无天！他们先是夷平了森林，建起了那座恶心的机器。现在，他们又开始把油桶扔进海湾里！$b$b我们必须阻止这种疯狂行径！至少也得拖延一下他们的进度。$b$b我们要销毁他们的燃料，没准还可以顺手解决掉几个地精！
Description.english: Those goblins are gettin' out of hand! First they level the forest and set up that abomination of a rig. Then, they start dumpin' their oil barrels into the bay!$b$bWe got to put a stop to this madness! At the very least we need ta set them back.$b$bWe need to take out their fuel supply! Maybe you'll even get to kill a few goblins in the process!

identity.title: It's Only Right
identity.objectives: Retrieve 7 Shieldwall Soldier Dog Tags from the Fallen Shieldwall Soldiers in and around Bilgewater Beach.
identity.description: This is barbaric warfare, $c! We've lost so many trying to keep the Bilgewater operation from spreading any further.$b$bThose fallen soldiers fought honorably and deserved to be given their last rights. At the very least we need to be able to notify their next of kin.$b$bPerhaps you can collect their identification tags so we can honor them in some small way.

Objectives.text: 从锈水海滩的阵亡的神盾士兵身上收集7枚神盾士兵狗牌。
Objectives.english: Retrieve 7 Shieldwall Soldier Dog Tags from the Fallen Shieldwall Soldiers in and around Bilgewater Beach.

Description.text: 这是一场野蛮的战争，$c！为了防止锈水财阀继续扩张，我们已经牺牲了许多战士。$b$b那些阵亡的士兵都曾英勇奋战，理应得到临终关怀。至少，我们得将死讯通知他们的亲人。$b$b或许你能帮我们去收集一下他们的身份牌？至少让我们可以简单地向他们致敬。
Description.english: This is barbaric warfare, $c! We've lost so many trying to keep the Bilgewater operation from spreading any further.$b$bThose fallen soldiers fought honorably and deserved to be given their last rights. At the very least we need to be able to notify their next of kin.$b$bPerhaps you can collect their identification tags so we can honor them in some small way.

identity.title: The Only Good Goblin...
identity.objectives: Kill 10 Bilgewater Goblins in and around Bilgewater Beach.
identity.description: The destruction in Krasarang is unforgivable, $c. The only way to put an end to this is to destroy the Bilgewater operation.$b$bThis is for the greater good of Pandaria and the Alliance. Go to Bilgewater Beach and cut them down! No doubt the Horde will come to their assistance.$b$bDestroy them!

Objectives.text: 在锈水海滩击败10个锈水地精。
Objectives.english: Kill 10 Bilgewater Goblins in and around Bilgewater Beach.

Description.text: 卡桑琅所受到的破坏是不可原谅的，$c。阻止这场悲剧的唯一方法就是摧毁锈水公司。$b$b这是为了潘达利亚和联盟的福祉。快去锈水海滩干掉他们！部落肯定会去支援他们。$b$b把他们一块儿消灭掉！
Description.english: The destruction in Krasarang is unforgivable, $c. The only way to put an end to this is to destroy the Bilgewater operation.$b$bThis is for the greater good of Pandaria and the Alliance. Go to Bilgewater Beach and cut them down! No doubt the Horde will come to their assistance.$b$bDestroy them!

identity.title: Two Step Program
identity.objectives: Destroy Shredmaster Packle in Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
identity.description: Shredmaster Packle is responsible for much of the devastation down there, $c.$b$bRumor has it he modified the shredders to work more quickly with less regard for the collateral damage they can inflict.$b$bImagine the agony the trees must endure being hacked at. It will be difficult to recover from this level of destruction.$b$bThe first step in any recovery is acknowledging the problem. Step two is eliminating that problem.

Objectives.text: 消灭快锯伐木场的粉碎大师帕克尔。
Objectives.english: Destroy Shredmaster Packle in Quickchop's Lumber Farm.

Description.text: 这里大部分的植被破坏都要归咎于伐木大师帕克尔，$c。$b$b据说他改进了伐木机，提高了它的工作效率，却完全不考虑它可能带来的副作用。$b$b想想这些树木被滥砍滥伐时的痛苦吧。这种程度的破坏是很难恢复的。$b$b一切修复工作的第一步永远是确认问题，而第二步则是消灭问题。
Description.english: Shredmaster Packle is responsible for much of the devastation down there, $c.$b$bRumor has it he modified the shredders to work more quickly with less regard for the collateral damage they can inflict.$b$bImagine the agony the trees must endure being hacked at. It will be difficult to recover from this level of destruction.$b$bThe first step in any recovery is acknowledging the problem. Step two is eliminating that problem.

identity.title: Beastmaster's Hunt: The Crane
identity.objectives: Obtain 5 Pristine Golden Crownfeathers and a Pristine Jet Crownfeather.
identity.description: Along with the snare, you get some advice on crane hunting:$b$bThe greatest cranes of the Krasarang Wilds are not tempted by simple things like food. You will need to play on the creatures' emotions if you wish to draw them from their hiding places in the jungle.$b$bCranes abound on both the Cradle of Chi-ji and the Narsong Spires, both of which can be found east of here. Pluck those cranes' quills, then place them in a visible spot near the Crane Temple. Your quarry will come running to you.

CompletionLog.text: 将完整的羽毛带去朱鹤寺南方的海滩。
CompletionLog.english: Bring the pristine feathers to the shore south of the Temple of the Red Crane.

identity.title: End of an Elder
identity.objectives: Speak with Jorn Skyseer at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
identity.description: The tiger has fallen.

Objectives.text: 去卡桑琅丛林的统御岗哨与乔恩·星眼谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Jorn Skyseer at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

Description.text: 这只老虎已经倒下了。
Description.english: The tiger has fallen.

identity.title: Mystery Meatloaf
identity.objectives: Obtain 7 Chunks of Mystery Meat from the local wildlife.
identity.description: We've been gettin' complaints right and left that the Boss-Lady gets all the good grub and leaves the scraps for the others.$b$bBetween you and I, they may be onto somethin' here. I don't even get to eat as good as she does!$b$bWe need somethin' Sezik can make a lot of that at least attempts to disguise how inedible the food is here...$b$bI got it! Mystery Meatloaf!

Objectives.text: 从当地的野生动物身上收集7份神秘肉块。
Objectives.english: Obtain 7 Chunks of Mystery Meat from the local wildlife.

Description.text: 我们收到了大量的抱怨，说女工头只知道自己吃肉，让别人喝汤。$b$b我也就跟你说说，他们可能在秘密地搞什么勾当。我甚至都吃不惯她那么好的伙食！$b$b我们需要一些材料，至少能让塞兹克掩饰一下这里的食物有多么难以下咽……$b$b我想到了！神秘肉卷！
Description.english: We've been gettin' complaints right and left that the Boss-Lady gets all the good grub and leaves the scraps for the others.$b$bBetween you and I, they may be onto somethin' here. I don't even get to eat as good as she does!$b$bWe need somethin' Sezik can make a lot of that at least attempts to disguise how inedible the food is here...$b$bI got it! Mystery Meatloaf!

identity.title: One Magical, Flying Kingdom's Trash...
identity.objectives: Speak with Barnaby Fletcher to learn more about Portal Shards.
identity.description: Before we enter into a business relationship, I am required by the terms of my rehabilitation program to inform you that I am a recovering potion addict.$B$BThere, now that THAT's out of the way, let's talk portals!$B$BYou see, the big portals in the cities - the ones running all day and night - leak tons of magical energy. It crystallizes around the edges and is generally regarded as trash.$B$BBut I noticed during my, uh... hiatus in the sewers of Dalaran, that these shards still had power.$B$BInterested?

Title.text: 来自浮空魔法城的垃圾……

Objectives.text: 与巴纳比·弗莱彻交谈，进一步了解传送门碎片。
Objectives.english: Speak with Barnaby Fletcher to learn more about Portal Shards.

Description.text: 在我们开始谈生意之前，按照我的康复疗程要求，我必须先告知你，我是一个治疗药水成瘾者。$B$B你瞧，既然我们已经把话说开了，那我们就来谈谈传送门吧！$B$B你知道的，主城中的那些大型传送门都是日夜运转的，所以会施放出大量魔法能量。因此它们的边缘为止会生成一些结晶——通常人们都把它们看做垃圾。$B$B可我在，呃……在达拉然下水道短暂停留期间，我注意到这些碎片也是含有能量的。$B$B怎么样？你有兴趣吗？
Description.english: Before we enter into a business relationship, I am required by the terms of my rehabilitation program to inform you that I am a recovering potion addict.$B$BThere, now that THAT's out of the way, let's talk portals!$B$BYou see, the big portals in the cities - the ones running all day and night - leak tons of magical energy. It crystallizes around the edges and is generally regarded as trash.$B$BBut I noticed during my, uh... hiatus in the sewers of Dalaran, that these shards still had power.$B$BInterested?

CompletionLog.text: 与半山市集的巴纳比·弗莱彻谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Barnaby Fletcher in Halfhill Market.

identity.title: Krasarang Steampot
identity.objectives: Obtain 5 chunks of Polluted Viseclaw Meat from the Viseclaw crabs on Bilgewater Beach.
identity.description: The Boss-Lady desires crabs!$b$bWhy are you looking at me like that? It's not uncommon for a classy person, such as her loveliness, to want crab for dinner. What did you think I meant?$b$bThere are some big crabs wandering around on Bilgewater Beach that should be suitable for her refined palate.$b$bBring Sezik the best crab meat you can find!

Objectives.text: 从锈水海滩的钳爪蟹身上收集5块被污染的钳爪蟹肉。
Objectives.english: Obtain 5 chunks of Polluted Viseclaw Meat from the Viseclaw crabs on Bilgewater Beach.

Description.text: 女工头想要吃螃蟹！$b$b你干嘛那么看着我？像那位美人这样的上等人想吃个螃蟹是很平常的。你以为我是什么意思？$b$b锈水海滩上游荡着许多大螃蟹。它们应该能够满足她挑剔的口味。$b$b快帮塞兹克带些最好的蟹肉回来！
Description.english: The Boss-Lady desires crabs!$b$bWhy are you looking at me like that? It's not uncommon for a classy person, such as her loveliness, to want crab for dinner. What did you think I meant?$b$bThere are some big crabs wandering around on Bilgewater Beach that should be suitable for her refined palate.$b$bBring Sezik the best crab meat you can find!

identity.title: This Just Won't Do
identity.objectives: Kill any 8 Zandalari trolls within Conqueror's Terrace.
identity.description: The Zandalari here are very powerful, $c. They should not be underestimated. We cannot afford to ignore them as a threat simply because they do not wield swords.$b$bMore arrive every day, and with them centuries of magic knowledge. This threat must be dealt with, and quickly.$b$bAid us in clearing this area, $c. Perhaps we can even learn something from them in the process.

Objectives.text: 在征服者平台击败任意8个赞达拉巨魔。
Objectives.english: Kill any 8 Zandalari trolls within Conqueror's Terrace.

Description.text: 这里的赞达拉巨魔非常强大，$c，绝对不可小觑。我们不能因为他们赤手空拳而忽视他们的威胁。$b$b每天都有大量巨魔涌来，带着他们积累了数个世纪的魔法知识。我们必须尽快应对这一威胁。$b$b帮助我们清扫这一地区，$c。或许我们还能在这个过程中了解一些他们的内情。
Description.english: The Zandalari here are very powerful, $c. They should not be underestimated. We cannot afford to ignore them as a threat simply because they do not wield swords.$b$bMore arrive every day, and with them centuries of magic knowledge. This threat must be dealt with, and quickly.$b$bAid us in clearing this area, $c. Perhaps we can even learn something from them in the process.

identity.title: Maximum Capacitor
identity.objectives: Interact with the three lightning drills in the Ghost Iron Mines to destroy them, and kill Metal Lord Mono-Han.
identity.description:
The mines north of here are being used to extract Ghost Iron ore and energize it with lightning energy.

We need to destroy the drills they use to extract the ore. They are impervious to normal attack, but can be overloaded using the proper methods.

Oh - and while you're there, take out whoever is running the operation.

Objectives.text: 在闪电矿脉中与3个闪电钻头相互作用以摧毁它们，并击败金铁领主莫诺汗。
Objectives.english: Interact with the three lightning drills in the Ghost Iron Mines to destroy them, and kill Metal Lord Mono-Han.

Description.text:
魔古族正在北边的矿脉源源不断地开采幽冥铁，并用闪电力量为其充能。

我们要摧毁他们用来采矿的钻头。普通的攻击对其并无影响，但却可以通过适当的方法使其过载。

噢——你在那里的时候，记得顺手把在那里活动的敌人全干掉。
Description.english:
The mines north of here are being used to extract Ghost Iron ore and energize it with lightning energy.

We need to destroy the drills they use to extract the ore. They are impervious to normal attack, but can be overloaded using the proper methods.

Oh - and while you're there, take out whoever is running the operation.

identity.title: Nalak the Storm Lord
identity.objectives: [PH] Kill Nalak [Log Description]
identity.description: [PH] Kill Nalak [Description]

identity.title: Bilgewater Infiltrators
identity.objectives: Kill 10 SI: 7 Saboteurs around Domination Point and Bilgewater Beach.
identity.description: There is nothing more unnerving than walking along, minding your own business, and hearing someone following you. I swear I hear it all over the place down here! We're being watched!$B$BI have a feeling the entire beach is just crawling with spies!$b$bI made some improvements to our infrared goggle tech to put an end to the sabotogery. That's right sabotogery! Now I just need you to try 'em out! Feel free to dispose of any spies you happen to catch.

Objectives.text: 在统御岗哨和锈水海滩击败10名军情七处破坏者。
Objectives.english: Kill 10 SI: 7 Saboteurs around Domination Point and Bilgewater Beach.

Description.text: 再也没有比好端端地干着自己的活儿时，听到有人跟踪你更让人紧张的事了。我发誓，我在这下面一直听到类似的动静！我们被监视了！$B$B我有一种感觉，整个海滩上充斥着间谍！$b$b为了制止他们的破坏活动，我制造了一些改良版的红外感温眼镜。没错，我说的就是破坏活动！现在，我只要你来试用一下！至于你抓到的间谍，就随你处置好了。
Description.english: There is nothing more unnerving than walking along, minding your own business, and hearing someone following you. I swear I hear it all over the place down here! We're being watched!$B$BI have a feeling the entire beach is just crawling with spies!$b$bI made some improvements to our infrared goggle tech to put an end to the sabotogery. That's right sabotogery! Now I just need you to try 'em out! Feel free to dispose of any spies you happen to catch.

CompletionLog.text: 去统御岗哨找利维特·急刹。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Rivett Clutchpop in Domination Point.

identity.title: Dark Offerings
identity.objectives: Destroy 6 Zandalari Offerings.
identity.description:
The spirtibinders of the Zandalari perform sacrificial rites to appease the loa and their vile gods. These dark rituals involve the sacrifice of our people.

Destroy any offerings you can find among their tents in Za'Tual and perhaps we can stall the sacrifices.

Objectives.text: 摧毁6份赞达拉供品。
Objectives.english: Destroy 6 Zandalari Offerings.

Description.text:
赞达拉缚灵者通过献祭仪式来取悦神灵和他们的邪神。我们的人民也成了这些黑暗仪式的牺牲品。

把你在赞图尔帐篷间找到的任何供品全都摧毁，这样一来，我们也许就能让献祭无法如期进行。
Description.english:
The spirtibinders of the Zandalari perform sacrificial rites to appease the loa and their vile gods. These dark rituals involve the sacrifice of our people.

Destroy any offerings you can find among their tents in Za'Tual and perhaps we can stall the sacrifices.

identity.title: Soul Surrender
identity.objectives: Save 6 Sunreaver Scouts or Silver Covenant Scouts.
identity.description: We assault the mogu at the Court of Bones, but I fear we merely send them fodder for their abominable rituals.$B$BThe mogu do not merely kill their prisoners - they steal their souls and imbue them in machinations of stone, or reforge the fallen into ghostly tools of war.$B$BHorde or Alliance, it matters not. We cannot allow the mogu to bolster their numbers.$B$BGo into the crypts. Free any prisoners that are still living.

Objectives.text: 解救6名夺日者斥候或银色盟约斥候。
Objectives.english: Save 6 Sunreaver Scouts or Silver Covenant Scouts.

Description.text: 我们攻击了白骨庭院的魔古族，可恐怕只是在给他们那邪恶的仪式输送牺牲品而已。$B$B魔古族不仅会消灭他们的俘虏，还会偷走他们的灵魂，将其注入石头里，图谋不轨，或者将牺牲者铸成幽魂战争武器。$B$B部落也好，联盟也罢，身份并不重要。我们决不能让魔古族扩充军力。$B$B快到墓穴去，救出所有一息尚存的俘虏。
Description.english: We assault the mogu at the Court of Bones, but I fear we merely send them fodder for their abominable rituals.$B$BThe mogu do not merely kill their prisoners - they steal their souls and imbue them in machinations of stone, or reforge the fallen into ghostly tools of war.$B$BHorde or Alliance, it matters not. We cannot allow the mogu to bolster their numbers.$B$BGo into the crypts. Free any prisoners that are still living.

identity.title: Storming the Beach
identity.objectives: Kill any 10 Shieldwall Forces including SI: 7 Saboteurs in and around Bilgewater Beach.
identity.description: Our lumber supply is being jeopardized by constant attacks from Lion's Landing.$b$bWe've been able to keep the attackers at bay, but it's time to really show 'em some muscle!$b$bHead down to the coast and start splitting some skulls!

Objectives.text: 在锈水海滩附近击败任意10名神盾军士兵，包括军情七处破坏者。
Objectives.english: Kill any 10 Shieldwall Forces including SI: 7 Saboteurs in and around Bilgewater Beach.

Description.text: 由于雄狮港的持续骚扰，我们的木材供应有点跟不上了。我们已经挡住了攻击者，现在该是我们展示肌肉的时候了！$b$b快去海滩上砸扁他们！
Description.english: Our lumber supply is being jeopardized by constant attacks from Lion's Landing.$b$bWe've been able to keep the attackers at bay, but it's time to really show 'em some muscle!$b$bHead down to the coast and start splitting some skulls!

identity.title: Wanted: Chief Engineer Cogwrench
identity.objectives: Destroy Chief Engineer Cogwrench at the edge of Bilgewater Beach.
identity.description: Wanted for crimes against the Bilgewater Operation!$b$bChief Engineer Cogwrench was last seen building what appeared to be a giant spider tank on the edge of Bilgewater Beach.$b$bExtreme caution should be used when approaching.$b$bA large reward has been posted for Cogwrench's destruction.

Objectives.text: 前往锈水海滩边缘消灭首席技师轮钳。
Objectives.english: Destroy Chief Engineer Cogwrench at the edge of Bilgewater Beach.

Description.text: 因其对锈水公司所犯罪行，特此通缉首席技师轮钳！$b$b该犯最后一次现身时，正在锈水海滩边缘建造一台疑似蛛形坦克的装置。$b$b任何人接近该犯时必须格外小心。$b$b消灭轮钳者将获得巨额赏金。
Description.english: Wanted for crimes against the Bilgewater Operation!$b$bChief Engineer Cogwrench was last seen building what appeared to be a giant spider tank on the edge of Bilgewater Beach.$b$bExtreme caution should be used when approaching.$b$bA large reward has been posted for Cogwrench's destruction.

CompletionLog.text: 回统御岗哨找血卫士高塔什。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Blood Guard Gro'Tash in Domination Point.

identity.title: Wanted: Lieutenant Ethan Jacobson
identity.objectives: Destroy Lieutenant Ethan Jacobson in the Southern Isles south of Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
identity.description: Wanted for crimes against the Domination Point forces!$b$bLieutenant Ethan Jacobson is responsible for leading several ground assaults against the Bilgewater lumber operation.$b$bLast spotted occupying an island south of Quickchop's Lumber Farm.

Title.text: 通缉：伊桑·雅各布森中尉

Objectives.text: 去快锯伐木场南端的南部岛屿消灭伊桑·雅各布森中尉。
Objectives.english: Destroy Lieutenant Ethan Jacobson in the Southern Isles south of Quickchop's Lumber Farm.

Description.text: 因其对统御岗哨部队犯下的罪行，特此通缉伊桑·雅各布森中尉！$b$b伊桑·雅各布森中尉指挥了数次针对锈水公司伐木场的地面袭击。$b$b该犯最后一次现身时正盘踞在快锯伐木场南边的一座小岛上。
Description.english: Wanted for crimes against the Domination Point forces!$b$bLieutenant Ethan Jacobson is responsible for leading several ground assaults against the Bilgewater lumber operation.$b$bLast spotted occupying an island south of Quickchop's Lumber Farm.

identity.title: The Call of Thunder
identity.objectives: Stop the Shan'ze Thundercallers' ritual.
identity.description: Within the graveyard, in the deepest ruins of their western crypt, the Thunder King's most powerful sorcerers are charging a lightning rod with crackling electricity.$B$BWe suspect that this weapon is meant to rain destruction on our stronghold at Dawnseeker Promontory.$B$BThere is no time to delay. You must stop their ritual at once.

Objectives.text: 阻止山泽唤雷者的仪式。
Objectives.english: Stop the Shan'ze Thundercallers' ritual.

Description.text: 在白骨庭院里，西边墓穴最深处的废墟间，雷电之王麾下最强大的巫师们正在用劈啪作响的电流为一柄闪电权杖充能。$B$B我们怀疑，这把武器将会给我们位于寻晨者海角的据点带来毁灭性的灾难。$B$B没时间耽搁了。你必须立即阻止他们的仪式。
Description.english: Within the graveyard, in the deepest ruins of their western crypt, the Thunder King's most powerful sorcerers are charging a lightning rod with crackling electricity.$B$BWe suspect that this weapon is meant to rain destruction on our stronghold at Dawnseeker Promontory.$B$BThere is no time to delay. You must stop their ritual at once.

identity.title: Trailing Light in the Dark
identity.objectives: Relight 8 torches within the Diremoor.
identity.description: There is some dark magic in the Diremoor that extinguishes even our magical illuminations, and so our scouts struggle to find their way.$B$BAs you pass through the swamp, relight any torches you find that our men might find their way. Perhaps they will help you find your way back as well.

Objectives.text: 重新点亮阴惨泥沼中的8支火炬。
Objectives.english: Relight 8 torches within the Diremoor.

Description.text: 在阴惨泥沼中存在着某种黑暗法术，就连我们的魔法之光都能扑灭，我们的斥候只得艰难的辨识方向。$B$B当你在泥沼中穿行时，重新将你所找到的所有火炬点燃，从而为我们的兄弟们照亮道路。或许它们还能帮你找到回来的路。
Description.english: There is some dark magic in the Diremoor that extinguishes even our magical illuminations, and so our scouts struggle to find their way.$B$BAs you pass through the swamp, relight any torches you find that our men might find their way. Perhaps they will help you find your way back as well.

CompletionLog.text: 回寻晨者海角找魔导师哈瑟尔。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promitory.

identity.title: What's Inside Counts
identity.objectives: Destroy Guardian Tak'u in Conqueror's Terrace.
identity.description: I noticed something strange on my last scouting mission. A group of Zandalari are performing a ritual on what appears to be a very large sentry. They may be trying to re-animate it.$b$bWe need that ritual stopped and the sentry destroyed. Anything that large can't be good.$b$bI've sent a scout ahead to observe their actions. Meet with her and figure out how to stop them.

Objectives.text: 摧毁征服者平台的守护者塔克乌。
Objectives.english: Destroy Guardian Tak'u in Conqueror's Terrace.

Description.text: 我在上一次侦察时发现了一些奇怪的事。一群赞达拉巨魔正在对一个看上去像是巨型哨兵的玩意儿举行仪式。他们或许是在试图复活它。$b$b我们得阻止那个仪式，并摧毁那个哨兵。那么巨大的家伙多半不是什么好东西。$b$b我已经派斥候提前去打探他们的行动了。去与她会合，看看如何才能阻止他们。
Description.english: I noticed something strange on my last scouting mission. A group of Zandalari are performing a ritual on what appears to be a very large sentry. They may be trying to re-animate it.$b$bWe need that ritual stopped and the sentry destroyed. Anything that large can't be good.$b$bI've sent a scout ahead to observe their actions. Meet with her and figure out how to stop them.

identity.title: Very Disarming
identity.objectives: Steal 7 Loa-Infused Blades from Conqueror's Terrace.
identity.description: Look around you, $c. What do you see? I see an opportunity.$b$bThe casters here work to imbue the Zandalari weapons with powerful magic. As if a sharp blade isn't enough to cut even the strongest foe down to size.$b$bIn my scouting I've noticed the weapons are not very well guarded. This is where you come in...$b$bIf we can steal a few of these weapons we may be able to use them. At the very least they are out of enemy hands.

Objectives.text: 从征服者平台偷取7把灌注神力的利刃。
Objectives.english: Steal 7 Loa-Infused Blades from Conqueror's Terrace.

Description.text: 看看周围吧，$c。你看到了什么？我看到的是机遇。$b$b这里的施法者正在使用强大的魔法给赞达拉武器灌魔，好像这些锋利的武器还不足以将最强大的战士切成两半似的。$b$b在我的侦探过程中，我发现他们对这些武器的看守并不严密。这就需要你出马了……$b$b如果能偷到一些这种武器，或许我们也可以使用它们。至少，也可以防止它们落入敌人的手里。
Description.english: Look around you, $c. What do you see? I see an opportunity.$b$bThe casters here work to imbue the Zandalari weapons with powerful magic. As if a sharp blade isn't enough to cut even the strongest foe down to size.$b$bIn my scouting I've noticed the weapons are not very well guarded. This is where you come in...$b$bIf we can steal a few of these weapons we may be able to use them. At the very least they are out of enemy hands.

identity.title: Knowledge Is Power
identity.objectives: Retrieve 6 Ritual Artifacts from around Conqueror's Terrace.
identity.description: The Zandalari here practice a different kind of magic. We must understand it before we can defeat it, $c.$b$bTheir control over the arcane and shadow is impressive. I wish to learn how they have achieved what so many others have not.$b$bI believe their ritual artifacts may hold the answers I seek. Bring me a sampling of the artifacts you find, and I will ensure you are rewarded properly.

Objectives.text: 在征服者平台附近夺取6件仪式神器。
Objectives.english: Retrieve 6 Ritual Artifacts from around Conqueror's Terrace.

Description.text: 这里的赞达拉巨魔所使用的魔法非常与众不同。$c，要想击败它，我们必须先了解它，$c。$b$b他们对奥术和暗影的控制力十分惊人。我很想知道他们是怎么做到这一点的，这可是众多施法者梦寐以求的境界。$b$b我认为他们的仪式神器或许就藏着我想要的答案。给我带一些神器样品回来，我保证会好好奖励你的。
Description.english: The Zandalari here practice a different kind of magic. We must understand it before we can defeat it, $c.$b$bTheir control over the arcane and shadow is impressive. I wish to learn how they have achieved what so many others have not.$b$bI believe their ritual artifacts may hold the answers I seek. Bring me a sampling of the artifacts you find, and I will ensure you are rewarded properly.

identity.title: Bug Off!
identity.objectives: Spray 5 Agitated Shale Spiders with the Bug Off Sprayer and eradicate 12 Shale Shards.
identity.description: This cave is crawlin' with nasty shale spiders! How's a girl supposed to get any work done with them gobbling up the miners AND the ore?!$b$bThis seemed like a good opportunity to use my newest invention, Bug Off. See, all you have to do is spray this stuff all over the shale spiders. They hate it and it doesn't seem to have many long term side-effects for the miners!$b$bWhat could possibly go wrong?$b$bTake this handy sprayer and get to work!

Objectives.text: 对5名兴奋的页岩蛛使用驱虫剂，消灭15只页岩小蜘蛛。
Objectives.english: Spray 5 Agitated Shale Spiders with the Bug Off Sprayer and eradicate 12 Shale Shards.

Description.text: 这座洞穴里爬满了恶心的页岩蛛！有这些不断吞噬矿工和矿石的家伙在，我一个姑娘家怎么可能完得成工作嘛？！$b$b不过，这倒是个测试我的新发明——除虫喷剂的好机会。你要做的很简单，就是把试剂对着那些蜘蛛喷就是了。这种喷剂可以驱赶页岩蛛，而且对矿工没有多少长期副作用！$b$b所以，怎么可能会出麻烦呢？$b$b拿上这个便携式喷雾器，然后去干活儿吧！
Description.english: This cave is crawlin' with nasty shale spiders! How's a girl supposed to get any work done with them gobbling up the miners AND the ore?!$b$bThis seemed like a good opportunity to use my newest invention, Bug Off. See, all you have to do is spray this stuff all over the shale spiders. They hate it and it doesn't seem to have many long term side-effects for the miners!$b$bWhat could possibly go wrong?$b$bTake this handy sprayer and get to work!

identity.title: Precious Resource
identity.objectives: Tighten 8 Faulty Valves in and around Gearslip's Gusher.
identity.description: What we have here is too much of a good thing, $n!$b$bOur rig just can't handle the amount of oil we're pumping out of the ground. It's literally bursting at the seams! To be more accurate, it's bursting at the valves.$b$bI've been working double-time to get the valves repaired, but every time I finish the rounds, they're all broken again.$b$bIt's as if someone is following me... That's ridiculous though....$b$bMaybe you'll have better luck. Try getting as many of those valves tightened as you can.

Objectives.text: 在轮滑油井周围拧紧8个故障阀门。
Objectives.english: Tighten 8 Faulty Valves in and around Gearslip's Gusher.

Description.text: 我们在这里可是大丰收啊，$n！$b$b我们的油井几乎应付不了泵出地面的大量原油。这是真正的井喷！或者更确切地说，是阀喷。$b$b我已经在加班抢修阀门了，可每次我刚修好，它们就又坏了。$b$b简直好像有人在跟着我搞破坏似的……不过这完全是无稽之谈……$b$b或许你的运气会好一些。请尽力去多拧紧一些阀门吧。
Description.english: What we have here is too much of a good thing, $n!$b$bOur rig just can't handle the amount of oil we're pumping out of the ground. It's literally bursting at the seams! To be more accurate, it's bursting at the valves.$b$bI've been working double-time to get the valves repaired, but every time I finish the rounds, they're all broken again.$b$bIt's as if someone is following me... That's ridiculous though....$b$bMaybe you'll have better luck. Try getting as many of those valves tightened as you can.

CompletionLog.text: 去锈水海滩找比克希·圆锯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Bixy Buzzsaw in Bilgewater Beach.

identity.title: Universal Remote-Explode
identity.objectives: Destroy 9 Shieldwall Mecha-Pounders in and around Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
identity.description: The Mecha-Pounders are really making things difficult down here, but I think I may have the solution!$b$bI made this universal remote for myself, but it looks like I hit a specific frequency that has an useful result!$b$bApparently this frequency weakens their armor!$b$bUse the remote to take them down a few notches then punch 'em in the face!

Objectives.text: 去快锯伐木场摧毁9个神盾机械碾压者。
Objectives.english: Destroy 9 Shieldwall Mecha-Pounders in and around Quickchop's Lumber Farm.

Description.text: 机械碾压者的确给我们造成了一些麻烦，可我想我能解决！$b$b我自制了一个通用遥控器，不过我似乎碰巧接入了一个特殊的频段。它对我们非常有用！$b$b显然这个频段能够削弱他们的护甲！$b$b快用这遥控器给他们留下点记号，然后干掉他们！
Description.english: The Mecha-Pounders are really making things difficult down here, but I think I may have the solution!$b$bI made this universal remote for myself, but it looks like I hit a specific frequency that has an useful result!$b$bApparently this frequency weakens their armor!$b$bUse the remote to take them down a few notches then punch 'em in the face!

identity.title: Breaking Down the Defenses
identity.objectives: Destroy 6 Kirin Tor Perimeter Wards.
identity.description: We need to keep a close watch on the Kirin Tor and their day-to-day activities. Normally this would be easy. We would sneak in a spy and have them report back to us.$b$bHowever, we've run into a slight problem I believe you can help us with.$b$bThe Kirin Tor perimeter wards have increased in power. It's next to impossible to get someone past their lines. If they were disabled we might be able to sneak in before they can be repaired.

Objectives.text: 摧毁6个肯瑞托监视结界。
Objectives.english: Destroy 6 Kirin Tor Perimeter Wards.

Description.text: 我们必须对肯瑞托和他们的日常活动严加监视。这通常并不难做到。只要派个间谍溜进去，把情报带回来就行了。$b$b然而，我们眼下却遇到了一个小麻烦，相信你能帮忙解决。$b$b肯瑞托监视结界变得强大起来了。现在要想派人闯过他们的防线，简直比登天还难。要是能令这些结界失效，我们也许就能趁它们被修复前溜进去。
Description.english: We need to keep a close watch on the Kirin Tor and their day-to-day activities. Normally this would be easy. We would sneak in a spy and have them report back to us.$b$bHowever, we've run into a slight problem I believe you can help us with.$b$bThe Kirin Tor perimeter wards have increased in power. It's next to impossible to get someone past their lines. If they were disabled we might be able to sneak in before they can be repaired.

identity.title: Metalocalypse
identity.objectives: Kill Metal Lord Mono-Han outside the Ghost Iron Mine on the Isle of the Thunder King.
identity.description:
You've made a good start, but now it's time to really make a dent in their operations.

Take out Metal Lord Mono-Han,  of the mines.

Objectives.text: 去雷神岛的闪电矿脉击败金铁领主莫诺汗。
Objectives.english: Kill Metal Lord Mono-Han outside the Ghost Iron Mine on the Isle of the Thunder King.

Description.text:
你有了一个很好的开端，但现在该是真正进一步干扰他们行动的时候了。

快去矿脉那里干掉金铁领主莫诺汗。
Description.english:
You've made a good start, but now it's time to really make a dent in their operations.

Take out Metal Lord Mono-Han,  of the mines.

identity.title: Fleshcrafter's End
identity.objectives: Kill Fleshcrafter Goju outside the Ghost Iron Mines on the Isle of the Thunder King.
identity.description:
The mogu responsible for the torture of the agents, Fleshcrafter Goju, stands outside the mine.

Killing him would be the only justice for what he's done to your agents.

Objectives.text: 去雷神岛的闪电矿脉外击败塑肌者霍古。
Objectives.english: Kill Fleshcrafter Goju outside the Ghost Iron Mines on the Isle of the Thunder King.

Description.text:
那个拷打密探的魔古族，塑肌者霍古就站在矿脉外面。

只有消灭他，才能为我们的密探伸张正义。
Description.english:
The mogu responsible for the torture of the agents, Fleshcrafter Goju, stands outside the mine.

Killing him would be the only justice for what he's done to your agents.

identity.title: Compy Stomp
identity.objectives: Kill 5 Raptors and 10 Trained Compies in the Beast Pens.
identity.description: The raptors and compies of the Zandalari represent a substantial threat to our forces here. They are superb hunting beasts that can track prey over great distances and are often lethal to encounter when caught unawares.$b$bI need you to head into the Beast Pens and cull their numbers. We need to make sure to slay them before they are fully trained.

Objectives.text: 在兽栏杀死5只迅猛龙和10只训练有素的掠食龙。
Objectives.english: Kill 5 Raptors and 10 Trained Compies in the Beast Pens.

Description.text: 赞达拉的迅猛龙和掠食龙是对我们部队的重大威胁。它们是出色的狩猎者，能够长途追踪猎物，对毫无准备的目标尤为致命。$b$b我需要你前往兽栏减少那里的恐龙数量。我们要在训练完成前先干掉它们。
Description.english: The raptors and compies of the Zandalari represent a substantial threat to our forces here. They are superb hunting beasts that can track prey over great distances and are often lethal to encounter when caught unawares.$b$bI need you to head into the Beast Pens and cull their numbers. We need to make sure to slay them before they are fully trained.

identity.title: Loa-saur
identity.objectives: Defeat a Loa Speaker.
identity.description: The Zandalari have found a way to bind loa to their beasts giving them impressive and lethal powers.$b$bWe need to put a stop to this.$b$bSearch the Beast Pens for a loa speaker and slay him. You should be able to find them by keeping a look out for their glowing beasts.$b$bWe must not allow these atrocities to continue.

Objectives.text: 击败一名神谕者。
Objectives.english: Defeat a Loa Speaker.

Description.text: 赞达拉巨魔发现了一种将神灵束缚在野兽体内的方法，这可以让它们获得惊人而致命的力量。$b$b我们必须阻止他们。$b$b去兽栏寻找一个神谕者并击败他。你可以通过那些发光的野兽来辨认找到他们。$b$b我们不能让这样的暴行继续下去。
Description.english: The Zandalari have found a way to bind loa to their beasts giving them impressive and lethal powers.$b$bWe need to put a stop to this.$b$bSearch the Beast Pens for a loa speaker and slay him. You should be able to find them by keeping a look out for their glowing beasts.$b$bWe must not allow these atrocities to continue.

identity.title: Raining Bones
identity.objectives: Kill Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter.
identity.description: We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.$B$BWould you be willing to do the deed?

Objectives.text: 消灭锻骨者祖尔查卡。
Objectives.english: Kill Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter.

Description.text: 我们在中央阶梯上发现了一位赞达拉首领。必须赶在他返回营地前将他消灭。$B$B你愿意去执行这项任务吗？
Description.english: We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.$B$BWould you be willing to do the deed?

CompletionLog.text: 回阴惨泥沼北部找斥候队长艾尔希娅。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Scout Captain Elsia north of the Diremoor.

identity.title: Just Some Light Clean-Up Work
identity.objectives: Disperse 75 pieces of filth by killing Quivering Filth in Ihgaluk Crag.
identity.description: This is not a glamorous job. Let me put it to you bluntly.$b$bThe Skumblade saurok pile all of their filth into a pool in the middle of their village. This filth is so concentrated and so rancid that it has congealed into moving, animate matter.$b$bThe saurok can keep their filth-pool, but once it starts spreading outside of the village, I'd say it's time to intervene.

Objectives.text: 击败伊瓜鲁克峭壁的颤栗污泥怪以分解75块污物。
Objectives.english: Disperse 75 pieces of filth by killing Quivering Filth in Ihgaluk Crag.

Description.text: 我就坦白说吧，这可不是什么好活儿。$b$b邪刃蜥蜴人将他们产生的污物都堆在村子中央的一个坑里。那里的污物太过集中，恶臭熏天，以至于都浓缩成了一种能够移动的活物。$b$b那些蜥蜴人可以留着他们的垃圾坑，可当它扩散到村子外面的时候，那我们就该干涉了。
Description.english: This is not a glamorous job. Let me put it to you bluntly.$b$bThe Skumblade saurok pile all of their filth into a pool in the middle of their village. This filth is so concentrated and so rancid that it has congealed into moving, animate matter.$b$bThe saurok can keep their filth-pool, but once it starts spreading outside of the village, I'd say it's time to intervene.

identity.title: Disarming Irony
identity.objectives: Disarm the Tactical Mana Bombs at the Horde Ships, the Scrying Crystals, and the Bridge within Dawnseeker Promontory.
identity.description: Well, it would seem the Lady Proudmoore has decided to use our own weaponry against us. Our perimeter wards reported several spies slipping through our defenses carrying tactical mana bombs.$b$bI would enjoy the irony if these bombs were less dangerous.$b$bSearch for these bombs and disarm them. Our wards reported one near the horde ships to the north, one on a bridge to the main isle, and one near our scrying crystals on the eastern side of the Promontory.

Objectives.text: 卸除部落舰船、占卜水晶和寻晨者海角桥梁处的战术魔法炸弹。
Objectives.english: Disarm the Tactical Mana Bombs at the Horde Ships, the Scrying Crystals, and the Bridge within Dawnseeker Promontory.

Description.text: 嗯，看来普罗德摩尔女士决定用我们自己的武器对付我们了。我们的监视结界发现，已经有好几位间谍带着战术魔法炸弹偷偷闯过了我们的防线。$b$b要是这些炸弹全都变成哑炮，那就有好戏看了。$b$b去找出这些炸弹，然后将它们一一卸除。守卫们报告说，在北边的部落舰船附近、通往主岛的桥梁附近和位于海角东侧的占卜水晶附近各有一枚魔法炸弹。
Description.english: Well, it would seem the Lady Proudmoore has decided to use our own weaponry against us. Our perimeter wards reported several spies slipping through our defenses carrying tactical mana bombs.$b$bI would enjoy the irony if these bombs were less dangerous.$b$bSearch for these bombs and disarm them. Our wards reported one near the horde ships to the north, one on a bridge to the main isle, and one near our scrying crystals on the eastern side of the Promontory.

identity.title: Made for War
identity.objectives: Kill the Arcane Destroyer.
identity.description: Jaina thinks this battle will be easily won. I intend to show her how wrong she is!$b$bThe Kirin Tor brought a weapon with them that must be destroyed. The Arcane Destroyer is a large construct capable of turning the tides of war in their favor.$b$bDestroying this monstrosity would send a very clear message to Proudmoore.

Objectives.text: 击败奥术毁灭者。
Objectives.english: Kill the Arcane Destroyer.

Description.text: 吉安娜以为自己能轻易打赢这场战斗。我打算让她看看自己错得有多离谱！$b$b肯瑞托手里有一种武器，必须把它摧毁。奥术毁灭者是个体型庞大的构造体，其力量足以扭转战局。$b$b把这个怪物消灭，就能让普罗德摩尔看清形势。
Description.english: Jaina thinks this battle will be easily won. I intend to show her how wrong she is!$b$bThe Kirin Tor brought a weapon with them that must be destroyed. The Arcane Destroyer is a large construct capable of turning the tides of war in their favor.$b$bDestroying this monstrosity would send a very clear message to Proudmoore.

identity.title: The Monkey King
identity.objectives: Help Anduin Wrynn find the Monkey King in the Valley of Emperors.
identity.description: Ever since the Horde captured the Divine Bell I have been searching for a means to counter its power.$b$bMy research got as far as this tomb. I am going inside. If you follow me, I will share the rest as we go.$b$bIf we get separated, meet me back here at the entrance to the tomb. Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.

Objectives.text: 在皇帝谷帮助安度因·乌瑞恩找到美猴王。
Objectives.english: Help Anduin Wrynn find the Monkey King in the Valley of Emperors.

Description.text: 自从部落得到圣钟起，我就一直在寻找克制这件神器的办法。$b$b我的研究全部指向了这座墓穴。我准备进去。如果你跟我一起去，我会在路上向你介绍具体情况。$b$b如果我们走散了，就回到墓穴入口这里来找我。你准备好了就告诉我一声吧。
Description.english: Ever since the Horde captured the Divine Bell I have been searching for a means to counter its power.$b$bMy research got as far as this tomb. I am going inside. If you follow me, I will share the rest as we go.$b$bIf we get separated, meet me back here at the entrance to the tomb. Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.

identity.title: Victorious Return
identity.objectives: Report your success to Nazgrim at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
identity.description: The portal by my side will return you safely to Domination Point. I will return behind you; I must clean up our tracks a bit before we leave, so that Proudmoore doesn't discover our involvement.

Objectives.text: 前往卡桑琅丛林的统御岗哨，向纳兹戈林报告你的成功。
Objectives.english: Report your success to Nazgrim at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

Description.text: 我身边的传送门可以把你安全地送回统御岗哨。你先走，我稍后就来。在离开前，我得先把我们留下的痕迹抹去，以免普罗德摩尔发现我们插手此事。
Description.english: The portal by my side will return you safely to Domination Point. I will return behind you; I must clean up our tracks a bit before we leave, so that Proudmoore doesn't discover our involvement.

identity.title: The Second Riddle: Fellowship
identity.objectives: Obtain Metal Brew.
identity.description: You want to stop the Divine Bell? We need the mallet first.$b$bYou want the mallet? We need to be friends first.$b$bYou want to be friends? We need a Metal brew first. $b$bYou want a Metal brew? You need to go to the Shrine of Fellowship first. $b$bYou want to go to the Shrine of Fellowship? Great! It's in the Jade Forest southeast of the Tian Monastery.$b$bRing the bell and get the Monkey King some brew while there. Oh... you may have to fight for it.

Objectives.text: 获得金铁酒。
Objectives.english: Obtain Metal Brew.

Description.text: 你们想克制那口钟？那我们得先有那柄钟杵。$b$b你们想要钟杵？那我们得先交个朋友。$b$b你们想和我交朋友？那我们先得有一罐金铁酒。$b$b你们想要金铁酒？那你们得先去结义坛。$b$b你们想去结义坛？很好！那地方就在天禅院东南面的翡翠林里。$b$b到了那儿敲钟，然后给美猴王带些酒来。噢……你可能会有架要打。
Description.english: You want to stop the Divine Bell? We need the mallet first.$b$bYou want the mallet? We need to be friends first.$b$bYou want to be friends? We need a Metal brew first. $b$bYou want a Metal brew? You need to go to the Shrine of Fellowship first. $b$bYou want to go to the Shrine of Fellowship? Great! It's in the Jade Forest southeast of the Tian Monastery.$b$bRing the bell and get the Monkey King some brew while there. Oh... you may have to fight for it.

identity.title: The Greatest Prank
identity.objectives: Listen to the Monkey King's story.
identity.description: So riddles three you answered me. Good good. The Monkey King is not so old that he tells just anyone his tricks.$b$bIt was the greatest prank ever!$b$bYou want to hear story of the Mallet and the Monkey? Too bad! No choice!

Objectives.text: 倾听美猴王的故事。
Objectives.english: Listen to the Monkey King's story.

Description.text: 你答出了我的三个谜题。很好很好。美猴王还没老到将自己的把戏到处说的地步。$b$b这可是史上最大的恶作剧！$b$b你想要听钟杵和美猴王的故事？太糟了！没的选择了！
Description.english: So riddles three you answered me. Good good. The Monkey King is not so old that he tells just anyone his tricks.$b$bIt was the greatest prank ever!$b$bYou want to hear story of the Mallet and the Monkey? Too bad! No choice!

identity.title: The Handle
identity.objectives: Recover the Mallet Handle.
identity.description: There once was a Chief named Ingoo Ingoo,$b$bWho beat me in a drink drink boogaloo.$b$bHe took the mallet's handle for winning,$b$bNot knowing you can't beat the King in drinking.$b$bMonkey King had to hide the mallet from the bell,$b$bBut Ingoo's children do not use the handle well.$b$bOver the years they have used the handle to do harm,$b$bNow we must find the current chief so we can disarm.$b$bGo south to Unga Ingoo, Monkey King meet you there.$b$bOnly wikkets show to a party with hands bare.

Objectives.text: 夺回杵柄。
Objectives.english: Recover the Mallet Handle.

Description.text: 很久以前，有一个名叫盎迦盎迦的酋长。$b$b他在拼酒时赢了我。$b$b他就拿走了钟杵的柄作为胜利的奖品。$b$b但你是肯定喝不过美猴王的啦。$b$b美猴王必须藏好钟杵，远离圣钟。$b$b可盎迦的子孙没有好好使用杵柄。$b$b这么多年来，他们一直在用杵柄干坏事。$b$b现在，我们必须找到现任酋长并收缴他手中的杵柄。$b$b到南方的盎迦猴岛去，美猴王在那里等你。$b$b别忘了，只有蠢蛋才会空着手去参加派对哦。
Description.english: There once was a Chief named Ingoo Ingoo,$b$bWho beat me in a drink drink boogaloo.$b$bHe took the mallet's handle for winning,$b$bNot knowing you can't beat the King in drinking.$b$bMonkey King had to hide the mallet from the bell,$b$bBut Ingoo's children do not use the handle well.$b$bOver the years they have used the handle to do harm,$b$bNow we must find the current chief so we can disarm.$b$bGo south to Unga Ingoo, Monkey King meet you there.$b$bOnly wikkets show to a party with hands bare.

identity.title: The Head
identity.objectives: Recover the Mallet Head.
identity.description: Monkey King receive word on where to find the head,$b$bThe hozen who got it has long since been dead. $b$bKunzen chiefs pass the relic from father to son, $b$bBut then virmen Skiggit came and the head it won. $b$bNow the wikket worships it in a hollow. $b$bSince it was too ookin' big for him to swallow. $b$bI sent a royal finder north to find him and stand. $b$bLook for finder in mountains west of the Heartland.

Objectives.text: 夺回杵头。
Objectives.english: Recover the Mallet Head.

Description.text: 美猴王知道该去哪里找杵头了。$b$b得到它的猢狲早就死了。$b$b这件圣物原本在昆森猢狲的酋长间世代相传。$b$b可是兔妖斯基奇特跑来抢走了它。$b$b现在，那个蠢蛋在一座山洞里膜拜它。$b$b就因为这个东西太大了，他吞不下去。$b$b我派了一个皇家搜寻者去北面找他。$b$b你可以去汇风岭西边的山里找他。
Description.english: Monkey King receive word on where to find the head,$b$bThe hozen who got it has long since been dead. $b$bKunzen chiefs pass the relic from father to son, $b$bBut then virmen Skiggit came and the head it won. $b$bNow the wikket worships it in a hollow. $b$bSince it was too ookin' big for him to swallow. $b$bI sent a royal finder north to find him and stand. $b$bLook for finder in mountains west of the Heartland.

identity.title: The Harmonic Ointment
identity.objectives: Recover the Harmonic Ointment.
identity.description: Legends are not born, they are made.$b$BMuch like your next target, a mogu named "The Blade." $b$BIn his bags you will find,$b$bAn ointment whose sound plays with the mind.$b$bBring this nibby ointment to the Monkey King!$b$bAnd with it, he shall make the mallet sing!$b$bTravel north along the wall, and when you reach the end, turn left.

Objectives.text: 夺回祥和药膏。
Objectives.english: Recover the Harmonic Ointment.

Description.text: 传奇不是天生的，它们是创造出来的。$b$B就像你的下一个目标一样。那是一个名叫“刀锋”的魔古。$b$B你可以在他的袋子里找到一种药膏。$b$b这种药膏可以发出惑人心神的声音。$b$b把这种神奇的药膏带回来给美猴王！$b$b有了它，美猴王就可以让钟杵唱歌啦！$b$b沿着长城到北方去，在走到底的地方左转就到了。
Description.english: Legends are not born, they are made.$b$BMuch like your next target, a mogu named "The Blade." $b$BIn his bags you will find,$b$bAn ointment whose sound plays with the mind.$b$bBring this nibby ointment to the Monkey King!$b$bAnd with it, he shall make the mallet sing!$b$bTravel north along the wall, and when you reach the end, turn left.

identity.title: Rebuilding the Mallet (Tracker)
identity.objectives: Obtain the Harmonic Mallet.
identity.description: Time for the fixing and then time for the mixing!

Objectives.text: 获得神圣之杵。
Objectives.english: Obtain the Harmonic Mallet.

Description.text: 修理时间到了，接着则是搅和时间！
Description.english: Time for the fixing and then time for the mixing!

identity.title: Demonstrate Your Power
identity.objectives: Slay the demons who are attacking Akama's men in the Halls of Anguish.
identity.description: Akama and his men are under siege by the forces you unleashed in the Reliquary of Souls. $B$BDemonstrate your power to Akama by saving his men from the demonic forces!

Objectives.text: 在苦痛大厅杀死攻击阿卡玛部下的恶魔。
Objectives.english: Slay the demons who are attacking Akama's men in the Halls of Anguish.

Description.text: 阿卡玛和他的人遭到了你在灵魂之匣所放出部队的围攻。$B$B去向阿卡玛展现一下你的实力，将他的人从恶魔大军中救出来吧！
Description.english: Akama and his men are under siege by the forces you unleashed in the Reliquary of Souls. $B$BDemonstrate your power to Akama by saving his men from the demonic forces!

CompletionLog.text: 回暗影圣殿找阿卡玛。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Akama inside the Sanctuary of Shadows.

identity.title: Ogudei's Lieutenants
identity.objectives: Collect Meng-do's Essence and Gen-li's Essence in the Ruins of Ogudei.
identity.description:
There are two extremely powerful mogu spirits that the Alliance unearthed in their ineptitude.

These are choice targets for us, $c. If you kill them and collect each of their essences, we could make great progress on decoding the history of this strange ruin.

Objectives.text: 去敖骨打废墟收集孟都的精华和庚离的精华。
Objectives.english: Collect Meng-do's Essence and Gen-li's Essence in the Ruins of Ogudei.

Description.text:
那些笨手笨脚的联盟挖出了两个非常强大的魔古幽灵。

这简直是送上门的靶子，$c。如果你能干掉他们，并收集他们的精华，那将对我们揭开这个诡异废墟的历史起到极大的推动作用。
Description.english:
There are two extremely powerful mogu spirits that the Alliance unearthed in their ineptitude.

These are choice targets for us, $c. If you kill them and collect each of their essences, we could make great progress on decoding the history of this strange ruin.

identity.title: We're Not Monsters!
identity.objectives: Liberate 14 Troubled Slave Spirits.
identity.description:
The Reliquary may have had a bad name in the past, but we're not monsters. We simply hold different views about archaeology than the Explorer's League.

We do focus on performing acts of heroism from time to time. So go, liberate some of the pandaren slave spirits in the ruins.

Objectives.text: 解放14个不安的灵奴。
Objectives.english: Liberate 14 Troubled Slave Spirits.

Description.text:
神圣遗物学会过去的名声可能不太好，但我们不是怪物。我们和探险者协会只是对考古的看法不同而已。

我们有时也会见义勇为的。所以，请你去释放废墟里那些熊猫人奴隶的灵魂吧。
Description.english:
The Reliquary may have had a bad name in the past, but we're not monsters. We simply hold different views about archaeology than the Explorer's League.

We do focus on performing acts of heroism from time to time. So go, liberate some of the pandaren slave spirits in the ruins.

identity.title: Tracking Event: Ambassadors Summoned
identity.objectives: See the scouts off, then speak to Big Lu.
identity.description: It's time for Sully and I to leave. We'll keep our eyes out for any sign of the White Pawn and report back shortly.$B$BI'm afraid I must leave you in charge while Admiral Taylor is recovering. Learn as much as you can from these jinyu while we are away. I expect a full report when we return.

Objectives.text: 目送斥候离开，然后与卢山大哥谈一谈。
Objectives.english: See the scouts off, then speak to Big Lu.

Description.text: 我和苏利该出发了。我们会注意寻找白卒留下的一切痕迹并尽快回报。$B$B在海军上将泰勒康复期间，我恐怕只能让你留下来主持大局了。在我们离开的期间，你要尽可能多地多了解这些锦鱼人。我希望当我们回来的时候能得到一份详细的报告。
Description.english: It's time for Sully and I to leave. We'll keep our eyes out for any sign of the White Pawn and report back shortly.$B$BI'm afraid I must leave you in charge while Admiral Taylor is recovering. Learn as much as you can from these jinyu while we are away. I expect a full report when we return.

Objectives.english: See the scouts off, then speak to Big Lu.

Description.text: 我和苏利该出发了。我们会注意寻找白卒留下的一切痕迹并尽快回报。$B$B在海军上将泰勒康复期间，我恐怕只能让你留下来主持大局了。在我们离开的期间，你要尽可能多地多了解这些锦鱼人。我希望当我们回来的时候能得到一份详细的报告。
