Learn as much as you can from these jinyu while we are away. I expect a full report when we return.

identity.title: The Fate of Dalaran
identity.objectives: Speak with Jaina Proudmoore and hear her story.
identity.description: Jaina is refusing to hear me out. Father was hoping I would have some pull with her, but I think she still sees me as a child.$b$bYou, on the other hand, are a hero of the Alliance and I know she respects your deeds.$b$bIs there something you can say to her to convince her we need her help?

Objectives.text: 与吉安娜·普罗德摩尔交谈并倾听她的故事。
Objectives.english: Speak with Jaina Proudmoore and hear her story.

Description.text: 吉安娜拒绝听我解释。虽然父亲以为她能听得进我的话，可我想她还是把我当成了小孩子。$b$b而你不同，作为联盟的英雄，我知道她很敬佩你的事迹。$b$b你能说服她来帮助我们吗？
Description.english: Jaina is refusing to hear me out. Father was hoping I would have some pull with her, but I think she still sees me as a child.$b$bYou, on the other hand, are a hero of the Alliance and I know she respects your deeds.$b$bIs there something you can say to her to convince her we need her help?

identity.title: Pandaren Medicine
identity.objectives: Find the recipe for Memory Wine.
identity.description: While I was in the Vale, I came across an ancient pandaren recipe for Memory Wine. I believe this brew can coax some helpful information out of Shan Kien.$B$BI am needed here, so I have no choice but to ask you to find the ingredients for me.$B$BThe recipe can be found in a book near my other things, just behind me.

Objectives.text: 找到溯源酒的配方。
Objectives.english: Find the recipe for Memory Wine.

Description.text: 我在锦绣谷时，得到了一份酿造溯源酒的熊猫人古方。我相信这种酒能帮我们找出有关单简的有用信息。$B$B这里离不开我，所以我只能请你帮我去收集材料了。$B$B你可以在我身后的某本书里找到配方。
Description.english: While I was in the Vale, I came across an ancient pandaren recipe for Memory Wine. I believe this brew can coax some helpful information out of Shan Kien.$B$BI am needed here, so I have no choice but to ask you to find the ingredients for me.$B$BThe recipe can be found in a book near my other things, just behind me.

identity.title: Memory Wine
identity.objectives: Use the Kor'kron Disguise to enter the camp. Then drink the Memory Brew and witness Shan Kien's past.
identity.description: <The radio static crackles, and Agent Connelly continues speaking.>$B$BNow comes the real challenge, $Gladdie:lassie;. $B$BHead on over to the center of camp and see what you can overhear.

Objectives.text: 使用库卡隆伪装进入营地。然后喝下溯源酒，查看单简的过去。
Objectives.english: Use the Kor'kron Disguise to enter the camp. Then drink the Memory Brew and witness Shan Kien's past.

Description.text: <无线电波喀喀作响，特工康奈利继续说了下去。>$B$B现在，真正的挑战来了，$G伙计:丫头;。$B$B到营地的中央去，看看你能偷听到什么。
Description.english: <The radio static crackles, and Agent Connelly continues speaking.>$B$BNow comes the real challenge, $Gladdie:lassie;. $B$BHead on over to the center of camp and see what you can overhear.

identity.title: The Measure of a Leader
identity.objectives: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists.
identity.description: We've progressed to a new part of the Pandaren campaign. The Alliance has landed on the shores with the full might of its navy. Your King aims to check Horde aggression in this new land.$b$bGarrosh Hellscream is propelling the Horde headfirst into battle, but King Varian Wrynn is a little more of a mystery to me. Do you have a moment? I'd like to talk to you about this leader of yours.

Objectives.text: 去迷雾酒肆与拉希奥谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists.

Description.text: 我们的熊猫人战役已经发展到了新的阶段。联盟的主力舰队已经登陆了海滩。你们的国王想要牵制部落对这片新大陆的侵略。$b$b加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮带着部落一头扎入了战斗，可瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王的行动对我来说却有点神秘。你有时间吗？我想跟你谈谈你们的领袖。
Description.english: We've progressed to a new part of the Pandaren campaign. The Alliance has landed on the shores with the full might of its navy. Your King aims to check Horde aggression in this new land.$b$bGarrosh Hellscream is propelling the Horde headfirst into battle, but King Varian Wrynn is a little more of a mystery to me. Do you have a moment? I'd like to talk to you about this leader of yours.

CompletionLog.text: 去雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆与拉希奥谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

identity.title: A Kor'kron In Our Midst
identity.objectives: Collect 1 Kor'kron Helmet, 1 Kor'kron Armor, and 1 Kor'kron Boots, then combine them into a Kor'kron Disguise.
identity.description: Garrosh is hell-bent on finding that Divine Bell. I wouldn't be surprised if he tore Kun-Lai Summit apart to find that artifact.$B$BThe Warchief's called a gathering at Garrosh'ar Advance, just to our north.$B$BI need to stay here to monitor troop movements, so you'll have to infiltrate their camp and overhear their discussion.$B$BGo to Garrosh'ar Advance and steal some Kor'kron Armor from Reavers, Honor Guards, and Scouts.$B$BTake this radio earpiece. Don't contact me... I'll contact you.

Objectives.text: 收集1个库卡隆头盔、1件库卡隆护甲和1双库卡隆长靴，然后用它们合成库卡隆伪装。
Objectives.english: Collect 1 Kor'kron Helmet, 1 Kor'kron Armor, and 1 Kor'kron Boots, then combine them into a Kor'kron Disguise.

Description.text: 加尔鲁什执意要寻找那座圣钟。即使他为了找那件神器而将昆莱山翻个底朝天，我也不会吃惊。$B$B酋长正在北边的加尔鲁什尔先锋营地的召集部队。$B$B我得留在这里监视部队动向，所以你得潜入他们的营地，偷听他们的谈话。$B$B快去加尔鲁什尔先锋营地，从劫掠者、荣誉守卫和斥候那里窃取库卡隆护甲。$B$B带上这个无线电耳机。别联络我……我会联络你的。
Description.english: Garrosh is hell-bent on finding that Divine Bell. I wouldn't be surprised if he tore Kun-Lai Summit apart to find that artifact.$B$BThe Warchief's called a gathering at Garrosh'ar Advance, just to our north.$B$BI need to stay here to monitor troop movements, so you'll have to infiltrate their camp and overhear their discussion.$B$BGo to Garrosh'ar Advance and steal some Kor'kron Armor from Reavers, Honor Guards, and Scouts.$B$BTake this radio earpiece. Don't contact me... I'll contact you.

identity.title: Bugging Out
identity.objectives: Plant the Cleverly Disguised Bugs in the large tent, near the small tents, and in the supplies.
identity.description: I've managed to plant a few bugs around the camp, but there could always be more.$b$bI disguised the bugs to look like statues. They blend in perfectly with the other artifacts lying around.$b$bYour disguise should allow you to move freely around the camp. Just don't go near the dog and don't linger around Garrosh! Nero and Garrosh will see through your disguise.$b$bIf you get caught I can't help you. I can't compromise the mission!

Objectives.text: 将精心伪装的窃听器放在大帐篷里、小帐篷附近和补给中。
Objectives.english: Plant the Cleverly Disguised Bugs in the large tent, near the small tents, and in the supplies.

Description.text: 我已经在营地里安装了一些窃听器，但窃听器是永远不嫌多的。$b$b这些雕像其实都是经过伪装的录音机。它们和周围的其他古物看起来别无二致。$b$b你的伪装应该可以让你在营地里自由行动。只要你别去接近狗和加尔鲁什就行！尼禄和加尔鲁什能看穿你的伪装。$b$b万一你被抓，我可帮不了你。我不能搞砸任务！
Description.english: I've managed to plant a few bugs around the camp, but there could always be more.$b$bI disguised the bugs to look like statues. They blend in perfectly with the other artifacts lying around.$b$bYour disguise should allow you to move freely around the camp. Just don't go near the dog and don't linger around Garrosh! Nero and Garrosh will see through your disguise.$b$bIf you get caught I can't help you. I can't compromise the mission!

identity.title: Call of the Packmaster
identity.objectives: Speak with Wrathion.
identity.description: $C, through your eyes I've been able to witness the fighting along the coast, and the epic course of battles around the world. You've been very patient... and most informative.$b$bI've also been keeping a close eye on your King. Would you be interested to hear what I've learned?

Objectives.text: 与拉希奥谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Wrathion.

Description.text: $C，通过你的眼睛，我也见证了海滩上的激战，那是一场震动世界的史诗战役。你很有耐心……并提供了大量情报。$b$b我一直在密切关注你们的国王。你想听听我对他的看法吗？
Description.english: $C, through your eyes I've been able to witness the fighting along the coast, and the epic course of battles around the world. You've been very patient... and most informative.$b$bI've also been keeping a close eye on your King. Would you be interested to hear what I've learned?

CompletionLog.text: 去迷雾酒肆从拉希奥的宝箱中挑选奖励。
CompletionLog.english: Choose your reward from Wrathion's chest at the Tavern in the Mist.

identity.title: The Ruins of Korune
identity.objectives: Find Ishi at the Ruins of Korune. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.
identity.description: Garrosh sent a hundred riders to search the northern coast of Kun-Lai Summit, to seek a mogu crypt matching the one you saw in Shan Kien's memory.$B$BOut of those, one found the resting place of the Divine Bell.$B$BBlademaster Ishi is leading an advance party to secure the bell now.$B$BGo and assist him. Defend that artifact from anyone who might stand in your way!$B$BSpeak to Tak-Tak without delay. He can take you there.

Objectives.text: 去寇茹废墟找伊什。你可以与统御岗哨的泰克泰克谈一谈，让他送你一程。
Objectives.english: Find Ishi at the Ruins of Korune. Speak to Tak-Tak at Domination Point for transportation.

Description.text: 加尔鲁什派出了一百名骑兵搜索昆莱山的北部海岸，去寻找你在单简的记忆中看到的那座魔古墓穴。$B$B其中有一个人找到了圣钟的埋藏地。$B$B剑圣伊什已经带着一支先遣队赶去保护圣钟了。$B$B我要你去协助他。守住那件神器，把碍事的家伙全干掉！$B$B快去找泰克泰克，他会送你过去的。
Description.english: Garrosh sent a hundred riders to search the northern coast of Kun-Lai Summit, to seek a mogu crypt matching the one you saw in Shan Kien's memory.$B$BOut of those, one found the resting place of the Divine Bell.$B$BBlademaster Ishi is leading an advance party to secure the bell now.$B$BGo and assist him. Defend that artifact from anyone who might stand in your way!$B$BSpeak to Tak-Tak without delay. He can take you there.

identity.title: The Divine Bell
identity.objectives: Kill Sarannha Skyglaive.
identity.description: If the Alliance thought they could steal the Divine Bell from us, they were wrong!$B$BEven now, we have them trapped in the crypts beneath us.$B$BDeath will be the price they pay for defying us.$B$BCome, $c. Let us show them the error of their ways.

Objectives.text: 击败萨拉哈·天剑。
Objectives.english: Kill Sarannha Skyglaive.

Description.text: 要是联盟以为能从我们手中偷走圣钟，那他们就错了！$B$B现在，我们就把他们困在了下面的墓穴里。$B$B敢于反抗我们的代价就是死亡。$B$B来吧，$c。我们要让他们知道自己错得有多离谱。
Description.english: If the Alliance thought they could steal the Divine Bell from us, they were wrong!$B$BEven now, we have them trapped in the crypts beneath us.$B$BDeath will be the price they pay for defying us.$B$BCome, $c. Let us show them the error of their ways.

identity.title: The Ruins of Korune
identity.objectives: Find Sarannha Skyglaive at the Ruins of Korune. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.
identity.description: It's time for our boldest move yet, $n.$B$BSince you acquired intel on the location of the Divine Bell, we've amassed a top team to excavate the artifact without delay.$B$BCommander Sarannha Skyglaive leads the expedition into the northern-most reaches of Kun-Lai Summit.$B$BJoin them at once, and use whatever skills you need to make the endeavor a success.$B$BGood luck, $c. I don't need to tell you how important this mission is to the Alliance.$B$BSpeak to Fennie. She'll get you there quickly.

Objectives.text: 去寇茹废墟找萨拉哈·天剑。你可以与雄狮港的范妮·盘角谈一谈，让她送你一程。
Objectives.english: Find Sarannha Skyglaive at the Ruins of Korune. Speak to Fennie Hornswaggle at Lion's Landing for transportation.

Description.text: 接下来将是我们最大胆的一次行动，$n。$B$B在你打听到圣钟的位置后，我们立刻就召集了一支精英小队前去发掘神器。$B$B指挥官萨拉哈·天剑带着远征队进入了昆莱山的最北部。$B$B你要立刻加入他们，尽你的一切力量确保行动成功。$B$B祝你好运，$c。我就不用向你强调这次行动对联盟有多么重要了吧？$B$B去跟范妮谈谈。她能把你快速送到目的地。
Description.english: It's time for our boldest move yet, $n.$B$BSince you acquired intel on the location of the Divine Bell, we've amassed a top team to excavate the artifact without delay.$B$BCommander Sarannha Skyglaive leads the expedition into the northern-most reaches of Kun-Lai Summit.$B$BJoin them at once, and use whatever skills you need to make the endeavor a success.$B$BGood luck, $c. I don't need to tell you how important this mission is to the Alliance.$B$BSpeak to Fennie. She'll get you there quickly.

identity.title: He Won't Even Miss It
identity.objectives: Create a distraction in the camp and steal the Weathered Journal.
identity.description: I've noticed Garrosh and that Reliquary blood elf carrying around some sort of journal.$b$bThe journal is never more than a stone's throw away. It must be important!$b$bIf you can cause enough of a distraction, you may be able to swipe the journal off the table.$b$bThese yaks might just do the trick. Give one of 'em a tap and they'll do the rest.$b$bJust be ready to move fast!

Objectives.text: 在营地制造混乱，趁机窃取褪色日志。
Objectives.english: Create a distraction in the camp and steal the Weathered Journal.

Description.text: 我注意到加尔鲁什和一位神圣遗物学会的血精灵在一起，而且那位血精灵还随身带着某种日志。$b$b那本日志几乎从不离身，肯定非常重要！$b$b如果你能制造出足够大的混乱，就可以偷走桌上的日志了。$b$b这些牦牛或许能派上用处。只要狠狠给它们一鞭子，它们就会帮你搞定剩下的事。$b$b不过你一定得做好快跑的准备！
Description.english: I've noticed Garrosh and that Reliquary blood elf carrying around some sort of journal.$b$bThe journal is never more than a stone's throw away. It must be important!$b$bIf you can cause enough of a distraction, you may be able to swipe the journal off the table.$b$bThese yaks might just do the trick. Give one of 'em a tap and they'll do the rest.$b$bJust be ready to move fast!

identity.title: Breath of Darkest Shadow
identity.objectives: Witness the ringing of the Divine Bell.
identity.description: It is time, $n. We have traveled a long path to reach this moment.$B$BToday, our Warchief, Garrosh Hellscream, will change the course of our people's history forever.$B$BToday, we witness the birth of Garrosh's Horde!$B$BDo not let anything interfere with the ceremony!

Objectives.text: 见证圣钟的鸣响。
Objectives.english: Witness the ringing of the Divine Bell.

Description.text: 是时候了，$n。我们历经千难万险，终于等来了这个时刻。$B$B今天，我们的酋长，加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮将永远改写我们的历史。$B$B今天，我们将见证加尔鲁什的新部落诞生！$B$B不要让任何人干扰仪式！
Description.english: It is time, $n. We have traveled a long path to reach this moment.$B$BToday, our Warchief, Garrosh Hellscream, will change the course of our people's history forever.$B$BToday, we witness the birth of Garrosh's Horde!$B$BDo not let anything interfere with the ceremony!

identity.title: Breath of Darkest Shadow
identity.objectives: Defeat Ishi and destroy the Divine Bell.
identity.description: Garrosh is right over there, and he's going to ring that bell at any moment.$B$BWe don't have time to wait for my father's army. This is our only chance to stop him!$B$BI'll attempt to appeal to his senses before resorting to using the Harmonic Mallet.$B$BCharge in whenever you're ready, $n. I'll be right behind you.

Objectives.text: 击败伊什并摧毁圣钟。
Objectives.english: Defeat Ishi and destroy the Divine Bell.

Description.text: 加尔鲁什就在那里，他马上就要敲响那个钟了。$B$B我们没时间等待我父亲的援军了。这是我们阻止他的最后机会！$B$B我会设法吸引他的注意力，然后使用祥和钟杵。$B$B你准备好之后就冲吧，$n。我会跟紧你的。
Description.english: Garrosh is right over there, and he's going to ring that bell at any moment.$B$BWe don't have time to wait for my father's army. This is our only chance to stop him!$B$BI'll attempt to appeal to his senses before resorting to using the Harmonic Mallet.$B$BCharge in whenever you're ready, $n. I'll be right behind you.

identity.title: It Starts in the Sewers
identity.objectives: Evacuate 9 Sunreaver Citizens.
identity.description: Compared to the rest of the city, this part of the sewers is relatively calm. This is good - we can extract more Sunreavers in peace than we can in war.$b$bFind as many citizens as you can. Tell them that it is not safe here, that they must leave the city at once.$b$bAnd try to stay clear of the Silver Covenant. We don't want to cause a scene if we can avoid it. Not yet, anyhow.

Objectives.text: 疏散9名夺日者平民。
Objectives.english: Evacuate 9 Sunreaver Citizens.

Description.text: 比起城市的其他地方，这一段下水道相对平静。这样最好——比起战斗，我们可以在悄无声息的情况下撤走更多的夺日者。$b$b你要尽可能多找到一些平民，告诉他们这里已经不安全了，让他们立刻离开这座城市。$b$b尽量不要靠近银色盟约的人。如果有可能的话，我们并不想惹麻烦。至少目前不行。
Description.english: Compared to the rest of the city, this part of the sewers is relatively calm. This is good - we can extract more Sunreavers in peace than we can in war.$b$bFind as many citizens as you can. Tell them that it is not safe here, that they must leave the city at once.$b$bAnd try to stay clear of the Silver Covenant. We don't want to cause a scene if we can avoid it. Not yet, anyhow.

identity.title: Violence in the Arena
identity.objectives: Slay 6 Silver Covenant Enforcers and 4 Silver Covenant Spellbows.
identity.description: As I suspected, it gets worse up ahead. The Silver Covenant is outright attacking innocent Sunreavers!$b$bThis cannot stand. While our prime directive is to rescue Aethas Sunreaver, we must also protect as many blood elves as we can.$b$bI will continue to scout ahead. Fight well, $c!

Objectives.text: 击败6名银色盟约侩子手和4名银色盟约投法者。
Objectives.english: Slay 6 Silver Covenant Enforcers and 4 Silver Covenant Spellbows.

Description.text: 跟我想的一样，前面的情况要糟糕得多。银色盟约的人正在拼命攻击无辜的夺日者！$b$b这是无法容忍的暴行。虽然我们的首要任务是营救艾萨斯·夺日者，但我们也要尽可能地保护其他血精灵。$b$b我会继续在前面探路。好好打，$c！
Description.english: As I suspected, it gets worse up ahead. The Silver Covenant is outright attacking innocent Sunreavers!$b$bThis cannot stand. While our prime directive is to rescue Aethas Sunreaver, we must also protect as many blood elves as we can.$b$bI will continue to scout ahead. Fight well, $c!

identity.title: Hand of the Silver Covenant
identity.objectives: Slay Sorin Magehand.
identity.description: Every Sunreaver Jaina expels from this city is a new blade that fights for the Horde. For US.$b$bI'm off to gather more strong elves. You've proven your hand in combat thus far - go take care of that creep in the black market.$b$bWhen you're done, we'll meet at the ramp and prepare to go aboveground.

Objectives.text: 击败索林·法师之手。
Objectives.english: Slay Sorin Magehand.

Description.text: 吉安娜从这座城市里每驱逐出一个夺日者，就会多一个为部落、为我们而战的战士。$b$b我会去召集更多强大的精灵。而你已经证明了自己的战斗力——我要你去解决混进黑市的那个家伙。$b$b等你完成的时候，我们就在坡道上集合并准备冲出地面。
Description.english: Every Sunreaver Jaina expels from this city is a new blade that fights for the Horde. For US.$b$bI'm off to gather more strong elves. You've proven your hand in combat thus far - go take care of that creep in the black market.$b$bWhen you're done, we'll meet at the ramp and prepare to go aboveground.

identity.title: A Tactical Assault
identity.objectives: Follow Grand Magister Rommath into the center of Dalaran.
identity.description: If we're to survive up above ground, we're going to need a base of operations.$b$bI'm going to try to take the center of the city. It's risky, but hopefully Jaina and the Silver Covenant won't expect it.$b$bStay by my side now, $n.

Objectives.text: 跟随大法师罗曼斯进入达拉然的中心区域。
Objectives.english: Follow Grand Magister Rommath into the center of Dalaran.

Description.text: 如果我们想在地面上活下去，就需要一个行动基地。$b$b我会设法占领市中心。这样做风险很大，只能寄望于吉安娜和银色盟约没有想到这一点。$b$b现在，跟紧我，$n。
Description.english: If we're to survive up above ground, we're going to need a base of operations.$b$bI'm going to try to take the center of the city. It's risky, but hopefully Jaina and the Silver Covenant won't expect it.$b$bStay by my side now, $n.

identity.title: The Silver Covenant's Stronghold
identity.objectives: Slay Arcanist Rathaella.
identity.description: I have it on good authority that Archmage Aethas Sunreaver is being held in the Silver Enclave, home of the Silver Covenant. Arcanist Rathaella holds him in captivity.$b$bMost Covenant agents are out slaughtering Sunreavers right now, which means our chance is ripe. Slay Rathaella, and spring Aethas from his prison.

Objectives.text: 击败奥术师兰塞拉。
Objectives.english: Slay Arcanist Rathaella.

Description.text: 有可靠证据表明，大法师艾萨斯·夺日者被囚禁在银色盟约的大本营，银色领地里。奥术师兰塞拉正看守着他。$b$b大部分银色盟约的成员现在正在外面屠杀夺日者，营救的时机已经成熟了。去干掉兰塞拉，将艾萨斯救出来吧。
Description.english: I have it on good authority that Archmage Aethas Sunreaver is being held in the Silver Enclave, home of the Silver Covenant. Arcanist Rathaella holds him in captivity.$b$bMost Covenant agents are out slaughtering Sunreavers right now, which means our chance is ripe. Slay Rathaella, and spring Aethas from his prison.

identity.title: The Kirin Tor's True Colors
identity.objectives: Slay Lieutenant Corwin and 10 of his troops.
identity.description: Any pretense that the Kirin Tor might have had at being a "neutral" group can officially be discarded. I'm now hearing that Jaina's got Alliance troops stowed away near Antonidas Memorial.$b$bThe area's free of Sunreavers, but it still makes my blood boil to see such blatant favoritism from the Kirin Tor.$b$bGo visit the memorial, $n... and give those Alliance dogs a good kick on your way through.

Objectives.text: 击败考文中尉和他手下的10名士兵。
Objectives.english: Slay Lieutenant Corwin and 10 of his troops.

Description.text: 无论肯瑞托用什么借口继续假称“中立”组织，他们的谎言都已经正式破产了。我听说吉安娜已经悄悄让联盟部队抵达了安东尼达斯纪念碑附近。$b$b那一地区并没有夺日者存在，可肯瑞托这种公然偏袒联盟的做法仍然让我无比愤怒。$b$b到纪念碑那里去，$n……并狠狠教训一下你沿途遇到的联盟成员。
Description.english: Any pretense that the Kirin Tor might have had at being a "neutral" group can officially be discarded. I'm now hearing that Jaina's got Alliance troops stowed away near Antonidas Memorial.$b$bThe area's free of Sunreavers, but it still makes my blood boil to see such blatant favoritism from the Kirin Tor.$b$bGo visit the memorial, $n... and give those Alliance dogs a good kick on your way through.

identity.title: Krasus' Landing
identity.objectives: Free 6 Sunreaver Dragonhawks.
identity.description: We can rescue as many Sunreavers as we want, but if they can't escape, then there's no point.$b$bThe Silver Covenant will certainly be subduing and killing the Sunreavers' dragonhawks. Put a stop to it.

Objectives.text: 救下6只夺日者龙鹰。
Objectives.english: Free 6 Sunreaver Dragonhawks.

Description.text: 我们可以尽力营救夺日者，可如果他们都逃不出去，那就毫无意义了。$b$b银色盟约肯定在收服并屠杀夺日者的龙鹰。你必须阻止他们。
Description.english: We can rescue as many Sunreavers as we want, but if they can't escape, then there's no point.$b$bThe Silver Covenant will certainly be subduing and killing the Sunreavers' dragonhawks. Put a stop to it.

identity.title: The Remaining Sunreavers
identity.objectives: Use the Tear of the Sin'dorei on Uda the Beast, High Arcanist Savor, Magister Hathorel, Magister Surdiel, and Magistrix Vesara.
identity.description: There's still a number of significant Sunreavers who haven't been accounted for. Odds are that they're in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary, caught by surprise.$b$b<Rommath hands you an artifact, clearly made by blood elf hands.>$b$bThe place is crawling with Silver Covenant. You'll need to get in, use the Tear to evacuate the VIPs, and then get out.$b$bStay alive, $n.

Objectives.text: 对兽女乌达、高阶奥术师西瓦、魔导师哈瑟尔、魔导师索迪耶尔和魔导师维莎拉使用辛多雷之殇。
Objectives.english: Use the Tear of the Sin'dorei on Uda the Beast, High Arcanist Savor, Magister Hathorel, Magister Surdiel, and Magistrix Vesara.

Description.text: 仍然有相当数量的夺日者下落不明。他们很可能是在出其不意的情况下被困在了夺日者圣殿里。$b$b<罗曼斯交给你一件神器，它显然出自血精灵之手。>$b$b那里到处都是银色盟约的人。你可以用它进入圣殿，救出那里的重要人物，然后再撤离。$b$b好好活下去，$n。
Description.english: There's still a number of significant Sunreavers who haven't been accounted for. Odds are that they're in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary, caught by surprise.$b$b<Rommath hands you an artifact, clearly made by blood elf hands.>$b$bThe place is crawling with Silver Covenant. You'll need to get in, use the Tear to evacuate the VIPs, and then get out.$b$bStay alive, $n.

identity.title: One Last Grasp
identity.objectives: Slay Mage-Commander Zuros, then escape from Dalaran.
identity.description: We've looked everywhere he's likely to be, except for one place: the Violet Citadel.$b$bFind out if Archmage Aethas is being held within the citadel, $n. We may get lucky. If not... at least we saved a number of lives today.

Objectives.text: 击败法师指挥官左洛斯然后逃出达拉然。
Objectives.english: Slay Mage-Commander Zuros, then escape from Dalaran.

Description.text: 我们找遍了他可能去的地方，除了紫罗兰城堡。$b$b去看看大法师艾萨斯是不是被关在城堡里了，$n。我们只能碰碰运气了。如果还是没有的话……至少我们今天也救了许多性命。
Description.english: We've looked everywhere he's likely to be, except for one place: the Violet Citadel.$b$bFind out if Archmage Aethas is being held within the citadel, $n. We may get lucky. If not... at least we saved a number of lives today.

identity.title: A Return to Krasarang
identity.objectives: Report to General Nazgrim at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
identity.description: Wherever your loyalties might lie - with Rommath and I, with Garrosh, or elsewhere - one thing is true: your acts today were truly heroic.$b$bI can arrange for your transport back to Krasarang Wilds. Speak with me if you would like passage back to Pandaria, $n.

Objectives.text: 去卡桑琅丛林的统御岗哨找纳兹戈林将军。
Objectives.english: Report to General Nazgrim at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

Description.text: 无论你效忠谁——我和罗曼斯，或是加尔鲁什，或是别的什么人——有一件事是确定无疑的：你今天的行动非常英勇。$b$b我可以安排你传送回卡桑琅丛林。在你准备返回潘达利亚时，请告诉我一声，$n。
Description.english: Wherever your loyalties might lie - with Rommath and I, with Garrosh, or elsewhere - one thing is true: your acts today were truly heroic.$b$bI can arrange for your transport back to Krasarang Wilds. Speak with me if you would like passage back to Pandaria, $n.

identity.title: Sewer Cleaning
identity.objectives: Slay 12 Sunreavers in the Dalaran Sewers.
identity.description: Jaina's doing a good job taking care of Sunreavers above ground, but there's still plenty rooting around in the sewers.$b$bGo find those lying rats and exterminate them!

Objectives.text: 在达拉然下水道中击败12名夺日者。
Objectives.english: Slay 12 Sunreavers in the Dalaran Sewers.

Description.text: 吉安娜清理附近夺日者的行动很成功，但还有很多人躲在下水道里。$b$b去找出那些满口谎言的鼠辈并消灭他们！
Description.english: Jaina's doing a good job taking care of Sunreavers above ground, but there's still plenty rooting around in the sewers.$b$bGo find those lying rats and exterminate them!

identity.title: Unfair Trade
identity.objectives: Slay Inkmaster Aelon, Tolyria, Gearmage Astalon, and Sintharia Cinderweave.
identity.description: Most shopkeepers in the Magus Commerce Exchange have sided with the Silver Covenant, but there remain a few holdouts that must be taken care of.$b$b<Vereesa shows you a list of names.>$b$bThey will not go easily.

Objectives.text: 击败墨水大师艾伦、托莉雅、火轮法师艾斯泰伦和辛瑟莉亚·织烬。
Objectives.english: Slay Inkmaster Aelon, Tolyria, Gearmage Astalon, and Sintharia Cinderweave.

Description.text: 魔法商业区的大部分商店老板都支持银色盟约，可还有一部分负隅顽抗的家伙需要我们去解决。$b$b<温蕾萨给你看了一份名单。>$b$b不能让他们轻易逃脱。
Description.english: Most shopkeepers in the Magus Commerce Exchange have sided with the Silver Covenant, but there remain a few holdouts that must be taken care of.$b$b<Vereesa shows you a list of names.>$b$bThey will not go easily.

identity.title: Nowhere to Hide
identity.objectives: Slay 16 Sunreavers in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary.
identity.description: The Sunreaver's Sanctuary is still crawling with those Horde-loving Sunreavers.$b$bJaina will have sent the reasonable ones to the Violet Hold. The rest refuse to leave, raising their weapons against us.$b$bShow them the cost of their defiance. They now face the judgment of the Alliance, the Silver Covenant, and the Kirin Tor!

Objectives.text: 在夺日者圣殿击败16名夺日者。
Objectives.english: Slay 16 Sunreavers in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary.

Description.text: 那些死忠部落的夺日者还躲在夺日者圣殿里。$b$b吉安娜会将那些愿意接受劝降的人送去紫罗兰监狱。而拒绝离开的人，则拿起了武器反抗我们。$b$b去让他们明白反抗的代价吧。他们将面对联盟、银色盟约和肯瑞托的审判！
Description.english: The Sunreaver's Sanctuary is still crawling with those Horde-loving Sunreavers.$b$bJaina will have sent the reasonable ones to the Violet Hold. The rest refuse to leave, raising their weapons against us.$b$bShow them the cost of their defiance. They now face the judgment of the Alliance, the Silver Covenant, and the Kirin Tor!

identity.title: Cashing Out
identity.objectives: Slay Magister Brasael.
identity.description: I just saw one of the Sunreavers - Brasael, I think his name was - running off in the direction of the bank to the north. No doubt he's trying to gather whatever assets he can before he leaves.$b$bHead him off and make sure he doesn't steal any resources from our coffers. He relinquished whatever funds he left in the bank when he and his Sunreaver kind betrayed us.

Objectives.text: 击败魔导师布拉塞尔。
Objectives.english: Slay Magister Brasael.

Description.text: 我刚刚看见一名夺日者——我想他叫布拉塞尔——朝北边的银行方向逃去了。毫无疑问，他是想在逃走前卷走一切财产。$b$b去找到他，绝不能让他偷走我们金库中的一分一毫。当他和他那些夺日者同党背叛我们的时候，他已经放弃了自己存在银行里的一切资产。
Description.english: I just saw one of the Sunreavers - Brasael, I think his name was - running off in the direction of the bank to the north. No doubt he's trying to gather whatever assets he can before he leaves.$b$bHead him off and make sure he doesn't steal any resources from our coffers. He relinquished whatever funds he left in the bank when he and his Sunreaver kind betrayed us.

identity.title: Nowhere to Run
identity.objectives: Render 5 Sunreaver Dragonhawks incapable of flying.
identity.description: Compliant Sunreavers will be sent to the Violet Hold. Defiant ones are put to the sword.$b$bNONE are to escape.$b$bThe Sunreavers keep their dragonhawk mounts on Krasus' Landing. Take this dust, and use it to render them incapable of flying.$b$bOr kill them. I don't care.

Objectives.text: 令5头夺日者龙鹰失去飞行能力。
Objectives.english: Render 5 Sunreaver Dragonhawks incapable of flying.

Description.text: 投降的夺日者将被送去紫罗兰监狱。反抗者将死于利剑之下。$b$b他们一个也别想跑。$b$b夺日者将他们的龙鹰坐骑养在克拉苏斯平台上。带上这把粉尘，用它剥夺龙鹰的飞行能力。$b$b或者杀了它们，我不在乎。
Description.english: Compliant Sunreavers will be sent to the Violet Hold. Defiant ones are put to the sword.$b$bNONE are to escape.$b$bThe Sunreavers keep their dragonhawk mounts on Krasus' Landing. Take this dust, and use it to render them incapable of flying.$b$bOr kill them. I don't care.

identity.title: The Measure of a Leader
identity.objectives: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists.
identity.description: We've progressed to a new part of the Pandaren campaign. Your Warchief aims to impress the Pandaren with the full might of the Horde's military. He will lay claim to the resources of this land, with or without Pandaren aid.$b$bI understand your leader's aims, but I really want to understand the Warchief himself. What drives him? And where is the Horde ultimately going? I'd like to talk to you about this leader of yours.

Objectives.text: 与迷雾酒肆的拉希奥谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists.

Description.text: 我们的熊猫人战役已经发展到了新的阶段。你们的酋长试图以部落的强大武力震慑熊猫人。无论熊猫人是否愿意，他都会攫取这片土地的资源。$b$b我理解你们领袖的意愿，但我更想理解酋长本人的意图。到底是什么在驱使着他？部落究竟会走向何方？我想跟你谈谈你们的这位领袖。
Description.english: We've progressed to a new part of the Pandaren campaign. Your Warchief aims to impress the Pandaren with the full might of the Horde's military. He will lay claim to the resources of this land, with or without Pandaren aid.$b$bI understand your leader's aims, but I really want to understand the Warchief himself. What drives him? And where is the Horde ultimately going? I'd like to talk to you about this leader of yours.

CompletionLog.text: 去雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆找拉希奥。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

identity.title: The Prince's Pursuit
identity.objectives: Kill Alliance forces along the southern shores of Krasarang Wilds until you are Revered with the Black Prince.
identity.description: My goal is an expedient end to this costly war. Prove to me that the Horde deserves to win. Show me your prowess on the battlefield.$b$bYou are not fighting some abstract force like the sha: You are facing your enemy head-on, eye-to-eye.$b$bWill you triumph?

Objectives.text: 击败卡桑琅丛林南部海滩上的联盟军队，直到你在黑王子阵营的声望达到崇敬。
Objectives.english: Kill Alliance forces along the southern shores of Krasarang Wilds until you are Revered with the Black Prince.

Description.text: 我的目标就是暂时终止这场代价高昂的战争。在我看来，部落完全应该获胜。让我看看你在战场上的实力吧。$b$b我不是要你去面对那些抽象的敌人，例如煞魔，而是要你正面对抗你的敌人。$b$b你是否能够凯旋呢？
Description.english: My goal is an expedient end to this costly war. Prove to me that the Horde deserves to win. Show me your prowess on the battlefield.$b$bYou are not fighting some abstract force like the sha: You are facing your enemy head-on, eye-to-eye.$b$bWill you triumph?

identity.title: A Change of Command
identity.objectives: Kill High Marshal Twinbraid at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds. You will need a group.
identity.description: There's an Alliance dwarf I've been keeping a close eye on. High Marshal Twinbraid proved to be a nuisance in Southern Barrens when he struck back at the Horde after the loss of Bael Modan. He's now entrenched within the Alliance stronghold in Lion's Landing, helping to orchestrate the Krasarang counter-offensive.$b$bOnly a legendary group of Horde heroes could possibly defeat him.$b$bIf you wish to finish him off, bring friends. Lots of friends.

Objectives.text: 去卡桑琅丛林的雄狮港击败大元帅双辫。建议你组队前往。
Objectives.english: Kill High Marshal Twinbraid at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds. You will need a group.

Description.text: 我一直在密切监视一个联盟矮人将军。大元帅双辫是个棘手的家伙。巴尔莫丹失陷之后，他在南贫瘠之地击退了部落部队。他现在就呆在雄狮港的联盟堡垒里帮助协调卡桑琅的反攻战。$b$b只有由部落的传奇英雄组成的队伍才有可能打败他。$b$b如果你想干掉他，一定找几个朋友一起去。记得多带点人。
Description.english: There's an Alliance dwarf I've been keeping a close eye on. High Marshal Twinbraid proved to be a nuisance in Southern Barrens when he struck back at the Horde after the loss of Bael Modan. He's now entrenched within the Alliance stronghold in Lion's Landing, helping to orchestrate the Krasarang counter-offensive.$b$bOnly a legendary group of Horde heroes could possibly defeat him.$b$bIf you wish to finish him off, bring friends. Lots of friends.

identity.title: Glory to the Horde
identity.objectives: Win battles at the Temple of Kotmogu and the Silvershard Mines.
identity.description: This is a global war, $n. It has spilled onto Pandaria, and it has set hot spots across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms ablaze. How will you fare on an organized battlefront? I would like to see for myself.$b$bI look forward to hearing your report from the front lines.

Objectives.text: 赢得寇魔古寺和碎银矿脉的胜利。
Objectives.english: Win battles at the Temple of Kotmogu and the Silvershard Mines.

Description.text: 这是一场全球战争，$n。它不仅波及了潘达利亚，卡利姆多和东部王国也同样战火频燃。你在有组织的战场上会表现如何呢？我很想亲眼看一看。$b$b我期待听到你从前线带回的报告。
Description.english: This is a global war, $n. It has spilled onto Pandaria, and it has set hot spots across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms ablaze. How will you fare on an organized battlefront? I would like to see for myself.$b$bI look forward to hearing your report from the front lines.

identity.title: The Soul of the Horde
identity.objectives: Speak with Wrathion.
identity.description: $C, through your eyes I've been able to witness the fighting along the coast, and the epic course of battles around the world. You've been very patient... and most informative.$b$bI've also been keeping a close eye on Garrosh Hellscream. Would you be interested to hear what I've learned?

Objectives.text: 与拉希奥谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Wrathion.

Description.text: $C，通过你的眼睛，我也见证了海滩上的激战，那是一场震动世界的史诗战役。你很有耐心……并提供了大量情报。$b$b我一直在密切关注加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮。你想听听我对他的看法吗？
Description.english: $C, through your eyes I've been able to witness the fighting along the coast, and the epic course of battles around the world. You've been very patient... and most informative.$b$bI've also been keeping a close eye on Garrosh Hellscream. Would you be interested to hear what I've learned?

CompletionLog.text: 去迷雾酒肆从拉希奥的宝箱中挑选奖励。
CompletionLog.english: Choose your reward from Wrathion's chest at the Tavern in the Mist.

identity.title: Dis-Assembly Required
identity.objectives: Destroy the Jungle Shredders using the Re-Configured Remote and then collect 6 pieces of Scrap Metal.
identity.description: Those shredders are becoming a problem down there, $c.$b$bWe've sent in the Mecha-Pounders, but it just isn't enough. They're getting damaged faster than we can repair 'em!$b$bI happened upon this strange remote while scouting. With a little bit of re-configurin' I think we can use it.$b$bTry usin' it on the Jungle Shredders. Hopefully it will destroy them and then you can bring me the scrap metal.

Objectives.text: 使用重置的遥控器摧毁丛林伐木机并收集6个废金属。
Objectives.english: Destroy the Jungle Shredders using the Re-Configured Remote and then collect 6 pieces of Scrap Metal.

Description.text: 那些伐木机已经变成了一个大麻烦，$c。$b$b我们派出了机械碾压者，可这还不够。它们损坏的速度比我们修理的速度还要快！$b$b我在侦察时，凑巧捡到了这个奇怪的遥控器。我想只要稍微重置一下，我们就能使用它了。$b$b去对丛林伐木机使用这个遥控器，但愿它能摧毁它们。还有，把那些废金属带回来给我。
Description.english: Those shredders are becoming a problem down there, $c.$b$bWe've sent in the Mecha-Pounders, but it just isn't enough. They're getting damaged faster than we can repair 'em!$b$bI happened upon this strange remote while scouting. With a little bit of re-configurin' I think we can use it.$b$bTry usin' it on the Jungle Shredders. Hopefully it will destroy them and then you can bring me the scrap metal.

identity.title: And Then There Were Goblins
identity.objectives: Report to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.
identity.description: We're fighting a war on all fronts, $c. Even Pandaria itself needs our protection.$b$bThe Bilgewater goblins are destroying land that doesn't belong to them. They must be stopped!$b$bReport to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire. From her vantage point she should have a good idea of where their weak spots are.

Objectives.text: 去卡桑琅丛林的天火号找空军上将罗杰斯。
Objectives.english: Report to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

Description.text: 我们正在打一场全面战争，$c。就连潘达利亚本身也需要我们的保护。$b$b锈水地精正在摧残不属于他们的土地。我们必须阻止他们！$b$b快去天火号上找空军上将罗杰斯。她占据了有利地形，应该可以找出他们的弱点。
Description.english: We're fighting a war on all fronts, $c. Even Pandaria itself needs our protection.$b$bThe Bilgewater goblins are destroying land that doesn't belong to them. They must be stopped!$b$bReport to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire. From her vantage point she should have a good idea of where their weak spots are.

identity.title: The Silence
identity.objectives: Use the Alliance Flare Gun.
identity.description: D..did we... do it?$B$B<Anduin mumbles the words, even though the effort clearly costs him.>$B$BL..look... in.. my... bag...$B$BUse... flare...

Objectives.text: 使用联盟信号枪。
Objectives.english: Use the Alliance Flare Gun.

Description.text: 我们……成功……了吗？$B$B<安度因努力吐出了几个词，这显然消耗了他大量的精力。>$B$B看……我的……包……$B$B用……信号……
Description.english: D..did we... do it?$B$B<Anduin mumbles the words, even though the effort clearly costs him.>$B$BL..look... in.. my... bag...$B$BUse... flare...

identity.title: The Thunder King
identity.objectives: Contact Wrathion on the second floor of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
identity.description: Are you aware of recent events in Kun-Lai Summit? The Zandalari have landed on the northern shores in great numbers and have set about renewing old alliances. To that end, they have resurrected The Thunder King.$b$bEven among the mogu, the name of the first emperor commands awe and fear. The Thunder King founded a vast empire of slavery and suffering... but also of power, riches, and splendor.$b$bWe will take the fight to him soon. Find me when your faction makes its move.

Objectives.text: 在雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆二楼与拉希奥取得联系。
Objectives.english: Contact Wrathion on the second floor of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

Description.text: 你注意到昆莱山最近的情况了吗？大量赞达拉巨魔已经登上了北部海岸并开始拉拢旧日的盟友了。为此，他们复活了雷电之王。$b$b即使在魔古族当中，这位开国皇帝的名字仍然等同于敬畏和恐惧。雷电之王曾建立起一个充满奴役和苦难的庞大帝国……可它也同样强大、富饶、显赫。$b$b我们很快就将与他开战。当你的阵营开始行动时，请再来找我。
Description.english: Are you aware of recent events in Kun-Lai Summit? The Zandalari have landed on the northern shores in great numbers and have set about renewing old alliances. To that end, they have resurrected The Thunder King.$b$bEven among the mogu, the name of the first emperor commands awe and fear. The Thunder King founded a vast empire of slavery and suffering... but also of power, riches, and splendor.$b$bWe will take the fight to him soon. Find me when your faction makes its move.

CompletionLog.text: 去雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆二楼找拉希奥。
CompletionLog.english: Contact Wrathion on the second floor of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

identity.title: With the Wind's Blessing...
identity.objectives: Collect Charms of Good Fortune.
identity.description: <An urgent plea reaches your ears.>$b$b$n! My father's fleet is making its way to Pandaria. With favorable winds, they could arrive any moment.$b$bThe Pandaren have a blessing that will give us good luck with the weather and speed our ships to these shores. We just need to collect charms of good fortune to make it happen.$b$bAs our ships draw closer to the island, less charms will be required. But if you have enough, we can speed them here right away...

Objectives.text: 收集好运护符。
Objectives.english: Collect Charms of Good Fortune.

Description.text: <你的耳边响起了迫切的恳求声。>$b$b$n！我父亲的舰队正在开向潘达利亚。如果是顺风的话，他们随时可能到达。$b$b熊猫人有一种祝福，可以给我们带来好天气，并加快舰船到岸的速度。我们只需要收集好运护符来激活它就行了。$b$b舰船离本岛的距离越近，所需要的护符就越少。可如果你能找到足够的护符，我们就能让他们立刻加快速度了……
Description.english: <An urgent plea reaches your ears.>$b$b$n! My father's fleet is making its way to Pandaria. With favorable winds, they could arrive any moment.$b$bThe Pandaren have a blessing that will give us good luck with the weather and speed our ships to these shores. We just need to collect charms of good fortune to make it happen.$b$bAs our ships draw closer to the island, less charms will be required. But if you have enough, we can speed them here right away...

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的七星殿与安度因·乌瑞恩谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Anduin Wrynn at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: With the Wind's Blessing...
identity.objectives: Collect Charms of Good Fortune.
identity.description: <An urgent plea reaches your ears.>$b$b$n! The Horde fleet is making its way to Pandaria. With favorable winds, they could arrive any moment.$b$bThe Pandaren have a blessing that will give us good luck with the weather and speed our brothers and sisters to these shores. We simply need to collect charms of good fortune to gain fortune's favor.$b$bAs our ships draw closer to the island, less charms will be required. But if you have enough, we can speed them here right away...

Objectives.text: 收集好运护符。
Objectives.english: Collect Charms of Good Fortune.

Description.text: <你的耳边响起了迫切的恳求声。>$b$b$n！部落舰队正在驶向潘达利亚。如果是顺风的话，他们随时可能到达。$b$b熊猫人有一种祝福，可以给我们带来好天气，并加快我们的兄弟姐妹到岸的速度。我们只需要收集好运护符来激活它就行了。$b$b舰船离本岛的距离越近，所需要的护符就越少。可如果你能找到足够的护符，我们就能让他们立刻加快速度了……
Description.english: <An urgent plea reaches your ears.>$b$b$n! The Horde fleet is making its way to Pandaria. With favorable winds, they could arrive any moment.$b$bThe Pandaren have a blessing that will give us good luck with the weather and speed our brothers and sisters to these shores. We simply need to collect charms of good fortune to gain fortune's favor.$b$bAs our ships draw closer to the island, less charms will be required. But if you have enough, we can speed them here right away...

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的双月殿与烈日行者德兹科谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Sunwalker Dezco at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: They All Fall Down
identity.objectives: Kill 5 Spirit-Bound Sentries and then use the Resonance Crystal to capture the Zandalari Spirits trapped within.
identity.description: The Zandalari do not tolerate weakness in their ranks, $c.$b$bThose that are deemed weak are often sacrificed in barbaric ceremonies. The victims' spirits are captured and entombed within the sentries you see guarding the grounds.$b$bI wish to study their essence. For this I will need your help.$b$bTake this resonance crystal and siphon the spirits from the sentry corpses.$b$b Do not allow them to escape!

Objectives.text: 消灭5名缚灵哨兵，并使用共振水晶捕捉被禁锢在哨兵中的赞达拉巨魔灵魂。
Objectives.english: Kill 5 Spirit-Bound Sentries and then use the Resonance Crystal to capture the Zandalari Spirits trapped within.

Description.text: 赞达拉巨魔是不会怜悯部落中的弱者的，$c。$b$b那些被视为弱者的人常常会被当成野蛮仪式中的祭品。受害者的灵魂会被禁锢到那些担任守卫的哨兵里。$b$b我想要研究一下他们的精华。因此我需要你的帮助。$b$b带上这枚共振水晶，将灵魂从哨兵的尸体里吸出来。$b$b别让它们跑了！
Description.english: The Zandalari do not tolerate weakness in their ranks, $c.$b$bThose that are deemed weak are often sacrificed in barbaric ceremonies. The victims' spirits are captured and entombed within the sentries you see guarding the grounds.$b$bI wish to study their essence. For this I will need your help.$b$bTake this resonance crystal and siphon the spirits from the sentry corpses.$b$b Do not allow them to escape!

identity.title: Power Play
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Mask of the Dark Mystic and the Mask of the Spirit-Caller from Spiritbinder Tu'chek and Arcanital Ra'kul within Conqueror's Terrace.
identity.description: The Zandalari have found a way to infuse items of great power with the essence of their loa. These items are often passed from one generation to another, each recipient adding to the item's power.$b$bTwo such items exist here. To be specific, two masks, worn by two brothers.$b$bSpiritbinder Tu'chek and Arcanital Ra'kul must be stopped and their masks destroyed.$b$bKill them and return their masks to me. I will make sure the masks are disposed of.

Objectives.text: 从征服者平台的缚灵者图切克和魔术士拉古尔处夺取黑暗秘法面具和唤魂者面具。
Objectives.english: Retrieve the Mask of the Dark Mystic and the Mask of the Spirit-Caller from Spiritbinder Tu'chek and Arcanital Ra'kul within Conqueror's Terrace.

Description.text: 赞达拉巨魔有一种方法，能将他们的神灵精华注入到强大的物品中去。这些物品通常都是代代相传，而每一个继承者都会增添物品的威力。$b$b这里就有两件这样的物品。确切的说，是两个面具，分别在两兄弟的手中。$b$b我们必须阻止缚灵者图切克和魔术士拉古尔，并摧毁他们的面具。$b$b快去击败他们，将他们的面具带回来给我。我会处理掉这些面具的。
Description.english: The Zandalari have found a way to infuse items of great power with the essence of their loa. These items are often passed from one generation to another, each recipient adding to the item's power.$b$bTwo such items exist here. To be specific, two masks, worn by two brothers.$b$bSpiritbinder Tu'chek and Arcanital Ra'kul must be stopped and their masks destroyed.$b$bKill them and return their masks to me. I will make sure the masks are disposed of.

identity.title: The Bloodletter
identity.objectives: Kill Kaida the Bloodletter.
identity.description: I have heard a disturbing report, $c.$B$BJust beyond our position, in the Court of Bone, the mogu bring captives to a general named Kaida the Bloodletter.$B$BI will spare you the details, but he thrives on torturing his victims.$B$BThis monster must be stopped. If you fall to his blade, I wish you a swift death.

Objectives.text: 击败放血者喀岱。
Objectives.english: Kill Kaida the Bloodletter.

Description.text: 我收到了一份令人不安的报告，$c。$B$B在距离我们不远的白骨庭院中，魔古族会将俘虏都交给一个名叫放血者喀岱的将军。$B$B具体的细节我就不说了，总之他惯于拷打受害者。$B$B我们必须阻止这个怪物。如果你倒在他的剑下，那我只能祈祷你能速死。
Description.english: I have heard a disturbing report, $c.$B$BJust beyond our position, in the Court of Bone, the mogu bring captives to a general named Kaida the Bloodletter.$B$BI will spare you the details, but he thrives on torturing his victims.$B$BThis monster must be stopped. If you fall to his blade, I wish you a swift death.

identity.title: Mission: The Secrets of Stormwind
identity.description: Send undercover forces into the heart of enemy territory in an effort to learn of their plans.

Description.text: 派遣一支秘密部队潜入敌方腹地，设法打探对方的计划。
Description.english: Send undercover forces into the heart of enemy territory in an effort to learn of their plans.

identity.title: A Wing to Fly On
identity.objectives: Recover a Wild Ptrerrorwing Hatchling.
identity.description: I've just received a report that another young pterrorwing has been spotted in the Diremoor.$B$BWe need to recover as many of these as we can find. They may be the key to flying on this island.

Objectives.text: 找回一只野生飞翼幼龙。
Objectives.english: Recover a Wild Ptrerrorwing Hatchling.

Description.text: 我刚刚收到报告，在阴惨泥沼里又发现了另一只飞翼幼龙。$B$B我们要把能找到的所有飞翼幼龙都找回来。它们也许是在这岛上飞行的关键所在。
Description.english: I've just received a report that another young pterrorwing has been spotted in the Diremoor.$B$BWe need to recover as many of these as we can find. They may be the key to flying on this island.

identity.title: The Bloodletter
identity.objectives: Kill Kaida the Bloodletter.
identity.description: I have heard a disturbing report, $c.$B$BTo the south, in the Court of Bones, the mogu bring captives to a general named Kaida the Bloodletter.$B$BI will spare you the details, but he thrives on torturing his victims.$B$BThis monster must be stopped. If you fall to his blade, I wish you a swift death.

Objectives.text: 击败放血者喀岱。
Objectives.english: Kill Kaida the Bloodletter.

Description.text: 我收到了一份令人不安的报告，$c。$B$B在南方的白骨庭院中，魔古族会将俘虏都交给一个名叫放血者喀岱的将军。$B$B具体的细节我就不说了，总之他惯于拷打受害者。$B$B我们必须阻止这个怪物。如果你倒在他的剑下，那我只能祈祷你能速死。
Description.english: I have heard a disturbing report, $c.$B$BTo the south, in the Court of Bones, the mogu bring captives to a general named Kaida the Bloodletter.$B$BI will spare you the details, but he thrives on torturing his victims.$B$BThis monster must be stopped. If you fall to his blade, I wish you a swift death.

CompletionLog.text: 去雷神岛的[Horde Hub]找大法师罗曼斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Grand Magister Rommath at [Horde Hub] at the Isle of the Thunder King.

identity.title: The Beating of Troll Drums
identity.objectives: Locate Scout Captain Elsia within Conqueror's Terrace.
identity.description: Do you hear that, $c? The beating of war drums in the distance. The Zandalari are preparing for us.$b$bLet's not give them the luxury of time to organize their defenses. We need to push the attack now!$b$bReport to Scout Captain Elsia within Conqueror's Terrace. She will have further orders for you.

Objectives.text: 在征服者平台找到斥候队长艾尔希娅。
Objectives.english: Locate Scout Captain Elsia within Conqueror's Terrace.

Description.text: 你听见了吗，$c？在远处擂响的战鼓声。那是赞达拉巨魔们在准备迎战呢。$b$b我们可不能让他们安逸地部署防御。现在就得发起攻击！$b$b去征服者平台向斥候队长艾尔希娅回报。她会向你传达更多指示。
Description.english: Do you hear that, $c? The beating of war drums in the distance. The Zandalari are preparing for us.$b$bLet's not give them the luxury of time to organize their defenses. We need to push the attack now!$b$bReport to Scout Captain Elsia within Conqueror's Terrace. She will have further orders for you.

identity.title: Ashes of the Enemy
identity.objectives: Burn 8 Mummified Remains.
identity.description: The mogu at the Court of Bones are bolstering their army by resurrecting the spirits of their dead.$B$BWe cannot allow them to revive their fallen warriors.$B$BTake this torch and burn any mummified corpses that you can find.$B$BWe will destroy our enemies before they have a chance to rise.

Objectives.text: 超度8具干尸残骸。
Objectives.english: Burn 8 Mummified Remains.

Description.text: 白骨庭院中的魔古族正在施法复活亡者之魂来扩充兵力。$B$B我们决不能任由他们让亡者士兵起死回生。$B$B带上这个火把，去超度你所找到的干尸遗骸。$B$B我们要在这些敌人复活之前先干掉他们。
Description.english: The mogu at the Court of Bones are bolstering their army by resurrecting the spirits of their dead.$B$BWe cannot allow them to revive their fallen warriors.$B$BTake this torch and burn any mummified corpses that you can find.$B$BWe will destroy our enemies before they have a chance to rise.

identity.title: Into the Crypts
identity.objectives: Use the Incantation of Gura in the Hall of the Exalted, then defeat Gura the Reclaimed.
identity.description: Every day, we uncover additional relics from the Court of Bones.$B$BRecently, we discovered this scroll amongst the gravestones in one of the deepest crypts.$B$BI believe that this incantation can be used to call beyond the grave. And if my Mogu is up to date, I'd say you should use it in the last room in the Hall of the Exalted.$B$BWould you be willing to test out my theory?

Objectives.text: 在至尊殿使用古拉的咒语，然后击败重生的古拉。
Objectives.english: Use the Incantation of Gura in the Hall of the Exalted, then defeat Gura the Reclaimed.

Description.text: 每一天，我们都会从白骨庭院发现更多的遗物。$B$B最近，他们在其中一处最深处墓穴的石碑上找到了这个卷轴。$B$B我相信这个咒语能够唤起坟墓中的死者。如果我的魔古知识没错，那你应该到至尊殿的最后一个房间里使用它。$B$B你愿意去验证一下我的理论吗？
Description.english: Every day, we uncover additional relics from the Court of Bones.$B$BRecently, we discovered this scroll amongst the gravestones in one of the deepest crypts.$B$BI believe that this incantation can be used to call beyond the grave. And if my Mogu is up to date, I'd say you should use it in the last room in the Hall of the Exalted.$B$BWould you be willing to test out my theory?

identity.title: The Bloodletter
identity.objectives: Kill Kaida the Bloodletter.
identity.description: I have heard a disturbing report, $c.$B$BJust beyond our position, in the Court of Bones, the mogu bring captives to a general named Kaida the Bloodletter.$B$BHe thrives on torturing his victims.$B$BThis monster must be stopped. If you fall to his blade, I wish you a swift death.

Objectives.text: 击败放血者喀岱。
Objectives.english: Kill Kaida the Bloodletter.

Description.text: 我收到了一份令人不安的报告，$c。$B$B在距离我们不远的白骨庭院中，魔古族会将俘虏都交给一个名叫放血者喀岱的将军。$B$B他惯于拷打受害者。$B$B我们必须阻止这个怪物。如果你倒在他的剑下，那我只能祈祷你能速死。
Description.english: I have heard a disturbing report, $c.$B$BJust beyond our position, in the Court of Bones, the mogu bring captives to a general named Kaida the Bloodletter.$B$BHe thrives on torturing his victims.$B$BThis monster must be stopped. If you fall to his blade, I wish you a swift death.

identity.title: The Conquest of Stone
identity.objectives: Disrupt the Ancient Stone Conqueror ritual in the main temple at the Court of Bones.
identity.description: In the Court of Bones, the Thunder King's sorcerers perform dark rituals.$B$BTo bolster their numbers, the Shan'ze soulrippers are imbuing ancient stone statues with stolen spirits from the living.$B$BAfter these stone conquerors are brought to life, they will be formidable opponents on the battlefield.$B$BWe must stop their ritual before these statues can be revived.

Objectives.text: 打断在白骨庭院主殿中举行的古代岩石征服者仪式。
Objectives.english: Disrupt the Ancient Stone Conqueror ritual in the main temple at the Court of Bones.

Description.text: 在白骨庭院中，雷电之王麾下的巫师们正在举行黑暗的仪式。$B$B为扩充军力，山泽夺魂者们将从生者身上偷取的灵魂，注入古老的石头雕像里。$B$B当这些岩石征服者被赋予生命后，他们就会成为战场上可怕的敌手。$B$B我们必须在这些雕像被复活前，阻止他们的仪式。
Description.english: In the Court of Bones, the Thunder King's sorcerers perform dark rituals.$B$BTo bolster their numbers, the Shan'ze soulrippers are imbuing ancient stone statues with stolen spirits from the living.$B$BAfter these stone conquerors are brought to life, they will be formidable opponents on the battlefield.$B$BWe must stop their ritual before these statues can be revived.

identity.title: Surgical Strike
identity.objectives: Slay 3 Zandalari Spiritbinders, 3 Zandalari Beastcallers, and 3 Zandalari Jaguar Warriors.
identity.description:
Zandalari spiritbinders perform sacrifices to their gods, the beastcallers bend innocent skyscreamers to their will, and the jaguar warriors venture closer to us by the day.

Dispose of these threats in Za'Tual, $r, and watch the might of the trolls weaken.

Objectives.text: 击败3名赞达拉缚灵者、3名赞达拉驭兽师和3名赞达拉丛林豹战士。
Objectives.english: Slay 3 Zandalari Spiritbinders, 3 Zandalari Beastcallers, and 3 Zandalari Jaguar Warriors.

Description.text:
赞达拉缚灵者举行献祭来取悦神灵，驭兽师迫使无辜的啸天龙听命于自己的意志，而丛林豹战士则向我们日渐逼近。

去赞图尔消灭这些威胁，$r，削弱巨魔的力量。
Description.english:
Zandalari spiritbinders perform sacrifices to their gods, the beastcallers bend innocent skyscreamers to their will, and the jaguar warriors venture closer to us by the day.

Dispose of these threats in Za'Tual, $r, and watch the might of the trolls weaken.

identity.title: The Creeping Carpet of Ihgaluk
identity.objectives: Crush 75 Ihgaluk Roaches.
identity.description: Ah, roaches! I once bought a pet roach in Booty Bay.$b$bRoaches will soak up disease like a sponge, and then spread it as far as they can run. Which is pretty far.$b$bIhgaluk Crag is crawling with the things, and they carry Skumblade filth all over of this island. Crush as many of them as you can while you're there.

Objectives.text: 踩死75只伊瓜鲁克蟑螂。
Objectives.english: Crush 75 Ihgaluk Roaches.

Description.text: 啊，蟑螂！我曾在藏宝海湾买过一只宠物蟑螂。$b$b蟑螂会像海绵一样吸收病菌，然后将它们散播到自己所经之处。而它们的活动范围偏偏又很广。$b$b伊瓜鲁克峭壁上爬满了这种东西，将邪刃部族的秽物传播到岛上的每一个角落。当你去那里时，记得尽可能多踩死几只蟑螂。
Description.english: Ah, roaches! I once bought a pet roach in Booty Bay.$b$bRoaches will soak up disease like a sponge, and then spread it as far as they can run. Which is pretty far.$b$bIhgaluk Crag is crawling with the things, and they carry Skumblade filth all over of this island. Crush as many of them as you can while you're there.

identity.title: The More You Know
identity.objectives: Retrieve 6 Ritual Artifacts from around Conqueror's Terrace.
identity.description: This whole area is littered with Zandalari artifacts. I would be lying if I said studying them didn't interest me. I am fascinated by the significance of these objects to their rituals.$b$bThe more we understand our enemies, the better prepared we are to defeat them.$b$bIf I am to study them, I will need to see them up close. Bring me as many artifacts as you can find.

Objectives.text: 在征服者平台附近找回6个仪式神器。
Objectives.english: Retrieve 6 Ritual Artifacts from around Conqueror's Terrace.

Description.text: 这里到处都是赞达拉神器。要是我跟你说，我没兴趣研究它们，那我一定是在说谎。这些器物对赞达拉仪式的重要性令我着迷。$b$b知己知彼，才能百战百胜。$b$b要想研究它们，我就必须得近距离观察清楚才行。把你能找到的所有神器都带回来交给我。
Description.english: This whole area is littered with Zandalari artifacts. I would be lying if I said studying them didn't interest me. I am fascinated by the significance of these objects to their rituals.$b$bThe more we understand our enemies, the better prepared we are to defeat them.$b$bIf I am to study them, I will need to see them up close. Bring me as many artifacts as you can find.

identity.title: Out of Enemy Hands
identity.objectives: Steal 7 Loa-Infused Blades from Conqueror's Terrace.
identity.description: Magic is a frightening opponent when wielded by an experienced caster. A blade however, is terrifying in even the most inexperienced hands.$b$bThe Zandalari have some impressive weapons, made even more deadly by the magic they are enhanced with. We should relieve them of this advantage.$b$bSteal as many of the weapons as you can find.

Objectives.text: 从征服者平台偷取7把灌注神力的利刃。
Objectives.english: Steal 7 Loa-Infused Blades from Conqueror's Terrace.

Description.text: 魔法只有被老练的施法者驾驭，才会变成可怕的敌人。但利刃则不然——即使是被毫无战斗经验的人挥持，也足以令人胆寒。$b$b赞达拉巨魔掌管着一些颇具杀伤力的武器，灌注其上的魔法又更加令其如虎添翼。我们一定要让他们丧失这种优势。$b$b把你所能找到的武器全都偷回来。
Description.english: Magic is a frightening opponent when wielded by an experienced caster. A blade however, is terrifying in even the most inexperienced hands.$b$bThe Zandalari have some impressive weapons, made even more deadly by the magic they are enhanced with. We should relieve them of this advantage.$b$bSteal as many of the weapons as you can find.

identity.title: Competing Magic
identity.objectives: Kill Arcweaver Jor'guva.
identity.description: One of my scryers has identified a Zandalari leader near the central tower. He needs to be removed.$B$BWould you be willing to do this for me, $c?

identity.title: Trailing Light in the Dark
identity.objectives: Relight 8 torches in the Diremoor.
identity.description: There is some dark magic in the Diremoor that extinguishes even our magical illuminations, and so our scouts struggle to find their way.$B$BAs you pass through the swamp, relight any torches you find that our men might find their way. Perhaps they will help you find your way back as well.

Objectives.text: 在阴惨泥沼中重新点燃8个火炬。
Objectives.english: Relight 8 torches in the Diremoor.

Description.text: 在阴惨泥沼中存在着某种黑暗法术，就连我们的魔法之光都能扑灭，我们的斥候只得艰难的辨识方向。$B$B当你在泥沼中穿行时，重新将你所找到的所有火炬点燃，从而为我们的兄弟们照亮道路。或许它们还能帮你找到回来的路。
Description.english: There is some dark magic in the Diremoor that extinguishes even our magical illuminations, and so our scouts struggle to find their way.$B$BAs you pass through the swamp, relight any torches you find that our men might find their way. Perhaps they will help you find your way back as well.

CompletionLog.text: 去紫罗兰高地找战斗法师尤里亚斯。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Warmage Yurias at the Violet Rise.

identity.title: A Wing to Fly On
identity.objectives: Recover a Wild Ptrerrorwing Hatchling.
identity.description: I've just received a report that another young pterrorwing has been spotted in the Diremoor.$B$BWe need to recover as many of these as we can find. They may be the key to flying on this island.

Objectives.text: 找回一只野生飞翼幼龙。
Objectives.english: Recover a Wild Ptrerrorwing Hatchling.

Description.text: 我刚刚收到报告，在阴惨泥沼里又发现了另一只飞翼幼龙。$B$B我们要把能找到的所有飞翼幼龙都找回来。它们也许是在这岛上飞行的关键所在。
Description.english: I've just received a report that another young pterrorwing has been spotted in the Diremoor.$B$BWe need to recover as many of these as we can find. They may be the key to flying on this island.

identity.title: Meet Me Upstairs
identity.objectives: Meet Wrathion upstairs on the second floor of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
identity.description: There's someone I'd like you to meet. Stormwind's own crown prince recently paid a visit to this humble inn. I've instructed my guards to defend him from any Horde aggression - I don't want to draw any undue attention to myself.$b$bHe and I have been discussing world events, such as the battle along the southern shores, his encounter with Garrosh, and the upcoming assault on the Thunder King.$b$bCome! Let's talk upstairs...

Objectives.text: 在雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆二楼与拉希奥会面。
Objectives.english: Meet Wrathion upstairs on the second floor of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

Description.text: 我想带你见个人。暴风城的王子殿下不久前造访了这间简陋的旅舍。我命令守卫保护他，使他免受任何来自部落的威胁——当然，我可不想为自己招来任何不必要的关注。$b$b他与我纵谈世界大事，比如发生在南部海岸上的战争，他与加尔鲁什的会面，以及雷电之王即将发起的攻击。$b$b来吧！让我们到楼上聊聊……
Description.english: There's someone I'd like you to meet. Stormwind's own crown prince recently paid a visit to this humble inn. I've instructed my guards to defend him from any Horde aggression - I don't want to draw any undue attention to myself.$b$bHe and I have been discussing world events, such as the battle along the southern shores, his encounter with Garrosh, and the upcoming assault on the Thunder King.$b$bCome! Let's talk upstairs...

CompletionLog.text: 在雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆二楼与拉希奥会面。
CompletionLog.english: Meet Wrathion upstairs on the second floor of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

identity.title: I Need a Champion
identity.objectives: Earn Exalted Reputation with the Black Prince by defeating mogu, Zandalari, and saurok enemies on the Isle of Thunder.
identity.description: You are a superb representative of your people, $r. But I need someone special. I have big plans. And to enact them I will need a champion to carry my flame to the four corners of the world.$b$bAre you the one?$b$bProve it to me on the Isle of Thunder! Lay waste to any mogu, Zandalari, or saurok that you find. Impress me!

Objectives.text: 在雷神岛上击败魔古、赞达拉巨魔和蜥蜴人，在黑王子阵营中达到崇拜声望。
Objectives.english: Earn Exalted Reputation with the Black Prince by defeating mogu, Zandalari, and saurok enemies on the Isle of Thunder.

Description.text: 你是你族人当中的盖世精锐，$r。可我需要的是一个特别的帮手。我有一揽子的大计划。若要将这些计划变为现实，就得有一位勇士，将我的光辉散播到世界各处。$b$b你是合适的人选吗？$b$b去雷神岛向我证明你的实力吧！消灭你所遇到的所有魔古、赞达拉巨魔或蜥蜴人。让我对你刮目相看！
Description.english: You are a superb representative of your people, $r. But I need someone special. I have big plans. And to enact them I will need a champion to carry my flame to the four corners of the world.$b$bAre you the one?$b$bProve it to me on the Isle of Thunder! Lay waste to any mogu, Zandalari, or saurok that you find. Impress me!

identity.title: The Thunder Forge
identity.objectives: Progress through the Isle of Thunder until you unlock the Thunder Forge. Meet Wrathion outside the Thunder Forge and complete his task.
identity.description: Everything is prepared, $n, and I have selected you to be my champion.$b$bNext, we must infiltrate the legendary Thunder Forge of Lei Shen himself! You and your faction will need to advance forward until the Thunder Forge is exposed, if it isn't already.$b$bOnce you have infiltrated the forge, meet me there. Be ready for a fight!

CompletionLog.text: 去雷神岛的雷霆熔炉附近与拉希奥交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Wrathion near the Thunder Forge on the Isle of Thunder.

identity.title: Spirit of the Storm Lord
identity.objectives: Progress through the Isle of Thunder until you unlock the final courtyard. Obtain a Tempered Lightning Lance by thrusting the lance into Storm Lord Nalak and surviving long enough to siphon his power.
identity.description: Our next objective is to temper this weapon with the blood of a demigod, one imbued with the Thunder King's powers.$b$bMy agents tell me that the mogu named Shan Bu is creating just such a creature, intended to guard the Thunder King's citadel.$b$bOnce your faction has fought your way to the front gates, attack Storm Lord Nalak and thrust this lance into his side. The creature will do everything in his power to stop you - stay alive long enough to siphon out the power of the Storm Lord!

Objectives.text: 在雷神岛上继续探索，直到你找到最后一个庭院。将长枪插进暴风领主纳拉克的身体里，坚持到将他的力量虹吸出来，以获得淬火闪电长枪。
Objectives.english: Progress through the Isle of Thunder until you unlock the final courtyard. Obtain a Tempered Lightning Lance by thrusting the lance into Storm Lord Nalak and surviving long enough to siphon his power.

Description.text: 我们的下一个目标，就是要用充满雷电之王力量的半神之血来调节这把武器。$b$b据密探回报，有位名叫山怖的魔古族正在创造这样一种怪物，想让其戍守雷电堡。$b$b当你的阵营攻到前门时，攻击暴风领主纳拉克，并将这根长枪插进它的身侧。这只怪物会使出浑身解数来阻止你——在成功将暴风领主的力量吸出来以前，千万要挺住！
Description.english: Our next objective is to temper this weapon with the blood of a demigod, one imbued with the Thunder King's powers.$b$bMy agents tell me that the mogu named Shan Bu is creating just such a creature, intended to guard the Thunder King's citadel.$b$bOnce your faction has fought your way to the front gates, attack Storm Lord Nalak and thrust this lance into his side. The creature will do everything in his power to stop you - stay alive long enough to siphon out the power of the Storm Lord!

CompletionLog.text: 将淬火闪电长枪带回雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆，交给拉希奥。
CompletionLog.english: Bring the Tempered Lightning Lance to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

identity.title: The Crown of Heaven
identity.objectives: Meet Wrathion atop Mason's Folly in the Veiled Stair and collect your reward.
identity.description: Do you recall Mason's Folly, the hilltop east of here where you and I met before?$b$bI'm going to use the Lightning Lance to create something special, and I certainly can't do it in here.$b$bMeet me atop Mason's Folly so that we may celebrate our victories together!

Objectives.text: 与拉希奥在雾纱栈道的石匠之愚碰面，并领取奖赏。
Objectives.english: Meet Wrathion atop Mason's Folly in the Veiled Stair and collect your reward.

Description.text: 你还记得石匠之愚吗？就在东边的山顶上，我们曾在那里见过面。$b$b我要用这把闪电长枪创造一样特别的东西，当然不能在这进行了。$b$b去石匠之愚与我会面，让我们共同欢庆胜利！
Description.english: Do you recall Mason's Folly, the hilltop east of here where you and I met before?$b$bI'm going to use the Lightning Lance to create something special, and I certainly can't do it in here.$b$bMeet me atop Mason's Folly so that we may celebrate our victories together!

CompletionLog.text: 去雾纱栈道的石匠之愚与拉希奥谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Wrathion atop Mason's Folly in the Veiled Stair.

identity.title: Heart of the Thunder King
identity.objectives: Slay the Thunder King in the Halls of Thunder and collect the Heart of the Thunder King.
identity.description: The Thunder King. Dead for twelve thousand years, only to be brought back by Zandalari voice. No doubt Titan power preserved his vile corpse.$b$bTitan power that's mine by right.$b$b$n! Bring me the heart of the Thunder King. I will have it, and once it is mine, none will ever be able to resurrect him again.$b$bBring it to me, $c. Bring me his cold, dead heart!

Objectives.text: 在雷电王座内殿里消灭雷电之王，并取得雷神之核。
Objectives.english: Slay the Thunder King in the Halls of Thunder and collect the Heart of the Thunder King.

Description.text: 已死去一万两千年之久的雷电之王，却被赞达拉的声音唤了回来。无疑是泰坦之力使他邪恶的尸身恒久不腐。$b$b泰坦之力应该归我所有。$b$b$n！把雷神之核给我带回来。一旦我得到了它，谁也别想再让他起死回生。$b$b把它带来交给我，$c。把他冰冷的核心交给我！
Description.english: The Thunder King. Dead for twelve thousand years, only to be brought back by Zandalari voice. No doubt Titan power preserved his vile corpse.$b$bTitan power that's mine by right.$b$b$n! Bring me the heart of the Thunder King. I will have it, and once it is mine, none will ever be able to resurrect him again.$b$bBring it to me, $c. Bring me his cold, dead heart!

CompletionLog.text: 将雷神之核带回雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆，交给拉希奥。
CompletionLog.english: Bring the heart to Wrathion at the Tavern in the mists in the Veiled Stair.

identity.title: Rumbles of Thunder
identity.objectives: Bring the Rumbles of Thunder to Lorewalker Cho.
identity.description: Dear $p,$b$bThe foreboding sound of thunder has haunted my people for generations. And as you have discovered in your own research, Lei Shen is at the heart of that fear.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

Objectives.text: 将雷电轰鸣带给游学者周卓。
Objectives.english: Bring the Rumbles of Thunder to Lorewalker Cho.

CompletionLog.text: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

identity.title: Subtle Encouragement
identity.objectives: Plant Mogu Weapons into the corpses of 9 Skumblade saurok.
identity.description: The saurok are vile, but we share an enemy: the mogu. And I'd rather send saurok to kill mogu than send my own men.$b$bWe've been collecting mogu weaponry. Bury these polearms into the skulls of the saurok. Feed our enemies' rivalry, and you may save Alliance lives.

Objectives.text: 将魔古武器插在9个邪刃蜥蜴人的尸体附近。
Objectives.english: Plant Mogu Weapons into the corpses of 9 Skumblade saurok.

Description.text: 蜥蜴人非常邪恶，但我们却有着共同的敌人——魔古族。我更愿意派蜥蜴人去消灭魔古族，而不是让我自己的兄弟去送死。$b$b我们一直在收集魔古的武器。击败蜥蜴人后，将这些长矛插在它们身边。让我们的敌人自相残杀，就能挽救大批联盟手足的性命。
Description.english: The saurok are vile, but we share an enemy: the mogu. And I'd rather send saurok to kill mogu than send my own men.$b$bWe've been collecting mogu weaponry. Bury these polearms into the skulls of the saurok. Feed our enemies' rivalry, and you may save Alliance lives.

identity.title: Chief Engineer Jard's Journal
identity.objectives: Investigate the Thunder Forges to find the Secrets of Stabilized Lightning.
identity.description: What an unusual power source. Wonder how it works? And what it can be used to create?

Title.text: 首席工程师贾德的日记

Objectives.text: 调查雷霆熔炉，找到固化闪电的秘诀。
Objectives.english: Investigate the Thunder Forges to find the Secrets of Stabilized Lightning.

Description.text: 多么另类的能量之源啊！不知它是怎么运作的？它又能创造出什么呢？
Description.english: What an unusual power source. Wonder how it works? And what it can be used to create?

CompletionLog.text: 找到固化闪电的秘诀。
CompletionLog.english: Find the Secrets of Stabilized Lightning.

identity.title: Breaking Down the Defenses
identity.objectives: Destroy 6 Sunreaver Perimeter Wards around Dawnseeker Promontory.
identity.description: Even the strongest defense can still have a weakness, $c. We just need to find the weakness in the Sunreaver's defense and then exploit it as much as possible.$b$bScouts have reported the use of perimeter wards around Dawnseeker Promontory. They're powerful, but not deadly.$b$bDisabling them would allow us to keep closer watch on their activities.

Objectives.text: 在寻晨者海角附近摧毁6个夺日者监视结界。
Objectives.english: Destroy 6 Sunreaver Perimeter Wards around Dawnseeker Promontory.

Description.text: 哪怕是最无懈可击的防御也会有薄弱点，$c。我们只需要找到夺日者防线的薄弱点，然后尽可能地加以利用。$b$b据斥候回报，在寻晨者海角四处布满了监视结界。这些结界十分强大，可并不具有致命的杀伤力。$b$b如果能让它们失效，我们就能近距离监视夺日者的行动了。
Description.english: Even the strongest defense can still have a weakness, $c. We just need to find the weakness in the Sunreaver's defense and then exploit it as much as possible.$b$bScouts have reported the use of perimeter wards around Dawnseeker Promontory. They're powerful, but not deadly.$b$bDisabling them would allow us to keep closer watch on their activities.

identity.title: Extended Shore Leave
identity.objectives: Steal the Workshop Orders and slay the new captain of the Zandalari warship.
identity.description: The Zandalari have already begun repairing that warship, but we can keep it crippled with minimal effort.$B$BSimply relieve the new captain of his post, and steal the ship's damage report from that workshop just outside the vault.$B$BNo captain. No repairs. No warship.

Objectives.text: 偷取工坊报告，并消灭赞达拉战船的新船长。
Objectives.english: Steal the Workshop Orders and slay the new captain of the Zandalari warship.

Description.text: 赞达拉巨魔已经开始修复战船了，但我们稍作努力，就能让他们无法成事。$B$B把那位新上任的船长从位子上拉下来，然后从地窖外面的工作间里偷取舰船的损坏报告。$B$B没有船长。没有修复。没有战船。
Description.english: The Zandalari have already begun repairing that warship, but we can keep it crippled with minimal effort.$B$BSimply relieve the new captain of his post, and steal the ship's damage report from that workshop just outside the vault.$B$BNo captain. No repairs. No warship.

identity.title: Rocks Fall, People Die
identity.objectives: Slay the Rocky Horror.
identity.description: Words fail to describe the massive horror of rock, bone, and blood that rumbles mindlessly and aimlessly ahead of you.$b $bMassive earthquakes crack the seemingly hollow shell of ground beneath the figure, leaving destruction in its wake. It appears that the creature is unaware of your presence.

Objectives.text: 击败岩石恐魔。
Objectives.english: Slay the Rocky Horror.

Description.text: 出现在你面前的，是个由岩石、骨头和鲜血构成的恐怖巨怪，正在漫无目地盲目暴走，简直无法用语言加以形容。$b$b那怪物脚下的地面剧烈颤动，如空壳般破裂开来，所到之处一片狼藉。看来这只生物完全没有察觉到你的出现。
Description.english: Words fail to describe the massive horror of rock, bone, and blood that rumbles mindlessly and aimlessly ahead of you.$b $bMassive earthquakes crack the seemingly hollow shell of ground beneath the figure, leaving destruction in its wake. It appears that the creature is unaware of your presence.

identity.title: Taming the Tempest
identity.objectives: Slay No'ku Stormsayer.
identity.description: You hear a fierce and militant voice roaring in the distance. A crackling storm swells and swirls around a clouded, shadowy figure. Lightning flashes and No'ku Stormsayer appears, his scornful gaze aimed directly at you.

Objectives.text: 击败颂风者诺库。
Objectives.english: Slay No'ku Stormsayer.

Description.text: 你听见从远处传来一声凶猛刺耳的咆哮。劈啪作响的风暴在一个模糊阴暗的身影四周升腾盘旋。随着闪电划过，颂风者诺库现身了，他目空一切地径直凝视着你。
Description.english: You hear a fierce and militant voice roaring in the distance. A crackling storm swells and swirls around a clouded, shadowy figure. Lightning flashes and No'ku Stormsayer appears, his scornful gaze aimed directly at you.

identity.title: Requiem for a Queen
identity.objectives: Put Monara to rest.
identity.description: A chilling breeze sweeps across your body, bringing with it a haunting drape of sadness. Your soul sinks as you hear the faint, melodic cries of Monara, the last Queen of the Mogu.$b$bHer sweet requiem creeps through the air, bending and shaping itself into a spectral hand, reaching for your heart. As it grabs hold, you see a brief flash of Monara's last moments... her brutal murder by the hand of Lei Shen.$b$bSong turns to sadness and Monara weeps, wailing louder and louder into the darkness.

Objectives.text: 让莫纳拉安息。
Objectives.english: Put Monara to rest.

Description.text: 一阵冷风掠过你的身体，风中夹杂着挥之不去的哀伤。当你听到魔古末代皇后莫纳拉那带有旋律的低声哭喊时，你感到灵魂在往下沉。$b$b她那甜美嗓音唱出的安魂曲弥漫在空气里，歌声弯曲成形，竟变成了一只幽灵之手，攫住了你的心。随着这只手越抓越紧，你看见了莫纳拉临终前的片刻时光……是雷神残忍地亲手夺走了她的生命。$b$b曲调变得悲鸣，莫纳拉哀泣起来，在黑暗中越来越大声地恸哭着。
Description.english: A chilling breeze sweeps across your body, bringing with it a haunting drape of sadness. Your soul sinks as you hear the faint, melodic cries of Monara, the last Queen of the Mogu.$b$bHer sweet requiem creeps through the air, bending and shaping itself into a spectral hand, reaching for your heart. As it grabs hold, you see a brief flash of Monara's last moments... her brutal murder by the hand of Lei Shen.$b$bSong turns to sadness and Monara weeps, wailing louder and louder into the darkness.

identity.title: Mogu Runes of Fate
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Lesser Charms of Good Fortune.
identity.description: Greetings, $n. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With a Mogu Rune of Fate, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently inside the palace of the Thunder King.

Description.text: 欢迎你，$n。我有幸为你送上一个难得的好机会。经过几个世纪，我们找到了一种可以改变运势的方法。只要拥有魔古命运符石，雷电之王宫殿中的珍贵神器就会更加频繁地自动落入你的手中。
Description.english: Greetings, $n. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With a Mogu Rune of Fate, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently inside the palace of the Thunder King.

With a Mogu Rune of Fate, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently inside the palace of the Thunder King.

Description.text: 欢迎你，$n。我有幸为你送上一个难得的好机会。经过几个世纪，我们找到了一种可以改变运势的方法。只要拥有魔古命运符石，雷电之王宫殿中的珍贵神器就会更加频繁地自动落入你的手中。
Description.english: Greetings, $n. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With a Mogu Rune of Fate, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently inside the palace of the Thunder King.

identity.title: Forge Ahead!
identity.objectives: Kill the Master of the Forge and collect a Codex Fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku in the Isle of Thunder.
identity.description:
There's more you must do. 

Kill Itoka, master of the forge, and find a codex fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku, gatekeeper of the Thunder King.

Objectives.text: 在雷王島上殺死熔爐統領，並從血肉工匠郝古身上取得聖典殘片。
Objectives.english: Kill the Master of the Forge and collect a Codex Fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku in the Isle of Thunder.

Description.text:
還有一件事情你非做不可。

殺死熔爐統領夷托卡，再從雷王守門人血肉工匠郝古身上取得聖典殘片。
Description.english:
There's more you must do. 

Kill Itoka, master of the forge, and find a codex fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku, gatekeeper of the Thunder King.

CompletionLog.text: 向斥候隊長艾爾西雅回報。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Scout Captain Elsia.

identity.title: reuse me
identity.objectives: Kill the Master of the Forge and Collect a Codex Fragment from the Mogu Gatekeeper in the Isle of Thunder.
identity.description:
There's more you must do. 

Kill Itoka, master of the forge, and find a codex fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku, gatekeeper of the Thunder King.

Objectives.text: 在雷神岛上消灭锻造大师，然后从魔古看门人身上找到一块法典碎片。
Objectives.english: Kill the Master of the Forge and Collect a Codex Fragment from the Mogu Gatekeeper in the Isle of Thunder.

Description.text:
还有其它事情要你去做。

消灭锻造大师伊多喀，然后从雷电之王的看门人——塑肌者霍古身上找到一块法典碎片。
Description.english:
There's more you must do. 

Kill Itoka, master of the forge, and find a codex fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku, gatekeeper of the Thunder King.

CompletionLog.text: 回去找<the questgiver>
CompletionLog.english: Return to <the questgiver>

identity.description:

Kill Itoka, master of the forge, and find a codex fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku, gatekeeper of the Thunder King.

Objectives.english: Kill the Master of the Forge and Collect a Codex Fragment from the Mogu Gatekeeper in the Isle of Thunder.
