Description.english:
There's more you must do. 

Kill Itoka, master of the forge, and find a codex fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku, gatekeeper of the Thunder King.

CompletionLog.text: 向斥候隊長狄林回報。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Scout Captain Daelin.

identity.title: The Court of Bones
identity.objectives: Find Grand Magister Rommath outside the Court of Bones.
identity.description: The mogu within the nearby Court of Bones pose a constant threat to our foothold on this island. Grand Magister Rommath has been entrusted with halting their efforts, but I am certain he could use a capable $c to see this task through.$B$BGo to him. Aid in whatever ways that you are able.

Objectives.text: 在白骨庭院外面找到大法师罗曼斯。
Objectives.english: Find Grand Magister Rommath outside the Court of Bones.

Description.text: 附近白骨庭院中的魔古族一直威胁着我们在这座岛屿上的据点。我已经委派大法师罗曼斯去阻止他们的行动了，但我相信，有像你这么能干的$c帮忙，一定能起到事半功倍的效果。$B$B去找他吧。尽你所能提供帮助。
Description.english: The mogu within the nearby Court of Bones pose a constant threat to our foothold on this island. Grand Magister Rommath has been entrusted with halting their efforts, but I am certain he could use a capable $c to see this task through.$B$BGo to him. Aid in whatever ways that you are able.

identity.title: On the Trail of Blood
identity.objectives: Follow the trail of blood.
identity.description: This orc appears to have made a last stand, dying while defending his fallen wolf. His clothes are that of the Frostwolf Clan.$B$BFrom the tracks and other signs it would appear there were six other wolves during the battle that got away, one bleeding. A trail of fresh blood leads off into the desert northward.

Objectives.text: 沿着血迹前进。
Objectives.english: Follow the trail of blood.

Description.text: 这个兽人似乎在做最后的抗争，在垂死之际还在保护着自己倒下的战狼。看他的衣服，他应该是霜狼氏族的人。$B$B从脚印和其它迹象来看，应该有其它六只战狼从战斗中逃走了，其中一只还在流血。一条新鲜的血迹延伸进了北边的沙漠深处。
Description.english: This orc appears to have made a last stand, dying while defending his fallen wolf. His clothes are that of the Frostwolf Clan.$B$BFrom the tracks and other signs it would appear there were six other wolves during the battle that got away, one bleeding. A trail of fresh blood leads off into the desert northward.

identity.title: Celestial Blessings
identity.objectives: Travel to the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai, the Temple of the Red Crane in Krasarang, the Temple of the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest, and Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes to obtain four blessings of the celestials. Complete ONE of their four available challenges.
identity.description: I would like to grant you my full array of draconic power, but sadly, it would tear your mortal frame apart. Still, it's not hopeless - I believe I can create a powerful vessel that you can use.$b$bTo craft it, I will need the blessings of the four August Celestials in Pandaria. Travel with me to the four temples and we will speak to each. To be worthy of their gifts, you must defeat one of their challenges.$b$bThey will not be easy - chose the one challenge best suited to your equipment and skills!

Objectives.text: 前往昆莱山的白虎寺、卡桑琅丛林的朱鹤寺、翡翠林的青龙寺、螳螂高原的砮皂寺，获得四位天神的祝福。完成他们四项挑战中的其中一项。
Objectives.english: Travel to the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai, the Temple of the Red Crane in Krasarang, the Temple of the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest, and Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes to obtain four blessings of the celestials. Complete ONE of their four available challenges.

Description.text: 我愿意将自己全部的巨龙之力都赋予你，但遗憾的是，那会使你的凡人之躯彻底瓦解。不过，希望仍在——我相信我能创造出一个强大的容器来供你使用。$b$b要想制作这个容器，我需要潘达利亚四位至尊天神的祝福。与我一同前往那四座神殿吧，让我们与诸位天神谈一谈。若要让自己配得上他们的馈赠，你必须赢得他们其中一项挑战。$b$b这些挑战可不简单——选择与你的装备和技能最相匹配的挑战吧！
Description.english: I would like to grant you my full array of draconic power, but sadly, it would tear your mortal frame apart. Still, it's not hopeless - I believe I can create a powerful vessel that you can use.$b$bTo craft it, I will need the blessings of the four August Celestials in Pandaria. Travel with me to the four temples and we will speak to each. To be worthy of their gifts, you must defeat one of their challenges.$b$bThey will not be easy - chose the one challenge best suited to your equipment and skills!

identity.title: A Little Field Work
identity.objectives: Secure passage to Kalimdor from Gleep Chatterswitch at the Shrine of Seven Stars. Then speak with Amber Kearnen, who is scouting Bladefist Bay near Skull Rock in Durotar.
identity.description: My dream brew can only tell me so much. Its visions are scattered in time and space. But it is clear that a showdown is brewing at the Horde capital of Orgrimmar.$b$bYou should go there, and see these events for yourself!$b$bIn my dream brew I see two brave Alliance spies alone in Durotar. I see "Amber" and "Sully"...$b$bPerhaps you remember them? I think they need your help!$b$bYou'll find Amber and Sully in Kalimdor, near Skull Rock, at a place called the Dranosh'ar Blockade.

Objectives.text: 与七星殿的格里普·跳闸交谈以安全抵达卡利姆多。然后与安玻·吉尔妮交谈，她正在杜隆塔尔的骷髅石附近侦察刃拳海湾。
Objectives.english: Secure passage to Kalimdor from Gleep Chatterswitch at the Shrine of Seven Stars. Then speak with Amber Kearnen, who is scouting Bladefist Bay near Skull Rock in Durotar.

Description.text: 我的洄梦仙酒只能告诉我这么多。我所看到的视像都是散落在不同时间与空间中的零星碎片。但显而易见的是，在部落主城奥格瑞玛，正在酝酿一场决战。$b$b你应该前往那里，亲眼见证这些事件！$b$b我通过洄梦仙酒看到，在杜隆塔尔有两位勇敢的联盟密探正在孤身行动。我看见了“安玻”和“苏利”……$b$b也许你还记得他们？我想他们需要你的帮助！$b$b安玻和苏利就在卡利姆多的骷髅石附近，一处名叫德拉诺什尔封锁线的地方。
Description.english: My dream brew can only tell me so much. Its visions are scattered in time and space. But it is clear that a showdown is brewing at the Horde capital of Orgrimmar.$b$bYou should go there, and see these events for yourself!$b$bIn my dream brew I see two brave Alliance spies alone in Durotar. I see "Amber" and "Sully"...$b$bPerhaps you remember them? I think they need your help!$b$bYou'll find Amber and Sully in Kalimdor, near Skull Rock, at a place called the Dranosh'ar Blockade.

identity.title: Gathering Intelligence
identity.objectives: Obtain the Kor'kron Supply Lines, Operation: Darkspear Destruction, Kor'kron Command Posts, and free the prisoner.
identity.description: Garrosh continues building up his forces in Orgrimmar - this place is like a fortress!$b$bKing Wrynn won't want to risk an assault until we have as much information as possible.$b$bUse Project C4T to navigate through the Blockade. Try to gather as much information as you can. Look for any high priority documents and any weakness we can take advantage of. Keep your ears open and your head down!

Objectives.text: 取得“库卡隆补给线”、“行动：毁灭暗矛部族”和“库卡隆指挥官位置图”，并释放囚犯。
Objectives.english: Obtain the Kor'kron Supply Lines, Operation: Darkspear Destruction, Kor'kron Command Posts, and free the prisoner.

Description.text: 加尔鲁什继续在奥格瑞玛壮大自己的军队——这地方简直像堡垒一样！$b$b乌瑞恩国王不愿意冒险出击，除非我们搜集到了尽可能多的情报。$b$b利用C4T计划对封锁线展开调查。尽你所能地搜集情报。寻找任何高优先级的文件，以及任何我们能加以利用的薄弱点。一定要眼观六路耳听八方，小心行事！
Description.english: Garrosh continues building up his forces in Orgrimmar - this place is like a fortress!$b$bKing Wrynn won't want to risk an assault until we have as much information as possible.$b$bUse Project C4T to navigate through the Blockade. Try to gather as much information as you can. Look for any high priority documents and any weakness we can take advantage of. Keep your ears open and your head down!

CompletionLog.text: 回杜隆塔尔的德拉诺什尔封锁线找安玻·吉尔妮。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Amber Kearnen at the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar.

identity.title: The Darkspear Rebellion
identity.objectives: Speak with Zen'tabra at Razor Hill in Durotar.
identity.description: The trolls are in open rebellion. This could work to our advantage! If they open up a second front, Garrosh cannot possibly defend the city from us both.$b$bI have a very risky assignment for you. I need you to be the Alliance representative, and open up talks with Vol'jin of the Darkspear tribe.$b$bTry finding the troll prisoner that we freed from Kor'kron clutches. Zen'tabra, wasn't it?$B$BIt may be our only chance to bring Garrosh to his knees...

Objectives.text: 在杜隆塔尔的剃刀岭与岑塔布拉交谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Zen'tabra at Razor Hill in Durotar.

Description.text: 巨魔们公然反叛了。我们正好可以利用这一点！要是他们能开辟出第二条战线，加尔鲁什就会分身乏术，无法同时抵挡我们两支攻城大军。$b$b我这里有一项风险极高的任务要你去完成。我要你充当联盟代表，去与暗矛部族的沃金展开谈判。$b$b试着找到我们从库卡隆手中救出的巨魔囚犯。好像是叫岑塔布拉对吧？$B$B这也许是我们击垮加尔鲁什的唯一机会……
Description.english: The trolls are in open rebellion. This could work to our advantage! If they open up a second front, Garrosh cannot possibly defend the city from us both.$b$bI have a very risky assignment for you. I need you to be the Alliance representative, and open up talks with Vol'jin of the Darkspear tribe.$b$bTry finding the troll prisoner that we freed from Kor'kron clutches. Zen'tabra, wasn't it?$B$BIt may be our only chance to bring Garrosh to his knees...

identity.title: Battlefield: Barrens
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Kor'kron Lumber, $2oa Kor'kron Oil, $3oa Kor'kron Meat, and $4oa Kor'kron Stone.
identity.description: Ya want we work together on dis, ya gotta earn me trust.$b$bIn Northern Barrens, de Kor'kron be massin' for war. Hellscream's goons be stockpilin' lumber, oil, stone, an' meat. Supplies de Darkspear want ta use against' 'im.$b$bGo to de Barrens. Kill de Kor'kron. Bring me dem supplies! Fight dem wherever dey spring up, escort supply caravans, group up ta take down de dangerous ones. Whatever ya gotta do.$b$bProve ta me da Alliance wants dis! I be watchin'.

Description.text: 你要想跟我们合作，就得先赢得我的信任。$b$b在北贫瘠之地，库卡隆正在积极备战。地狱咆哮的爪牙们大肆囤积木材、原油、石料和食用肉。暗矛部族需要这些补给品来与之对抗。$b$b前往贫瘠之地，消灭库卡隆，把补给品给我带回来！不管他们打哪儿冒出来，都把他们解决掉，护送补给车队，组队去消灭那些危险的敌人。至于方法，你想怎么做都可以。$b$b向我证明联盟的诚意吧！我等着看呢。
Description.english: Ya want we work together on dis, ya gotta earn me trust.$b$bIn Northern Barrens, de Kor'kron be massin' for war. Hellscream's goons be stockpilin' lumber, oil, stone, an' meat. Supplies de Darkspear want ta use against' 'im.$b$bGo to de Barrens. Kill de Kor'kron. Bring me dem supplies! Fight dem wherever dey spring up, escort supply caravans, group up ta take down de dangerous ones. Whatever ya gotta do.$b$bProve ta me da Alliance wants dis! I be watchin'.

identity.title: The Darkspear Rebellion
identity.objectives: Travel to Durotar and speak with Ki'ta Arrowtusk in Sen'jin Village.
identity.description: My dream brew can only tell me so much. Its visions are scattered in time and space. But it is clear that a showdown is brewing amongst the Horde.$b$bIn my dream brew I see that the troll Vol'jin of the Darkspear has already travelled to Durotar to defend his people. He is accompanied by Chen Stormstout, the brewmaster from the Wandering Isle.$b$bIf I have learned anything about Chen, it won't be long before he brews up some trouble... You should hurry!

Objectives.text: 前往杜隆塔尔，到森金村与基塔·箭牙交谈。
Objectives.english: Travel to Durotar and speak with Ki'ta Arrowtusk in Sen'jin Village.

Description.text: 我的洄梦仙酒只能告诉我这么多。我所看到的视像都是散落在不同时间与空间中的零星碎片。但显而易见的是，部落间正在酝酿一场决战。$b$b我通过洄梦仙酒看到，暗矛部族的巨魔沃金已经前往杜隆塔尔保卫他的人民。在他身边还有来自迷踪岛的酒仙陈·风暴烈酒相陪。$b$b要是说起我对陈的了解，他过不了多久就会惹出麻烦来……你得赶快！
Description.english: My dream brew can only tell me so much. Its visions are scattered in time and space. But it is clear that a showdown is brewing amongst the Horde.$b$bIn my dream brew I see that the troll Vol'jin of the Darkspear has already travelled to Durotar to defend his people. He is accompanied by Chen Stormstout, the brewmaster from the Wandering Isle.$b$bIf I have learned anything about Chen, it won't be long before he brews up some trouble... You should hurry!

identity.title: Battle of Sen'jin Village
identity.objectives: Defend Sen'jin Village from the Kor'kron assault.
identity.description: <Distant war drums sound.>$b$b$C, you always be in de right place at de right time. Hellscream be makin' a move against his own people.$b$bHe gonna find out what happens when you cross de Darkspear. Come! Fight wit' us! Show him de spirit of de real Horde!

Objectives.text: 保卫森金村，抵御库卡隆的攻击。
Objectives.english: Defend Sen'jin Village from the Kor'kron assault.

Description.text: <远处传来战鼓声。>$b$b$C，你总是会在正确的时间出现在正确的地方。地狱咆哮对他自己的人民动手了。$b$b我会让他明白，惹恼暗矛部族是什么下场。来吧！与我们并肩作战！让他看看真正的部落精神！
Description.english: <Distant war drums sound.>$b$b$C, you always be in de right place at de right time. Hellscream be makin' a move against his own people.$b$bHe gonna find out what happens when you cross de Darkspear. Come! Fight wit' us! Show him de spirit of de real Horde!

CompletionLog.text: 回杜隆塔尔的森金村找沃金。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Vol'jin at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

identity.title: Battle of Razor Hill
identity.objectives: Free 6 Captives and defeat Kor'kron leaders to capture Razor Hill for the Darkspear revolutionaries.
identity.description: Now, we hit back! We don't give Hellscream no time to regroup. We ride north. We slit every Kor'kron throat we see.$b$bIf we take Razor Hill, we control all de roads in Durotar.$b$bCome! Ride wit' me!

Objectives.text: 解救6名俘虏并击败库卡隆首领，为暗矛起义军夺取剃刀岭。
Objectives.english: Free 6 Captives and defeat Kor'kron leaders to capture Razor Hill for the Darkspear revolutionaries.

Description.text: 现在该我们还击了！地狱咆哮休想有时间重整军队。我们要向北进发，干掉所有的库卡隆。$b$b要是我们能顺利夺取剃刀岭，就能控制杜隆塔尔的所有交通要道。$b$b来吧！跟我一起出发！
Description.english: Now, we hit back! We don't give Hellscream no time to regroup. We ride north. We slit every Kor'kron throat we see.$b$bIf we take Razor Hill, we control all de roads in Durotar.$b$bCome! Ride wit' me!

CompletionLog.text: 去杜隆塔尔俯瞰剃刀岭的瞭望塔下与沃金交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Vol'jin beneath the tower overlooking Razor Hill in Durotar.

identity.title: Battlefield: Barrens
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Kor'kron Lumber, $2oa Kor'kron Oil, $3oa Kor'kron Meat, and $4oa Kor'kron Stone.
identity.description: Ta take down de warchief, I be needin' an army an' supplies. I got me an army. No shortage of hate for what Hellscream done to de Horde. But supplies! Lumber, stone, meat, oil. Dis be what we need.$b$bHellscream's Kor'kron be stockpilin' supplies in Northern Barrens, to de west. Kill de Kor'kron! Fight dem wherever dey spring up. Help our tauren bruddahs by escortin' their caravans, an' group up to take down Kor'kron leaders. Whatever it takes. Get me dem supplies!

Description.text: 要想推翻酋长的统治，我必须要有军队和物资。军队我有，而且地狱咆哮对部落犯下的罪行令士兵们感到仇恨不已。可我缺少补给品！木材、石料、食用肉和原油。这些都是我们所需要的。$b$b地狱咆哮手下的库卡隆正在北贫瘠之地囤积物资，就在西边。去消灭那些库卡隆！不管他们打哪儿冒出来，一个一个地把他们解决掉。帮助我们的牛头人兄弟护送车队，然后组队除掉库卡隆首领。必须不惜一切代价达到目的。把他们的补给品给我带回来！
Description.english: Ta take down de warchief, I be needin' an army an' supplies. I got me an army. No shortage of hate for what Hellscream done to de Horde. But supplies! Lumber, stone, meat, oil. Dis be what we need.$b$bHellscream's Kor'kron be stockpilin' supplies in Northern Barrens, to de west. Kill de Kor'kron! Fight dem wherever dey spring up. Help our tauren bruddahs by escortin' their caravans, an' group up to take down Kor'kron leaders. Whatever it takes. Get me dem supplies!

identity.title: A Knockoff Grumplefloot
identity.objectives: Return the Knockoff Grumplefloot to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
identity.description: The "grumplefloot" has been hastily carved out of a tree root, with holes unevenly spaced along its length.$b$bA close inspection of its backside, however, reveals words carved into the wood:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

Objectives.text: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把冒牌土笛子交给那里的某个人。
Objectives.english: Return the Knockoff Grumplefloot to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.

Description.text: 这支“土笛子”是草草用树根雕凿而成，笛身遍布凹凸不平的孔洞。$b$b但在仔细检查背面之后，你发现了这样一行刻字：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
Description.english: The "grumplefloot" has been hastily carved out of a tree root, with holes unevenly spaced along its length.$b$bA close inspection of its backside, however, reveals words carved into the wood:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

identity.title: Grandpa Grumplefloot
identity.objectives: Defeat Grandpa Grumplefloot by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.
identity.description: The challenge card I have for you today belongs to a grummle by the adorable name of Grandpa Grumplefloot. While the grummles aren't particularly well-known for their combat skills, they are remarkably lucky little creatures.$b$bPerhaps it's their... what do they call them... their luckydos?

Objectives.text: 购买老爹土笛子的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向他发起挑战。
Objectives.english: Defeat Grandpa Grumplefloot by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.

Description.text: 我今天为你准备的挑战卡牌属于一位名字可爱的土地精，他叫老爹土笛子。虽然土地精的战斗技能并不十分出众，但他们可是非常幸运的小家伙。$b$b也许帮他们忙的是……他们管那叫什么来着……幸运符？
Description.english: The challenge card I have for you today belongs to a grummle by the adorable name of Grandpa Grumplefloot. While the grummles aren't particularly well-known for their combat skills, they are remarkably lucky little creatures.$b$bPerhaps it's their... what do they call them... their luckydos?

CompletionLog.text: 回你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部找卡牌商人。
CompletionLog.english: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

identity.title: Master Boom Boom
identity.objectives: Defeat Master Boom Boom by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.
identity.description: You have earned a card belonging to a bomb-throwing hozen named Master Boom Boom.$b$bWhile hozen are naturally attracted to the destructive power of explosives, they seldom learn how to use them properly without blowing themselves up in the process. Master Boom Boom is the exception.$b$bGood luck!

Objectives.text: 购买布姆布姆大师的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向他发起挑战。
Objectives.english: Defeat Master Boom Boom by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.

Description.text: 你赢得的这张挑战卡牌，属于一只喜欢扔炸弹的猢狲，他叫布姆布姆大师。$b$b尽管猢狲生来就是炸药破坏力的狂热爱好者，可他们却很少能够学会如何正确地使用炸药，总是在使用过程中把自己炸伤。布姆布姆大师是个例外。$b$b祝你好运！
Description.english: You have earned a card belonging to a bomb-throwing hozen named Master Boom Boom.$b$bWhile hozen are naturally attracted to the destructive power of explosives, they seldom learn how to use them properly without blowing themselves up in the process. Master Boom Boom is the exception.$b$bGood luck!

identity.title: Modified Chomping Apparatus
identity.objectives: Return the Modified Chomping Apparatus to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
identity.description: You might not have recognized this as a modified chomping apparatus if it didn't have the words "MODIFIED CHOMPING APPARATUS" messily painted onto it.$b$bRight beneath the sloppy label, you see a smaller message, written much more neatly in bright red ink:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

Objectives.text: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把改良的咀嚼装置交给那里的某个人。
Objectives.english: Return the Modified Chomping Apparatus to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.

Description.text: 如果不是因为在这玩意上面胡乱地写有“改良的咀嚼装置”这几个字，你也许不会想到这竟是一个改良的咀嚼装置。$b$b在那破烂的标签底下，你看到一行更小的文字，用醒目的红色墨水书写得较为整洁：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
Description.english: You might not have recognized this as a modified chomping apparatus if it didn't have the words "MODIFIED CHOMPING APPARATUS" messily painted onto it.$b$bRight beneath the sloppy label, you see a smaller message, written much more neatly in bright red ink:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

identity.title: Mecha-Bruce
identity.objectives: Defeat Mecha-Bruce by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.
identity.description: Everybody knows Bruce. Everybody loves Bruce! And eventually, everybody kills Bruce.$b$bAn orcish hunter with a knack for engineering thought that this was a shame, so he's found his own crocolisk and geared him up a bit.$b$bThe challenge card you've earned grants you the right to fight Mecha-Bruce. It's bound to be a bloodbath. The question is... will you be the chomper, or the chompee?

Objectives.text: 购买机甲布鲁斯的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向他发起挑战。
Objectives.english: Defeat Mecha-Bruce by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.

Description.text: 人人都知道布鲁斯。人人都爱布鲁斯！可结果呢，人人都杀死了布鲁斯。$b$b一位精通工程学的兽人猎人把这视作奇耻大辱，于是他找到了他的鳄鱼，给他草草武装了一下。$b$b你赢得的这张挑战卡牌，赋予了你与机甲布鲁斯决斗的权力。这注定是场血战。问题在于……你将成为猎手，还是猎物？
Description.english: Everybody knows Bruce. Everybody loves Bruce! And eventually, everybody kills Bruce.$b$bAn orcish hunter with a knack for engineering thought that this was a shame, so he's found his own crocolisk and geared him up a bit.$b$bThe challenge card you've earned grants you the right to fight Mecha-Bruce. It's bound to be a bloodbath. The question is... will you be the chomper, or the chompee?

identity.title: Frost-Tipped Eggshell
identity.objectives: Return the Frost-Tipped Eggshell to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
identity.description: A piece of an eggshell, presumably penguin. Its edges are covered with rime, and based on its curvature, this egg was quite large when it was intact.$b$bStrangely, the inside of the eggshell has a message written on it, in jade-green ink:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

Objectives.text: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把冰冻蛋壳交给那里的某个人。
Objectives.english: Return the Frost-Tipped Eggshell to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.

Description.text: 一片蛋壳，有可能是企鹅蛋。蛋壳边缘覆有白霜，而且根据弯曲度来看，这枚蛋在完整时是相当巨大的。$b$b奇怪的是，在蛋壳内侧用翠绿色的墨水写有这样一行字：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
Description.english: A piece of an eggshell, presumably penguin. Its edges are covered with rime, and based on its curvature, this egg was quite large when it was intact.$b$bStrangely, the inside of the eggshell has a message written on it, in jade-green ink:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

identity.title: Dippy and Doopy
identity.objectives: Defeat Dippy & Doopy by purchasing their challenge card and challenging them in the Brawler's Guild.
identity.description: Brawler's Guild vets will remember Dippy, the penguin. Dippy's not the most accomplished challenger in the Brawler's Guild, but he's no pushover, either!$b$bActually, come to think of it, he IS kind of a pushover...$b$bAnyway! The card you've earned gives you the right to challenge Dippy alongside his older, huger brother, Doopy. They may both be pushovers, but that doesn't mean that one or both of them won't eventually murder you.

Objectives.text: 购买帝皮和杜皮的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向他们发起挑战。
Objectives.english: Defeat Dippy & Doopy by purchasing their challenge card and challenging them in the Brawler's Guild.

Description.text: 搏击俱乐部的老手们都会记得那只名叫帝皮的企鹅。帝皮在搏击俱乐部里并不是战技最为卓绝的挑战者，但也决不是不堪一击的草包！$b$b其实仔细想想的话，它也确实有点草包……$b$b不论如何！你赢得的这张挑战卡牌将使你得以挑战帝皮和他的大块头哥哥杜皮。它们或许都是草包，但没准你就会死在它们其中一个或两个的手上。
Description.english: Brawler's Guild vets will remember Dippy, the penguin. Dippy's not the most accomplished challenger in the Brawler's Guild, but he's no pushover, either!$b$bActually, come to think of it, he IS kind of a pushover...$b$bAnyway! The card you've earned gives you the right to challenge Dippy alongside his older, huger brother, Doopy. They may both be pushovers, but that doesn't mean that one or both of them won't eventually murder you.

CompletionLog.text: 回你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部找卡牌商人。
CompletionLog.english: Return to the Card Trader in your faction's Brawler's Guild.

identity.title: The Digmaster's Earthblade
identity.objectives: Return the Digmaster's Earthblade to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
identity.description: An entirely ordinary-looking shovel. The handle is carved with an ornate script: "The Digmaster's Earthblade".$b$bOn the flipside of the handle, however, is a smaller label, written in simpler text:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

Objectives.text: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把挖掘专家的铲地刀交给那里的某个人。
Objectives.english: Return the Digmaster's Earthblade to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.

Description.text: 一把普普通通的铲子。把手上刻有华丽的文字：“挖掘专家的铲地刀”。$b$b在把手的另一面则有个更小的标签，简明地写道：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
Description.english: An entirely ordinary-looking shovel. The handle is carved with an ornate script: "The Digmaster's Earthblade".$b$bOn the flipside of the handle, however, is a smaller label, written in simpler text:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

identity.title: Mingus Diggs
identity.objectives: Defeat Mingus Diggs by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.
identity.description: You've earned the right to challenge Mingus Diggs, the archaeologist!$b$bMingus isn't that tough, from what I hear... but the people in charge let him bring some of his excavated treasures with him into the brawling ring. Those are what you want to watch out for.$b$bCome buy his card when you're ready!

Objectives.text: 购买明格斯·迪格斯的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向他发起挑战。
Objectives.english: Defeat Mingus Diggs by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.

Description.text: 你赢得了挑战考古学家明格斯·迪格斯的权力！$b$b据我所知，明格斯并不是那么能打……可负责人让他把一些出土文物带进了竞技场。你可要小心那些玩意儿。$b$b等你准备好，就来购买他的卡牌吧！
Description.english: You've earned the right to challenge Mingus Diggs, the archaeologist!$b$bMingus isn't that tough, from what I hear... but the people in charge let him bring some of his excavated treasures with him into the brawling ring. Those are what you want to watch out for.$b$bCome buy his card when you're ready!

identity.title: Raptorhide Boxing Gloves
identity.objectives: Return the Raptorhide Boxing Gloves to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.
identity.description: The gloves are stitched together roughly, and by the smell of it, they've been treated with crawler mucus. Nevertheless, they appear sturdy and functional.$b$bSomewhat unsurprisingly, the inner seam bears the following words:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

Objectives.text: 前往你所在阵营的搏击俱乐部，把迅猛龙皮拳击手套交给那里的某个人。
Objectives.english: Return the Raptorhide Boxing Gloves to someone within your faction's Brawler's Guild.

Description.text: 这副手套针脚粗糙，而且从气味判断，应该沾有爬行者的粘液。尽管如此，看上去仍然坚固耐用。$b$b令人不大出乎意料的是，在内侧边缝处有这样一行字：$b$b归还搏击俱乐部
Description.english: The gloves are stitched together roughly, and by the smell of it, they've been treated with crawler mucus. Nevertheless, they appear sturdy and functional.$b$bSomewhat unsurprisingly, the inner seam bears the following words:$b$bRETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

identity.title: Ty'thar
identity.objectives: Defeat Ty'thar by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.
identity.description: You've earned the right to purchase a challenge card, and that card belongs to a troll named Ty'thar.$b$bTy'thar has a very distinct fighting style, and as part of his agreement with the Brawler's Guild, you have to follow his rules:$b$b - Face-to-face fist fighting. No running around.$b$b - Three knockdowns wins the fight.$b$bGood luck!

Objectives.text: 购买泰塔尔的挑战卡牌，并在搏击俱乐部里向他发起挑战。
Objectives.english: Defeat Ty'thar by purchasing his challenge card and challenging him in the Brawler's Guild.

Description.text: 你赢得了购买一张挑战卡牌的权力，这张卡牌属于一位名叫泰塔尔的巨魔。$b$b泰塔尔的战斗风格极为独特，且作为他与搏击俱乐部协议的一部分，你必须遵循他的规则：$b$b面对面徒手拳击。不得四处乱跑。$b$b三次击倒对手者获胜。$b$b祝你好运！
Description.english: You've earned the right to purchase a challenge card, and that card belongs to a troll named Ty'thar.$b$bTy'thar has a very distinct fighting style, and as part of his agreement with the Brawler's Guild, you have to follow his rules:$b$b - Face-to-face fist fighting. No running around.$b$b - Three knockdowns wins the fight.$b$bGood luck!

identity.title: Cloak of Virtue
identity.objectives: Travel to Mason's Folly in the Veiled Stair and speak with Wrathion.
identity.description: We have what we need. I can create an item that will harness the power of the celestials and, with a little work, may also be able to contain some of my own.$b$bMeet me atop Mason's Folly, east of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair, where we've met before. You will be delighted with the results!

Objectives.text: 前往雾纱栈道的石匠之愚，与拉希奥交谈。
Objectives.english: Travel to Mason's Folly in the Veiled Stair and speak with Wrathion.

Description.text: 我们有了需要的东西。我能创造出驾驭天神之力的物品，而且只要略作努力，也许还能把我自己的部分力量收入其中。$b$b到石匠之愚上方与我会面吧，就在雾纱栈道迷雾酒肆的东边，我们曾经在那里见过面。结果会让你喜出望外的！
Description.english: We have what we need. I can create an item that will harness the power of the celestials and, with a little work, may also be able to contain some of my own.$b$bMeet me atop Mason's Folly, east of the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair, where we've met before. You will be delighted with the results!

identity.title: Battlefield: Barrens
identity.objectives: [Weekly Quest] Collect $1oa Kor'kron Lumber, $2oa Kor'kron Oil, $3oa Kor'kron Meat, and $4oa Kor'kron Stone.
identity.description: Our work be far from finished, $n. De flames of change burn, but dey can still be snuffed out.$B$BBring me more Kor'kron war supplies, and I'll reward ya well.

Description.text: 我们的工作还远未结束，$n。变革之火熊熊燃烧，可仍然能被扑灭。$B$B给我把更多库卡隆战争物资带回来，我会好好犒赏你的。
Description.english: Our work be far from finished, $n. De flames of change burn, but dey can still be snuffed out.$B$BBring me more Kor'kron war supplies, and I'll reward ya well.

identity.title: Vol'jin of the Darkspear
identity.objectives: Listen to Ki'ta Arrowtusk.
identity.description: Welcome ta Sen'jin Village, mon. I know you traveled far ta see Vol'jin, leader a' da Darkspear.$B$BBut I must ask ya ta wait a little longer. Let us speak.

Objectives.text: 听基塔·箭牙说话。
Objectives.english: Listen to Ki'ta Arrowtusk.

Description.text: 欢迎来到森金村，伙计。我知道你大老远赶来就是为了拜见暗矛部族的领袖沃金的。$B$B可我必须得让你多等一小会儿。让我们谈一谈吧。
Description.english: Welcome ta Sen'jin Village, mon. I know you traveled far ta see Vol'jin, leader a' da Darkspear.$B$BBut I must ask ya ta wait a little longer. Let us speak.

CompletionLog.text: 去杜隆塔尔的森金村找沃金谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Vol'jin at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

identity.title: Preparing to Strike
identity.objectives: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
identity.description: Events are in motion, $n. We have one final task to complete before we are ready to move into the final act of my plan.$b$bMy agents tell me that King Wrynn has reassembled a naval fleet after his losses at Theramore, and Vol'jin is marching north across Durotar in open rebellion against the warchief.$b$bSpeak with me again as soon as they are ready to converge on the gates. We will bring this war to a glorious conclusion!

Objectives.text: 回雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆找拉希奥。
Objectives.english: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

Description.text: 一切都在有条不紊地进行着，$n。在实施我计划的收尾行动之前，我们还有最后一项任务需要完成。$b$b我的密探们告诉我，乌瑞恩国王在塞拉摩惨败之后，集结了一支海军舰队；而沃金正在挥军北上，横跨杜隆塔尔，发起了推翻酋长统治的公开起义。$b$b一旦他们做好在大门处会师的准备时，就立刻回来与我交谈。我们要为这场战争画下辉煌的句点！
Description.english: Events are in motion, $n. We have one final task to complete before we are ready to move into the final act of my plan.$b$bMy agents tell me that King Wrynn has reassembled a naval fleet after his losses at Theramore, and Vol'jin is marching north across Durotar in open rebellion against the warchief.$b$bSpeak with me again as soon as they are ready to converge on the gates. We will bring this war to a glorious conclusion!

CompletionLog.text: 回雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆找拉希奥。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

identity.title: Vol'jin of the Darkspear
identity.objectives: Accompany Zen'tabra to Vol'jin.
identity.description: I take ya to Vol'jin.

Objectives.text: 陪岑塔布拉去找沃金。
Objectives.english: Accompany Zen'tabra to Vol'jin.

Description.text: 我带你去见沃金。
Description.english: I take ya to Vol'jin.

CompletionLog.text: 在杜隆塔尔的剃刀岭与沃金交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Vol'jin at Razor Hill in Durotar.

identity.title: Battlefield: Barrens
identity.objectives: [Weekly Quest] Collect $1oa Kor'kron Lumber, $2oa Kor'kron Oil, $3oa Kor'kron Meat, and $4oa Kor'kron Stone.
identity.description: Our work be far from finished, $r. If ya willin' ta put ya neck on the line for the Darkspear once more, I'll be sure ta see ya get a proper reward.

Description.text: 我们的工作还远未结束，$r。要是你愿意为暗矛部族再冒一次险，我一定会让你得到适当的奖赏。
Description.english: Our work be far from finished, $r. If ya willin' ta put ya neck on the line for the Darkspear once more, I'll be sure ta see ya get a proper reward.

CompletionLog.text: 回杜隆塔尔的剃刀岭找基塔·箭牙。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Ki'ta Arrowtusk at Razor Hill in Durotar.

identity.title: The Road to War
identity.objectives: Speak to Ki'ta Arrowtusk at Razor Hill in Durotar.
identity.description: Hey! I just received word from our agents in Durotar.$B$BThe Darkspear Rebellion needs your help.$B$BI hear you've already got an in with the trolls. Why don't you zip over to Durotar and see what's happening?

Objectives.text: 在杜隆塔尔的剃刀岭与基塔·箭牙交谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Ki'ta Arrowtusk at Razor Hill in Durotar.

Description.text: 嘿！我刚刚收到我们远在杜隆塔尔的密探发回的情报。$B$B暗矛起义军需要你的帮助。$B$B我听说你本来就跟巨魔有点交情。那为什么不亲自去杜隆塔尔走一趟，看看那里到底发生了什么事情？
Description.english: Hey! I just received word from our agents in Durotar.$B$BThe Darkspear Rebellion needs your help.$B$BI hear you've already got an in with the trolls. Why don't you zip over to Durotar and see what's happening?

identity.title: The Road to War
identity.objectives: Speak to Ki'ta Arrowtusk at Razor Hill in Durotar.
identity.description: I have received word from Baine. The Darkspear Rebellion needs your help.$B$BGo to Razor Hill and seek out Ki'ta Arrowtusk.$B$BBreathe word of this to no one!

Objectives.text: 在杜隆塔尔的剃刀岭与基塔·箭牙交谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Ki'ta Arrowtusk at Razor Hill in Durotar.

Description.text: 我收到了贝恩的消息。暗矛起义军需要你的帮助。$B$B前往剃刀岭，寻找基塔·箭牙。$B$B别对任何人走漏了风声！
Description.english: I have received word from Baine. The Darkspear Rebellion needs your help.$B$BGo to Razor Hill and seek out Ki'ta Arrowtusk.$B$BBreathe word of this to no one!

identity.title: reuse me
identity.objectives: Kill the Master of the Forge and Collect a Codex Fragment from the Mogu Gatekeeper in the Isle of Thunder.
identity.description:
There's more you must do. 

Kill Itoka, master of the forge, and find a codex fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku, gatekeeper of the Thunder King.

Objectives.text: 在雷神岛上消灭锻造大师，然后从魔古看门人身上找到一块法典碎片。
Objectives.english: Kill the Master of the Forge and Collect a Codex Fragment from the Mogu Gatekeeper in the Isle of Thunder.

Description.text:
还有其它事情要你去做。

消灭锻造大师伊多喀，然后从雷电之王的看门人——塑肌者霍古身上找到一块法典碎片。
Description.english:
There's more you must do. 

Kill Itoka, master of the forge, and find a codex fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku, gatekeeper of the Thunder King.

CompletionLog.text: 回去找<the questgiver>
CompletionLog.english: Return to <the questgiver>

identity.title: Task: Stonefang Outpost Fires
identity.objectives: Pick up snowballs from Snow Mounds and throw them at burning structures in Stonefang Outpost.

Objectives.text: 从雪堆上拾取雪球，并朝岩牙岗哨燃烧的建筑物扔过去。
Objectives.english: Pick up snowballs from Snow Mounds and throw them at burning structures in Stonefang Outpost.

identity.title: Thunderlord War-Gronn
identity.objectives: Slay 6 Thunderlord Giantslayers or Thunderlord Gronnstalkers around Kron'mar.

Objectives.text: 在库隆玛附近消灭6个雷神巨人屠夫或雷神戈隆追猎者。
Objectives.english: Slay 6 Thunderlord Giantslayers or Thunderlord Gronnstalkers around Kron'mar.

identity.title: NC S1 Q2
identity.description: Well hello there. I am Lin, Chao-Wei. Have you come here to try my family's famous noodle soup? I'm afraid you're all out of luck. My father passed away before he could teach me the secret ingredient to his secret ingredient noodle soup. He did mention writing down the recipe for a friend of his that went to the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Perhaps you can find it there?

Description.text: 你好啊。我是林潮薇。你来这里是想品尝我们家族最出名的汤面吗？恐怕你得败兴而归了。我父亲还没来得及将他秘制汤面的秘密配方传授给我就过世了。不过我倒是听他说起过，他把配方写下来交给一位前去青龙寺的朋友了。也许你可以去那找找？
Description.english: Well hello there. I am Lin, Chao-Wei. Have you come here to try my family's famous noodle soup? I'm afraid you're all out of luck. My father passed away before he could teach me the secret ingredient to his secret ingredient noodle soup. He did mention writing down the recipe for a friend of his that went to the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Perhaps you can find it there?

identity.title: Collect Karabor Axes
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Karabor Weapons.
identity.description: Some of our bravest champions have fallen today.$b$bTo make matters worse the Iron Horde has started using our own weapons against us. $b$bThe idea of my people being slain with the weapons forged by our ancestors makes me sick.$b$b$n, could you please retrieve these weapons and bring them back to me?

Description.text: 我们当中一些最为勇敢的勇士今天倒下了。$b$b钢铁部落还开始用我们自己的武器对付我们，简直是雪上加霜。$b$b一想到我们的族人正在被我们祖先锻造的武器杀死，我就感到恼火不已。$b$b$n，你能否找到这些武器，把它们带回来交给我？
Description.english: Some of our bravest champions have fallen today.$b$bTo make matters worse the Iron Horde has started using our own weapons against us. $b$bThe idea of my people being slain with the weapons forged by our ancestors makes me sick.$b$b$n, could you please retrieve these weapons and bring them back to me?

CompletionLog.text: 回影月谷的卡拉波神殿找阿卡兰娜·迅蹄。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Akclana Swifthoof at the Temple of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

identity.title: Put down Poisonfiend.
identity.objectives: Kill Zugunk Poisonfiend
identity.description: Zugunk Poisonfiend is to blame for this madness.$b$bHe has contaminated this temple and it is time for his reign of terror to end.

Objectives.text: 击败祖嘎克·毒魔
Objectives.english: Kill Zugunk Poisonfiend

Description.text: 祖嘎克·毒魔应该对这疯狂的局面负责。$b$b他玷污了这座神殿，是时候终结他的恐怖统治了。
Description.english: Zugunk Poisonfiend is to blame for this madness.$b$bHe has contaminated this temple and it is time for his reign of terror to end.

CompletionLog.text: 回影月谷的卡拉波神殿找阿卡兰娜·迅蹄。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Aklana Swifthoof at the Temple of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

identity.title: Task: Warsong Riot
identity.objectives: Kill Warsong Ragemongers near the Temple of Katabor in Shadowmoon Valley.
identity.description: The Warsong Ragemongers are attacking the temple!

Objectives.text: 在影月谷的卡拉波神殿附近击败战歌煽动者。
Objectives.english: Kill Warsong Ragemongers near the Temple of Katabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

Description.text: 战歌煽动者正在攻击神殿！
Description.english: The Warsong Ragemongers are attacking the temple!

CompletionLog.text: 回影月谷的卡拉波神殿找Captain Quest Giver。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Captain Quest Giver at the Temple of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

identity.title: The Call of War
identity.objectives: Deliver Kaati's Letter to Faran at Teluuna Observatory.
identity.description: If you are reading this letter, it likely means that I am dead. Please deliver this to my son, Faran, at Teluuna Observatory.$B$B$BDearest Faran and Elsa,$B$BI have fallen in the line of duty while defending the Temple of Karabor.$B$BPlease know that I love you both with all of my heart. My spirit will watch over you for the rest of your days. Be strong, love one another, and live this life to the best of your ability.$B$BI am so proud of you both.$B$BLove,$B$BYour Mother

Objectives.text: 把卡缇的遗书交给特鲁纳观星台的法兰。
Objectives.english: Deliver Kaati's Letter to Faran at Teluuna Observatory.

Description.text: 当你看到这封信的时候，我可能已经死了。请把这封信转交给我在特鲁纳观星台的儿子法兰。$B$B$B亲爱的法兰和艾尔莎，$B$B我在执行保卫卡拉波神殿的任务时阵亡了。$B$B请记住，我全心全意的爱着你们。我的灵魂将永远与你们同在。你们两个要坚强，要相亲相爱，精彩地过完你们的一生。$B$B我为你们感到骄傲。$B$B深爱你们的，$B$B妈妈
Description.english: If you are reading this letter, it likely means that I am dead. Please deliver this to my son, Faran, at Teluuna Observatory.$B$B$BDearest Faran and Elsa,$B$BI have fallen in the line of duty while defending the Temple of Karabor.$B$BPlease know that I love you both with all of my heart. My spirit will watch over you for the rest of your days. Be strong, love one another, and live this life to the best of your ability.$B$BI am so proud of you both.$B$BLove,$B$BYour Mother

identity.title: The Demons Among Us - Alliance
identity.objectives: Speak to Ginni Gingerlips to craft a Shadowmoon orc disguise.
identity.description: Now that we have the cloth and leather, we can craft a fitting disguise for our infiltration mission.$B$BGo speak to Ginni Gingerlips. She has proven herself quite capable in the realm of... errr... garment design.

Objectives.text: 与吉尼·姜唇交谈来制作一套影月兽人伪装服。
Objectives.english: Speak to Ginni Gingerlips to craft a Shadowmoon orc disguise.

Description.text: 有布料皮革在手，我们终于可以制作一套适合执行潜入任务的伪装服了。$B$B去找吉尼·姜唇谈一谈。她在……呃……服装设计方面很是在行。
Description.english: Now that we have the cloth and leather, we can craft a fitting disguise for our infiltration mission.$B$BGo speak to Ginni Gingerlips. She has proven herself quite capable in the realm of... errr... garment design.

identity.title: Meet Me Back at the Inn
identity.objectives: Meet Wrathion upstairs at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
identity.description: I'm certain you're eager to test out your new cloak. Let's put it to use.$b$bMeet me back inside the inn! A new development has come to my attention that we'll want to take advantage of.

Title.english: Meet Me Back at the Inn

Objectives.text: 到雾纱栈道迷雾酒肆的楼上与拉希奥会面。
Objectives.english: Meet Wrathion upstairs at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

Description.text: 我敢肯定，你此刻已经迫不及待地想要试试自己的新披风了。那就让它发挥作用吧。$b$b回旅馆里与我碰面！一项新发现引起了我的注意，我们可以对其善加利用。
Description.english: I'm certain you're eager to test out your new cloak. Let's put it to use.$b$bMeet me back inside the inn! A new development has come to my attention that we'll want to take advantage of.

identity.title: A Timeless Discovery
identity.objectives: Travel to the Timeless Isle southeast of the Jade Forest and speak with Wrathion.
identity.description: Pandaria. Just when I think I've gotten its mysteries figured out, I discover something new.$b$bIt's called "The Timeless Isle." Once hidden in the mists, it appears and disappears seemingly of its own will. I've heard that time has no meaning there, that the sun neither rises nor sets.$b$bWe can take advantage of this anomaly, $n! If I could time-lock your cloak, the power it could contain would be... immense.$b$bOur path is clear. Fly southeast of the Jade Forest and meet me at the Timeless Isle!

Objectives.text: 前往位于翡翠林东南部的永恒岛，并与拉希奥交谈。
Objectives.english: Travel to the Timeless Isle southeast of the Jade Forest and speak with Wrathion.

Description.text: 潘达利亚。正当我以为自己已经洞悉了这片大陆上的一切神秘时，我却有了新的发现。$b$b那地方叫做“永恒岛”。它曾经深藏在迷雾之中，仿佛听凭自己的意志忽而出现，忽而消失。我听说时间在那里毫无意义，既无日出，也无日落。$b$b我们正好可以利用这一怪象，$n！如果我能用时间锁住你的斗篷，它所蕴含的力量将会是……无边无际的。$b$b我们的前路非常清晰。飞去翡翠林的东南部，到永恒岛上与我会面！
Description.english: Pandaria. Just when I think I've gotten its mysteries figured out, I discover something new.$b$bIt's called "The Timeless Isle." Once hidden in the mists, it appears and disappears seemingly of its own will. I've heard that time has no meaning there, that the sun neither rises nor sets.$b$bWe can take advantage of this anomaly, $n! If I could time-lock your cloak, the power it could contain would be... immense.$b$bOur path is clear. Fly southeast of the Jade Forest and meet me at the Timeless Isle!

identity.title: Secrets of the Timeless Isle
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Timeless Coins from creatures and events on the Timeless Isle.
identity.description: There is a currency minted only on this island - "timeless coins." They are immune to the island's temporal distortions... I would like to figure out why.$b$bGather some for me! Venture into the jungles of this forgotten paradise. Destroy the mysterious foes who lurk in this timeless place, discover hidden caches of treasure, and explore forgotten treasure hoards - whatever it takes. I will be waiting!

Description.text: 在这座岛屿上铸有一种独特的货币，叫做“永恒铸币”。它们可以免疫岛上的时间扭曲之力……我想要查明原因。$b$b替我找些铸币来！深入这片被遗忘天堂的丛林间吧。不惜一切代价消灭那些潜伏在这片永恒之地的神秘敌人，探索隐藏的宝藏，找寻被遗忘的财宝。我等着你回来！
Description.english: There is a currency minted only on this island - "timeless coins." They are immune to the island's temporal distortions... I would like to figure out why.$b$bGather some for me! Venture into the jungles of this forgotten paradise. Destroy the mysterious foes who lurk in this timeless place, discover hidden caches of treasure, and explore forgotten treasure hoards - whatever it takes. I will be waiting!

CompletionLog.text: 将铸币交给拉希奥，他就在翡翠林附近的永恒岛上。
CompletionLog.english: Bring the coins to Wrathion on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

identity.title: The Emperor's Way
identity.objectives: Defeat Yu'lon, Chi-Ji, Xuen and Niuzao, the four August Celestials of Pandaria.
identity.description: Recently, the August Celestials of Pandaria presented you with a challenge - and you triumphed.$b$bBut can you defeat them in combat? They are testing the mettle of all of Pandaria's heroes.$b$bThis challenge is not impossible, but you'll need to follow the advice of the last Pandaren Emperor and tackle it with unwavering inner strength. You'll also need a small army, so find a group of people you trust.$b$bDefeat the four celestials here in the Celestial Court, and our journey is almost complete...

Objectives.text: 击败玉珑、赤精、雪怒和砮皂这四位潘达利亚的至尊天神。
Objectives.english: Defeat Yu'lon, Chi-Ji, Xuen and Niuzao, the four August Celestials of Pandaria.

Description.text: 不久前，潘达利亚的至尊天神给予了你一项挑战——而你取得了胜利。$b$b但你能在战斗中打败他们吗？他们在考验潘达利亚所有英雄的胆魄。$b$b这项挑战并非不可能完成，可你需要听取熊猫人末代皇帝的建议，并凭借坚定的内在力量应对这项挑战。你还需要集结一小支军队，去找些你信任的朋友来吧。$b$b在天神庭院击败四位天神，我们的旅途就差不多要结束了……
Description.english: Recently, the August Celestials of Pandaria presented you with a challenge - and you triumphed.$b$bBut can you defeat them in combat? They are testing the mettle of all of Pandaria's heroes.$b$bThis challenge is not impossible, but you'll need to follow the advice of the last Pandaren Emperor and tackle it with unwavering inner strength. You'll also need a small army, so find a group of people you trust.$b$bDefeat the four celestials here in the Celestial Court, and our journey is almost complete...

identity.title: A Pandaren Legend
identity.objectives: Meet Wrathion within the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
identity.description: I have learned so much in this timeless place, friend. Between the wisdom of the celestials and the curious power of these timeless artifacts, I know now how to safely augment your cloak with my own considerable power.$b$bI need a sacred place to complete my final incantations. Quickly! Meet me in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, within the Seat of Knowledge above the Mogu'shan Palace.$b$bToday, your legend begins!

Objectives.text: 到锦绣谷的闻道之座与拉希奥会面。
Objectives.english: Meet Wrathion within the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Description.text: 我在这个永恒之地增长了许多见识，朋友。在天神的智慧与这些永恒神器的神秘力量之间，我现在知道该如何安全地用我自己强大的力量来强化你的斗篷。$b$b我需要到一个神圣的地方来施展最后的法术。动作快！到锦绣谷魔古山宫殿上方的闻道之座与我会面吧。$b$b今天，你的传说即将开始！
Description.english: I have learned so much in this timeless place, friend. Between the wisdom of the celestials and the curious power of these timeless artifacts, I know now how to safely augment your cloak with my own considerable power.$b$bI need a sacred place to complete my final incantations. Quickly! Meet me in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, within the Seat of Knowledge above the Mogu'shan Palace.$b$bToday, your legend begins!

identity.title: Judgment of the Black Prince
identity.objectives: Complete the Siege of Orgrimmar and defeat Garrosh Hellscream.
identity.description: Now. To the final stage of my plan. Time to fulfil your grand purpose.$b$bUsing your newfound powers, it is time to bring this war to its conclusion. Destroy Garrosh Hellscream. Your people demand it, and future generations will sing your praises as the harbinger for the glorious new world we shall build together.$b$bI have no reward to offer you. I have already done everything in my power to ensure that you succeed. You are on your own.$b$bEnd Hellscream's reign.

Objectives.text: 完成决战奥格瑞玛并击败加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮。
Objectives.english: Complete the Siege of Orgrimmar and defeat Garrosh Hellscream.

Description.text: 现在，该实行我计划的最后一步了。是时候完成你的伟大使命了。$b$b利用你新获得的力量，为这场战争画上句号吧。去消灭加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮。你的人民在迫切渴望着，你的后世子孙也将歌颂你的功绩，我们将共同建造一个光辉的新世界，而你，将成为先驱者！$b$b我没有奖励可以给你。我已经竭尽所能来确保你能取得成功。现在要靠你自己了。$b$b终结地狱咆哮的暴政。
Description.english: Now. To the final stage of my plan. Time to fulfil your grand purpose.$b$bUsing your newfound powers, it is time to bring this war to its conclusion. Destroy Garrosh Hellscream. Your people demand it, and future generations will sing your praises as the harbinger for the glorious new world we shall build together.$b$bI have no reward to offer you. I have already done everything in my power to ensure that you succeed. You are on your own.$b$bEnd Hellscream's reign.

identity.title: Task: Poisionous bunnies
identity.objectives: Burn $1oa poisonous bunnies
identity.description: A large number the bunnies in the area have been infected with a toxic poison.$B$BIt might seem cruel but burning the bodies of the bunnies is the only way to ensure the infection will not spread.

Description.text: 这里有许多小兔子感染了剧毒。$B$B这也许听上去很残忍，但是焚烧那些小兔子的尸体是阻止感染进一步扩散的唯一办法。
Description.english: A large number the bunnies in the area have been infected with a toxic poison.$B$BIt might seem cruel but burning the bodies of the bunnies is the only way to ensure the infection will not spread.

CompletionLog.text: 回影月谷的卡拉波神殿找阿卡兰娜·迅蹄。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Akclana Swifthoof at the Temple of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

identity.title: The Celestial Tournament
identity.objectives: Win the Celestial Tournament.  Master Li can enter you into the tournament.
identity.description: The Timeless Isle is home to a special tournament created to test the leadership of its participants.  Those who prove their worth are granted an opportunity to befriend an embodiment of virtue - the progeny of the Celestials themselves.$b$bEach time you win the tournament, I will honor you with a single ceremonial coin.  When you have enough coins, speak with me again to further discuss your reward.

Objectives.text: 赢得天神比武大会。李大师可以带你入场。
Objectives.english: Win the Celestial Tournament.  Master Li can enter you into the tournament.

Description.text: 永恒岛上正在举办一场特殊的比赛，为的是考验参赛者的领导力。那些证明自己价值的人，将有机会和一种美德的化身成为朋友——它们是天神的后裔。$b$b每当你赢得比赛时，我就会颁发给你一枚仪式硬币。等你拥有了足够多的硬币时再来找我吧，我们将进一步讨论下你的奖励。
Description.english: The Timeless Isle is home to a special tournament created to test the leadership of its participants.  Those who prove their worth are granted an opportunity to befriend an embodiment of virtue - the progeny of the Celestials themselves.$b$bEach time you win the tournament, I will honor you with a single ceremonial coin.  When you have enough coins, speak with me again to further discuss your reward.

identity.title: A Proper Burial
identity.objectives: Burn the corpses of dead Frostwolf Outriders.
identity.description: <The orc is visibly winded. A large pool of blood is gathering at his feet.>$B$BWe were out hunting when we found the wolves under attack.$b$bMany ogres were slaughtered by our blades... but their numbers were too great.$b$bI'm going to catch my breath before I go out and kill the rest of them.$B$BHere, take this torch. Go give my brothers and sister a proper burial and return to me.

Objectives.text: 焚烧霜狼先锋的尸体。
Objectives.english: Burn the corpses of dead Frostwolf Outriders.

Description.text: <兽人看起来上气不接下气。在他脚下有一大滩血。>$B$B我们当时正在外出狩猎，结果我们的狼群遭到了攻击。$b$b有不少食人魔死在了我们的剑下……但他们的数量实在太多了。$b$b等我喘过气来，我还会去追杀其余的食人魔。$B$B给，拿上这个火把。给我的兄弟姐妹们办个像样的葬礼，然后再回来找我。
Description.english: <The orc is visibly winded. A large pool of blood is gathering at his feet.>$B$BWe were out hunting when we found the wolves under attack.$b$bMany ogres were slaughtered by our blades... but their numbers were too great.$b$bI'm going to catch my breath before I go out and kill the rest of them.$B$BHere, take this torch. Go give my brothers and sister a proper burial and return to me.

CompletionLog.text: 回霜火岭的肃霜丘陵找乌鲁卡格。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Urukag by Grimfrost Hill in Frostfire Ridge.

identity.title: Tracking Event: Chief killed
identity.objectives: Kill the Foreling Chief.
identity.description: Okay best friend. Let's talk to old smelly mud chief. We smell so good like moonstone and foods. We give friends moonstones. We tell friends I'm chief. We get ALL the foods.$b$bStupid bad smelling chief. Thinks I'm foods? Pshh. He's foods.$b$bTime for foods best friend.

Objectives.text: 击败蕨人首领。
Objectives.english: Kill the Foreling Chief.

Description.text: 好吧，好朋友。让我们跟那个又老又臭的脏首领谈一谈。我们闻上去像月光石和美食那么香。我们把月亮石送给朋友们。我们告诉朋友们我才是首领。所有的美食都归我们。$b$b那个又蠢又臭的首领。他以为我是美食？他才是美食。$b$b该享用美食了好朋友。
Description.english: Okay best friend. Let's talk to old smelly mud chief. We smell so good like moonstone and foods. We give friends moonstones. We tell friends I'm chief. We get ALL the foods.$b$bStupid bad smelling chief. Thinks I'm foods? Pshh. He's foods.$b$bTime for foods best friend.

identity.title: REUSE
identity.objectives: Find Ga'nar and 2 Frostwolf Lieutenants at the Ogre Fortress.
identity.description: My brother Ga'nar led an assault into the citadel a few hours ago with some of my best lieutenants. They have yet to return.$B$BI need you to move ahead of the pack and find them. We need every warrior we can if we are to stand atop the ogre king's skull by the day's end.

Objectives.text: 在食人魔堡垒里找到贾纳尔和2位霜狼副官。
Objectives.english: Find Ga'nar and 2 Frostwolf Lieutenants at the Ogre Fortress.

Description.text: 我的兄弟贾纳尔在数小时前率领我最骁勇的副官对城堡发起了攻击。他们到现在还没回来。$B$B我需要你先行一步去找他们。要是我们想在明天到来之前站在刀塔领主食人魔国王的头骨上，就得集结所有的战士才行。
Description.english: My brother Ga'nar led an assault into the citadel a few hours ago with some of my best lieutenants. They have yet to return.$B$BI need you to move ahead of the pack and find them. We need every warrior we can if we are to stand atop the ogre king's skull by the day's end.

CompletionLog.text: 在食人魔堡垒里找到杜隆坦。
CompletionLog.english: Find Durotan inside the Ogre Fortress.

Description.text: 萨尔制定了一个计划，要你解决掉那些阻碍我们在战场上前进的投石车。去找他谈谈吧。
Description.english: Thrall has a plan for you to take out the catapults preventing us from gaining ground on the battlefield. Speak with him.

identity.title: General Problems
identity.objectives: Speak to Commander Dorgosh.
identity.description: My forces are spread thin. The Iron Horde batters our defenses endlessly.$B$BIf you really want to help, find my commanders on the front and help them hold the line.

Objectives.text: 与指挥官多尔戈什交谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Commander Dorgosh.

Description.text: 我的军队处境艰难。钢铁部落无止无休地冲击着我们的防御。$B$B如果你真想要帮忙的话，就去前线找我的指挥官，帮他们稳住阵线吧。
Description.english: My forces are spread thin. The Iron Horde batters our defenses endlessly.$B$BIf you really want to help, find my commanders on the front and help them hold the line.
