identity.title: Elwynn Run
identity.objectives: Hit the blue marker, then the green marker, then return to the Ironelf games camp.
identity.description: Welcome to the Ironelf games! For this challenge: get to the blue marker, then the green marker, then return here.$B$BScore is based on your time, so get back as fast as you can!

Objectives.text: 击中蓝色标记，然后是绿色标记，最后返回钢铁精灵游戏营地。
Objectives.english: Hit the blue marker, then the green marker, then return to the Ironelf games camp.

Description.text: 欢迎来到钢铁精灵游戏营地！在这项挑战中：你需要抵达蓝色标记，然后是绿色标记，最后返回这里。$B$B你的得分取决于你用掉的时间，以最快的速度跑回来吧！
Description.english: Welcome to the Ironelf games! For this challenge: get to the blue marker, then the green marker, then return here.$B$BScore is based on your time, so get back as fast as you can!

identity.title: Westfall Race 30
identity.objectives: Run through the arch, hit the blue marker, then the green marker, then return to the Ironelf games camp.
identity.description: Run through the arch...$BGet to the blue marker...$BGet to the green marker...$Bthen return here before the bell tolls 15 times.$B$BGood luck!

Title.text: 西部荒野赛跑之钟响30下

Objectives.text: 跑过拱门，击中蓝色标记和绿色标记，然后返回钢铁精灵游戏营地。
Objectives.english: Run through the arch, hit the blue marker, then the green marker, then return to the Ironelf games camp.

Description.text: 跑过拱门……$B抵达蓝色标记……$B再抵达绿色标记……$B然后在钟敲响15下之前返回这里。$B$B祝你好运！
Description.english: Run through the arch...$BGet to the blue marker...$BGet to the green marker...$Bthen return here before the bell tolls 15 times.$B$BGood luck!

identity.title: Unexpected Assault
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Bonechewer Orcs and direct $2oa Auchenai to safety in the Court of Souls.
identity.description: My scouts have reported that the Bonechewer clan is attacking Auchindoun, $n. The Auchenai guard are here, but I fear they won't be enough.$B$BI sense a dark presence nearby... we cannot chance leaving their defenses weak. Too much power lies within those hallowed halls.$B$BSlay the Bonechewer and direct any of the Auchenai injured back to their defensive line. I will direct my scouts throughout the area to try to ascertain the Bonechewers' motives.

Description.text: 据我的斥候们回报，噬骨氏族正在攻击奥金顿，$n。奥金尼卫兵已经赶来，可我担心光靠他们是不够的。$B$B我感觉到附近有一股黑暗气息……我们不能冒险，必须加强防御。在那些神圣的殿堂中存在着太过巨大的力量。$B$B消灭噬骨兽人，并指挥所有奥金尼伤兵返回防线。我会派斥候到那里查明噬骨氏族的动机。
Description.english: My scouts have reported that the Bonechewer clan is attacking Auchindoun, $n. The Auchenai guard are here, but I fear they won't be enough.$B$BI sense a dark presence nearby... we cannot chance leaving their defenses weak. Too much power lies within those hallowed halls.$B$BSlay the Bonechewer and direct any of the Auchenai injured back to their defensive line. I will direct my scouts throughout the area to try to ascertain the Bonechewers' motives.

CompletionLog.text: 回塔拉多的莉亚德琳哨所找女伯爵莉亚德琳。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Lady Liadrin at Liadrin's Watch in Talador.

identity.title: Un-Safety First
identity.objectives: Disable 4 Safety Valves.
identity.description: These plans were designed to be read by even the most unskilled of metallurgists. It has big symbols on specific pipes for what valves NOT to turn unless risking woeful amounts of destruction.

Objectives.text: 关闭4个安全阀。
Objectives.english: Disable 4 Safety Valves.

Description.text: 这些设计图就连最没有经验的冶炼新手都能看懂。他们在特定的管道上用显眼的符号标示出了哪些阀门不得转动，除非愿意付出死伤惨重的巨大代价。
Description.english: These plans were designed to be read by even the most unskilled of metallurgists. It has big symbols on specific pipes for what valves NOT to turn unless risking woeful amounts of destruction.

CompletionLog.text: 在戈尔隆德的战斗燃油仓库里与杜隆坦交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Durotan in the Warfuel Depot of Gorgrond.

identity.title: Felblood
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Felblood Samples by killing Stormreaver Fearmongers in the Court of Lights in Talador.
identity.description: Fascinating. The doomguard in the courtyard southwest of here have disguised themselves as orcs and do not die when defeated in battle.$B$BYou see, they are powerful magical beings, and their essence manifests nearby as a blood creature that revives its body upon reaching it.$B$BI would like to study these essences without dealing with the demons myself. Bring me a few samples, would you?

Description.text: 真是有趣极了。西南边庭院里的末日守卫居然把自己乔装打扮成了兽人，即便在战斗中倒下也不会死去。$B$B你看到了，他们都是强大的魔法生物，一旦倒下后，体内的精华会在附近以鲜血生物的形态徘徊，接触躯体并将其复活。$B$B我愿意好好研究下这些精华，但我可不想惹上那些恶魔。给我带些样本来，怎么样？
Description.english: Fascinating. The doomguard in the courtyard southwest of here have disguised themselves as orcs and do not die when defeated in battle.$B$BYou see, they are powerful magical beings, and their essence manifests nearby as a blood creature that revives its body upon reaching it.$B$BI would like to study these essences without dealing with the demons myself. Bring me a few samples, would you?

CompletionLog.text: 回塔拉多的莉亚德琳哨所找法师领主阿斯塔洛·血誓。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Mage-Lord Astalor Bloodsworn at Liadrin's Watch in Talador.

identity.title: Nightmare in the Tomb
identity.objectives: Investigate the ritual in the Tomb of Souls.
identity.description: In the tomb... horrible... bodies everywhere...$B$BA dark ritual... please... you must stop it...

Objectives.text: 调查幽魂陵墓里的仪式。
Objectives.english: Investigate the ritual in the Tomb of Souls.

Description.text: 陵墓里……很可怕……到处都是尸体……$B$B有个黑暗的仪式……拜托……你必须终止它……
Description.english: In the tomb... horrible... bodies everywhere...$B$BA dark ritual... please... you must stop it...

CompletionLog.text: 到塔拉多的莉亚德琳哨所找女伯爵莉亚德琳谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Lady Liadrin at Liadrin's Watch in Talador.

identity.title: Find D'kaan
identity.objectives: Find Rangari D'kaan at Tailthrasher Basin in Gorgrond.
identity.description: D'kaan's nearby. He said something about unusual tracks. Hardly what we need to be focusing on at a time like this.$B$BWe need to leave soon. Help him, would you?

Objectives.text: 在戈尔隆德的鞭尾牛盆地找到游侠达坎。
Objectives.english: Find Rangari D'kaan at Tailthrasher Basin in Gorgrond.

Description.text: 达坎就在附近。他提到了一些可疑的足迹。眼下哪是关心这些的时候。$B$B我们很快就要离开了。你愿意去帮帮他吗？
Description.english: D'kaan's nearby. He said something about unusual tracks. Hardly what we need to be focusing on at a time like this.$B$BWe need to leave soon. Help him, would you?

identity.title: The Element of Demise
identity.objectives: Place Thrall's totem at the center of the bridge.
identity.description: The Frostwolves are a fierce and noble clan, but distrustful of outsiders.$b$bWe have arrived amidst their assault on a mighty ogre citadel. I will remain here to offer counsel to their chieftain, Durotan.$b$bYou are a proven hero of Azeroth, $n. Demonstrate your value to the Frostwolves. We need them as allies.$b$bUse my totem to thwart the ogre counterattack. This should serve to get their attention.$b$bThe rest is up to you.

Objectives.text: 将萨尔的图腾放在桥中央。
Objectives.english: Place Thrall's totem at the center of the bridge.

Description.text: 霜狼是个凶猛而高贵的部族，但他们从不相信外来者。$b$b我们到来时，他们正在对一座强大的食人魔堡垒发起攻击。我会留在这里继续为他们的酋长杜隆坦提供建议。$b$b你是艾泽拉斯名副其实的英雄，$n。向霜狼氏族彰显你的价值吧。我们需要与他们结盟。$b$b用我的图腾挫败食人魔的反击。这应该能引起他们的注意。$b$b剩下的事情就交给你了。
Description.english: The Frostwolves are a fierce and noble clan, but distrustful of outsiders.$b$bWe have arrived amidst their assault on a mighty ogre citadel. I will remain here to offer counsel to their chieftain, Durotan.$b$bYou are a proven hero of Azeroth, $n. Demonstrate your value to the Frostwolves. We need them as allies.$b$bUse my totem to thwart the ogre counterattack. This should serve to get their attention.$b$bThe rest is up to you.

identity.title: Arkonite Crystals
identity.objectives: Gather 8 Arkonite Crystals at the Overload Mine in Talador.
identity.description: Mage-Lord Bloodsworn and I recently completed the first of our new blood golems. Once we're in full production, we won't need to risk lives in the field!Unfortunately, they still need a core power crystal.$B$BWe spotted a Draenei mine overrun with crystal-hungry Goren nearby. Do what you must to get enough crystals to power our golems!

Objectives.text: 从塔拉多的超能矿井中收集8块阿肯尼特水晶。
Objectives.english: Gather 8 Arkonite Crystals at the Overload Mine in Talador.

Description.text: 我和法师领主血誓在不久前完成了第一个新型鲜血魔像。等全面投入生产后，我们就不用在战场上冒生命危险了！不幸的是，他们还需要用到一块核心能量水晶。$B$B我们在附近发现了一个德莱尼矿井，里面住满了对水晶虎视眈眈的鬣蜥人。尽你所能去找足够的水晶回来，强化我们的魔像！
Description.english: Mage-Lord Bloodsworn and I recently completed the first of our new blood golems. Once we're in full production, we won't need to risk lives in the field!Unfortunately, they still need a core power crystal.$B$BWe spotted a Draenei mine overrun with crystal-hungry Goren nearby. Do what you must to get enough crystals to power our golems!

CompletionLog.text: 回塔拉多的莉亚德琳哨所找麦拉·黎明之刃。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Mehlar Dawnblade at Liadrin's Watch in Talador.

identity.title: The Cost of Chaos
identity.objectives: Find Lorgosh in Bladespire Citadel
identity.description: Durotan had a plan.$b$bThere were many paths to victory, but his was the most wise. His would cost the least blood.$b$bHis brother, Ga'nar, is one of our most revered warriors, but he is prone to give in to blood lust. As the first Frostwolf fell, his temper won over his discipline. He ordered the bulk of our forces headlong into the citadel.$b$bThis is not the first time Durotan's brother has abandoned reason, but it may be the most costly.$b$bFind them, stranger. Do what you can to salvage our assault.

Objectives.text: 在刀塔堡垒里找到洛戈什
Objectives.english: Find Lorgosh in Bladespire Citadel

Description.text: 杜隆坦制定了一个计划。$b$b取得胜利有许多条途径，但杜隆坦的做法无疑是最明智的，可以最大限度的减少流血。$b$b他的兄弟贾纳尔是我们最受尊敬的战士之一，但他却容易对自己心中的杀戮欲妥协。当第一个霜狼战士倒下时，他的怒火战胜了戒律。他命令我们的大部队杀进堡垒。$b$b这已经不是杜隆坦的兄弟第一次将理性置之脑后了，但也许会是代价最为高昂的一次。$b$b快去找他们吧，陌生人。尽你所能地避免无谓的伤亡。
Description.english: Durotan had a plan.$b$bThere were many paths to victory, but his was the most wise. His would cost the least blood.$b$bHis brother, Ga'nar, is one of our most revered warriors, but he is prone to give in to blood lust. As the first Frostwolf fell, his temper won over his discipline. He ordered the bulk of our forces headlong into the citadel.$b$bThis is not the first time Durotan's brother has abandoned reason, but it may be the most costly.$b$bFind them, stranger. Do what you can to salvage our assault.

CompletionLog.text: 在刀塔堡垒里找到洛戈什
CompletionLog.english: Find Lorgosh in Bladespire Citadel

identity.title: Muddy Waters
identity.objectives: Find nutritious mud in the Spinebloom Spires to revive Jagahari.
identity.description: <Cough>$b$bNot feeling so strong... dehydrated...$b$b<Cough>$b$bNeed nutrients for leaves... need revenge...

Objectives.text: 在棘花石林找到营养土，使贾格哈里苏醒。
Objectives.english: Find nutritious mud in the Spinebloom Spires to revive Jagahari.

Description.text: <咳嗽>$b$b感觉不太好……快要脱水了……$b$b<咳嗽>$b$b叶子需要养分……需要复仇……
Description.english: <Cough>$b$bNot feeling so strong... dehydrated...$b$b<Cough>$b$bNeed nutrients for leaves... need revenge...

CompletionLog.text: 回戈尔隆德的棘花石林找贾格哈里。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Jagahari at the Spinebloom Spires in Gorgrond.

identity.title: A New Threat
identity.objectives: Speak with Crystal-Shaper Barum at the crossroads northwest of Aruuna.
identity.description: Aruuna, a draenei mining settlement to the northeast, has been sacked. Strangely, it doesn't sound like the work of the Iron Horde.$B$BMy scouts describe the attackers as "giant fire-breathing birdmen."$B$BI suppose nothing in this place should surprise me anymore...$B$B<QUESTGIVER points to her map.>$B$BRefugees have been seen fleeing along this road. Help them if possible, and learn whatever you can about the attackers.$B$Bif these "birdmen" are a threat, we need to know.

Objectives.text: 在阿鲁纳西北方的十字路口处与塑晶者巴伦姆交谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Crystal-Shaper Barum at the crossroads northwest of Aruuna.

Description.text: 位于东北边的德莱尼挖矿据点阿鲁纳遭到了洗劫。奇怪的是，那听起来不像是钢铁部落的杰作。$B$B据我的探子回报，攻击者犹如“巨大的喷火鸟人”。$B$B我以为这地方没什么能使我惊讶了……$B$B<QUESTGIVER指了指地图。>$B$B沿路各处都有难民在奔逃。要是可以的话就去帮帮他们吧，顺便调查攻击者的身份。$B$B如果这些“鸟人”真是威胁的话，我们必须要了解清楚。
Description.english: Aruuna, a draenei mining settlement to the northeast, has been sacked. Strangely, it doesn't sound like the work of the Iron Horde.$B$BMy scouts describe the attackers as "giant fire-breathing birdmen."$B$BI suppose nothing in this place should surprise me anymore...$B$B<QUESTGIVER points to her map.>$B$BRefugees have been seen fleeing along this road. Help them if possible, and learn whatever you can about the attackers.$B$Bif these "birdmen" are a threat, we need to know.

CompletionLog.text: 在阿鲁纳西北方的十字路口处与塑晶者巴伦姆交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Crystal-Shaper Barum at the crossroads northwest of Aruuna.

identity.title: Demons Among Us - Horde
identity.objectives: Deliver Thamuun's Letter to Thalia at Teluuna Observatory.
identity.description: If you are reading this, it means I have fallen in battle. As my last request, please deliver this letter to Thalia at Teluuna Observatory.$B$B$BDearest Thalia,$B$B$BYou have always been my best friend, ever since we were children growing up in Tuurem.$B$BI have always been too afraid to tell you my feelings, but I cannot leave this world without finally speaking the truth.$B$BThalia, I love you with all my heart.$B$BI shall wait for you in the next world. I will for eternity for you.$B$BLove,$B$B$BThamuun

Objectives.text: 把萨姆恩的遗书交给特鲁纳观星台的萨莉亚。
Objectives.english: Deliver Thamuun's Letter to Thalia at Teluuna Observatory.

Description.text: 当你看到这封信的时候，说明我已经死了。作为我最后的请求，请把这封信转交给特鲁纳观星台的萨利亚。$B$B$B亲爱的萨利亚，$B$B$B我们自小一起在图雷姆长大，你一直都是我最好的朋友。$B$B我从来不敢把自己心中真实的感受说给你听，但我如果不把实话说出来的话，就无法安心离开这个世界。$B$B萨莉亚，我全心全意地爱着你。$B$B我会在另一个世界里等你，直到海枯石烂，不离不弃。$B$B爱你的，$B$B$B萨姆恩
Description.english: If you are reading this, it means I have fallen in battle. As my last request, please deliver this letter to Thalia at Teluuna Observatory.$B$B$BDearest Thalia,$B$B$BYou have always been my best friend, ever since we were children growing up in Tuurem.$B$BI have always been too afraid to tell you my feelings, but I cannot leave this world without finally speaking the truth.$B$BThalia, I love you with all my heart.$B$BI shall wait for you in the next world. I will for eternity for you.$B$BLove,$B$B$BThamuun

identity.title: TASK: Kill Ogre Slavers
identity.objectives: Kill $1oa Stonemaul ogres.

Title.text: 任务：击败食人魔奴隶主

identity.title: The Thing in the Cave
identity.objectives: Slay the Thing in the Cave, then loot its Dreadful Heart.
identity.description: The note reads as follows:$b$b"It cannot be defeated. No matter how many troops we send at it, it seemingly cannot be destroyed.$b$b"We have lost too many lives as it is. I refuse to send another orc after that thing. Instead, we will establish a guard station outside the cave's mouth to keep it from getting out."

Objectives.text: 消灭洞里的敌人，拾取恐惧之心。
Objectives.english: Slay the Thing in the Cave, then loot its Dreadful Heart.

Description.text: 纸条上写着：$b$b“它是不可战胜的。不管我们派出多少军队，都似乎无法消灭它。”$b$b“我们已经牺牲了太多弟兄。我拒绝再多派一个兽人去送死。相反地，我们要在洞口外面建个护卫站，决不能让它闯进来。”
Description.english: The note reads as follows:$b$b"It cannot be defeated. No matter how many troops we send at it, it seemingly cannot be destroyed.$b$b"We have lost too many lives as it is. I refuse to send another orc after that thing. Instead, we will establish a guard station outside the cave's mouth to keep it from getting out."

CompletionLog.text: 到戈尔隆德你的车队处，将恐惧之心交还给尖啸者卡兹。
CompletionLog.english: Return the Dreadful Heart to Kaz the Shrieker at your caravan in Gorgrond.

identity.title: In Need of a Hero
identity.objectives: Save Squiggy by dousing fires with buckets of water.
identity.description: I...<sob>... I can't leave...<gulp>... without... Squiggy...!$B$BHe... he's... trapped!$B$BYou need... to put out... the fire!$B$B<Ariaana points across the room and bursts into tears.>

Progress.text: 扭扭……是……我……最好的……朋友！
Progress.english: Twisted... it was... my... best... friend!

identity.title: Vignette: Broodmother Reeg'ak
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
identity.description: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.

Description.text: 鬣蜥人是危险的敌人，尤其是在他们人多势众的时候，更别说我们身边还跟着一个没用的瞎眼老萨满。$b$b幸运的是，他们都很短命。而不幸的是，他们繁衍很快，生长更快。$b$b如果我们想要完成这个任务，就得找到巢母。消灭她和她的卵，就能令鬣蜥人的攻势放缓。去检查一下熔炉之门附近的洞穴吧，我会尽量不让他们发现德雷克塔尔的气味。
Description.english: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.

CompletionLog.text: 回霜火岭的熔炉之门找德拉卡。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Draka at the Forge Gates in Frostfire Ridge.

identity.title: The Pale Hunter
identity.objectives: Help Helga reclaim her sanity.
identity.description: Spiders!$b$bWhere is my father!$b$bI feel so... so... good? Bad? Don't judge me! Leave me alone! I'm sleeping... in my brain.$b$bAHH!! More bunnies!$b$b<The dwarves eyes are extremely dilated. She appears to be hallucinating. >

Objectives.text: 帮助希尔加恢复神智。
Objectives.english: Help Helga reclaim her sanity.

Description.text: 蜘蛛！$b$b我父亲在哪儿！$b$b我感觉这么……这么……好？坏？别替我做判断！离我远点儿！我的大脑……在沉睡。$b$b啊！更多兔子！$b$b<矮人把眼睛瞪得极大。她似乎产生了幻觉。>
Description.english: Spiders!$b$bWhere is my father!$b$bI feel so... so... good? Bad? Don't judge me! Leave me alone! I'm sleeping... in my brain.$b$bAHH!! More bunnies!$b$b<The dwarves eyes are extremely dilated. She appears to be hallucinating. >

CompletionLog.text: 在戈尔隆德被遗忘的洞穴附近阅读希尔加的日记。
CompletionLog.english: Read Helga's Journal near the Forgotten Caves in Gorgrond.

identity.title: Goren, Goren, Gone!
identity.objectives: Destroy 15 Goren Stonechewers and their leader, Pastrok within the Jorune Quarry.
identity.description: I was all set to take a little trip to the nearby quarry when all of the sudden a bunch of goren bust out of the ground and started wreaking havoc!$b$bIt would be a shame for all of those beautiful gems to be destroyed by those filthy creatures. All they do is eat them! Can you believe that?!$b$bBe a dear and dispose of them. Make sure you get rid of the leader or they will only come back.

Objectives.text: 在尤鲁恩采石场里消灭15个鬣蜥人嚼石者和他们的首领帕斯特洛克。
Objectives.english: Destroy 15 Goren Stonechewers and their leader, Pastrok within the Jorune Quarry.

Description.text: 当时我正准备到附近的采石场去，结果一群鬣蜥人突然从地下冒了出来，开始大搞破坏！$b$b那些美丽的宝石就这样被那群肮脏的怪物白白毁掉，真是暴殄天物啊。他们所做的就是把宝石全都吃进肚子里去！你能相信吗？！$b$b请你行行好去消灭他们吧。一定要把首领除掉，否则他们还会回来的。
Description.english: I was all set to take a little trip to the nearby quarry when all of the sudden a bunch of goren bust out of the ground and started wreaking havoc!$b$bIt would be a shame for all of those beautiful gems to be destroyed by those filthy creatures. All they do is eat them! Can you believe that?!$b$bBe a dear and dispose of them. Make sure you get rid of the leader or they will only come back.

CompletionLog.text: 回莉亚德琳哨所找克丽丝托尔。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Crystal in Liadrin's Watch.

identity.title: Can't Live With 'Em, Can't Learn Without 'Em
identity.objectives: Rescue 8 Jorune Miners from within the Jorune Quarry.
identity.description: The Draenei here are so in touch with the light. It's imperative that we learn as much as we can from them.$b$bWe must find a way to overcome their distrust in us...$b$bThe Jorune Quarry was attacked by goren leaving many helpless miners trapped within. The miners aren't fighters and would probably appreciate help from anywhere at this point.$b$bMaybe if you lend a hand in rescuing them, we may earn ourselves some goodwill.

Title.english: Can't Live With 'Em, Can't Learn Without 'Em

Objectives.text: 从尤鲁恩采石场里救出8名尤鲁恩矿工。
Objectives.english: Rescue 8 Jorune Miners from within the Jorune Quarry.

Description.text: 这里的德莱尼十分亲近圣光。我们应该尽可能地向他们学习。$b$b我们得想办法消除他们对我们的怀疑……$b$b尤鲁恩采石场遭到了鬣蜥人的攻击，有许多无助的矿工被困了在里面。矿工们不是战士，他们目前可能很需要帮助。$b$b要是你能帮忙把他们救出来，我们也许就能赢得德莱尼的善意了。
Description.english: The Draenei here are so in touch with the light. It's imperative that we learn as much as we can from them.$b$bWe must find a way to overcome their distrust in us...$b$bThe Jorune Quarry was attacked by goren leaving many helpless miners trapped within. The miners aren't fighters and would probably appreciate help from anywhere at this point.$b$bMaybe if you lend a hand in rescuing them, we may earn ourselves some goodwill.

CompletionLog.text: 回莉亚德琳哨所找萨琳德拉·光誓。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Salindra Lightsworn in Liadrin's Watch.

identity.title: War Kangaroo!
identity.objectives: test
identity.description: test

identity.title: The Power Shards
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Shard of Souls in the Tomb of Souls.
identity.description: I know what the Bonechewer are after.$B$BAuchindoun is protected by a powerful barrier, which can only be disabled using an ancient key. No being could ever hope to penetrate it.$B$BThe Auchenai, my people, split the key into three shards long ago and hid each piece outside the mausoleum walls. We guard those shards with the same zeal as Auchindoun itself.$B$BGo into the Tomb of Souls and retrieve the key from Soulbinder X. The shards are no longer safe.

Objectives.text: 从幽魂陵墓里取回灵魂碎片。
Objectives.english: Retrieve the Shard of Souls in the Tomb of Souls.

Description.text: 我已经知道噬骨氏族要干什么了。$B$B有一道强大的屏障在保护着奥金顿，只能用一把古老的钥匙才能解除这道屏障。否则，任何生物都休想穿透它。$B$B我的奥金尼族人在很久以前将钥匙分成了三块碎片，并把每块碎片分别藏在陵墓的高墙之外。我们用守护奥金顿的热忱守护着那些碎片。$B$B请你进入幽魂陵墓，从缚魂者X身上取回钥匙。碎片已经不再安全了。
Description.english: I know what the Bonechewer are after.$B$BAuchindoun is protected by a powerful barrier, which can only be disabled using an ancient key. No being could ever hope to penetrate it.$B$BThe Auchenai, my people, split the key into three shards long ago and hid each piece outside the mausoleum walls. We guard those shards with the same zeal as Auchindoun itself.$B$BGo into the Tomb of Souls and retrieve the key from Soulbinder X. The shards are no longer safe.

CompletionLog.text: 回塔拉多的莉亚德琳哨所找缚魂者尼娅米。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Soulbinder Nyami at Liadrin's Watch in Talador.

identity.title: Desperate Times
identity.objectives: Ride to the Tomb of Lights with Lady Liadrin.
identity.description: This alliance between the Bonechewer and Teron'gore does not bode well.$B$BWe cannot allow the remaining two key fragments to fall into their hands. The Auchenai cannot stop the onslaught, so the duty falls on us.$B$BLet us waste no time. We ride for the Tomb of Lights at once.

Objectives.text: 与女伯爵莉亚德琳一同骑行前往圣光之墓。
Objectives.english: Ride to the Tomb of Lights with Lady Liadrin.

Description.text: 噬骨部族与塔隆戈尔之间达成的联盟可不是好兆头。$B$B我们决不能让剩下的两块钥匙碎片落入他们手中。既然奥金尼无力阻挡攻击，那这责任就落在我们肩上了。$B$B抓紧时间。我们要立刻前往圣光之墓。
Description.english: This alliance between the Bonechewer and Teron'gore does not bode well.$B$BWe cannot allow the remaining two key fragments to fall into their hands. The Auchenai cannot stop the onslaught, so the duty falls on us.$B$BLet us waste no time. We ride for the Tomb of Lights at once.

CompletionLog.text: 到塔拉多的圣光之墓找女伯爵莉亚德琳。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Lady Liadrin at the Tomb of Lights in Talador.

identity.title: Gut Guttra
identity.objectives: Kill Guttra Wolfchew.
identity.description: Guttra Wolfchew's hunger can be blamed for this massacre. He will pay with his life for the blood spilled today. $b$bYou can find Guttra up on Grimfrost Hill to the north. Slay him and return to me.$b$bWhen you get back we shall drink to our victory.

Objectives.text: 消灭古特拉·狼噬
Objectives.english: Kill Guttra Wolfchew.

Description.text: 是古特拉·狼噬的欲望造成了这场杀戮。他必须为今天流淌在这里的鲜血付出生命的代价。$b$b古特拉就在北边的肃霜丘陵上。去干掉他，然后再回来找我。$b$b等你凯旋归来时，我们要好好喝上几杯，欢庆胜利。
Description.english: Guttra Wolfchew's hunger can be blamed for this massacre. He will pay with his life for the blood spilled today. $b$bYou can find Guttra up on Grimfrost Hill to the north. Slay him and return to me.$b$bWhen you get back we shall drink to our victory.

CompletionLog.text: 回霜火岭的肃霜丘陵附近找乌鲁卡格。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Urukag near the Grimfrost Hill in Frostfire Ridge.

identity.title: Stolen Axes
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Stolen Frostwolf Axes.
identity.description:
The saberon usually keep to themselves, but sometimes they range out of their dens and attack.

A pride of them live in the Windswept Lowland and have been coming too close for comfort, especially at night.

They even attacked a shipment of axes and took them back to their den!

Description.text:
刃牙虎人通常是安分守己的，但有时也会跑到巢穴外面来挑衅滋事。

一群生活在啸风洼地的刃牙虎人最近是越来越放肆了，尤其是在夜晚。

他们甚至还袭击了运送战斧的货船，把武器抢回了自己的老巢！
Description.english:
The saberon usually keep to themselves, but sometimes they range out of their dens and attack.

A pride of them live in the Windswept Lowland and have been coming too close for comfort, especially at night.

They even attacked a shipment of axes and took them back to their den!

CompletionLog.text: 回去找后勤管理员艾丽
CompletionLog.english: Return to Supplymaster Eri

identity.title: Demons? In Auchindoun?
identity.objectives: Kill O'mogg Blackheart in the Tomb of Lights to shut down the demon portal.
identity.description: Demons! I feared as much.$B$BWe cannot let them leave that tomb. They musn't be allowed near Auchindoun!$B$BQuickly, go in and shut down the portal letting them in while I help rally the Auchenai's defenses. There must be a powerful warlock keeping it open. Kill him and the portal will fall apart!

Objectives.text: 在圣光之墓里消灭奥莫格·黑心，并关闭恶魔传送门。
Objectives.english: Kill O'mogg Blackheart in the Tomb of Lights to shut down the demon portal.

Description.text: 恶魔！我担心的事情还是发生了。$B$B我们不能让这些恶魔离开陵墓。绝不能让它们接近奥金顿！$B$B赶快，进去关闭那道它们的传送门，我会帮忙集结奥金尼的防御力量。肯定有位强大的术士在维持传送门的开启。去干掉他，传送门就不复存在了！
Description.english: Demons! I feared as much.$B$BWe cannot let them leave that tomb. They musn't be allowed near Auchindoun!$B$BQuickly, go in and shut down the portal letting them in while I help rally the Auchenai's defenses. There must be a powerful warlock keeping it open. Kill him and the portal will fall apart!

CompletionLog.text: 到金色黎明营地向女伯爵莉亚德琳报告。
CompletionLog.english: Report to Lady Liadrin at Goldendawn Camp.

identity.title: Saberon Matriarch
identity.objectives: Slay the Saberon Pridematron.
identity.description:
The current matriarch of the Windswept Lowland saberon pride is bold.

She leads her pride in ambushes and attacks that some consider organized raids on our supply lines.

The intelligence she displays  is becoming a legitimate threat.

Take her out and perhaps she'll be replaced with a less dangerous leader.

Objectives.text: 消灭虎人主母。
Objectives.english: Slay the Saberon Pridematron.

Description.text:
啸风洼地的刃牙虎人的现任主母行事过于大胆了。

她率领自己的族群不断地伏击和进攻，对我们的补给线发起了有组织的突袭。

她所表现出的智慧，已经使她成为了我们不容忽视的威胁。

把她找出来，也许她的继任者不会像她那么难对付。
Description.english:
The current matriarch of the Windswept Lowland saberon pride is bold.

She leads her pride in ambushes and attacks that some consider organized raids on our supply lines.

The intelligence she displays  is becoming a legitimate threat.

Take her out and perhaps she'll be replaced with a less dangerous leader.

CompletionLog.text: 回去找后勤管理员艾丽
CompletionLog.english: Return to Supplymaster Eri

identity.title: This Is Not a Quest
identity.objectives: Help Deceptia
identity.description: We need help! But not from you...

Objectives.text: 帮助德塞普提亚
Objectives.english: Help Deceptia

Description.text: 我们需要帮助！但用不着你管……
Description.english: We need help! But not from you...

identity.title: Outrider Urukag
identity.objectives: Join Urukag on his hunt.
identity.description: I can't believe I'm stuck here cooking while Urukag is out there hunting with the others.$b$bIf you hurry you might still be able to catch him, $n.

Objectives.text: 和乌鲁卡格一起狩猎。
Objectives.english: Join Urukag on his hunt.

Description.text: 我真不敢相信。当乌鲁卡格和其他人外出狩猎时，我居然只能待在这里做饭。$b$b如果你速度够快的话，也许还能追上他，$n。
Description.english: I can't believe I'm stuck here cooking while Urukag is out there hunting with the others.$b$bIf you hurry you might still be able to catch him, $n.

CompletionLog.text: 在霜火岭的肃霜丘陵附近加入乌鲁卡格。
CompletionLog.english: Join Urukag near Grimfrost Hill in Frostfire Ridge.

identity.title: The Hunting Party
identity.objectives: Find the Frostwolf Hunters in the Windswept Lowland.
identity.description: Korga and her brothers have been out hunting for days and have not returned.$b$bThis is a common problem amongst our clan.$b$bCall them in so they can get some proper rest.

Objectives.text: 在啸风洼地找到霜狼猎手。
Objectives.english: Find the Frostwolf Hunters in the Windswept Lowland.

Description.text: 科尔加和她的兄弟们已经外出狩猎多日了，到现在还没回来。$b$b这是我们氏族成员的通病。$b$b把他们叫回来，好让他们得到适当的休息。
Description.english: Korga and her brothers have been out hunting for days and have not returned.$b$bThis is a common problem amongst our clan.$b$bCall them in so they can get some proper rest.

CompletionLog.text: 回霜火岭的集结地找库伦克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Krunk at the Muster Field in Frostfire Ridge.

identity.title: The Bloodmaul Scheme
identity.objectives: Deliver the Ogre Plans to Rogash.
identity.description: <This parchment contains crudely written notes detailing the Bloodmaul Clan's future plans.$b$bRogash will know what to do with this information.>

Objectives.text: 把食人魔计划书交给罗格什。
Objectives.english: Deliver the Ogre Plans to Rogash.

Description.text: <在这张羊皮纸上用潦草的字迹详细记叙了血槌氏族未来的计划。$b$b罗格什知道该如何处理这份情报。>
Description.english: <This parchment contains crudely written notes detailing the Bloodmaul Clan's future plans.$b$bRogash will know what to do with this information.>

identity.title: Missing Frostwolves
identity.objectives: Search Bloodmaul for the missing Frostwolves.
identity.description: $n, I'm glad you're here.$B$BSeveral Frostwolf patrols have gone missing recently around the Bloodmaul Compound. Search the area around Bloodmaul and report back to me when you're done.

Objectives.text: 在血槌寻找失踪的霜狼成员。
Objectives.english: Search Bloodmaul for the missing Frostwolves.

Description.text: $n，你在这真是太好了。$B$B最近有好几支霜狼巡逻队在血槌营地附近失踪。请你去血槌附近的地区搜索一下，然后回来向我汇报。
Description.english: $n, I'm glad you're here.$B$BSeveral Frostwolf patrols have gone missing recently around the Bloodmaul Compound. Search the area around Bloodmaul and report back to me when you're done.

identity.title: A Gift for Raa'la
identity.objectives: Collect a Baby Rylak for Raa'la in the Windswept Lowlands.
identity.description: I need to pack up this kill.  I promised my daughter Raa'la I would bring her home a gift from the hunt.$b$bThere are a couple baby Rylaks in the cave nearby. Maybe Raa'la would like one as a pet?$b$bWould you mind catching one while I finish up here?

Objectives.text: 在啸风洼地为莱拉找到一只幼年双头飞龙。
Objectives.english: Collect a Baby Rylak for Raa'la in the Windswept Lowlands.

Description.text: 我得结束这场杀戮了。我答应过我的女儿莱拉，一定会带礼物给她的。$b$b在附近的洞穴里有几只幼年双头飞龙。也许莱拉会愿意要一只当宠物？$b$b我在这里还有收尾工作要做，你愿意替我去抓一只来吗？
Description.english: I need to pack up this kill.  I promised my daughter Raa'la I would bring her home a gift from the hunt.$b$bThere are a couple baby Rylaks in the cave nearby. Maybe Raa'la would like one as a pet?$b$bWould you mind catching one while I finish up here?

CompletionLog.text: 回霜火岭的啸风洼地找莱克拉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Rakla at the Windswept Lowlands in Frostfire Ridge.

identity.title: You Sunk My Battleship!
identity.objectives: Plant the Underwater Explosives on the Iron Horde boats.
identity.description: They sunk my battleship, $n!$b$bI drove her in with a cargo of underwater explosives to place on the Iron Horde ships, but they spotted me and opened fire! Luckily I was able to salvage most of the explosives before she sank. Ain't nobody sinks my ship and gets away with it...nobody!$b$bTake the rest of the underwater charges and plant all of 'em on the western Battleship. You'll have to swim your way into the harbor to avoid detection.$b$bWhen you're done, swim into shore. I'll be waiting on the path!

Objectives.text: 把水下炸药放在钢铁部落的船上。
Objectives.english: Plant the Underwater Explosives on the Iron Horde boats.

Description.text: 他们击沉了我的战舰，$n！$b$b我在船上装满了水下炸药，原本想把它们安放在钢铁部落的船上，结果却被他们发现，还朝我开了火！幸好我在船只沉没之前把大部分炸药都抢救出来了。敢弄沉我战舰的人全都休想全身而退……休想！$b$b快拿上剩下的水下炸药，把它们放在西边的战舰上。你得设法游进港口，以避免被发现。$b$b等你完成后，再游回岸边吧。我会在小路上等你的！
Description.english: They sunk my battleship, $n!$b$bI drove her in with a cargo of underwater explosives to place on the Iron Horde ships, but they spotted me and opened fire! Luckily I was able to salvage most of the explosives before she sank. Ain't nobody sinks my ship and gets away with it...nobody!$b$bTake the rest of the underwater charges and plant all of 'em on the western Battleship. You'll have to swim your way into the harbor to avoid detection.$b$bWhen you're done, swim into shore. I'll be waiting on the path!

CompletionLog.text: 在格罗玛尔的港口与钟摆汇合。
CompletionLog.english: Meet Ticker inside Grommar harbor.

identity.title: Goren Boss Kill and Collect
identity.description: <Light bounces from within the gem creating rainbows on the nearby walls.>$b$bThis curious looking gem seems to have fallen from Pastrok's back. Perhaps a skilled gem-shaper or jewelcrafter would have a use for it.

Description.text: <从宝石中折射出的光芒，在附近的墙壁上映出了一道彩虹。>$b$b这块奇形怪状的宝石似乎是从帕斯特洛克的背上掉下来的。也许一位老练的塑晶者或珠宝匠知道它的用处。
Description.english: <Light bounces from within the gem creating rainbows on the nearby walls.>$b$bThis curious looking gem seems to have fallen from Pastrok's back. Perhaps a skilled gem-shaper or jewelcrafter would have a use for it.

CompletionLog.text: 把宝石交给附近的塑晶者或珠宝匠。
CompletionLog.english: Return the gem to a nearby crystal-shaper or jewelcrafter.

identity.title: Hansel, Report
identity.objectives: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at Bastion Rise in Gorgrond.
identity.description: I have Hansel directing our counter-fire against the Iron Horde's war machines.$B$BI need to know what's going on and why some of the orcs slipped through. He's down the hill to the north.

Objectives.text: 在戈尔隆德的棱堡高地与汉瑟尔·重拳谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at Bastion Rise in Gorgrond.

Description.text: 我让汉瑟尔指挥对抗钢铁部落战争机器的反击行动。$B$B我需要了解最新的情况，为什么会有一些兽人溜了过来。他就在北边的山脚下。
Description.english: I have Hansel directing our counter-fire against the Iron Horde's war machines.$B$BI need to know what's going on and why some of the orcs slipped through. He's down the hill to the north.

identity.title: Build Us A Backdoor
identity.objectives: Help Nightstalker find a weak spot in the Stonemaul Slave Camp walls.
identity.description: According to the prisoner here, the Stonemaul ogres are providing slaves and supplies to the Iron Horde. No creature should live a life in chains! And to add insult to injury, Orgrim Doomhammer is here to discuss terms with them!$b$bI sent my wolf Nightstalker ahead to find a weakness. If there is another way in, he will find it.$b$BGo, find my wolf near walls of the Stonemaul camp south of here. Test their defenses.$b$bIf you cannot find us a way in, then make one.

Objectives.text: 帮助逐夜在石槌奴隶营地的围墙上找到薄弱点。
Objectives.english: Help Nightstalker find a weak spot in the Stonemaul Slave Camp walls.

Description.text: 据这里的囚犯说，石槌食人魔正在为钢铁部落提供奴隶和补给品。任何生命都不该戴着镣铐过活！更雪上加霜的是，奥格瑞姆·毁灭之锤正在这里和他们谈价钱！$b$b我派我的战狼逐夜到前方寻找薄弱点了。只要存在别的入口，它就一定能找得到。$b$b去吧，到南边石槌营地的围墙附近找到我的战狼。试试他们的防御力。$b$b要是实在找不到进去的路，就帮我们制造一条。
Description.english: According to the prisoner here, the Stonemaul ogres are providing slaves and supplies to the Iron Horde. No creature should live a life in chains! And to add insult to injury, Orgrim Doomhammer is here to discuss terms with them!$b$bI sent my wolf Nightstalker ahead to find a weakness. If there is another way in, he will find it.$b$BGo, find my wolf near walls of the Stonemaul camp south of here. Test their defenses.$b$bIf you cannot find us a way in, then make one.

CompletionLog.text: 到戈尔隆德的石槌奴隶营地与杜隆坦交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Durotan at the Stonemaul Slave Camp in Gorgrond.

identity.title: We Are Leaving!
identity.description: We have who we came for. Find the others. Tell them to get back to the caravan as soon as possible.$b$bIt will not be long before the ogres figure out how few of us there actually are. We will wait for you at the front gates.

Description.text: 我们已经找到了要找的人。现在去找其他人吧，让他们尽快回到车队这里来。$b$b食人魔很快就会发现我们其实没有多少人。我们会在前门等你。
Description.english: We have who we came for. Find the others. Tell them to get back to the caravan as soon as possible.$b$bIt will not be long before the ogres figure out how few of us there actually are. We will wait for you at the front gates.

identity.title: Fungal Heart
identity.objectives: Collect 3 Fungal Hearts.
identity.description: The second ingredient I will need for the elixir is harder to obtain.$B$BAlong the river roam Marsh Giants - fungal monstrosities whose hunger is never sated. I will need three of their hearts.$B$BThe stronger the heart, the more potent the mixture, and the clearer my vision.

Objectives.text: 收集3颗真菌之心。
Objectives.english: Collect 3 Fungal Hearts.

Description.text: 我制作药剂需要用到的第二种原料更难获得。$B$B在河边有游荡的泽地巨人——那些是真菌怪物，食欲永远得不到满足。我需要三颗他们的心。$B$B心越是强大，合剂的效力就越大，我的视野就会更加清晰。
Description.english: The second ingredient I will need for the elixir is harder to obtain.$B$BAlong the river roam Marsh Giants - fungal monstrosities whose hunger is never sated. I will need three of their hearts.$B$BThe stronger the heart, the more potent the mixture, and the clearer my vision.

CompletionLog.text: 回影月谷的暮光林地找先知维伦。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Prophet Velen at Twilight Glade in Shadowmoon Valley.

identity.title: Enemies Above
identity.objectives: Speak with Scout Ruk'gan near the Bones of Agurak.
identity.description: We have dealt a crushing blow to the Thunderlords with the death of the Iron Wolf $n, but we can not rest yet.$B$BThe Thunderlord generals will be fighting like caged wolves to maintain their place in the Iron Horde and that means bad news for us.$b$bI sent Scout Ruk'gan to keep an eye on their movements but he hasn't reported back for some time now. If you would help us then seek out Ruk'gan. $B$B Lok'tar $n!

Objectives.text: 在阿古拉克之骨附近与斥候鲁甘谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Scout Ruk'gan near the Bones of Agurak.

Description.text: 铁狼的死无疑对雷神氏族造成了沉重打击，$n，但我们现在还不能休息。$B$B为了维护自己在钢铁部落中的地位，雷神将军们一定会像笼中困兽一样死战到底，那对我们来说可是坏消息。$b$b我派斥候鲁甘去监视他们的行动，可他已经有阵子没回来汇报了。要是你愿意帮我们的话就去找鲁甘吧。$B$BLok'tar，$n！
Description.english: We have dealt a crushing blow to the Thunderlords with the death of the Iron Wolf $n, but we can not rest yet.$B$BThe Thunderlord generals will be fighting like caged wolves to maintain their place in the Iron Horde and that means bad news for us.$b$bI sent Scout Ruk'gan to keep an eye on their movements but he hasn't reported back for some time now. If you would help us then seek out Ruk'gan. $B$B Lok'tar $n!

identity.title: Getting the Points
identity.objectives: Gather 5 Barbed Thunderlord Spears within the Bones of Agurak.
identity.description: Those Thunderlords circling above us are a problem $n.$b$bThey fly their pathetic Rylaks leisurely across the valley, thinking they are safe to rain spears down on our heads. We need to show them they are not safe from Frostwolf Vengeance!$b$bI have a plan but we will need to gather some material. Go hunt across the valley for any of their spears that survived intact. I think five should be enough.

Objectives.text: 在阿古拉克之骨里收集5根带刺的雷神长矛。
Objectives.english: Gather 5 Barbed Thunderlord Spears within the Bones of Agurak.

Description.text: 那些在我们头顶上飞来飞去的雷神成员是个麻烦，$n。$b$b他们骑在那些可怜的双头飞龙背上，悠然自得地在山谷上空翱翔，以为能安全地把长矛砸到我们的脑袋上。我们得让他们知道，想避开霜狼的复仇之火可没那么容易！$b$b我有个计划，但我们得先收集一些材料才行。去山谷里把那些完好无损的长矛找来。我想有五把应该就够了。
Description.english: Those Thunderlords circling above us are a problem $n.$b$bThey fly their pathetic Rylaks leisurely across the valley, thinking they are safe to rain spears down on our heads. We need to show them they are not safe from Frostwolf Vengeance!$b$bI have a plan but we will need to gather some material. Go hunt across the valley for any of their spears that survived intact. I think five should be enough.

identity.title: Mutation Station
identity.objectives: Assist Grulk in destroying the Mutation Lab by administering the Mutation Serum to him.
identity.description: Grulk very weak...barely stand.$b$bGrulk not always look this way. Grulk once was orc...Iron Horde make Grulk mutant. Grulk angry at Iron Horde...so Iron Horde lock Grulk in cage...hurt Grulk.$b$bGrulk HATE Iron Horde...Grulk want SMASH them...make them PAY!$b$bTake serum...use on Grulk to make Grulk strong! Help Grulk SMASH Iron Horde!

Objectives.text: 把变异血清用在古鲁尔克身上，帮他摧毁变异实验室。
Objectives.english: Assist Grulk in destroying the Mutation Lab by administering the Mutation Serum to him.

Description.text: 古鲁尔克好虚弱……都站不起来了。$b$b古鲁尔克以前不是这样的。古鲁尔克曾经是个兽人……是钢铁部落让古鲁尔克变异了。古鲁尔克对钢铁部落发怒……所以钢铁部落把古鲁尔克锁进了笼子里……还伤害古鲁尔克。$b$b古鲁尔克恨钢铁部落……古鲁尔克要粉碎他们……让他们还债！$b$b拿上血清……用在古鲁尔克身上，把古鲁尔克变强！帮助古鲁尔克粉碎钢铁部落！
Description.english: Grulk very weak...barely stand.$b$bGrulk not always look this way. Grulk once was orc...Iron Horde make Grulk mutant. Grulk angry at Iron Horde...so Iron Horde lock Grulk in cage...hurt Grulk.$b$bGrulk HATE Iron Horde...Grulk want SMASH them...make them PAY!$b$bTake serum...use on Grulk to make Grulk strong! Help Grulk SMASH Iron Horde!

identity.title: Smash Blon'sky!
identity.objectives: Defeat Blon'sky.
identity.description: Grulk not choose to be mutated. Grulk not monster like Blon'sky! Blon'sky evil... chose mutation for power!$b$bYou go to Grommar? Smash Blon'sky before he hurt innocents, make Grulk happy!

Objectives.text: 击败布隆斯基。
Objectives.english: Defeat Blon'sky.

Description.text: 古鲁尔克不是自愿变异的。古鲁尔克不是布隆斯基那样的怪物！布隆斯基是邪恶的……他为了力量自愿变异！$b$b你要去格罗玛尔？趁布隆斯基伤人前把他粉碎，这样古鲁尔克就高兴了！
Description.english: Grulk not choose to be mutated. Grulk not monster like Blon'sky! Blon'sky evil... chose mutation for power!$b$bYou go to Grommar? Smash Blon'sky before he hurt innocents, make Grulk happy!

CompletionLog.text: 回你的要塞找古鲁尔克。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Grulk in your Garrison.

identity.title: They Took My Father
identity.objectives: Collect Anchorite Dolruu's three notes.
identity.description: $p! I have a lead on what happened to my father. There have been reports that he was seen in the presence of Shadow Council orcs in ____.$b$bMy father was a powerful Anchorite with a vast amount of ancient knowledge. I dread to think what those within the Shadow Council would do to him to get that knowledge. $b$bCan you go to ___? Hunt down their officers and see what they know?

Objectives.text: 收集学者多尔鲁的三份笔记。
Objectives.english: Collect Anchorite Dolruu's three notes.

CompletionLog.text: 回你的要塞找学者拉里妮。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Anchorite Raleen in your garrison.

identity.title: Mind Controlled Rylaks
identity.objectives: xxxxx
identity.description: xxxxx

Title.text: 被精神控制的双头飞龙

identity.title: Powering the Defenses
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Shard of Souls in the Tomb of Souls.
identity.description: I know what the Bonechewer are after.$B$BAuchindoun is protected by a powerful barrier, which can only be disabled using an ancient key. No being could ever hope to penetrate it.$B$BThe Auchenai, my people, split the key into three shards long ago and hid each piece outside the mausoleum walls. We guard those shards with the same zeal as Auchindoun itself.$B$BGo into the Tomb of Souls and retrieve the key from Soulbinder X. The shards are no longer safe.

Objectives.text: 从幽魂陵墓里取回灵魂碎片。
Objectives.english: Retrieve the Shard of Souls in the Tomb of Souls.

Description.text: 我已经知道噬骨氏族要干什么了。$B$B有一道强大的屏障在保护着奥金顿，只能用一把古老的钥匙才能解除这道屏障。否则，任何生物都休想穿透它。$B$B我们奥金尼在很久以前将钥匙分成了三块碎片，并把每块碎片分别藏在陵墓的高墙之外。我们用守护奥金顿的热忱守护着那些碎片。$B$B请你进入幽魂陵墓，从缚魂者X身上取回钥匙。碎片已经不再安全了。
Description.english: I know what the Bonechewer are after.$B$BAuchindoun is protected by a powerful barrier, which can only be disabled using an ancient key. No being could ever hope to penetrate it.$B$BThe Auchenai, my people, split the key into three shards long ago and hid each piece outside the mausoleum walls. We guard those shards with the same zeal as Auchindoun itself.$B$BGo into the Tomb of Souls and retrieve the key from Soulbinder X. The shards are no longer safe.

CompletionLog.text: 回塔拉多的奥金顿北门找缚魂者尼娅米。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Soulbinder Nyami at the Auchindoun North Gate in Talador.

identity.title: Follow Spirit
identity.objectives: xxxxx
identity.description: xxxx

identity.title: Bonus Objective: Kill Grimfrost Ogres
identity.description: Free the Frostwolves being held by the Grimfrost ogres.

Title.text: 奖励目标：消灭肃霜食人魔

Description.text: 释放被肃霜食人魔囚禁的霜狼。
Description.english: Free the Frostwolves being held by the Grimfrost ogres.

identity.title: Vignette: Yaga the Scarred
identity.objectives: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
identity.description: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.

Description.text: 鬣蜥人是危险的敌人，尤其是在他们人多势众的时候，更别说我们身边还跟着一个没用的瞎眼老萨满。$b$b幸运的是，他们都很短命。而不幸的是，他们繁衍很快，生长更快。$b$b如果我们想要完成这个任务，就得找到巢母。消灭她和她的卵，就能令鬣蜥人的攻势放缓。去检查一下熔炉之门附近的洞穴吧，我会尽量不让他们发现德雷克塔尔的气味。

identity.title: Tearing Up Talador
identity.description: Commander, we have a bit of a problem.$b$bWe found a location in Talador to set up an outpost but the team that was sent to begin construction have been arguing with each other on what to build. This situation could really put a setback in our plans unless it's dealt with swiftly.$b$bTake a gryphon to Talador and speak with Foreman Eksos before this gets any worse.

Description.text: 指挥官，我们遇到了点麻烦。$b$b我们在塔拉多找到了适合建立哨站的位置，但派去开工的队伍却一直在为建造什么而争论不休。除非立刻解决，否则这种局面会严重阻碍我们的计划。$b$b骑乘狮鹫前往塔拉多，在情况进一步恶化前与监工艾克索斯谈一谈。
Description.english: Commander, we have a bit of a problem.$b$bWe found a location in Talador to set up an outpost but the team that was sent to begin construction have been arguing with each other on what to build. This situation could really put a setback in our plans unless it's dealt with swiftly.$b$bTake a gryphon to Talador and speak with Foreman Eksos before this gets any worse.

identity.title: REUSE
identity.objectives: Slay Hurkan Skullsplinter in the Seat of Depravity.
identity.description: Teron'gor and his master Gul'dan were here! I tried to stop them... they escaped through the demonic gateway behind me before I could finish them!$B$BI think I can activate the portal open just long enough for you to enter. We have no way of knowing where it leads, but I fear it may end inside Auchindoun!$B$BYou have to stop him once and for all!

Objectives.text: 在堕落之座消灭胡尔坎·裂颅。
Objectives.english: Slay Hurkan Skullsplinter in the Seat of Depravity.

Description.text: 塔隆戈尔和他的主子古尔丹到这来了！我想要拦住他们……可他们在我得手前从我身后的恶魔传送门逃走了！$B$B我想我能确保那道传送门开启，好让你进去。我们没办法查出传送门是通往哪里的，但我担心另一端连接着奥金顿！$B$B你必须彻底阻止他！
Description.english: Teron'gor and his master Gul'dan were here! I tried to stop them... they escaped through the demonic gateway behind me before I could finish them!$B$BI think I can activate the portal open just long enough for you to enter. We have no way of knowing where it leads, but I fear it may end inside Auchindoun!$B$BYou have to stop him once and for all!

CompletionLog.text: 到堕落之座找大主教玛拉达尔谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Exarch Maladaar in the Seat of Depravity.

identity.title: Just the Beginning
identity.objectives: Speak to Durotan in Talador.
identity.description: I forgive Orgrim. He acted as well all must - we do what our hearts tell us is right.$B$BWe should return to your outpost and discuss our next course of action. There is nothing left for us here.$B$BI will ask the human to open a portal for us. We shall speak again there.

Objectives.text: 到塔拉多爾和杜洛坦交談。
Objectives.english: Speak to Durotan in Talador.

Description.text: 我原諒奧格林。他做的是他認為必要的事，而我們跟隨的是自己內心的聲音。$B$B我們應該回你的要塞，討論下一步該怎麼做。我們在這裡的任務都完成了。$B$B我會請人類幫我們打開一道傳送門。我們回去再談。
Description.english: I forgive Orgrim. He acted as well all must - we do what our hearts tell us is right.$B$BWe should return to your outpost and discuss our next course of action. There is nothing left for us here.$B$BI will ask the human to open a portal for us. We shall speak again there.

identity.title: Blood Oath of Lokra
identity.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
identity.description: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?

Objectives.text: 接受剑圣纳什拉的血誓。
Objectives.english: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.

Description.text: 你帮了我一个大忙。这柄利刃既是你的也是我的。$b$b我要为你送上这个血誓：我愿助你一臂之力，把我掌握的利刃和采矿方面的知识都贡献给你的军队。$b$B你愿意接受吗？
Description.english: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?

identity.title: Altar Altercation
identity.description: Save the prisoners from the Altar.$b$b[NOTE: THIS QUEST WILL GET SIGNIFICANT REVAMP ONCE WE GET THE ALTAR IN]

identity.title: Fish Fight
identity.objectives: Find a local fisherman that can help our cause.
identity.description: We have an accessible fishing spot here, but no bait seems to work!  We need to find a local fisherman with some knowledge of the area to help us out.  Think you are up to the task?

Objectives.text: 找到一位能够帮助我们的当地渔夫。
Objectives.english: Find a local fisherman that can help our cause.

Description.text: 我们这有个适合垂钓的钓鱼地点，但好像用什么鱼饵都钓不上鱼来！我们得找个熟悉情况的当地渔夫来帮忙。你觉得你能完成任务吗？
Description.english: We have an accessible fishing spot here, but no bait seems to work!  We need to find a local fisherman with some knowledge of the area to help us out.  Think you are up to the task?

CompletionLog.text: 回你的要塞找马克金。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Mak'jin at your Garrison.

identity.title: Loola's Lost Love
identity.objectives: Search Loose Mud for Old Loola's husband.
identity.description: Oh it was horrible.$b$bMy husband and I were fishing in the marsh, I fell asleep and when I woke up he had been turned into a toad!$b$bI'm sure it was one of those Shadowmoon orcs I hear so much about.$b$bHe jumped into the muddy waters before I could catch him.$b$bWill you help me find my lost love, $c?

Progress.text: 根据我对我丈夫的了解，他此刻很可能正在冬眠。你能检查下沼泽里的松软泥土，找找他吗？
Progress.english: Based on what I know about my husband, he is probably hibernating at the moment. Can you check the soft soil in the swamp and find him?

identity.objectives: Return the Iron Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
identity.description: Now that you have gathered all of the cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."  You have heard that the entrance to this faire appears near Mulgore and Goldshire every month.

Objectives.text: 当暗月马戏团来到镇上的时候，把钢铁套牌交给他们。
Objectives.english: Return the Iron Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.

Description.text: 你现在已经收集到了套牌的所有卡片，与前8张的背面图案完全一样的第9张卡片神秘地出现在你手中。在这张卡片上写着，“将这些卡片拿到暗月马戏团去，你就将获得奖励。”你听说每个月暗月马戏团的入口都会出现在莫高雷和闪金镇。

CompletionLog.text: 去找萨杜斯·帕雷教授。
