identity.title: Iron Horde Orders
identity.objectives: Look for weaponization orders at the Iron Horde camp in Crushfang's End.
identity.description: Spirit spotted some orders at the Iron Horde camp on the nearby bluff. You must have missed them when you were there. Could you look into it?

Objectives.text: 在碎牙之殁的钢铁部落营地中寻找武器装配员的命令。
Objectives.english: Look for weaponization orders at the Iron Horde camp in Crushfang's End.

Description.text: 灵魂在附近峭壁上的钢铁部落营地里发现了一些命令书。你在那的时候肯定没发现。能去调查一下吗？
Description.english: Spirit spotted some orders at the Iron Horde camp on the nearby bluff. You must have missed them when you were there. Could you look into it?

identity.title: Firing the Mayor
identity.objectives: Kill Mayor Nurg Boltsnap.
identity.description: The bottle has a large stopper in it with the label "Property of Mayor Nurg Boltsnap."$b$bAs you gaze at the bottle you hear the sound of heavy machinery coming from the nearby marshland. $b$bAn investigation would be prudent. If the mayor has turned he will also need to be put down.

Objectives.text: 杀死镇长努格·折箭
Objectives.english: Kill Mayor Nurg Boltsnap.

Description.text: 这瓶子有着一个巨大的瓶塞，上面写着“镇长努格·折箭的财产”。$B$B当你注视着这个瓶子时，你听到附近的沼泽地里传来了重型机械的轰鸣声。$B$B你有必要去那里查探一下，假如镇长被感染了，那么他同样需要被消灭。
Description.english: The bottle has a large stopper in it with the label "Property of Mayor Nurg Boltsnap."$b$bAs you gaze at the bottle you hear the sound of heavy machinery coming from the nearby marshland. $b$bAn investigation would be prudent. If the mayor has turned he will also need to be put down.

CompletionLog.text: 回风险海湾找利维特·急刹。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Rivett Clutchpop in Venture Cove.

identity.title: Firing the Mayor
identity.objectives: Kill Mayor Nurg Boltsnap.
identity.description: Ever since this zombie outbreak began I haven't seen the mayor at all. If he is infected then we could be in for a huge problem if he can escape out of town. Damn, we could be in for another zombie outbreak even!$b$bWe got to find him and make sure he doesn't escape! He used to ride in his custom shredder down on the shore line before the fungus started covering up everything. You might find him down there.

Objectives.text: 杀死镇长努格·折箭
Objectives.english: Kill Mayor Nurg Boltsnap.

Description.text: 自从僵尸疫情爆发以后，我就没见过镇长了。假如他也被感染了而且跑出了镇子，那可就要出大事了。再爆发一次僵尸疫情我们可遭不住！$B$B我们必须尽快找到他，别让他跑出镇子！在疫情爆发前，他曾经在海岸边操作他自己组装的伐木机。你也许能在那找到他。
Description.english: Ever since this zombie outbreak began I haven't seen the mayor at all. If he is infected then we could be in for a huge problem if he can escape out of town. Damn, we could be in for another zombie outbreak even!$b$bWe got to find him and make sure he doesn't escape! He used to ride in his custom shredder down on the shore line before the fungus started covering up everything. You might find him down there.

CompletionLog.text: 回风险海湾找利维特·急刹。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Rivett Clutchpop in Venture Cove.

identity.title: The Bounty of Bladespire
identity.objectives: Take your share of the plunder from Durotan's chest.
identity.description:
The sacking of this fortress is as much your victory as ours. It is only fair you should share in the bounty.

I had the men prepare a chest for you. Take what you will.

Objectives.text: 从杜隆坦的箱子里拿走你的那份战利品。
Objectives.english: Take your share of the plunder from Durotan's chest.

Description.text:
能夺下这座要塞有你的一半功劳。因此我觉得你也有资格瓜分这里的财宝。

我让人给你准备了一个箱子。你想要什么就拿什么。
Description.english:
The sacking of this fortress is as much your victory as ours. It is only fair you should share in the bounty.

I had the men prepare a chest for you. Take what you will.

CompletionLog.text: 与杜隆坦交谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak to Durotan.

identity.title: Tainted Garden
identity.objectives: Kill Stonetooth in the Garrison Mine.
identity.description: The abandonded mine shaft has been overrun with Goren!  They seem to be responding to commands from a big one further down in the mine.  If you can take him out, the rest will probably retreat.$b$bOnce you have those Goren cleared out, we can get that mine up and working!

Objectives.text: 除掉要塞矿井里的石牙。
Objectives.english: Kill Stonetooth in the Garrison Mine.

Description.text: 这座废弃的矿坑被鬣蜥人给占领了！他们的头领似乎是矿井深处的一个大块头。假如你能把他干掉，剩下的鬣蜥人可能就会作鸟兽散了。$B$B只要这些鬣蜥人不在，我们就能让这座矿井重新运作起来。
Description.english: The abandonded mine shaft has been overrun with Goren!  They seem to be responding to commands from a big one further down in the mine.  If you can take him out, the rest will probably retreat.$b$bOnce you have those Goren cleared out, we can get that mine up and working!

identity.title: What Happened Here?
identity.objectives: Search for one of Bryan Finn's Schematics.
identity.description: Dis architect's spirit not be wantin' to fight us. Maybe we can break da haze over his mind and find out what happened.$B$BI bet one of da undead peasants has one of his schematics or somethin' we can show to him to clear his mind.$B$BIt be worth a shot.

Objectives.text: 找来一份布莱恩·费恩的图纸。
Objectives.english: Search for one of Bryan Finn's Schematics.

Description.text: 这名建筑师的灵魂没有主动攻击我们。或许我们能破除笼罩他神智的迷雾，让他告诉我们这里发生了什么。$B$B我猜这里这些亡灵农夫的身上可能带着他的设计图纸之类的东西，可以拿去给他看，以便他恢复神智。$B$B我认为这值得一试。
Description.english: Dis architect's spirit not be wantin' to fight us. Maybe we can break da haze over his mind and find out what happened.$B$BI bet one of da undead peasants has one of his schematics or somethin' we can show to him to clear his mind.$B$BIt be worth a shot.

CompletionLog.text: 回海军上将泰勒的要塞找暗影猎手乌卡比。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Shadow Hunter Ujambe in Admiral Taylor's Garrison.

identity.title: Through The Nether
identity.objectives: Travel to the Twisting Nether.
identity.description: The void rituals have been disrupted, but dark energy still flows into the nether beacons at the ritual sites. This can only mean that the beacons are being powered from within the Twisting Nether itself.$b$bThe only way to sever the flow of void energy to the beacons is to travel into the Twisting Nether and stop whatever power lurks there!$b$bUse a beacon to travel to the Twisting Nether. Once there, us the shaman stone given to us by the furies to contact me.$b$bLight be with you.

Objectives.text: 进入扭曲虚空。
Objectives.english: Travel to the Twisting Nether.

Description.text: 虚空仪式被阻止了，可黑暗能量仍在不断地流入各个仪式场的虚空道标之中。这只能有一个原因：这些道标的能量是由扭曲虚空直接供给的。$B$B切断这些虚空能量流的唯一方法就只有进入扭曲虚空，然后消除潜伏在那里的能量！$B$B使用那边的道标进入扭曲虚空。一旦你到了那里，就使用元素之怒赐给我们的萨满之石来联系我。$B$B愿圣光与你同在。
Description.english: The void rituals have been disrupted, but dark energy still flows into the nether beacons at the ritual sites. This can only mean that the beacons are being powered from within the Twisting Nether itself.$b$bThe only way to sever the flow of void energy to the beacons is to travel into the Twisting Nether and stop whatever power lurks there!$b$bUse a beacon to travel to the Twisting Nether. Once there, us the shaman stone given to us by the furies to contact me.$b$bLight be with you.

identity.title: The Void March
identity.objectives: Destroy $oa Void Creatures.
identity.description: Legions of void terrors are marching upon Oshu'gun and sacrificing themselves to the void lord Invalidus.$b$bAs they die Invalidus grows stronger. It is as if the lesser creatures only serve to feed the void lord.$b$bWe must stop Invalidus from becoming so powerful that it cannot be stopped.$b$bSlay as many void monsters as you can, to slow the growth of Invalidus. In the meantime, I will search for a way to encounter Invalidus before it is too late to stop it.

Description.text: 虚空恐魔的大军正向着沃舒古汇聚，并一一将它们的身躯奉献给虚空领主伊瓦里杜斯。每当那些虚空恐魔死亡，伊瓦里杜斯就会变得更加强大。那些下级的生物似乎纯粹是为了被虚空领主吞噬而存在的。$B$B伊瓦里杜斯的力量正在不断增强，我们必须趁在还能阻止它的时候将它消灭。$B$B尽可能地杀死那些虚空怪物以减缓伊瓦里杜斯的成长速度。我会尽快想出一个能与伊瓦里杜斯作战的方法。
Description.english: Legions of void terrors are marching upon Oshu'gun and sacrificing themselves to the void lord Invalidus.$b$bAs they die Invalidus grows stronger. It is as if the lesser creatures only serve to feed the void lord.$b$bWe must stop Invalidus from becoming so powerful that it cannot be stopped.$b$bSlay as many void monsters as you can, to slow the growth of Invalidus. In the meantime, I will search for a way to encounter Invalidus before it is too late to stop it.

identity.title: Silence The Call
identity.objectives: Slay the Warsong ritual leaders.
identity.description: The Warsong shaman are using the elements to channel dark energy from the void.$b$bI am no shaman, but even I know that such practices are abhored by most orc clans. The power of the void is opposite to the Light, and a source of entropy and destruction.$b$bThese rituals thin the veil between our world and the Twisting Nether. Should the rituals continue, this land will soon be overrun by the denizens of the Twisting Nether.$b$bSlay the shaman leading these dark rituals before destruction falls upon us!

Objectives.text: 杀死所有的战歌仪式领袖。
Objectives.english: Slay the Warsong ritual leaders.

Description.text: 战歌萨满正使用元素之力来引导虚空能量。$B$B我虽然不是萨满，但也知道这种行为在大多数兽人氏族里是被禁止的。虚空之力是圣光的反面，是无序和毁灭的根源。$B$B这些仪式会削弱扭曲虚空与这个世界之间的壁障。要是不阻止这些仪式的话，这片土地很快就会被扭曲虚空的住民所填满。$B$B杀死那些主持这些黑暗仪式的萨满，迟了的话，毁灭就会降临到我们的头上。
Description.english: The Warsong shaman are using the elements to channel dark energy from the void.$b$bI am no shaman, but even I know that such practices are abhored by most orc clans. The power of the void is opposite to the Light, and a source of entropy and destruction.$b$bThese rituals thin the veil between our world and the Twisting Nether. Should the rituals continue, this land will soon be overrun by the denizens of the Twisting Nether.$b$bSlay the shaman leading these dark rituals before destruction falls upon us!

identity.title: The Shadow Over Oshu'gun
identity.objectives: Summon and defeat Invalidus.
identity.description: The void lord Invalidus stands atop the peak of Oshu'gun gorging itself upon the souls of the dead.$b$bEven the fallen void terrors that you slew only served to feed the monster.$b$bIf we do not act now, Invalidus will grow too powerful to encounter alone.$b$bAt each of the ritual sites in the Twisting Nether, there is a crystal filled with the powers of the void. Disturb the void crystal and Invalidus will sense your presence.$b$bBe ready, Invalidus will waste no time in attempting to feed on your soul.

Objectives.text: 召唤并击败伊瓦里杜斯。
Objectives.english: Summon and defeat Invalidus.

Description.text: 虚空领主伊瓦里杜斯在沃舒古的山顶上吸食着亡者的灵魂。$B$B甚至那些死去的虚空恐魔也成为了它的食粮。$B$B我们必须立刻行动，否则这个怪物会变得越来越强大，让我们无法应付了。$B$B在扭曲虚空中的每一处仪式场地上，都有一颗充满了虚空能量的水晶。只要触碰这种水晶，伊瓦里杜斯就会注意到你的存在。$B$B准备好，伊瓦里杜斯会第一时间试图吸食你的灵魂。
Description.english: The void lord Invalidus stands atop the peak of Oshu'gun gorging itself upon the souls of the dead.$b$bEven the fallen void terrors that you slew only served to feed the monster.$b$bIf we do not act now, Invalidus will grow too powerful to encounter alone.$b$bAt each of the ritual sites in the Twisting Nether, there is a crystal filled with the powers of the void. Disturb the void crystal and Invalidus will sense your presence.$b$bBe ready, Invalidus will waste no time in attempting to feed on your soul.

identity.title: Disrupt The Rituals
identity.objectives: Destroy the Ritual Totems.
identity.description: Beneath the mountain of Oshu'gun the Warsong perform dark rituals.$b$bThe Warsong shaman seek to empower their clan by drawing upon a great source of void energy within the heart of Oshu'gun.$b$bThough I do not know for certain the source of this power...I fear that the dying naaru K'ure may be involved.$b$bThe Warsong rituals must be stopped or the veil that separates this world from the Twisting Nether will be ripped apart.$b$bLocate the ritual totems used to channel these rituals and destroy them.

Objectives.text: 摧毁仪式图腾。
Objectives.english: Destroy the Ritual Totems.

Description.text: 战歌兽人在沃舒古的山脚下进行着黑暗的仪式。$B$B战歌萨满意图从圣山的中心吸取虚空能量来强化他们的氏族。$B$B我并不了解这虚空能量的源头……但这恐怕与飞船中濒死的纳鲁克乌雷有关。$B$B我们必须阻止这些战歌仪祭师，否则这个世界与扭曲虚空之间屏障将被撕裂。$B$B找到他们用来维持仪式的仪式图腾，并摧毁它们。
Description.english: Beneath the mountain of Oshu'gun the Warsong perform dark rituals.$b$bThe Warsong shaman seek to empower their clan by drawing upon a great source of void energy within the heart of Oshu'gun.$b$bThough I do not know for certain the source of this power...I fear that the dying naaru K'ure may be involved.$b$bThe Warsong rituals must be stopped or the veil that separates this world from the Twisting Nether will be ripped apart.$b$bLocate the ritual totems used to channel these rituals and destroy them.

identity.title: The Nether Approaches
identity.objectives: Collapse $oa Void Portals.
identity.description: By drawing upon the power of the void, the Warsong have thinned the veil that shields our world from the Twisting Nether.$b$bPortals are opening within the nether that threaten to connect the terrors of the void to Draenor.$b$bShould these portals fully open, the path will be clear for all manner of demons and void creatures to rampage across Nagrand.$b$bGo and collapse the portals before they become functional!

Description.text: 战歌氏族吸取虚空能量的愚行削弱了我们的世界和扭曲虚空之间的壁障。$B$B扭曲虚空中正不断有传送门在打开，意图将虚空的怪物们引往德拉诺。$B$B一旦这些传送门彻底开始运作，各种各样的恶魔和虚空怪物将席卷纳格兰。$B$B快趁这些传送门还没开始运作前摧毁它们！
Description.english: By drawing upon the power of the void, the Warsong have thinned the veil that shields our world from the Twisting Nether.$b$bPortals are opening within the nether that threaten to connect the terrors of the void to Draenor.$b$bShould these portals fully open, the path will be clear for all manner of demons and void creatures to rampage across Nagrand.$b$bGo and collapse the portals before they become functional!

identity.title: Writing in the Snow
identity.objectives: Deliver the tattered journal page to Rokhan in your garrison.
identity.description: This is a worn page from Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja's journal. It appears to be a sketch of the entrance of the Bloodmaul Slave Mines. Rokhan, in your garrison, would be very interested in this.

Objectives.text: 把被撕烂的日志交给你要塞中的洛坎。
Objectives.english: Deliver the tattered journal page to Rokhan in your garrison.

Description.text: 这张破旧的纸出自暗影猎手布加的日志。上面似乎画着血槌奴隶矿井入口的草图。你的要塞中的洛坎会对这个感兴趣的。
Description.english: This is a worn page from Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja's journal. It appears to be a sketch of the entrance of the Bloodmaul Slave Mines. Rokhan, in your garrison, would be very interested in this.

CompletionLog.text: 回你的要塞找洛坎。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Rokhan in your Garrison.

identity.title: Trophy of Glory: Sodius
identity.objectives: Take the trophy to <ARENA NPC NAME> at <HORDE OUTPOST> in Gorgrond.
identity.description: Defeating Erosian has yielded you a trophy worthy of showing off at your gladiatorial arena. $b$bReturn this to <ARENA NPC NAME> to increase your glory!

Objectives.text: 帶著戰利品到格古隆德的<部落哨站>找<ARENA NPC NAME>。
Objectives.english: Take the trophy to <ARENA NPC NAME> at <HORDE OUTPOST> in Gorgrond.

identity.title: Trophy of Glory: Sodius
identity.objectives: Take the trophy to Durotan at <HORDE OUTPOST> in Gorgrond.
identity.description: Defeating Sodius has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.$b$bTake this to Durotan at <HORDE OUTPOST>.

Objectives.text: 帶著戰利品到格古隆德的<部落哨站>找杜洛坦。
Objectives.english: Take the trophy to Durotan at <HORDE OUTPOST> in Gorgrond.

identity.title: Peckers the Majestic
identity.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
identity.description: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?

Objectives.text: 接受剑圣纳什拉的血誓。
Objectives.english: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.

Description.text: 你帮了我一个大忙。这柄利刃既是我的也是你的。$b$b我要向你发下血誓：我愿助你一臂之力，把我掌握的利刃和采矿方面的知识都贡献给你的军队。$b$B你愿意接受吗？
Description.english: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?

identity.title: Khadgar's Task
identity.objectives: Speak with Khadgar within his tower in Zangarra.
identity.description: This world poses many dangers to our own. Chief among them is the Iron Horde - your garrison and the full might of your army is directed at this foe. But for myself I have a different target in mind.$b$bGul'dan.$b$bHere, make yourself comfortable. Have some mana strudel. I will share my plan as I create your ring...

Objectives.text: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Khadgar within his tower in Zangarra.

Description.text: 这个世界对我们的世界造成了许多威胁。其中最首要的自然是钢铁部落——你的要塞和你的军队正在全力对抗这个敌人。但就我个人而言，我还有另外一个目标。$B$B古尔丹。$B$B过来坐一下，尝点魔法点心。我会在帮你制造指环时，告诉你我的计划……
Description.english: This world poses many dangers to our own. Chief among them is the Iron Horde - your garrison and the full might of your army is directed at this foe. But for myself I have a different target in mind.$b$bGul'dan.$b$bHere, make yourself comfortable. Have some mana strudel. I will share my plan as I create your ring...

identity.title: Eyes of the Archmage
identity.objectives: Speak with Khadgar and guard him as he performs his scrying spell.
identity.description: With the blood of Teron'gor and the crystals you collected for me, I should be able to zero in on our target. Step outside with me and I will begin my scrying spell. Speak with me to start - be ready for anything!

Objectives.text: 与卡德加交谈，并在他施放占卜法术时保护他。
Objectives.english: Speak with Khadgar and guard him as he performs his scrying spell.

Description.text: 有了塔隆戈尔的鲜血和你帮我找来的水晶，我应该就能对准我们的目标了。跟我一起到外面去，我要开始施放占卜法术了。跟我交谈来开始这个法术——做好应对一切的准备！
Description.english: With the blood of Teron'gor and the crystals you collected for me, I should be able to zero in on our target. Step outside with me and I will begin my scrying spell. Speak with me to start - be ready for anything!

CompletionLog.text: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

identity.title: Tarnished Bronze
identity.objectives: Speak to Archmage Khadgar to choose your preferred role, and defeat the Spirit of Kairozdormu.
identity.description: That dead dragon's essence has seeped into the very fabric of this light-forsaken world. His spirit is also restless. If you and I are to claim what remains of his power, we're going to need to finish the job that Garrosh started.$b$bI'm going to need to rely on your tactical combat expertise, commander. Would you prefer to go on the offensive, to fight defensively, or to heal us?$b$bThe decision is yours. Speak to me when you are ready, and the three of us will destroy Kairoz once and for all.

Objectives.text: 与大法师卡德加交谈来选择你想要担任的角色，并击败凯诺兹多姆之魂。
Objectives.english: Speak to Archmage Khadgar to choose your preferred role, and defeat the Spirit of Kairozdormu.

Description.text: 那条死去龙的精华渗入到了这个被光明遗弃世界的每个角落。他的灵魂同样无法安宁。如果你跟我想要将他剩下的力量占为己有的话，就需要完成加尔鲁什未完成的工作。$b$b我得依靠一下你的战术天赋，指挥官。你希望负责攻击还是防御？还是负责治疗我们呢？$b$b由你自己来做决定吧。等你准备好就来找我谈谈，我们三个人将会彻底消灭凯诺兹。
Description.english: That dead dragon's essence has seeped into the very fabric of this light-forsaken world. His spirit is also restless. If you and I are to claim what remains of his power, we're going to need to finish the job that Garrosh started.$b$bI'm going to need to rely on your tactical combat expertise, commander. Would you prefer to go on the offensive, to fight defensively, or to heal us?$b$bThe decision is yours. Speak to me when you are ready, and the three of us will destroy Kairoz once and for all.

identity.title: Fugitive Dragon
identity.objectives: Meet with Khadgar north of the Ring of Trials in Nagrand.
identity.description: Ready to do some dragon hunting? A bronze dragon freed Garrosh Hellscream and took him to this world. His name is  Kairozdormu, and he's a fugitive from Azeroth. It's time to track him down.$b$bHis essence permeates this entire timeline. If I could just get a hold of him - dead or alive! - I could re-calibrate my magic to this era of Draenor.$b$bWe'll need the help of a fellow bronze dragon. I'll find her and meet you in Nagrand. Let's rendezvous at the crossroads north of the Ring of Trials.

Objectives.text: 在纳格兰的试炼竞技场北边与卡德加会面。
Objectives.english: Meet with Khadgar north of the Ring of Trials in Nagrand.

Description.text: 做好猎龙的准备了吗？一只青铜龙释放了加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮，并把他带到了这个世界。这只龙名叫凯诺兹多姆，是艾泽拉斯的逃亡者。现在是时候去会会他了。$b$b他的精华弥漫在整个时间线之中。要是我能抓住他的话——甭管是死是活——我都会重新校准我的魔法，使其适应德拉诺的这一纪元。$b$b我们需要某只青铜龙的帮助。我会找到她，然后去纳格兰找你。让我们在试炼竞技场北边的十字路口处会合吧。
Description.english: Ready to do some dragon hunting? A bronze dragon freed Garrosh Hellscream and took him to this world. His name is  Kairozdormu, and he's a fugitive from Azeroth. It's time to track him down.$b$bHis essence permeates this entire timeline. If I could just get a hold of him - dead or alive! - I could re-calibrate my magic to this era of Draenor.$b$bWe'll need the help of a fellow bronze dragon. I'll find her and meet you in Nagrand. Let's rendezvous at the crossroads north of the Ring of Trials.

CompletionLog.text: 在纳格兰的试炼竞技场北边与卡德加会面。
CompletionLog.english: Meet with Khadgar north of the Ring of Trials in Nagrand.

identity.title: Power Unleashed
identity.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra, and allow him to upgrade your ring.
identity.description: You've more than earned a reward, commander. I'll wrap things up here and meet you back at my tower - you can use my portal as a shortcut.$b$bSpeak to me when you arrive and I will use Kairoz's power with the crystals you gathered earlier to upgrade your ring!

Objectives.text: 在赞加拉卡德加的法师塔里与大法师卡德加谈一谈，并让他升级你的戒指。
Objectives.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra, and allow him to upgrade your ring.

Description.text: 你不仅获得了一份奖励而已，指挥官。等我结束这里的工作后就回我的法师塔找你——你可以用我的传送门走捷径。$b$b到了之后找我谈谈，我会用凯诺兹的力量和你之前找来的水晶，来升级你的戒指！
Description.english: You've more than earned a reward, commander. I'll wrap things up here and meet you back at my tower - you can use my portal as a shortcut.$b$bSpeak to me when you arrive and I will use Kairoz's power with the crystals you gathered earlier to upgrade your ring!

identity.title: The Scrying Game
identity.objectives: Speak with Khadgar and locate Gul'dan with his scrying spell.
identity.description: We've learned everything we need from the ogres, $n. Thanks to your efforts, I believe I can pierce the veil of secrecy that's cloaking Gul'dan.$b$bI WILL find him, $c.$b$bOnce my spell is finished we should be ready to leap into action. I won't begin until you let me know you're ready.

Objectives.text: 与卡德加交谈，并用他的占卜法术找到古尔丹。
Objectives.english: Speak with Khadgar and locate Gul'dan with his scrying spell.

Description.text: 我们已经掌握了需要从食人魔那里了解到的一切，$n。多亏你的努力，我想我可以刺穿笼罩古尔丹的那层神秘面纱了。$b$b我一定会找到他的，$c。$b$b等我的法术完成后，我们应该就能展开行动了。我会等你做好准备再开始。
Description.english: We've learned everything we need from the ogres, $n. Thanks to your efforts, I believe I can pierce the veil of secrecy that's cloaking Gul'dan.$b$bI WILL find him, $c.$b$bOnce my spell is finished we should be ready to leap into action. I won't begin until you let me know you're ready.

identity.title: Hunter: Hunted
identity.objectives: Follow Garona's trail into the Zangarra lowlands. Find, defeat, and capture her.
identity.description: The weapon that stabbed the archmage was imbued with fel magic. He's slowly being poisoned!$b$b$n, we don't have any time. Khadgar will be dead in minutes. I need you to track down Garona before she gets away - find that murder weapon and maybe we can find a cure!$b$bFollow the traces of fel energy she left behind. Track her down into the Zangarra lowlands and capture her with this Violet Hold Incarceration rune.$b$bHurry!

Objectives.text: 跟随迦罗娜的踪迹进入赞加拉的低洼地带。找到她并将其击败，然后抓住她。
Objectives.english: Follow Garona's trail into the Zangarra lowlands. Find, defeat, and capture her.

Description.text: 刺伤大法师的那把武器上灌注了邪能魔法。毒素正在慢慢侵入他的身体！$b$b$n，我们没时间了。卡德加过不了几分钟就会死去。我要你在迦罗娜逃走前追上她——找到她那把用来谋杀卡德加的武器，也许就能找到疗法！$b$b沿着她留在身后的邪能踪迹。跟随她进入赞加拉的低洼地带，用这块紫罗兰监狱的监禁符文抓住她。$b$b赶快！
Description.english: The weapon that stabbed the archmage was imbued with fel magic. He's slowly being poisoned!$b$b$n, we don't have any time. Khadgar will be dead in minutes. I need you to track down Garona before she gets away - find that murder weapon and maybe we can find a cure!$b$bFollow the traces of fel energy she left behind. Track her down into the Zangarra lowlands and capture her with this Violet Hold Incarceration rune.$b$bHurry!

identity.title: Touch of the Kirin-Tor
identity.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar to upgrade your ring.
identity.description: <Khadgar's breathing is labored and his face is drained of color, but his eyes still flash with energy.>$b$bYou saved me, $n. Once again I underestimated Gul'dan, and it nearly cost me everything.$b$bCome, help me up. While Jaina is here, the two of us can work together to upgrade your ring. You've earned it! Let me know when you're ready.

Objectives.text: 与大法师卡德加交谈来升级你的指环。
Objectives.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar to upgrade your ring.

Description.text: <卡德加的呼吸变得急促，脸色青白，可双目仍然炯炯有神。>$b$b是你救了我，$n。我又一次低估了古尔丹，而那几乎让我一败涂地。$b$b来，帮我站起来。趁吉安娜在，我们俩可以合力升级你的指环。这是你应得的！等你准备好就跟我说一声吧。
Description.english: <Khadgar's breathing is labored and his face is drained of color, but his eyes still flash with energy.>$b$bYou saved me, $n. Once again I underestimated Gul'dan, and it nearly cost me everything.$b$bCome, help me up. While Jaina is here, the two of us can work together to upgrade your ring. You've earned it! Let me know when you're ready.

identity.title: Heart of the Fury
identity.objectives: Collect a Heart of the Fury from the elemental Fury encased within the furnace of the Blackrock Foundry.
identity.description: It is foolish to pursue Gul'dan with magical means alone. But thanks to you we have a prisoner: Garona. If we can break Gul'dan's mind-control over her, we will learn all his secrets.$b$bI can do it, but I'll need some powerful spell components.$b$bFirst on the list is the heart of an elemental fury. There's one imprisoned in the center of the Blackrock Foundry. Fight your way in, destroy the furnace, and slay the elemental within.

Objectives.text: 从黑石铸造厂熔炉里的元素之怒身上取得一颗愤怒之心。
Objectives.english: Collect a Heart of the Fury from the elemental Fury encased within the furnace of the Blackrock Foundry.

Description.text: 光用魔法手段去追击古尔丹是愚蠢的。但幸好有你帮忙，我们现在有了一名俘虏——迦罗娜。如果我们能打破古尔丹对她的精神控制，就能弄清他所有的秘密了。$b$b我可以完成这件事，但我需要一些强大的魔法材料。$b$b首先要用到的是元素之怒的心。在黑石铸造厂的中央区域就囚禁着这样一位元素之怒。到里面去破坏熔炉，然后消灭里面的元素吧。
Description.english: It is foolish to pursue Gul'dan with magical means alone. But thanks to you we have a prisoner: Garona. If we can break Gul'dan's mind-control over her, we will learn all his secrets.$b$bI can do it, but I'll need some powerful spell components.$b$bFirst on the list is the heart of an elemental fury. There's one imprisoned in the center of the Blackrock Foundry. Fight your way in, destroy the furnace, and slay the elemental within.

identity.title: Flamebender's Tome
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Flamebender's Tome from Flamebender Ka'graz in the Blackrock Foundry.
identity.description: The Iron Horde, and the Burning Blade clan in particular, have forged a unique relationship with Draenor's ancient elementals. They can work with iron and flame in ways that even I don't fully understand.$b$bYet.$b$b$n, slay the Burning Blade's highest-ranking artisan: Flamebender Ka'graz. She is down in the very heart of the Black Forge of the Blackrock Foundry, an area known as the Burning Font. If we're lucky, her secrets are codified in a Flamebender's Tome.

Objectives.text: 从黑石铸造厂的缚火者卡格拉兹身上找到缚火者宝典。
Objectives.english: Retrieve the Flamebender's Tome from Flamebender Ka'graz in the Blackrock Foundry.

Description.text: 钢铁部落——尤其是火刃氏族，跟德拉诺的古老元素建立起了独特的联系。他们驾驭钢铁与烈火的本事连我都望尘莫及。$b$b起码现在如此。$b$b$n，去消灭火刃氏族最高级的工匠——缚火者卡格拉兹。她就在黑石铸造厂的黑色熔炉的正中央，名叫炽燃火池的地方。要是我们走运的话，可以在缚火者宝典里找到她所有的秘密。
Description.english: The Iron Horde, and the Burning Blade clan in particular, have forged a unique relationship with Draenor's ancient elementals. They can work with iron and flame in ways that even I don't fully understand.$b$bYet.$b$b$n, slay the Burning Blade's highest-ranking artisan: Flamebender Ka'graz. She is down in the very heart of the Black Forge of the Blackrock Foundry, an area known as the Burning Font. If we're lucky, her secrets are codified in a Flamebender's Tome.

identity.title: Reverse Piracy
identity.objectives: Acquire the Draenic Thaumaturgical Orb from the Dread Grotto in the Blackrock Foundry.
identity.description: $n, during the attack on Karabor Iron Horde dreadnaughts looted or sank most of the draenei eastern fleet. A priceless artifact was captured: A genuine Draenic Thaumaturgical Orb.$b$bI must have it! Those orcs don't know what they've got!$b$bMy sources indicate that the orb was aboard a ship that's being retrofitted down in the Dread Grotto beneath the Blackrock Foundry. Search the ship and the area nearby for the Sha'tari Vault that contained the orb. We've got to get it back!

Objectives.text: 从黑石锻造厂的恐惧岩洞里取得德拉诺奇迹宝珠。
Objectives.english: Acquire the Draenic Thaumaturgical Orb from the Dread Grotto in the Blackrock Foundry.

Description.text: $n，在入侵卡拉波的战斗中，钢铁部落的炮舰洗劫或击沉了德莱尼东部舰队的大部分舰船。还抢走了一件无比宝贵的神器——那是一枚真正的德拉诺奇迹宝珠。$b$b我必须拿到它！那些兽人根本不明白它的价值！$b$b据线人回报，宝珠被装到了一艘船上，船正在黑石锻造厂下方的恐惧岩洞里接受翻新。到舰船和附近的区域里展开搜索，宝珠就在沙塔尔宝箱里面。我们得把它夺回来！
Description.english: $n, during the attack on Karabor Iron Horde dreadnaughts looted or sank most of the draenei eastern fleet. A priceless artifact was captured: A genuine Draenic Thaumaturgical Orb.$b$bI must have it! Those orcs don't know what they've got!$b$bMy sources indicate that the orb was aboard a ship that's being retrofitted down in the Dread Grotto beneath the Blackrock Foundry. Search the ship and the area nearby for the Sha'tari Vault that contained the orb. We've got to get it back!

identity.title: The Unbroken Circle
identity.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar to upgrade your ring.
identity.description: Reading these tablets is like stepping back in time to the moment of Draenor's creation. There is a power here greater than any I have dealt with since I was Medivh's apprentice. I believe I can control it, but - can you handle it?$b$bIf you think you are ready, prepare yourself. Hold your ring close to your heart. I will channel pure elemental energies into it.$b$bSpeak with me to begin!

Objectives.text: 跟大法师卡德加交谈来升级你的指环。
Objectives.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar to upgrade your ring.

Description.text: 阅读这些石板上的文字，就如同穿越回了德拉诺的初生时刻。自从我当上麦迪文的学徒，都从没应对过如此巨大的力量。我有自信能够控制住它，可是——你呢？$b$b要是你认为自己准备好了，就打起精神来吧。拿起你的指环，放在贴近你心脏的位置。我会引导纯净的元素能量流进指环。$b$b跟我交谈，我们就开始了！
Description.english: Reading these tablets is like stepping back in time to the moment of Draenor's creation. There is a power here greater than any I have dealt with since I was Medivh's apprentice. I believe I can control it, but - can you handle it?$b$bIf you think you are ready, prepare yourself. Hold your ring close to your heart. I will channel pure elemental energies into it.$b$bSpeak with me to begin!

identity.title: Prisoner of the Mind
identity.objectives: Speak with Khadgar and protect him while he casts his spell on Garona.
identity.description: I'd had some time to compare the Flamebinder's tome with the elemental tablets you collected. Where it gets interesting is when I cross-reference the incantations you obtained from the ogre felbreakers... I can see I'm losing you. I will get to the point: I believe I can cast a spell that will nullify Gul'dan's mind control over his assassin Garona.$b$bMind-controlled or not, she may be dangerous, so I won't begin the spell until you're with me. Let me know when you're ready!

Objectives.text: 与卡德加交谈，并在他对迦罗娜施法时保护他。
Objectives.english: Speak with Khadgar and protect him while he casts his spell on Garona.

Description.text: 我花时间对比了缚火者宝典和你找来的那些元素石板。有趣的是，当我交叉对照你从食人魔破魔者那获得的咒语时……我感觉到我要失去你了。让我把话说明白点：我相信我能用法术破除古尔丹对他刺客迦罗娜的精神控制。$b$b但即便不受精神控制，迦罗娜也仍然是危险的，所以等你跟我一起时，我才会开始施放法术。准备好就告诉我一声吧！
Description.english: I'd had some time to compare the Flamebinder's tome with the elemental tablets you collected. Where it gets interesting is when I cross-reference the incantations you obtained from the ogre felbreakers... I can see I'm losing you. I will get to the point: I believe I can cast a spell that will nullify Gul'dan's mind control over his assassin Garona.$b$bMind-controlled or not, she may be dangerous, so I won't begin the spell until you're with me. Let me know when you're ready!

identity.title: A Hero's Welcome
identity.objectives: Speak with Farseer Drek'Thar at Glacier Bay in Frostfire Ridge.
identity.description: You have arrived in Frostfire Ridge. Farseer Drek'Thar can guide you from here.

identity.objectives: Retrieve Rulga's lost inscription papers.

Description.text: 文本
Description.english: Text

identity.title: Moving On Up
identity.objectives: Garaal has offered to further your knowledge in leatherworking.
identity.description: A generous decision, $n.$B$BYou have demonstrated your skills as a hunter, delivered a piece worthy of your name and proven your dedication to your craft. Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.$B$BMay the light guide your hand and passion, your heart.

Objectives.text: 加莱尔愿意帮你提高制皮技巧。
Objectives.english: Garaal has offered to further your knowledge in leatherworking.

Description.text: 真是个慷慨的决定，$n。$B$B你展现了身为猎人的战技，证明自己名不虚传，还彰显出对手工艺的不懈追求。请你收下我这份表达谢意的馈赠吧。$B$B愿圣光指引你的双手，沐浴你心中的热情。
Description.english: A generous decision, $n.$B$BYou have demonstrated your skills as a hunter, delivered a piece worthy of your name and proven your dedication to your craft. Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.$B$BMay the light guide your hand and passion, your heart.

CompletionLog.text: 加莱尔愿意与你分享他的德拉诺手工艺知识。
CompletionLog.english: Garaal has afforded you his knowledge of draenic craftsmanship.

identity.title: The Dragon's Tale
identity.objectives: Follow the trail of clues up the hillside until you discover Kairozdormu in the Time-Lost Glade.
identity.description: Chromie thinks she's picked up the trail. We suspect that Garrosh traveled through here when he first arrived on Draenor. But what about Kairoz? He must be close.$b$bChromie will illuminate the clues. Look for a series of temporal anomalies. Follow the trail east of here and pick your way up to the top of the mountains until we've located Kairozdormu... or his body. Good luck!

Objectives.text: 在迷时林地里沿着踪迹上山，直到找到凯诺兹多姆。
Objectives.english: Follow the trail of clues up the hillside until you discover Kairozdormu in the Time-Lost Glade.

Description.text: 克罗米认为她发现了踪迹。我们怀疑加尔鲁什在初次抵达德拉诺时曾经经过这里。可凯诺兹呢？他一定就在附近。$b$b克罗米会把线索具现出来。注意寻找一系列的时空异常情况。沿着东边的踪迹往山顶走，直到我们发现凯诺兹多姆……或者他的尸体为止。祝你好运！
Description.english: Chromie thinks she's picked up the trail. We suspect that Garrosh traveled through here when he first arrived on Draenor. But what about Kairoz? He must be close.$b$bChromie will illuminate the clues. Look for a series of temporal anomalies. Follow the trail east of here and pick your way up to the top of the mountains until we've located Kairozdormu... or his body. Good luck!

CompletionLog.text: 到纳格兰的迷时林地与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the Time-Lost Glade in Nagrand.

identity.title: A Strengthened Bond
identity.objectives: Give Axe-Shaper Kugra the Ghost-Touched Materials.
identity.description: This entire time... I have been so consumed with my own grief.$B$BI never once stopped to consider how much my father was suffering at the hands of our enemies.$B$BThank you so much $c for helping him to return to me. Please, allow me to repair his hammer.$B$BIn exchange for everything you have done for us, I will teach you whatever you wish to know.

Description.text: 这么长时间以来……我都无法平息心中的悲痛。$B$B我无时无刻不在回想，父亲当时在敌人手中遭受了怎样的折磨。$B$B谢谢你$c，是你帮他重新回到了我身边。请让我来修理他的锤子吧。$B$B为了报答你为我们所做的一切，我会知无不言地向你传授你想要了解的一切。
Description.english: This entire time... I have been so consumed with my own grief.$B$BI never once stopped to consider how much my father was suffering at the hands of our enemies.$B$BThank you so much $c for helping him to return to me. Please, allow me to repair his hammer.$B$BIn exchange for everything you have done for us, I will teach you whatever you wish to know.

identity.objectives: Hand the assistant the reagents to start your first work order from a profession building.

Objectives.english: Hand the assistant the reagents to start your first work order from a profession building.

Description.text: 既然你已经有了一座专业技能建筑，我们可以开始为你生成产品订单了。等你找到我们需要的材料就到我这里来，开始生产第一批药剂吧 。
Description.english: Now that you have a profession building, we can start producing work orders for you. When you have the ingredients we need, please come to me to start the first batch.

CompletionLog.text: 從專業建築物展開你的第一個工作令，把材料交給助手。
CompletionLog.english: Hand the assistant the reagents to start your first work order from a profession building.

identity.title: Assault on Shattrath Harbor
identity.objectives: Assault the Sargerei forces at Shattrath City in Talador.
identity.description:
Shattrath City is in the hands of Sargerei forces under the leadership of the traitor Exarch, Socrethar.

Members of the Sha'tari Defense have been requesting aid against the Shadow Council forces in the eastern portions of the city.

Objectives.text: 突袭塔拉多沙塔斯城的萨格雷军队。
Objectives.english: Assault the Sargerei forces at Shattrath City in Talador.

Description.text:
沙塔斯城现在处于萨格雷军队的控制下，他们的首领是大主教索克雷萨那个叛徒。

沙塔尔防御者的成员们请求援助，对抗沙塔斯城东部区域内的暗影议会军队。
Description.english:
Shattrath City is in the hands of Sargerei forces under the leadership of the traitor Exarch, Socrethar.

Members of the Sha'tari Defense have been requesting aid against the Shadow Council forces in the eastern portions of the city.

identity.title: Assault on Shattrath Harbor
identity.objectives: Assault the Sargerei forces at Shattrath City in Talador.
identity.description:
Shattrath City is in the hands of Sargerei forces under the leadership of the once Exarch, Socrethar.

The Shadow Council forces in the eastern portion of the city are gaining in power through the aid of demons from the Nether, and need to be culled before they become a threat to all of our operations.

Objectives.text: 突袭塔拉多沙塔斯城的萨格雷军队。
Objectives.english: Assault the Sargerei forces at Shattrath City in Talador.

Description.text:
沙塔斯城现在处于萨格雷军队的控制下，他们的首领是索克雷萨，曾经的大主教。

沙塔斯城东部区域的暗影议会军队正在虚空恶魔的帮助下壮大自己的力量，必须要在他们对我们的行动构成威胁前斩草除根。
Description.english:
Shattrath City is in the hands of Sargerei forces under the leadership of the once Exarch, Socrethar.

The Shadow Council forces in the eastern portion of the city are gaining in power through the aid of demons from the Nether, and need to be culled before they become a threat to all of our operations.

CompletionLog.text: 回你在霜火岭的要塞找暗影猎手乌卡比。

identity.title: Assault on the Iron Siegeworks
identity.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
identity.description:
Iron Horde war machines are being shipped onto battlefields by the dozens, and our forces are struggling to hold their ground. Most of these machines seem to be originating from the Iron Siegeworks in eastern Frostfire Ridge.

A strategic attack to disrupt and dismantle the Iron Horde at the siegeworks could be just what we need to turn the tide of the war.

Objectives.text: 突袭霜火岭钢铁军工厂的钢铁部落军队。
Objectives.english: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.

Description.text:
钢铁部落的战争机器正在被成批成批地运送到战场上来，而我们的军队正在死守阵线。大多数战争机器都是在霜火岭东边的钢铁军工厂里制造出来的。

如果可以对军工厂发起战略突袭，破坏并瓦解钢铁部落的行动，或许就能扭转战局。
Description.english:
Iron Horde war machines are being shipped onto battlefields by the dozens, and our forces are struggling to hold their ground. Most of these machines seem to be originating from the Iron Siegeworks in eastern Frostfire Ridge.

A strategic attack to disrupt and dismantle the Iron Horde at the siegeworks could be just what we need to turn the tide of the war.

identity.title: Assault on Magnarok
identity.objectives: Assault the stone monstrosities at Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.
identity.description:
Colossal magnaron, gronn, and other stone monstrosities have been threatening our outposts in the west. Most seem to originate from Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.

If we strike at them at their home, we should be able to force them back. It's risky, but it may be our best move. While you're there, see if you can recover any of our supplies.

Objectives.text: 攻击霜火岭玛戈纳洛克的石头怪物。
Objectives.english: Assault the stone monstrosities at Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.

Description.text:
巨大的玛戈隆、戈隆还有其它石头怪物一直威胁着我们西边哨站的安全。它们大多数都是从霜火岭的玛戈纳洛克来的。

如果我们突袭它们的老巢，应该就能迫使敌人撤退了。虽然这样做有风险，但却是眼下最好的对策。在那的时候顺便找回我们的补给品吧。
Description.english:
Colossal magnaron, gronn, and other stone monstrosities have been threatening our outposts in the west. Most seem to originate from Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.

If we strike at them at their home, we should be able to force them back. It's risky, but it may be our best move. While you're there, see if you can recover any of our supplies.

identity.title: Assault on the Broken Precipice
identity.objectives: Assault the ogron forces at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.
identity.description:
Massive ogron have been battering our frontlines, and no matter how many we down, there seem to be more to replace them.

Most of these ogron appear to be coming from the Broken Precipice, deep in western Nagrand. If we're to stand a chance in the coming battles, we need to find a way to remove these ogron from the battlefield.

Objectives.text: 突袭纳格兰破碎悬崖的独眼魔部队。
Objectives.english: Assault the ogron forces at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.

Description.text:
巨大的独眼魔一直在冲击着我们的前线，而且不管我们干掉多少个，敌人似乎都会前仆后继的不断涌来。

这些独眼魔大多数都是从纳格兰遥远西部的破碎悬崖来的。如果我们想在接下来的战斗中立于不败之地，就必须想办法把这些独眼魔从战场上赶走。
Description.english:
Massive ogron have been battering our frontlines, and no matter how many we down, there seem to be more to replace them.

Most of these ogron appear to be coming from the Broken Precipice, deep in western Nagrand. If we're to stand a chance in the coming battles, we need to find a way to remove these ogron from the battlefield.

identity.title: Assault on Mok'gol Watchpost
identity.objectives: Assault the Warsong forces at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.
identity.description:
Warsong raiders out of Mok'gol Watchpost have been terrorizing anything and everything not behind a tall wall. We've warned travelers not to stray out alone, but many don't listen.

If we were to launch an assault on Mok'gol Watchpost, we would almost certainly put the Warsong back on the defensive, restricting most of their riders to Nagrand.

Objectives.text: 突袭纳格兰莫高尔岗哨的战歌兽人。
Objectives.english: Assault the Warsong forces at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.

Description.text:
来自莫高尔岗哨的战歌掠夺者对高墙之外的一切都不放过。我们已经告诫旅行者不要在外单独行动，可很多人还是置若罔闻。

要是我们突袭莫高尔岗哨的话，几乎肯定能让战歌士兵们忙于撤退防守，从而牵制他们在纳格兰大部分的骑兵力量。
Description.english:
Warsong raiders out of Mok'gol Watchpost have been terrorizing anything and everything not behind a tall wall. We've warned travelers not to stray out alone, but many don't listen.

If we were to launch an assault on Mok'gol Watchpost, we would almost certainly put the Warsong back on the defensive, restricting most of their riders to Nagrand.

identity.title: Assault on Socrethar's Rise
identity.objectives: Assault the Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.
identity.description:
Recent reports suggest a notable rise of activity by Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in southern Shadowmoon Valley.

Socrathar's disciples pose a threat to draenei and our garrison alike. We need to quell them at our soonest convenience.

Objectives.text: 攻击影月谷索克雷萨高地的萨格雷军队。
Objectives.english: Assault the Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.

Description.text:
近来有情报显示，在影月谷南边索克雷萨高地的萨格雷军队呈现出了日渐频繁的活动之势。

索克雷萨的门徒对德莱尼和我们的要塞都构成了威胁。我们得尽快压制住他们才行。
Description.english:
Recent reports suggest a notable rise of activity by Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in southern Shadowmoon Valley.

Socrathar's disciples pose a threat to draenei and our garrison alike. We need to quell them at our soonest convenience.

identity.title: Assault on Pillars of Fate
identity.objectives: Assault the Shadowmoon orcs at Pillars of Fate in Shadowmoon Valley.
identity.description:
Remnants of the Shadowmoon clan continue to operate out of the peaks on the eastern border of Spires of Arak.

Bodrick Grey is concerned at their proximity to the garrison, and has put out a request that we thin their forces as soon as possible.

Objectives.text: 突袭影月谷命运之柱的影月兽人。
Objectives.english: Assault the Shadowmoon orcs at Pillars of Fate in Shadowmoon Valley.

Description.text:
影月氏族的残余力量继续在阿兰卡峰林东部边界的群山里蠢蠢欲动。

伯德里克·格雷担心他们距离要塞过近，会是个隐患，要求我们尽快削减他们的兵力。
Description.english:
Remnants of the Shadowmoon clan continue to operate out of the peaks on the eastern border of Spires of Arak.

Bodrick Grey is concerned at their proximity to the garrison, and has put out a request that we thin their forces as soon as possible.

identity.title: Assault on Skettis
identity.objectives: Assault the Adherents of Rukhmar at Skettis in Spires of Arak.
identity.description:
We've been receiving regular reports of birdmen from the south ambushing and burning caravans along the main roads.

Guards from our outposts are requesting that we launch a counter attack against the main presence of Adherents of Rukhmar at Skettis in Spires of Arak.

Objectives.text: 突袭阿兰卡峰林斯克提斯处的鲁克玛信徒。
Objectives.english: Assault the Adherents of Rukhmar at Skettis in Spires of Arak.

Description.text:
我们不断收到关于鸟人在南边伏击，以及焚烧途径主干道路车队的报告。

哨站的卫兵们请求我们对阿兰卡峰林斯克提斯处的鲁克玛信徒们发起反击。
Description.english:
We've been receiving regular reports of birdmen from the south ambushing and burning caravans along the main roads.

Guards from our outposts are requesting that we launch a counter attack against the main presence of Adherents of Rukhmar at Skettis in Spires of Arak.

identity.title: Battle in Ashran
identity.objectives: Join the battle in Ashran.
identity.description:
As we do battle all across Draenor, the cowardly Horde try to seize our territory within Ashran.

Our men would be inspired to see you join the battlefield, striking terror into the hearts of the Horde.

Objectives.text: 加入阿什兰的战斗。
Objectives.english: Join the battle in Ashran.

Description.text:
当我们在德拉诺全线作战时，懦弱的部落却想要抢夺我们在阿什兰的领土。

要是战士们看到你亲临战场，领导大军重创部落的话，一定会感到倍受鼓舞的。
Description.english:
As we do battle all across Draenor, the cowardly Horde try to seize our territory within Ashran.

Our men would be inspired to see you join the battlefield, striking terror into the hearts of the Horde.

CompletionLog.text: 回你在影月谷的要塞找斥候瓦德兹。

identity.title: Challenge at the Ring of Blood
identity.objectives: Do battle at the Ring of Blood.
identity.description:
A challenge has been issued at the Ring of Blood.

Bring friends and do battle to prove your right as champion.

Title.english: Challenge at the Ring of Blood

Objectives.text: 在鲜血竞技场里参加对决。
Objectives.english: Do battle at the Ring of Blood.

Description.text:
在鲜血竞技场有挑战在等着你。

带上朋友一同前往，证明你的勇士称号是当之无愧的。
Description.english:
A challenge has been issued at the Ring of Blood.

Bring friends and do battle to prove your right as champion.

CompletionLog.text: 回你在影月谷的要塞找斥候瓦德兹。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Scout Valdez at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

identity.description:
Remnants of the Shadowmoon clan continue to operate out of the peaks on the eastern border of Spires of Arak.

Rokhan is concerned at their proximity to key choke points leading into Shadowmoon Valley, and has put out a request that we thin their forces as soon as possible.

影月氏族的残余力量继续在阿兰卡峰林东部边界的群山里蠢蠢欲动。

洛坎担心他们离通往影月谷的咽喉要道过近，会是个隐患，要求我们尽快削减他们的兵力。

identity.title: Assault on Mok'gol Watchpost
identity.objectives: Assault the Warsong force at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.
identity.description:
Warsong raiders out of Mok'gol Watchpost have been terrorizing anything and everything not behind a tall wall. We've warned travelers not to stray out alone, but many don't listen.

If we were to launch an assault on Mok'gol Watchpost, we would almost certainly put the Warsong back on the defensive, restricting most of their riders to Nagrand.

Objectives.text: 突袭纳格兰莫高尔岗哨的战歌兽人。
Objectives.english: Assault the Warsong force at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.

Description.text:
来自莫高尔岗哨的战歌掠夺者对高墙之外的一切都不放过。我们已经告诫旅行者不要在外单独行动，可很多人还是置若罔闻。

要是我们突袭莫高尔岗哨的话，几乎肯定能让战歌士兵们忙于撤退防守，从而牵制他们在纳格兰大部分的骑兵力量。
Description.english:
Warsong raiders out of Mok'gol Watchpost have been terrorizing anything and everything not behind a tall wall. We've warned travelers not to stray out alone, but many don't listen.

If we were to launch an assault on Mok'gol Watchpost, we would almost certainly put the Warsong back on the defensive, restricting most of their riders to Nagrand.

identity.title: Assault on the Iron Siegeworks
identity.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
identity.description:
Iron Horde war machines are being shipped onto battlefields by the dozens, and our forces are struggling to hold their ground. Most of these machines seem to be originating from the Iron Siegeworks in eastern Frostfire Ridge.

A strategic attack to disrupt and dismantle the Iron Horde at the siegeworks could be just what we need to turn the tide of the war.

Objectives.text: 突袭霜火岭钢铁军工厂的钢铁部落军队。
Objectives.english: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.

Description.text:
钢铁部落的战争机器正在被成批成批地运送到战场上来，而我们的军队正在死守阵线。大多数战争机器都是在霜火岭东边的钢铁军工厂里制造出来的。

如果可以对军工厂发起战略突袭，破坏并瓦解钢铁部落的行动，或许就能扭转战局。
Description.english:
Iron Horde war machines are being shipped onto battlefields by the dozens, and our forces are struggling to hold their ground. Most of these machines seem to be originating from the Iron Siegeworks in eastern Frostfire Ridge.

A strategic attack to disrupt and dismantle the Iron Horde at the siegeworks could be just what we need to turn the tide of the war.

CompletionLog.text: 回你在霜火岭的要塞找暗影猎手乌卡比。

identity.title: Assault on Magnarok
identity.objectives: Assault the stone monstrosities at Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.
identity.description:
Colossal magnaron, gronn, and other stone monstrosities have been threatening our garrison. Most seem to originate from Magnarok, just to the north.

If we strike at them at their home, we should be able to force them back. It's risky, but it may be our best move. While you're there, see if you can recover any of our supplies.

Objectives.text: 攻击霜火岭玛戈纳洛克的石头怪物。
Objectives.english: Assault the stone monstrosities at Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.

Description.text:
巨大的玛戈隆、戈隆还有其它石头怪物一直威胁着我们的要塞。它们大多数都是从北边的玛戈纳洛克来的。

如果我们突袭它们的老巢，应该就能迫使敌人撤退了。虽然这样做有风险，但却是眼下最好的对策。在那的时候顺便找回我们的补给品吧。
Description.english:
Colossal magnaron, gronn, and other stone monstrosities have been threatening our garrison. Most seem to originate from Magnarok, just to the north.

If we strike at them at their home, we should be able to force them back. It's risky, but it may be our best move. While you're there, see if you can recover any of our supplies.

identity.objectives: Join the battle in Ashran.
identity.description:
As we do battle all across Draenor, the cowardly Alliance try to seize our territory within Ashran.

Our men would be inspired to see you join the battlefield, striking terror into the hearts of the Alliance.

Objectives.english: Join the battle in Ashran.

当我们在德拉诺全线作战时，懦弱的联盟却想要抢夺我们在阿什兰的领土。

要是战士们看到你亲临战场，领导大军重创联盟的话，一定会感到倍受鼓舞的。
Description.english:

CompletionLog.text: 回你在霜火岭的要塞找暗影猎手乌卡比。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Shadow Hunter Ukambe at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

identity.title: Vintage Free Action Potion
identity.objectives: Bring Gimlett Ginfizz 10 Ashmaul Pearls.
identity.description: I hear our heroes in the front line are becoming victim to massive amounts of snares, roots and stuns! Luckily I have just the potion for them. The recipe is a little old, but it'll work. $b$bA key ingredient I need can be found here in Ashran, at the beach near that Ogre Tower.

Objectives.text: 给吉丽特·松酒带去10颗灰槌珍珠。
Objectives.english: Bring Gimlett Ginfizz 10 Ashmaul Pearls.

Description.text: 我听说敌人大量使用了诱捕、定身和昏迷的攻击手段，害得我们前线上的英雄动弹不得。幸好我这刚好有可用的药剂。虽然配方有些古老，但效果依旧。$b$b我需要的一种关键材料就在阿什兰，位于食人魔高塔附近的海滩上。
Description.english: I hear our heroes in the front line are becoming victim to massive amounts of snares, roots and stuns! Luckily I have just the potion for them. The recipe is a little old, but it'll work. $b$bA key ingredient I need can be found here in Ashran, at the beach near that Ogre Tower.

identity.title: Vintage Free Action Potion
identity.objectives: Bring Tyra Silverblood 10 Ashmaul Pearls.
identity.description: The Alliance have increased their usage of snares, roots and stuns on our melee forces. Luckily I have just the potion for them. The recipe is a little old, but it'll work. $b$bA key ingredient I need can be found here in Ashran, at the beach near that Ogre Tower.

Objectives.text: 给泰拉·银血带去10颗灰槌珍珠。
Objectives.english: Bring Tyra Silverblood 10 Ashmaul Pearls.

Description.text: 联盟对我们的近战军队采取了更多诱捕、定身和昏迷的攻击手段。幸好我这刚好有可用的药剂。虽然配方有些古老，但效果依旧。$b$b我需要的一种关键材料就在阿什兰，位于食人魔高塔附近的海滩上。
Description.english: The Alliance have increased their usage of snares, roots and stuns on our melee forces. Luckily I have just the potion for them. The recipe is a little old, but it'll work. $b$bA key ingredient I need can be found here in Ashran, at the beach near that Ogre Tower.

identity.title: Phantom Potion
identity.objectives: Bring Gimlett Ginfizz 10 Ghost Truffles.
identity.description: Every turn you take in Ashran you run into danger. But don't fret $n, I've developed the perfect solution. It's my very own riff on the popular Invisibility Potion. $B$BI'm just missing one of the ingredients: cave mushrooms. $B$BLuckily, a variety grows right here in Ashran.

Objectives.text: 给吉丽特·松酒带去10份幽灵松露。
Objectives.english: Bring Gimlett Ginfizz 10 Ghost Truffles.

Description.text: 你在阿什兰的每个转角处都会遇到危险。但别担心，$n，我已经想出了完美的解决办法。就是这瓶我自制的大受欢迎的隐形药水。$B$B现在所有材料都齐了，只少洞穴蘑菇。$B$B幸好在阿什兰当地就有一种。
Description.english: Every turn you take in Ashran you run into danger. But don't fret $n, I've developed the perfect solution. It's my very own riff on the popular Invisibility Potion. $B$BI'm just missing one of the ingredients: cave mushrooms. $B$BLuckily, a variety grows right here in Ashran.

identity.title: The Flock's Revenge
identity.objectives: Kill 18 Bloodmane Saberon.
identity.description: The Bloodmane took several of our initiates when they ambushed our ritual in Ravenskar. They must be taught that the flock will never allow such a deed to go unpunished!$b$bWe will kill one of their tribe for each of the flock that has fallen!$b$bhead into their accursed home of Bloodmane Valley and slaughter as many of them as you can find.

CompletionLog.text: 去鸦语者巢穴找高阶鸦语者科卡。
CompletionLog.english: Return to High Ravenspeaker Krikka within the Nest of the Ravenspeakers.

identity.title: Your Second Alchemy Work Order
identity.objectives: Place a work order, then collect it once it completes. $b$bProgress can be monitored through the Garrison Report pane accessible through the button on your minimap.
identity.description: Place another work order with my assistant. Once it is complete, we will leave it out here for you to collect.

Title.text: 你的第二張鍊金術訂單

Objectives.text: 下訂單，等完工後再領取成品。$b$b你可以從小地圖上的按鈕打開要塞報告面板來查看進度。
Objectives.english: Place a work order, then collect it once it completes. $b$bProgress can be monitored through the Garrison Report pane accessible through the button on your minimap.

Description.text: 請到我的助理那兒去下其他訂單，等工作完成了，我們就會把東西放在這裡等你來點收。
Description.english: Place another work order with my assistant. Once it is complete, we will leave it out here for you to collect.

CompletionLog.text: 回去找助理。
CompletionLog.english: Return to the assistant.

identity.title: Wrangling a Wolf
identity.objectives: Use the Wolf Lasso on a Young Snarler and follow it until it is tamed.
identity.description: The wolves of this land have jaws of steel. It is no wonder that the orcs have taken them as their own.$B$BYet, deep in Nagrand, there are young wolves, ripe for taming. They will present a great challenge to you, as they are more fast and agile than any beast in this land.$B$BHere is your final rope, may luck be with you.

Objectives.text: 对一只幼年啸狼使用野狼套索，跟着它直到将它驯服。
Objectives.english: Use the Wolf Lasso on a Young Snarler and follow it until it is tamed.

Description.text: 这片大陆上的狼拥有钢钳一般的咬合力。难怪兽人会驯养他们。$B$B然而，在纳格兰的深处，还有一批适合驯服的幼年狼。它们比这片大陆上的所有其他野兽都要迅捷，这将会是你的一大挑战。$B$B这是你的套索，祝你好运。
Description.english: The wolves of this land have jaws of steel. It is no wonder that the orcs have taken them as their own.$B$BYet, deep in Nagrand, there are young wolves, ripe for taming. They will present a great challenge to you, as they are more fast and agile than any beast in this land.$B$BHere is your final rope, may luck be with you.

identity.title: Talbuk Training: Thundercall
identity.objectives: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
identity.description: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Ever seen a ram in a thunderstorm? They'll hide behind anything larger than themselves. I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your talbuk and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.

Objectives.text: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败雷鸣。
Objectives.english: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.

Description.text: 元素生物有时候也会对野兽构成威胁。见过雷暴雨中的山羊吗？它们会想尽办法逃窜，躲到任何比它们大的东西后面。我不知道这是不是山羊们所理解的世界末日，可如果你当时正好骑着一头，那情况就很不妙了。$B$B在纳格兰的海岸上，有一处迎风而立的峭壁。在那峭壁上住着雷暴雨的化身，它的名字叫雷鸣。骑上你的塔布羊去那儿对付它，让我们瞧瞧你的小羊羔是否也会被吓跑。
Description.english: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Ever seen a ram in a thunderstorm? They'll hide behind anything larger than themselves. I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your talbuk and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.

identity.title: Talbuk Training: Ironbore
identity.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
identity.description: Alright, we've taken on foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. What happens when the beasts are below your feet, though? We're about to find out!$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your talbuk on out to the sandy shores and see if you can't take down one of the elder rockworms: Ironbore.

Objectives.text: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败铁钻。
Objectives.english: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.

Description.text: 很好，我们解决掉了陆地和天空的敌人，甚至还有雷雨。接下来试试你脚底下的动物如何？答案即将揭晓！$B$B岩虫是一种狡猾的捕食者，它们喜欢从沙土底下钻出来袭击敌人。在纳格兰，很多野兽都学会了注意脚底下的动静。骑上你的塔布羊去那边的沙滩试试，看看你们能不能干掉那里最古老的一只岩虫：铁钻。
Description.english: Alright, we've taken on foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. What happens when the beasts are below your feet, though? We're about to find out!$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your talbuk on out to the sandy shores and see if you can't take down one of the elder rockworms: Ironbore.

identity.title: Clefthoof Training: Moth of Wrath
identity.objectives: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
identity.description: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it'll probably be a pretty good test for your clefthoof. See if you can't keep it focused and take down that moth.

Objectives.text: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败暴怒飞蛾。
Objectives.english: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.

Description.text: 在纳格兰的森林中有许多善于躲避捕食者的动物。但其中又要属那只名叫暴怒飞蛾的蛾子做的最好，它浑身覆满了充满恶臭的飞蛾之尘。$B$B如果它能让附近的野狼都不得不退避三舍，这对你的裂蹄牛来说一定是一次非常美妙的试炼。看看你能不能让它保持专注，干掉那只飞蛾吧。
Description.english: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it'll probably be a pretty good test for your clefthoof. See if you can't keep it focused and take down that moth.

I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your clefthoof and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.

Objectives.text: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败雷鸣。
Objectives.english: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.

Description.text: 元素生物有时候也会对野兽构成威胁。见过雷暴雨中的山羊吗？它们会想尽办法逃窜，躲到任何比它们大的东西后面。我不知道这是不是山羊们所理解的世界末日，可如果你当时正好骑着一头，那情况就很不妙了。$B$B在纳格兰的海岸上，有一处迎风而立的峭壁。在那峭壁上住着雷暴雨的化身，它的名字叫雷鸣。骑上你的裂蹄牛去那儿对付它，让我们瞧瞧你的小牛犊是否也会被吓跑。
Description.english: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Ever seen a ram in a thunderstorm? They'll hide behind anything larger than themselves. I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your clefthoof and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.

identity.title: Boar Training: Ironbore
identity.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Boar-In-Training.
identity.description: Alright, we've taken on foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. What happens when the beasts are below your feet, though? We're about to find out!$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your boar on out to the sandy shores and see if you can't take down one of the elder rockworms: Ironbore.

Objectives.text: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败铁钻。
Objectives.english: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Boar-In-Training.

Description.text: 很好，我们解决掉了陆地和天空的敌人，甚至还有雷雨。接下来试试你脚底下的动物如何？答案即将揭晓！$B$B岩虫是一种狡猾的捕食者，它们喜欢从沙土底下钻出来袭击敌人。在纳格兰，很多野兽都学会了注意脚底下的动静。骑上你的野猪去那边的沙滩试试，看看你们能不能干掉那里最古老的一只岩虫：铁钻。

identity.title: Riverbeast Training: The Garn
identity.objectives: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
identity.description: I've got one last challenge for ye, commander, but if it isn't a doozy.$B$BThey call them the garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear a man apart in seconds. Any beast in their right mind would be scared witless at the sight of such a predator.$B$BThere's a lone garn that's made it from their usual home in Frostfire, all the way over to Nagrand. Take your riverbeast, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your riverbeast will truly be ready.

Objectives.text: 骑着你的训练中的淡水兽去击败残爪。
Objectives.english: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.

Description.text: 指挥官，我还有最后一项挑战要给你，这次可没那么简单。$B$B在德拉诺有一种狼，他们的皮肤像夜晚一样漆黑，他们体型比一般的狼要大上一倍，人们称他们为铁颚狼。它们转眼间就能把一个大活人撕成两半，任何脑子正常的动物遇到它们都会吓得腿软。$B$B有一头孤独的铁颚狼离开了它们世代居住的霜火岭跑到了纳格兰定居。骑上你的淡水兽去干掉它，如果你们两个能够生还，你的淡水兽才能成为一头真正的战兽。

identity.description: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it'll probably be a pretty good test for your wolf. See if you can't keep it focused and take down that moth.

Objectives.english: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Snarler-In-Training.

Description.text: 在纳格兰的森林中有许多善于躲避捕食者的动物。但其中又要属那只名叫暴怒飞蛾的蛾子做的最好，它浑身覆满了充满恶臭的飞蛾之尘。$B$B如果它能让附近的野狼都不得不退避三舍，这对你的座狼来说一定是一次非常美妙的试炼。看看你能不能让它保持专注，干掉那只飞蛾吧。

identity.description: Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques.$B$BThere is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your beast reacts to that.

Title.text: 野猪训练：凶残的食人魔

Objectives.text: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败高里亚驱兽者。
Objectives.english: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Boar-In-Training.

Description.text: 在纳格兰居住着德拉诺最强大的野兽，而且那里的食人魔使用一种非常残忍的手段驯养他们。$B$B其中，又数那个叫高里亚驱兽者的尤为凶残。他浑身充满了血腥和恐惧的气息。让我们瞧瞧你的坐骑面对他是否还能面不改色。

identity.title: Clefthoof Training: Darkwing Roc
identity.objectives: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
identity.description: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both.$B$BTravel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.

Objectives.english: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.

Description.text: 纳格兰的风鹏是一种非常聪明的捕食者，它们经常成群结队地突袭猎物。要是你的坐骑不时刻注意着天空的话，就可得跟它这双眼睛说再见了。$B$B去纳格兰干掉那里最凶猛的风鹏——暗翼大鹏。这对你的坐骑来说是个不错的试炼。

Objectives.english: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.

Description.text: 纳格兰的战歌氏族可跻身德拉诺最优秀的猎人的行列，他们的狩猎者可以帮我们为这批坐骑提供试炼。$B$B你能在纳格兰找到一位名叫狩猎大师卡拉克的兽人，死在他手上的凶残动物的数量是他们整个氏族里最多的。骑上你的坐骑去干掉他，为那些被杀害的动物报仇。

identity.title: Unconventional Inventions
identity.objectives: Acquire an invention from the workbench at the Gnomish Gearworks.
identity.description:
The workshop is bustling with the whir of minds and motors. We're coming up with new inventions all the time.

Try out today's glorious invention on the workbench behind me.

Objectives.text: 从侏儒工厂的工作台上拿取一份发明。
Objectives.english: Acquire an invention from the workbench at the Gnomish Gearworks.

Description.text:
车间的活力来自于马达和大脑的交替轰鸣。我们每天都能想出全新的发明创意。

试试我身后工作台上今天刚刚研究出来的华丽发明吧。

Objectives.text: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败暗翼大鹏。
Objectives.english: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.

Description.text: 纳格兰的风鹏是一种非常聪明的捕食者，它们经常成群结队地突袭猎物。要是你的坐骑不时刻注意着天空的话，就可得跟它这双眼睛说再见了。$B$B去纳格兰干掉那里最凶猛的风鹏——暗翼大鹏。这对你的坐骑来说是个不错的试炼。
Description.english: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both.$B$BTravel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.

identity.title: Talbuk Training: Orc Hunters
identity.objectives: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
identity.description: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. Their beast-killers will aid us in putting this mount to the test.$B$BOut in Nagrand, you will find an orc by the name of Karak, the Great Hunter. He has slain more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Face him astride your mount, and avenge the slain.

Objectives.text: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败狩猎大师卡拉克。
Objectives.english: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.

Description.text: 纳格兰的战歌氏族可跻身德拉诺最优秀的猎人的行列，他们的狩猎者可以帮我们为这批坐骑提供试炼。$B$B你能在纳格兰找到一位名叫狩猎大师卡拉克的兽人，死在他手上的凶残动物的数量是他们整个氏族里最多的。骑上你的坐骑去干掉他，为那些被杀害的动物报仇。
Description.english: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. Their beast-killers will aid us in putting this mount to the test.$B$BOut in Nagrand, you will find an orc by the name of Karak, the Great Hunter. He has slain more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Face him astride your mount, and avenge the slain.

identity.title: Wolf Training: Moth of Wrath
identity.objectives: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
identity.description: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it will probably be a pretty good test for your wolf. See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.

Objectives.text: 骑着你的训练中的啸狼去击败暴怒飞蛾。
Objectives.english: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Snarler-In-Training.

Description.text: 在纳格兰的森林中有许多善于躲避捕食者的动物。但其中又要属那只名叫暴怒飞蛾的蛾子做的最好，它浑身覆满了充满恶臭的飞蛾之尘。$B$B如果它能让附近的野狼都不得不退避三舍，这对你的座狼来说一定是一次非常美妙的试炼。看看你能不能让它保持专注，干掉那只飞蛾吧。
Description.english: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it will probably be a pretty good test for your wolf. See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.

identity.title: A Worthy Challenge: Teron'gor
identity.objectives: Complete the Auchindoun Challenge Mode.
identity.description: $n, I need you to assemble a fearless group and lead them into the depths of Auchindoun. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and cleanse Auchindoun of Teon'gor's evil presence.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Objectives.text: 完成奥金顿挑战模式。
Objectives.english: Complete the Auchindoun Challenge Mode.

Description.text: $n，我要你去召集一支勇敢的队伍，前往奥金顿的深处。你要激活那里的挑战者的宝珠，并净化塔隆戈尔对那里的渗透。$B$B完成这个挑战后，你再回来找我。我会好好奖赏你的。
Description.english: $n, I need you to assemble a fearless group and lead them into the depths of Auchindoun. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and cleanse Auchindoun of Teon'gor's evil presence.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

CompletionLog.text: 回阿什兰的战争之矛找挑战者森弗吉。

identity.title: A Worthy Challenge: Gug'rokk
identity.objectives: Complete the Bloodmaul Slag Mines Challenge Mode.
identity.description: $n, I need you to assemble a formidable group and head into the depths of the Bloodmaul Slag Mines. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and free the miners of Gug'rokk's tyrannical rule.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Objectives.text: 完成血槌炉渣矿井挑战模式。
Objectives.english: Complete the Bloodmaul Slag Mines Challenge Mode.

Description.text: $n，我要你去召集一支强劲的队伍，前往血槌炉渣矿井的深处。你要激活那里的挑战者的宝珠，并将矿工们从戈洛克的残暴统治下解救出来。$B$B完成这个挑战后，你再回来找我。我会好好奖赏你的。
Description.english: $n, I need you to assemble a formidable group and head into the depths of the Bloodmaul Slag Mines. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and free the miners of Gug'rokk's tyrannical rule.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

CompletionLog.text: 回阿什兰的战争之矛找挑战者森弗吉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Challenger Sunforge at Warspear in Ashran.

identity.title: A Worthy Challenge: Skylord Tovra
identity.objectives: Complete the Grimrail Depot Challenge Mode.
identity.description: $n, I need you to assemble an elite group to infiltrate the Grimrail Depot. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and make your way to the Grimrail and put an end to it and Skylord Tovra's air support.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Objectives.text: 完成恐轨车站挑战模式。
Objectives.english: Complete the Grimrail Depot Challenge Mode.

Description.text: $n，我要你去召集一支精英队伍渗透进恐轨车站。你要激活那里的挑战者的宝珠，血洗恐轨号，并消灭啸天者托瓦拉的空中支援力量。$B$B完成这个挑战后，你再回来找我。我会好好奖赏你的。
Description.english: $n, I need you to assemble an elite group to infiltrate the Grimrail Depot. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and make your way to the Grimrail and put an end to it and Skylord Tovra's air support.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

identity.title: A Worthy Challenge: Skullok, Son of Gruul
identity.objectives: Complete the Iron Docks Challenge Mode.
identity.description: $n, I need you to assemble a hardy group to breach the Iron Docks. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and put a stop to the Iron Horde's training facility and their subjugation of Draenor's mightiest, including Skullok, Son of Gruul.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title.text: 艰难的挑战：斯古洛克，格鲁尔之子
Title.english: A Worthy Challenge: Skullok, Son of Gruul

Objectives.text: 完成钢铁码头挑战模式。
Objectives.english: Complete the Iron Docks Challenge Mode.

Description.text: $n，我要你去召集一支勇敢的队伍攻入钢铁码头。你要激活那里的挑战者的宝珠，摧毁钢铁部落的训练设施，并击败他们所奴役的德拉诺最强大的怪物，包括斯古洛克，格鲁尔之子。$B$B完成这个挑战后，你再回来找我。我会好好奖赏你的。
Description.english: $n, I need you to assemble a hardy group to breach the Iron Docks. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and put a stop to the Iron Horde's training facility and their subjugation of Draenor's mightiest, including Skullok, Son of Gruul.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

identity.objectives: Complete the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode.
identity.description: $n, I need you to assemble a resolute group of warriors and venture into the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and put a stop to Ner'zhul's communion with the void before he takes all of Draenor with him.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Objectives.text: 完成影月墓地挑战模式。
Objectives.english: Complete the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode.

Description.text: $n，我要你去召集一群刚毅的战士前往影月墓地。你要激活那里的挑战者的宝珠，并在耐奥祖让整个德拉诺陪葬之前阻止他与虚空的融合。$B$B完成这个挑战后，你再回来找我。我会好好奖赏你的。

identity.title: A Worthy Challenge: High Sage Viryx
identity.objectives: Complete the Skyreach Challenge Mode.
identity.description: $n, I need you to assemble a determined group of adventures and venture into Skyreach. Activate the Challenger's Orb, reach the summit and put an end to High Sage Viryx and her super weapon.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title.text: 艰难的挑战：高阶贤者维里克斯
Title.english: A Worthy Challenge: High Sage Viryx

Objectives.text: 完成通天峰挑战模式。
Objectives.english: Complete the Skyreach Challenge Mode.

Description.text: $n，我要你去召集一支果决的队伍前往通天峰。你要激活那里的挑战者的宝珠，并登上峰顶消灭高阶贤者维里克斯和她的超级武器。$B$B完成这个挑战后，你再回来找我。我会好好奖赏你的。
Description.english: $n, I need you to assemble a determined group of adventures and venture into Skyreach. Activate the Challenger's Orb, reach the summit and put an end to High Sage Viryx and her super weapon.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

identity.objectives: Complete The Everbloom Challenge Mode.
identity.description: $n, I need you to assemble a resolute group of adventures and journey in to The Everbloom. Activate the Challenger's Orb, penetrate the depths of The Everbloom and put a stop to Yalnu and his ambitions.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Objectives.text: 完成永茂林地挑战模式。
Objectives.english: Complete The Everbloom Challenge Mode.

Description.text: $n，我要你去召集一支刚毅的队伍前往永茂林地。你要激活那里的挑战者的宝珠，并深入永茂林地阻止雅努的野心。$B$B完成这个挑战后，你再回来找我。我会好好奖赏你的。
Description.english: $n, I need you to assemble a resolute group of adventures and journey in to The Everbloom. identity.title: A Worthy Challenge: Warlord Zaela
identity.objectives: Complete the Upper Blackrock Spire Challenge Mode.
identity.description: $n, I need you to assemble a group of stalwart adventures and journey back to Azeroth and Upper Blackrock Spire. Activate the Challenger's Orb, enter the old home of the Blackrock clan and defeat the Ironmarch Vanguard and their new ally, Warlord Zaela.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title.text: 艰难的挑战：督军扎伊拉

Objectives.text: 完成黑石塔上层挑战模式。
Objectives.english: Complete the Upper Blackrock Spire Challenge Mode.

Description.text: $n，我要你去召集一支可靠的队伍返回艾泽拉斯的黑石塔上层。你要激活那里的挑战者的宝珠，并深入黑石兽人的旧居击败铁军先锋和他们的新盟友，督军扎伊拉。$B$B完成这个挑战后，你再回来找我。我会好好奖赏你的。
Description.english: $n, I need you to assemble a group of stalwart adventures and journey back to Azeroth and Upper Blackrock Spire. Activate the Challenger's Orb, enter the old home of the Blackrock clan and defeat the Ironmarch Vanguard and their new ally, Warlord Zaela.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

CompletionLog.text: 回阿什兰的战争之矛找挑战者森弗吉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Challenger Sunforge at Warspear in Ashran.

identity.title: Shadowmoon Invasion! BETA
identity.objectives: Repel the Shadowmoon Clan invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Crowler again to begin)
identity.description: Scouts report that the Shadowmoon Clan is buzzing like a kicked hornets' nest. Time again to earn our pay, Commander?

Objectives.text: 击退影月氏族对你要塞的入侵。$B$B（再次与克劳勒中士交谈来开始行动）
Objectives.english: Repel the Shadowmoon Clan invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Crowler again to begin)

Description.text: 斥候们回报说，影月氏族像被踢翻的马蜂窝一样躁动不安。又该大干一场了吧，指挥官？
Description.english: Scouts report that the Shadowmoon Clan is buzzing like a kicked hornets' nest. Time again to earn our pay, Commander?

identity.title: Shadowmoon Invasion! BETA
identity.objectives: Repel the Shadowmoon invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw again to begin)
identity.description: Scouts say the Shadowmoon Clan looms close, ready with their necromancy. If I die and rise again, Commander, finish me quickly. I don't want to be a ghoul.

Description.text: 据斥候回报，影月氏族已经近在咫尺，巫术也已准备就绪。要是我死了又爬起来的话，尽快把我解决掉，指挥官。我可不想变成个食尸鬼。
Description.english: Scouts say the Shadowmoon Clan looms close, ready with their necromancy. If I die and rise again, Commander, finish me quickly. I don't want to be a ghoul.
