identity.title: A Worthy Challenge: Yalnu
identity.objectives: Complete The Everbloom Challenge Mode.
identity.description: $n, I need you to assemble a resolute group of adventures and journey in to The Everbloom. Activate the Challenger's Orb, penetrate the depths of The Everbloom and put a stop to Yalnu and his ambitions.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Objectives.text: 完成永茂林地挑战模式。
Objectives.english: Complete The Everbloom Challenge Mode.

Description.text: $n，我要你去召集一支刚毅的队伍前往永茂林地。你要激活那里的挑战者的宝珠，并深入永茂林地阻止雅努的野心。$B$B完成这个挑战后，你再回来找我。我会好好奖赏你的。
Description.english: $n, I need you to assemble a resolute group of adventures and journey in to The Everbloom. Activate the Challenger's Orb, penetrate the depths of The Everbloom and put a stop to Yalnu and his ambitions.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

CompletionLog.text: 回阿什兰的暴风之盾找挑战者森弗吉。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Challenger Sunforge at Stormshield in Ashran.

identity.title: A Worthy Challenge: Warlord Zaela
identity.objectives: Complete the Upper Blackrock Spire Challenge Mode.
identity.description: $n, I need you to assemble a group of stalwart adventures and journey back to Azeroth and Upper Blackrock Spire. Activate the Challenger's Orb, enter the old home of the Blackrock clan and defeat the Ironmarch Vanguard and their new ally, Warlord Zaela.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

Title.text: 艰难的挑战：督军扎伊拉

Objectives.text: 完成黑石塔上层挑战模式。
Objectives.english: Complete the Upper Blackrock Spire Challenge Mode.

Description.text: $n，我要你去召集一支可靠的队伍返回艾泽拉斯的黑石塔上层。你要激活那里的挑战者的宝珠，并深入黑石兽人的旧居击败铁军先锋和他们的新盟友，督军扎伊拉。$B$B完成这个挑战后，你再回来找我。我会好好奖赏你的。
Description.english: $n, I need you to assemble a group of stalwart adventures and journey back to Azeroth and Upper Blackrock Spire. Activate the Challenger's Orb, enter the old home of the Blackrock clan and defeat the Ironmarch Vanguard and their new ally, Warlord Zaela.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.

CompletionLog.text: 回阿什兰的暴风之盾找挑战者萨维娜。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Challenger Savina at Stormshield in Ashran.

identity.title: Feast of the Spires
identity.objectives: Eat a Feast of the Spires at Axefall.
identity.description: Boss-mon, I prepared a great feast for you right over dere. You should be havin' a bite or two before you be goin' out for da day.$B$BTrust me, you will feel much betta if you do!

Objectives.text: 在坠斧营地尝一尝峰林盛宴。
Objectives.english: Eat a Feast of the Spires at Axefall.

Description.text: 头儿，我给您准备了一餐盛宴。出门前务必尝上几口。$B$B相信我，吃了之后肯定会让你觉得浑身充满力量的！
Description.english: Boss-mon, I prepared a great feast for you right over dere. You should be havin' a bite or two before you be goin' out for da day.$B$BTrust me, you will feel much betta if you do!

CompletionLog.text: 回坠斧营地找伦祖尔。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Lunzul at Axefall.

identity.title: Feast of the Spires
identity.objectives: Eat a Feast of the Spires at Southport.
identity.description: Commander, I prepared a great feast for ye right over there. You should be have a bite o' two before you be go out fer the day.$B$BTrust me, it's good fer ya!

Objectives.text: 在南港尝一尝峰林盛宴。
Objectives.english: Eat a Feast of the Spires at Southport.

Description.text: 指挥官，我为您准备了一餐盛宴。出门前请务必赏脸尝上几口。$B$B相信我，绝对合您胃口。
Description.english: Commander, I prepared a great feast for ye right over there. You should be have a bite o' two before you be go out fer the day.$B$BTrust me, it's good fer ya!

CompletionLog.text: 回南港找考里格·斯托克顿。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Kolrigg Stoktron at Southport.

identity.title: Fully Armed and Operational
identity.objectives: Place a Work Order at your Garrison's Workshop.
identity.description: Commander! Great news! Now that the workshop is fully armed and operational, we can start cranking out siege weapons just as soon as we have the resources.$B$BThe Overcharged Siege Engine is the pinnacle of gnomish  engineering, if I do say so myself. It's more powerful than your average siege engine and you can use it almost anywhere! The only limit is the amount of fuel we're able to pack into the chasis.$B$BAs soon as you're ready to begin production, just bring us some resources and place a work order!

Objectives.text: 在你要塞的车间下达一份产品订单。
Objectives.english: Place a Work Order at your Garrison's Workshop.

Description.text: 好消息，指挥官！我们的车间已全面就绪并随时可以开工，一旦有足够的资源，就能开始建造攻城武器了。$B$B过载的攻城坦克是地精工程的巅峰之作，虽然这只是我的个人看法。它可比一般的攻城坦克要强大得多，而且你随时随地可以使用它 ！唯一的限制恐怕就是油量有限。$B$B当你想要开始生产的时候，只管把资源带过来，并下一份订单就好了！
Description.english: Commander! Great news! Now that the workshop is fully armed and operational, we can start cranking out siege weapons just as soon as we have the resources.$B$BThe Overcharged Siege Engine is the pinnacle of gnomish  engineering, if I do say so myself. It's more powerful than your average siege engine and you can use it almost anywhere! The only limit is the amount of fuel we're able to pack into the chasis.$B$BAs soon as you're ready to begin production, just bring us some resources and place a work order!

identity.title: Solanian's Belongings
identity.objectives: Collect Well Watcher Solanian's Scrying Orb, his Scroll of Scourge Magic, and his Journal.  They are found on Sunstrider Isle by the pond, the fountain, and one of the Burning Crystals.  Return them to the Well Watcher at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle when you've collected them all.
identity.description: With all the chaos happening here at the Sunspire, I haven't had a chance to collect my belongings I've left outside at various places on the isle.  I must maintain my vigil over the Sunwell here, so I'll ask you to collect them in my stead.$B$BI need my scrying orb, my scroll of Scourge magic, and my journal.  Use this satchel for some extra space, as my things are rather bulky.  Return them to me and I'll give you a little something - you know, for the effort; you can keep the satchel as well!

Objectives.text: 收集护井者索兰尼亚的占卜宝珠、天灾魔法卷轴和日记。它们分别位于逐日岛上的池塘边、喷泉附近以及一块燃烧水晶旁。找到所有物品后，将它们归还给太阳之塔上的护井者索兰尼亚。
Objectives.english: Collect Well Watcher Solanian's Scrying Orb, his Scroll of Scourge Magic, and his Journal.  They are found on Sunstrider Isle by the pond, the fountain, and one of the Burning Crystals.  Return them to the Well Watcher at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle when you've collected them all.

Description.text: 由于逐日岛这段时间以来所发生的混乱和变故，我几乎完全没有时间来收回我散落在岛上的东西。现在我必须守在这里观察太阳之井，所以我想只能拜托你替我收回这些东西了。$B$B我需要我的占卜宝珠，我的天灾魔法卷轴，还有我的日记本。来，拿着这个小背包，我的东西实在是太多了，你可以把它们都装在这里面带回来。请一定要把它们带回来给我，我会给你一点小礼物以表达谢意的——另外，这个小背包你也可以留下！
Description.english: With all the chaos happening here at the Sunspire, I haven't had a chance to collect my belongings I've left outside at various places on the isle.  I must maintain my vigil over the Sunwell here, so I'll ask you to collect them in my stead.$B$BI need my scrying orb, my scroll of Scourge magic, and my journal.  Use this satchel for some extra space, as my things are rather bulky.  Return them to me and I'll give you a little something - you know, for the effort; you can keep the satchel as well!

CompletionLog.text: 去逐日岛找太阳之塔的护井者索兰尼亚。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Well Watcher Solanian at the Sunspire in Sunstrider Isle.

identity.title: Captain's Whistle
identity.objectives: Bring Anne Dunworthy 100 Artifact Fragments for a Captian's Whistle.

Objectives.text: 给安妮·顿沃斯100块神器碎片以交换一支上尉的哨子。
Objectives.english: Bring Anne Dunworthy 100 Artifact Fragments for a Captian's Whistle.

CompletionLog.text: 回战争之矛岗哨找乌瑟特·狼行将军。
CompletionLog.english: Return to General Ushet Wolfbarger in Warspear Outpost.

identity.title: Primals Invasion! BETA
identity.objectives: Repel the Primals invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Crowler again to begin)
identity.description: The plants seem different today. Grass blades bend against the wind and catch on my boots. Twice this morning a tree branch struck my helmet as it fell.

Objectives.text: 击退原兽对你要塞的入侵。$B$B（再次与克劳勒中士交谈来开始行动）
Objectives.english: Repel the Primals invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Crowler again to begin)

Description.text: 植物今天看起来很不一样。草叶都被风吹弯了，掠扫着我的靴子。早上还有两根树枝掉到了我的头盔上。
Description.english: The plants seem different today. Grass blades bend against the wind and catch on my boots. Twice this morning a tree branch struck my helmet as it fell.

identity.title: Ogres Invasion! BETA
identity.objectives: Repel the Ogres invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw again to begin)
identity.description: Commander, our scouts say that Ogre bands march through the snow. If they want more battle after the beating we already delivered, then I'm eager to oblige them.

Description.text: 指挥官，据斥候回报，食人魔战队正在冒雪行进。要是那群家伙在上次挨打之后还没吃够苦头的话，我非常乐意去教训他们。
Description.english: Commander, our scouts say that Ogre bands march through the snow. If they want more battle after the beating we already delivered, then I'm eager to oblige them.

identity.title: Breakers Invasion!! BETA
identity.objectives: Repel the Goren and Gronnling invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw again to begin)
identity.description: The earth quakes beneath us, Commander. Our scouts are not returning. I can feel an attack creeping up on us, but from where?

Description.text: 大地在我们脚下震颤，指挥官。我们的斥候还没回来复命。我能感觉到一场攻击迫在眉睫，可是敌人会从哪里袭来呢？
Description.english: The earth quakes beneath us, Commander. Our scouts are not returning. I can feel an attack creeping up on us, but from where?

identity.title: The Iron Horde Approaches... BETA
identity.objectives: Speak with Sergeant Crowler.
identity.description: There's smoke on the horizon... The Iron Horde is coming.

Objectives.text: 与克劳勒中士谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Sergeant Crowler.

Description.text: 远方有几股黑烟……钢铁部落来了。
Description.english: There's smoke on the horizon... The Iron Horde is coming.

identity.title: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
identity.objectives: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.
identity.description:
The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds are rousing champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.

A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent them from mustering the forces they need to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to make.

Title.english: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds

Objectives.text: 突袭高里亚试炼场的食人魔部队。
Objectives.english: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.

Description.text:
高里亚试炼场的食人魔正在选拔勇士对付我们位于纳格兰的部队。

我们要对试炼场采取断然措施，以防止他们召集起足以对抗我们的部队。这也能提醒他们一下，我们可不是好对付的。
Description.english:
The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds are rousing champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.

A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent them from mustering the forces they need to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to make.

CompletionLog.text: 回你在影月谷的要塞找斥候瓦德兹。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Scout Valdez at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

identity.title: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
identity.objectives: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.
identity.description:
The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds be rousin' champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.

A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent dem from musterin' the forces dey be needin' to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to be makin'.

Title.english: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds

Objectives.text: 突袭高里亚试炼场的食人魔部队。
Objectives.english: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.

Description.text:
高里亚试炼场的食人魔正在选拔勇士对付我们位于纳格兰的部队。

我们要对试炼场采取断然措施，以防止他们召集起足以对抗我们的部队。这也能提醒他们一下，我们可不是好对付的。
Description.english:
The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds be rousin' champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.

A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent dem from musterin' the forces dey be needin' to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to be makin'.

CompletionLog.text: 回你在霜火岭的要塞找暗影猎手乌卡比。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Shadow Hunter Ukambe at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

identity.title: Your First Blacksmithing Work Order
identity.objectives: Start and collect your first Blacksmithing work order at the Forge.
identity.description: Now that the forge is complete, we can start producing truesteel ingots for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

Objectives.text: 在熔炉处开始你的第一份锻造订单，并收集产品。
Objectives.english: Start and collect your first Blacksmithing work order at the Forge.

Description.text: 既然你已经有了熔炉，我们可以开始为你生产真钢锭了。等你找到材料就跟我的助手说一声，开始第一份产品订单吧。
Description.english: Now that the forge is complete, we can start producing truesteel ingots for you. When you have the ingredients, please speak with my assistant to start the first work order.

CompletionLog.text: 回去找铁匠的助手。
CompletionLog.english: Return to the blacksmith's assistant.

identity.title: Reignite the Wards
identity.objectives: Reignite the 3 demon wards.
identity.description:
The demons are weakening my defenses. They must be far more powerful than what we've faced before.

Will you help me to reignite the wards to keep the Legion from overrunning our position here?

Progress.text: 想要守住阵线，我们就得重新激活所有结界。
Progress.english: To hold the front line, we have to reactivate all enchantments.

identity.title: Building for Professions
identity.objectives: Build any profession building.
identity.description: I see that you have acquired the blueprints for a profession building! Use the Architect Table to build in a small plot.

Objectives.text: 建造任意的专业技能建筑。
Objectives.english: Build any profession building.

Description.text: 你弄到了一个专业技能建筑的图纸！快用建筑设计桌选一块小空地来建造它吧。
Description.english: I see that you have acquired the blueprints for a profession building! Use the Architect Table to build in a small plot.

CompletionLog.text: 在你的要塞与建筑师谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with the architect at your garrison.

identity.title: Trials of Khadgar: Iron Maidens
identity.objectives: Defeat the Iron Maidens encounter, with the following conditions.
identity.description: Defeat your enemies with greater skill to earn the favor of Khadgar - and with it, greater rewards!

Title.text: 卡德加的试炼：钢铁女武神

Objectives.text: 在钢铁女武神的战斗中获胜，并满足以下条件。
Objectives.english: Defeat the Iron Maidens encounter, with the following conditions.

Description.text: 运用你高超的技巧打败敌人，赢得卡德加的青睐——以及更好的奖励！
Description.english: Defeat your enemies with greater skill to earn the favor of Khadgar - and with it, greater rewards!

identity.title: Bloodmaul Slag Mines
identity.objectives: Defeat Gug'rokk in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
identity.description: The Bloodmaul ogres are brutal slavers, commander. Innocents from across Draenor are dragged deep into the volcanic slag mines in Frostfire Ridge to dredge up cart after cart of gems and ore, never to return.$B$BWe suspect that they have turned their focus to unearthing an ancient relic of immense power for their sorcerer-king.$B$BThe ogre Gug'rokk rules over the slag mines with an iron fist. Take him down and the mines will fall as well.

Objectives.text: 在血槌炉渣矿井击败戈洛克。
Objectives.english: Defeat Gug'rokk in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.

Description.text: 血槌食人魔都是凶残的奴隶主，指挥官。他们将德拉诺各地的无辜平民虏到位于霜火岭的炉渣矿井里，逼迫他们不眠不休地挖掘矿物和宝石，所有人都是有去无回。$B$B我们怀疑那些家伙正在全力为他们的巫王寻找一件拥有无穷力量的古老遗物。$B$B食人魔戈洛克用铁腕手段统治着炉渣矿井。只要干掉他，矿井就会随之崩溃。
Description.english: The Bloodmaul ogres are brutal slavers, commander. Innocents from across Draenor are dragged deep into the volcanic slag mines in Frostfire Ridge to dredge up cart after cart of gems and ore, never to return.$B$BWe suspect that they have turned their focus to unearthing an ancient relic of immense power for their sorcerer-king.$B$BThe ogre Gug'rokk rules over the slag mines with an iron fist. Take him down and the mines will fall as well.

identity.title: Skyreach
identity.objectives: Defeat High Sage Viryx in Skyreach.
identity.description: High Sage Viryx has finished a devastating crystal superweapon atop the highest point in Skyreach in Spires of Arak. She intends to eradicate the 'lesser races' in the name of their god Rukhmar.$B$BThe arakkoa outcasts were nearly wiped out in mere seconds by the weapon. You must stop Viryx before she turns her sights to your garrison, commander.

Objectives.text: 击败通天峰的高阶贤者维里克斯。
Objectives.english: Defeat High Sage Viryx in Skyreach.

Description.text: 高阶贤者维里克斯在阿兰卡峰林的通天峰之巅制造出了一件毁灭性的水晶超级武器。她正打算以鸦人的太阳神鲁克玛之名，肃清所谓的“低等种群”。$B$B这件武器曾在几秒内差点灭绝那些鸦人流亡者。指挥官，你必须阻止维里克斯，否则她下一个目标就会是你的要塞了。
Description.english: High Sage Viryx has finished a devastating crystal superweapon atop the highest point in Skyreach in Spires of Arak. She intends to eradicate the 'lesser races' in the name of their god Rukhmar.$B$BThe arakkoa outcasts were nearly wiped out in mere seconds by the weapon. You must stop Viryx before she turns her sights to your garrison, commander.

identity.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
identity.objectives: Defeat Warlord Zaela in Upper Blackrock Spire.
identity.description: Hellscream's Ironmarch vanguard managed to reach Blackrock Mountain and has allied with Warlord Zaela of the Dragonmaw clan. Even now the Iron Horde readies to invade Azeroth while Zaela prepares a doomsday weapon in the heart of the mountain to ensure nothing stands in their way.$B$BYou must put a stop to Zaela once and for all, commander. She has been a thorn in our side for too long.

Objectives.text: 在黑石塔上层击败督军扎伊拉。
Objectives.english: Defeat Warlord Zaela in Upper Blackrock Spire.

Description.text: 地狱咆哮的铁军先锋部队设法抵达了黑石山，并与龙喉氏族的督军扎伊拉结盟了。眼下，钢铁部落正在准备入侵艾泽拉斯，而扎伊拉则在黑石山的腹地组装一架灭世武器，要将所有挡路者尽数消灭。$B$B你必须彻底粉碎扎伊拉的阴谋，指挥官。她已经威胁我们太久了。
Description.english: Hellscream's Ironmarch vanguard managed to reach Blackrock Mountain and has allied with Warlord Zaela of the Dragonmaw clan. Even now the Iron Horde readies to invade Azeroth while Zaela prepares a doomsday weapon in the heart of the mountain to ensure nothing stands in their way.$B$BYou must put a stop to Zaela once and for all, commander. She has been a thorn in our side for too long.

Take him down and the mines will fall as well.

Description.english: The Bloodmaul ogres are brutal slavers, commander. Innocents from across Draenor are dragged deep into the volcanic slag mines in Frostfire Ridge to dredge up cart after cart o' gems and ore, never to return.$B$BWe suspect that they have turned their focus to unearthin' an ancient relic o' immense power for their sorcerer-king.$B$BThe ogre Gug'rokk rules over the slag mines with an iron fist. Take him down and the mines will fall as well.

identity.title: Auchindoun
identity.objectives: Defeat Teron'gor in Auchindoun.
identity.description: Commander, Gul'dan's favored agent Teron'gor has infiltrated Auchindoun in Talador and has already taken to devourin' the countless souls within. We mustn't let this nefarious warlock gain any further strength.$B$BEnter the holy mausoleum o' Auchindoun and rout Teron'gor and the rest o' the Shadow Council before more damage is done.

Objectives.text: 在奥金顿击败塔隆戈尔。
Objectives.english: Defeat Teron'gor in Auchindoun.

Description.text: 指挥官，古尔丹最得力的密探塔隆戈尔已经渗透进了位于塔拉多的奥金顿，并妄图吞噬在陵墓中安息的万千亡魂。我们决不能让这个邪恶的术士汲取更多力量了。$B$B快进入神圣的奥金顿陵墓，在塔隆戈尔和暗影议会造成更多伤害前将其击溃。
Description.english: Commander, Gul'dan's favored agent Teron'gor has infiltrated Auchindoun in Talador and has already taken to devourin' the countless souls within. We mustn't let this nefarious warlock gain any further strength.$B$BEnter the holy mausoleum o' Auchindoun and rout Teron'gor and the rest o' the Shadow Council before more damage is done.

identity.title: Death to Nullifier Darkoor!
identity.objectives: Speak to Gurgthock at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand and win the special exhibition match.
identity.description: Da goblin Gurgthock be requestin' your presence at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand, boss-mon.$B$BIt seems that Mogor, da lord of da ring, be holdin' an exhibition match der and he want you to fight his newest acquisition.$B$BI think it be safe, commander. I heard of dis goblin's work before. If you be ready, whisper to him "I seek da seeker."

Objectives.text: 在纳格兰的鲜血竞技场与古尔戈索克交谈，并在特别表演赛中获胜。
Objectives.english: Speak to Gurgthock at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand and win the special exhibition match.

Description.text: 地精古尔戈索克想要你到纳格兰的鲜血竞技场去亮个相，头儿。$B$B看来竞技场的老大穆戈尔在那举办了一场表演赛，想让你去跟他招募的新秀过过招。$B$B我想应该是安全的，指挥官。我以前听说过这个地精的工作。等你做好准备，只要在他耳边低声说一句：“我要挑战寻魔者”就行了。
Description.english: Da goblin Gurgthock be requestin' your presence at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand, boss-mon.$B$BIt seems that Mogor, da lord of da ring, be holdin' an exhibition match der and he want you to fight his newest acquisition.$B$BI think it be safe, commander. I heard of dis goblin's work before. If you be ready, whisper to him "I seek da seeker."

identity.title: Death to Hivelord Ik'rix!
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Iceshatter Carapace from Hiveord Ik'rix at Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
identity.description: We been tryin' out a new way to temper weapons with ice ravager carapaces. Der icy hides are perfect for da process.$B$BHivelord Ik'rix in da Southwind Cliffs nearby is rumored to be da largest ravager we ever seen - if you could bring its carapace back, we'd be able to make all sorts of things!

Title.text: 领巢者伊里克斯必须死！

Objectives.text: 从霜火岭南风崖的领巢者伊里克斯身上取得碎冰甲壳。
Objectives.english: Retrieve the Iceshatter Carapace from Hiveord Ik'rix at Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

Description.text: 我们一直在尝试用寒冰掠食者的甲壳给武器淬火。把那玩意儿添加到我们的工艺流程中来再合适不过了。$B$B在附近的南风崖有个领巢者伊里克斯，据说是我们所见过块头最大的掠食者——如果你能把它的甲壳带回来，我们想打造什么武器都是轻而易举的事了！
Description.english: We been tryin' out a new way to temper weapons with ice ravager carapaces. Der icy hides are perfect for da process.$B$BHivelord Ik'rix in da Southwind Cliffs nearby is rumored to be da largest ravager we ever seen - if you could bring its carapace back, we'd be able to make all sorts of things!

identity.title: Orb of Dominion
identity.objectives: Retrieve an Orb of Dominion from the Den of Secrets in Shadowmoon Valley.
identity.description: Gul'dan and his Shadow Council have their hooks embedded deep into Garona's soul. We've tried traditional magical methods and they haven't helped her. It's time to get unorthodox.$b$b<Khadgar cracks his knuckles, his eyes flashing with a disturbing eagerness.>$b$bI've just learned of a Shadow Council holdout hidden beneath the Draenei city of Elodor. They are using an Orb of Dominion to brainwash spies. Quickly! Assault the cave and recover the orb for me. We will turn this dark magic to our advantage.

Objectives.text: 从影月谷的秘密巢穴中取得主宰宝珠。
Objectives.english: Retrieve an Orb of Dominion from the Den of Secrets in Shadowmoon Valley.

Description.text: 古尔丹和他的暗影议会对迦罗娜灵魂的影响根深蒂固。我们已经用遍了传统魔法手段，对她却根本起不了任何作用。现在该试试另类的了。$b$b<卡德加将指关节捏的嘎嘎作响，眼中闪烁着令人不安的急切。>$b$b我刚刚听说在德莱尼城市艾洛多尔的下方有个暗影议会的秘密据点。他们正在使用主宰宝珠给间谍洗脑。赶快！袭击那个洞穴，把宝珠给我带回来。我们要将这黑暗魔法收为己用。
Description.english: Gul'dan and his Shadow Council have their hooks embedded deep into Garona's soul. We've tried traditional magical methods and they haven't helped her. It's time to get unorthodox.$b$b<Khadgar cracks his knuckles, his eyes flashing with a disturbing eagerness.>$b$bI've just learned of a Shadow Council holdout hidden beneath the Draenei city of Elodor. They are using an Orb of Dominion to brainwash spies. Quickly! Assault the cave and recover the orb for me. We will turn this dark magic to our advantage.

identity.title: The Shadow War
identity.objectives: Slay $1oa Shadow Council members in the Den of Secrets.
identity.description: The Shadow Council are more entrenched than you expected. A large contingent seems focused on infiltrating the draenei Exarch Council in the town above.$b$bKhadgar certainly wouldn't complain if you did a little... "housecleaning."

Description.text: 暗影议会比你想得要难对付得多。他们专门有一支庞大的分遣队在上方的镇子里执行渗透德莱尼主教议会的任务。$b$b如果你想要稍加……“清理门户”的话，我想卡德加一定不会有意见的。
Description.english: The Shadow Council are more entrenched than you expected. A large contingent seems focused on infiltrating the draenei Exarch Council in the town above.$b$bKhadgar certainly wouldn't complain if you did a little... "housecleaning."

identity.title: Breaking Badness
identity.objectives: Speak with Khadgar and assist him as he frees Garona from Gul'dan's mind control.
identity.description: It is time to liberate Garona. I know what to do... I think. I'd like you to stay close in case anything goes wrong.$b$bSpeak with me when you are ready to begin.

Objectives.text: 与卡德加交谈，并在他帮助迦罗娜摆脱古尔丹的灵魂控制时协助他。
Objectives.english: Speak with Khadgar and assist him as he frees Garona from Gul'dan's mind control.

Description.text: 是时候解放迦罗娜了。我想……我知道该怎么做。我想让你密切留意任何可能发生的异常情况。$b$b等你准备好就来跟我交谈吧。
Description.english: It is time to liberate Garona. I know what to do... I think. I'd like you to stay close in case anything goes wrong.$b$bSpeak with me when you are ready to begin.

identity.title: An Inside Job
identity.objectives: Infiltrate Bladefury's Command with Garona's help. Use her talents to eliminate guards without being seen. Locate Iron Horde intelligence and then spy on Gul'dan.
identity.description: If Garona's intelligence is correct, Gul'dan will be inside this Iron Horde compound. With Garona's help, slip inside, gather any info you find, and learn what Gul'dan intends to do.$b$bThe guards are on high alert. Garona can "liquidate" individual guards for you, but she must not be seen! You will have to choose your targets carefully and pick your way through the bastion undetected. Don't let anyone sound the alarm.$b$bIf things get too hot, I'll teleport you to safety. At least... I'll try.

Objectives.text: 在迦罗娜的帮助下潜入进刃怒的指挥部。利用她的天赋不被察觉地解决掉卫兵。找到钢铁部落的情报，然后监视古尔丹。
Objectives.english: Infiltrate Bladefury's Command with Garona's help. Use her talents to eliminate guards without being seen. Locate Iron Horde intelligence and then spy on Gul'dan.

Description.text: 倘若迦罗娜的情报准确无误的话，古尔丹就在这处钢铁部落据点里。在迦罗娜的帮助下，偷偷溜进去，搜集你所能找到的任何情报，查明古尔丹的企图。$b$b里面的卫兵警惕性极高。迦罗娜能替你“清理”落单的卫兵，可她不能暴露自己！你得小心选择目标，神不知鬼不觉地沿着相对安全路线进入堡垒。别让任何人发出警报。$b$b如果局面变得过糟，我会把你传送到安全的地方。至少……我会尽力的。
Description.english: If Garona's intelligence is correct, Gul'dan will be inside this Iron Horde compound. With Garona's help, slip inside, gather any info you find, and learn what Gul'dan intends to do.$b$bThe guards are on high alert. Garona can "liquidate" individual guards for you, but she must not be seen! You will have to choose your targets carefully and pick your way through the bastion undetected. Don't let anyone sound the alarm.$b$bIf things get too hot, I'll teleport you to safety. At least... I'll try.

identity.title: Light Be With You
identity.objectives: Meet Yrel at the Coliseum of Light near the Temple of Karabor.
identity.description: You've done everything I've asked, $n. I believe we can apply one final enchantment to your ring. But... we must be cautious. Last time I augmented your ring I killed you. (Sorry.) It will take a divine act to empower you further.$b$bFortunately, you've made some powerful allies during your time here. Travel to the Temple of Karabor, where Yrel is waiting for you. With the blessing of a Naaru your ring will become as powerful and unique as - well, as you yourself. Go to Karabor. You've earned it.

Objectives.text: 在卡拉波神殿附近的圣光剧场与伊瑞尔见面。
Objectives.english: Meet Yrel at the Coliseum of Light near the Temple of Karabor.

Description.text: 你做到了我所要求的一切，$n。我相信我们已经可以将你的戒指强化至最终阶段了。但……我们必须小心行事。上一次强化你的戒指时我把你杀掉了。（真抱歉。）为了让你变得更强，我们需要神圣力量的帮助。$b$b幸运的是，在这段时间里，你也结交了一些强大的盟友。到卡拉波神殿去吧，伊瑞尔在等着你。在纳鲁的祝福下，你的戒指将变得强大，而且独一无二，就像——好吧，就像你本人一样。现在去卡拉波吧。这是你应得的奖励。
Description.english: You've done everything I've asked, $n. I believe we can apply one final enchantment to your ring. But... we must be cautious. Last time I augmented your ring I killed you. (Sorry.) It will take a divine act to empower you further.$b$bFortunately, you've made some powerful allies during your time here. Travel to the Temple of Karabor, where Yrel is waiting for you. With the blessing of a Naaru your ring will become as powerful and unique as - well, as you yourself. Go to Karabor. You've earned it.

identity.title: The Final Assault
identity.objectives: Speak with your faction leader in your garrison and complete the quests to build a shipyard. Khadgar will meet you there when it's built.
identity.description: Our campaign in Draenor has taken an unexpected turn. With Gul'dan assuming power over the Iron Horde, history is poised to repeat itself - our world is in more peril than ever.$b$bIt's time to bring the full might of your garrison to bear against Tanaan Jungle. Build a shipyard for your garrison! I will meet you at your new shipyard and we will discuss our next move from there.

Objectives.text: 在你的要塞中与阵营领袖谈话，完成船坞的建造。船坞建好后，卡德加会在那儿与你会面。
Objectives.english: Speak with your faction leader in your garrison and complete the quests to build a shipyard. Khadgar will meet you there when it's built.

Description.text: 我们在德拉诺的战役遇到了意想不到的转折。古尔丹控制了钢铁部落，历史总是惊人的相似——我们的世界再次陷入了空前的危机之中。$b$b现在是时候了，调集你要塞中全部的力量，向塔纳安丛林发动进攻吧。你需要在要塞中建立一座船坞！我会在新的船坞和你见面的，到时候我们再继续讨论下面的计划。
Description.english: Our campaign in Draenor has taken an unexpected turn. With Gul'dan assuming power over the Iron Horde, history is poised to repeat itself - our world is in more peril than ever.$b$bIt's time to bring the full might of your garrison to bear against Tanaan Jungle. Build a shipyard for your garrison! I will meet you at your new shipyard and we will discuss our next move from there.

identity.title: Dark Grimoire: The First Ingredient
identity.objectives: Follow the clue from Megacharge's Cookbook to locate some precision blasting powder.
identity.description:
You will need three ingredients to make Megacharge's special "Arcane Bunker Buster," which should be able to take down the barrier. The first ingredient, some precision blasting powder, should be available nearby. The book reads:

"To make one, you'll first need to acquire some high grade, precision blasting powder. Here in Blackfuse Company, it's pretty easy to come by, since they use it for all of the cannons."

Objectives.text: 根据麦加奇配方手册中的线索，找到精密火药。
Objectives.english: Follow the clue from Megacharge's Cookbook to locate some precision blasting powder.

Description.text:
你需要找到三种材料来制作麦加奇的独门“魔法堡垒克星”，然后用它来消除屏障。第一种材料是某种精密火药，在附近就能找到。手册里写着：

“要想制作这样一枚炸弹，你首先需要一些高级的精密火药。在黑索公司，这种原料唾手可得，因为他们所有的火炮都使用这种火药。”
Description.english:
You will need three ingredients to make Megacharge's special "Arcane Bunker Buster," which should be able to take down the barrier. The first ingredient, some precision blasting powder, should be available nearby. The book reads:

"To make one, you'll first need to acquire some high grade, precision blasting powder. Here in Blackfuse Company, it's pretty easy to come by, since they use it for all of the cannons."

identity.title: Dark Grimoire: The Second Ingredient
identity.objectives: Follow the clue from Megacharge's Cookbook to find the high voltage detonator.
identity.description:
With the blasting powder acquired, you now must find a suitable detonator. A note attached to the entry in the cookbook hints to where one might be found:

"Reminder: Order more high-voltage detonators. The last shipment was lost off of the Shadowmoon coast near the demon-inhabited cliffs. Maybe we should send a diving team to salvage."

Objectives.text: 根据麦加奇配方手册中的线索，找到高压起爆器。
Objectives.english: Follow the clue from Megacharge's Cookbook to find the high voltage detonator.

Description.text:
找到了火药，你现在必须找到合适的起爆器。这一页上还有一条备注，写明了该去哪里寻找：

“备注：多订购几个高压起爆器。上一批货遗失在了影月谷的海岸上，靠近恶魔盘踞的悬崖附近。或许我们该派一支潜水小队去把它们捞回来。”
Description.english:
With the blasting powder acquired, you now must find a suitable detonator. A note attached to the entry in the cookbook hints to where one might be found:

"Reminder: Order more high-voltage detonators. The last shipment was lost off of the Shadowmoon coast near the demon-inhabited cliffs. Maybe we should send a diving team to salvage."

identity.title: Dark Grimoire: The Final Ingredient
identity.objectives: Collect blood from demons in Socrethar's Rise.
identity.description:
The final ingredient to create Megacharge's bomb is a sizable quantity of demon's blood. 

Unfortunately, that's not something they're likely to give up easily...

Title.text: 黑暗魔典：最后一种材料

Objectives.text: 从索克雷萨高地的恶魔身上收集血液。
Objectives.english: Collect blood from demons in Socrethar's Rise.

Description.text:
制作麦加奇的炸弹还需要用到最后一种材料，那就是大量的恶魔之血。

可惜，恶魔可不会乖乖把自己的血拱手奉上……
Description.english:
The final ingredient to create Megacharge's bomb is a sizable quantity of demon's blood. 

Unfortunately, that's not something they're likely to give up easily...

identity.title: Dark Grimoire: Breaching the Barrier
identity.objectives: Destroy the ancient barrier below Socrethar's Rise and claim the Grimoire of the Nameless Void.
identity.description:
The components have been gathered and the "Arcane Bunker Buster" is assembled. Hopefully, this should pack enough punch to take out the barrier.

There's only one way to find out...

Objectives.text: 摧毁索克雷萨高地下方的上古屏障，并取得无名虚空魔典。
Objectives.english: Destroy the ancient barrier below Socrethar's Rise and claim the Grimoire of the Nameless Void.

Description.text:
材料都已经备齐了，“魔法堡垒克星”也已装配完成。但愿这炸药的威力能粉碎那道屏障。

成败在此一举……
Description.english:
The components have been gathered and the "Arcane Bunker Buster" is assembled. Hopefully, this should pack enough punch to take out the barrier.

There's only one way to find out...

identity.title: To Gul'dan!
identity.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar outside of Bladefury's Command in Northern Talador.
identity.description: We must act quickly - Garona here tells me that Gul'dan is on the move. He is headed to the Path of Glory to meet with Grommash Hellscream.$b$bWe have to act while our intelligence is fresh! Hurry and meet us outside of Bladefury's Command in northern Talador. We won't be able to engage Gul'dan and the whole Iron Horde army on our own, but we may just learn something to use against them...

Objectives.text: 在塔拉多北部刃怒的指挥部外面与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar outside of Bladefury's Command in Northern Talador.

Description.text: 我们必须赶快行动——迦罗娜跟我说，古尔丹已经开始动手了。他正赶去荣耀之路见格罗玛什·地狱咆哮。$b$b我们必须抓紧最新的情报，占据先机！快到塔拉多北部刃怒的指挥部外面与我们会合。单凭我们的力量，无法对抗古尔丹和整支钢铁部落大军，可我们也许恰好掌握了用来对付他们的东西……
Description.english: We must act quickly - Garona here tells me that Gul'dan is on the move. He is headed to the Path of Glory to meet with Grommash Hellscream.$b$bWe have to act while our intelligence is fresh! Hurry and meet us outside of Bladefury's Command in northern Talador. We won't be able to engage Gul'dan and the whole Iron Horde army on our own, but we may just learn something to use against them...

CompletionLog.text: 在塔拉多北部刃怒的指挥部外面与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar outside of Bladefury's Command in Northern Talador.

identity.title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Spirit Forge
identity.objectives: Locate the Spirit Forge in Earthshaker Gorge and reforge Gutrek's Cleaver.
identity.description:
With the pieces recovered, all that is left is to reforge Gutrek's Cleaver. Goldspade's journal seems to indicate that the only place to do this is the location where it was initially dismantled.

The journal mentions a "Spirit Forge" used to dismantle the blade, and that it may be located somewhere in the nearby gorge. Find the forge and use it to combine the pieces you've gathered.

Title.text: 古特里克的杀生刀：灵魂熔炉

Objectives.text: 在震地峡谷里找到灵魂熔炉，并重铸古特里克的杀生刀。
Objectives.english: Locate the Spirit Forge in Earthshaker Gorge and reforge Gutrek's Cleaver.

Description.text:
有了这些部件，现在只要重铸古特里克的杀生刀就行了。金铲在日记里暗示说，只有在它当时被拆解的地方才能将它重铸。

日记提到了一个用来拆解这把利刃的“灵魂熔炉”，可能就在附近峡谷里的某个地方。找到熔炉，用它将你收集到的所有部件拼合起来。
Description.english:
With the pieces recovered, all that is left is to reforge Gutrek's Cleaver. Goldspade's journal seems to indicate that the only place to do this is the location where it was initially dismantled.

The journal mentions a "Spirit Forge" used to dismantle the blade, and that it may be located somewhere in the nearby gorge. Find the forge and use it to combine the pieces you've gathered.

identity.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Apexis Device
identity.objectives: Activate the Apexis device and claim the Amulet of Rukhmar.
identity.description:
Now that the keys have been activated, the Apexis device that leads to the amulet should be accessible. 

The Arakkoa research states that it is likely located in Lost Veil Anzu, within the "shrine to the raven god."

Title.text: 鲁克玛护符：埃匹希斯装置
Title.english: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Apexis Device

Objectives.text: 激活埃匹希斯装置并取得鲁克玛护符。
Objectives.english: Activate the Apexis device and claim the Amulet of Rukhmar.

Description.text:
既然已经激活了所有钥匙，可以使用埃匹希斯装置找到护符了。

鸦人的研究表明，它很可能在失落的安苏鸦巢——“乌鸦之神的祭坛内”。
Description.english:
Now that the keys have been activated, the Apexis device that leads to the amulet should be accessible. 

The Arakkoa research states that it is likely located in Lost Veil Anzu, within the "shrine to the raven god."

identity.title: Dark Grimoire: Breaching the Barrier
identity.objectives: Destroy the ancient barrier below Socrethar's Rise and claim the Grimoire of the Nameless Void.
identity.description:
The components have been gathered and the "Arcane Bunker Buster" is assembled. Hopefully, this should pack enough punch to take out the barrier.

There's only one way to find out...

Objectives.text: 摧毁索克雷萨高地下方的上古屏障，并取得无名虚空魔典。
Objectives.english: Destroy the ancient barrier below Socrethar's Rise and claim the Grimoire of the Nameless Void.

Description.text:
材料都已经备齐了，“魔法堡垒克星”也已装配完成。但愿这炸药的威力能粉碎那道屏障。

成败在此一举……
Description.english:
The components have been gathered and the "Arcane Bunker Buster" is assembled. Hopefully, this should pack enough punch to take out the barrier.

There's only one way to find out...

identity.title: Dream of Argus: The Crystal Reborn
identity.objectives: Locate the crystal reconstruction device and use it to restore the Dream of Argus.
identity.description: With the shards recovered, it is now possible to restore the Dream of Argus. You must seek out the device that Maatun mentions in his journal, which is said to be in a cave overlooking Anguish Fortress.

Title.english: Dream of Argus: The Crystal Reborn

Objectives.text: 找到水晶重塑装置并用它来复原阿古斯之梦。
Objectives.english: Locate the crystal reconstruction device and use it to restore the Dream of Argus.

Description.text: 有了这些碎片，现在可以复原阿古斯之梦了。你必须找到马顿在他日记中提过的那个装置。据说它就在俯瞰痛楚堡垒的洞穴中。
Description.english: With the shards recovered, it is now possible to restore the Dream of Argus. You must seek out the device that Maatun mentions in his journal, which is said to be in a cave overlooking Anguish Fortress.

identity.title: The Road of Glory
identity.objectives: Chris Clarkie in Stormshield wants you to kill 5 members of the Horde within the Road of Glory.
identity.description: The Horde intends to force us out of Ashran, $n. We can't let them succeed. March into the Road of Glory and thin their ranks by at least five.

Objectives.text: 暴风之盾的克里斯·克拉奇要你在荣耀之路消灭5名部落成员。
Objectives.english: Chris Clarkie in Stormshield wants you to kill 5 members of the Horde within the Road of Glory.

Description.text: 部落想要把我们赶出阿什兰，$n。决不能让他们得逞。向荣耀之路进军，至少除掉他们5位成员。
Description.english: The Horde intends to force us out of Ashran, $n. We can't let them succeed. March into the Road of Glory and thin their ranks by at least five.

identity.title: Battle At The Iron Front
identity.objectives: Aid the Alliance and Horde assault at The Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description: The war against the Iron horde rages on.$b$bNot far from here at The Iron Front, our warriors are engaged in mortal combat with the enemy. They fight tenaciously and with great fury, but the losses have been severe.$b$bGo to The Iron Front and show the enemy that we will not falter in this war.$b$bShow them that we fight as wolves!

Objectives.text: 协助联盟与部落的联军突袭塔纳安丛林的钢铁前线。
Objectives.english: Aid the Alliance and Horde assault at The Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.

Description.text: 我们与钢铁部落的战争已日趋白热化。$b$b在不远处的钢铁前线，我们的战士与敌人展开了鏖战。战况十分激烈，损失也很惨重。$b$b前往钢铁前线，告诉敌人们我们不惧怕这场战争。$b$b告诉他们，我们像狼群一样作战。
Description.english: The war against the Iron horde rages on.$b$bNot far from here at The Iron Front, our warriors are engaged in mortal combat with the enemy. They fight tenaciously and with great fury, but the losses have been severe.$b$bGo to The Iron Front and show the enemy that we will not falter in this war.$b$bShow them that we fight as wolves!

identity.title: Missive: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
identity.objectives: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.
identity.description:
The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds are rousing champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.

A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent them from mustering the forces they need to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to make.

Title.text: 密报：突袭高里亚试炼场
Title.english: Missive: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds

Objectives.text: 突袭高里亚试炼场的食人魔部队。
Objectives.english: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.

Description.text:
高里亚试炼场的食人魔正在选拔勇士对付我们位于纳格兰的部队。

我们要对试炼场采取断然措施，以防止他们召集起足以对抗我们的部队。这也能提醒他们一下，我们可不是好对付的。
Description.english:
The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds are rousing champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.

A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent them from mustering the forces they need to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to make.

CompletionLog.text: 回你在影月谷的要塞找斥候瓦德兹。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Scout Valdez at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

identity.title: Missive: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
identity.objectives: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.
identity.description:
The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds be rousin' champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.

A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent dem from musterin' the forces dey be needin' to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to be makin'.

Title.text: 密报：突袭高里亚试炼场
Title.english: Missive: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds

Objectives.text: 突袭高里亚试炼场的食人魔部队。
Objectives.english: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.

Description.text:
高里亚试炼场的食人魔正在选拔勇士对付我们位于纳格兰的部队。

我们要对试炼场采取断然措施，以防止他们召集起足以对抗我们的部队。这也能提醒他们一下，我们可不是好对付的。
Description.english:
The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds be rousin' champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.

A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent dem from musterin' the forces dey be needin' to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to be makin'.

CompletionLog.text: 回你在霜火岭的要塞找暗影猎手乌卡比。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Shadow Hunter Ukambe at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

identity.title: Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak
identity.objectives: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Ruins of Kra'nak in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description:
The Shadow Council have recruited the Sethekk and other power hungry Arakkoa to their service. Our allies in the Order of the Awakened have tracked them to a ruin in the west of Tanaan where the Shadow Council is instructing them in the use of fel magic.

We must strike at them before they can master their diabolic powers.

Title.english: Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak

Objectives.text: 突袭塔纳安丛林卡纳克废墟的暗影议会军队。
Objectives.english: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Ruins of Kra'nak in Tanaan Jungle.

Description.text:
暗影议会招募了塞泰克和其他渴求力量的鸦人为他们效力。我们那些觉醒教派的盟友一路追踪他们，到达了塔纳安西边的一座废墟，暗影议会应该就在那里向他们传授恶魔的法术。

我们必须在他们掌握那可怕的力量之前向他们发动攻击。
Description.english:
The Shadow Council have recruited the Sethekk and other power hungry Arakkoa to their service. Our allies in the Order of the Awakened have tracked them to a ruin in the west of Tanaan where the Shadow Council is instructing them in the use of fel magic.

We must strike at them before they can master their diabolic powers.

identity.title: Val'sharah
identity.objectives: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage at Lor'lathil in Val'Sharah.
identity.description: [PH] Go through the portal in Dalaran and meet Malfurion Stormrage in Val'Sharah.

Objectives.text: 在瓦尔莎拉的洛拉希尔与玛法里奥·怒风谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage at Lor'lathil in Val'Sharah.

Description.text: 穿过达拉然的传送门前往瓦尔莎拉，并与玛法里奥·怒风会面。
Description.english: [PH] Go through the portal in Dalaran and meet Malfurion Stormrage in Val'Sharah.

identity.title: Cenarius, Keeper of the Grove
identity.objectives: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage at Lorlathil in Val'Sharah.
identity.description: Greetings, hero.$b$bWelcome to Val'sharah. It has been an age since I have set foot in these precious woods. Too long...$b$bOur work here is simple. We must call upon my mentor, Cenarius, and learn where he safeguards the Tears of Elune. With them, you will be one step closer to sealing Sargeras' Tomb and thwarting the Legion.$b$bYou have many treacherous tasks in front of you. Consider your visit here a brief respite.$b$bCome, this will not take long.

Objectives.text: 在瓦尔莎拉的洛拉希尔与玛法里奥·怒风谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage at Lorlathil in Val'Sharah.

Description.text: 你好，英雄。$b$b欢迎来到瓦尔莎拉。我已经很久没有踏足这片珍贵的森林了。太久了……$b$b这次的任务很简单——去拜访我的导师塞纳留斯，询问他将艾露恩之泪藏在了哪里。有了它，我们就离封印萨格拉斯之墓并且阻止燃烧军团的目标更近了一步。$b$b未来还有许多危险计划等着你去执行，所以现在就先在这里喘口气吧。$b$b来吧，这不会花你太多时间的。
Description.english: Greetings, hero.$b$bWelcome to Val'sharah. It has been an age since I have set foot in these precious woods. Too long...$b$bOur work here is simple. We must call upon my mentor, Cenarius, and learn where he safeguards the Tears of Elune. With them, you will be one step closer to sealing Sargeras' Tomb and thwarting the Legion.$b$bYou have many treacherous tasks in front of you. Consider your visit here a brief respite.$b$bCome, this will not take long.

identity.title: Eyes in the Overlook
identity.objectives: Recover the SI:7 Intel from Spymaster Knockwhistle in Blackbeak Overlook.
identity.description: Alliance personnel from the Skyfire were spotted parachuting into Blackbeak Overlook.$B$BI was unable to confirm numbers or positions during my flyover, but I did see parachutes tangled in treetops and a LOT of ravenbears on the ground.$B$BIf anyone is up there, they must be laying low and keeping an eye on us.$B$BI have posted a rider at the top of the overlook to keep watch while I press forward into Stormheim.$B$B- Liza Cullen, Dread-Rider - 1st Wing

Progress.text: <这个侏儒间谍保护着一份关于被遗忘者部队的详细报告。>
Progress.english: <Гном-шпион охранял подробный отчет о расположении сил Отрекшихся.>

identity.title: Lord Hal'shara's Tomb
identity.objectives: Raid the tomb.
identity.description: The tomb, I've found it.

Objectives.text: 袭击墓穴。
Objectives.english: Raid the tomb.

Description.text: 墓穴，我找到了。
Description.english: The tomb, I've found it.

identity.title: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden
identity.objectives: Defeat the Shadow Council at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description:
The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. Make no mistake; This is the most dangerous region in Tanaan.

Gather together a war party and assault the Throne of Kil'jaeden before the Legion gains a foothold here!

Title.english: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden

Objectives.text: 击败塔纳安丛林基尔加丹王座的暗影议会军队。
Objectives.english: Defeat the Shadow Council at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.

Description.text:
暗影议会正在被他们称为基尔加丹王座的高山顶上召唤他们的恶魔主子。别大意，那里可是整个塔纳安最危险的地方。

快去召集一支战斗小队突袭基尔加丹王座吧，别让燃烧军团在这里站稳了脚跟！
Description.english:
The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. Make no mistake; This is the most dangerous region in Tanaan.

Gather together a war party and assault the Throne of Kil'jaeden before the Legion gains a foothold here!

identity.title: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden
identity.objectives: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.
identity.description:
The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. We know the destruction the legion can cause if they are left unchecked.

Head to the Throne of Kil'jaeden and let's put an end to this invasion before it can begin.

Title.english: Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden

Objectives.text: 突袭塔纳安丛林基尔加丹王座的暗影议会军队。
Objectives.english: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.

Description.text:
暗影议会正在被他们称为基尔加丹王座的高山顶上召唤他们的恶魔主子。别大意，那里可是整个塔纳安最危险的地方。

快去召集一支战斗小队突袭基尔加丹王座吧，别让燃烧军团在这里站稳了脚跟！
Description.english:
The Shadow Council are summoning their demonic masters upon a mountain they are calling the Throne of Kil'jaeden. We know the destruction the legion can cause if they are left unchecked.

Head to the Throne of Kil'jaeden and let's put an end to this invasion before it can begin.

identity.title: Gates of Valhallas
identity.objectives: Speak with Vedhir.
identity.description:
Escaping the grasp of Helya is no small feat. You may prove to be a worthy warrior after all.

Skovald has entered Valhallas; you are running out of time. Legion has corrupted the minds of the Skovald's men. A battalion of unworthy vrykul is attempting to enter the portal to Valhallas.

The giants that protect the gates are fighting a losing battle. There is no end to Legion's onslaught.

Speak with the dragon, Vehdir, inside the gates near the portal. He will aid you on your next task.

Objectives.text: 与维瑟尔谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Vedhir.

Description.text:
挣脱海拉的魔掌绝非易事。你彻底证明了自己的能力。

斯科瓦尔德已经进入瓦尔哈拉，你的时间十分有限。燃烧军团腐化了斯科瓦尔德手下的心智。一群不知所谓的维库人正打算进入瓦尔哈拉传送门。

守门的巨人们正在节节败退，燃烧军团的猛攻似乎永无止尽。

与传送门内的巨龙维瑟尔谈谈。他会协助你进行下一个任务。
Description.english:
Escaping the grasp of Helya is no small feat. You may prove to be a worthy warrior after all.

Skovald has entered Valhallas; you are running out of time. Legion has corrupted the minds of the Skovald's men. A battalion of unworthy vrykul is attempting to enter the portal to Valhallas.

The giants that protect the gates are fighting a losing battle. There is no end to Legion's onslaught.

Speak with the dragon, Vehdir, inside the gates near the portal. He will aid you on your next task.

identity.title: Burning Importance
identity.objectives: Save yourself by completing a Timewalking Dungeon.
identity.description: Champion, you would not believe the horrors I have seen. The timeline is twisting and your fate is dire. Causality bends at its very knees, and in this dire future you kneel to the Betrayer himself, Illidan Stormrage. Venture into the past and save yourself, but beware - your powers are as they were then.

Objectives.text: 完成时空漫游地下城，拯救你自己。
Objectives.english: Save yourself by completing a Timewalking Dungeon.

Description.text: 勇士，你不会相信我所见证的恐惧。时间线扭曲了，你的命运汲汲可危。因果关系是非常玄妙的，在这个可怕的未来中，你会向背叛者伊利丹·怒风本人屈膝下跪。回到过去，拯救你自己，但要小心——你的力量也会变成当初的样子。
Description.english: Champion, you would not believe the horrors I have seen. The timeline is twisting and your fate is dire. Causality bends at its very knees, and in this dire future you kneel to the Betrayer himself, Illidan Stormrage. Venture into the past and save yourself, but beware - your powers are as they were then.

identity.title: Black Rook Orders
identity.objectives: Return to Commander Jarod Shadowsong at Bradensbrook.
identity.description: The letter is written in midnight ink:$B$B"A demon invasion is imminent, but as long as the fires of Black Rook Hold blaze, we shall protect kaldorei lands. Kill any intruders who stand in our way."$B$B- K.R."$B$BPerhaps Jarod Shadowsong will want to see this.

Objectives.text: 回鲑鱼溪找指挥官加洛德·影歌。
Objectives.english: Return to Commander Jarod Shadowsong at Bradensbrook.

Description.text: 信是用午夜墨水写的：$B$B“恶魔入侵在即，但是只要黑鸦堡垒的火焰不熄，我们就会保护卡多雷的土地。消灭所有踏足我们土地的入侵者。$B$B——K.R.”$B$B或许应该把这封信拿给加洛德·影歌看看。
Description.english: The letter is written in midnight ink:$B$B"A demon invasion is imminent, but as long as the fires of Black Rook Hold blaze, we shall protect kaldorei lands. Kill any intruders who stand in our way."$B$B- K.R."$B$BPerhaps Jarod Shadowsong will want to see this.

identity.title: Silence in the City
identity.objectives: Speak to Chief Telemancer Oculeth.
identity.description: There is a troubling silence from Suramar City this day.$b$bOculeth just informed me that the teleporter to the Waning Crescent has gone dark. He is not able to reach Vanthir, nor am I.$b$bWhile I am hesitant to believe something dire has happened, I do feel this warrants investigation.$b$bSpeak with Oculeth and see if he can transport you to the Waning Crescent. We need to find out what happened.

Completion.text: 情況不對勁。我感覺得到。
Completion.english: Algo va mal. Lo noto en los huesos.

identity.title: Our Last Hope
identity.objectives: Speak with Maiev Shadowsong in the Illidari Cellblock.
identity.description:
Your jailor, Maiev Shadowsong, stands outside the open door to your cell. The leader of the Wardens has just finished removing your bonds.

In the distance, you can hear sounds of battle. The unmistakable stench of the Burning Legion wafts through the air.

Objectives.text: 在伊利达雷监狱与玛维·影歌谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Maiev Shadowsong in the Illidari Cellblock.

Description.text:
你的狱卒玛维·影歌正站在牢房门外。门是开着的，这位守望者的领袖已经解除你的束缚。

你听到远处有打斗的声音。燃烧军团那特殊的腐臭味在空气中飘荡。
Description.english:
Your jailor, Maiev Shadowsong, stands outside the open door to your cell. The leader of the Wardens has just finished removing your bonds.

In the distance, you can hear sounds of battle. The unmistakable stench of the Burning Legion wafts through the air.

identity.title: Our Last Hope
identity.objectives: Retrieve your new warglaives.
identity.description:
The Vault has fallen to the Burning Legion.

It pains me to say it, but all is lost, but for one glimmer of hope... YOU. Believe me when I say, I did NOT want to have to do this. However, it would seem I have no choice.

Help me, demon hunter, and I will grant you your freedom.

Objectives.text: 取得你的新战刃。
Objectives.english: Retrieve your new warglaives.

Description.text:
地窟已经落入燃烧军团手里。

我以无比沉重的心情告诉你，现在大势已去，只剩下一线希望……那就是你。相信我的决心，虽然我实在不想这么做，但是我已经别无选择。

帮帮我，恶魔猎手，我会还你自由。
Description.english:
The Vault has fallen to the Burning Legion.

It pains me to say it, but all is lost, but for one glimmer of hope... YOU. Believe me when I say, I did NOT want to have to do this. However, it would seem I have no choice.

Help me, demon hunter, and I will grant you your freedom.

CompletionLog.text: 回守望者地窟找玛维·影歌。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Maiev Shadowsong in the Vault of the Wardens.

identity.title: Answering Aggression
identity.objectives: Kill 12 of Elisande's Forces in the Waning Crescent, Starcaller Retreat, and Siren's Vigil.
identity.description: I weep for the Nightborne this day.$b$b<Silgryn gestures out the door.>$b$bElisande demonstrates the ultimate disdain for her people. So many lives... wasted!$b$bAll to relay a message: This is what happens to those who defy her.$b$b$n, my friend, we must answer her. We must show her that she cannot slay her people without retribution.$b$bFight back, $n.

Completion.text: 務必制止他們。
Completion.english: Tenía que hacerse.

identity.title: Regroup
identity.objectives: Escape Siren's Vigil.
identity.description: These people may be able to hold out here, but I know for certain that we cannot.$b$bEvery moment we spend here places them in danger of Elisande's forces retaliating against us.$b$bWe need to move. We need to find a place to regroup and recover.$b$bFollow me. I think I know how we can get out of here.

Completion.text: 歐庫雷斯已經準備好了。很好，少一件要擔心的事。
Completion.english: Oculeth se ha anticipado a nuestra llegada. Bien, una cosa menos de la que preocuparse.

identity.title: Crackdown
identity.objectives: Investigate the events of the Waning Crescent.
identity.description: Thalyssra is right to be concerned!$b$bThe network has not responded to my attempts to re-establish connection with the Waning Crescent. I do not know what happened, but given the circumstances I believe it prudent to investigate in person.$b$b$n, would you do the honors? I will send you as close to the Waning Crescent as I can.

Completion.text:
一定有人通報了大博學者，她們才會知道凡席爾也參與了這場反叛行動。如此殘暴的行為…

艾莉珊德…為什麼？
Completion.english: Alguien debe de haber informado a la Gran Magistrix acerca de la implicación de Vanthir en la rebelión. Una violencia así es...$B$BElisande... ¿Cómo has podido?

identity.title: The Sword of Truth
identity.objectives: Place Fal'shathil on the ground, then defeat Black Rook night elves within its holy light.
identity.description: Lord Ravencrest's army rises from the dead, but I believe they are controlled by Gul'dan's will.$B$BTake this - Lord Ravencrest's blade, Fal'shathil. It was known for a unique, magical quality. Those who gazed upon its mirrored blade found themselves unable to deny the truth.$B$BTake the blade and plant it in the ground. Attack the night elven ghosts near its light. Once they are weakened in its presence, perhaps they will regain their senses.

Objectives.text: 把法沙希尔插入地面，然后在它的圣光之中攻击黑鸦暗夜精灵。
Objectives.english: Place Fal'shathil on the ground, then defeat Black Rook night elves within its holy light.

Description.text: 拉文凯斯领主的军队死而复生，我相信是古尔丹在背后搞鬼。$B$B这是拉文凯斯领主的武器，法沙希尔。它曾以独一无二的魔法特质而闻名。任何人凝视如镜的剑身时，都无法再抗拒真相，从而恢复理智。$B$B带上这把剑，把它插入地面，在它的光芒附近攻击暗夜精灵的鬼魂。等到他们被削弱之后，或许就能恢复意识。
Description.english: Lord Ravencrest's army rises from the dead, but I believe they are controlled by Gul'dan's will.$B$BTake this - Lord Ravencrest's blade, Fal'shathil. It was known for a unique, magical quality. Those who gazed upon its mirrored blade found themselves unable to deny the truth.$B$BTake the blade and plant it in the ground. Attack the night elven ghosts near its light. Once they are weakened in its presence, perhaps they will regain their senses.

CompletionLog.text: 回黑鸦堡垒找加洛德·影歌。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Jarod Shadowsong at Black Rook Hold.

identity.title: Competitive Exorcise
identity.objectives: Kill 15 Burning Legion invaders in 10 minutes or less.
identity.description:
Think you're good at sending demons back to the hell from whence they came? Show me!

I once bagged 15 in under 10 minutes. Do better than that and there'll be brew money waitin' for ya.

Objectives.text: 在10分钟以内消灭15个燃烧军团入侵者。
Objectives.english: Kill 15 Burning Legion invaders in 10 minutes or less.

Description.text:
你自认为是除魔高手？来露两手吧！

我曾在10分钟内干掉15个恶魔。要是你也能做到，甚至做得更好的话，我就帮你付酒钱。
Description.english:
Think you're good at sending demons back to the hell from whence they came? Show me!

I once bagged 15 in under 10 minutes. Do better than that and there'll be brew money waitin' for ya.

identity.title: No Reason to Stay
identity.objectives: Evacuate survivors in the Waning Crescent and Siren's Vigil.
identity.description: Elisande's purge of the Waning Crescent came so swiftly that few could react. Many of my people are dead or taken.$b$bSome may have endured this atrocity. We need to make sure they are not left behind.$b$bI need you to search the houses nearby for any survivors. See that they flee before they are discovered. Reassure them that there is no reason to stay. $b$bNot here, not while Elisande's insanity reigns.

Completion.text: 看來你有找到倖存者。很好，這讓我放心不少。
Completion.english: Ya veo que has encontrado a varios supervivientes. Bien, eso me quita un peso de encima.

identity.title: Felslate Seam Sample
identity.objectives: Bring the Felslate Seam Sample to Mama Diggs in Dalaran.
identity.description: This ore is remarkably heavy. More disturbingly, it seems to darken and hiss at your touch.$b$bPerhaps your mining trainer in Dalaran has some insights.

Progress.text: 看来你在下面过得非常忙碌，矿工。
Progress.english: Parece que has estado ocupada, minera.

identity.title: Done with Waiting
identity.objectives: Travel to the southern cliffs of Val'sharah and speak to Makra Knifewhisper.
identity.description: Mom got a message and said blood called for blood. She told me to wait here while she went out, but it's been two weeks since then. I'm tired of waiting.$B$BI'll stay home if you go find her. She said she was going to the cliffs far to the south.

Objectives.text: 前往瓦尔莎拉的南部峭壁，与马克拉·刀语谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Travel to the southern cliffs of Val'sharah and speak to Makra Knifewhisper.

Description.text: 母亲收到一个消息，就说要血债血偿。她离开之前叫我乖乖在这里等，但已经过去两个星期，我实在等不下去了。$B$B如果你能把她找回来，我就在家里等着。她说会往南走，到离这很远的峭壁去。
Description.english: Mom got a message and said blood called for blood. She told me to wait here while she went out, but it's been two weeks since then. I'm tired of waiting.$B$BI'll stay home if you go find her. She said she was going to the cliffs far to the south.

identity.title: Fishy Business
identity.objectives: Kill 3 Murktide Wavecallers on the southern coast of Val'sharah.
identity.description: Makrura are massing down by the shore, and far too many of them seem to practice water magic.$B$BI think once they've got enough spellcasters, they're planning to summon a massive wave.

Objectives.text: 在瓦尔莎拉的南部海岸上消灭3个影潮召浪者。
Objectives.english: Kill 3 Murktide Wavecallers on the southern coast of Val'sharah.

Description.text: 龙虾人正在海滩作乱，他们中的大多数人似乎都在操练水魔法。$B$B我认为，等到他们有足够多的施法者之后，肯定就会计划召唤巨浪。
Description.english: Makrura are massing down by the shore, and far too many of them seem to practice water magic.$B$BI think once they've got enough spellcasters, they're planning to summon a massive wave.

CompletionLog.text: 回瓦尔莎拉的南部峭壁找马克拉·刀语。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Makra Knifewhisper on the southern cliffs of Val'sharah.

identity.title: Die, Fish-People
identity.objectives: Bring 3 Intact Murktide Tails to Makra Knifewhisper on the southern cliffs of Val'sharah.
identity.description: Makrura are massing down by the shore, and far too many of them seem to practice water magic. I think they're planning to summon a massive wave.$B$BAlso, I've come a long way, and I'm out of supplies. I'm so hungry, I could eat almost anything. Even the makrura you kill. Just cut the heads off first.

Objectives.text: 把3个完整的影潮龙虾尾带回瓦尔莎拉的南部峭壁，交给马克拉·刀语。
Objectives.english: Bring 3 Intact Murktide Tails to Makra Knifewhisper on the southern cliffs of Val'sharah.

Description.text: 龙虾人正在下面的海滩作乱，他们中的大多数人似乎都在操练水魔法。我认为他们正在计划召唤巨浪。$B$B话说回来，我赶了很远的路，补给也早已见底。我饿坏了，现在什么东西都吃得下，哪怕是你杀掉的龙虾人也行——不过请把他们的头先切掉。
Description.english: Makrura are massing down by the shore, and far too many of them seem to practice water magic. I think they're planning to summon a massive wave.$B$BAlso, I've come a long way, and I'm out of supplies. I'm so hungry, I could eat almost anything. Even the makrura you kill. Just cut the heads off first.

CompletionLog.text: 回瓦尔莎拉的南部峭壁找马克拉·刀语。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Makra Knifewhisper on the southern cliffs of Val'sharah.

identity.title: Not Dead Yet!
identity.objectives: Use the Nitro-Electric Jumpstarter to resurrect 5 Gadgetzan Bruisers.
identity.description: They're not dead yet! A little nitro here, a jolt of electricity there... we can bring 'em back! And then, they can pay me! Whaddya say, $n? Wanna go into business with me?

Objectives.text: 使用硝基电能起搏器复活5名加基森卫兵。
Objectives.english: Use the Nitro-Electric Jumpstarter to resurrect 5 Gadgetzan Bruisers.

Description.text: 他们还没死！用硝基电能起搏器就能救活他们！然后，他们就可以付我报酬了！你怎么说，$n？要和我一起做生意吗？
Description.english: They're not dead yet! A little nitro here, a jolt of electricity there... we can bring 'em back! And then, they can pay me! Whaddya say, $n? Wanna go into business with me?

identity.title: Scouting Report
identity.objectives: Find Goblin Intel from any Steamwheedle Scout in Tanaris.
identity.description:
We were supposed to meet back here, and then sneak back to Gatgetzan. That was hours ago, $n! The others fanned out across all of Tanaris to gather intel.

Anything you can find will help in the defense of Gadgetzan. Keep your eyes open, $n!

Objectives.text: 从塔纳利斯的热砂港斥候身上收集地精情报。
Objectives.english: Find Goblin Intel from any Steamwheedle Scout in Tanaris.

Description.text:
我们本该在这里碰头，然后偷偷回到加基森。这都好几个小时了，$n！其他人早就分散到塔纳利斯各地去收集情报了。

你能找到的任何情报都能帮助我们守卫加基森。眼睛睁大点，$n！
Description.english:
We were supposed to meet back here, and then sneak back to Gatgetzan. That was hours ago, $n! The others fanned out across all of Tanaris to gather intel.

Anything you can find will help in the defense of Gadgetzan. Keep your eyes open, $n!

identity.title: Tearing down the Legion
identity.objectives: Kill 15 Legion Invaders while piloting a vehicle during a Tanaris invasion.
identity.description:
A piece of paper is tacked to the controls. On it is a tally of demons slain by the previous pilot.

Your ego demands satisfaciton.

Objectives.text: 在塔纳利斯侵略战中，驾驶载具消灭15个军团入侵者。
Objectives.english: Kill 15 Legion Invaders while piloting a vehicle during a Tanaris invasion.

Description.text:
控制板上贴着一张纸，上面写着前任驾驶员的除魔计数。

你忍不住想满足自己的虚荣心。
Description.english:
A piece of paper is tacked to the controls. On it is a tally of demons slain by the previous pilot.

Your ego demands satisfaciton.

identity.title: Unbearable
identity.objectives: Investigate the Shivering Ashmaw Cub in southern Val'sharah.
identity.description: Not far away, a bear cub looks to be in some distress. Perhaps you should investigate?

Objectives.text: 在瓦尔莎拉南部查看发抖的灰喉熊崽。
Objectives.english: Investigate the Shivering Ashmaw Cub in southern Val'sharah.

Description.text: 在离这不远的地方，有一只熊崽似乎遭遇了不幸。你或许可以去看看？
Description.english: Not far away, a bear cub looks to be in some distress. Perhaps you should investigate?

identity.title: Black Rook Invasion
identity.objectives: Kill 7 Black Rook Assassins in Bradensbrook.
identity.description: Once, this area was peaceful and prosperous. Then we saw the first bad omens: strange ailments, spoiled crops, and the like. Now ghosts attack us from that castle across the river, and undead assassins slay our fishers so as to cut off the village's food supply.$B$BWe're the last family living this close to the castle, but we daren't retreat: this river is the best route for fishers to bring their hauls in to town. Please, will you take the fight to these undead?

Objectives.text: 在鲑鱼溪消灭7个黑鸦刺客。
Objectives.english: Kill 7 Black Rook Assassins in Bradensbrook.

Description.text: 这里曾经既和平又繁荣。后来我们看到了不详的预兆：村民染病，庄稼变质，怪事频频。现在，河对岸那座堡垒的幽灵袭击了我们，还派出刺客杀害渔夫以切断村里的粮食供应。$B$B我们是堡垒附近幸存的最后一家人了，但是我们不敢撤离，因为这条河流是把捕来的鱼送进城镇的最佳路线。拜托了，你可以去对付这些幽灵吗？
Description.english: Once, this area was peaceful and prosperous. Then we saw the first bad omens: strange ailments, spoiled crops, and the like. Now ghosts attack us from that castle across the river, and undead assassins slay our fishers so as to cut off the village's food supply.$B$BWe're the last family living this close to the castle, but we daren't retreat: this river is the best route for fishers to bring their hauls in to town. Please, will you take the fight to these undead?

CompletionLog.text: 回去找鲑鱼溪的塞西莉·雷德克里夫。
CompletionLog.english: Return to Cecily Radcliffe in Bradensbrook.

identity.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
identity.objectives: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
identity.description: The chill star shines upon the land with its cold light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, sapping warmth and life. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Objectives.text: 完成5个时空漫游地下城。
Objectives.english: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.

Description.text: 冰冷的星星用它冰冷的光芒照耀着大地，仿佛连灵魂都退缩到了暗影之中。这颗星星与天空中其他的星星完全不同，它会吸取热量与生命。在它的影响持续期间，新的道路将被打开，通往遥远的空间与时间。没有哪位贤者真正了解这一预兆的涵义，但英勇的行为总会得到幸运的眷顾。
Description.english: The chill star shines upon the land with its cold light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, sapping warmth and life. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

identity.title: Call of the Archmage
identity.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
identity.description: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.

Objectives.text: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

Description.text: 大法师卡德加已经制定了对抗暗影议会的下一步行动计划。到他的法师塔和他会面吧，就在塔拉多东边的赞加拉沼泽里。
Description.english: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.

CompletionLog.text: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

identity.title: Call of the Archmage
identity.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
identity.description: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.$b$bThis will not take long.

Objectives.text: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

Description.text: 大法师卡德加已经计划好了对暗影议会展开下一步行动。到他的法师塔和他会面吧，就在塔拉多东边的赞加拉沼泽里。$b$b应该不会花费你太长时间的。
Description.english: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.$b$bThis will not take long.

CompletionLog.text: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

identity.title: Call of the Archmage
identity.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
identity.description: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.$b$bThis will not take long.

Objectives.text: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

Description.text: 大法师卡德加已经计划好了对暗影议会展开下一步行动。到他的法师塔和他会面吧，就在塔拉多东边的赞加拉沼泽里。$b$b应该不会花费你太长时间的。
Description.english: Archmage Khadgar has devised the next course of action against the Shadow Council. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.$b$bThis will not take long.

CompletionLog.text: 在赞加拉的卡德加的法师塔与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

identity.title: A Summons from Saylanna
identity.objectives: Seek out Saylanna Riverbreeze in the Lunarwing Shallows.
identity.description: Sprites have always been mischievous creatures, but lately their mischief has turned to violence.$B$BOne of the druids I call friend, Saylanna Riverbreeze, reports that they are assaulting the faerie dragon nesting grounds.$B$BThe Lunarwing Shallows lie to the south. You will find Saylanna there.

Objectives.text: 前往月翼浅滩寻找赛兰娜·河风。
Objectives.english: Seek out Saylanna Riverbreeze in the Lunarwing Shallows.

Description.text: 林精总爱恶作剧，但是它们最近变得非常暴力。$B$B我的一位德鲁伊朋友，赛兰娜·河风报告林精正在骚扰精灵龙的栖地。$B$B月翼浅滩就在南边，你到那里就能找到赛兰娜。
Description.english: Sprites have always been mischievous creatures, but lately their mischief has turned to violence.$B$BOne of the druids I call friend, Saylanna Riverbreeze, reports that they are assaulting the faerie dragon nesting grounds.$B$BThe Lunarwing Shallows lie to the south. You will find Saylanna there.

identity.title: Emissary of War
identity.objectives: Complete 4 dungeons on Mythic difficulty.
identity.description: When the sign of the emissary shines in the night sky, the stars strengthen existing bonds and forge new ones. Friendship is still not cheaply won, and deeds will prove loyalty, but trust comes more readily during these days. Venture deep into caverns and strongholds to prove your worth.

Objectives.text: 完成4次史诗难度的地下城。
Objectives.english: Complete 4 dungeons on Mythic difficulty.

Description.text: 当战争使者的标记在夜空中闪烁时，星辰将会强化已有的羁绊，并会创建新的联系。想要获取友谊并不容易，你需要通过自己的行为来证明忠诚，但在这样的日子中，信任会变得更容易创建。冲进地穴与要塞的深处，证明你的价值。
Description.english: When the sign of the emissary shines in the night sky, the stars strengthen existing bonds and forge new ones. Friendship is still not cheaply won, and deeds will prove loyalty, but trust comes more readily during these days. Venture deep into caverns and strongholds to prove your worth.

identity.title: The Very Best
identity.objectives: Defeat 5 players through Find Battle with a team of level 25 pets.
identity.description: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

Objectives.text: 帶著由25級寵物組成的隊伍，透過對戰搜尋功能打倒5位玩家。
Objectives.english: Defeat 5 players through Find Battle with a team of level 25 pets.

Description.text: 這種星象十分怪異，它讓最小的生物顯現出異於平常的習性。沒有一位賢者能夠解釋這種現象，但是聰明的訓練師可以從中獲益良多，尤其是和同伴對戰、考驗技巧。
Description.english: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

identity.title: By Any Means
identity.objectives: Gain entrance to the Violet Hold and interrogate Taldath the Destroyer to find out the location of the traitor Varedis.
identity.description: We need to figure out what rock Varedis is hiding under - the only way we're going to do that is by getting inside this prison.$B$BDo what you must.

Progress.text: 真是让人印象深刻。
Progress.english: A truly impressive display.

identity.title: Command of the Seas
identity.objectives: Upgrade to a Level 2 shipyard.
identity.description: Gul'dan wasted no time integrating his Shadow Council minions into every rank of the Iron Horde. The naval fleet that once owed loyalty only to Grommash is now his to command. If we want to fight back, we're going to need more than just a couple of transport ships. We must build an arsenal.$b$bWe need your expertise, commander. Upgrade your dockyards and create a fleet capable of dominating the seas!

Objectives.text: 升到2级船坞。
Objectives.english: Upgrade to a Level 2 shipyard.

Description.text: 古尔丹正在争分夺秒地推动暗影议会的爪牙全面渗透钢铁部落。曾经只效忠格罗玛什的海军舰队现在已经被他控制了。如果我们想反击，几艘运输舰是不够的。我们必须建造武装舰船。$b$b我们需要你的专业知识，指挥官。快去升级你的码头，组建一支足以称霸诸海的舰队吧！
Description.english: Gul'dan wasted no time integrating his Shadow Council minions into every rank of the Iron Horde. The naval fleet that once owed loyalty only to Grommash is now his to command. If we want to fight back, we're going to need more than just a couple of transport ships. We must build an arsenal.$b$bWe need your expertise, commander. Upgrade your dockyards and create a fleet capable of dominating the seas!

identity.title: Critters of Draenor
identity.objectives: Defeat Erris the Collector in a pet battle.
identity.description: I love collecting pets, and I've picked up a few unusual pets here in Draenor.  What would you say to a battle?  If you can defeat my humble team, I think we'll both learn a few new tricks.

Objectives.text: 在宠物对战中击败收藏家爱瑞斯。
Objectives.english: Defeat Erris the Collector in a pet battle.

Description.text: 我喜欢收集宠物，而且已经在德拉诺发现了几个罕见的小家伙。你想跟我打一场吗？要是你能击败我这几员小将，我想我们都会从这场切磋中受益匪浅的。
Description.english: I love collecting pets, and I've picked up a few unusual pets here in Draenor.  What would you say to a battle?  If you can defeat my humble team, I think we'll both learn a few new tricks.

CompletionLog.text: 与爱瑞斯谈一谈。

identity.title: Demon Destroyer
identity.objectives: Slay Doomcaller, Sneermaw, and Grinchain
identity.description:
The demons spreading this corruption must be dealt with. Kill their generals and their plans will unravel.

I have a gift for you. This horn was given to me by Odyn himself, use it to strike down all that stand in your way.

The gods will surely smile upon you if you thwart the advances of Legion.

Objectives.text: 消灭厄运召唤者、嘲喉，以及笑链。
Objectives.english: Slay Doomcaller, Sneermaw, and Grinchain

Description.text:
我们必须解决这些散播腐化的恶魔。去除掉他们的将领，让他们的计划泡汤。

我有件礼物要给你。这是奥丁亲手赠予我的号角，用它去扫清一切障碍吧。

如果你能挫败燃烧军团的锐气，众神一定会倍感欣慰。
Description.english:
The demons spreading this corruption must be dealt with. Kill their generals and their plans will unravel.

I have a gift for you. This horn was given to me by Odyn himself, use it to strike down all that stand in your way.

The gods will surely smile upon you if you thwart the advances of Legion.

CompletionLog.text: 占位符
CompletionLog.english: xxx

identity.title: Possessions of Power
identity.objectives: Seek those who may offer insight into the origins of the shard.
identity.description: Echoes of a thousand worlds swirl in the palm of your hand. Its true value lies in the eye of the beholder.

Objectives.text: 寻找可能了解碎片来源的人。
Objectives.english: Seek those who may offer insight into the origins of the shard.

Description.text: 大千世界的回声在你的掌中回旋。只有观察者的眼睛才能看出它的真正价值。
Description.english: Echoes of a thousand worlds swirl in the palm of your hand. Its true value lies in the eye of the beholder.

identity.title: Bloodstone Bandit
identity.objectives: Recover Kira's Bloodstone from Narashi Spitescale.
identity.description:
Something of personal value has been taken from me, and my work here cannot continue until I get it back.

To most it would appear to be an ordinary stone, but it is so much more than a simple rock - it lives and breathes!

The nearby naga have been snatching anything with any sort of magical significance, my stone included. Fortunately, they do not know how to access its power.

Return my stone to me, and I will consider your request for help.

Progress.text: 你幫我拿回血石了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Has recuperado ya mi sangrita?

Completion.text: 你很有本事，我能理解瑞特辛為什麼喜歡派你辦事。
Completion.english: Tienes muchos recursos. Entiendo que a Ritssyn le guste enviarte a hacer recados.

identity.title: Equipment Blueprint: Sonic Amplification Field
identity.objectives: Return the blueprints to a Naval Equipment Specialist at your garrison shipyard.
identity.description: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment.  We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

Objectives.text: 把图纸交给你要塞船坞中的海军装备专家。
Objectives.english: Return the blueprints to a Naval Equipment Specialist at your garrison shipyard.

Description.text: 这些图纸上画的似乎是某种海军装备。我们应该把它带回到船坞去，看有没有人能够读懂。
Description.english: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment.  We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

identity.title: Equipment Blueprint: Q-43 Noisemaker Mines
identity.objectives: Return the blueprints to a Naval Equipment Specialist at your garrison shipyard.
identity.description: This appears to be a blueprint for some sort of naval equipment.  We should take it back to our Shipyard and see if someone can decipher it.

Objectives.text: 把图纸交给你要塞船坞中的海军装备专家。
