identity.title: Moonclaw's Wisdom
identity.objectives: Meet Thaon Moonclaw in his den.
identity.description: Our quick action today has stopped this aggression and saved my valley. As you requested, I will join Malfurion in the Grove of Cenarius.$B$BStill, there is much about these satyrs that I wish to tell you. This information would be most valuable to you.$B$BPlease meet me in my den before departing.

Objectives.text: 到绍恩·月爪的巢穴去找他。
Objectives.english: Meet Thaon Moonclaw in his den.

Description.text: 我们今天的快速行动成功阻止了侵略，并拯救了我的山谷。如你所求，我将前往塞纳留斯林地和玛法里奥汇合。$B$B而且，我还有很多关于这些萨特的事情想要告诉你。这些信息会对你很有帮助。$B$B请在动身之前到我的巢穴来一趟。
Description.english: Our quick action today has stopped this aggression and saved my valley. As you requested, I will join Malfurion in the Grove of Cenarius.$B$BStill, there is much about these satyrs that I wish to tell you. This information would be most valuable to you.$B$BPlease meet me in my den before departing.

identity.title: It Hungers for Blood
identity.objectives: Let the Bloodstone feed on the blood of demons.
identity.description:
Bloodstones contain a great deal of power that can only be awakened once they are fed. 

Yet this stone does not feast on fish and cakes. It hungers for blood; the more powerful, the better.

There's an infestation of demons just east of here. I need you to nourish my stone with their blood, so that I may unlock its power.

Completion.text: 看來血石滿足了。做得好！測試的時候到了…
Completion.english: La sangrita parece saciada. ¡Buen trabajo! Ahora es hora de probarla...

identity.title: NOT USED
identity.objectives: Get Oronok and your ally to destroy the barrier, then stop Gul'dan.
identity.description:
Your ally and I will remove this barrier now, though it will take a greater part of our strength. What lies beyond will not be easy.

Gul'dan will have empowered an elemental lord with the Cipher, driving it insane. He will use it to destroy the link between the elements and Draenor. If you destroy that elemental, we could recover the Cipher.

Objectives.text: 让欧鲁诺克和你的盟友摧毁屏障，然后阻止古尔丹。
Objectives.english: Get Oronok and your ally to destroy the barrier, then stop Gul'dan.

Description.text:
你的盟友和我马上就会清除这些障碍，不过这会消耗我们很大一部分力量。不管前面是什么，都不是那么容易对付的。

古尔丹利用密文强化了一个元素领主，让它变得疯狂了。他想要用它来破坏元素与德拉诺之间的联系。如果你能摧毁那个元素，我们就能收回密文了。
Description.english:
Your ally and I will remove this barrier now, though it will take a greater part of our strength. What lies beyond will not be easy.

Gul'dan will have empowered an elemental lord with the Cipher, driving it insane. He will use it to destroy the link between the elements and Draenor. If you destroy that elemental, we could recover the Cipher.

CompletionLog.text: 在塔纳安丛林腐化的避难所与欧鲁诺克谈谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Oronok at the Corrupted Refuge in Tanaan Jungle.

identity.title: Crystal Fury
identity.objectives: Slay Gelmogg.
identity.description:
A drogbar stonecaster known as Gelmogg entered our sacred water caverns and aims to draw its power into himself.

We must destroy him before he gets too powerful.

He is in the upper caverns.

Progress.text: 卓格巴尔原来只能控制大地魔法，但是他们好像找到了什么方法，使得他们能够吸取其他来源的能量。
Progress.english: Раньше этот дрогбар мог использовать только магию земли. Выходит, они нашли способ манипулировать силой и из других источников.

identity.title: Slay Them All!
identity.objectives: Slay 200 enemy players.
identity.description: Find them, hunt them, kill them. Teach our enemies a lesson they'll never forget.

Objectives.text: 杀死200名敌对玩家。
Objectives.english: Slay 200 enemy players.

Description.text: 找到他们，追猎他们，杀死他们。给我们的敌人上一堂永生难忘的课！
Description.english: Find them, hunt them, kill them. Teach our enemies a lesson they'll never forget.

CompletionLog.text: 返回你在阿什兰的基地。
CompletionLog.english: Return to your base inside Ashran.

identity.title: Slay Them All!
identity.objectives: Slay 200 enemy players.
identity.description: The Horde encroachment cannot be tolerated. Dwindle their numbers to the ground!

Objectives.text: 杀死200名敌对玩家。
Objectives.english: Slay 200 enemy players.

Description.text: 绝不能容忍部落的入侵。去把他们都干掉！
Description.english: The Horde encroachment cannot be tolerated. Dwindle their numbers to the ground!

identity.title: Treasures of Deathwing
identity.objectives: Defend Brann Bronzebeard.
identity.description: Neltharion's Vault? Well why didn't that spiritwalker just say so?$b$bWhen we were jumpin' into the cavern I thought I saw a chamber up high that might have what we are after.$b$bHave a look around this place while I see if I can't find a way up.

Objectives.text: 保护布莱恩·铜须。
Objectives.english: Defend Brann Bronzebeard.

Description.text: 奈萨里奥的宝库？那个灵魂行者怎么不早说？$b$b之前进洞穴的时候，我好像看到高处有个密室，我们要找的东西可能就在那里。$b$b先四处看看，我想想怎么上去。
Description.english: Neltharion's Vault? Well why didn't that spiritwalker just say so?$b$bWhen we were jumpin' into the cavern I thought I saw a chamber up high that might have what we are after.$b$bHave a look around this place while I see if I can't find a way up.

CompletionLog.text: 在奈萨里奥的宝库与布莱恩·铜须谈一谈。
CompletionLog.english: Speak with Brann Bronzebeard in Neltharian's Vault.

identity.title: The Call of War
identity.objectives: Speak to the Warchief.
identity.description: Welcome to Orgrimmar, the Horde's seat of power.$B$BEnter Grommash Hold straight ahead, and make your introduction to Warchief Vol'jin.$B$BHe is expecting you.

identity.title: A Sound Plan
identity.objectives: Select your first assault point on the Broken Isles.
identity.description: The Legion still believes us crippled from the Broken Shore. They think we are unable to fight back.$B$BLet's prove them wrong.$B$BWe've been hard at work mapping out the Broken Isles, learning everything we can about each region for our imminent assault.$B$BOnce you've had a chance to peruse the map, you should leave for Dalaran at once and charge into the maw of the beast.$B$BWe will end this madness for good. Light help us all.

Progress.text: 只要你一声令下，我保证完成任务。
Progress.english: As long as you give an order, I promise to complete the task.

identity.title: The Council's Approval
identity.objectives: Speak with Khadgar in Dalaran, and ask for permission to build an Obliterum Forge.
identity.description: Those results certainly were disappointing. Calcination is a tricky process, better reserved for alchemists and blacksmiths. Still, I thought we'd get more than a measly TWO GRAINS of obliterum.$b$bFor a more efficient reaction, we'll need a special forge, and to get that...$b$b...we'll need permission from the Council of Six.

Objectives.text: 在达拉然与卡德加谈一谈，针对建造抑魔金熔炉的事情征求议会的许可。
Objectives.english: Speak with Khadgar in Dalaran, and ask for permission to build an Obliterum Forge.

Description.text: 结果的确令人失望。煅烧过程难以掌控，最好是由炼金师和铁匠来进行。我万万没想到最后只有两格令抑魔金。$b$b想要得到更有效率的反应，就需要一座特制熔炉，而要建造这种熔炉的话……$b$b……我们必须得到六人议会的许可。
Description.english: Those results certainly were disappointing. Calcination is a tricky process, better reserved for alchemists and blacksmiths. Still, I thought we'd get more than a measly TWO GRAINS of obliterum.$b$bFor a more efficient reaction, we'll need a special forge, and to get that...$b$b...we'll need permission from the Council of Six.

identity.title: Friends in Low Places
identity.objectives: Report to Oxana Demonslay in the Underbelly.
identity.description: My contact is one Oxana Demonslay. She has declined invitation to Dalaran proper, preferring to stay in the sewers of the Underbelly.$b$bIf there is anybody on this rock that knows how to properly build an Obliterum Forge, it is her.$b$bOh, and watch your back while you're down there, $n.

Objectives.text: 到达拉然下水道去找奥克萨娜·屠魔。
Objectives.english: Report to Oxana Demonslay in the Underbelly.

Description.text: 我的联络人叫奥克萨娜·屠魔。她拒绝了达拉然市区的邀请，而选择在下水道里工作。$b$b在这座漂浮的城市里，知道建造抑魔金熔炉的正确方法的人就只有她了。$b$b对了，你在下水道的时候一定要多加小心，$n。
Description.english: My contact is one Oxana Demonslay. She has declined invitation to Dalaran proper, preferring to stay in the sewers of the Underbelly.$b$bIf there is anybody on this rock that knows how to properly build an Obliterum Forge, it is her.$b$bOh, and watch your back while you're down there, $n.

identity.title: Toll for the Soul
identity.objectives: Defeat Helya and free the Valarjar.
identity.description:
[PH] As foretold, you have arrived... Helya is foolish to think I'll let her ferry me into Helheim. Odyn has already smiled upon me, my soul belongs in Valhallas. 

Make no mistake, I am not a prisoner. Before my death Odyn appeared to me in the form of a raven. He praised my battles in life and gave me a quest no vrykul could refuse. The Helerjar arrived... and I let them slay me.

Prisoner-- nay, I am a liberator, sent by Odyn to free the souls of Valarjar.

Objectives.text: 打败海拉并释放瓦拉加尔。
Objectives.english: Defeat Helya and free the Valarjar.

Description.text:
正如预言所说的一样，你来了……海拉真傻，以为我会乖乖来到冥狱深渊。奥德眷顾我，我的灵魂属于瓦尔哈拉。

不要误会，我不是囚犯。在我死之前，奥丁以一只渡鸦的样貌出现在我面前。他赞扬了我生前的战斗，并且交给了我一个任何维库人都无法拒绝的任务。然后赫拉加尔来了……我让他们把我杀死。

囚犯——不对，我是一位解放者，我是奥丁派来解放瓦拉加尔灵魂的勇士。
Description.english:
[PH] As foretold, you have arrived... Helya is foolish to think I'll let her ferry me into Helheim. Odyn has already smiled upon me, my soul belongs in Valhallas. 

Make no mistake, I am not a prisoner. Before my death Odyn appeared to me in the form of a raven. He praised my battles in life and gave me a quest no vrykul could refuse. The Helerjar arrived... and I let them slay me.

Prisoner-- nay, I am a liberator, sent by Odyn to free the souls of Valarjar.

identity.title: Trouble for Okuna
identity.objectives: Search for Okuna Longtusk.
identity.description:
<You open the bottle and find a message inside.>

Help! I need somebody... but not just anybody. I need a champion! I finally escaped the grasp of Prince Oceanus only to be hunted by his father, King Deepbeard.

I was enjoying my freedom and decided to go fishing when that giant attacked. I've been running around these islands trying to avoid that creature ever since... if anyone gets this message, please send help!

Objectives.text: 寻找欧库纳·长牙。
Objectives.english: Search for Okuna Longtusk.

Description.text:
<你打开瓶子，在里面找到一封信。>

救命！我需要有人帮忙……但不是任何人都帮得上忙。我需要一位勇士！我本来好不容易才逃出了欧逊努斯王子的魔掌，但是现在却遭到了他的父亲深须国王的追杀。

我原本正在享受自由，然后决定去钓鱼，但是那个巨人突然对我发起了攻击。后来我只能在小岛上不断跟他周旋……如果有人看到这封信，请赶快来帮帮我！
Description.english:
<You open the bottle and find a message inside.>

Help! I need somebody... but not just anybody. I need a champion! I finally escaped the grasp of Prince Oceanus only to be hunted by his father, King Deepbeard.

I was enjoying my freedom and decided to go fishing when that giant attacked. I've been running around these islands trying to avoid that creature ever since... if anyone gets this message, please send help!

identity.description: xxxxx

Objectives.text: 占位符
Objectives.english: xxxxx

Description.text: 占位符
Description.english: xxxxx

identity.title: Khadgar's Discovery
identity.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
identity.description: Champion! Please come to the Violet Citadel immediately.$B$BI have made a discovery that I would like to share with you before the Council of Six.

Completion.text: 謝謝你趕過來，$n。
Completion.english: Gracias por venir, $N.

identity.title: Magic Message
identity.objectives: Examine the Arcane Anomaly in Dalaran.
identity.description: For the last 10,000 years, the elven city of Suramar has been sealed in an arcane barrier, much like Dalaran once was.$B$BThat barrier has come down.$B$BSince then, waves of magical energy have been emanating from the city like ripples in a pond. It was in these waves that I sensed a pattern.$B$BA spell, encrypted among the chaos.$B$BI have recreated the spell here. It's not dangerous, but beyond that... I have no idea what it does!

Completion.text: 一道魔法訊息，居然能夠從燃燒軍團的監視下傳出…非常聰明。
Completion.english: Un mensaje mágico en una botella, enviado ante las narices de la Legión... Ingenioso.

identity.title: Trail of Echoes
identity.objectives: Use Khadgar's Wand to find Arcane Echoes and track down First Arcanist Thalyssra.
identity.description:
The Nightborne could prove powerful allies against the Legion. We must aid this Thalyssra if we can.

We should be able to find her by tracking her magical echoes, the same way I found her distress call.

I can teleport you near the location where she recorded that message. From there, you must search for ripples in the very fabric of the arcane itself.

My wand should do the trick. Follow the sparks it creates--they should lead you to places where Thalyssra used her magic.

Completion.text:
是個外地人…

你收到了我的信息？
Completion.english: Un forastero...$B$B¿Recibiste mi mensaje?

identity.title: A Familiar Fate
identity.objectives: Collect the Jailer's Shard from Dravax and free Vethir from his prison.
identity.description:
We had come to defend the Halls of Valor... I was taken from the sky...

I cannot break free of my bindings. Find the jailer who made this cell...

Set me free, friend...

Progress.text: 狱卒有……钥匙……
Progress.english: Ключ... у тюремщика...

identity.title: The Only Way Out is Through
identity.objectives: Escort Thalyssra to safety.
identity.description:
I have much to tell you, but it is not safe to speak here. I cannot hold this barrier forever.

<Thalyssra lifts a delicate flask to her lips. Her eyes shimmer as she takes a sip.>

If we push through, we may find shelter up ahead.

Completion.text:
你很善戰。

我想應該是時候正式的向你自我介紹。
Completion.english: Luchas bien.$B$BTal vez sea hora de una presentación formal.

identity.title: Arcane Thirst
identity.objectives: Enter Shal'Aran and find something to sate Thalyssra's thirst.
identity.description:
My people have subsisted on the Nightwell for millennia. Ancient mana is our lifeblood - without it, we become... well, you saw them out there.

<Thalyssra holds her flask aloft, gently shaking free the last precious drops.>

I'm afraid I have been rather reckless today. 

Already, my senses are dulling. Without magic to feed upon, I will turn. 

Please... find me something to feed upon... anything...

Progress.text: <薩莉瑟拉眼神渙散，身體不斷顫抖。>
Progress.english: <Los ojos de Thalyssra se han apagado y su cuerpo se convulsiona de modo incontrolable.>

Completion.text: <薩莉瑟拉用顫抖的手拿著水晶。>
Completion.english: <Thalyssra coge los cristales con mano temblorosa.>

identity.title: Tapping the Leylines
identity.objectives: Explore Anora Hollow and find the Ley Station there.
identity.description: The arcways were built to tap into the magical leylines beneath Suramar. As we learned to subsist on the Nightwell, the old facilities fell out of use.$B$BThis chamber is clearly receiving power from elsewhere.$B$BThere is only a trickle now, but if you can direct more leyline energy here it will help to sustain us.$B$BThe closest source is to the north, near Anora Hollow.

Completion.text: 你又是誰？
Completion.english: ¿Y tú quién eres?

identity.title: Oculeth's Workshop
identity.objectives: Give the First Arcanist's Token to Chief Telemancer Oculeth.
identity.description:
We need to make contact with Chief Telemancer Oculeth, the man who developed Suramar's teleportation network. 

Oculeth had a workshop in old Suramar, from the age before the Sundering. He may be taking refuge there.

<Thalyssra presses a small coin into your palm.>

If you find him, show him this. Hopefully you see him before he sees you...

Completion.text: 等到我這裡的工作完成後，請你帶我去找薩莉瑟拉。
Completion.english: Podrás llevarme hasta Thalyssra en cuanto mi trabajo aquí esté terminado.

identity.title: An Old Ally
identity.objectives: Find Arcanist Kel'danath's hideout in Ambervale.
identity.description:
I was on my way to Ambervale in hopes of finding an old colleague.

Arcanist Kel'danath was fascinated by the withered. He studied them for years hoping to calm their feral nature or even cure them.

When one of his subjects escaped and ran amok in the royal gardens, Kel'danath was ordered to cease his research and kill all withered in his possession. He refused, and was exiled.

If Kel'danath lives, he is near withered. And withered are drawn to old settlements like Ambervale.

Completion.text: <有人居住於此的痕跡。這份捲軸上書寫著奇異的文字，發出溫暖的光芒，使你忍不住伸出手觸摸。>
Completion.english: <Alguien ha estado viviendo aquí recientemente. Este pergamino tiene una letra extraña que emite un fulgor cálido que atrae tu mano.>

identity.title: The Nightborne Pact
identity.objectives: Bandage Thalyssra.
identity.description:
<Thalyssra winces and holds her abdomen.>

Ngh... I can ignore this wound no longer.

Help me patch this up. I will explain everything.

Completion.text: 我們得想辦法奪回蘇拉瑪爾城。
Completion.english: Debemos encontrar un modo de recuperar la Ciudad de Suramar.

identity.title: Branch of the Arcan'dor
identity.objectives: Speak with Thalyssra.
identity.description:
You have used the spellstone of Kel'danath to soothe countless withered. Yet it contains merely a shade of the arcan'dor's power, drawn from its slumbering seed. 

<Thalyssra holds aloft a gleaming white branch.>

This fell from the tree. Though it is severed, it is not dead - invisible threads of magic bind all pieces of the arcan'dor together.

I have enchanted this branch with a new iteration of Kel'danath's charm spell. With it, you can mend the arcane essence of even more withered. Use it well.

Completion.text: 我從沒想到，我居然會在被流放的時候，跑來研究凋萎者。透過他們，我又對我的族人有了更深刻的認識，也更加瞭解我們與夜井的關係。
Completion.english: Jamás imaginé que pasaría mi tiempo en el exilio estudiando a los Marchitos. Gracias a ellos he aprendido mucho sobre mi propia gente y la naturaleza de nuestra relación con la Fuente de la Noche.

identity.title: Repairing the Source
identity.objectives: You have found a damaged power core for an arcane construct. It seems like you could repair the device.
identity.description: <A glint catches your eye in the dirt. A brief excavation yields a mostly intact piece of an arcane construct's power core. The breaks appear to be clean, perhaps you could repair it if you find the other fragments.>

Objectives.text: 你找到一个受损的奥术构造体能量核心。似乎你可以修复这个装置。
Objectives.english: You have found a damaged power core for an arcane construct. It seems like you could repair the device.

Description.text: <尘土中有一道亮光引起了你的注意。稍微挖掘以后，你找到一个还算完整的奥术构造体能量核心。裂口十分整齐，如果能够找到其他的碎片，或许可以将它修复。>
Description.english: <A glint catches your eye in the dirt. A brief excavation yields a mostly intact piece of an arcane construct's power core. The breaks appear to be clean, perhaps you could repair it if you find the other fragments.>

identity.title: Magic Clams
identity.objectives: Collect Infused Clams from Seerspine murlocs in the Murloc Shoals.
identity.description: <The clam resonates with a arcane energy.>$B$BWhat are murlocs doing with arcane clams?$B$BPerhaps your Nightfallen allies could make use of them.

Objectives.text: 从鱼人浅滩的幻脊鱼人身上收集灌魔蛤蜊。
Objectives.english: Collect Infused Clams from Seerspine murlocs in the Murloc Shoals.

Description.text: <蛤蜊与奥术能量产生了共鸣。>$B$B鱼人拿这些奥术蛤蜊来做什么？$B$B或许它们对你的堕夜精灵朋友会有用处。
Description.english: <The clam resonates with a arcane energy.>$B$BWhat are murlocs doing with arcane clams?$B$BPerhaps your Nightfallen allies could make use of them.

identity.title: Tapping the Underground
identity.objectives: Destroy Seerspine Conduits in the Murloc Shoals.
identity.description: Have you seen them, $n?$B$BThese are not ordinary murlocs. They have been drawn by the ley line that flows from Azsuna into this land. $B$BSomehow they have managed to tap into its arcane current and are tapping its power for their own devious purposes.$B$BThese disturbances must be stopped if the ley line is to remain intact.

Objectives.text: 破坏鱼人浅滩的幻脊导管。
Objectives.english: Destroy Seerspine Conduits in the Murloc Shoals.

Description.text: 你见过他们吗，$n？$B$B这些可不是普通的鱼人。他们被阿苏纳流经此处的魔网能量线深深吸引。$B$B他们接入奥术之流，拿魔力来干坏事。$B$B要保护魔网的话，就必须阻止他们的侵扰。
Description.english: Have you seen them, $n?$B$BThese are not ordinary murlocs. They have been drawn by the ley line that flows from Azsuna into this land. $B$BSomehow they have managed to tap into its arcane current and are tapping its power for their own devious purposes.$B$BThese disturbances must be stopped if the ley line is to remain intact.

identity.title: Leying with Murlocs
identity.objectives: Infuse yourself with ley energies located in the Murloc Shoals.
identity.description: I have seen these Seerspine summon minor elementals, which is no small feat for a murloc, but their high summoner, Blargrrrl, is trying to summon Torretus from the river.$B$BI doubt a mere murloc has the capabilities to control an entity as powerful as Torrentus.$B$BBlargrrrl will be deeply entranced if he is trying such a feat. We'll need something powerful to halt his ritual.$B$BInfuse yourself with ley energies and return to me.

Objectives.text: 在鱼人浅滩为自己灌注魔网能量。
Objectives.english: Infuse yourself with ley energies located in the Murloc Shoals.

Description.text: 我见过幻脊召唤小型元素，这对鱼人来说不算稀奇。但是他们的高阶召唤师布莱格正在试图从河流之中召唤托伦图斯。$B$B我怀疑，鱼人光靠自己的能力不足以控制像托伦图斯这般强大的实体。$B$B布莱格尝试如此的举动，肯定会陷入极端的痴迷。我们需要强大的力量去阻止他的仪式。$B$B去为自己灌注魔网能量，然后回来找我。
Description.english: I have seen these Seerspine summon minor elementals, which is no small feat for a murloc, but their high summoner, Blargrrrl, is trying to summon Torretus from the river.$B$BI doubt a mere murloc has the capabilities to control an entity as powerful as Torrentus.$B$BBlargrrrl will be deeply entranced if he is trying such a feat. We'll need something powerful to halt his ritual.$B$BInfuse yourself with ley energies and return to me.

identity.title: Debt Repaid
identity.objectives: Speak to Ritssyn Flamescowl.
identity.description:
I have a few urgent matters to take care of, but soon after I will make my way to Dreadscar Rift and aid you with your summoning.

You should warn Ritssyn to keep his distance. I'll be there to repay my debt to you, not to speak to the hypocrite who chose the council over his friends.

Completion.text:
你的消息還沒傳來這裡，琪拉就先來了。她不久前剛來到這裡，但她顯然有意避開我的目光。

你居然能夠得到她的信任，這是我辦不到的。有了她的幫忙，我們應該就可以召喚傳送門了。
Completion.english: Parece que Kira es más rápida que tu palabra. Llegó hace unos instantes, aunque me evitó la mirada.$B$BAl ganarte su confianza has conseguido algo que yo no pude. Con su ayuda, invocaremos el portal.

identity.title: Bad Intentions
identity.objectives: Speak with Thaedris Feathersong in Tel'anor.
identity.description: Suramar is lost.$b$bOur leaders struck a dark bargain, accepting the Legion as our allies. We were meant to be heroes, guardians - the people resting here. We are not like them any more. I cannot live with them.$b$bBut cut off from the Nightwell, we wither and devolve into a mindless existence. An existence without release or dignity, as you can see even here...$b$bI rejected both of these options and found myself here. I will find a third way.

Completion.text: 陌生人的花言巧語，雖然動聽，但無法動搖我的決心。快過來，依現在這種速度，在我們完成之前我大概都凋萎了。
Completion.english: Palabras zalameras de un desconocido. Si bien reconfortan, no me hacen cambiar de idea. Vamos, a este paso me marchitaré antes de que hayamos acabado.

identity.title: The Lost Advisor
identity.objectives: Collect 8 Cliffthorn.
identity.description: You may as well assist me while you are here. I require a potion to be made, one that will set things right.$b$bI must conserve my energy until my task is finished, lest I become like these miserable wretches scrabbling at the cobblestones. There is coin in it for you, since I will not be needing it soon.$b$bThe harpies around here cannot resist cliffthorn. It is what drew them to Tel'anor in the first place. $b$bYou should find plenty just outside this building.

Progress.text: <泰德里斯盯著蘇拉瑪爾，似乎陷入沉思。>
Progress.english: <Thaedris parece perdido en sus pensamientos mientras mira hacia la Ciudad de Suramar.>

Completion.text:
<你靠近的時候，泰德里斯才從沉思中回神。>

這樣夠了，$r。

峭壁荊棘是一種致命的毒藥，正好符合我的需要。
Completion.english: <Thaedris sale de sus pensamientos cuando te acercas.>$B$BCon esto bastará, $R.$B$BLa riscoespina es un veneno letal y será perfecta para mis necesidades.

identity.title: Tiny Poacher, Tiny Animals
identity.objectives: Defeat Grixis Tinypop in a pet battle.

Objectives.text: 在宠物战斗中击败格里克斯·微泡。
Objectives.english: Defeat Grixis Tinypop in a pet battle.

identity.title: Tools of the Trade
identity.objectives: Retrieve burial objects for Thaedris.
identity.description: I used to visit here before the barrier was raised. While the ruling council and the Grand Magistrix argued and politicked I watched the caretakers  perform their rituals and venerate the dead.$b$bI would honor the spirits here one last time. I am headed to the tombs. If some of the sacred oils, burial shrouds, or incense survived the ages then bring them to me.

Progress.text: 有什麼收獲嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Has encontrado algo?

Completion.text:
這正是我們保存技術的證明。我本來不抱期望，經過洗劫和歲月的摧殘還會有東西留下。

先祖們肯定會很高興的。
Completion.english: Un auténtico testimonio de nuestras técnicas de conservación. Había perdido la esperanza de que algo hubiera sobrevivido al saqueo y al paso del tiempo.$B$BLos ancestros estarán complacidos.

identity.title: The Last Chapter
identity.objectives: Find the Encyclopedia Botanica.
identity.description: The next step of my journey requires a tome, but I find that I am still unable to idly sit by as this place continues to fall into disrepair.$b$bI will tidy up the memorials while you go fetch me the tome. It is called the Encyclopedia Botanica and you can find it in the library near the main plaza.

Progress.text: 你拿到書了嗎，$r？
Progress.english: ¿Tienes el libro, $R?

Completion.text:
唉。既然你在幫我做事，我想必應該要問問你的名字。

<泰德里斯把手伸進書中，拉出一株陌生的乾枯植物。>

謝謝你幫我取得下一種材料。我對你的協助…感念在心，$n。
Completion.english: Mmm. Supongo que, si me ayudas con mi tarea, debería saber cómo te llamas.$B$B<Thaedris mete la mano en el libro y saca una planta seca desconocida.>$B$BGracias por traerme otro de los ingredientes.Tu ayuda se... agradece, $N.

identity.title: Glaive Circumstances
identity.objectives: Retrieve Lyana Darksorrow's glaives.
identity.description: I came here on a mission to slay the demon eredar, Azoran. During my infiltration, I was shot down from my felbat and captured.$b$bI'm not going to mince words, $n. Azoran plans to use the Burning Legion command ship to destroy Dalaran.$b$bTo stop him, I will need my warglaives that were lost during my fall from the sky. I would retrieve them myself, but I'm still weakened from my imprisonment.$b$bSearch for the warglaives on the northern side of the crater, where I was shot down.

Progress.text: $r，你拿到我的戰刃了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Tienes mis gujas, $R?

Completion.text:
謝謝你。既然我拿回戰刃了，我要夷平魔魂堡。

我的怒火無人能擋，復仇之前不會停息。
Completion.english: Gracias. Ahora que he recuperado mis gujas de guerra, llevaré la ruina al Bastión Alma Vil.$B$BMi cólera es infinita y mi venganza presta.

identity.title: Fragments of Memory
identity.objectives: Retrieve 15 Tel'anor Mementos.
identity.description: <The beautiful elven burial urn is shattered carelessly on the ground. It was clearly handled roughly, but not scratched by the talons of the harpies.>$b$b<You find a trail of shards leading towards a cave. Those responsible are certainly within. Thaedris would be interested in the relics and their safe return.>

Progress.text: 你帶了什麼來？
Progress.english: ¿Qué tienes ahí?

Completion.text:
這些聖物是曾經埋骨於此的生命的象徵與遺物，他們希望被後世所銘記，而這些祭禮使他們得以長眠。

死者的魂魄如今能安息了，我得感謝你。
Completion.english: Estas reliquias son recuerdos de las antiguas vidas de los que se encuentran enterrados aquí. A ellos les gustaría ser recordados, y estas ofrendas los mantienen en paz eterna.$B$BLos espíritus de los caídos podrán descansar. Tienes mis agradecimientos.

identity.title: End of the Line
identity.objectives: Speak with Thaedris at the upper landing of Tel'anor.
identity.description: I cannot call Suramar my home any more, and I refuse to become a withered abomination. There is no place for me anymore, don't you understand?$b$bWe only need one last ingredient to complete the elixir. You will help me, won't you?

Completion.text: 你說得也有道理，$n。但我的決心不會動搖。
Completion.english: A tus argumentos no les falta peso, $N. Pero me mantengo firme.

identity.title: The Final Ingredient
identity.objectives: Find Latara's bow.
identity.description: The potion is complete, $n. Soon our journey will be over. There is one last thing I would have you do for me, then you shall have your reward.$b$bMy wife's bow was kept here, but I have not been able to find it after searching everywhere. There is potent magic in it.$b$bI fear one of the restless spirits may have taken it, but it would take a powerful force to pick up an item such as this. Be careful.

Progress.text: 什麼？我聽到熟悉的聲音…但不可能。
Progress.english: ¿Qué ha sido eso? He oído una voz familiar... Imposible.

Completion.text:
你看見菈塔娜了？怎麼回事？

…我知道了。對不起讓妳失望了，吾愛。
Completion.english: ¿Has visto a Latara? ¿Qué ha pasado?$B$BEntiendo. Siento tanto haberte fallado, amor mío.

identity.title: Band of Blood Brothers
identity.objectives: Locate Katarine, Fjolrik, and Stokalfr in Muddledeep Cavern.
identity.description: You are the one that Toryl was bellowing about? Perhaps you can help me.$B$BWhen I set out to search for Throndyr, I was not alone. Three vrykul loyal to Throndyr also accompanied me. As you can plainly see, I now stand alone.$B$BFind my kin, $n.$B$BI cannot bear to think that they also share Throndyr's fate.

Completion.text: 我的族人安然無恙。現在我們來解決這些毒蛇！
Completion.english: Mi familia está a salvo. Ahora, ¡encarguémonos de las serpientes!

identity.title: Feathersong's Redemption
identity.objectives: Slay the Cliffclutch Matriarch.
identity.description: I must confess I was not entirely honest with you, $n. I meant to drink the potion and join my wife.$b$bAnd even she was taken from her rest... I cannot fail her again. I must live and do what I can to stop this coming storm to be worthy of joining her.$b$bCome, young one. Let us take care of the harpy matriarch and restore Tel'anor to its former glory. We cannot let this poison go to waste, eh?

Completion.text: 謝謝你，$n。你使我看清我的目標，給了我繼續活下去的理由。我們並肩作戰，就能夠拯救蘇拉瑪爾，並彌補我族人所犯下的罪。
Completion.english: Gracias, $N. Me has dado un objetivo claro y un motivo para volver a vivir. Juntos salvaremos Suramar y expiaremos los pecados de mi pueblo.

identity.title: Arcane Communion
identity.objectives: Feed Theryn 300 Ancient Mana.
identity.description:
All of Kel'danath's experiments to connect with the withered failed, and some even made them more dangerous.

Until he found Theryn.

His arcane essence - the very soul of the shal'dorei - had been touched by something special. But what? 

By weaving my arcane essence together with Theryn's, I can create an empathic bond. This communion will bare his soul to us all - or what's left of it. 

We need only to feed him mana, and lots of it, in order to begin.

Completion.text: 很好。來看看我們會有什麼發現。
Completion.english: Bien. A ver qué averiguamos.

identity.title: Scenes from a Memory
identity.objectives: Help Thalyssra complete the arcane communion with Theryn.
identity.description:
Theryn is at the mercy of his own mind. Whatever we find in there, it may be difficult to control.

I will need your help to sort through the visions, so be ready for anything.

With any luck, we will discover what makes Theryn special. And... whether there is anything left of who he used to be.

Completion.text:
凋萎者…對夜井的迫切渴望使他們生不如死，同時他們本身的記憶也在折磨他們。

確實是比死亡更悲慘的命運…
Completion.english: Los Marchitos... no solo sufren una sed angustiosa por la Fuente de la Noche, sino que sus propios recuerdos también los torturan.$B$BSin duda, su destino es peor que la muerte...

identity.title: Scattered Memories
identity.objectives: Inspect $1oa pages of Kel'danath's Notes.
identity.description:
<As your fingers trace the elegant symbols on the page, a voice dictates the words in your mind.

It seems the nightborne have elevated even simple note-taking to a sorcerous art.

Arcanist Kel'danath was definitely working in this area. There must be more of his notes scattered around.>

Completion.text: <一個裝著許多頁技術筆記的袋子。快速翻閱後，你找到克達納茲的最後一篇記錄。>
Completion.english: <Una bolsa con innumerables páginas de notas técnicas. Al hojearlas, encuentras la última anotación del diario de Kel'danath.>

identity.title: A Fate Worse Than Dying
identity.objectives: Open $1oa Soul Engine Cages.
identity.description: When the Burning Legion takes a prisoner, it is not an act of mercy.$b$bWhile death is the destruction of the mortal body... if you are captured by the Legion, they will seek to destroy your soul.$b$bThe Burning Legion uses sacrificial souls to power their demonic machinations of war. The soul engine is where the harvested souls are collected and stored.$b$bThough countless have already perished in the soul engine, you may yet save those still alive inside.$b$bHurry and release them before it is too late!

Completion.text: 靈魂被摧毀是比死還可怕的下場。你拯救了那些靈魂，做得很好。
Completion.english: La destrucción del alma es un destino mucho peor que la muerte. Has prestado un gran servicio a los que has salvado.

identity.title: Bite of the Sashj'tar
identity.objectives: Collect 8 Sashj'tar Fangs from Sashj'tar naga in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: If I had been by Throndyr's side when he fought the naga, he might still be alive.$B$BThese serpents will regret the day that they decided to slither from their watery hole!$B$BKilling them is not enough. No! I will honor Throndyr with a necklace of naga fangs!

Progress.text: 我們要把這些蛇殺光！
Progress.english: ¡Los mataremos a todos!

Completion.text: 我會一直配戴這條項鍊，紀念索隆迪爾！
Completion.english: ¡Usaré esto en honor a Throndyr!

identity.title: Beach Bonfire
identity.objectives: Collect 6 Driftwood in Azuregale Bay and build a funeral pyre for Jarl Throndyr.
identity.description: Do not let... my body lie in... the mud.$B$BSet my flesh... aflame.

Progress.text: 索隆迪爾不應該死得這麼慘。
Progress.english: Throndyr merecía una muerte más honorable.

Completion.text: 向索隆迪爾致敬。願你的靈魂在英靈殿中尋得一席之地。
Completion.english: Salve, Jarl Throndyr. Que tu alma encuentre su lugar en Valhalas.

identity.title: Fisherman's Tonic
identity.objectives: Collect 4 Axetail Eyes from Axetail Basilisks, a Sashj'tar Air Bladder from Sashj'tar Naga, and a Sample of Siren Blood from Siren Naz'jul in Azuregale Cove.
identity.description: If you detest these serpents as much as we do, I ask that you continue the fight against them.$B$BThat will mean fighting them in their watery domain. I don't see any gills on you, so we're going to have to concoct an old tonic used by vrykul fishermen.$B$BThe ingredients are plentiful around here, taken that you do not mind picking through entrails.

Progress.text: 我會幫忙收集我們需要的東西。
Progress.english: Te ayudaré a reunir lo que necesitamos.

Completion.text:
<布蘭道夫把配方混合。>

好吧，我可沒說過這東西會好入口。乾杯。
Completion.english: <Brandolf mezcla el brebaje.>$B$BBueno, nunca dije que tendría buen sabor. Hasta el fondo.

identity.title: Sashj'tar Accord DISABLED
identity.objectives: Show the stone tablet to Toryl.
identity.description: <This stone tablet appears to be a contract between Tidemistress Sashj'tar and King Forgalash.$B$BAs far as you can decipher, the naga are recruiting the sea giants on behalf of Queen Azshara.>

Objectives.text: 把石板给托尔里看。
Objectives.english: Show the stone tablet to Toryl.

Description.text: <这块石板似乎是潮汐主母萨吉塔与弗加拉什国王之间的合约。$B$B从你所能解读的信息来看，纳迦正在以艾萨拉女王的名义招募海巨人。>
Description.english: <This stone tablet appears to be a contract between Tidemistress Sashj'tar and King Forgalash.$B$BAs far as you can decipher, the naga are recruiting the sea giants on behalf of Queen Azshara.>

identity.title: Turning the Tidemistress
identity.objectives: Construct a Makeshift Ballista and kill Tidemistress Sashj'tar in the Sashj'tar Ruins.
identity.description: The Tidemistress has fallen back to the elven ruins and is licking her wounds.$B$BHer guard is undoubtedly protecting her. To best her, you will have to break her defenses.$B$BConstruct a ballista using the parts that you salvaged and end her once and for all.

Completion.text: 你辦到了，$n。你成功殺死了海潮祭司並從沙許塔爾納迦手中拯救了詹德維克。
Completion.english: Lo has conseguido, $N. Has matado a la maestra de las mareas y salvado Jandvik de los Sashj'tar.

identity.title: Surprise the Sashj'tar
identity.objectives: Kill 12 Sashj'tar Champions or Sashj'tar Deep Witches in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: The naga are preoccupied with recruiting the sea giants for Queen Azshara's battles in other lands.$B$BNow is the time to strike!

Objectives.text: 在蓝风海湾消灭12个萨吉塔勇士或萨吉塔深海女巫。
Objectives.english: Kill 12 Sashj'tar Champions or Sashj'tar Deep Witches in Azuregale Bay.

Description.text: 纳迦正忙着招募巨人在其它大陆上与艾萨拉女王作战。$B$B现在正是进攻的好时机！
Description.english: The naga are preoccupied with recruiting the sea giants for Queen Azshara's battles in other lands.$B$BNow is the time to strike!

identity.title: Something in the Water
identity.objectives: Slay 12 Mana-corrupted Waterspawn.
identity.description: There is something fouling these waters, $c.$b$bWe will need to purify the waters in order to restore balance to the elemental forces below this ruin.$b$bThe magic here has warped the elementals and they are beyond restoration. Release their corrupted forms so that they may be reborn pure.

Completion.text: 我們已經驅除了腐化，新生的水元素現在可以蓬勃成長了。
Completion.english: Ahora que hemos limpiado la corrupción, podrán florecer nuevos elementales de agua.

identity.title: Bubble Trouble
identity.objectives: Collect a piece of Needle Coral and then rescue 5 Captured Vrykul in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: $C! The sea giants have already eaten half of my kin.$B$BWe are helpless in these accursed bubbles. I beseech you to get us out of here.$B$BTake heed. These bubbles are strong. You will need something that is extremely sharp to pierce them.

Progress.text: 動作快，$c！這些海巨人的食慾是無底洞！
Progress.english: ¡Date prisa, $C! ¡Estos gigantes de mar tienen un apetito insaciable!

Completion.text: 被消化這種死法實在很不光榮。
Completion.english: No hay gloria ni honor en acabar digerido.

identity.title: Turtle Powered
identity.objectives: Collect 7 Shimmering Snapper Scales.
identity.description: In order to locate and purify the source of the corruption I am going to need an elemental focus.$b$bThe turtles around here have developed scales that can focus and amplify their innate magics. Bring back some snapper scales and we will have these waters purified in no time!

Progress.text: 記住，這些鱗片必須完整無缺，才能作為焦點。
Progress.english: Recuerda, las escamas tienen que estar enteras para poder usarlas como enfoque.

Completion.text: 這些非常合用。
Completion.english: Estas servirán.

identity.title: Purge the Unclean
identity.objectives: Defeat the corruption in the Azurefall Guardian.
identity.description: Do you feel it in the air, $r? The stage is set for us to make things right.$b$bWhile you were busy I was able to track down the elder elemental that rules these waters. Its name is the Azurefall Guardian and it resides within the channels below Tel'anor.$b$bTake the ritual focus, it should help you during the battle.

Completion.text:
完成了。我已能感到腐敗的存在逐漸被驅淨。

感謝你，$n，你幫了這地方大忙。
Completion.english: Hecho. Ya noto cómo se disipa la presencia corruptora.$B$BGracias, $N. Le has hecho un gran servicio a este lugar.

identity.title: Take Me To Your Leader
identity.objectives: Meet with Khadgar in Suramar.
identity.description: I am glad you are here, $n.$b$bThis... Khadgar, the archmage who found my message, has called a meeting.$b$bHe wishes to meet us at the entrance to the city as soon as possible.$b$bWill you accompany me? I have the strangest feeling that he will not be alone.

Completion.text: 勇士，又見面了。看來大家都到了。
Completion.english: Hola otra vez, campeón. Veo que ya estamos todos.

identity.title: Clandestine Operation
identity.objectives: Speak to Vereesa Windrunner.
identity.description: You have long been a trusted hero of the Alliance, $n. And like the rest of us, you have endured many hardships to reach this point.$b$bNow, I must ask even more of you. Will you hear me out?

Progress.text: 现在你必须决定，是否要和我们同生共死。
Progress.english: Now you have to decide whether you want to live and die with us.

identity.title: A Way Back In
identity.objectives: Find the smuggler.
identity.description: I must get back into Suramar.$b$bI was exiled unfairly! I cannot live out here like this. I need the Nightwell's energies...$b$bI saw a message carved into a wall a few days ago. There is someone in the Water Gardens who can smuggle people into the city.$b$bIt said "We shall drink of the Well again."$b$bI cannot survive a confrontation with the guards again. Will you go in my stead? Once I am back in the city I can repay you.

Completion.text: 為了你我著想，我希望你沒被跟蹤。我們動作要快，我就快要成功了。
Completion.english: Espero por el bien de los dos que no te hayan seguido. Debemos actuar con rapidez, teniendo en cuenta lo cerca que estoy.

identity.title: Azoran Must Die
identity.objectives: Defeat Azoran in Felsoul Hold.
identity.description: You won't have much time before the Legion is aware of your presence on the ship.$b$bWhen the alarm is raised, countless Burning Legion forces will attempt to board the ship through this portal.$b$bI will not let them succeed.$b$bI will guard this portal from enemy reinforcements until you return. It is up to you to slay Azoran and lay waste to his ship.$b$bWe don't have much time... you must attack swiftly and without mercy.

Completion.text:
在阿佐朗死後，燃燒軍團的元氣大傷，一時之間難以復原。

你贏得我的尊敬，$n。
Completion.english: Con la muerte de Azoran, la Legión ha recibido un duro golpe del que tardará en recuperarse.$B$BTienes mi respeto, $N.

identity.title: A Desperate Journey
identity.objectives: Follow the lamp posts to take Iadreth to Astoril.
identity.description: The city's entrances are under heavy guard. He must have another way.$b$bThanks to this wine I am strong enough to make the journey to him. I fear that I will not be able to defend or run if I come under attack.$b$bYou will accompany me, $r. You and this Astoril are my only chance at surviving now. $b$bI remember when I was leaving the city that there were lamps guiding me here. We should be able to retrace our steps by following them.

Completion.text:
非常好。你在這裡的工作完成了。

你幫了我很大的忙，請好好休息一下。

拿去，這是你的報酬。聊表我的一點心意。
Completion.english: Excelente. Tu cometido aquí ha terminado.$B$BQue sepas que me has hecho un gran favor.$B$BTen, toma este pago. Un pequeño obsequio por tu servicio.

identity.title: Final Preparations
identity.objectives: Recover 6 stashed supplies.
identity.description: We will need supplies for our trip into Suramar. We cannot exactly stop for refreshments at the gate with you two in tow, can we?$b$bThe water gardens were a place to socialize and relax. Before the patrols arrived it was rather trivial to hide some mana wine for later retrieval.$b$bThat's where you come in. Fetch some supplies and bring them to your friend, then meet me at the ruins north of the city. We will be ready to depart soon.

Progress.text: 你找到走私者了嗎？他們怎麼說？
Progress.english: ¿Has encontrado al contrabandista? ¿Qué ha dicho?

Completion.text:
那是法力酒嗎？要給我的？

<埃亞卓斯貪婪的把整瓶酒咽下。>

我向你和這位艾斯托里致謝，沒有你們，我肯定就死在這了。
Completion.english: ¿Eso es vino de maná? ¿Para mí?$B$B<Iadreth engulle la botella con avidez.>$B$BTú y el tal Astoril tenéis mi gratitud. Sin duda, habría muerto aquí fuera.

identity.title: Quality of Life
identity.objectives: Follow Iadreth.
identity.description: I am afraid, $n. We're so close to home, so close to salvation...$b$bAstoril says he knows the rest of the way through and can get us there safely. I believe him, but you've come this far to see us safe. Will you see this through to the end?

Completion.text:
這真是令人不安的故事。

你做了一件好事，$n。他不能再折磨我們的人民了。
Completion.english: Es una historia bastante inquietante.$B$BHas hecho bien, $N. Ya no volverá a atormentar a nuestra gente.

identity.title: Ulthalesh, the Deadwind Harvester
identity.objectives: Start your search for the Deadwind Harvester at Manor Mistmantle in Duskwood.
identity.description:
The book says the Dark Riders were last seen in a place called Manor Mistmantle. If friend can find these riders, then $Ghe:she; can get Ulthalesh!

Calydus will wait here and await your return. Find Ulthalesh, friend!

Completion.text:
我的選擇不多。我無法獨自面對黑騎士的另一次埋伏，而你的力量顯然相當強大。

我會幫忙找你要的那把武器，但前提是你必須協助我，把他們搶走的其他東西物歸原主。

就這樣說定了吧，術士？
Completion.english: No tengo elección. No puedo enfrentarme a otra emboscada de los jinetes oscuros a solas y está claro que tú eres formidable.$B$BTe ayudaré a encontrar el arma que buscas, pero solo si tú me ayudas a devolver las otras que tienen en su poder al lugar que les corresponde.$B$B¿Te parece, $C?

identity.title: The Fallen Lion
identity.objectives: Deliver King Varian's letter to King Anduin.
identity.description: I haven't left the deck of this ship since we got back. The fleet must be made ready for war. Don't know where we will be needed, but when the call comes, we'll be ready.$b$bTruth be told... I welcome the distraction. The others are paying their respects to Varian, but I... I cannot bring myself to face that casket. To face his son.$b$bVarian gave me a letter he wrote to Anduin. Please, take it to him on my behalf.

Progress.text: 欢迎，$n。我很高兴你安然无恙。你有东西要给我吗？
Progress.english: Welcome, $n. I am pleased you survived the battle. You have something for me?

identity.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
identity.objectives: Take Captain Russo's ship to the Broken Shore.
identity.description:
Your warship awaits at the end of the dock, $n. May your weapon bring you many kills today.

The Warchief has already made landfall, I will wager you will simply need to follow the trail of demon blood.

Completion.text: 很高興看到你傷勢痊癒，$n。許多航向破碎海岸的精兵就沒這麼幸運了。
Completion.english: Me alegra comprobar que vuelves a estar bien, $N. Muchos grandes soldados que zarparon hacia la Costa Abrupta no tuvieron tanta suerte.

identity.title: Fate of the Horde
identity.objectives: Go to Grommash Hold and learn the fate of the Horde.
identity.description: It is a wonder any of our troops survived that bloodbath on the Broken Shore. If not for Lady Sylvanas...$B$BHigh Overlord Saurfang has been asking for you at Grommash Hold. He will not say why... but he was insistent that I send you to him.

Completion.text:
一直以來，你對部落貢獻良多，$n。

你的責任會變得越來越重…越來越重。
Completion.english: Has servido bien a la Horda en el pasado, $N.$B$BSe te exigirá mucho... demasiado.

identity.title: Paying Respects
identity.objectives: Slay 8 Disturbed Apparitions or Disturbed Spectres.
identity.description: All I see is despair.$b$bLook, $r. The grounds are overwhelmed with these wraiths, spirits of those interred here. Something has made them angry and they are lashing out. I can feel their pain.$b$bI will go look for remaining relics, and there is a tomb I must see. It is too late for these unfortunate souls. Please defeat any you find and return them to the rest they deserve.

Completion.text: 它們所受的痛苦讓我感同身受。它們終將回歸，但現在它們將暫時獲得安息。
Completion.english: Me duele verlas sufrir. Con el tiempo volverán, pero por ahora estarán en paz.

identity.title: Following the Curse
identity.objectives: Escort Revil Kost from Manor Mistmantle in Duskwood to Ariden's Camp in Deadwind Pass.
identity.description:
Very well. I suppose an introduction is in order. I am Revil Kost, priest of the Light and a seeker of lost artifacts. I've dealt with the Dark Riders before, and have returned to rid this place of them.

The Riders are elusive, but I may have a clue to their whereabouts. In our previous confrontation, I was able to see a glimpse into their past. Granted blessed vision by the Cloak of Purity, I saw the Dark Riders for who they were before.

Come with me to Ariden's camp. I will explain on the way.

Completion.text:
奇怪，黑騎兵竟然沒跟過來。不過沒關係，這是一件好事。

我相信找到黑騎兵的關鍵就在這附近。讓我們開始搜索吧。
Completion.english: Me extraña que los jinetes oscuros no nos hayan seguido hasta aquí, pero no cuestionaré nuestra buena suerte.$B$BCreo que la clave para encontrar a los jinetes oscuros se encuentra aquí, en algún lugar. Empecemos a buscar.

identity.title: Disturbing the Past
identity.objectives: Search around Ariden's Camp for clues leading to the Dark Riders.
identity.description:
This place is where the merchant, Ariden, set up camp while he was trying to ply his dubious wares to the sorcerer Medivh. It has remained strangely untouched for all this time, which leads me to believe it may still have a connection to its former owner.

Help me search the camp. Let's see if we can find something to lead us to the Dark Riders.

Completion.text:
這本日記外表看似平凡，但當你接近時，卻發現其中散發著源源不絕的黑暗能量。

你快速掃過內容後，發現這是埃瑞丁的日記，上面記載著他在逆風小徑的經歷。在日記的最後，不僅字跡產生變化，語氣也變得越來越陰沉。不斷提到「詛咒」，以及將偉大力量佔為己有的無盡慾望。

而在你的瀏覽過程中，有條記錄吸引你的目光。
Completion.english: Aunque podría parecer un diario normal, el libro rezuma energía oscura a medida que te acercas a él.$B$BUn vistazo rápido a sus páginas revela que se trata del diario de Ariden, y que relata su estancia en el Paso de la Muerte. Hacia el final del diario, la escritura empieza a cambiar y el tono se vuelve notablemente más oscuro. Se refiere constantemente a "la maldición" y al deseo infinito de poseer cosas de gran poder.$B$BUna de estas entradas capta tu atención mientras lo hojeas.

identity.title: Keep Your Friends Close
identity.objectives: Speak to Elthyn Da'rai at the Illidari camp atop the plateau in Orgrimmar.
identity.description: The Legion is bold indeed to strike at the Horde's stronghold! You aided our defense, but now I have a more important task for you.$b$bIt seems the demon hunters will play a crucial part in this war... but I still don't trust them. You will be my envoy to the Illidari. Learn what they know. Study their techniques. If they betray us, we'll use their own knowledge against them.$b$bTheir camp lies atop the plateau in the city. Go. Nathanos and I will clean up this mess.

Completion.text:
啊，你就是那個鼎鼎大名的$c。很好。

我們應該看看你是不是名副其實。
Completion.english: Ah, así que tú eres el famoso $C del que he escuchado. Bien. $B$BVeamos si tu reputación es verdadera.

identity.title: To Point the Way
identity.objectives: Find the compass mentioned in the journal in Ariden's Camp.
identity.description:
Though the journal devolves into dark ramblings written in hurried scribbles, one entry stands out:

"Ulthalesh. The name rings in my head. I can hear it calling, but where?

"The spirits... the very land here is tied to it. It is no wonder we would so often get lost in this place. The forces pull my compass point in every direction...

"Perhaps if it had a stronger pull, the compass could show the way..."

Progress.text: 就是那個嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Es esa?

Completion.text:
這個羅盤絕對有問題。

它似乎打算指向所有方向。
Completion.english: Definitivamente, a esta brújula le ocurre algo. $B$BParece que trata de señalar en todas direcciones al mismo tiempo.

identity.title: Demons Among Us
identity.objectives: Learn what Allari the Souleater sees.
identity.description: Look around. What do you see?$B$B<Allari glares at something over your shoulder.>$B$BThe Legion has already infiltrated the Horde... even now, they are among you.$B$BWe must protect your Warchief.$B$BWhen you are ready to see what lies beneath the veil, say the word.

Completion.text:
看來惡魔獵人的擔憂絕非空穴來風。那些惡魔居然敢在國喪期間悄悄潛入我們的城鎮！

這對部落而言可不是什麼好兆頭。
Completion.english: Parecería que las preocupaciones de los cazadores de demonios estaban bien fundadas. ¡Y pensar que los demonios se atreverían a meterse por las malas a nuestra ciudad durante este período de duelo!$B$BEsto no es un buen augurio para el resto de mi reinado.

identity.title: The Fate of Deadwind
identity.objectives: Attune Ariden's Compass at the sites of restless spirits around Deadwind Pass.
identity.description:
The journal mentions a "stronger pull" for the compass. If the spirits of this place are indeed tied to it, they may serve as the pull we need.

I've come upon several locations in the pass where restless spirits tend to appear. Perhaps if you show the spirits there the compass, they may be able to help point it in the right direction.

You seek these locations out. I'll continue on to Karazhan and see if I can find anything leading to the Dark Riders.

Completion.text:
看來這招有用，羅盤指著河流的方向。

這表示…？
Completion.english: Parece que ha funcionado, y la brújula señala hacia el río.$B$B¿Podría ser...?

identity.title: Turn Around, Nighteyes
identity.objectives: Help Lilryia Dawnwind find Nighteyes.
identity.description: Stranger, you must help me!$b$bNighteyes, my old friend... he was scouting ahead and I heard him cry out a warning. I tried to run after him, but in my carelessness I stepped in this trap.$b$bHe's so close, just on the other side of this ridge. Please find him!

Progress.text: 你必須找到夜眼！
Progress.english: ¡Debes encontrar a Ojos Nocturnos!

Completion.text: 謝謝你，$r。我會照料夜眼的傷勢。告訴我發生了什麼事！
Completion.english: Gracias, $R. Yo atenderé las heridas de Ojos Nocturnos. ¡Dime lo que pasó!

identity.title: The Dark Riders
identity.objectives: Defeat the Dark Riders in the Karazhan Catacombs and claim Ulthalesh.
identity.description:
There's a sewer grate along the edge of the river leading to catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it could be where the spirits are directing us.

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

Completion.text:
今天，黑騎兵嘗到有史以來最大的敗績，也是暮色森林人民的一大勝利。

他們欠你一份恩情，我也是。
Completion.english: Hoy los jinetes oscuros han sufrido un gran golpe y ha sido una gran victoria para las gentes del Bosque del Ocaso.$B$BEstán en deuda contigo, igual que yo.

identity.title: Take Me To Your Leader
identity.objectives: Meet with Khadgar in Suramar.
identity.description: I am glad you are here, $n.$b$bThis... Khadgar, the archmage who found my message, has called a meeting.$b$bHe wishes to meet us by the entrance to the city as soon as possible.$b$bWill you accompany me? I have the strangest feeling that he will not be alone.

Completion.text: 勇士，又見面了。看來大家都到了。
Completion.english: Hola de nuevo, campeón. Por lo que veo, ya estamos todos.

identity.title: Seeing Stars
identity.objectives: Collect 4 Sea Stars from Elder Trenchwalkers in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: You think those naga are good sport, little rabbit?$B$B<Stokalfr chuckles.>$B$BI would savor the chance to do battle with one of those barnacle-crusted behemoths.$B$BIf you want to impress me, bring me the stars from their heads. I might consider you a true $c then.

Objectives.text: 从蓝风海湾的古代海沟行者身上获取4个海星。
Objectives.english: Collect 4 Sea Stars from Elder Trenchwalkers in Azuregale Bay.

Description.text: 你觉得那些纳迦可以让你活动筋骨，小兔子？$B$B<斯托卡弗咯咯笑着。>$B$B如果有机会跟那种无脊椎的硬皮巨兽对峙，我肯定会好好珍惜。$B$B想让我佩服的话，就把他们头上的星星带回来。我或许会把你当成真正的$c来看待。
Description.english: You think those naga are good sport, little rabbit?$B$B<Stokalfr chuckles.>$B$BI would savor the chance to do battle with one of those barnacle-crusted behemoths.$B$BIf you want to impress me, bring me the stars from their heads. I might consider you a true $c then.

identity.title: The Tome of Blighted Implements
identity.objectives: Speak with Calydus to choose which artifact you will pursue.
identity.description:
The book you carry is the key to your friends' salvation, and to your absolute power! It holds within information about many relics too dangerous to the Legion to leave unchecked.

Read, friend. And decide which of these artifacts you will use to strike Jagganoth down!

Completion.text: 真好，朋友選得真好！
Completion.english: ¡Sí, amiga, has elegido sabiamente!

identity.title: The Sixth
identity.objectives: Meet with Ritssyn Flamescowl in the Circle of Wills beneath Dalaran.
identity.description: Greetings, warlock. I speak on behalf of the Council of the Black Harvest.$b$bWith the Legion invasion upon us, it is painfully clear that our only hope is to grow stronger. The council plans to tap into the Twisting Nether and call forth more powerful demon allies. The ritual is ready, but we are short one number.$b$bNo doubt you have heard of the fate that befell Kanrethad Ebonlocke.$b$bYou will be his replacement. Do you accept?

Completion.text:
你做了正確的決定。

希望你的本事就和名氣一樣響亮。
Completion.english: Has tomado la decisión correcta.$B$BEsperemos que hagas honor a tu reputación.

identity.title: Arganax
identity.objectives: Find and slay Arganax in Lorlathil.
identity.description: A satyr known as Arganax has infiltrated the village of Lorlathil in Val'sharah. I believe that Arganax has disguised himself as one of the local residents.$b$bUse the demon Eye of Azzorok on the villagers in Lorlathil. If there is a demon disguised as a local, the Eye of Azzorok will reveal their true identity.$b$bUncover the demon infiltrator Arganax, and slay him without mercy.

Objectives.text: 在洛拉希尔寻找并消灭阿格纳克斯。
Objectives.english: Find and slay Arganax in Lorlathil.

Description.text: 一个名叫阿格纳克斯的萨特渗透了瓦尔莎拉的洛拉希尔村。我相信，那个阿格纳克斯肯定伪装成了当地的居民。$b$b对洛拉希尔的村民使用艾佐洛克之眼。如果那个人是恶魔假扮的，那么佐洛克之眼就会揭露他的真实身份。$b$b找出恶魔渗透者阿格纳克斯，并毫不留情地消灭他。
Description.english: A satyr known as Arganax has infiltrated the village of Lorlathil in Val'sharah. I believe that Arganax has disguised himself as one of the local residents.$b$bUse the demon Eye of Azzorok on the villagers in Lorlathil. If there is a demon disguised as a local, the Eye of Azzorok will reveal their true identity.$b$bUncover the demon infiltrator Arganax, and slay him without mercy.

identity.title: All Along the Waterways
identity.objectives: Slay 3 Duskwatch Orbitists.
identity.description:
I've noticed some wandering eyes, lately.

I am more than happy to continue delivering the goods to Vanthir, but it is getting increasingly dangerous to do so. 

The Duskwatch that walk the bazaar are by far the most observant.

Find and slay the Orbitists so that I may deliver the goods safely.

I will follow behind with the shipment.

Completion.text: 德林能夠安全送出貨物了，謝謝你。
Completion.english: Deline ha podido entregar la mercancía sin peligro, gracias a ti.

identity.title: The New Blood
identity.objectives: Complete the summoning ritual with the Council of the Black Harvest in the Circle of Wills in Dalaran.
identity.description: It is time to begin the ritual, warlock. Be prepared, for the summoning we perform today will be more challenging than any you have known or seen before.$b$bAre you ready?

Completion.text:
卡萊德斯覺得很難過，我們沒有救出你的朋友。但如果我們的動作夠快，他們可能還活著。

雖然賈岡諾斯會拷問他們，但是他會留下囚犯一條小命…通常來說。
Completion.english: Calydus siente no haber salvado a tus amigos, pero quizás sobrevivan si nos damos prisa.$B$BJagganoth los torturará, sí, pero le gusta mantenerlos con vida... por lo general.

identity.title: Redistribution
identity.objectives: Acquire 20 Bottles of Arcwine.
identity.description:
I would imagine you thought I would simply have wine to deliver.

<Deline chuckles.>

If it were that easy, his people would not be starving.

<Her expression becomes serious.>

These... loyalists, shall we say, enjoy abundance. They dance to the Magistrix's whims and so they have all that they need.

There is no Arcwine shortage. The Magistrix created one to keep us in line.

They will not miss a few bottles. They have plenty.

Search the square and bring as much as you can carry back.

Progress.text: 你有拿到足夠的酒嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Has encontrado bastantes?

Completion.text: 我會負責將這個安全送回朋友手中。做得很好。
Completion.english: Me aseguraré de que nuestro amigo reciba esto en perfecto estado. Buen trabajo.

identity.title: The Heart of the Dreadscar
identity.objectives: Defeat Jagganoth and take his heart to the Seat of the Overlord in Dreadscar Rift.
identity.description: Friend has the artifact! Now Jagganoth does not stand a chance!$b$bQuickly, you must go back to Dreadscar Rift! You may still be able to save your friends from Jagganoth's vengeance.$b$bIf you take the heart of the overlord, his army will be yours to command!

Completion.text:
殘忍的賈岡諾斯被擊倒了！

朋友，你就是懼痕裂隙的新主宰！

這裡就是朋友的新家。你控制了懼痕裂隙，你想來就來想走就走！
Completion.english: ¡El cruel Jagganoth ha sido derrotado!$B$B¡Amiga, eres la nueva Señora suprema de los Cicatriz del Terror!$B$BEste lugar será el nuevo hogar de amiga. Con los Cicatriz del Terror bajo tu control, podrás ir y venir como te plazca.

identity.title: An Ancient Recipe
identity.objectives: Collect 6 Harpy Talons.
identity.description: Suramar is... was... an intellectual's dream.$b$bWe studied everything in there, from alchemy and the arts to the very nature of magic itself. How could we be so foolish as to accept them in?$b$bLook at me, lost in the clouds again when there is much to be done. My work requires some fairly difficult ingredients, $r. Perhaps you would help me procure them?$b$bI am going to need some harpy talons. Crushed into a powder, they will be a potent reagent.

Progress.text: $r，你有我需要的東西嗎？時間所剩不多了。
Progress.english: ¿Tienes lo que necesito, $R? No tenemos tiempo que perder.

Completion.text: 這應該夠了。鷹爪粉很快就會失去效力，我們必須速戰速決。
Completion.english: Con eso debería bastar. El polvo de garras pierde su potencia bastante rápido, así que debemos darnos prisa.

identity.title: Shift Change
identity.objectives: Hide in the basket and wait for the guard to appear. Follow the guard to their destination.
identity.description:
This is as good a chance as we are going to get to rescue Verene's daughter.

Here is how this is going to work. 

You are going to wait here for the guard to pass by on their way to their guard shift. Look for something to hide in.

<Silgryn marks a spot on your map.>

You will know the guard by their bright red armor.

Follow closely, but not so closely that you are seen. It may be necessary to kill the guard when you reach your destination.

The child's name is Korine. Good luck.

Completion.text: 我以為…他們要…*哽咽*
Completion.english: C-creía que... me iban a... *sniff*

identity.title: One of the People
identity.objectives: Meet with Vanthir in Suramar City.
identity.description:
It is time for you to enter the city proper, $n.

I am sending you to my loyal friend Vanthir. I do hope you remember him- I can guarantee that he remembers you.

I will not be able to accompany you, but I must stress that the disguise I have granted you is not impervious. Tread carefully, and avoid those who stare too long.

Farewell for now.

Completion.text: 很高興你平安抵達了。這裡急需你的幫忙。
Completion.english: Me alegra que hayas venido. Tu ayuda es muy necesaria aquí.

identity.title: The Delicate Art of Telemancy
identity.objectives: Collect the Weathered Telemancy Beacon and Cracked Warpsleeve from Oculeth's Workshop.
identity.description:
I hadn't the time to gather my instruments before fleeing the palace. I came here to salvage some equipment.

This old workshop is actually several rooms connected by teleporter pads.

Elisande's goons are already scouring the place looking for me, but from here I can alter the teleporter network and keep them moving in circles.

You go in. I'll monitor your position and ensure the teleporters work normally for you.

Find these two parts and bring them back!

Progress.text: 如果要開一個傳送網路到薩莉瑟拉那邊，就非拿到這些器材不可。
Progress.english: Es necesario recuperar este equipo si quiero desarrollar una red de teletransportadores para Thalyssra.

Completion.text: 這些東西的狀況不太好，但是還算堪用。
Completion.english: No están en muy buen estado, pero bastarán.

identity.title: Network Security
identity.objectives: Complete the lockdown sequence in Oculeth's Test Chamber.
identity.description:
We must lock down the facility. Otherwise my esteemed colleagues from the palace could uncover my secrets, which puts any teleporters I build for you and Thalyssra at risk.

<The inactive attunement device near Oculeth hums to life.>

This will take us to my secret test chamber beneath the mountain. From there we can begin the lockdown sequence and make our escape!

Completion.text: 我們…成功了嗎？
Completion.english: ¿Hemos... llegado?

identity.title: A Token of Remembrance
identity.objectives: Place 4 Bouquets of Moon Lilies.
identity.description: The flower rests peacefully in your hand, glowing softly.$b$bWhile it doesn't appear to be growing anywhere nearby, there are small bouquets of the flower on some of the memorials around here.$b$bPerhaps laying down some flowers on the remaining graves will ease the gloom.

Objectives.text: 放置4束月光百合。
Objectives.english: Place 4 Bouquets of Moon Lilies.

Description.text: 你手中的花朵静静地散发出柔和的光芒。$b$b虽然它不像是生长在附近的植被，但是这里的一些墓碑上面都放着这种花束。$b$b如果为其余的坟墓也献上花束，或许可以缓和这里的阴郁氛围。
Description.english: The flower rests peacefully in your hand, glowing softly.$b$bWhile it doesn't appear to be growing anywhere nearby, there are small bouquets of the flower on some of the memorials around here.$b$bPerhaps laying down some flowers on the remaining graves will ease the gloom.

identity.title: Emissary
identity.objectives: Speak with Allari the Souleater.
identity.description: As if things weren't unsettled enough, guests have arrived... the Illidari.$b$bThese demon hunters have been imprisoned since their master's fall at the Black Temple. For the Wardens to release them can only mean the peril is dire indeed.$b$bTheir delegation's leader, Allari "the Souleater," claims Orgimmar faces a hidden threat. I gave them leave to establish a camp within the city... for now.$B$BYou will speak with her at once. Find out whether this threat is credible.

Completion.text:
<艾萊莉說話時眉頭深鎖。>

你該不會以為部落領袖可以齊聚一地，還不被燃燒軍團注意到吧？
Completion.english: <Allari frunce el ceño mientras habla>.$B$B¿Acaso creías que el liderazgo de la Horda podría reunirse en un mismo lugar sin que la Legión Ardiente se percatara?

identity.title: Zealot's Dues
identity.objectives: Take Commander Domitille's Helm to Lothrius Mooncaller.
identity.description:
Commander Domitille represents the very essence of the Nightborne's corruption. Abhorrent of power not their own, enamoured with their Grand Magistrix to the point of zealotry, and focused utterly on the destruction of the Moon Guard.

Take her helm to Lothrius as proof of her demise.

Completion.text: 我才在懷疑為何突然間沒了她的消息。這對我的心情或許只是小有撫慰，但對於夜裔的部隊來說卻是極大的打擊。做得很好，$n。
Completion.english: Me preguntaba por qué se habría callado de repente. Es un alivio pequeño para mi corazón, pero un gran golpe a las fuerzas restantes de los Nocheterna. Bien hecho, $N.

identity.title: Casual Redistribution
identity.objectives: Collect 20 Bottles of Arcwine.
identity.description:
Lately there have been a disturbing array of changes involving our most precious resource, Arcwine. 

I imagine Thalyssra has thoroughly educated you about what happens when a Nightborne does not have access to a source of power like Arcwine.

With the presence of the demons came rationing. There are many who do not have enough to sustain themselves.

Bring me as much Arcwine as you can carry. I will see that it gets to the right people.

Objectives.text: 收集20瓶魔力酒。
Objectives.english: Collect 20 Bottles of Arcwine.

Description.text:
最近发生了一系列令人不安的变动，关系到我们最珍贵的资源，魔力酒。

我猜塔莉萨已经详细向你说明，夜之子没有魔力酒之类的能量供给后会发生什么。

随着恶魔的不断涌入，缺乏的补给让许多人都难以支撑。

给我带来尽可能多的魔力酒。我会把它们交给合适的人。
Description.english:
Lately there have been a disturbing array of changes involving our most precious resource, Arcwine. 

I imagine Thalyssra has thoroughly educated you about what happens when a Nightborne does not have access to a source of power like Arcwine.

With the presence of the demons came rationing. There are many who do not have enough to sustain themselves.

Bring me as much Arcwine as you can carry. I will see that it gets to the right people.

identity.title: Kazok'thul
identity.objectives: Find and slay Kazok'thul in Azurewing Repose.
identity.description: A rogue felhunter known as Kazok'thul has been terrorizing Azurewing Repose in Azsuna.$b$bFelhunters feed on arcane energy and it seems that Kazok'thul has been gorging itself on the mana from nearby Azurewing whelps.$b$bTravel to Azurewing Repose and speak with Ardonu to find the last known location of Kazok'thul.$b$bSlay the demon and return here when your mission is complete.

Objectives.text: 在蓝翼栖地找到并消灭卡佐图尔。
Objectives.english: Find and slay Kazok'thul in Azurewing Repose.

Description.text: 有头名叫卡佐图尔的地狱猎犬正在阿苏纳的蓝翼栖地里肆虐。$b$b地狱猎犬以魔法能量为食，看来卡佐图尔一直从那里的蓝翼雏龙身上吸取法力。$b$b到蓝翼栖地跟阿杜努谈谈，找出卡佐图尔最后出没的地点。$b$b消灭那个恶魔，完成任务以后再回来。
Description.english: A rogue felhunter known as Kazok'thul has been terrorizing Azurewing Repose in Azsuna.$b$bFelhunters feed on arcane energy and it seems that Kazok'thul has been gorging itself on the mana from nearby Azurewing whelps.$b$bTravel to Azurewing Repose and speak with Ardonu to find the last known location of Kazok'thul.$b$bSlay the demon and return here when your mission is complete.

identity.title: Lingering on the Edge
identity.objectives: Give Absolon 100 Ancient Mana.
identity.description:
I h-have made... mistakes...

<Absolon draws in a rasping breath.>

I want to make it right... I want to live! But the madness... the WITHERING..

I am... fading.

<Absolon stares at you helplessly.>

Progress.text: 你可以幫我嗎？難道你也無能為力？
Progress.english: ¿Puedes ayudarme? ¿No hay nada que puedas hacer?

Completion.text: <阿布撒隆立即吞噬上古法力，看來短時間內似乎說不出話。>
Completion.english: <Absolon consume de inmediato el maná antiguo y parece incapaz de hablar durante unos instantes.>

identity.title: Cling to Hope
identity.objectives: Deliver a letter to Absolon's Wife, Noressa.
identity.description:
Your kindness has inspired me, friend.

I thought I would wander forever among the empty husks of the Withered, but Thalyssra invited me in.

I have chosen to remain here with my people and together we will take back Suramar.

For now I have but one request.

Take this letter to my wife. She should know that I still live, among other things.

Give her the hope that you gave me.

Progress.text: <諾瑞莎懷疑地打量著你。>
Progress.english: <Noressa te mira con recelo.>

Completion.text: 阿布撒隆…還活著？
Completion.english: ¿Absolon... está vivo?

identity.title: Rebuilding the Council
identity.objectives: Resurrect Ritssyn Flamescowl in Dreadscar Rift.
identity.description:
It seems that friend has caught the attention of Mephistroth. This is very bad news, as the dreadlord will surely wish to seek revenge for losing his general.

Friend will need more than the Dreadscar to stand against him, you will need powerful warlocks such as those who were captured.

Calydus thinks the orc still lies in the pit where you were chained. Friend must revive him, and rebuild the council!

Progress.text: 我一定会不遗余力地重建议会。
Progress.english: I will not rest until the council has been rebuilt.

Completion.text:
我幾乎不敢相信我看見的景象。以單一術士之力統領整支惡魔軍團，實在超乎我對議會能力的想像。

我只希望這樣的力量足以逆轉戰局。
Completion.english: No puedo creer lo que ven mis ojos. Que un $C controle un ejército completo de demonios es mucho más de lo que pensaba que sería capaz el consejo.$B$BSolo espero que tal poder sea suficiente para cambiar el curso de esta guerra.

identity.title: The Path of the Dreadscar
identity.objectives: Use the Dreadscar Battle Plans to choose your first zone.
identity.description:
It would seem that where the council has failed, you have found untold success. These Dreadscar should prove powerful allies, but they may not be enough.

For now, we must look to rebuild. I will send agents out to locate the whereabouts of the captured council members, as well as any other warlocks who may be able to aid the cause.

Meet me at the scrying pool, and we will plan our action from there.

Completion.text: 計畫定下來了，開始著手進行吧。
Completion.english: El plan está hecho y los engranajes empiezan a moverse.

identity.title: Close Enough
identity.objectives: Carry Chief Telemancer Oculeth to Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
identity.description:
<Oculeth's eyes have dulled. His voice trembles.>

Are we... are we close?

So hungry...

Completion.text: 謝謝你救回歐庫雷斯。他對於我們的計劃是無可取代的戰力。
Completion.english: Gracias por traer de vuelta a Oculeth. Será una baza de gran valor para nuestra causa.

identity.title: It'll Cost You
identity.objectives: Collect a Fel Reaver Arm and a Fel Reaver Leg from within the Felblaze Ingress.
identity.description: If yeh need demon parts, oh aye, this place is right teeming with them fel buggers.$b$bYer bound ta find what'yer lookin' fer probably near them portals they've got jus' sou'east of 'ere.

Progress.text: 找到想要的东西了吗？
Progress.english: ¿Has encontrado ya lo que necesitas?

identity.title: Bits and Pieces
identity.objectives: Meet with Brann Bronzebeard in Stormheim.
identity.description: So many artifacts to catalogue, and never enough time.$b$bGood to see you again, $n. Brann Bronzebeard and the Explorers' League are in Stormheim right now and could use your help tracking down an ancient titan relic.$b$bBrann can fill you in on the details when you arrive.

Objectives.text: 在风暴峡湾与布莱恩·铜须见面。
Objectives.english: Meet with Brann Bronzebeard in Stormheim.

Description.text: 有那么多古物需要收录，时间总是不够用。$b$b很高兴见到你，$n。布莱恩·铜须和探险者协会正在风暴峡湾，他们需要你帮忙寻找一件古老的泰坦圣物。$b$b你到达之后，布莱恩会给你说明详细的情况。
Description.english: So many artifacts to catalogue, and never enough time.$b$bGood to see you again, $n. Brann Bronzebeard and the Explorers' League are in Stormheim right now and could use your help tracking down an ancient titan relic.$b$bBrann can fill you in on the details when you arrive.

identity.title: Resupplying the Line
identity.objectives: Deliver the Crate of Ammunition to Fargo Flintlocke in Val'sharah.
identity.description: $n, I need you to make a delivery for me.$b$bFlintlocke's sent word from Val'sharah stating that they're out of bullets.$b$bI sent him down there with enough ammo to cut the planet in half, but Flintlocke goes through ammunition the way you or I go through... air. Go help him out!

Completion.text: 噢对！这正是我们需要的！我刚想给那些动物来个大轰炸。
Completion.english: ¡Ah, sí! ¡Esto es exactamente lo que necesitaba! Ya iba a empezar a lanzar animales pequeños.

identity.title: In My Sights
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Deployable Bullet Dispenser Parts around Moonrest.
identity.description: I used up all me bullets on a wee invention of mine. I call it: Tha Deployable Bullet Dispenser!$b$bOh aye. It shoots in-der-scriminantly wit'out all that messy and time-consumin' "aiming" or "thinkin'" that us people-folk are wont ta do.$b$bWe had deployed quite a few of 'em east o' here when this swarm of plants came a'thrashin from tha trees.$b$bI didn't 'ave time ta go back an' get me turrets. Would ye mind gettin' them back fer me? Or at least, what's left of 'em?

Progress.text: 那些可恶的植物最好没碰我的洒弹器！
Progress.english: ¡Será mejor que esos malvados verdes no hayan tocado mis dispensadores!

Completion.text: 噢，我可怜又无辜的洒弹器！看看它们把你怎么了。$B$B不过至少它们完成了发射任务，我要的就是这个效果。$B$B这是洒弹器的结构图。你可以把它们装在你不喜欢的东西旁边！
Completion.english: Ohh, ¡mis pobres e inocentes dispensadores de balas! Miren lo que les hicieron.$B$BAl menos no cayeron sin disparar, así es como yo lo haría.$B$BAcá están los planos. ¡Ármalos cerca de algo que no te guste!

identity.title: All Charged Up
identity.objectives: Use Flintlocke's Gunpowder Charges to kill $1oa Shimmering Oleanders.
identity.description: If yer gonna wander inta these woods, ye'll be wantin' somethin' with some punch. These plants are a might grabby.$b$bI've got me special explosive charges here that should send those fertilizer mutations back to the dirt.$b$bTake 'em with yeh and give them viney beasties a what-fer!

Completion.text: 真是除草利器，嗯？哈哈！$B$B我猜你一定想要更多炸药，以备今后派上用场，所以我已经抄好了结构图，你可以自己制作了。$B$B我觉得，如果花草树木发了狂，就应该统统除掉。
Completion.english: Eso sí es un herbicida, ¿no? ¡Ja, ja!$B$BMe imaginé que querrías un par de esas cargas, así que me adelanté y te escribí unos planos.$B$BImagino que siempre es bueno mantener a esas plantas y árboles a raya cuando se ponen así de arrogantes.

identity.title: Always the Last Thing
identity.objectives: Find a suitable power source for Didi's design and deliver it to her. Then, see if her new battery actually works.
identity.description: Well, I've worked out all the kinks. Added a few nuts and bolts, and fitted a new housing for the power core.$b$bProblem is, none of the batteries I have here seem to work. I think we're gonna have to fashion somethin' new together.$b$bI'm gonna need your help, $n. Let's start by trying a charged gem from the jewelcrafting shop down the way.

Progress.text: 希望寻找合适的能量源的事不会太麻烦。
Progress.english: Espero que no sea muy complicado encontrar una fuente de alimentación adecuada.

identity.title: Fate of the Guard
identity.objectives: Find the corpses of Nyellus Starweaver, Galar'thus Rivertree, and Kailea Windfeather and perform funereal rites for them.
identity.description:
<Thalrenus looks you over.>

You are not one of them.

The Nightborne came to our gates hours after the shield over Suramar fell. We thought them friends, despite our long separation.

We were wrong.

They poured into our stronghold and began the slaughter. We were unprepared. Though we fought, we were beaten.

The keep is lost. Our leaders have perished and their corpses lay in the streets.

Find them, give them their final rites.

While you search, look for survivors. Help them if you can.

Completion.text: 我以为月之守卫可以承受任何事……
Completion.english: Creía que la Guardia Lunar soportaba cualquier cosa...

identity.title: Fresh Meat
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Fresh Fel-Flesh.
identity.description: This crater is infested with felfire basilisks.$b$bThey may not be the most cunning of creatures, but they are as vile and dangerous as any demon.$b$bHowever, they may yet prove useful to us. Slay the basilisks, but return to me with chunks of their fel-infused flesh.$b$bI have plans to make use of their freshly carved flesh...

Progress.text: 你拿到我要的新鮮魔化肉塊了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Tienes la carne vil fresca que necesito?

Completion.text:
我看到你帶了剛切下來的魔火石化蜥蜴肉塊回來。

仔細聽好。我會解釋這些東西的用途…
Completion.english: Veo que regresas con los restos recién trinchados de los basiliscos viles.$B$BEscucha atentamente y te explicaré por qué hacían falta...

identity.title: Serpents from the Deep
identity.objectives: Speak with Toryl outside of Jandvik.
identity.description: Hail, $c.$B$BMy village of Jandvik has fallen under siege by a group of naga called the Sashj'tar.$B$BNormally I would not seek out the help of an outsider, but we are facing an enemy that we are incapable of defeating.$B$BMany powerful elven relics can be found in the ruins around Jandvik. In exchange for your help, you will have your just rewards.$B$BDo we have an accord?

Objectives.text: 在贾德维克外面与托尔里谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Toryl outside of Jandvik.

Description.text: 你好，$c。$B$B我的贾德维克村遭到了一群萨吉塔纳迦的围攻。$B$B通常情况下，我不会向外来者请求帮助，但是这一次我们面对的是我们无法打败的敌人。$B$B贾德维克周围的废墟里有许多强大的精灵圣物。为了感谢你的帮助，你可以拿走应得的报酬。$B$B我们就这么说好了？
Description.english: Hail, $c.$B$BMy village of Jandvik has fallen under siege by a group of naga called the Sashj'tar.$B$BNormally I would not seek out the help of an outsider, but we are facing an enemy that we are incapable of defeating.$B$BMany powerful elven relics can be found in the ruins around Jandvik. In exchange for your help, you will have your just rewards.$B$BDo we have an accord?

identity.title: Removing Obstacles
identity.objectives: Kill Calder and Eynar in Jandvik.
identity.description: $C! Interested in earning some coin?$B$BThe jarl of Jandvik is missing and two headstrong whelps are vying to take over leadership. I should be the next jarl, not them!$B$BI want you to enter Jandvik and defeat Calder and Eynar in mortal combat.$B$BI would not normally put my trust in an outsider, but this situation requires the aid of someone like you. Jandvik would condemn me if I were caught with their blood on my hands.$B$BMeet me in the center of Jandvik when the deed is done.

Completion.text: 我的對手消失以後，我就可以不受阻攔的取得領導權。
Completion.english: Ahora que mis adversarios ya no están, puedo ser líder de Jandvik sin oposición alguna.

identity.title: Jarl Come Back Now
identity.objectives: Locate Jarl Throndyr in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: You seem to follow my commands well, $n. Perhaps I can use you again.$B$BJarl Throndyr, the leader of Jandvik, has been missing for some time now. I assume that he has fallen in battle to the invading Sashj'tar naga, but I must know for certain.$B$BFind out what has become of him.$B$BDo this task for me and I can assure you that my vrykul will not harm you.

Completion.text:
<索隆迪爾氣若游絲勉強吐出幾個字。>

毒藥…流遍我…全身。
