Completion.english: <Throndyr murmura entre respiraciones cortadas.>$B$BUn veneno... corre por... mis venas.

identity.title: Symbols of Power
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Legion Emblems.
identity.description: This demon has information that could lead us to those in charge.$b$bUnfortunately, he is more fearful of his master than he is of us. We need to change his mind about that.$b$bThe most powerful Burning Legion soldiers often carry an emblem of their rank and status within the demon army.$b$bSeek out the stronger demons in Felsoul Hold, slay them, and return to me with their emblems.$b$bWe will show this wyrmtongue servant who it is he should fear...

Progress.text: 你拿到了軍團紋章嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Tienes los emblemas de la Legión?

Completion.text:
我看到你帶著紋章回來。太棒了。

讓我們看看這隻蟲舌魔看到自己同伴的下場，會有什麼反應。
Completion.english: Veo que has vuelto con los emblemas. Excelente.$B$BA ver cómo reacciona este Lenguavermis cuando le enseñemos lo que les hemos hecho a sus camaradas.

identity.title: The Dark Riders
identity.objectives: Defeat the Dark Riders in the Karazhan Catacombs and claim Apocalypse.
identity.description:
The catacombs? I've never heard of such a place. Unless, he means...

There's a sewer grate along the edge of the river leading to a catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it could lead to the catacombs that the spirit spoke of. 

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

Progress.text: 死亡骑士，你找到想要的东西了吗？
Progress.english: Death knight, have you found what you want?

identity.title: Special Delivery
identity.objectives: Acquire 3 Stacks of Letters from Nightborne Couriers using the Nightborne Spellblade.
identity.description:
Verene's child has gone missing. I can guess what happened, but I need to be sure.

Most guardsmen use couriers to relay delicate information. In this, magic is strictly the province of high ranking officials.

Take this blade. Do not touch the cutting edge. Use it to silently waylay the couriers and collect any correspondence they carry.

With any luck, the missives will tell us exactly where to find the girl.

We guards know everything, after all.

<Silgryn offers you a winning smile.>

Progress.text: 你成功了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Has tenido éxito?

Completion.text: 做得很好。我會細讀這些信件。
Completion.english: Buen trabajo. Me las leeré.

identity.title: Not Their Last Stand
identity.objectives: Dissuade 5 Lingering Moonfall Hippogryphs
identity.description:
I've been watching you- you are not with them.

<Ivanel coughs quietly.>

I am not long for this world, but there is one thing I would have you do while you are here.

The hippogryphs here still fight bitterly to defend their home and their companions in the Moon Guard. They have not accepted that the Guard is no more. 

Please... send them away. Let them know there is nothing left for them to fight for here.

Completion.text: 谢谢。知道它们不会再为我们而牺牲，我感觉好些了。
Completion.english: Gracias. Me siento mejor al saber que no se seguirán sacrificando por nosotros.

identity.title: Honoring Success
identity.objectives: Celebrate the successful acquistion of your artifact with your fellow Shadows.
identity.description: All has gone as planned. Your new blades are a testament to that.$B$BWe will demand a great deal of you in the weeks and months to come, as we must. But we would be remiss if we failed to take a moment to celebrate a job well done.$B$BWhat do you say?

Progress.text: 不做刀俎，便成鱼肉。
Progress.english: It's kill or be killed.

identity.title: Survey Says...
identity.objectives: Use the Telemancy Beacon to survey the Ruins of Elune'eth.
identity.description: It is time to establish the first secure connection in our teleportation network.$B$BTake this beacon to the Ruins of Elune'eth above us and survey the area to find a suitable location.$B$BOnce your survey is complete, place the beacon and I will anchor a connection to it from here.

Completion.text: <這看來是設置傳送裝置的好地點。>
Completion.english: <Este parece un buen sitio para el teletransportador.>

identity.title: Luminous Pearl
identity.objectives: Bring the Luminous Pearl to Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
identity.description: Balanced upon your fishing hook, you find a pearl unlike any other you've seen before. It shines with a cold, steady light, and its size and weight fluctuate in your hand.$b$bThis is clearly a magical item, and should be brought to a magical person.

Completion.text: 你说，是一颗珍珠？好吧，让我仔细瞧瞧……
Completion.english: ¿Una perla, dices? Bueno, pues déjame echarle un vistazo...

identity.title: The Dalaran Fountain
identity.objectives: Bring the Luminous Pearl to the fountain in Dalaran.
identity.description: You fished this up, did you? I'm... not quite sure what you want ME to do about that. Here.$b$b<Khadgar pats you on the head.>$b$b"Good job."$b$bWith regard to the pearl... it does seem to be magical, but I couldn't tell you much more than that. Perhaps it might look nice in the Dalaran fountain?

Completion.text: 太美了！我从没见过这么美的东西！$B$B是的，是的，我确定，把它扔到喷泉里吧。圣光在上，人们总是把各种垃圾扔到里面。$B$B<珍珠现在更加明亮了，它移动到了水面上方。>
Completion.english: ¡Qué PRECIOSIDAD! ¡Nunca he visto una así!$B$BSí, sí, claro, tírala a esa fuente. Bien sabe la Luz que la gente tira ahí todo tipo de trastos.$B$B<Ahora la perla brilla más y se desplaza a un punto sobre el agua.>

identity.title: Take Them in Claw
identity.objectives: Attract 3 Wild Moonfall Hippogryphs to deal with the Nightborne at Moonfall Roost.
identity.description:
We should have seen this coming. My sister is dead, my friends are wounded and we will likely die here.

I want revenge.

<Lyrea hands you a vial full of growing green liquid.>

We cannot beat them, but we can turn the Stronghold against them.

Wild hippogryphs are attracted to the scent in this bottle. Wild hippogryphs are also notoriously violent when the object of their attraction is not a hippogryph.

Use it to clear a path deeper into the stronghold.

Completion.text: 我听到了尖叫，很高兴那是夜之子们发出的。做得好。
Completion.english: Oí gritos y me produjo una gran satisfacción que fueran de los Nocheterna. Bien hecho.

identity.title: The Rift Between
identity.objectives: Locate Lothrius Mooncaller in the Athenaeum.
identity.description:
I was with Lothrius when the Nightborne poured into the stronghold.

He and his constructs managed to get the majority of us out of the Athenaeum, but he was cornered before he could make good on his own escape.

I know he still lives- I feel it in my gut!- but I cannot go back for him myself. My injuries are too severe.

Beakbuck will take you to where we last saw Lothrius. Simply let him know when you are ready to leave.

Go quickly, and good luck!

Completion.text: 塞伦娜派你来的？太好了……她还活着。
Completion.english: ¿Te envía Serena? Bien... Sigue viva.

identity.title: Lay Waste, Lay Mines
identity.objectives: Slay 50 Nightborne With the Trap Rune.
identity.description:
They ransacked my library, $n.

If they want our knowledge, we will give it to them. 

This piece of rune work will allow you to cast an ensnaring spell on the ground. When the Nightborne cross the threshold they will see the true might of the Moon Guard.

Teach them well!

Progress.text: 你好好教训他们了吗？
Progress.english: ¿Cómo va la enseñanza?

Completion.text: 大家总有一天会学到教训。活要见人，死要见尸，否则绝不能断定你的敌人已经死了。<洛休斯咧嘴一笑。>
Completion.english: Una lección que todos debemos aprender antes o después. Nunca des a tu enemigo por muerto hasta ver su cadáver. <Lothrius sonríe.>

identity.title: Precious Little Left
identity.objectives: Locate and recover "Anthology of the Guard", "Magical Manifest of the Moon", and "Aftermath of the Well".
identity.description:
I have not been able to leave the safety of my guardians to search, but there are three tomes of great importance to me and mine. 

They contain secrets and cantrips that the Nightborne must NOT obtain. 

<Lothrius raises his hand to your forehead, cementing the names of three tomes into your mind> 

If we cannot best them, we must preserve all we can. Hurry, $n.

Progress.text: 你找到它们了吗？
Progress.english: ¿Los has encontrado?

Completion.text: 感谢月神……它们保存下来了！
Completion.english: Gracias a la Madre Luna... ¡Han sobrevivido!

identity.title: Starweaver's Fate
identity.objectives: Locate Syrana Starweaver
identity.description:
I will take these tomes to Thalrenus.

There is one thing that weighs heavily on my mind, and I would like for you to attend to it in my stead. 

My wife and life partner, Syrana Starweaver, resides in the Starweaver's Sanctum across the bridge. It fell shortly after the Nightborne entered the Stronghold. 

If she still lives she will need to know of our efforts. Her power is sorely needed. 

Give her my best- I will be along shortly.

Completion.text: 这么说，洛休斯和萨伦努斯还活着。或许还有一线希望。谢谢你冒险过桥，陌生人。
Completion.english: Así que Lothrius y Thalrenus viven. Tal vez aún haya esperanza. Gracias por franquear el puente, forastero.

identity.title: The Orchestrator of Our Demise
identity.objectives: Slay Conjurer Thalerian and acquire the Astromancer's Keystone.
identity.description:
Conjurer Thalerian must be stopped.

He immediately sought out my father's private study when he arrived and he has not yet emerged. I worry that he may have found a very dangerous item.

It is called the Astromancer's Keystone. It is used to manipulate the stronghold's defenses.

Such magic was meant to protect the Moon Guard- used for any other purpose and it becomes unspeakably destructive.

Retrieve the Keystone. Slay Conjurer Thalerian to get it, if you must.

Progress.text: 成功了吗？
Progress.english: ¿Ya está?

Completion.text: 他们没有资格占有这份力量。谢谢。
Completion.english: No tenían derecho a poseer este poder. Gracias.

identity.title: Overwhelming Distraction
identity.objectives: Overcharge 3 Imperial Conjurers using the Inert Crystal. You must be standing on a Mana Focuser to use the crystal.
identity.description:
Do you see the Nightborne outside this room?

They hold us here, like mice in a cage. It is more convenient for them that we are pinned down while they search the Sanctum for my father's relics.

My companions and I can escape to higher ground with some help.

Take this crystal. While standing on a mana focusing rune, use it to overcharge a Conjurer.

Their summons will turn on them and create an opening.

Use it well, and we will meet you atop the stronghold when the way is clear.

Completion.text: 幸好有你，我们才能安全地来到这里。
Completion.english: Hemos conseguido llegar a salvo hasta aquí gracias a ti.

identity.title: Last Stand of the Moon Guard
identity.objectives: Leave Moon Guard Stronghold with Thalrenus, Lothrius, and Syrana.
identity.description:
This is all that remains of the Moon Guard.

Take a good look.

We are but a shadow of our former selves, and we have the Nightborne to thank for our demise.

For now there is nothing more we can do. If we want to live, we must leave immediately.

Retribution can wait.

Completion.text: 是我叫他们来的。在我的人民为他们带来如此的灾难后，我希望他们能够获得帮助。
Completion.english: Los he llamado. Me aseguraré de que están a salvo después de los horrores por los que los ha hecho pasar mi pueblo.

identity.title: Creating Time
identity.objectives: Defend Syrana Starweaver.
identity.description:
Thanks in large part to your substantial efforts, we have discovered the whereabouts of a powerful piece of our history. It should enable us to survive whatever else the Nightborne have to throw at us, and hopefully more.

However, recovering it will require a great deal of our energy and focus. We will bolster the Starweaver's scrying efforts, but the slightest disruption will ruin this delicate spellwork. See that we are not disturbed.

Speak to Syrana Starweaver when you are ready to begin.

Objectives.text: 保护塞拉娜·织星。
Objectives.english: Defend Syrana Starweaver.

Description.text:
多亏了你的不懈努力，我们发现了一件强大历史遗物的线索。它应该可以帮助我们面对夜之子的威胁，而且它或许还有更大的潜力。

不过，想要获取遗物的话，我们需要消耗大量的能量和精力。我们会协助织星者进行占卜仪式，不过任何一点轻微的动静都会破坏这个精密的法术。你必须确保我们不会受到任何干扰。

你准备好以后就告诉塞拉娜·织星。
Description.english:
Thanks in large part to your substantial efforts, we have discovered the whereabouts of a powerful piece of our history. It should enable us to survive whatever else the Nightborne have to throw at us, and hopefully more.

However, recovering it will require a great deal of our energy and focus. We will bolster the Starweaver's scrying efforts, but the slightest disruption will ruin this delicate spellwork. See that we are not disturbed.

Speak to Syrana Starweaver when you are ready to begin.

identity.title: Latosius' Trial
identity.objectives: Survive the Trial of Latosius.
identity.description: I bow to Latosius' wisdom. If we are to endure, it must be you who claims the Amulet. Survive this challenge, $n, and the might of the Moon Guard will be yours forevermore.

Objectives.text: 完成拉图修斯的试炼。
Objectives.english: Survive the Trial of Latosius.

Description.text: 拉图修斯的睿智令我敬佩。想要渡过难关，就必须由你去取得护符。$n，只要通过这次挑战，你就能永远拥有月之守卫的力量。
Description.english: I bow to Latosius' wisdom. If we are to endure, it must be you who claims the Amulet. Survive this challenge, $n, and the might of the Moon Guard will be yours forevermore.

identity.title: Demons Among Them
identity.objectives: Protect the Warchief.
identity.description: It is just as we suspected, $n! The demons thought they could take us by surprise.$B$BQuickly, to arms! Protect the Banshee Queen!

Completion.text:
這場攻擊…和破碎海岸上的戰爭…都只不過是燃燒軍團的初步行動。

如果我們不想辦法阻止燃燒軍團，我們就會失去我的父親，還有其他領導者所打造的一切。

我們需要伊利達瑞的支援。
Completion.english: Tu aviso nos salvó de lo que pudo ser una pérdida catastrófica. Ahora podemos desatar nuestra venganza contra esa basura de la Legión.$B$BAhora tienes mi atención, $C... y quizás un poco de agradecimiento también.

identity.title: Shatter the Sashj'tar
identity.objectives: Kill 12 Sashj'tar naga in the Sashj'tar Ruins.
identity.description: The Sashj'tar forces may have dwindled, but the Tidemistress has surrounded herself with her fiercest naga.$B$BThis is the time to strike a final crushing blow against the Sashj'tar.$B$BIf we can defeat them now, we may finally break the back of this menace and save Jandvik.

Completion.text: 我們或許終於能戰勝納迦了。
Completion.english: Tal vez hayamos vencido al fin a la amenaza naga.

identity.title: Hunter to Hunter
identity.objectives: Returno the Hunter's Reach shop in Dalaran and speak to Emmarel Shadewarden.
identity.description: I sense the threads of fate entwined about you. Your destiny is tied to that of the ancient night elf who started you on this journey.$b$bI can send you back to the city in the sky. From there, you must begin the task of gathering allies against the ravenous darkness.$b$bFight well, $n. May Talonclaw serve you well.

Objectives.text: 返回达拉然的猎人用品店与伊墨瑞尔·影卫谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Returno the Hunter's Reach shop in Dalaran and speak to Emmarel Shadewarden.

Description.text: 我感觉到你的命运线纵横交错。让你踏上这次旅途的古老暗夜精灵与你命运相连。$b$b我可以送你返回空中的城市。你必须从那里开始履行你的使命，集结盟友共同对抗吞噬一切的黑暗。$b$b努力奋战，$n。愿雄鹰之爪让你如虎添翼。
Description.english: I sense the threads of fate entwined about you. Your destiny is tied to that of the ancient night elf who started you on this journey.$b$bI can send you back to the city in the sky. From there, you must begin the task of gathering allies against the ravenous darkness.$b$bFight well, $n. May Talonclaw serve you well.

identity.title: Fish Frenzy
identity.objectives: Follow Nat Pagle to the Gloaming Reef, then dispatch all of the fish in the area.
identity.description: $N!$b$b<pant, pant>$b$bYou've got to see it! The fish, they're... they're everywhere!$b$bOff the coast of Val'sharah, something's whipping them up into a frenzy.$b$bI've never seen better fishing in my life!$b$bI've got a boat down below. Grab your pole and I'll take you there!

Completion.text: 你给我的是什么东西？纳特叫你请求我把这玩意儿做成鱼竿？$B$B<玛西娅接过你手中切断的鱼饵。她将鱼饵挨到珍珠跟前，发现它们产生了共鸣。>$B$B有点意思。看来这东西和珍珠之间存在某种联系。也许把这东西做成鱼竿确实能得出有趣的结果……
Completion.english: ¡Pero ¿qué diablos me has traído?! ¿Nat te ha dicho que me pidas que te haga una caña con ESTO?$B$B<Marcia coge el señuelo cortado. Cuando lo acerca a la perla, comienza a resonar con ella.>$B$BQué interesante. Parece haber una conexión entre esto y la perla. Si lo convierto en una caña de pescar, quizás obtengamos un resultado interesante...

identity.title: One Last Breath
identity.objectives: Drink the Nightfallen Alchemist's Strange Draught in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: <The parchment is soaked in seawater. A note is hastily scribbled on it.>$B$BTo whomever finds this note first,$B$BBefore I was cast from Suramar, I was a master alchemist. In my time, I have concocted many potions and elixirs for the benefit of the Nightborne.$B$BAll of this was forgotten when the Legion came.$B$BBefore I succumb to the hunger, I wanted to create one last draught to celebrate my love of sea.$B$BDrink it and explore the vast deep in my honor.

Objectives.text: 在蓝风海窟喝下堕夜炼金师的古怪饮剂。
Objectives.english: Drink the Nightfallen Alchemist's Strange Draught in Azuregale Bay.

Description.text: <羊皮纸浸泡在海水中。上面有一条仓促写下的留言。>$B$B至最早发现这张便条的人：$B$B在被驱逐出苏拉玛之前，我是一名炼金大师。曾经，我调制了许多对夜之子有益的药水和药剂。$B$B但是，在燃烧军团到来以后，我的贡献被抹杀了。$B$B在屈服于饥渴之前，我想制作最后一份饮剂，表达我对海洋的热爱。$B$B喝下它，带着我的祝福去探索这片无边无际的深海。
Description.english: <The parchment is soaked in seawater. A note is hastily scribbled on it.>$B$BTo whomever finds this note first,$B$BBefore I was cast from Suramar, I was a master alchemist. In my time, I have concocted many potions and elixirs for the benefit of the Nightborne.$B$BAll of this was forgotten when the Legion came.$B$BBefore I succumb to the hunger, I wanted to create one last draught to celebrate my love of sea.$B$BDrink it and explore the vast deep in my honor.

identity.title: Power Grid
identity.objectives: Charge the Moon Seal, Star Seal, Beast Seal and Elven Seal in Ley Station: Tel'Anor.
identity.description: This station has fallen into disrepair. The circuit is broken, and to mend it we must recharge the seals in the central chamber.$B$BBoth a high potency current and low potency current are needed for each seal. Direct the currents to point at the same seal, then engage the seal.$B$BMe? I shall supervise. You are the help, after all.

Completion.text: 我得承認你蠻厲害的，或許你真的能幫上我們的忙。
Completion.english: Estoy impresionada, lo reconozco. Puede que nos sirvas de algo y todo.

identity.title: Sigil Reclamation
identity.objectives: Collect 7 Moon Guard Sigils.
identity.description:
The smooth square sigil weighs a fair amount more than its appearance would suggest. 

Handling it results in an intense tingling sensation in your palm- this is an object of focused, pure power. 

Such an advantage should not be so easily surrendered to the Nightborne.

Progress.text: 这是什么？
Progress.english: ¿Qué es esto?

Completion.text: 不让这些落入敌人的手中，你很聪明，$C。我认为你值得信任。
Completion.english: Hiciste bien al mantenerlo lejos de las manos enemigas, $C. Creo que se puede confiar en ti.

identity.title: For the People
identity.objectives: Locate an Arcwine Fountain to fill your Empty Arcwine Skin, then offer Arcwine to Mana-Starved Nightborne.
identity.description:
We have a problem, friend.

Across the canal is a district not well known for affluence. Since the demons' arrival, it has been locked down. I have heard the cries of those who have been deprived of sustenance.

Take this wineskin. Find an Arcwine fountain and take your fill.

Find those who are suffering and offer them a drink. It is the best we can do in the present circumstances.

You must not be seen doing this, $n. It will end badly.

Objectives.text: 找到魔力酒泉，把空的魔力酒囊装满，然后把魔力酒分给渴求法力的夜之子。
Objectives.english: Locate an Arcwine Fountain to fill your Empty Arcwine Skin, then offer Arcwine to Mana-Starved Nightborne.

Description.text:
我们遇到一个问题，朋友。

运河对面是一个不太富裕的街区。恶魔到来以后，那里就被封闭了。我可以听到那些失去补给的人所发出的惨叫。

拿上这个酒囊，找到魔力酒泉并装满它。

找到那些受苦的人，把酒给他们喝。在现在这种情况下，我们能做的只有这么多了。

你必须暗中行事，$n。否则后果不堪设想。
Description.english:
We have a problem, friend.

Across the canal is a district not well known for affluence. Since the demons' arrival, it has been locked down. I have heard the cries of those who have been deprived of sustenance.

Take this wineskin. Find an Arcwine fountain and take your fill.

Find those who are suffering and offer them a drink. It is the best we can do in the present circumstances.

You must not be seen doing this, $n. It will end badly.

identity.title: Stop the Spell Seekers
identity.objectives: Close 3 Spell Seeker Portals.
identity.description:
The Nightborne are here in force. As if that were not worrying enough, they now bring reinforcements.

I have seen them opening large portals to Suramar.

Through these portals they have called in their constructs. They are immune to much of my magic and so represent something of a stumbling block to rejoining the others.

Find the portals and close as many as you can. That should buy us some time.

Completion.text: 很好！我感觉到他们的法术正在消逝。我很快就能和拉图修斯会合！
Completion.english: ¡Sí! Siento cómo se desvanecen sus hechizos. ¡Pronto podré reunirme con Thalrenus!

identity.title: Testing the Waters
identity.objectives: Slay Raz'jira, Malt'his, and Kel'tariss in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: There is no place that the Sashj'tar can hide from you now, $n.$B$BThey will not be expecting a direct attack in their waters. This is a perfect opportunity to cut down their commanders.$B$BMeet me in Jandvik after you have slaughtered them.

Completion.text:
海灣裡有海巨人！？

你得立刻把這可怕的消息告訴托莉爾。
Completion.english: ¿¡Hay gigantes de mar en la bahía!?$B$BDebes decirle a Toryl acerca de estas terribles noticias de inmediato.

identity.title: Sashj'tar Allies DISBALED
identity.objectives: Speak with Toryl in Jandvik.
identity.description: Commander Malt'his was conferring with a sea giant?$B$BWe are prepared to battle the naga, but if they have yoked the strength of the sea giants, we will have to double our efforts to save Jandvik.$B$BYou must tell Toryl about this grave news right away.

Objectives.text: 在贾德维克与托尔里谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with Toryl in Jandvik.

Description.text: 指挥官马尔特希斯在跟海巨人打交道？$B$B我们已经准备好跟纳迦开战，但是如果他们有了海巨人助阵，我们就必须加倍努力才能保住贾德维克。$B$B你必须立刻把这个重大的消息告诉托尔里。
Description.english: Commander Malt'his was conferring with a sea giant?$B$BWe are prepared to battle the naga, but if they have yoked the strength of the sea giants, we will have to double our efforts to save Jandvik.$B$BYou must tell Toryl about this grave news right away.

identity.title: Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim
identity.objectives: Use the Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim to empower your artifact.
identity.description: Even as we speak, the Legion's dark masters fashion new horrors in hopes that they might destroy us - especially you.$B$BYou must increase your own power as well.$B$BThe Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim, our greatest treasure from taking the Fel Hammer, waits in the chamber ahead. You can use it to further empower your blades and maintain our edge over the enemy.

Progress.text: 你的武器……闪耀着强大的力量……
Progress.english: Your blades... they glow with such power...

identity.title: Shard of Vorgos
identity.objectives: Collect the Shard of Vorgos.
identity.description: According to the wyrmtongue servant, there is a portal that will take you into the Burning Legion command ship. However, the portal is locked to those without the keys.$b$bThe first key shard is held by an Ered'ruin known as Vorgos. He resides within the Fel Breach, which is at the end of the Arcway.$b$bSlay Vorgos and place the key shard into its position next to the portal.

Progress.text: <沃戈斯裂片在你手中發出脈動。>
Progress.english: <El fragmento de Vorgos palpita en tu mano.>

Completion.text: <沃戈斯裂片嵌入了傳送門旁的位置。漩渦般的魔化能量圍繞在裂片四周，整個房間充滿不祥的黑暗能量。>
Completion.english: El fragmento de Vorgos encaja en su sitio junto al portal. A su alrededor se acumula energía vil, que llena la estancia de una presencia oscura y ominosa.

identity.title: Shard of Kozak
identity.objectives: Collect the Shard of Kozak.
identity.description: The demon leading the operation in Felsoul Hold is an eredar named Azoran. In order to get to him, we will need to open a portal to the Burning Legion command ship.$b$bAzoran has a demon jailer in his service known as Kozak the Afflictor.$b$bKozak the Afflictor holds one of the key shards necessary to open a portal to the ship. He can be found in the prison quarters known as the Halls of the Eclipse in the lower portion of Felsoul Hold.$b$bSlay Kozak and place his key shard next to the portal.

Progress.text: <寇札克裂片極力掙脫，似乎想飛向某個地方。>
Progress.english: <El fragmento de Kozak tira como si quisiera volar a su sitio.>

Completion.text: <寇札克裂片嵌入傳送門旁的定位。你可以感覺到無數魔化能量朝著傳送門聚集過來，在你身旁不斷翻滾擾動。>
Completion.english: <El fragmento de Kozak encaja en su sitio junto al portal. Sientes el estremecimiento oscuro de la energía vil que te rodea al acumularse cerca del portal.>

identity.title: Bad Apples
identity.objectives: Gather $1oa Shadowbloom.
identity.description: That fruit over there? That's a pale imitation to what I can grow.$b$bBut that accursed Daglir somehow manages to gain the favor of the courts, so we must dine on mediocrity!$b$bWe must teach Daglir a lesson for stealing my crop, but we must be discreet.$b$bOutside the shield grows a purple flower called Shadowbloom. Fetch some for me and we'll make sure that he pays dearly for his insolence!

Progress.text: 如果我是你，我會先洗手，再吃東西。
Progress.english: Yo que tú no comería nada hasta haberme lavado las manos.

Completion.text: 非常好，這些夠我用了。
Completion.english: Excelente. Con esto bastará para mis fines.

identity.title: An Artisan's Mark
identity.objectives: Obtain Lespin's Signet Ring.
identity.description: You there! Do you have a moment?$b$bI need you to meet with my friend in the Promenade and retrieve a signet ring. I would send my oaf of an apprentice, but he is not finished with the simple task I gave him.$b$bI am expecting a guest at any moment and I simply must have it before he arrives. Can you help me, friend?

Progress.text: 你拿到了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Lo tienes?

Completion.text:
喔，感謝博學者！我曾怕永遠找不到它了。

我知道這枚戒指有些…用途。我的確希望它不屬於任何重要人士。或是…會說話之人。
Completion.english: ¡Oh, gracias a la Magistrix! Temía que se hubiera perdido para siempre.$B$BVeo que este sello está... usado. Espero que no con alguien importante. O... ruidoso.

identity.title: Fall of the King
identity.objectives: Place the Jandvik Banner on the Sea Giant King's island to draw him out and defeat him.
identity.description: All that remains is the Sea Giant King.$B$BPlace our banner upon his beach and draw him out of the sea. Once he has revealed himself, use the trident to wound him.$B$BThere is a derelict boat that washed up on the shore. Use that to quickly get to the king's island.$B$BGird your loins, $n. This fight will not be easy.

Objectives.text: 把贾德维克旗帜插到海巨人国王的岛上，引出国王并消灭他。
Objectives.english: Place the Jandvik Banner on the Sea Giant King's island to draw him out and defeat him.

Description.text: 现在只剩下海巨人国王了。$B$B把我们的旗帜放到他的海滩上，引蛇出洞。只要他一现身，就用三叉戟攻击他。$B$B那边有一艘被冲上岸的弃船，用它迅速赶到国王的岛屿。$B$B做好准备，$n。这将是一场硬仗。
Description.english: All that remains is the Sea Giant King.$B$BPlace our banner upon his beach and draw him out of the sea. Once he has revealed himself, use the trident to wound him.$B$BThere is a derelict boat that washed up on the shore. Use that to quickly get to the king's island.$B$BGird your loins, $n. This fight will not be easy.

identity.title: Feeding Shal'Aran
identity.objectives: Examine the Leyline Feed in Shal'Aran with Arcanist Valtrois.
identity.description: With leyline energy feeding in from Anora, this chamber can begin to awaken.$B$BIt will be a slow process, and we must take care to mask this activity from our enemies, a process which itself requires enormous effort and focus.$B$BFurthermore, there is the conundrum of actually consuming the mana in this form. A stream too weak is not enough to provide sustenance - too powerful and it would vaporize us.$B$BThere is much work to be done yet. For now, let us examine the feed.

Completion.text: 我會再次找你的，我確定。
Completion.english: Te volveré a llamar, no tengo ninguna duda.

identity.title: The Key Is Around Here Somewhere...
identity.objectives: Find the Reinforced Cage Key.
identity.description: Well aren't ye a sight fer sore eyes!$b$bIt's no use tryin' to bust open this cage, this one needs a key!$b$bNow, I know what yer thinkin', "How is it possible that the Burnin' Legion could capture a dwarf as mighty as ol' Angus here."$b$bYe can rest easy knowin' I let myself be captured. I'm here to rescue a dear friend o' mine, an' gettin' captured was the only way!$b$bI had the key in me pocket... but it musta' fell out.$b$bIt's  errm... around here somewhere.$b$bA felhunter ate it a wee while back...

Progress.text: 你找到鑰匙了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Has encontrado la llave?

Completion.text:
你找到鑰匙了！快點，看看合不合…

沒錯，就是這支！你找到了！
Completion.english: ¡Has encontrado la llave! Rápido, a ver si entra...$B$B¡Sí, esta es! ¡Lo has conseguido!

identity.title: Search and Rescue!
identity.objectives: Find Brambley Morrison.
identity.description: We've got to find Brambley before it's too late!$b$bOl' Brambley an' I have been fightin' side by side since the Third War. When the Burnin' Legion invaded, we didn't think twice about coming to the Broken Isles.$b$bFightin' is what we do best!$b$bDuring the battle ol' Brambley got caught too deep an' got himself captured. Now we've got to rescue him!$b$bLast I saw, the demons were keeping him in a prison cell not far from here... let's go!

Progress.text: 你找到鑰匙了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Has encontrado ya la llave?

Completion.text: 終於被人從這個可怕的牢籠中放出來了，太好了。作為回報，我會遵守對你和你古怪的多毛朋友所做的的承諾。
Completion.english: Qué gusto salir al fin de esta horrible jaula. Como agradecimiento, cumpliré mi palabra contigo y con tu grotesco amigo peludo.

identity.title: Mglrgrs Of Our Grmlgrlr
identity.description: Mlrg...mglrmlr...$b$bGmlrgmlr mglrml gmlrg! Mlrgrlgr!$b$b<Mrgrglilgrl points at the trail of spiderwebs leading out of the ruin.>

Completion.text: 莫咕莫嘎咕莫！莫咕莫嘎咕莫咕，莫咕哇啊莫咕嘎哩莫哩！莫咕莫嘎咕莫莫咕，莫咕哩咕…
Completion.english: ¡Mlrgmlr rmlgml! Mrlmgrlg gmlrmlrg, grmlgmlr lmrglgr mlgmrlr. Mlgrmlgr grmlmgl, Mrgrlilgrl...

identity.title: Elegant Design
identity.objectives: Convince Lady Anastae to give you the Gemcutter's Tome.
identity.description: Amateur merchants complain about supply and demand. Masters create their own.$b$bYou have done well retrieving the last two pieces I requested, but they are baubles compared to this.$b$bYour target is the Lady Anastae, and she has something very valuable of mine: A design for a masterwork gem cut. $b$bGo and get it from her by any means necessary, but take care. She is a master manipulator and will tell you all manner of lies.

Completion.text: 萊斯賓會為他的罪行付出代價！
Completion.english: ¡Lespin pagará por sus crímenes!

identity.title: Dispensing Compassion
identity.objectives: Offer Arcwine to suffering citizens.
identity.description:
There is much you need to learn about our city.

First and foremost, Arcwine. It is the vehicle by which we imbibe the Nightwell's energies. Without it, we wither and die.

Palace lackeys have seen fit to ration it, thinking this will control us. Keep us quiet, complacent.

I would like you to look for those in need near the tavern. You will find many, but those most desperately afflicted by this rationing will be obvious.

Take this flask. Revive them. Tend to their suffering.

Progress.text: 你是否讓他們免於折磨？
Progress.english: ¿Has ayudado a los afligidos?

Completion.text: 你正在逐漸了解我們的現實世界。我能從你的表情中看出來。很好。
Completion.english: Estás abriendo los ojos a nuestra realidad. Lo veo en tu expresión. Bien.

identity.title: A Re-Warding Effort
identity.objectives: Activate $1oa Arcane Wards in Ambervale.
identity.description:
<This small device of elegant nightborne design crackles gently with arcane power.

Kel'danath's notes mention wards that keep the withered at bay. It seems he found some form of spellcasting that does not tempt their ravenous appetite for magic.

These may prove useful in your search for the missing arcanist.>

Completion.text: <結界斷然張開，帶給你些微的痛感。克達納茲一定耗費了無數心力研發這個咒語，既可嚇跑凋萎者，又不會讓他們受傷。>
Completion.english: <The ward snaps to life, giving you a slight pinch. Kel'danath must have put great care into developing a spell that would scare the withered away without harming them.>

identity.title: The Dark Riders
identity.objectives: Defeat the Dark Riders in the Karazhan Catacombs and claim Ulthalesh.
identity.description:
There's a sewer grate along the edge of the river leading to catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it could be where the spirits are directing us.

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

Completion.text:
今天，黑騎兵嘗到有史以來最大的敗績，也是暮色森林人民的一大勝利。

他們欠你一份恩情，我也是。
Completion.english: Though I'll admit I may not have been able to do this alone, I will not forget the transgressions that happened today.$B$BYou have what you came for, $C. I think it is time you were on your way.

identity.title: Corrupted Studies
identity.objectives: Survey digsites in Stormheim and bring Brann back $1oa War of the Ancients Fragments.
identity.description: Stormheim is steeped with artifacts from tha War of the Ancients. Demon artifacts ta be exact.$b$bI think these artifacts can clue us into some knowledge about their leader, Sargeras. I've already found some fragments to a titan disc, but need ta find the rest of 'em.$b$bI need ya ta dig around Stormheim and see if ye can find any more fragments so we can reassemble the disc.

Description.text: 风暴峡湾到处都是上古之战遗留下来的神器。准确地说，是恶魔的神器。$b$b我认为，这些神器可以提供一些线索，让我们进一步了解他们的领导者萨格拉斯。我已经找到一些泰坦圆盘的碎片，还需要找到其余的部分。$b$b我要你在风暴峡湾进行挖掘，看看能不能找到更多的碎片，好让我们拼合圆盘。
Description.english: Stormheim is steeped with artifacts from tha War of the Ancients. Demon artifacts ta be exact.$b$bI think these artifacts can clue us into some knowledge about their leader, Sargeras. I've already found some fragments to a titan disc, but need ta find the rest of 'em.$b$bI need ya ta dig around Stormheim and see if ye can find any more fragments so we can reassemble the disc.

identity.title: And Into the Fel Fire
identity.objectives: Survey digsites in Azsuna and find $1oa missing Parts of the Infernal Device and bring them back to Brann.
identity.description: I found something, $n. Well, a couple of things actually.$b$bFirst I found an ancient text talking about a demon who harnessed the power of the titan disc I've been searching for.$b$bThen I found a device which supposedly is used to summon 'im! Only, it's missin' some pieces from what I can make out.$b$bI'm sure if we survey around Azsuna some more, those missin' pieces are sure ta turn up.

Description.text: 我发现了一样东西，$n。其实，是发现了一些东西。$b$b起初，我发现了一篇古代文本，里面讲诉了一个恶魔的事情，而那个恶魔拥有我一直在寻找的泰坦圆盘的力量。$b$b后来我又找到了一个可能是用来召唤那个恶魔的装置！不过就我所知，它缺少一些零件。$b$b我确信，如果我们在阿苏纳继续勘测的话，一定会找到那些遗失的零件。
Description.english: I found something, $n. Well, a couple of things actually.$b$bFirst I found an ancient text talking about a demon who harnessed the power of the titan disc I've been searching for.$b$bThen I found a device which supposedly is used to summon 'im! Only, it's missin' some pieces from what I can make out.$b$bI'm sure if we survey around Azsuna some more, those missin' pieces are sure ta turn up.

identity.title: The Apocalypse Bringer
identity.objectives: Talk to Brann when you're ready to activate the device.
identity.description: Right, well, I managed to piece the device back together.$b$bI guess I'll jes' turn it on when you're ready and we'll see what happens, yea?

Objectives.text: 准备好之后跟布莱恩交谈以启动装置。
Objectives.english: Talk to Brann when you're ready to activate the device.

Description.text: 成功了，我把零件都装回去了。$b$b等你准备好之后我就启动装置，看看会发生什么，可以吗？
Description.english: Right, well, I managed to piece the device back together.$b$bI guess I'll jes' turn it on when you're ready and we'll see what happens, yea?

identity.title: Darkheart Thicket: Through the Fog
identity.objectives: Obtain the Final Chapter of The Purple Hills of Mac'Aree.
identity.description: I can't believe that after all that searchin' ye did, it's still missing a chapter!$b$bI'm willin' ta bet that those satyrs got a hand on it and took it somewhere. Probably somewhere dark where no one could find it.$b$bI've heard rumors of a place, the Darkheart Thicket they call it, where the strongest of the satyrs are.$b$bIf I had ta guess, I'd say ye need to go there and look around fer it.

Objectives.text: 取得《玛凯雷的紫色群山》终章。
Objectives.english: Obtain the Final Chapter of The Purple Hills of Mac'Aree.

Description.text: 难以置信，你费力找了这么久，居然还缺一个章节！$b$b我敢打赌，它肯定是被萨特拿到其他地方去了。应该是被藏在一个阴森的，没有人找得到的地方。$b$b我听说过一个叫做黑心林地的地方，那里有最强大的萨特。$b$b要是我没猜错的话，你应该去那里找找。
Description.english: I can't believe that after all that searchin' ye did, it's still missing a chapter!$b$bI'm willin' ta bet that those satyrs got a hand on it and took it somewhere. Probably somewhere dark where no one could find it.$b$bI've heard rumors of a place, the Darkheart Thicket they call it, where the strongest of the satyrs are.$b$bIf I had ta guess, I'd say ye need to go there and look around fer it.

identity.title: The Reliquary Calls
identity.objectives: Meet with Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher in Azsuna.
identity.description: Tae'thelan of the Reliquary has asked me to send anyone who may be able to help them in Azsuna.$b$bSeeing as how you happened into my shop purely by coincidence, I thought you'd be willing to go, $n.$b$bBack to work for me though. So much to do and so little help.$b$b<Dariness lets out a sigh.>

Objectives.text: 在阿苏纳与泰瑟兰·血望者见面。
Objectives.english: Meet with Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher in Azsuna.

Description.text: 神圣遗物学会的泰瑟兰要我把能够帮得上忙的人派到阿苏纳。$b$b既然你曾经那么碰巧地来到我的商店，或许你会愿意帮忙，$n。$b$b不过记得回来继续帮我干活，这里事情太多，但是人手却太少。$b$b<达瑞妮斯叹了口气。>
Description.english: Tae'thelan of the Reliquary has asked me to send anyone who may be able to help them in Azsuna.$b$bSeeing as how you happened into my shop purely by coincidence, I thought you'd be willing to go, $n.$b$bBack to work for me though. So much to do and so little help.$b$b<Dariness lets out a sigh.>

identity.title: A Beacon of Hope
identity.objectives: Go to the location Tae'thelan marked on your map and survey the area until you find the artifact.
identity.description: I've marked the location of the artifact on your map. It's in a rather hostile location, so I'd like you to go there and find it.$b$bWhen you've recovered it, bring it back to me so I can discern its power.

Objectives.text: 前往泰瑟連在地圖上標記的位置，並進行勘察，直到找到文物為止。
Objectives.english: Go to the location Tae'thelan marked on your map and survey the area until you find the artifact.

Description.text: 我已經把文物的位置標記在你的地圖上。文物就位在敵人出沒的地方，我希望你可以前往那裡，找回文物。$b$b找回文物後，把它帶回來給我，我會辨識文物的力量。
Description.english: I've marked the location of the artifact on your map. It's in a rather hostile location, so I'd like you to go there and find it.$b$bWhen you've recovered it, bring it back to me so I can discern its power.

identity.title: Explosive Results
identity.objectives: Use the goblin explosives to free $1oa Artifact Fragments from their geological prisons.
identity.description: As you may or may not have heard, I've been working with the goblins on using a new way of uncovering our artifacts.$b$bAnd if you know anything about goblins, you know that I'm talking about explosives.$b$bWe've only run a few tests here at my camp, but I would appreciate your help in testing this method out in the field.$b$bI've marked a location on your map that has some particularly difficult digs.

Description.text: 你或许听说过，我正在和地精合作，使用新的方法挖掘古物。$b$b如果你对地精略有所知的话，应该知道我所说的新方法就是爆破。$b$b我们只在营地进行了一些测试，如果你能到野外去测试这套新方法的话，我将会非常感激。$b$b我在你的地图上标出了一个位置，那里有一些非常有难度的挖掘点。
Description.english: As you may or may not have heard, I've been working with the goblins on using a new way of uncovering our artifacts.$b$bAnd if you know anything about goblins, you know that I'm talking about explosives.$b$bWe've only run a few tests here at my camp, but I would appreciate your help in testing this method out in the field.$b$bI've marked a location on your map that has some particularly difficult digs.

identity.title: What Once Was Lost
identity.objectives: Go to the location marked on the map and recover the artifact in question. Use the dynamite to uncover the artifact.
identity.description: That reminds me, I found a map to a chamber that may or may not hold something of value.$b$bIt doesn't seem to have any power associated with it, which is why I'm handing it over to you.$b$bHere, take some more explosives. They may help speed of the process of finding it.

Objectives.text: 前往地图上标记的地点，获取相关的神器。用炸药来帮助你挖掘神器。
Objectives.english: Go to the location marked on the map and recover the artifact in question. Use the dynamite to uncover the artifact.

Description.text: 我想起来了，我找到了一张密室地图，那里面可能藏着有用的东西。$b$b它似乎和任何力量都没有关系，所以我把这件事交给你来办。$b$b过来多拿些炸药。它们或许可以加快你的搜索速度。
Description.english: That reminds me, I found a map to a chamber that may or may not hold something of value.$b$bIt doesn't seem to have any power associated with it, which is why I'm handing it over to you.$b$bHere, take some more explosives. They may help speed of the process of finding it.

identity.title: Uncovering the Orb of Sciallax
identity.objectives: Meet Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher at the entrance to the chamber where the Orb of Sciallax is held. Once inside, set the charges on the casing and recover the artifact.
identity.description: We'll need to hurry before the nightborne realize what we're after.$b$bI'm bringing the goblins along in case we run into any obstacles along the way.$b$bI've marked the location of the entrance to the chamber the Orb resides in on your map.$b$bMeet me there as soon as you're ready and we'll claim this artifact for our own.

Objectives.text: 在斯卡拉克斯珠宝所在密室的入口处和泰瑟兰·血望者碰头。进去之后，在外壳上设置炸药，然后取得神器。
Objectives.english: Meet Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher at the entrance to the chamber where the Orb of Sciallax is held. Once inside, set the charges on the casing and recover the artifact.

Description.text: 我们必须在夜之子发现我们的意图之前迅速行动。$b$b我会带上地精一起，以防中途遇到什么障碍。$b$b我在你的地图上标出了珠宝所在密室的入口位置。$b$b你准备好之后，就尽快到那里跟我碰头，然后我们一起取得这件神器。
Description.english: We'll need to hurry before the nightborne realize what we're after.$b$bI'm bringing the goblins along in case we run into any obstacles along the way.$b$bI've marked the location of the entrance to the chamber the Orb resides in on your map.$b$bMeet me there as soon as you're ready and we'll claim this artifact for our own.

identity.title: Surveying Student
identity.objectives: Complete 20 successful surveys with Luron present.
identity.description: The reason I sent for someone was that I've been having trouble keeping up with my research and training my assistant.$b$bI was hoping you might be able to show him the ropes again. Get him reacquainted with surveying.$b$bJust speak with him when you're ready to go.

Objectives.text: 于鲁隆在场的情况下完成20次勘测。
Objectives.english: Complete 20 successful surveys with Luron present.

Description.text: 我之所以需要帮忙，是因为我没办法一边进行研究一边训练我的助手。$b$b我希望你可以再提点提点他，让他重新掌握勘测技巧。$b$b等你准备好之后就去跟他谈谈吧。
Description.english: The reason I sent for someone was that I've been having trouble keeping up with my research and training my assistant.$b$bI was hoping you might be able to show him the ropes again. Get him reacquainted with surveying.$b$bJust speak with him when you're ready to go.

identity.title: Neltharion's Lair: Misdirected
identity.objectives: Go to Neltharion's Lair and recover the Ancient Highmountain Artifact.
identity.description: I've been looking into the history of Huln Highmountain, a legendary warrior from the War of the Ancients whom this very land is named after.$b$bAllegedly some of his personal effects were carried here after his death and have been lost in time.$b$bAfter some digging around I believe I have discovered the location of one of his artifacts to be in a place called Neltharion's Lair.$b$bI'm no fighter, $n, but you are. Will you go and recover this artifact for me?

Objectives.text: 前往奈萨里奥的巢穴，取得上古至高岭神器。
Objectives.english: Go to Neltharion's Lair and recover the Ancient Highmountain Artifact.

Description.text: 我一直在研究胡恩·高岭的历史，他是上古之战时期的传奇战士，这片土地就是以他的名字而命名的。$b$b据说在他死后，他的一些私人物品被带到这里，后来随着时间的流逝而遗失。$b$b在这里挖掘之后，我相信他的一件神器就在奈萨里奥的巢穴里。$b$b我不擅长战斗，$n，但是你跟我不一样。你愿意到那里去帮我取得这件神器吗？
Description.english: I've been looking into the history of Huln Highmountain, a legendary warrior from the War of the Ancients whom this very land is named after.$b$bAllegedly some of his personal effects were carried here after his death and have been lost in time.$b$bAfter some digging around I believe I have discovered the location of one of his artifacts to be in a place called Neltharion's Lair.$b$bI'm no fighter, $n, but you are. Will you go and recover this artifact for me?

identity.title: The Right Path
identity.objectives: Meet with Lessah in Highmountain.
identity.description: This new shop is shaping up quite nicely, I think. Still, there's so much left to organize.$b$b$n, Lessah has requested your presence in Highmountain. Something about a moose?$b$bI'm not sure to what she's speaking of, but as soon as you have a chance, please go see her.

Objectives.text: 在至高岭与莱莎见面。
Objectives.english: Meet with Lessah in Highmountain.

Description.text: 我觉得，这个新店铺已经大致完工。不过，还是有很多东西需要整理。$b$b$n，莱莎要你到至高岭去找她。好像是和驼鹿有关？$b$b我不太确定她的意思，不过你有空就尽快去找她吧。
Description.english: This new shop is shaping up quite nicely, I think. Still, there's so much left to organize.$b$b$n, Lessah has requested your presence in Highmountain. Something about a moose?$b$bI'm not sure to what she's speaking of, but as soon as you have a chance, please go see her.

identity.title: Laying to Rest
identity.objectives: Find $1oa Bone Fragments of Eche'ro and return them to Lessah in Highmountain. Then observe the burial ceremony Lessah performs.
identity.description: If I was able to find a bone fragment in what appeared to be a random location, then that means Eche'ro's bones must be scattered around Highmountain.$b$bWe must find his remains and give him the proper burial he deserved.$b$bOh, I'm sorry, in case you weren't aware, Eche'ro was Huln Highmountain's mount and companion.$b$bHe deserves to be honored as Huln once was.

Description.text: 如果我能在随意的一个地方找到遗骨残片，那就意味着艾特洛的遗骨一定散落在至高岭的各个角落。$b$b我们必须找到其余的遗骨，并给它举行一场合适的葬礼。$b$b噢，抱歉，如果你不知道的话请听我说，艾特洛曾经是胡恩·高岭的坐骑和伙伴。$b$b它应该得到和胡恩一样的尊敬。
Description.english: If I was able to find a bone fragment in what appeared to be a random location, then that means Eche'ro's bones must be scattered around Highmountain.$b$bWe must find his remains and give him the proper burial he deserved.$b$bOh, I'm sorry, in case you weren't aware, Eche'ro was Huln Highmountain's mount and companion.$b$bHe deserves to be honored as Huln once was.

identity.title: You've Got to Be Kitten Me Right Meow
identity.objectives: "Herd" 7 Lost Feathermane Kittens back home.
identity.description:
While you were dealing with the stray Owlkitten, I took a look around.

It seems these curious creatures have a habit of escaping their parents' watchful eyes - some are trapped across the road by a wandering Ettin. 

He appears to have been... ahem... eating them.

We can earn Yowlon's blessing by bringing his children home.

Completion.text: 牠們看起來很開心能回到家裡。做得非常好。
Completion.english: Parecen muy contentos de estar en casa. Excelente trabajo.

identity.title: Parts Unknown
identity.objectives: Collect Brambley Morrison's remains.
identity.description: Brambley... I still canna' believe it.$b$bI canna' leave the lad here... not in this place... not like this.$b$bHelp me find the rest of him, so I can take his remains back home where he belongs.$b$bWe'll give him a proper burial... it's what he deserves!

Completion.text:
<安格斯一邊擦眼淚一邊說。>

布蘭伯利，你這傢伙…我保證會給你一場最盛大的葬禮！還有喝也喝不完的麥酒…
Completion.english: <Angus se seca una lágrima al hablar.>$B$BBrambley, muchacho... ¡Te prometo que tendrás el funeral más lujoso que puedas imaginar! Y toda la cerveza que puedas beber...

identity.title: They Become The Hunted
identity.objectives: Slay 6 Nightborne Trappers.
identity.description: The trapper you slew was but one of many.$b$bThe Nightborne are subjugating the local creatures, creating a sort of pleasurable exhibit. I think we can strike them in two places at once.$b$bDescend upon these trappers, $r. Let us teach them a lesson in respecting their prey.

Completion.text: 做得非常好。他們不尊重狩獵，所以必須藉此提醒他們自己的定位。
Completion.english: Un trabajo excelente. No respetan la caza, así que hay que recordarles cuál es su sitio.

identity.title: Survival of the Fittest
identity.objectives: Free $1oa exhibits from the Menagerie.
identity.description: The collar you took from the trapper is simple, but effective. Affixing the collar to a target will make them complacent and obedient to their Nightborne masters. Lilryia was able to reverse the spell using the traps you found.$b$bThe magics in the collar can now be used to cancel out the other collars.$b$bHow about giving the Nightborne a reminder that nature always finds a way?

Completion.text: 我從這裡就能聽見他們的哭喊，看到屠殺的慘況！總算能教訓那些任意奴役生物的夜裔精靈。躲在護盾下這麼多年來，他們竟然墮落到這種地步！
Completion.english: ¡Podía oír sus gritos y ver la carnicería desde aquí! Así aprenderán los Nocheterna a no esclavizar criaturas. ¿Tan bajo han caído durante todos esos años bajo el escudo?

identity.title: Into The Pit!
identity.objectives: Escort Angus to Felmaw Cavern in Felsoul Hold.
identity.description: The felstalker pits?!$b$bThere's no time to waste, $n!$b$b I canna' tell ye what the Burnin' Legion has planned for ol' Brambley, but it canna' be good!$b$bHurry! We've got to find him before the Burnin' Legion has their way with him!

Completion.text:
這不是真的！

布蘭伯利…我親愛的老朋友！你為什麼就這樣死了？
Completion.english: ¡No puede ser!$B$BBrambley... ¡Mi querido amigo! ¿Por qué has tenido que morir?

identity.title: Trapping Evolved
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Arcane Traps for Lilryia.
identity.description: The Nightborne are using magic for everything, even trapping.$b$bNighteyes saw them at work, laying down magical snares to capture prey rather than the kind our people use. $b$bBring me their traps so that I may study their make.

Progress.text: $r，你拿到陷阱了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Tienes los cepos, $R?

Completion.text: 這些裝置非常獨特。它們很像是我們獵人使用的陷阱，卻可以透過魔法吸引並困住附近的野獸。
Completion.english: Qué curiosos son estos artefactos. Son como las trampas que usan nuestros cazadores, pero pueden atraer y atrapar a las bestias cercanas mediante magia.

identity.title: Apex Predator
identity.objectives: Find and slay the Nightborne keeping Su'esh obedient.
identity.description: I have good news and bad news, $r.$b$bThe bad news is that they somehow managed to capture and train a Devilsaur.$b$BThe good news is that it doesn't seem to have a collar and is tame. I imagine it must think that one of the Nightborne in there is its master. Find the pack leader and take him out, and we will set quite a beast upon them.

Completion.text: 我在這裡看得一清二楚。那真是…慘不忍睹。
Completion.english: Lo he visto todo desde aquí. Ha sido... un estropicio.

identity.title: Blast of Spice Fish
identity.objectives: Collect Toad Gizzards for Keelay.
identity.description: I have an ingredient that will make my fruit irresistible.$b$bNot many remember the delicacy of manatrout liquor. Its pungent aroma, the unctuous mouthfeel...$b$bThe toads near the northern river concentrate this additive in their gizzards. Fetch some stomachs for me, and we will have plenty.

Progress.text: 戴格利爾太年輕、太愚蠢！
Progress.english: ¡Daglir es joven e insensato!

Completion.text: 我們港灣裡的法力鱒魚都已經釣捕殆盡。自從護盾升起後，我們現在只能在回憶中品嘗這滋味了。
Completion.english: Ya no queda manatrucha en nuestros puertos. Desde que levantaron el escudo, lo único que tenemos del licor es el recuerdo en el paladar.

identity.title: Fruit of the Doom
identity.objectives: Poison 3 Bowls of Fruit.
identity.description: Now is the time to strike.$b$bShadowbloom has... potent digestive qualities. Go sprinkle some on Daglir's fruit bowls and watch the show.$b$bMeanwhile, I will use the manatrout liquor to cement my position as the premier fruit vendor in the city.

Completion.text: 任何美食，就算是我煮的，也都比不上勝利的滋味。
Completion.english: La victoria sabe mejor que cualquier otro plato, incluso que los míos.

identity.title: All That Glitters
identity.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Arcane Glowlamps.
identity.description: Now that the shield is down, the older settlements outside the city have been on my mind.$b$bDid you know that I helped create the filigree on the arcane lamps that are used throughout the city? A simple task, one of my first...$b$bNo matter. Nostalgia is the enemy of progress. The lamps are made of material better used in my new works.$b$bThose wretched harpies probably have several decorating their nests. Bring back any you find.

Progress.text: 你能想像萊斯賓的真跡埋藏在一堆樹葉中嗎？真是糟蹋。
Progress.english: ¿Te lo puedes creer, un original de Lespin tapado por un montón de hojas? Qué desperdicio.

Completion.text: 太好了。我該把這些熔掉並鑄成錠，供下一批委託用。
Completion.english: Excelente. Haré que las fundan y las conviertan en lingotes para mi siguiente tanda de encargos.

identity.title: Mangelrath
identity.objectives: Defeat Mangelrath.
identity.description: The demonic beast that stands before ye, must be the one that devoured ol' Brambley...$b$bJust look at it, lying there with a full belly! I canna abide it any longer, $n! We must slay the foul creature and avenge Brambley!$b$bWe've come this far already, $c.$b$bAre ye with me?!

Completion.text: 很高興看到友善的臉孔，我不知道靠自己一個人還能撐多久！
Completion.english: Me alegra ver una cara conocida. ¡No sé cuánto más habría aguantado sin compañía!

identity.title: Pry It From Their Cold, Feral Claws
identity.objectives: Retrieve 8 Harpy Necklaces for Lespin.
identity.description: The shield being lowered presents a unique opportunity for new styles.$b$bFeathers, bone and other primitive materials are suddenly fashionable again. Who would have thought they could grow tired of my masterpieces?$b$bVenture out of the city and collect necklaces from the harpies on the southern cliffs. Etching my mark into them should net me a tidy profit.

Progress.text: 你拿到我的項鍊了嗎？戴在那些…生物的脖子上，對我一點好處也沒有。
Progress.english: ¿Tienes mis collares? No me sirven de nada en el cuello de esas... criaturas.

Completion.text:
那些可鄙的生物是我們美麗土地上的詛咒。至少牠們穿戴配件的品味還不錯。

又或許牠們發亮的東西都喜歡吧。
Completion.english: Esas criaturas despreciables son un azote para nuestras hermosas tierras. Al menos tenían buen gusto para los accesorios.$B$BO quizás simplemente les gustan las cosas que brillan.

identity.title: Ascending The Circle
identity.objectives: Accompany Archdruid Greathoof and then speak with Malfurion Stormrage.
identity.description: Now, you are more powerful than ever! Truly, you are a druid without equal, $n.$b$bI sense that Malfurion has arrived. He will certainly want to know of your accomplishments, but first, please walk with me a moment.

Progress.text: 什么事？
Progress.english: What's up?

identity.title: Timing Is Everything
identity.objectives: Ride an Azuregale Paddlefoot and kill 50 Sashj'tar naga using the Sealed Powder Kegs in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: Can you feel it, $n? The waters churn with approaching Sashj'tar.$B$BYou must strike now...$B$BLeave me... Find a way to bombard the naga... with the kegs...$B$BProtect... Jandvik...

Completion.text: 弗喬里克為詹德維克而死，我們不會忘了他的英勇行為。
Completion.english: Fjolrik murió en honor de Jandvik. Recordaremos su valor.

identity.title: Dry Powder
identity.objectives: Collect 5 Sealed Powder Kegs from the shipwrecks in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: $n... I did not expect to see you down here.$B$BThe Sashj'tar are... rallying against Jandvik. I had a plan to... decimate them using these old powder kegs.$B$BThe naga proved more formidable to these old bones than I thought.$B$B<Fjolrik coughs out some blood.>$B$BWe haven't much time... to prepare.

Progress.text: 動作快，$n。
Progress.english: Date prisa, $N.

Completion.text:
<弗喬里克虛弱地看著你。>

你及時趕回來了…
Completion.english: <Fjolrik te mira con aspecto débil.>$B$BHas vuelto a tiempo...

identity.title: Sunken Foes
identity.objectives: Kill 6 Sashj'tar Overseers and 6 Trenchwalker Scavengers in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: The Tidemistress... is filling her ranks with hulking naga... and sea giants.$B$BJandvik cannot withstand... their combined might.$B$BSlaughter them... before they reach its shores...

Completion.text: 沙許塔爾的部隊比我預料的還難對付。
Completion.english: Las fuerzas Sashj'tar son mucho más grandes de lo que imaginaba.

identity.title: Against Their Will
identity.objectives: Remove Writhing Willbreakers from 6 Possessed Vrykul in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: When the naga brought me down here, I saw many of my vrykul mining the sea floor. They had... squids... attached to their faces.$B$BWhatever those things are, they must be controlling my kin and forcing them to work for the naga.$B$BI do not know what will happen if you remove the squids, but I would rather my vrykul die than be slaves to the naga.$B$BSee me in Jandvik when the deed is done.

Completion.text: 我必須為你今天拯救的維酷人表達感激之情。
Completion.english: Debo expresarte mi gratitud por los vrykuls que has salvado hoy.

identity.title: Feline Frantic
identity.objectives: Organize the camp.
identity.description:
Greetings, stranger.

<Mayruna bows to you.>

We arrived from Val'Sharah a short time ago with hopes of settling here. Our journey was not easy and we are weary.

These owlcats have made a mess of our camp, as you can surely see. Would you be so kind as to assist us with cleaning up?

Then perhaps you can help us establish a new moonwell!

Completion.text: 一切就緒。我們已幾乎要安置好了。
Completion.english: Todo está en su sitio. Poco a poco conseguiremos asentarnos.

identity.title: Homeward Bounding
identity.objectives: Chase the Lost Feathermane Kitten across the bridge and return it to its family.
identity.description:
The first step to establishing a moonwell is to gain the blessings of the local wildlife. 

It is their good will that enables us to  peacefully coexist, and a moonwell thrives on such energies. Combined with Elune's light, a moonwell can purify its surroundings for years.

To begin, we must find creatures willing to give their blessing. We can start with these owl-cat creatures.

They ran while you cleaned, but I saw one lingering just before the bridge. 

See if you can find where it lives!

Completion.text: 這真是有趣的轉折。
Completion.english: Bueno, se ha producido un cambio en los acontecimientos muy interesante.

identity.title: Missing Along the Way
identity.objectives: Locate Kalendros Irongrove.
identity.description:
As we retreated from Val'Sharah, our company was briefly separated by a conflict with some satyrs at the border.

One of our own did not make it here- Mythandros' brother, Kalendros. I would like you to try and find him if you could.

Search the woods just before the bridge back into Val'Sharah.

Completion.text: 梅露娜派來的協助真是及時。我幾乎要放棄希望了。
Completion.english: Qué bien que Mayruna haya enviado ayuda. Casi había perdido la esperanza.

identity.title: Not Here, Not Now, Not Ever
identity.objectives: Use Satyr Horns to destroy 3 Darkfiend Totems.
identity.description:
I cannot, will not, accept what is happening here. My body resists me, but I will stop this.

<He looks at you.> You will stop this.

Here is a root of the corrupted World Tree Shaladrassil. It has somehow found its way out of the ground to this untouched place and already the Darkfiend satyrs are hard at work corrupting Suramar.

Stop them. Kill the satyrs, take their horns, drive their points through the totems.

Only then can we have any hope of reversing this.

Completion.text: 我感到欣慰，但還有我們必須做的事。
Completion.english: Me siento aliviado, aunque nos queda mucho por hacer.

identity.title: Estate Jewelry: A Braggart's Brooch
identity.objectives: Retrieve Lespin's Brooch from Naltethis Springblade.
identity.description: Amateur merchants worry about losing face from bad products. Masters worry about losing face from bad customers.$b$bNaltethis Springblade has grown too bold for his station, and as such has lost much standing in the eyes of the city's elite.$b$bI sold this man a brooch, a clasp he wears on his cape. I am careful to only sell to those above my station.$b$bMy pieces never tarnish, but my name and reputation are much more fragile. Relieve him of my property before he lowers me further.

Progress.text: 那個蠢貨會讓多年的辛勞毀於一旦。跌落谷底比爬到高處容易許多…
Progress.english: Ese patán se cargará años de duro trabajo. Es mucho más fácil caer que ascender...

Completion.text:
啊，快看！我就說它不會失去光采。現在沒有線索能從那傻瓜身上追查到我這了…

你說什麼？弱化他地位的計謀？無論如何，傷害已經造成。安全總比遺憾好。
Completion.english: ¡Ah, ¿lo ves?! Te dije que no se deslustran. Ya no hay nada que me vincule a ese necio...$B$B¿Cómo? ¿Una trama para debilitar su posición? En cualquier caso, el daño ya está hecho. Más vale prevenir que curar.

identity.title: Estate Jewelry: Haute Claw-ture
identity.objectives: Find and retrieve Lespin's 'art' from Mornath.
identity.description: An amateur merchant looks back on their previous work as a learning experience. A master knows that some things are better left forgotten.$b$bI was... vain, centuries ago. Desperate to prove myself, I took on a bold commission.$b$bFind him and bring... it... back. You will know what I am talking about when you see it.$b$bHe resides near the villa south of this courtyard.

Progress.text: 他實在太熱情、太奔放。我看到他的幻想，完全按照他的規格製作作品。美麗的鑲鈿和瓷釉共同構成令人生畏的成品…
Progress.english: Era tan apasionado, tan impulsivo... Vi su visión, la creé según sus indicaciones exactas. Una preciosidad de filigrana y esmalte en un arma temible...

Completion.text: 以博學者之名啊，我已經忘記那個東西有多醜了。工藝技術絕對無懈可擊，只是…呃。我應該把那個東西整個熔掉。
Completion.english: Por la Magistrix, había olvidado lo fea que es esa cosa. La artesanía es impecable, por supuesto. Pero... uf. Debería fundirlo todo.

identity.title: The Only Choice We Can Make
identity.objectives: Incinerate the Shaladrassil Root.
identity.description:
Take this torch, $n. 

We cannot reverse the Nightmare corruption once it has taken hold. All we can hope to do is destroy its manifestations.

Incinerate the root. Only then can we rest easy in Suramar.

Completion.text: 真是令人不安的故事！
Completion.english: ¡Qué historia tan perturbadora!

identity.title: Return to Irongrove Retreat
identity.objectives: Seek Mythandros at Irongrove Retreat.
identity.description:
We have three blessings from the creatures we share this land with.

Combined with a blessing from Elune, the moonwell will watch over this land for years to come.

Meet Mythandros at the retreat. I am sure he would like to include you in the ritual.

Completion.text: 歡迎回來。很好，我們隨時可以開始。
Completion.english: Te doy la bienvenida. Veo que estás listo para empezar.

identity.title: Redhoof the Ancient
identity.objectives: Locate Mythandros and Redhoof the Ancient.
identity.description:
While you were busy assisting the Owlcats across the river, Mythandros and Solendra ventured further to the east.

I believe Mythandros may have found the next creature that may offer us its blessing.

There is a secluded glade along the river's bend to the Northeast. There you may find our new ally, an elderly stag named Redhoof.

Completion.text: 這位紳士正在告訴我他事多麼深愛他的森林。讓我們幫助他吧！
Completion.english: Este caballero me estaba explicando lo mucho que ama su bosque. ¡Ayudémoslo!

identity.title: Fertilizing the Future
identity.objectives: Plant 5 Lush Grass Seeds in piles of Rich Soil.
identity.description:
Like most herbivores, our antlered friends will eat anything green enough to chew. 

However I have noticed that they seek these patches of dark grass, given their preference. I believe we can begin to earn their favor if we aid the forest in producing more of this most nutritious of stag food.

I will provide you with the seeds- all you must do is locate suitable growing soil and plant them. Our magic will do the rest.

Completion.text: 牠們看起來吃得更飽了！
Completion.english: ¡Ahora sí que se ven mejor alimentados!

identity.title: Prongs and Fangs
identity.objectives: Slay 8 Suramar Snarlers and Gloomfang.
identity.description:
Now, $n, do not mistake me- I am a druid. I understand that nature has a balance.

Predators must feed, and others will be hunted. I also understand that tampering with such balance has consequences.

That is why I have taken upon myself to walk this land and perform some... ah... calculations.

Slay only a small number of the wolves you find, and one alpha. That should reduce their number enough to allow the Sablehorn to thrive without disrupting the flow of things here.

Completion.text: 最後，牠們都會蓬勃生長，而有了更多的闇角以後，狼群也能在之後幾年吃得更好。
Completion.english: Al final, todos prosperan. Cuantos más Cuernosable haya, mejor comerán los lobos en los años venideros.

identity.title: The Final Blessing
identity.objectives: Speak to Solendra Featherdown.
identity.description:
My friend Solendra Featherdown went to explore the habitat of the native Nightsabers. 

Now that we have the blessings of the Feathermane and the Sablehorn it is time to seek the blessing of the Nightsabers. She is just on the other side of this glade, to the North.

Completion.text: 歡迎，$r。
Completion.english: Bienvenido, $R.

identity.title: Natural Adversaries
identity.objectives: Slay 8 Manascale Basilisks.
identity.description:
I have walked this land in the time since our arrival. Here, basilisks have emerged from the ravines to the east. They encroach upon the home of the Nightsabers.

To earn their blessing, I believe we should clear the way for their return.

Slay the basilisks that have taken more than their fair share of the land, $r.

Completion.text: 做得好，$r。
Completion.english: Bien hecho, $R.

identity.title: Managazer
identity.objectives: Slay Managazer, the Basilisk Lord.
identity.description:
There is one basilisk here who has gorged himself so thoroughly on Nightsaber flesh that he seldom leaves his cave.

We will use this to our advantage.

Seek out the basilisk Managazer and use his death as an example to the others who have strayed from their home.

Completion.text: 真是貪吃的傢伙。
Completion.english: Qué criatura tan voraz.

identity.title: Moonwhisper Rescue
identity.objectives: Free 5 Petrified Nightsabers using Solendra's Gift.
identity.description:
As a druid I understand that predation happens. Creatures that eat meat must acquire meat.

But this...

<Solendra gestures angrily toward a nearby petrified nightsaber.>

This is just sad. Free them, $r. Take my blessing and free them from this needless torment.

Completion.text: 我的心情好多了，$r。
Completion.english: Siento un gran alivio, $N.

identity.title: Eminent Grow-main
identity.objectives: Imbue the inert waters with the ritual bundle, then witness the well's creation.
identity.description:
You have done very well, $r. 

All that is left is to combine their blessings into the ritual bundle and imbue the Moonwell. Once that is done, Mayruna will add a little water from a purified Moonwell and this land will be protected so long as we inhabit it.

This is a momentous occasion, my friend. You bear witness to a sacred rite not often performed in the company of strangers.

I will let you do the honors- simply place the ritual bundle into the sacred waters and we will do the rest.

Completion.text: 你的協助讓這一切得以實現。謝謝你。
Completion.english: Tu ayuda ha hecho que todo esto sea posible. Gracias.

identity.title: Squid Out of Water
identity.objectives: Destroy 5 Willbreaker Incubators in the Sashj'tar Ruins.
identity.description: Toryl told me about those squid creatures that are controlling my brothers.$B$BI have never seen anything like them before around Jandvik. The naga must have brought them from wherever they came.$B$BI do not want any more of my kin to suffer the fate of being controlled by the naga.$B$BFind out where those squids come from and stop them.

Completion.text: 納迦不能再奪走我的親族了！
Completion.english: ¡Los nagas no se apoderarán de ninguno más de los míos!

identity.title: Felsoul Teleporter Online!
identity.objectives: Infuse the Beacon with Ancient Mana.
identity.description: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>

Progress.text: <信標冰冷而黑暗。>
Progress.english: <La baliza está fría y oscura.>

Completion.text: <當你注入上古法力時，信標不斷發光。>
Completion.english: <La baliza brilla cuando la imbuyes de maná antiguo.>

identity.title: Finding Brytag
identity.objectives: Locate Brytag in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: <Kell barely manages to speak.>$B$BThat naga witch... has given many of my kin... to the sea giants.$B$BBrytag was... the last one I saw alive.$B$BFind him quickly.

Completion.text: 我不認識你，但你不是海巨人，這樣就夠了。
Completion.english: No sé quién eres, pero no eres un gigante de mar y con eso me basta.

identity.title: Taking a Promenade
identity.objectives: Locate the scouts in the Promenade.
identity.description: We must learn much about our long-lost kin if we are to fight them.$b$bWe dispatched one of our scouts to infiltrate the Promenade and gather intelligence. The Sentinels sent their own scout as well, hopefully she is smart enough to not get herself killed before reporting in.$b$bThey have not returned in some time, and we must suspect the worst.$b$bFind them and we shall see what we are up against.

Completion.text: 很高興知道他們還活著。他們的情報會在接下來的行動中派上很大的用場。
Completion.english: ¿Están vivos? Una gran noticia. Su conocimiento de las defensas puede ser valiosísimo.

identity.title: The Seawarden
identity.objectives: Kill Seawarden Largush in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: The Seawarden made a deal with the Tidemistress. She handed us over to him like cattle.$B$BI despise that sea giant! If I were not trapped in this bubble, I would choke the life out of him with my own two hands.$B$BIf you cross his path before I get out of here, make him regret ever making a deal with the naga!

Completion.text:
我只希望我有機會早一步對付他。

啊！他的屍體在這片水域裡腐爛了我也不在乎。
Completion.english: Ojalá hubiera tenido la oportunidad de pillarlo yo antes.$B$B¡Bah! Por mí ya puede pudrirse su cadáver en estas aguas.

identity.title: Snail Fight!
identity.objectives: Defeat Grixis Tinypop in a pet battle.

Objectives.text: 在宠物战斗中击败格里克斯·微泡。
Objectives.english: Defeat Grixis Tinypop in a pet battle.

identity.title: Written in Stone
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Spellstone of Kel'danath.
identity.description:
<You bundle the notes and store them away in your pack.

According to his final journal entry, Kel'danath used something called a "spellstone" in his experiments.

The spellstone, if not the arcanist himself, must be nearby.>

Progress.text: <這個凋萎者似乎被法術石催眠，徹底平靜下來。>
Progress.english: <Este Marchito parece embelesado por la piedra de hechizo. Está completamente apaciguado.>

Completion.text: <他的袖子上有個小掛牌，上面寫著「16‧瑟倫」。>
Completion.english: <De la manga le cuelga una pequeña etiqueta que pone: "16 - Theryn".>

identity.title: Subject 16
identity.objectives: Deliver Theryn to Thalyssra.
identity.description: <It seems Theryn is still under the arcanist's spell. In the absence of Kel'danath himself, a live subject could be useful in helping Thalyssra unravel his research.>

Completion.text:
克達納茲最後還是變成了怪物…

他的命運實在不該如此。感謝你結束他的生命。
Completion.english: Así que Kel'danath acabó convirtiéndose...$B$BMerecía algo mejor. Gracias por darle paz.

identity.title: Breaking Down the Big Guns
identity.objectives: Collect 50 Harpoon Parts from Sashj'tar Harpooners in Azuregale Bay.
identity.description: You did well against that sea witch, but not well enough.$B$BHer power far surpasses any creature that I have ever fought. To defeat her, we will need something formidable. Something that she will not expect...$B$B<Toryl grins wryly.>$B$BSomething of their own design... $B$BSalvage as many parts from their harpoon launchers as you can carry and meet me back in Jandvik.

Progress.text: 海潮祭司是危險的敵人。要擊敗她，我們得變得跟她一樣狡猾。
Progress.english: La maestra de mareas es una peligrosa enemiga. Debemos ser tan astutos como ella para derrotarla.

Completion.text: 你已拿到所有你需要的零件了…有些部位甚至還雙倍有餘。
Completion.english: Tienes todas las piezas que puedas necesitar... Y algunas repetidas.

identity.title: An Unlikely Ally
identity.objectives: Speak to Kira Iresoul in Azsuna.
identity.description:
Channeling the demonic gateway will require the assistance of someone with intimate knowledge of the Burning Legion.

I know of such a warlock, though I imagine her blood still boils upon hearing my name. It might be best if you are the one to request her help.

Completion.text:
瑞特辛派你來的，是吧？看來我昔日的導師還是不肯親自動手做骯髒事。

但當然，像他這樣地位的人，怎麼能讓人看到與疑似阿古斯覺醒者的成員在一起呢！其他人會怎麼想？

雖然我很高興瑞特辛需要我的協助，但我不是在做慈善事業，$n。

想要我幫忙，就要用力量與知識來交換。如果你有其中之一，那麼我們或許就能好好安排。
Completion.english: Te envía Ritssyn, ¿no? Veo que mi antiguo mentor sigue negándose a hacer él mismo su trabajo sucio.$B$BPero, claro, alguien de su posición no puede dejarse ver confraternizando con un supuesto miembro del Despertar de Argus. ¿Qué pensarían los demás?$B$BPor más que disfrute con la idea de que Ritssyn necesita mi ayuda, no me muevo por favores y amabilidad, $N.$B$BPoder y conocimiento son mis intereses. Si tienes alguna de esas cosas, entonces tal vez lleguemos a un acuerdo.

identity.title: Kel'danath's Legacy
identity.objectives: Use the Spellstone of Kel'danath to charm 5 withered and send them to Shal'Aran.
identity.description:
Kel'danath discovered something incredible - the power to subdue and even control the withered.

I will pick up where my old friend left off. We shall see to it that he did not die in vain. 

Perhaps in the end we can even find peace for the wretches who have been left to a fate worse than death.

I will need more subjects. Take Kel'danath's spellstone and use it to subdue more withered.

Progress.text: 我们需要更多的实验体才能继续凯尔丹纳斯的研究。
Progress.english: We need more subjects to continue Kyle Danners' research.

Completion.text:
真迷人。

真希望這法術不會消散。
Completion.english: Fascinante.$B$BEsperemos que el hechizo aguante.

identity.title: Winter Moose Roundup
identity.objectives: Rescue 4 Talbuk at Kuuros Farm.
identity.description: My father, Karmaan, owns this farm, and our main livestock are talbuk. One of the podlings must have opened the gate to their pen and they all escaped!$B$BThe little terrors could have slaughtered them in the cage, but they like to hunt their prey. I'm afraid that if I stay out here much longer, I'll be their next meal!$B$BWill you round up the talbuk and bring them here? I can't get them myself, and I can't let my dad find out about this!

Objectives.text: 在库若斯农场拯救4头塔布羊。
Objectives.english: Rescue 4 Talbuk at Kuuros Farm.

Description.text: 我的父亲卡尔曼是这座农场的主人，塔布羊是我们饲养的主要家畜。肯定是某个魔荚人打开了它们的围栏门，让它们全都逃走了！$B$B那些小怪物本来可以在围栏里大开杀戒，但是他们喜欢追捕猎物的刺激。如果我再待下去，恐怕就会成为他们的下一顿大餐！$B$B你可以把塔布羊聚集起来，并把它们带来这里吗？我自己无能为力，而且我也不能让父亲知道这件事！
Description.english: My father, Karmaan, owns this farm, and our main livestock are talbuk. One of the podlings must have opened the gate to their pen and they all escaped!$B$BThe little terrors could have slaughtered them in the cage, but they like to hunt their prey. I'm afraid that if I stay out here much longer, I'll be their next meal!$B$BWill you round up the talbuk and bring them here? I can't get them myself, and I can't let my dad find out about this!

identity.title: Sympathizers Among the Shal'dorei
identity.objectives: Speak with Silgryn in the Suramar Outskirts.
identity.description: Elisande's decision to welcome the Legion into Suramar earned her plenty of enemies, though only some of us were bold enough to openly defy her.$B$BWe have allies in the city - we just don't know how many.$B$BI need you to make contact with a spell-fencer by the name of Silgryn. He is loyal to our cause, and has been lying in wait since our failed coup.$B$BHe patrols the western edge of the city. Address him by name and tell him our cause is not lost!

Completion.text: 我們應該可以在這安全地談一會話。
Completion.english: Aquí deberíamos poder hablar un momento.

identity.title: A Daring Rescue
identity.objectives: Enter the demon world and rescue the missing council members.
identity.description:
The plan is a simple one, but it will require great effort on your part.

Kira and I will summon the demonic gateway, but you will have to enter alone and recover the missing council members.

Completion.text:
馨菲不能毀在梅菲斯托手裡。如果驚懼領主可以利用她的力量和知識，就能對懼痕裂隙發動毀滅性的攻擊。

使用召喚儀式可以把馨菲召喚到我們身邊，但我們需要先建立一個強大的定位點…
Completion.english: Shinfel no puede caer en manos de Mephistroth. Si se hace con su poder y sus conocimientos, el Señor del Terror podría lanzar un devastador ataque contra la Falla Cicatriz del Terror.$B$BDeberíamos ser capaces de invocar a Shinfel para nuestra causa mediante un ritual de invocación, pero tendremos que crear un ancla potente.

identity.title: Soul Beacon
identity.objectives: Perform a ritual of summoning to retrieve the missing council member.
identity.description:
I have bound Shinfel's soul to her staff, allowing it to serve as an anchor in this world.

When we perform the ritual of summoning, it will act as a beacon, guiding Shinfel through the Twisting Nether and back to our world.

Completion.text:
我們雖然找回馨菲了，但她的心智還掌握在俘虜她的惡魔手中。

他們到底在她身上下了什麼古代魔咒？我從來沒看過這種事情。
Completion.english: Puede que tengamos a Shinfel con nosotros, pero su mente sigue en manos de sus captores demoníacos.$B$B¿Con qué tipo de magia ancestral la han maldecido? Nunca he visto nada igual.

identity.title: The Masks We Wear
identity.objectives: Speak with $3oa Masqued Revelers while in costume, then speak with Ly'leth Lunastre.
identity.description:
Many nightborne had pinned their hopes on Thalyssra deposing the Grand Magistrix. Since she disappeared, dissenting voices have grown silent.

We must spread the word, discreetly, among the populace. Ly'leth Lunastre will be a perfect ally in this. She is a socialite with many connections, and she is no friend of the Legion.

Ly'leth hosts a masquerade party at her estate where rumors are traded like coin - and brandished like daggers.

Let us invite ourselves in.

Progress.text: 很高興與你認識。
Progress.english: Es un placer conocerte.

Completion.text:
這面具很適合你。

在蘇拉瑪爾，能扮演他人一段時間是件深具益處的的事…。
Completion.english: Esa máscara te conviene.$B$BEn Suramar puede ser muy ventajoso ser otra persona durante un tiempo...

identity.title: Lady Lunastre
identity.objectives: Seek out Ly'leth at the Grand Promenade.
identity.description:
Our friend Ly'leth contacted me. She requested that you meet her atop the Grand Promenade as it overlooks the city.

Have your disguise ready just in case, $n.

Completion.text: 希望你是做好了準備才進入這座城市。時候到了。
Completion.english: Espero que te hayas preparado para entrar en la ciudad. Es la hora.

identity.title: The Gondolier
identity.objectives: Make contact with the Gondolier.
identity.description:
I need your help.

The wine you so graciously distributed to the needy was the last of my reserves. Without more, these people here will risk succumbing to their thirst, and eventually becoming withered.

I am dedicated to preventing this for as long as possible.

There is a woman by the name of Deline who owns and operates a small delivery service out of her gondola.

Find her, identify yourself as my messenger, and offer your aid in acquiring the next shipment.

Completion.text: 我們開始吧，怎麼樣？
Completion.english: Empecemos, ¿de acuerdo?

identity.title: Den of Shadows
identity.objectives: Make contact with Arluin Shadowblade.
identity.description: Placeholder: Thalyssra sends you to find Arluin Shadowblade, a deft assassin once in her employ/social circle. (whichever fits) Indicate that he would be an invaluable asset to making progress in the City with covert operations.

Objectives.text: 接触阿鲁因·影刃。
Objectives.english: Make contact with Arluin Shadowblade.

Description.text: 占位符
Description.english: Placeholder: Thalyssra sends you to find Arluin Shadowblade, a deft assassin once in her employ/social circle. (whichever fits) Indicate that he would be an invaluable asset to making progress in the City with covert operations.

identity.title: The Master's Legacy
