identity.objectives: Investigate the Gemcutter's Tomb.
identity.description: You work for a murderer and a thief.$b$bThat design he wants? It is called the magistrix cut, and it was perfected by my husband. He was killed by Lespin for his secret.$b$bI had him entombed in a small cave north of the city, for we could not make the trip to Tel'anor. Buried with him is a tome that contains the secrets of the design.$b$bRetrieve the design and keep it out of his hands!

Progress.text: 師傅呢？
Progress.english: ¿Dónde está el maestro?

Completion.text:
太好了，那個老糊塗總算得到報應了。

看來漫步宏園現在需要一名新的珠寶匠，而我覺得我已經學會前任師傅的所有知識了。

這是體恤你的辛勞的一點小心意。
Completion.english: Vaya, vaya, por lo visto ese viejo idiota encontró al fin la horma de su zapato.$B$BParece que el Paseo necesita otro joyero y creo que he aprendido todo lo que podía de mi antiguo maestro.$B$BAquí tienes algo por tus esfuerzos.

identity.title: A Better Future
identity.objectives: Rescue $1oa Shal'dorei Insurgents in the Grand Promenade.
identity.description: We must move quickly, $n. I must save as many of my people as I can before the attack begins.$b$bWord has gotten out in the city that there is a safe haven with us and some no longer fear exile.$b$bVenture into the Grand Promenade, champion. Find those willing to join us and let them know it is time they made their escape.

Completion.text: 我們多了一份力量，敵人少了一個助力。這場仗我們一定會贏，$n！
Completion.english: Nuestra fuerza crece y la de nuestros enemigos merma. ¡Ganaremos esta pelea, $N!

identity.title: The Shadows Reveal
identity.objectives: Speak to your contacts in Dalaran to acquire intel on Akaari Shadowgore's whereabouts.
identity.description: The Fangs of the Devourer are wielded by Akaari Shadowgore, one of Kil'Jaeden's personal assassins. Every attempt on her life ends the same... she's gone before we even arrive.$B$B<Valeera scrawls a few lines on a piece of paper, then hands it to you.>$B$BBut not this time. We've been working with these contacts to find Akaari so we can finally take the Fangs for our own purposes.$B$BGo to each contact and tell them "The shadows reveal." See what they know.

Progress.text: 嗯？
Progress.english: Ok?

identity.title: A Matter of Finesse
identity.objectives: Borrow a Rune of Portals from Archmage Celindra.
identity.description: A rune of portals?! Who does Val'zuun think he is?$B$B<Valeera takes a deep breath.>$B$BIt's worth the price, but those runes aren't exactly easy to come by. Unless...$B$BArchmage Celindra, the Kirin Tor's portal master, has a study in the center of town. We rogues aren't particularly welcome there, nor would she simply hand a rune over even if we were...$B$B<Valeera smirks.>$B$BBut who said anything about asking?

Progress.text: 据说吞噬者之牙举世无双。如果这是真的，付出任何代价都值得。
Progress.english: They say the Fangs of the Devourer have no equal; if that's true, they're worth any price.

identity.title: Closing In
identity.objectives: Confront Akaari Shadowgore in the Legerdemain Lounge.
identity.description: The Legerdemain Lounge isn't far from here. We have agents nearby who can secure the area.$B$BCome prepared for a fight. Akaari won't go down easily.

Progress.text: 真是难以置信……
Progress.english: I can't believe it...

identity.title: Fangs of the Devourer
identity.objectives: Obtain the Fangs of the Devourer from Akaari Shadowgore.
identity.description: If you spare me I can use the rune of portals you provided to open a gateway to Akaari's citadel in the Twisting Nether.$B$BOf course, killing the Legion's master assassin in her own domain will be no simple feat, but surely the Fangs of the Devourer are worth the risk, no?$B$B<Val'zuun smiles.>$B$BI will guide you through the citadel once you arrive, but you will have to defeat Akaari on your own.

Progress.text: 怎么样？
Progress.english: How about it?

identity.title: Blood of My Blood
identity.objectives: Defeat Anarys Lunastre and deliver $Ghim:her; to Ly'leth Lunastre.
identity.description: As my darling $Gbrother:sister; has demonstrated, Elisande's decision to bring down the shield has sown unrest among the nightborne.$B$BLoyalists and demons march together in the streets. Fear and distrust grip our hearts. Family turns against family.$B$BI will help Thalyssra stir a new rebellion, but first we must deal with Anarys.$B$BI do not wish to spill the blood of my blood - only to help $Ghim:her; see reason.$B$BAnarys is likely brooding over our father's memorial. Bring $Ghim:her; to me alive.

Completion.text: 謝謝你，現在我們就能開始我們的工作了。
Completion.english: Gracias. Ahora podemos empezar nuestro trabajo.

identity.title: Seeker of Truth
identity.objectives: Speak with Orik Trueheart in Dalaran.
identity.description: You may be familiar with Orik Trueheart. He has devoted his time after the Northrend campaign to learning more about Tyr. $b$bOrik has evidence of a powerful shield crafted by Tyr long ago. With the help of the Sunwalkers, we may finally be able to seek it out.$b$bPlease speak to him immediately.

Progress.text: 很高兴你也能来。我们的旅程可不轻松。
Progress.english: Glad you can come too. Our journey was not easy.

identity.title: Masquerade
identity.objectives: Use the Mask of Mirror Image on Anarys Lunastre.
identity.description: Our family commands great respect in this city, thanks to my father. Through my network of contacts, we can organize the citizens to prepare Suramar for Thalyssra's return.$B$BYou must walk among the nightborne. You must earn the trust of our friends and foes alike.$B$BYou must become someone else.$B$B<Ly'leth hands you a shimmering party mask.>$B$BPut this on Anarys.

Completion.text: 我的小妹將宛若重生，不管她自己喜不喜歡。
Completion.english: Mi hermano pequeño está a punto de hacer borrón y cuenta nueva, le guste o no.

identity.title: Searching the Archives
identity.objectives: Interact with the Dreadscar Battle Plans and complete the mission "Searching the Archives".
identity.description:
The Black Harvest archives contain an immeasurable amount of magical knowledge that has been collected from various sources over time. 

It's reasonable to think that somewhere among the countless scrolls that we'll find something to aid us in our mission to rescue the remaining council members. 

The search may be exhausting, but it is necessary if we plan to rebuild and face the Burning Legion.

Completion.text:
搜尋文獻之後，我們發現一部典籍，裡面詳細說明如何建立惡魔傳送門。只要我們知道位置，就能透過傳送門，出入任何惡魔世界。

我們可以利用這種傳送門，找到並帶回剩下的議會成員。
Completion.english: Durante nuestra búsqueda en los Archivos hemos dado con un libro que detalla el proceso de creación de un portal demoníaco. Con él podremos acceder a cualquier mundo demoníaco, siempre que sepamos cómo dirigirlo.$B$BNos vendría bien para localizar y recuperar a los restantes miembros del consejo.

identity.title: Black Rook Hold: An Unclaimed Soul
identity.objectives: Collect an Unclaimed Soul from The Amalgam of Souls in the Black Rook Hold dungeon.
identity.description:
In order to create the anchor, we'll need to link something of Shinfel's to an unclaimed soul.

The soul will act like a beacon, guiding Shinfel through the Twisting Nether, and back to Dreadscar Rift.

Shinfel's staff should provide us with the link we need, but the soul will be a bit harder to find. 

Dwelling within Black Rook hold is an amalgam of souls, some lost and forgotten. Killing this monstrosity should provide us with the soul we need.

Progress.text: 你找到靈魂了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Has recuperado el alma ya?

Completion.text:
你從不讓人失望，$n。

這個早已遭到遺忘的靈魂，現在可以更有貢獻。
Completion.english: Nunca me decepcionas, $N.$B$BEsta alma que habría quedado olvidada cumplirá ahora una misión importante.

identity.title: Empowering the Soul
identity.objectives: Collect Empowered Soul Shards by completing class hall missions.
identity.description:
Creating the anchor will require more power than our soul shards will be able to provide.

Dreadscar's troops are capable of amassing a large amount of soul shards when they defeat enemies while on missions. Once we have enough, I can harvest the supply and use them to craft the anchor.

Progress.text: 有了足夠的靈魂裂片，我們就應該有能力建立定位器了。
Progress.english: Con los fragmentos de alma suficientes, deberíamos tener la potencia para crear el anclaje.

Completion.text: 你的部隊做得很好。我們擁有的靈魂裂片已經足以強化定位器。
Completion.english: Tus tropas han hecho un buen trabajo. Nuestro suministro de fragmentos de alma basta para crear el anclaje.

identity.title: Dark Whispers
identity.objectives: Use Calydus's portal to enter into Felsoul Hold and recover the Skull of the Man'ari.
identity.description: Felsoul Hold is not far away, but it is well defended. Very tough to get in the normal way, but Calydus can help you sneak in!$b$bThere is a portal that my kind use to haul in treasures, with it you can get in and find the skull!

Completion.text:
朋友拿到顱骨了嗎？

啊，卡萊德斯感受到了！別讓它盯著卡萊德斯，朋友。我很樂意協助你，完全沒有不甘願。
Completion.english: ¿Amigo ha podido conseguir el cráneo?$B$B¡Sí, Calydus lo nota! Aparta su mirada de Calydus, amigo. Trabajo gustosamente para ti, sin coacciones.

identity.title: Ritual Reagents
identity.objectives: Search within Dalaran for Grave Dust, a Can of Overheated Oil, an Aged Snowplum Brandy, and a Stag Blood Sample.
identity.description: The Skull of the Man'ari, oh good choice! It's very powerful and it's held by an even more powerful Dreadlord!$b$bThere is a weakness, the skull has a will of its own! If we can commune with the skull we might be able to convince it to serve you instead!$b$bWe will need reagents from the floating city before we can perform the ritual to commune with it. Dust from a fresh grave, dark oil, and a powerful alcohol catalyst.$b$bOh, and blood! I sense a beast whose blood should be perfect.

Progress.text: 你拿到所有東西了嗎，朋友？
Progress.english: ¿Lo has conseguido todo, amigo?

Completion.text: 非常好！現在，我們可以開始了。
Completion.english: ¡Muy bien! Bueno, ya podemos comenzar.

identity.title: First Contact
identity.objectives: Speak with Vanthir in The Grand Promenade.
identity.description: Time to put your new disguise to the test.$B$BYour first contact is Vanthir, a merchant from the common district. He is in the Grand Promenade today visiting one of his suppliers.$B$BTell Vanthir to pay me a visit regarding a shipment of dusk lily bulbs. He will understand.$B$BBeyond that, we will need time to prepare. You should return to Thalyssra.$B$B<Ly'leth hands you a corked bottle of faintly glowing fluid.>$B$BGive her this, with my regards. We will call upon you soon.

Progress.text: 你有與支持我們的人聯絡上了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Has conseguido contactar con nuestros simpatizantes?

Completion.text: 路納斯特家族交遊廣闊，當時機來臨時，他們會是一大助益。
Completion.english: La familia Lunastre tiene buenas conexiones. Nos serán de gran ayuda cuando llegue el momento.

identity.title: Looking into the Darkness
identity.objectives: Perform the ritual to commune with the Skull of the Man'ari and convince it to tell you its location.
identity.description:
Friend now is ready to perform the ritual!

Remember, friend, the skull must be convinced that it is in its best interest to be in your possession. If we must force the skull into your servitude, it would be far weaker.

Progress.text: 召唤法阵已经就绪，朋友。
Progress.english: The ritual circle is ready, friend.

Completion.text:
沒錯，魔魂堡！卡萊德斯知道在哪裡！

卡萊德斯可以建立一條路徑，連到那裡的傳送門！
Completion.english: ¡Sí, el Bastión Alma Vil! ¡Calydus sabe dónde está!$B$B¡Calydus puede crear un camino que enlace con uno de los portales que hay allí!

identity.title: Scouting the Crimson Thicket
identity.objectives: Find Lilryia Dawnwind in Dawncleft.
identity.description: If you are heading east, there is something I would ask of you.$b$bWhile we struck camp some of our caravan left to scout around the city. Lilryia Dawnwind has been gone too long.$b$bI would be most grateful if you would go check on her safety. She said she was going to scout out the ruins of Dawncleft.

Completion.text: 你來得正好，$r。
Completion.english: No pudiste llegar en mejor momento, $R.

identity.title: Cloaked in Moonshade
identity.objectives: Explore Moonshade Sanctum.
identity.description:
I do not know what Theryn found, but I know where he found it. 

Moonshade Sanctum, to the west. Beyond the Temple of Fal'adora. 

Whatever power altered Theryn's arcane essence... Whatever power allowed Kel'danath to create a spell to soothe the withered... Its source rests there. 

I know this as surely as if I had been there myself.

Completion.text: <你從薩莉瑟拉的夢境中認出聖物。>
Completion.english: <Reconoces la reliquia de la visión de Thalyssra.>

identity.title: Breaking the Seal
identity.objectives: Break the Seal of the Tides, Seal of the Earth and Seal of the Sky.
identity.description:
<As you behold the relic, Thalyssra's voice echoes in your mind.>

You found it! But it is sealed away tight.

Search the room for a way to break those seals.

Completion.text: <隨著魔法屏障逐漸消失，你聽見外頭傳來樹葉沙沙的聲響，以及昆蟲喀喀的聲音。>
Completion.english: <Cuando la barrera mágica empieza a desvanecerse, oyes un frufrú de hojas y un chasqueo de mandíbulas en el exterior.>

identity.title: Moonshade Holdout
identity.objectives: Slay a Fal'dorei Webslinger, a Fal'dorei Broodcaller, and a Fal'dorei Widowmaker.
identity.description: <Tampering with the relic has drawn the attention of some hideous creatures from beneath Falanaar.>

Completion.text: 你知道你做了什麼嗎？
Completion.english: ¡¿Tienes idea de lo que has hecho?!

identity.title: Into the Crevasse
identity.objectives: Follow Valewalker Farodin into the Falanaar Tunnels.
identity.description: I have protected that seed for ten thousand years. You let it fall into the hands of the fal'dorei.$B$BI should have let you die.$B$BRepay your debt. Help me get the seed back.

Completion.text: 我們必須動作快點。
Completion.english: Debemos darnos prisa.

identity.title: The Hidden City
identity.objectives: Follow Orathiss through Falanaar Tunnels and slay her.
identity.description: Orathiss has underestimated the seed. It is sapping her power - slowing her down.$B$BWe must catch her and get the seed to safety!

Completion.text: <遠古種子散發能量脈動。>
Completion.english: <La semilla antigua está envuelta en una energía palpitante.>

identity.title: Shal'Aran
identity.objectives: Follow Thalyssra while she explores Shal'Aran.
identity.description:
The chamber beyond may be the perfect hiding place, now that its guardian has been dealt with.

Come with me.

Completion.text: 像這樣暫時的家就非常理想。
Completion.english: Este hogar temporal nos servirá.

identity.title: The Valewalker's Burden
identity.objectives: Activate the Fal'adora Beacon in Temple of Fal'adora.
identity.description:
The seed is awakening. Without power it will quickly wither and die.

We must carry the seed out of here and plant it somewhere safe.

I am not strong enough to bear this burden. But you... you are brimming with power. I can sense it. 

Please take the seed.

Completion.text: <種子穩穩地落在高台上，卡嗒一聲沉了下去。>
Completion.english: <La semilla queda a la perfección sobre el soporte y encaja con un chasquido de lo más satisfactorio.>

identity.title: Do The Thing!
identity.description: Mrglrg! Mrlglr mrgllrg.$b$b<Phin gesticulates wildly>$b$bMrlgrlg glrglmglr mrlglrg. Rglrgmrg mrglr glr. Glr! Gmrlgrmlg mrglmrgm...$b$b<Phin looks at you expectantly.>

Completion.text:
<菲恩抓住你的肩膀，高興地跳來跳去。>

莫嚕咕！咕嚕莫嘎咕。
Completion.english: <Phin te toma de los hombros y salta con felicidad.>$B$B¡Mlrglr! Grlrlrglrmg.

identity.title: Aiding Our Allies
identity.objectives: Deliver supplies to Meliah Grayfeather.
identity.description:
Our Skyhorn allies could use some assistance. 

Their ongoing war with the invading harpies has left them low on supplies. 

Anything we can give them will surely help with their efforts to rid those witches from their village.

Progress.text: 我们的天角盟友需要补给，帮助他们与鹰身人作战。
Progress.english: Our Skyhorn allies need supplies to help them fight the Harpy.

identity.title: Little One Lost
identity.objectives: Escort Korine back to her mother Verene at the Waning Crescent.
identity.description:
I'm ready to go home now, but there are still scary men outside...

Will you stay with me? Make sure they don't take me away?

I don't want to go back in the cage...

Completion.text: 喔，我親愛的小可琳！感謝你，感謝你！
Completion.english: ¡Ay, mi pequeña y dulce Korine! ¡Gracias, gracias!

identity.title: Friends On the Outside
identity.objectives: Activate the teleporter pad and bring Vanthir's gift to Thalyssra.
identity.description:
You have done well for us here, but it is time for you to return to Thalyssra.

There is a teleporter pad nearby that has gone unused in recent years. See if you can reroute it and return to her that way.

Oh, and before you go:

<Vanthir hands you a wrapped bottle of Arcwine.>

Take this to her, with my thanks for sending you. Let her know that your efforts helped replenish our Arcwine supplies and reunited a mother and child.

We are grateful beyond measure. Farewell for now.

Completion.text: 凡席爾是個非常風趣的人。
Completion.english: Vanthir es un tipo muy majo.

identity.title: Thalyssra's Abode
identity.objectives: Search Thalyssra's estate and collect 3 Amplifier Fragments. Combine them into an Arcane Amplifier.
identity.description:
While you were busy in the city I reached a roadblock in my withered research. 

I feel I am close to overcoming this barrier, but I'm afraid I cannot do so without some more advanced tools.

I hid among my possessions an item called an Arcane Amplifier. It does precisely what its name entails.

It is more than likely that the Magistrix ordered my estate dismantled. If the Amplifier remains, it will be in fragments.

Recover the whole, if you can.

Progress.text: 你找到了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Ha habido suerte?

Completion.text: 我們非常幸運，居然可以取回它…謝謝你。
Completion.english: Qué suerte haberlo recuperado... Gracias.

identity.title: Thalyssra's Drawers
identity.objectives: Search Thalyssra's estate and collect her belongings.
identity.description: Thalyssra's ransacked estate still contains a number of items important to Thalyssra. Collect them and return them to her.

Progress.text: 你找到什麼？
Progress.english: ¿Qué has encontrado?

Completion.text: 這真是讓我放了一百二十個心。
Completion.english: Es un consuelo indescriptible.

identity.title: The Arcway: Opening the Arcway
identity.objectives: Slay Advisor Vandros in the Arcway.
identity.description:
Deep beneath Suramar is a defunct set of tunnels known as the Arcway. They were abandoned when a disaster disrupted the mana collectors operating there. 

I know not what awaits you down there, but I do know one thing.

We are not the only ones interested in this place. Make enough noise and one of the advisors with whom I served under Elisande is sure to appear.

His name is Vandros. Slay him, if you can.

His death will be our victory, as we deprive Elisande of one more weapon in her arsenal.

Completion.text: 謝謝你。我終於了結一件事了。
Completion.english: Gracias. Una cosa menos de la que preocuparme.

identity.title: The Arcway: Long Buried Knowledge
identity.objectives: Acquire the Suramar Leyline Map from the Arcway.
identity.description:
Beneath Suramar City is an ancient network of tunnels known as the Arcway.

They were abandoned some time ago as part of the cavern became unstable. Since then, who knows?

Regardless of what is currently down there, I believe you will find something essential to our continued success.

Long ago my people took a thorough survey of the ley lines in and around Suramar. This they would have stored in the library in the Arcway. 

Find this map for me.

Progress.text: 你找到了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Ha habido suerte?

Completion.text: 太棒了！我會立刻研讀地圖。
Completion.english: ¡Excelente! Lo estudiaré inmediatamente.

identity.title: PH: Withered Scenario
identity.objectives: PH
identity.description: PH

Objectives.text: 占位符
Objectives.english: PH

Description.text: 占位符
Description.english: PH

identity.title: Finishing the Job
identity.objectives: Assassinate Cade Shadowgaze at the Altar of Storms in Blasted Lands and search his body for information.
identity.description: Garona set out to assassinate the leaders of a Legion cult some time ago. We haven't heard from her since.$B$BTo make matters worse, she took the Kingslayers with her. She knows they bring out the worst in her!$B$BYour best bet to find Garona is by continuing her work. Our intel points to a warlock by the name of Caden Shadowgaze inducting new recruits at the Altar of Storms in Blasted Lands. See if he has anything useful in his pockets.$b$bOnce he's dead, I mean.

Progress.text: <想要找到邪教徒，任何线索都很重要。>
Progress.english: <Any information could be invaluable in tracking down the cultists.>

identity.title: No Sanctuary
identity.objectives: Assassinate Felcaller Whitley at Raven Hill in Duskwood and search his body for information.
identity.description: We have one other lead that may prove useful. Goes by Felcaller Whitley, another of the cult's elite. He's eluded our agents at every turn.$B$BOur latest reconnaissance report puts him somewhere in the village of Raven Hill in Duskwood. He's sure to have information vital to your search.$B$BYou know what to do.

Progress.text: <你的线人所言不假，维特雷是邪教的精英，他身上肯定有线索。>
Progress.english: <If Whitley is as prominent in the cult as your sources say, he's bound to have something useful on him.>

identity.title: Cloak and Dagger
identity.objectives: Retrieve the Skull of the Innocent, the Blood of the Innocent, and make an attempt on Althea Ebonlocke's life in Darkshire.
identity.description: <The cultists seem to have a base of operations in Darkshire. At least Althea Ebonlocke is a member, but it is likely that the entire Night Watch has been compromised.>$B$B<The best course of action for now is to retrieve the dark implements for their ritual and make an attempt on Althea's life. Garona will have to wait.>

Progress.text: <你拿走了他们的仪式用品，从而阻止了隐蔽之手的活动，为我们争取了宝贵的时间。>
Progress.english: <By denying the Hand the reagents for their ritual you've managed to buy precious time.>

identity.title: Mrgls of Endearment
identity.description: Mrmlgr! Mrglr rlmgrg mlrgr! Mrlgmr...$b$b<Phin shows you a flaw on the side of the pearl.>$b$bMmlrgmlr rlmgr grlmrmlg mglrmglr. Mlrgmrl rmglr? Mlgrmglr!$b$bGmmlrgmrl mlrgmlr lrglrmgrl lrlgllrlm mglrlr grlm-grlm.$b$b<Phin makes a pinching motion with his hand.>$b$bMrlgmlgr mgrlmlgr? Mlrgmlr gmrlmglr Mrgrlilgrl.

Completion.text: 莫咕莫咕！啊咕莫咕。咕莫莫咕啊莫咕啊咕莫咕莫咕啊！莫咕啊莫咕啊咕。
Completion.english: ¡Mlrgmlr! ¡Rgmrlmg, grmlmglr lmrglmrg mrlgmlglr! Mlrgmlrg grmlgrl.

identity.title: Friends in Cages
identity.objectives: Release 3 Nightborne Citizens from their captivity.
identity.description:
<Korine stomps her foot and refuses to move.>

They put my friends in cages!

Make the bad men stop hurting them! They take them out the garden and they never come back!

<Korine gestures stubbornly toward the door.>

I am not going home until they do!

Progress.text: 你放他们出来了吗？
Progress.english: Did you let them out?

Completion.text: 你讓他們離開了？我好高興。我也不喜歡被關在籠裡…
Completion.english: ¿Los has soltado? Me alegro. A mí tampoco me gustaba estar en una jaula...

identity.title: A Mlrglrmg For Grlmrgl
identity.description: Mrglm, rmgrlg mrlgmrl.$b$bGrmrglmrl mlrmglrgr mlrmlgr! Rglrmgl rmglrgmlr mlmlglr mglgrgrlm - grlgmr, mlgr - lrgmlrgr rmgrmlg mlrg! Mlrgr?$b$bMrlgmrlgmrl rmglrmglr!$b$b<Pearlhunter Phin makes a stabbing motion.>

Completion.text: 莫莫咕莫…莫哩咕莫咕。莫哩咕哩咕咕莫哩！
Completion.english: Mrrgml... mlrgmlrg. ¡Mlrmglrg gmrlr!

identity.title: Working With the Wardens
identity.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the "Working With the Wardens" missions.
identity.description:
As much as we might not like it, we need the aid of the Wardens if we're to locate the Sargerite Keystone. They took it from you when we were all imprisoned in the vault.

With Maiev missing, their current leader is Sira Moonwarden. On your behalf, I have agreed that we will assist them in tracking down some of the more powerful creatures that escaped from the Vault of the Wardens. In return, she will direct us to where we need to go to get the Keystone.

Progress.text: 赛拉对我们的进展还满意吗？我并不关心她本人，只是我们的确需要她的帮助。
Progress.english: Is Sierra satisfied with our progress? I don't care about her, but we really need her help.

identity.title: The Light Reveals
identity.objectives: Commune with Uther the Lightbringer.
identity.description: We seek aid not from a living friend, but one who passed long ago.$B$BUther the Lightbringer was more attuned to the subtleties of the Light than any paladin I've ever known. If we reach out to him, he may be able to help us find the Ashbringer.$B$BThe ceremony has been prepared. Approach the tomb when you are ready.

Progress.text: 我们必须不惜一切代价。
Progress.english: We must do whatever it takes.

identity.title: Make Your Mark
identity.objectives: Recruit Sylessa, Cyrille, and Lorin and slay Overseer Durant.
identity.description:
While you were out, I asked around.

You are looking for Overseer Durant. Turns out he lives near the Shimmershade Garden.

I can help you confront him, but you will need help. There are three individuals with the necessary skills, and they serve our cause.

Tell Cyrille that the owl hoots at dusk.

Inform Lorin that the saber prowls the plaza.

Mention to Sylessa that the cruel caskmaster has breathed his last.

They will know what to do. 

Speak to Vanthir when the deed is done.

Completion.text: 他們現在知道暮色百合不好惹，做得很好。
Completion.english: Ya no menospreciarán al Lirio Nocturno. Bien hecho.

identity.title: We Meet at Light's Hope
identity.objectives: Join the other paladins at Light's Hope Sanctum beneath Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
identity.description: Before we march on the Broken Isles, $n, we must put Highlord Tirion to rest.$B$BThere is but one place suitable for a paladin of his caliber... Light's Hope Sanctum, a secret bastion of the Light hidden beneath our chapel here.$B$BPaladins the world have gathered below for the ceremony. They await your arrival to begin the ceremony.

Objectives.text: 前往東瘟疫之地，進入聖光之願禮拜堂地下的聖光之願會堂，和其他聖騎士會合。
Objectives.english: Join the other paladins at Light's Hope Sanctum beneath Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

identity.title: Moths to a Flame
identity.objectives: Collect 4 Underglow Locusts.
identity.description:
No doubt you have noticed our guests.

I have watched them for a time and seen how they are attracted to the tree. I do not know if they are harmful to our sapling, but we cannot take that chance.

Collect a handful of the insects and bring them to me. I will examine them and determine if they are to be left alone.

Completion.text: 嗯，沒錯。跟我猜的一樣。
Completion.english: Mmm, sí. Lo que sospechaba.

identity.title: Make an Entrance
identity.objectives: Meet with Ly'leth Lunastre outside the Twilight Vineyards.
identity.description:
I need you to infiltrate the Twilight Vineyards and bring back something to deal with these insects.

To do that, you will need a way to bypass the guards that keep the orchards secure.

Ly'leth will be able to help us there. I will arrange to have her meet you near the entrance.

Go quickly!

Completion.text: 那麼就讓我帶你參觀一番。
Completion.english: Vale, te enseñaré todo esto.

identity.title: The Fruit of Our Efforts
identity.objectives: Taste the Honeyed Infusion, Supple Nectar, and Unctuous Draught.
identity.description:
It is my job to maintain appearances here.

<Margaux smiles apologetically.>

You will have to endure a little showmanship while I walk with you through the vineyard. It is the only way to avoid suspicion.

I will try to help you as I can, but only when it is safe to do so.

Come with me- our first stop is the tasting pavilion. There you can sample some of our work.

Completion.text: 你或許會想先清滌一下味覺，我們釀的酒味道可都很濃郁！
Completion.english: Tal vez quieras limpiarte el paladar: ¡los sabores que elaboramos son fuertecillos!

identity.title: How It's Made: Arcwine
identity.objectives: Follow Margaux through the Vineyard. Exchange information where possible.
identity.description:
<Margaux speaks in a hushed tone.>

While we walk through the Vineyard, we may find time to exchange information.

Try not to look alarmed at what you see, hm?

<Margaux flashes a vacant, forced smile.>

Shall we press on?

Completion.text: 歡迎，遊覽還愉快嗎？
Completion.english: Bienvenido. ¿Te está gustando la visita?

identity.title: Intense Concentration
identity.objectives: Catch 15 drops of Nightwell Essence using an Energy Vessel.
identity.description:
This is a rare treat, I hope you know. Not just anyone is allowed to stand on this hallowed ground.

<Sylverin adjusts his cuffs in a dignified fashion.>

To participate in the demonstration, simply take up an energy vessel and wade into the pool beside us. 

Catch the delicate dewdrops of Nightwell energy in the bowl as they fall- this is the only way one can safely manage its essence.

Once your vessel is full, proceed to our demonstration cask and gently pour the amalgamation into it.

Enjoy!

Completion.text: 很簡單，是不是？
Completion.english: Sencillo, ¿no?

identity.title: The Old Fashioned Way
identity.objectives: Participate in a juicing demonstration.
identity.description:
While you experienced the raw majesty that is Nightwell Infusion, Margaux was busy preparing another demonstration for you.

Head across the bridge and to the left, then again across a bridge and to your right. You will find her on the juicing veranda.

Enjoy the remainder of your tour!

<Sylverin offers an intensely fake smile.>

Completion.text: 我一定會在你離開前為你準備一瓶秘能酒。
Completion.english: Me encargaré de que tengas una botella de tu vino de arco lista para cuando te vayas.

identity.title: Silkwing Sabotage
identity.objectives: Slay 8 Tattered Silkwings.
identity.description:
Moths. Who ever heard of something so... barbaric!

They are eating our crop and the mana wyrms do nothing to deter them.

You. You seem capable. Deter these creatures so we can complete our harvest on schedule.

Ahem. Please.

Completion.text: 好多了。十分感謝你。
Completion.english: Mucho mejor. Te doy las gracias.

identity.title: Balance to Spare
identity.objectives: Collect 8 Shadescale Flyeaters.
identity.description:
Our tour is just about over. I will let you loose to 'walk the orchard', as is proper at this stage.

While you are there, you will notice a large number of mana wyrms floating about.

I am certain the vineyard would not miss a handful of them.

Good luck with your insect problem, friend.

<Margaux smiles warmly at you.>

Completion.text: 我會幫你把這些…呃…紀念品…裝好。
Completion.english: Haré que te embalen estos... ejem... souvenirs.

identity.title: Reversal
identity.objectives: Locate Margaux.
identity.description:
<Sylverin regards you uneasily.>

I was meant to meet you and Margaux here so I could escort you from the Vineyard. 

My mistress Margaux is never late. I fear that something terrible may have happened.

Please find her and make sure she is well.

Completion.text: 瑪苟…不！
Completion.english: Margaux... ¡no!

identity.title: Seek the Unsavory
identity.objectives: Speak to Vanthir.
identity.description:
This is just... unspeakable.

Margaux risked everything to get these mana wyrms to us. I cannot let it end this way.

I need you to find someone who can make this right. Someone who will do whatever it takes to see Overseer Durant slain.

Speak with Vanthir. I am certain he will know exactly who we need.

Completion.text:
狠下心腸，$n。

瑪苟的死令人懊悔，但她不會是最後一個受虐而死的人。恐怕還有無數人跟她一樣的遭遇。
Completion.english: No desfallezcas, $N.$B$BLa pérdida de Margaux es lamentable, pero no será la última en este conflicto. Ni mucho menos, me temo.

identity.title: If Words Don't Work...
identity.objectives: Bribe Arluin with 800 Ancient Mana.
identity.description:
Unless you have something worth risking my life for, I will not budge.

Vanthir must have told you that my services do not come cheap.

Let's say... enough mana to sustain me for a month.

<Arluin looks smug, as if you could never agree to this request.>

Completion.text: 很高興你了解我所提供服務的價值，夥伴。
Completion.english: Me alegra saber que entiendes el valor de mis servicios, compinche.

identity.title: A Big Score
identity.objectives: Attack the Magistrix's arcwine shipment and bring Arluin his cut of the stolen goods.
identity.description:
I'm not rich in anything but information, but maybe that can be of use to someone with your skills. You helped me, now you can help yourself.

The Magistrix receives a daily shipment of arcwine, which travels to the palace with a heavy escort. I can share the location, provided you leave me a cut of the goods.

One of my men has infiltrated the group and will hold up the delivery long enough for you to strike.

Completion.text: 很高興與你作生意。
Completion.english: Un placer hacer negocios contigo.

identity.title: The Way Back Home
identity.objectives: Activate the beacon.
identity.description: Hello? This is Chief Telemancer Oculeth. I see you have emerged safely!$B$BI am locking in your location as we speak. I will need you to activate the beacon on your end so we can establish a teleportation link.$b$bGot it? Good.

Completion.text:
當你突然消失時，我們還以為你遭到了不測。

我不知該對你的冒險歷程作何感想…我需要時間來整理心情。

不論如何，很高興你安然無恙地回來了。
Completion.english: Cuando desapareciste de repente, empezamos a temer lo peor.$B$BNo sé qué pensar de tus aventuras... Necesitaré tiempo para asimilar esta tragedia.$B$BA pesar de todo, me alegro de que hayas regresado de una pieza.

identity.title: Tracking Down Uthalesh
identity.objectives: Take the logbook to Calydus in Dreadscar Rift.
identity.description: The logbook contains the latest information on Uthalesh. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

Objectives.text: 把记录交给恐痕裂隙的卡里杜斯。
Objectives.english: Take the logbook to Calydus in Dreadscar Rift.

Description.text: 记录里面有乌萨勒斯的最新消息。这好像是出自一个极度躁动和兴奋的疯狂小鬼之手，内容难以辨认。把它交给卡里杜斯翻译一下。
Description.english: The logbook contains the latest information on Uthalesh. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

identity.title: Tracking Down the Skull
identity.objectives: Take the logbook to Calydus in Dreadscar Rift.
identity.description: The logbook contains the latest information on the Skull of the Man'ari. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

Objectives.text: 把记录交给恐痕裂隙的卡里杜斯。
Objectives.english: Take the logbook to Calydus in Dreadscar Rift.

Description.text: 记录里面有堕落者之颅的最新消息。这好像是出自一个极度躁动和兴奋的疯狂小鬼之手，内容难以辨认。把它交给卡里杜斯翻译一下。
Description.english: The logbook contains the latest information on the Skull of the Man'ari. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

identity.title: Finding the Scepter
identity.objectives: Go to Caer Darrow in Western Plaguelands and find out about the Shadow Council ritual.
identity.description: Very powerful, but difficult to acquire. Scepter is in the hands of Gul'dan. We must find out his plans, get close.$b$bCalydus know Gul'dan planning major operation. He has sent out a call to arms to all Shadow Council to help with big ritual. One such group at Caer Darrow, talking to the necromancers there.$b$bYou should go, find out about plan.

Progress.text: 這有點麻煩，但卡萊德斯有辦法！
Progress.english: Esto se complica, ¡pero Calydus tiene idea!

Completion.text:
古爾丹說過，有力量的人都可以加入。如果朋友加入呢？然後靠近時把權杖搶走，然後跑！

沒錯！這行得通，可是要讓他們信任。古爾丹需要眼睛。朋友可以幫忙拿眼睛，就可以有信任。
Completion.english: Gul'dan dice que cualquiera con poder puede unirse. ¿Y si amigo se uniera? Luego, cuando cerca, ¡coge el Cetro y corre!$B$B¡Sí! Podría funcionar, pero hay que trabajar duro para ganar confianza. Gul'dan aún necesita Ojo. Amigo debería ayudar con eso, ganar más respeto.

identity.title: An Eye for a Scepter
identity.objectives: Take the portal to Tol Barad and help find the Eye of Dalaran.
identity.description: Sounds simple? Make nice with Shadow Council friend must... for now. Help with ritual enough to gain trust, then turn tables!$b$bCouncil made portal device to Tol Barad here. Go, help Shadow Council find Eye of Dalaran, earn spot in big ritual! Then steal Scepter!$b$bCalydus will try to keep eye on friend when possible.

Completion.text:
沒錯，沒錯！找到眼睛！幫暗影議會！現在可以參加儀式了。權杖就在那裡。

這件事有點麻煩，朋友，不過卡萊德斯對你很有信心！
Completion.english: ¡Sí, sí! ¡Tú tienes el Ojo! ¡Tú has ayudado al Consejo de la Sombra! Ahora ve al ritual. El Cetro estará allí.$B$BComplicado será, ¡pero Calydus tiene mucha fe en ti!

identity.title: Ritual Ruination
identity.objectives: Take the Fel Bat to the Tomb of Sargeras and steal the Scepter of Sargeras.
identity.description: Time for main event, friend! Gul'dan wants to begin his big ritual, cause end times for this world. Calydus confident getting the Scepter will stop that plan.$b$bTake this bat to Tomb of Sargeras, find ritual, steal Scepter. Oh... and get out!$b$bCalydus will help when he can! Good luck, friend!

Completion.text:
居然成功了，卡萊德斯不敢相信！儀式失敗，暗影議會全軍覆沒，而且我們沒死！

喔，還有你拿到權杖！這是我們的大勝利！
Completion.english: ¡Calydus no se cree que haya funcionado! Ritual desbaratado, Consejo de la Sombra erradicado ¡y tú y yo vivos!$B$B¡Ah, y tú tienes el Cetro! ¡Gran victoria para ti!

identity.title: Troops in the Field
identity.objectives: Use the Command Table and complete the mission, "Troops in the Field."
identity.description: It's time to send our newly summoned ghouls out into the field. Look at the Command Table and send your champions and troops on a routine scouting mission.

Progress.text: 进展如何？
Progress.english: Как все прошло?

identity.title: Spread the Word
identity.objectives: Use the Command Map and complete the mission, "Spread the Word".
identity.description:
In the center of the dais is a map of the Broken Isles. From it, you can direct our allies to carry out vital assignments across the world.

The first task is critical to the growth of our order - identifying skilled priests whom we can trust to train our order's troops.

This is a task we can easily entrust to one of our new champions.

Progress.text: 任务进展如何？
Progress.english: How is the task progressing?

identity.title: The Perfect Opportunity
identity.objectives: Meet Ly'leth Lunastre at the Waning Crescent.
identity.description:
I have heard whispers from Suramar City.

Recent unrest in the city has prompted the nobles to seek another advisor to fill Elisande's council. Such positions are rarely offered and hotly contested.

This is the perfect opportunity and Ly'leth is the perfect candidate. Fate smiles upon our cause!

I know she has historically chosen to avoid such politics and maneuvering, but we must now ask her to join the fray.

Seek her out at the Waning Crescent and ensure her victory.

Completion.text:
啊，$n。

很高興能與你重逢。相信你已經準備好助我一臂之力。
Completion.english: Aah, $N.$B$B¡Cuánto me alegro de volver a verte! Confío en que estés listo para ayudarme en mi campaña.

identity.title: Either With Us
identity.objectives: Speak to Lady Aurore.
identity.description:
Thalyssra asks much of me, but our cause is worth the risks.

The title of advisor would grant us enormous influence. Information. Access.

I could change this rebellion. I could save so many lives.

I will need strong endorsement to ascend, though. There are many houses who stand with me by virtue of my family's name. Some are more hesitant.

Lady Aurore of House Astravar is the most prominent of these. Seek her out. Offer your aid in my stead. 

Earn her trust and the rest will follow.

Completion.text: 我像一位姐姐一樣關愛路納斯特女士，但我恐怕舉步維艱。
Completion.english: Quiero a lady Lunastre como a una hermana, pero me temo que tengo las manos atadas.

identity.title: Or Against Us
identity.objectives: Speak to Arluin.
identity.description:
If Ly'leth is to achieve the role of advisor to the Grand Magistrix we will need to open a path for her.

It is true she will have some supporters but they alone cannot grant her the title.

There are other houses that Ly'leth must contend with. Fear and coercion are their tools. None dare stand against them openly, and we cannot win them over with favors and oaths. 

Seek out Arluin. I trust he will have some ideas of how to proceed.

Completion.text: 非常好。讓我們討論一下對策。
Completion.english: De acuerdo. Discutamos la estrategia.

identity.title: Thinly Veiled Threats
identity.objectives: Rescue Ailen Astravar.
identity.description:
How could I let this happen?

<Aurore wrings her hands.>

Yesterday Coryn Stelleris approached me about the appointment. He sought my support, but I did not offer it. 

He said my son's life would continue as normal... if I gave him my vote.

This morning my son was gone.

I can only think of the terrible things he may be suffering. You know what this family is capable of!

You want my support, but I can do nothing while my son is in danger. Nothing.

Please... save him!

Completion.text: 他沒有受到傷害！我欠你和黎利斯一份大人情。
Completion.english: ¡Está ileso! Estoy en deuda contigo y con Ly'leth.

identity.title: Rumor Has It
identity.objectives: Plant rumors among members of House Duskmere.
identity.description:
Coryn Stelleris and Ruven Duskmere were close friends, but one always overshadowed the other. Now the Stelleris family stands to gain from lord Ruven's death. Handsomely.

House Duskmere will soon learn of their loss. I want you to be the one to redirect their anger and grief.

A handful of well placed rumors should do the trick.

I won't be lingering in this part of the city for long, and Ly'leth will want to know of your efforts.

Return to her when you are finished.

Completion.text: 城市到處流傳著非常有趣的八卦，$n。勝利就在眼前了。
Completion.english: Por la ciudad se escuchan chismorreos muy interesantes, $N. La victoria está mucho más cerca.

identity.title: Court of Stars: Beware the Fury of a Patient Elf
identity.objectives: Enter the Court of Stars dungeon and slay Advisor Melandrus. Collect his Spellstone and return it to Thalyssra.
identity.description:
An opportunity presents itself, $n.

Ly'leth has arranged to grant you entry into a ball at the Court of Stars. I do not know what we may gain from this venture, but there is one task I must set for you.

Advisor Melandrus once called himself my ally. He and I planned Elisande's downfall, but when the moment came I found myself betrayed.

The wound his dagger inflicted still aches. I cannot enter Suramar to take my revenge, but you can.

Give him a traitor's death, and bring me his spellstone.

Progress.text: 好了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Ya está?

Completion.text:
<薩莉瑟拉用力握緊法術石，遲遲不肯放手。>

這是他自找的。

我不能一直困在過去。失去他，艾莉珊德就少了一大助力，我們離為夏多雷撥亂反正的目標也更近了一步。
Completion.english: <Thalyssra sujeta firmemente la piedra de hechizo durante un instante.>$B$BSe lo ganó a pulso.$B$BNo puedo vivir en el pasado. Elisande es más débil sin él, y estamos un paso más cerca de enmendar las afrentas que han sufrido los shal'dorei.

identity.title: Death Becomes Him
identity.objectives: Slay Ruven Duskmere.
identity.description:
There are two houses that pose a threat to Ly'leth's rise, but we concern ourselves with only one of them now.

House Duskmere commands respect through fear and that fear is not unfounded. Few can boast of magical talent equal to that of Ruven Duskmere. 

Without this charming specimen, however, their house is nothing.

I know you may find my methods distasteful. Know that there were demons in Suramar long before the Legion.

This one has lived long enough.

Completion.text:
看來你已經控制住局面。我並不想…打擾你。

又少了一個追求權力的貴族需要擔心。做得很好，$n。
Completion.english: Parecía que lo tenías todo bajo control. No quería... interrumpir.$B$BUn noble acaparador menos del que preocuparse. Bien hecho, $N.

identity.title: In the Bag
identity.objectives: Witness Ly'leth Lunastre's ascension to advisor.
identity.description:
Already the city is abuzz with outrage.

I will not lie to you- it pleases me greatly that one such as Coryn is made a fool.

The other houses have sent their endorsements. It is done, and nothing remains but a formal ceremony to grant me the title of advisor.

Meet me there. You deserve to share in this success.

Completion.text: 事情的結局可能沒我希望的這般明朗。
Completion.english: Esto podría no acabar de una forma tan limpia como me habría gustado.

identity.title: Ly'leth's Champion
identity.objectives: Speak with Ly'leth to begin the encounter.
identity.description:
Tal'ashar is an honor duel.

If I lose, then I must forfeit my title to Coryn Stelleris.

<Ly'leth smiles gently.>

That is why you are going to fight for me. 

I will grant you a more powerful disguise for this task, and together we will put Coryn in his place.

Speak to me when you are ready to battle on my behalf.

Completion.text: 我們今天大有斬獲，我絕不會忘記。
Completion.english: Hoy hemos hecho grandes avances. No lo olvidaré.

identity.title: Uniting the Isles
identity.objectives: Earn at least Friendly reputation with the factions of the Broken Isles.
identity.description: There are a great number of factions here on the Broken Isles. We must unite them if we want to stand a chance against the Legion. Prove your worth to them and report back to me.

Progress.text: 团结各大阵营的进展如何？
Progress.english: Well, how are you progressing in uniting factions?

identity.title: Asset Security
identity.objectives: Defend Arluin's stash from the city guards.
identity.description:
With the demons and guards so agitated, I'm running out of safe places to store contraband. The guards have caught on to one of my favorite havens and will be making off with my goods any minute now.

Head to my stash and discourage their curiosity. You will need to use a grappling hook to access it- just look for something to latch onto along the ledge.

I will make sure there is something in it for you when you are done.

Completion.text: 你真是越來越令人信賴了。
Completion.english: Te estás convirtiendo en un socio de lo más fiable.

identity.title: The Shardmaidens
identity.objectives: Slay 6 Shardmaidens in the Shattered Locus.
identity.description:
Long have I walked this land and I have seen many forms of corruption.

The creatures that wander this hall are twisted by the magics unleashed by the failed arcan'dor. These dryads have lost their way, and cannot be saved.

You must destroy them. End their suffering.

Completion.text: 謝謝你。此處將永遠無法回復生氣，但至少不會再有人因為林精陷入瘋狂而受傷。
Completion.english: Gracias. Este lugar nunca se recuperará, pero su locura no tiene por qué hacer daño a otros.

identity.title: Fragments of Disaster
identity.objectives: Collect 5 Crystallized Bark.
identity.description:
In the hall beyond rests the bones of the failed arcan'dor.

I will take fragments of the crystallized tree and attempt to read them. We must discover the root cause of this destruction.

Only then do we have any hope of preventing this disaster from repeating itself.

Progress.text: 你拿到樹皮了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Tienes los fragmentos?

Completion.text: 我會仔細研究這些東西。要是我們夠幸運，說不定可以找到答案。
Completion.english: Los examinaré concienzudamente. Si tenemos suerte, hallaremos respuestas.

identity.title: The Emerald Nightmare: The Stuff of Dreams
identity.objectives: Collect Purified Life Essence from the Emerald Dream, hidden inside the Emerald Nightmare Raid.
identity.description:
This arcan'dor is one of an ancient species. They were not bred, but created. In them the arcane and primitive druidic magics merged into something greater than both.

The arcane will soon devour it whole.

We can restore balance, but it will require wild magic. Magic trapped in another realm.

You must enter the Emerald Dream- the pure, unsullied vision of Azeroth - and bring back the essence of life itself.

Only then can the arcan'dor find stability and begin to thrive once more.

Progress.text: 你拿到了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿La tienes?

Completion.text: 我不知道你怎麼拿到這東西，不過一定很不容易。我們面前困難重重，但你卻一一克服。來吧，讓我們復活奧肯多爾。
Completion.english: No sé cómo te has hecho con esto, pero sé que no habrá sido sencillo. A pesar de los muchos obstáculos, has resistido. Ven. Restablezcamos el Arcan'dor.

identity.title: A Change of Seasons
identity.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois.
identity.description:
It is time.

The arcan'dor is preparing to mature. With a final burst of growth, this gift will be fully realized.

We must make ready the leyline feed.

Completion.text: 我們的樹看來十分需要水份滋潤。
Completion.english: Nuestro árbol parece estar sediento.

identity.title: Court of Stars
identity.objectives: Defeat Advisor Melandrus in Court of Stars.
identity.description:
The weather is perfect for a party, isn't it?

Travel to the Court of Stars, where the Grand Magistrix herself may appear among her nobles to reassure them of the need for all the Legion patrols.

identity.title: I Believe I Can Fly!
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Molted Feathers for Snicarus Dungleflight.
identity.description: Let's not bother explaining how this happened, just know that I have the plan of all plans to escape this... this... <Looks over his hand-crafted outfit, then quickly glances to a pile of droppings nearby.>$B$BThis place stinks! But you can help!$B$BThese feathers here will help craft my escape plan. If you wouldn't mind, I'm sure there's enough for the both of us!

Description.text: 別再浪費時間解釋一切，只要知道，我有辦法逃離這個…這個…<仔細檢查他的訂製服，然後很快看一下附近的一堆糞便。>$B$B這個地方真臭！不過你幫得上忙！$B$B這裡的這些羽毛對我的逃脫計畫不可或缺。如果你不介意，我敢肯定這裡的羽毛夠我們兩個人用！
Description.english: Let's not bother explaining how this happened, just know that I have the plan of all plans to escape this... this... <Looks over his hand-crafted outfit, then quickly glances to a pile of droppings nearby.>$B$BThis place stinks! But you can help!$B$BThese feathers here will help craft my escape plan. If you wouldn't mind, I'm sure there's enough for the both of us!

identity.title: Giving It All We've Got
identity.objectives: Activate all of the leyline feeds in Suramar, then speak with Valtrois.
identity.description:
The arcan'dor is drawing incredible amounts of energy.

Even with the leyline feed at full capacity, we may not have the power.

Let us first ensure that all potential leyline conduits connecting to Shal'Aran are active.

Then I can attempt to amplify the output and hopefully satisfy this insufferable plant.

Completion.text: 我們必須採取非常手段。
Completion.english: Debemos tomar medidas drásticas.

identity.title: Ephemeral Manastorm Projector
identity.objectives: Collect $1oa Warp-Resistant Plating from Chronarch Defenders.
identity.description:
Oculeth's theory is sound. Reckless, but sound.

A small warp-field could trap and excite ambient mana in the conduit, thus creating a manastorm similar to when the arcan'dor fell out of balance.

I can build a device to generate the warp-field, but I need materials.

Specifically, warp-resistant alloys - such as the armor plating of high-end security constructs in the noble district.

Those constructs are deadly. If anyone owes you a favor, now is the time to call it in.

Progress.text: 沒有裝甲的保護，電磁脈衝將在數秒內破壞自己。
Progress.english: Sin esos blindajes, el PEM quedaría destrozado en cuestión de segundos.

Completion.text: 這些非常合用。
Completion.english: Estos servirán.

identity.title: Flow Control
identity.objectives: Seal off the Arcway Outlets in Lunastre Lane, The Parade Grounds, and the Midnight Court.
identity.description:
If all goes as planned, the manastorm will cause the leyline to flare up, sending a great surge of energy through the arcway.

In order for the surge to reach Shal'Aran, we must seal off any outlets along the way. If we miss even one, the mission fails - and hundreds of people will be vaporized by the energy blow off.

Thalyssra had better be sure about this tree.

Completion.text: 如果我的拱道地圖正確無誤，那些應該就是我們需要注意的所有出口。
Completion.english: Si mi mapa de La Arquería es preciso, esas son todas las tomas de las que debemos preocuparnos.

identity.title: Bring Home the Beacon
identity.objectives: Use the Advanced Telemancy Beacon to survey Evermoon Commons, Evermoon Bazaar, and Siren's Vigil in Suramar City.
identity.description:
The conduit we need is in the Arcway, and security in the Arcway has doubled since your last visit.

Our only reasonable option is to teleport your strike team directly in. 

This is a long-range teleport to a non-anchored destination. In other words, it will be hard.

Take this beacon and survey the commons in Suramar City, then return the beacon to me so I can analyze the results. 

This will help me teleport you as close as possible to the conduit!

Completion.text: 太好了。有了這個，把你們所有人傳送到海底的機率就會大大降低！
Completion.english: Excelente. ¡Con esto, la probabilidad de que os teletransporte al fondo del mar es mucho menor!

identity.title: All In
identity.objectives: Complete the "All In" scenario.$B$BChief Telemancer Oculeth can begin the scenario.
identity.description:
It is time to put our plan into action.

Oculeth will send you, Arluin and myself into the Arcway, where we shall trigger a manastorm in the Nightflow Conduit.

Valtrois will stay here and prepare Shal'Aran for a massive jolt of arcane power - hopefully enough to satisfy the arcan'dor.

$p... We have a saying... "To lead is to stand alone." It means only those who bear the weight of leadership can truly appreciate it.

Thank you for standing beside me. In truth, I do not feel alone.

Completion.text: 看呀，夜落精靈的救贖。
Completion.english: Observa. La redención de los caídos de la noche.

identity.title: Arcan'dor, Gift of the Ancient Magi
identity.objectives: Pick the Fruit of the Arcan'dor and share it with Chief Telemancer Oculeth, Arcanist Valtrois, and First Arcanist Thalyssra.
identity.description:
Thousands of years ago, as the Quel'dorei were just beginning to unravel the mysteries of the arcane, a small enclave of druids met with the first of the elven magi.

In the pale moonlight, they formed an order that would seek to bring the arcane into balance - using nature itself as a vessel. Thus the arcan'dor were created.

My masters who belonged to this order have long since faded away. Yet their legacy remains.

Their gift will mend the spirit of the shal'dorei. Let them eat, and be made whole.

Completion.text: 我們…終於自由了。
Completion.english: Al fin... somos libres.

identity.title: Arluin's Request
identity.objectives: Locate Arluelle and give her a piece of the Arcan'dor Fruit.
identity.description:
I never thought I would need to read this...

<Vanthir hefts a scroll in his hand.>

Arluin made... plans... in the event he fell. It is not much, but I would like to honor his last request.

<Vanthir hands you the scroll.>

Go to the location marked on this map. Take this Arcan'dor Fruit and give it to a woman named Arluelle. Arluin was very specific that all rewards for his work be directed to her.

I think he may have known what his sacrifice meant. I was wrong about him.

Completion.text: 我不再覺得飢渴了。我能夠思考——我會活下去！喔，亞魯因…
Completion.english: Ya no tengo hambre. Puedo pensar... ¡Viviré! Oh, Arluin...

identity.title: Shalassic Park
identity.objectives: Ride Su'esh and defeat $3oa adversaries.
identity.description: We have a Devilsaur.$b$bI think she sees you as the pack leader now. She should obey your commands.$b$bShe looks hungry. Why don't you let her off the leash a little bit?

Completion.text:
真是令人嘆為觀止，$n。

蘇艾許將是我們未來有力的盟友。我會暫時注意著它。
Completion.english: Ha sido todo un espectáculo, $N.$B$BSu'esh será una valiosa baza en los tiempos que vendrán. Mientras tanto, yo le echaré un ojo.

identity.title: Leyline Feed: Elor'shan
identity.objectives: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.
identity.description: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>

Progress.text: <地脈饋流產生輕柔的脈衝。>
Progress.english: <El suministro de línea Ley palpita suavemente.>

Completion.text: <隨著你對饋流注入更多法力，構造體開始發揮作用。空氣中開始瀰漫著秘法能量，你的皮膚感到刺痛。>
Completion.english: <Al imbuir de maná el suministro, la estructura cobra vida. Sientes un cosquilleo al cargarse el aire de poder Arcano.>

identity.title: Leyline Feed: Kel'balor
identity.objectives: Defend the Leyline Feed and infuse it with Ancient Mana.
identity.description: <This feed appears to draw power from the leyline in order to become fully operational.$b$bYou should be able to imbue it with mana, but it will take a few minutes to draw enough leyline energy to accept the infusion.$b$bBeware, for creatures may notice the surge of arcane energy...>

Progress.text: <地脈饋流產生輕柔的脈衝。>
Progress.english: <El suministro de línea Ley palpita suavemente.>

Completion.text: <隨著你對饋流注入更多法力，構造體開始發揮作用。空氣中開始瀰漫著秘法能量，你的皮膚感到刺痛。>
Completion.english: <Al imbuir de maná el suministro, la estructura cobra vida. Sientes un cosquilleo al cargarse el aire de poder Arcano.>

identity.title: Leyline Feed: Ley Station Moonfall
identity.objectives: Find the Broken Leydar Dish and repair the leyline feed.
identity.description: <This leyline feed appears to be damaged. The large collector at the top is broken.$b$bThe broken piece must be around here somewhere. There are rough scuff marks on the floor that appear to be made by something larger than the creatures inside.$b$bMuch, much larger.>

Progress.text: <地脈饋流產生輕柔的脈衝。>
Progress.english: <El suministro palpita suavemente.>

Completion.text: <隨著你將斷裂的部分放到柱子上，並開始注入法力，秘法能量開始修復斷裂處。地脈啟動後，它開始緩慢轉動。>
Completion.english: <Cuando colocas el trozo roto en el pilar y comienzas a imbuirlo de maná, la rotura empieza a repararse con energía Arcana. Poco a poco va empezando a girar al activarse la línea Ley.>

identity.title: Leyline Feed: Ley Station Aethenar
identity.objectives: Collect 6 Leyline Feed Fragments and infuse the feed with ancient mana.
identity.description: <This leyline appears to be damaged and needs repair.$b$bSeveral large chunks of the main column are missing and arcane energy is crackling in the gaps.$b$bThe elementals nearby seem to pick up debris and absorb it into their bodies as they move around. Maybe they have the missing pieces...>

Progress.text: <隨著狂暴的能量從圓柱的縫隙逸出，地脈饋流也開始劈啪作響。>
Progress.english: <El suministro de línea Ley crepita cuando la energía salvaje se escapa por los huecos de la columna.>

Completion.text: <隨著你將碎片重新插入柱子中，秘法能量開始修復裂痕。你對地脈饋流注入上古法力，整個構造體開始復甦。>
Completion.english: <Al insertar los fragmentos en el pilar, la energía Arcana empieza a reparar las grietas. Imbuyes el suministro de maná antiguo y la estructura vuelve a la vida.>

identity.title: Leyline Feed: Falanaar Arcway
identity.objectives: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.
identity.description: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>

Progress.text: <地脈饋流產生輕柔的脈衝。>
Progress.english: <El suministro de línea Ley palpita suavemente.>

identity.title: Hidden History
identity.objectives: Use the scouting notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes Holt needs to begin research on your artifact.
identity.description:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it.

If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can help with that.

Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes. They may be hard to procure. I asked one of the scouts to seek them out, here are her notes.

Objectives.text: 利用偵察筆記尋獲4部古老典籍，浩特才能夠幫你研究神兵武器。
Objectives.english: Use the scouting notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes Holt needs to begin research on your artifact.

Description.text:
你拥有一件古老而强大的武器。但目前为止，我们对它知之甚少。

如果我们想要释放它全部的潜能，我们就必须深入地探究它的奥秘。我可以帮你做到这一点。

在我开始研究之前，我还需要几本古代典籍以供研究。它们也许会很难以获得。我已经派遣一名斥候去寻找它们的下落，这是她的笔记。
Description.english:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it.

If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can help with that.

Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes. They may be hard to procure. I asked one of the scouts to seek them out, here are her notes.

identity.title: Hidden History
identity.objectives: Use the scouting notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes Fjornson needs to begin research on your artifact.
identity.description:
You wield ancient steel, strengthened by magics we barely understand.

If you truly want to unlock the potential of your weapons, you need to know more of how they were forged, and of the battles they've fought in. I can help with this.

Your races use books to store their histories, and I will need some of these to piece together the legend of your steel. I asked one of your followers to look into their locations for me. Here are her notes.

Objectives.text: 利用偵察筆記尋獲4部古老典籍，富友森才能幫你研究神兵武器。
Objectives.english: Use the scouting notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes Fjornson needs to begin research on your artifact.

Description.text: 你所挥舞着的远古武器拥有我们难以理解的魔力。$B$B如果你想要解放武器的真正力量，你就必须更清楚地了解它的锻造方法和战斗经历。我可以帮你做到这一点。$B$B你的种族会利用书本来记录历史，而我刚好需要其中的一些来完整地揭示这把武器的来龙去脉。我已经请求你的一个追随者去寻找这些典籍的线索。这是她的笔记。
Description.english:
You wield ancient steel, strengthened by magics we barely understand.

If you truly want to unlock the potential of your weapons, you need to know more of how they were forged, and of the battles they've fought in. I can help with this.

Your races use books to store their histories, and I will need some of these to piece together the legend of your steel. I asked one of your followers to look into their locations for me. Here are her notes.

identity.title: Hitting the Books
identity.objectives: Start a Research Work Order.
identity.description:
Any death knight worth their salt knows the weapon they wield as if they were born with it.  But you now carry a weapon older than any in this hall.

If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. I promise you it will be worth every minute.

Objectives.text: 开始一项研究工作的订单。
Objectives.english: Start a Research Work Order.

Description.text:
所有的死亡骑士都应该了解自己的武器，因为那是他们与生俱来的伙伴。但你手中那把武器比这个大厅中的任何一把都更古老。

如果我们真要解放它全部的潜力，就得更了解它。想要全部浏览、翻译并得出有价值的成果的话，需要大量的时间，我一个人也无法担此重任。

我们应该优先抽调一部分组织的资源来进行此项研究。我向你保证，我们付出的每一丝努力都不会被白费。

identity.description:

We be shipping outta Bladefist Bay right away. With da full fury of da Horde, we gonna smash der line so hard dat Sargeras is gonna feel it in da Nether!
