Completion.text:
船隻即將從刃拳海岸的碼頭出航，

在你出發前，先做好準備吧。我有預感這會是艱難的一仗。
Completion.english: Las naves están zarpando del puerto en la Bahía de Garrafilada.$B$BPrepárate antes de irte. Tengo la sensación de que esta batalla no será fácil.

identity.title: Hired Help
identity.objectives: Locate Arluin and persuade him to help you.
identity.description:
I was fond of Margaux. News of her death weighs heavily on many of us.

<Vanthir shakes his head sadly.>

If we are to carry on, we need to send a strong message. We need those like Durant to know that we are watching, and we will hold them accountable.

I know someone who could help us.

His name is Arluin. To call him a reluctant ally would be generously overstating it. He is cautious, and will not risk himself without compensation.

You can find him in the alleys north of the Evermoon Bazaar.

Completion.text: 我可以幫你，但你必須先幫我一點小忙。
Completion.english: Te ayudaré, pero quiero que antes hagas algo por mí.

identity.title: A Falling Star
identity.objectives: Find the Mysterious Lightbound Object.
identity.description: $ct $n, thank you for coming. I have a matter of some urgency that requires your unique talents.$B$BThe Order of the Silver Hand have reported that an extraordinarily luminescent object has emerged from the Felstorm and is currently falling towards the coast of Suramar. What I find most curious about this occurrence is that the object was reported as having "cut a swath" through the Felstorm itself.$B$BWill you investigate? There is a gryphon awaiting your arrival at Krasus' Landing.

Progress.text: 讓我看看你找到的東西。
Progress.english: Enséñame qué has encontrado.

Completion.text: 真是太奇妙了！這絕對不是出自燃燒軍團之手。讓我仔細瞧瞧。
Completion.english: ¡Curiosísimo, ya lo creo! Este objeto no es obra de la Legión. Déjame echar un vistazo más a fondo.

identity.title: Vote of Confidence
identity.objectives: Return to Ly'leth at the Waning Crescent.
identity.description:
I will endeavor to protect my son until the votes are cast.

Coryn Stelleris is a predator even among the nobility. It does not surprise me that he should stoop to such depths to ensure his own success.

Tell Ly'leth that she has my support. Unequivocally.

You may also choose to tell her that Coryn Stelleris will hurt her, if she gives him a chance.

Be careful.

Completion.text:
我知道柯林恩。我們不會低估他的狠毒，我保證。

謝謝你幫助歐蘿蕾，她是我非常要好的朋友。
Completion.english: Sé de Coryn. No subestimaremos su veneno, descuida.$B$BGracias por ayudar a mi queridísima amiga Aurore.

identity.title: Wasted Potential
identity.objectives: Activate the teleporter pad and bring Vanthir's gift to Thalyssra.
identity.description:
You have done well for us here, but it is time for you to return to Thalyssra.

There is a teleporter pad nearby that has gone unused in recent years. See if you can reroute it and return to her that way.

Oh, and before you go:

<Vanthir hands you a wrapped bottle of Arcwine.>

Take this to her, with my thanks for sending you. Let her know that your efforts helped replenish our Arcwine supplies and reunited a mother and child.

We are grateful beyond measure. Farewell for now.

Completion.text:
我聽說你打算離開這座城市…據說夜裔精靈還有其他地方可去，在那裡我們再也不用忍受艾莉珊德的瘋狂。

我想跟你一起走。

我可以為你彈豎琴，也可以當你的幫手，雖然這些在這裡都派不上用場。

只要你開口，我就跟你一起透過傳送器離開，與另一端的知音分享我的音樂。
Completion.english: He oído rumores de que piensas abandonar la ciudad... Que hay otro sitio para los Nocheterna donde no nos inclinaríamos a la locura de Elisande.$B$BQuiero ir contigo.$B$BTe ofrezco mi arpa y mis manos, ya que aquí nadie las quiere.$B$BSi quieres, te acompañaré en el teletransporte y compartiré mi música con quienquiera que me espere al otro lado.

identity.title: And They Will Tremble
identity.objectives: Return to Thalyssra
identity.description:
There will be consequences for what has transpired this day.

For now, you should return to Thalyssra. Tell her that we have avenged Margaux and that the Dusk Lily has announced itself to all of Suramar.

There will be many more deaths before this is over, rest assured, but this is a death that will teach others like Durant to tread more carefully in the future.

Completion.text: 總算可稍稍鬆一口氣。你做得很好，可以稍微休息一下。
Completion.english: Es un pequeño alivio. Lo has hecho bien. Descansa.

identity.title: Friends With Benefits
identity.objectives: Return to Thalyssra.
identity.description: The Lunastre Attendant, silent as ever, offers you a wax-sealed scroll.$b$bIt reads:$b"Dearest $n,$b$bI asked my attendant to catch you, should things go in my favor.$b$bThe role of Advisor will keep me away from the estate for some time and I settled on a gift for Thalyssra.$b$bI have sent a detachment of attendants to Shal'Aran with some comfort items. Treat them well- they need someone to wait on and I could think of none better!$b$bGive the others my thanks, and my love,$bAdvisor Ly'leth Lunastre"

Completion.text: 她確實是一名可敬的夥伴。
Completion.english: No cabe duda de que es una digna compañera.

identity.title: Vengeance for Margaux
identity.objectives: Slay 8 Vineyard Enforcers or Wardens.
identity.description:
<Sylverin sputters, pale-faced with rage.>

How could they? Margaux did everything they asked of her and more! The arcwine never stopped flowing despite everything they did to us! To her!

Such injustice cannot stand. We must take vengeance for Margaux.

Completion.text: <薩莉瑟拉有好一會兒說不出話來。>
Completion.english: <Thalyssra se queda sin palabras durante un instante.>

identity.title: Protect the Home Front
identity.objectives: Open your map to find an active Legion invasion in Kalimdor or Eastern Kingdoms. Go to the invasion site and stop the demons!
identity.description: The Legion hasn't just invaded this city. Their evil is spreading across Azeroth, threatening the far corners of our world.$b$bWe must seek them out and stop them, everywhere their darkness touches.$b$bWe've dispatched scouts around the world to watch for Legion activity. As invasions arise, we'll mark the locations on your map.$b$bMake them suffer, $n!

Objectives.text: 打开地图，在卡利姆多或东部王国找到一场正在进行的军团入侵。前往入侵点并阻止恶魔！
Objectives.english: Open your map to find an active Legion invasion in Kalimdor or Eastern Kingdoms. Go to the invasion site and stop the demons!

Description.text: 军团还没有入侵这座城市。他们的邪恶力量正在艾泽拉斯蔓延，威胁着我们世界的每一个角落。$b$b无论他们的黑暗触手伸向何方，我们都必须找到并且阻止他们。$b$b我们已经向全世界派出了斥候，侦察军团活动。当入侵发生时，我们将在你的地图上标出发生的地点。$b$b让他们付出代价，$n！
Description.english: The Legion hasn't just invaded this city. Their evil is spreading across Azeroth, threatening the far corners of our world.$b$bWe must seek them out and stop them, everywhere their darkness touches.$b$bWe've dispatched scouts around the world to watch for Legion activity. As invasions arise, we'll mark the locations on your map.$b$bMake them suffer, $n!

identity.title: A Growing Crisis
identity.objectives: Meet Valewalker Farodin at the Temple of Fala'dora. You can travel there using the Portal to Falanaar in Shal'aran.
identity.description:
The Arcan'dor is failing.

This energy was once bound in its boughs and fueled its growth. There was balance, between life and arcane.

Now that energy is breaking free. When the heart can no longer hold it, this tree will kill every living thing in this hall.

I have seen this happen before and I must find a way to stop it from happening again. 

We must go to the tree that came before. Its bones can guide us.

Meet me at the temple of Fal'adora. We will descend together.

Completion.text: 我必須想個辦法…
Completion.english: Debo encontrar un modo...

identity.title: Light's Charge
identity.objectives: Place Light's Heart in your Order Hall.
identity.description: "You did not ask for this burden, but it is what fate has deemed." Turalyon's haunting last words still echo in my mind. I worry about the fate of the draenei... about the fate of my friend, Velen; but we must remain vigilant, $n!$B$BFor now, Light's Heart remains under your watchful eye. There is one place on Azeroth that I would trust with the safekeeping of the object: your order hall. Take it there, $n. I will remain in Dalaran and continue looking for answers. There must be another way!

Progress.text: 你必須把聖光之心放在這裡。
Progress.english: Aquí es donde debes colocar el Corazón de la Luz.

identity.title: Another Arcan'dor Closes...
identity.objectives: Return to Shal'aran.
identity.description:
I hope you have a better understanding of what is at stake.

Come. There is no more for us to do here.

Meet me in Shal'aran and we will discuss what steps we may take next.

Completion.text: 我們必須找到解決方案，我們沒有多少時間了。
Completion.english: Tenemos que hallar una solución. El tiempo se agota.

identity.title: A Burning Path Through Time
identity.objectives: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
identity.description: The blazing star shines upon the land, searing the earth and parching the landscape. This star is relentless, malevolent almost. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

Progress.text: 我预见你将跟随燃烧之星，走上它所揭示的道路。
Progress.english: I foresee that you will follow the burning star on the path it reveals.

identity.title: Treasure
identity.objectives: Speak with Valtrois.
identity.description:
There is a strange energy in the air.

I feel as if a force is growing, pressing down on us. It is worrisome.

Valtrois works most closely with the sources of power in this room.

Speak to her. Ask if there is anything to be concerned with.

Objectives.text: 与瓦尔托伊对话。
Objectives.english: Speak with Valtrois.

Description.text:
空气中流动着奇怪的能量。

我感觉某种力量正在增长，不断向我们迫近。这种情况令人担忧。

瓦尔托伊最了解这间屋子里的力量来源。

去找她。问问有什么需要担心的情况。
Description.english:
There is a strange energy in the air.

I feel as if a force is growing, pressing down on us. It is worrisome.

Valtrois works most closely with the sources of power in this room.

Speak to her. Ask if there is anything to be concerned with.

identity.title: The Might of Dalaran pt2
identity.objectives: Collect the Focusing Crystal and use it to complete a world quest.
identity.description: Yes, now once the crystal has been empowered, collect it here, and use it to unleash the power of our mages on a world quest.

Objectives.text: 取得聚焦水晶并用它来完成一个世界任务。
Objectives.english: Collect the Focusing Crystal and use it to complete a world quest.

Description.text: 是的，等水晶完成了充能，就到这儿来取回它。你可以在世界任务中使用它，来释放其中蕴藏着的法师们的力量。
Description.english: Yes, now once the crystal has been empowered, collect it here, and use it to unleash the power of our mages on a world quest.

identity.title: Essence of Fate
identity.objectives: Place a workorder for a Seal of Fate.
identity.description:
We are able to procure a valuable item to help you in our war against the Legion.  This Seal can be used at the most opportune moments to grant another chance at destiny.  

Shall we procure one for you?

Objectives.text: 下达一份命运印记订单。
Objectives.english: Place a workorder for a Seal of Fate.

Description.text:
我们可以找到一件宝物，它可以帮助你对抗燃烧军团。这个封印能在最关键的时刻给你一次改变命运的机会。

要我们帮你去找吗？
Description.english:
We are able to procure a valuable item to help you in our war against the Legion.  This Seal can be used at the most opportune moments to grant another chance at destiny.  

Shall we procure one for you?

identity.title: Court of Stars
identity.objectives: Defeat Advisor Melandrus in Court of Stars.
identity.description:
The weather is perfect for a party, isn't it?

Travel to the Court of Stars, where the Grand Magistrix herself may appear among her nobles to reassure them of the need for all the Legion patrols.

Description.text:
这样的天气最适合开派对了，不是吗？

前往群星庭院，大魔导师可能会在那里现身，试图让贵族们认同燃烧军团巡逻的必要性。
Description.english:
The weather is perfect for a party, isn't it?

Travel to the Court of Stars, where the Grand Magistrix herself may appear among her nobles to reassure them of the need for all the Legion patrols.

identity.title: To Be Prepared
identity.objectives: Visit Horde forces in Dranosh'ar Blockade.
identity.description:
Our allies have made the journey to Orgrimmar to support our war efforts.

Stop and visit with them, $n. Their assistance will secure our victory today.

Completion.text:
你看起來已經做好戰鬥的準備。到了那裡，別讓嗜血的慾望支配你。

大酋長希望在你前往戰場之前，先贈與你這枚戒指，願你能帶著無數惡魔的頭顱凱旋。
Completion.english: Luces preparado para la batalla. No dejes que la sed de sangre te domine allí.$B$BEl Jefe de Guerra quiere darte este anillo antes de que te vayas a luchar. Que regreses con las cabezas de muchos demonios.

identity.title: Goddess Watch Over You
identity.objectives: Meet Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
identity.description: I may have found a "key" to unlock Light's Heart, $n.$B$BI was going through some ancient cosmology tomes when I stumbled upon a passage indicating that the prime naaru may have been created by Elune during the great ordering of Light and Shadow.$B$BIf Elune did create Xe'ra, then it stands to reason that we could use the Tears of Elune to unlock the secrets of Light's Heart.$B$BIt's a long shot, but we've got nothing left to lose.$B$BMeet me in Dalaran. I will ready the Tears of Elune for you.

Completion.text: 如果真的成功了，說不定圖拉揚和聖光軍團還有希望。
Completion.english: Si esto funciona, puede que quede esperanza para Turalyon y el Ejército de la Luz.

identity.title: In the House of Light and Shadow
identity.objectives: Take the Tears of Elune to Light's Heart in your Order Hall.
identity.description: The Tears of Elune are ready for you, $n. I am uncertain what to do from here. Take the relic back to your order hall and try to use it on Light's Heart.$B$BMaybe make them touch? Honestly your guess is as good as mine.$B$BLet's hope this works!

Progress.text: 有消息吗？
Progress.english: Есть новости?

Completion.text: 死了？泰坦們死了？$B$B<卡德加沉思了一會。>$B$B這的確能解釋非常多事情，但我還是忍不住感到無比的哀傷。一直以來都只有我們獨自奮鬥，眾神在我們還沒出生之前就死了。$B$B至於聖光軍團和伊利丹，我感到不知所措，我從來沒感到如此無助過。$B$B伊利丹死了，而聖光軍團為了我們在群星間進行永無止盡的戰爭。$B$B我需要休息一會，$n。這消息對一個老人來說太難承受了。
Completion.english: ¿Muertos? ¿Que los titanes están muertos?$B$B<Khadgar se toma un momento para digerir la noticia.>$B$BEso explica muchas cosas, pero no puedo sino sentir una tristeza abrumadora. Llevamos solos todo el tiempo. Nuestros dioses murieron antes de que naciéramos.$B$BNo sé ni qué decir respecto a Illidan y el Ejército de la Luz. Nunca me he sentido con menos energía.$B$BIllidan ha caído y el Ejército Dorado libra en nuestro nombre una guerra sin fin por todo el cosmos.$B$BPermíteme un momento, $N. Demasiadas malas noticias para un anciano como yo.

identity.title: Awakenings
identity.objectives: Witness the Awakening of Illidan Stormrage in Val'sharah.
identity.description: Light's Heart is to serve as the vessel for Illidan Stormrage's rebirth: my last act of service to the Light.$B$BBut Illidan is dead and his soul is lost in the Nether. Before we may attempt to recover his soul, we must prepare the vessel for his return.$B$BAcross two worlds exist echoes of Illidan's past. You must venture out and find the echoes.$B$BStart where all life begins, $n: birth. Find Illidan's birthplace in Val'sharah. Awaken the memory.

Progress.text: 当我们的行动完成时，我将会迷失于黑暗虚空之中。
Progress.english: Когда наш труд будет завершен, я затеряюсь в Великой тьме.

Completion.text: 對一個悲慘的生命來說，是一個好的開始，也許是伊利丹的人生中屈指可數的幾個愉快記憶之一。雖然在那之後的數年，預言之子受到考驗，但依舊沒有使他挫敗。不論在往後在旅途中你會看到什麼，都不能忘記這點。$B$B還有許多的事情要玩成，不過時機還沒到。時機成熟時，我會呼喚你。
Completion.english: Un comienzo propicio para una vida de tragedias. Quizás sea uno de los pocos recuerdos alegres de toda la vida de Illidan. Aunque el niño de la profecía fue puesto a prueba durante los años venideros, su voluntad nunca se quebró. Debes recordar eso, a pesar de lo que puedas ver en nuestro viaje.$B$BQueda mucho por hacer, pero aún no me veo capaz. Te llamaré cuando llegue el momento.

identity.title: An Unclear Path
identity.objectives: Witness Illidan's Resilience at the Dreamgrove in Val'sharah.
identity.description: Much of Illidan's formative years were spent in Val'sharah, alongside his twin brother, Malfurion.$B$BAs young night elves, the twins vied for the affection of the young priestess, Tyrande, as they underwent the trials of the demi-god, Cenarius.$B$BWe must travel to the Dreamgrove now, where Illidan's true path would be forged.

Completion.text: 失敗，拒絕。從那一天起，伊利丹就被這兩種心魔糾纏。但他依然無所畏懼，持續尋找自己的宿命，他找到了另一條道路。
Completion.english: Fracaso. Rechazo. Desde ese día, Illidan será acechado por ambos. Siempre impávido, continuará su búsqueda por su destino. Encontrará otro camino.

identity.title: Ravencrest's Legacy
identity.objectives: Experience Ravencrest's Legacy at Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.
identity.description: Years later, as the War of the Ancients raged on and the Burning Legion's grip upon this world took hold, Illidan would meet a military leader known as Kur'talos Ravencrest. He too would see the potential within Illidan, eventually promoting him to captain of the Moon Guard: a powerful group of night elf sorcerers.$B$BWe must experience this memory in Black Rook Hold, located on the western shores of Val'sharah.

Completion.text: 正邪之间的界限并不是那么清晰，而在正邪交界的地方，人的本意并不那么重要。$B$B伊利丹不知道他周围的人为什么对燃烧军团带来的威胁视而不见，就像瞎了一样。命运之中不乏讽刺。
Completion.english: La línea entre el bien y el mal es muy fina, y se aloja en un territorio en el que las intenciones no significan gran cosa.$B$BIllidan se preguntaba cómo era posible que los que lo rodeaban estuvieran tan ciegos ante la amenaza de la Legión Ardiente. El destino siempre ha tenido su dosis de ironía.

identity.title: In My Father's House
identity.objectives: Witness Illidan's Sacrifice in Azshara on the continent of Kalimdor.
identity.description: Most mortals cannot comprehend the truth of the Legion. Those that recognize it, often refuse to accept its meaning. Such knowledge carries a weight that the mortal frame cannot bear. To sacrifice that much of ones self changes the soul.$B$BAmong your greatest heroes, a rare few understood that type of sacrifice. Let us witness it through Illidan's eyes.$B$BWe must go to Azshara, on the continent of Kalimdor.

Completion.text: 伊利丹追尋真相，眼前所見卻使他變得一意孤行。他開始認識到自己的命運，但他還必須做出最後一項犧牲。
Completion.english: Illidan buscó la verdad y fue cegado por lo que vio. Comenzó a comprender su destino, pero había un sacrificio final que aún le faltaba hacer.

identity.title: Lyana Darksorrow
identity.objectives: Destroy the Soul Harvester.
identity.description:
<Your fellow Illidari, Lyana Darksorrow, floats captive in stasis in front of you; her soul slowly draining into the harvester crystal.>

<In order to release her from stasis, you will need to destroy the soul harvester.>

Completion.text:
$n，看見你真讓人喜極而泣。謝謝你救了我。

我不知道我被困住多久…但是我感覺到附近有數量龐大的惡魔。

我在這裡還有很多事要做。要不要幫我一把？
Completion.english: $n, you are a sight for sore eyes. You have my gratitude for releasing me.$B$BI do not know how long I have been held captive... but I sense an overwhelming number of demons nearby.$B$BI have much to do here. Care to join me?

identity.title: Grimwing the Devourer
identity.objectives: Slay Grimwing the Devourer.
identity.description: You have my thanks for rescuing me from captivity, $n.$b$bHowever, Azoran is no mere demon. He is a powerful eredar who commands great rank within the Burning Legion.$b$bBefore we can get to him, there is another that must be destroyed.$b$bGrimwing the Devourer is the strongest of the felbats. Place the basilisk flesh upon the altar to the north and slay Grimwing when she appears.$b$bThen, return to me with her head. My thirst for vengeance must be quenched.

Progress.text: 你帶了什麼關於『吞噬者』恐翼的消息來？
Progress.english: What news do you bring of Grimwing the Devourer?

Completion.text:
恐翼是一隻非常可怕的惡魔…我不得不說，你的技術讓我印象深刻，$n。

要殺的惡魔多到不行。很高興能夠再跟你並肩作戰。
Completion.english: Grimwing was a formidable demon... I must say I am always impressed with your skill, $n.$B$BThere are many more demons here to kill. It is good to be at your side once more.

identity.title: Leyline Apprentice
identity.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois.
identity.description:
Good work finding those additional leyline feeds.

You seem rather competent - for an outlander.

Allow me to share with you a few secrets about the power of the leylines. This should help you in scavenging more ancient mana from the creatures around Suramar. A grisly task, I know - which is why I leave it to you!

Completion.text: 仔細聽好。
Completion.english: Escucha con atención.

identity.title: Leyline Proficiency
identity.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois.
identity.description:
Our leyline feed grows stronger.

The more powerful our feed becomes, the more I learn about ancient mana itself.

Of course, as my apprentice, you may reap the benefits of my discoveries. Listen well, and I will teach you how to extract power from your enemies more reliably.

Completion.text: 你最好一次就聽懂，我很討厭同一件事要說兩遍。
Completion.english: Procura comprenderlo todo a la primera, pues no me gusta repetir las cosas.

identity.title: Leyline Master
identity.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois.
identity.description:
You surprise me, outlander. During our first lesson about the ancient leylines, I half-expected you to be lost in daydreams of adventure, or treasure or... some such nonsense.

But you have proven an apt student.

Our leyline feed has grown extremely powerful. Watching it grow has taught me a great deal about the arcane, and the nature of mana.

I have one final lesson that will help you find even more ancient mana.

Completion.text: 也許外來者還是值得期待。
Completion.english: Tal vez haya esperanza para los forasteros, después de todo.

identity.title: Khadgar's Discovery
identity.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
identity.description: Champion! Please come to the Violet Citadel immediately.$B$BI have made a discovery that I would like to share with you before the Council of Six.

Completion.text: 謝謝你趕過來，$n。
Completion.english: Thank you for coming, $n.

identity.title: Follow the Recipe
identity.objectives: Collect the other parts of the Crown Chemical Company's recipe, then return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.
identity.description: This seems to be part of a recipe for whatever concoction the Crown Chemical Company is cooking up. The other parts must be nearby.

Objectives.text: 收集皇冠药剂公司的配方的其他部分，然后向暴风城的探员斯尼普·滑栓复命。
Objectives.english: Collect the other parts of the Crown Chemical Company's recipe, then return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.

Description.text: 皇冠药剂公司似乎正在制造某种合剂，而这就是其中一部分配方。其他部分应该就在附近。
Description.english: This seems to be part of a recipe for whatever concoction the Crown Chemical Company is cooking up. The other parts must be nearby.

identity.title: Seed of Hope
identity.objectives: Reach Honored with The Nightfallen.
identity.description: Thalyssra was wise to send you in search of the arcan'dor, though she underestimates its power.$B$BShe will learn - as will the others.$B$BBut it will take time. And with hunger gnawing at their very souls, the Nightfallen will need your help to survive.

Progress.text: 阿坎多尔需要时间。
Progress.english: Аркан'дору нужно время.

Completion.text: 在季節嬗變之際，真相將會浮現。
Completion.english: Con el cambio de estación se sabrá la verdad.

identity.title: Redemption for the Fallen
identity.objectives: Reach Exalted with The Nightfallen.
identity.description: Soon the change of seasons will be upon us, and the Nightfallen will take command of their fate.$B$BYou have given them hope, and set them on the path to redemption. They need you now more than ever.$B$BWe all do.

Completion.text:
終於，我們失落已久的同胞總算能重回這個世界了。精靈的歸屬，是燦爛的星空，而非虛假的幻象。

感謝你，$n。
Completion.english: Por fin mis hermanos perdidos hace tanto tiempo pueden volver a este mundo. Los elfos deben estar bajo un cielo estrellado, no bajo uno conjurado.$B$BGracias, $N.

identity.title: We'll Need Some Obliterum
identity.objectives: Find Camille Kleister in the Magus Commerce Exchange district of Dalaran.
identity.description:
Loramus Thalipedes has offered to improve our armaments. He says that he pried a secret out of Razelikh. Apparently, the demon knows how to work a material known as Obliterum.

I myself have coerced some information out of the demons. One of the souls trapped in my scythe has whispered the name, Camille Kleister. All I know is that she is somewhere in Dalaran. For the rest, you are on your own.

Objectives.text: 在达拉然的魔法商业区找到卡米勒·克雷斯特。
Objectives.english: Find Camille Kleister in the Magus Commerce Exchange district of Dalaran.

Description.text:
洛拉姆斯·萨里比迪斯主动提出要帮我们强化装备。他说自己从拉瑟莱克嘴里撬出了一些秘密。看来，那个恶魔懂得如何加工一种名叫抑魔金的材料。

我自己也从恶魔那里拷问出了一些消息。我的镰刀中囚禁的一个恶魔灵魂提到过“卡米勒·克雷斯特”这个名字。我只知道她就在达拉然的某处。其他的，就得靠你自己了。
Description.english:
Loramus Thalipedes has offered to improve our armaments. He says that he pried a secret out of Razelikh. Apparently, the demon knows how to work a material known as Obliterum.

I myself have coerced some information out of the demons. One of the souls trapped in my scythe has whispered the name, Camille Kleister. All I know is that she is somewhere in Dalaran. For the rest, you are on your own.

identity.title: In the Blink of an Eye
identity.objectives: Witness the teleportation of Dalaran to the Broken Isles.
identity.description: <The entity speaks with the familiar voice of Archmage Khadgar.>$b$bAzeroth needs you, $n!$B$BAfter scouring Ulduar and Karazhan for answers, we know the key to defeating the Legion: five ancient artifacts called the Pillars of Creation.$b$bTo find them, Dalaran must be moved to the Broken Isles. As our leader Jaina is... absent, Kalecgos of the blue dragonflight has offered the Kirin Tor his aid.$b$bThe Legion is assaulting our current position over Deadwind Pass. Hurry!

Completion.text:
啊，$n，很高興看到你安然無恙！六法議會的成員正從施法後的虛弱逐漸恢復。

高強度的傳送法術可能會使人頭暈目眩，你剛剛雖然暫時失去意識，但至少醒來的時候沒發現自己卡在牆壁裡！

達拉然已經移動到破碎群島。從現在開始，我們會傾全力取得創世之柱，將燃燒軍團永遠逐出艾澤拉斯！
Completion.english: ¡Ah, $N, me alegra verte en pie! Los miembros del Consejo de los Seis se están recuperando de su terrible experiencia.$B$BLa intensidad del hechizo de teletransporte puede desorientar. Parece que perdiste la consciencia durante un rato, ¡pero al menos no te despertaste espachurrado en una pared!$B$BDalaran ha sido trasladada a las Islas Abruptas. ¡Desde aquí encabezaremos los esfuerzos para conseguir los Pilares de la Creación y expulsar a la Legión de Azeroth de una vez por todas!

identity.title: Ancient Mana
identity.objectives: Gather from $1oa Ancient Mana nodes.
identity.description: Without the Nightwell to feed upon, my comrades and I will have to live off the land itself.$B$BAncient mana from the underground leylines can reach the surface in many forms, most commonly as crystals or gems.$B$B<Thalyssra picks up a small stone and, whispering words of power, traces a rune upon it with her fingertip.>$B$BThis stone will glow when ancient mana is nearby. Please gather as much as possible! It will be a precious resource in the weeks to come.

Completion.text: 隨時注意蘇拉瑪爾四處有沒有出現這類結晶。我們一定用得上。
Completion.english: Mantente alerta por si ver esas formaciones de cristal en Suramar. Nos harán falta.

identity.title: Hungry Work
identity.objectives: Use Ancient Mana to feed Chief Telemancer Oculeth.
identity.description: We must get Chief Telemancer Oculeth back on his feet as soon as possible.$B$BFind ancient mana, any way you can, and feed it to him.

Progress.text: <欧库勒斯克制不住地颤抖起来。>
Progress.english: <Окулета всего трясет.>

Completion.text:
啊，這樣感覺好多了。謝謝你！

開始上工吧。
Completion.english: Ah, me siento mucho mejor. ¡Gracias!$B$BAhora, a trabajar.

identity.title: Disillusioned Defector
identity.objectives: Meet Silgryn at Evermoon Terrace.
identity.description:
The atmosphere in the city has improved little, but we may find this to our advantage today.

Silgryn asks for you at the Terrace. It seems even Elisande's forces are fleeing before her insanity.

A defector has risen from the ranks and seeks to join our cause.

See that this individual is well received, $n. We need all the friends we can get during these dark times.

Completion.text: 很高興你趕到了。
Completion.english: Me alegro de que lo hayas conseguido.

identity.title: More Like Me
identity.objectives: Use the Dusk Lily Sigil on Duskwatch Subjugators to identify 5 Deserters.
identity.description: Greetings, Outlander.$b$bI am Victoire. I served Elisande while she maintained peace in the city. I fought beside demons and worse for the greater good.$b$bThe massacre at the Waning Crescent made it clear that she no longer serves the Nightborne. She serves only herself.$b$bThere are others who feel as I do. They simply need proof that there is another way.$b$bThe Dusk Lily is not unknown to us- try showing it to those now guarding Astravar Harbor. They have seen the worst of Elisande's cruelty.

Completion.text:
希望會有更多人跟隨他們。

感謝你讓他們知道，要為夜裔效力還有其他的選擇。
Completion.english: Con suerte serán más los que sigan su ejemplo.$B$BGracias por enseñarles que existe otro modo de servir a los Nocheterna.

identity.title: Missing Persons
identity.objectives: Acquire a Legion Communicator from demons in Astravar Harbor.
identity.description: Our new friend brings us some disturbing information.$b$bShe claims to have seen a large number of citizens dragged from Starcaller Retreat in chains. Their destination appears to be Astravar Harbor.$b$bThose taken to the harbor have yet to return, however. Worse yet, the area is now overrun with demons.$b$bI need you to find out where these people went. Infiltrate the harbor and gather any information you can.$b$bStart with the Legion filth- their corpses may point us in the right direction.

Progress.text: 你找到那些俘虜的下落了嗎？
Progress.english: ¿Has descubierto el paradero de los cautivos?

Completion.text: <西爾格臨一臉嚴肅地看著通訊器。>
Completion.english: <Silgryn mira con aire sombrío al comunicador.>

identity.title: Hostage Situation
identity.objectives: Go to Astravar Harbor and join a group of captives being taken to Felsoul Hold.
identity.description: Our own people, sacrificed to the Legion!$b$bWe need to intercept a transport if we intend to put an end to this trade. I'm afraid this does mean you will be playing the part of a captive, my friend.$b$bBefore voicing your concerns, try to have a little faith.$b$bWe will follow behind in one of Deline's boats and break you out once we know where they are going.$b$bGo to the harbor and find a group of captives. Stand among them. Allow yourself to be taken.$b$bWe will not be far.

Completion.text: 感謝你願意冒這個險。我們現在就來做個了結吧！
Completion.english: Gracias por asumir semejante riesgo. ¡Acabemos con esto de una vez!

identity.title: In the Business of Souls
identity.objectives: Slay Aargoss in Felsoul Advance.
identity.description: We will hold our position here while you find and slay the demon responsible for this camp.$b$bEnding Aargoss will not permanently stop this smuggling operation, but it may slow them down long enough for us to find another way to help these people.$b$bGo quickly. He is somewhere atop this ridge.

Completion.text: 做得好。在他們把援軍找來之前我們趕快離開吧。
Completion.english: Buen trabajo. Vayámonos antes de que envíen refuerzos.

identity.title: Smuggled!
identity.objectives: Release Maribeth and 5 captives in Felsoul Advance.
identity.description: Please get me out of here!$b$bThe bars are brittle but I am so weak...$b$bThe others! There are so many others! Please help us!

Completion.text: 謝謝你。在你來之前，我們完全沒有獲救的希望。
Completion.english: Gracias. Habíamos perdido la esperanza hasta que llegaste.

identity.title: Tavernkeeper's Fate
identity.objectives: Follow Thalyssra to the Lunastre Estate and learn of Vanthir's fate.
identity.description: I have finished unraveling Ly'leth's message.$b$bI want you to come with me to her estate. It is long past time I returned to the city.

Completion.text: 我們必須立刻採取行動！
Completion.english: ¡Debemos actuar inmediatamente!

identity.title: Tyrande's Command
identity.objectives: Speak with Tyrande Whisperwind in Meredil.
identity.description: Shal'aran is bursting at the seams with refugees and rebels. We practically have an army now but not enough weapons or mana to keep everyone armed and un-withered.$b$bAnd in all of this, Tyrande has a battery of requests I simply do not have the time to deal with.$b$bWill you go to her? Her growing army is hard to miss in Meredil.

Completion.text: 夜落精靈堅持要參與這場戰鬥。我們的人手應付不了所有的工作。
Completion.english: El Caído de la Noche insistió en ser parte del conflicto. No tenemos suficiente gente para todo el trabajo.

identity.title: Essence Triangulation
identity.objectives: Help Thalyssra collect 3 of Vanthir's Arcane Essences.
identity.description: Vanthir... an example! That certainly explains why Elisande chose to hold him this long.$b$bWe need to move quickly. I can track him, but I will need to find places where his Arcane Essence is strongest.$b$bThis will not be an easy feat, not in a city this old, but with any luck there are a few places important enough to him that he left a little bit of himself behind.$b$bWe should start in the promenade- he often visited it for business.

Completion.text: 現在只需要全神貫注在他的精華上，然後分析出他的所在位置。你做得很好。
Completion.english: Ahora debemos concentrarnos en su esencia para identificar su paradero. Bien hecho.

identity.title: On Public Display
identity.objectives: Help Thalyssra complete the Scrying Ritual.
identity.description: Now that I have identified Vanthir's essence from the multitude of Suramar's citizens, it may be that I can find his exact location.$b$bI believe you'll recall a similar ritual with our friend Theryn. Do not worry- there will be less screaming this time. Hopefully.$b$bCome. Let us find our missing tavernkeeper.

Completion.text: 真是…不容易…但我很高興我們成功了。
Completion.english: No ha sido... fácil... Pero me alegro de que haya funcionado.

identity.title: Waxing Crescent
identity.objectives: Rescue Vanthir and give him an Arcan'dor fruit.
identity.description: His captor is familiar to me. He is one of Aluriel's lieutenants and a skilled spell-fencer at that. You will need Silgryn's help to retrieve the key to Vanthir's prison.$b$bOur friend's life hangs in the balance. Even if we manage to wrestle him from the executioner's grasp, he may well Wither before we can act.$b$bI need you to take an Arcan'dor fruit to him. They are precious, and few, but for Vanthir this is the only chance he has.$b$bGo quickly, and good luck.

Progress.text: <凡席爾劇烈顫抖，眼神空洞地盯著前方。他似乎沒有察覺到你在這裡。>
Progress.english: <Vanthir se estremece violentamente, con la mirada perdida al frente. No parece percatarse de tu presencia.>

Completion.text: <凡席爾的雙手猛然伸出，從你的手裡搶走果實。>
Completion.english: <La mano de Vanthir sale disparada para arrebatarte la fruta.>

identity.title: Sign of the Dusk Lily
identity.objectives: Place a Dusk Lily Sigil above Vanthir's Cage.
identity.description: Simply... astounding.$b$bI have not felt this clear of mind in so long.$b$bI am still weak... I need to rest. But first...$b$b<Vanthir gestures to the top of his cage with a trembling hand.>$b$bShow them that the Dusk Lily triumphs this day.

Completion.text:
下次有雞會，我一定確保他得到妥善的照顧。我們今天大有斬獲，$n。

艾莉珊德一定會記住，我們不會輕易丟下自己人。
Completion.english: En cuanto pueda, me encargaré de que esté cómodo. Hoy hemos dado un gran paso adelante, $N.$B$BElisande tardará en olvidar que nosotros nunca abandonamos a los nuestros.

identity.title: Trial by Demonfire
identity.objectives: Slay Rozzeleth in Meredil.
identity.description:
We are out of time. I have reports that a pitlord has come to Meredil. 

I have dispatched a strike force. We cannot let this demon flank our army here, nor can we let him find Shal'Aran. It is time to temper these recruits in a real battle.

Join our forces in Meredil, engage the demon, and help us ensure this new army of ours is not lost in its first conflict.

Completion.text: 做得好。有時候一場簡單的勝利就能把軍隊團結起來。接下來，這些新兵就會開始訓練其他人，我們軍隊的規模就會越來越大。
Completion.english: Bien hecho. A veces, una sola victoria es suficiente para unir a un ejército. Con el tiempo estos reclutas entrenarán a otros y podremos hacer que nuestra armada sea aún mayor.

identity.title: Waning Refuge
identity.objectives: Leave Felsoul Advance on Deline's Gondola.
identity.description: We have done all we can here.$b$bLet us get everyone into the boat and get out while we still can.$b$bWe have bought time for the others but nothing more.

Completion.text: 感謝你的勇氣，這些人的命都是你救的。他們不會忘記我們為此所冒的風險。
Completion.english: Estas personas viven gracias a tu valentía. Jamás olvidarán los riesgos que corrimos por ellas.

identity.title: Citizens' Army
identity.objectives: Defeat $1oa of Ravencrest's forces at Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.
identity.description: I can barely get these civilians to stand in a straight line.$b$bThey are untrained, undisciplined, and underarmed.$b$bStill, they need to be ready for the real battle.$b$BKhadgar suggested we try some field training at the ruins of Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah. The risen forces of Lord Ravencrest apparently remember how to fight.$b$bGo, hero, and I will send some trainees to support you.

Completion.text:
你協助的受訓員一直在讚美你的戰鬥技巧。他們已經開始把自身所學教給其他人了。

我很感激你在這方面的幫忙。
Completion.english: Los aprendices a los que ayudaste no dejan de hablar de tu destreza en el combate. Ya están transmitiendo lo que les enseñaste.$B$BAgradezco tu ayuda con esto.

identity.title: We Need Weapons
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Weapon Caches at Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.
identity.description: So many of the rebels want to help in the coming battle. Our people have the will, they lack only the means.$b$bThey need weapons.$b$bFrom what Khadgar has told me, the fortress of Black Rook has plenty of munitions we could use.$b$bTravel to the fortress and place these beacons on some weapon caches there. Once placed, I can teleport them back.

Completion.text: 這些武器應該會在接下來的戰鬥中派上很大的用場。做得好啊，英雄。
Completion.english: Estas armas serán muy útiles en el conflicto que se avecina. Bien hecho, héroe.

identity.title: Learning From the Dead
identity.objectives: Recover $1oa Books of Tactics from Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah.
identity.description: I heard you were traveling to Black Rook Hold.$b$bIt was once home to the legendary Lord Ravencrest, a brilliant tactician. His knowledge may be exactly what we need to give us an edge against the Duskwatch.$b$bWhile you are at the Rook, keep your eyes peeled for any books that might have survived the ages that outline the Ravencrest's strategems.

Progress.text: 你找得怎麼樣了？
Progress.english: ¿Cómo va la búsqueda?

Completion.text: 好極了。這些書籍裡的知識對我們之後的作戰應該大有幫助。
Completion.english: Excelente, los conocimientos contenidos en estos libros serán de mucha utilidad en los días que se avecinan.

identity.title: Taking a Promenade
identity.objectives: Locate the scouts in the Promenade.
identity.description: These people are foreign to us, despite our common heritage. They have changed much in the years they have been cloistered away.$b$bWe need to learn more about them, what they are capable of. We dispatched one of our scouts to infiltrate the Promenade and assess the defenses. The blood elves did the same, although I doubt their ability to be discreet.$b$bBoth are long past due for reporting back to us. Find them and make sure they are safe or at least did not die in vain.

Completion.text: 很高興知道他們還活著。他們的情報會在接下來的行動中派上很大的用場。
Completion.english: Es bueno saber que siguen vivos. Su conocimiento será valioso en el asedio que se avecina.

identity.title: Shield, Meet Spell
identity.objectives: Use the Arcane Nullifier to defeat Arcshaper Thorendis.
identity.description: There you have it, one arcane nullifier! Using their weapon and magical signatures to cloak the spell, it should tear apart the shield as good as any spellbreaker would.$b$bGo teach that amateur spellslinger what it means to wage war against the sin'dorei!

Completion.text: 很好。解決他之後，等我們部隊的主力抵達，就能建立更穩固的據點。
Completion.english: Bien. Con él fuera del camino, podremos establecer una base más fuerte cuando llegue la fuerza principal.

identity.title: Break An Arm
identity.objectives: Defeat the Arm of the Magistrix.
identity.description: The insurgents you marshaled gave me some bad news, $n.$b$bThe arcanists loyal to Elisande have reactivated the Arm of the Magistrix. The most powerful construct ever attempted, it raged out of control and decimated an entire district before it was disabled. Truly they must be desperate to turn it against us.$b$bThe scouts have spotted it in the Crimson Thicket to the north. We cannot allow it to reach full power if we are to succeed.

Completion.text: 我們差點在入侵行動開始之前就失敗了。做得好。
Completion.english: Casi perdemos la invasión antes de comenzar. Buen trabajo.

identity.title: Trolling Them
identity.objectives: Remove insulting items from the elven war camps.
identity.description: My army is disciplined, and they will follow my order not to engage the Sin'dorei in combat unless I give the command.$b$bHowever, it is with some level of shame that I must admit both armies have been attempting to harass the other with pranks, littering our respective camps with insults.$b$bPlease, $p, we need someone both armies respect to collect these items before fighting breaks out.

Completion.text: 謝謝你，$n。希望我們的部隊看到你完成這件事以後會恢復理智，並停止這種騷擾行為。
Completion.english: Gracias, $N. Esperemos que nuestras fuerzas, tras verte realizar esta tarea, recapaciten y acaben con este hostigamiento.

identity.title: Trolling Them
identity.objectives: Remove insulting items from the elven war camps.
identity.description: My army is disciplined, and they will follow my order not to engage the kaldorei in combat unless I give the command.$b$bHowever, it is with some level of shame that I must admit both armies have been attempting to harass the other with pranks, littering our respective camps with insults.$b$bPlease, $p, we need someone both armies respect to collect these items before fighting breaks out.

Completion.text: 謝謝你，$n。希望我們的部隊看到你完成這件事以後會恢復理智，並停止這種騷擾行為。
Completion.english: Gracias, $N. Con suerte, ahora que nuestras fuerzas te han visto realizar esta tarea, entrarán en razón y cesará este hostigamiento.

identity.title: Arming the Rebels
identity.objectives: Speak with Victoire in Meredil.
identity.description: The Nightfallen rebellion is growing in number, but they have not fought a real war in ages.$b$bVictoire and Silgryn are doing their best to train the new arrivals, but could use an experienced hand.$b$bGo to them and show them some of the skills in battle you have picked up in your travels. I want those Nightfallen ready for battle when the time comes.

Completion.text: 暮衛部隊的每個成員都花了好幾百年磨練戰鬥技巧。我們可沒有這種時間訓練這些反抗軍。
Completion.english: Cada miembro de la Guardia Umbría tuvo siglos para perfeccionar sus técnicas de lucha. Sin embargo, nosotros no tenemos tanto tiempo para dejar a estos rebeldes aptos para el combate.

identity.title: Arming the Rebels
identity.objectives: Speak with Victoire in Meredil.
identity.description: The Nightfallen rebellion is growing in number, but they have not fought a real war in ages.$b$bVictoire and Silgryn are doing their best to train the new arrivals and could use an experienced hand.$b$bGo to them and show them some of the skills in battle you have picked up in your travels. We need those Nightfallen ready for battle when the time comes.

Completion.text: 暮衛部隊的每個成員都花了好幾百年磨練戰鬥技巧。我們可沒有這種時間訓練這些反抗軍。
Completion.english: Cada miembro de la Vigía del ocaso ha tenido siglos para perfeccionar sus técnicas de lucha. No tenemos tanto tiempo para dejar a estos rebeldes en condiciones de luchar.

identity.title: Mouths to Feed
identity.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois in Shal'Aran.
identity.description: We have rescued many refugees, as you can see. Unfortunately this has revealed a new problem.$b$bThe arcan'dor fruit is our salvation, but it does not bear enough fruit right now to cure everyone. We must rely on mana a little longer to tide the refugees over.$b$bValtrois thinks that she may have a solution. Please go speak with her and see what she plans to do.

Completion.text: 很高興看到你來。我正好需要幫手。
Completion.english: Me alegro de verte. Necesito ayuda.

identity.title: Oculeth Ex Machina
identity.objectives: Speak with Oculeth and teleport to Azsuna.
identity.description: I have a plan to feed Shal'Aran.$b$bNow that I am no longer starving for mana I have had time to study ley lines in new regions. I detected an eddy of mana in the ley lines of Azsuna. I have plenty of magic at my disposal, but we must visit the ley line in person in order to properly redirect the energy to Shal'Aran.$b$bOculeth has graciously offered to teleport us there, but I could use an assistant. Care to join me?

Completion.text: 我有點嚇到。有時候我覺得歐庫雷斯也不知道自己在做什麼。
Completion.english: Eso sí que dio miedo. A veces no tengo claro si Oculeth sabe lo que hace.

identity.title: Unbeleyvable
identity.objectives: Assist Arcanist Valtrois with placing ley line taps.
identity.description: Back to the task at hand!$b$bTake these ley line taps. We can use the resonant energies to properly redirect the flow, but they must be placed in precise locations. I will show you where.$b$bYour friend has agreed to... "supervise" us. Let us hope she just stays out of the way while the professionals take care of this.

Completion.text: 真是讓人生氣。好吧，至少她與生俱來的能力和我預估的差不多…
Completion.english: Eso me enfadó más de lo que debería. Al menos sus talentos naturales estuvieron a la par de mis cálculos...

identity.title: The Art of Flow
identity.objectives: Protect Arcanist Valtrois while she completes the ritual.
identity.description: All done, $n! We have but one more step and Shal'Aran will have all the mana it needs.$b$bNow that I have better access to the ley line below I can break the pool so that it will flow through properly. Given the chaotic state of this ley line it will require all of my concentration to redirect the energy.$b$bI must warn you that we will attract attention while I am doing this. You will need to protect me while I complete the process.$b$bSpeak to me when you are ready.

Completion.text: 完成了。沙亞蘭以後再也不缺法力了。
Completion.english: Hecho. Shal'aran ya no volverá a necesitar maná.

identity.title: A Dance With Dragons
identity.objectives: Speak with Stellagosa to ride back to Shal'Aran.
identity.description: I must say I am impressed, $n.$b$bYou and your friend were able to fix a ley line, and you are not even dragons!$b$bYou both seem exhausted by this ordeal. Allow me to help you get back home.

Completion.text: 真是一場精采的冒險。我們現在總算有足夠的法力提供給難民了。謝謝你，$n。
Completion.english: Vaya aventura tuviste. Afortunadamente, ahora tenemos mucho maná para los refugiados. Gracias, $N.

identity.title: Unwanted Evidence
identity.objectives: Bring the Fel Crystal Fragment to Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
identity.description: <You find a shattered remnant of fel crystal clutched in Skovald's hand, still glowing with demonic power.$b$bIt seems the god-king didn't want it found. Did the crystal contain the message sent to him by Gul'dan?$b$bIf anyone can glean the meaning of the broken crystal, it's Khadgar.>

Progress.text: 你好，$n。$B$B你截获了古尔丹给斯科瓦尔德的信息了吗？
Progress.english: Saludos, $N.$B$B¿Has logrado interceptar el mensaje de Gul'dan a Skovald?

Completion.text: 你觉得斯科瓦尔德不希望你发现这颗水晶，是吗？我来瞧瞧。$B$B<卡德加眯着眼睛检查邪能水晶碎片，寻找其中流淌的能量痕迹。>$B$B我见过这种水晶，它们是用来传达燃烧军团最高阶指挥官的命令的。$B$B这可不妙。
Completion.english: Crees que Skovald no quería que encontraras este cristal, ¿eh? Deja que le eche un vistazo.$B$B<Khadgar mira detenidamente el fragmento de cristal vil, pasando los dedos por las líneas de poder que lo recorren.>$B$BYa había visto antes este tipo de cristal. Se usa para transmitir órdenes que proceden de los rangos más altos de la Legión.$B$BMal asunto.

identity.title: Something's Not Quite Right...
identity.objectives: Remove the disguise of 5 Nightborne Infiltrators.
identity.description: Something is troubling me, champion.$b$bBeyond these simple japes, the Kirin Tor has had to break up a few fights between the elves. I am worried something - or someone - might be influencing them.$b$bYour disguise was made by the nightborne, yes? It is not unreasonable to assume they can do something similar.$b$bFortunately, Thalyssra has told me much about how the illusion works, and I believe this crystal can remove their disguise.$b$bWhy don't you check the camps, just to be safe?

Completion.text: 就跟我所擔憂的一樣。希望他們現在不敢再派間諜出來了。
Completion.english: Es como temía. Esperemos que se lo piensen dos veces antes de enviar más espías.

identity.title: Visitor in Shal'Aran
identity.objectives: Meet the stranger outside Shal'Aran.
identity.description: Someone came to Shal'Aran while you were in the City. She asked for you specifically.$b$bI did not recognize her face, nor her voice, but she seemed trustworthy and earnest.$b$bShe is just outside the cavern. Meet with her and determine her purpose for coming here.

Completion.text:
她看起來不錯。奧肯多爾果實對我們的同胞來說確實是奇蹟。

在接下來的戰鬥中，她會是不錯的盟友。西爾格臨會好好照顧她的。
Completion.english: Tenía buen aspecto. El Arcan'dor es un verdadero milagro para nuestra gente.$B$BY ella es una valiosa aliada para lo que se avecina. Silgryn la cuidará bien.

identity.title: The Call of Battle
identity.description:
These demons have no honor! Rather than meet us in glorious, open-battle; they hide behind their barricades and siege weapons.

The Valarjar have come for the glory of battle and we will not be turned away by cowardly tactics!

Destroy their cannons and bring down their barriers, so that our valiant Valarjar may face them in the true spirit of battle! When the dust of battle clears, the corpses of demons shall litter the ground... and the Valarjar will stand triumphant!

Description.text:
这些恶魔毫无荣誉感可言！他们不愿意与我们光明正大地交战，而是躲在路障和攻城武器后面。

瓦拉加尔是来追求战斗的荣耀的，我们不能容忍这些懦夫的伎俩！

摧毁他们的火炮，打垮他们的屏障，让我们英勇的瓦拉加尔教教他们什么才是真正的战斗精神！当硝烟散去时，恶魔的尸体会铺满战场……而瓦拉加尔会傲然挺立，迎接胜利！
Description.english:
These demons have no honor! Rather than meet us in glorious, open-battle; they hide behind their barricades and siege weapons.

The Valarjar have come for the glory of battle and we will not be turned away by cowardly tactics!

Destroy their cannons and bring down their barriers, so that our valiant Valarjar may face them in the true spirit of battle! When the dust of battle clears, the corpses of demons shall litter the ground... and the Valarjar will stand triumphant!

identity.title: Noressa
identity.objectives: Rescue Noressa.
identity.description: She is still in there, $n. Noressa, my wife.$b$bShe is in the Promenade while we wait outside, preparing to strike. Who knows what has happened to her?$b$bPlease, friend, I fear the worst. Tell her there is hope outside.$b$bWe had a small house in the south of the Grand Promenade, by the water gardens. She will probably be there during this madness.

Completion.text: 我實在無法表達對你的感激。我們會再度重逢的，我會確保我們再也不分開。
Completion.english: No tengo palabras para agradecértelo. Nos reuniremos y jamás volveremos a separarnos.

identity.title: Unlikely Seduction
identity.objectives: Defeat Agatha.
identity.description:
Mo... Modera sent you?

No...  you must... leave!  Agatha will be back any moment!

Save... yourself...

Progress.text: 快……逃命吧……
Progress.english: Hurry... Run for your life...

identity.title: The Hunt for Illidan Stormrage
identity.objectives: Seek out Allari the Souleater at Illidari Stand in Azsuna.
identity.description: Allari the Souleater, an oracle of the Illidari, has been on the hunt for Illidan's soul for quite some time. She now believes that she has discovered its location and requires your assistance in its recovery.$B$BFind Allari at Illidari Stand in Azsuna and aid her in any way possible.$B$BIf Sargeras truly plans to use Illidan's body as a vessel for his own return then returning Illidan's soul to his body is integral in preventing the dark titan from returning to our world!

Completion.text: 那魯聽到我的呼喚了？有意思…$B$B很好，我們就開始著手進行吧。我們終於找到伊利丹的靈魂了，所在位置出人意料之外。
Completion.english: ¿Los naaru oyeron mi llamada? Interesante...$B$BDe acuerdo, manos a la obra. Hemos encontrado, por fin, el alma de Illidan. Y no está donde suponíamos que estaría.

identity.title: Soul Prism of the Illidari
identity.objectives: Claim 40 Lingering Soul Fragments from the final bosses of Legion dungeons.$B$BHigher difficulty dungeons provide a greater chance and quantity of Lingering Soul Fragments.
identity.description: Alas, I will not burden you with the location of the master's soul just yet, $n. First we must craft a soul prism powerful enough to hold the master's boundless chaotic energies.$B$BTo do this I require lingering soul fragments from powerful beings found across this world. Bring me enough and I will craft a soul prism capable of holding the soul of the master - at least long enough to transfer into the naaru.

Completion.text: 伊利達瑞的靈魂稜石可以使用了。$B$B有人將伊利丹的靈魂從虛空之中抽離…或者是說竊取…然後帶往冥界了。在一個叫做黑爾海姆的地方。
Completion.english: El prisma de almas de los Illidari ya se puede usar.$B$BEl alma de Illidan fue arrancada, o más bien robada, del Vacío y conducida al inframundo. A un lugar llamado Helheim.

identity.title: Trial of Valor: The Once and Future Lord of Shadows
identity.objectives: Defeat Helya in the Trials of Valor raid and then use the Soul Prism of the Illidari to claim Illidan's Soul.
identity.description: While tracking the master's physical body proved challenging, we were able to locate it in the Nighthold of Suramar. Our intelligence reports that Gul'dan is making final preparations to the Nightwell in order to use its power to usher the soul of Sargeras into Illidan's body.$B$BThe only way to stop that from happening is to put Illidan's own immortal soul back.$B$BTake the Soul Prism of the Illidari and venture to Helheim. Defeat Helya and use the prism on Illidan's soul! Return it to Light's Heart.

Completion.text: <聖光之心發出耀眼的光芒，似乎在吞噬靈魂稜石。>
Completion.english: <El Corazón de la Luz brilla con fuerza y parece consumir el prisma de almas.>

identity.title: Runes of Rending
identity.objectives: Bypass the wards in Felbreach Hollow and confront Raest Magespear.
identity.description:
My brother and his cultists are engaged in some kind of ritual at the far end of the cave. I tried to intervene, but my brother has left magical wards to block the way.

If you can find a way past them, we may be able to stop him in time!

Progress.text: 我们不能再犹豫了！
Progress.english: We can no longer hesitate!

identity.title: One Day at a Time
identity.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
identity.description:
Thank you for coming, outlander. It is good to see you again.

I have a situation in the city that needs your attention, but first... 

Let us talk of hope.

<Thalyssra gestures toward the arcan'dor.>

The fruit of the arcan'dor can truly free my people from the Nightwell. However, it only grows so fast. It will take time to distribute this cure.

I think it only right that you help me pass out the fruit as it is ready. Please take this, and give it to anyone.

Completion.text:
等有更多果實成熟時，我會再度請你幫忙。

現在，我們需要討論令人不安的消息。
Completion.english: Te volveré a pedir lo mismo cuando haya más frutas listas.$B$BPero ahora tenemos que hablar de unas noticias inquietantes.

identity.title: Continuing the Cure
identity.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
identity.description:
Given the events at the Waning Crescent, the refugees here are more eager than ever to receive the gift of the arcan'dor and be free of the Nightwell forever. 

Fortunately, the tree has borne more fruit. Again, I ask that you honor us by giving this fruit to anyone here in Shal'Aran.

When you are finished, we shall discuss further developments within the city. Silgryn reports that Arluelle has proven a fine student, and the two are making progress in evacuating citizens.

Completion.text: 嗯，現在我們可以專心解救還在城裡受苦的居民了。
Completion.english: Bien, ahora centrémonos en quienes aún sufren dentro de la ciudad.

identity.title: A Message From Ly'leth
identity.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
identity.description:
The arcan'dor bears fruit once again. Just in time, too - Ly'leth has sent us a message, and it seems she may have a lead on Vanthir. He is long overdue for this gift, assuming we manage to find him.

Give a fruit to another citizen here in Shal'Aran while I finish decrypting Ly'leth's message.

Completion.text: 就在那裡。希望黎利斯給的是好消息…
Completion.english: Listo. Espero que las noticias de Ly'leth sean buenas...

identity.title: Eating Before the Meeting
identity.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
identity.description:
Having Vanthir around has done much to lift the spirits of the people here. I dare say some have begun to relish their newfound freedom, even if they miss their beloved city.

I will not rest until I can give it back to them.

You and I have an important meeting to attend. Before we go, let us distribute more of the arcan'dor's fruit. 

I want people to know that although I must leave for now, I have not abandoned them.

Completion.text: 嗯，我們走吧。
Completion.english: Muy bien, partamos.

identity.title: Feeding the Rebellion
identity.objectives: Feed the Fruit of the Arcan'dor to a Suramar Refugee in Shal'Aran.
identity.description:
More nightborne flee Suramar every day to join our cause.

Our ranks are swelling, and with the aid of great heroes like yourself and the armies of the Horde and Alliance, our chances have never been better.

Help me hand out more fruit of the arcan'dor - each one is a life free from slavish dependence on the Nightwell!

Afterwards, we shall speak on how best to assist our new allies in their siege.

Completion.text: 很好。我們現在就前往戰爭前線，了解情況。
Completion.english: Bien. Vayamos a lo nuestro en el frente de batalla.

identity.title: Insurrection: An Elven Problem
identity.objectives: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
identity.description: The Alliance and Horde have arrived in Suramar. First Arcanist Thalyssra needs your help in providing an introduction.$b$bMeet with Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.

Objectives.text: 前往沙尔艾兰找首席奥术师塔莉萨。
Objectives.english: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.

Description.text: 联盟和部落来到了苏拉玛。首席奥术师塔莉萨需要你帮忙引见。$b$b快去沙尔艾兰找塔莉萨吧。
Description.english: The Alliance and Horde have arrived in Suramar. First Arcanist Thalyssra needs your help in providing an introduction.$b$bMeet with Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.

identity.title: Insurrection: As Strong As Our Will
identity.objectives: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
identity.description: In the wake of Elisande's attack, the need is stronger than ever to add to the ranks of the Nightfallen rebellion.$b$bPlans are in motion that may help with this in an unconventional way.$b$BReport to First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran for more details.

Title.english: Insurrection: As Strong As Our Will

Objectives.text: 前往沙尔艾兰找首席奥术师塔莉萨。
Objectives.english: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.

Description.text: 艾利桑德出击后，堕夜精灵起义军急需扩充军力。$b$b目前的计划可能有用，但并不是长久之计。$b$b向沙尔艾兰的首席奥术师塔莉萨报到，了解更多细节。
Description.english: In the wake of Elisande's attack, the need is stronger than ever to add to the ranks of the Nightfallen rebellion.$b$bPlans are in motion that may help with this in an unconventional way.$b$BReport to First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran for more details.

identity.title: Insurrection: Breaking the Nighthold
identity.objectives: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.
identity.description: First Arcanist Thalyssra sends word that her forces are ready. It is time for you to lead the attack against the Nighthold.$b$bReport to Shal'Aran in Suramar for details.

Objectives.text: 前往沙尔艾兰找首席奥术师塔莉萨。
Objectives.english: Meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.

Description.text: 首席奥术师塔莉萨发来消息说，她的军队已经准备好了。是时候让你带队进攻暗夜要塞了。$b$b快去苏拉玛的沙尔艾兰报到，了解详情吧。
Description.english: First Arcanist Thalyssra sends word that her forces are ready. It is time for you to lead the attack against the Nighthold.$b$bReport to Shal'Aran in Suramar for details.

identity.title: Stabilizing Suramar
identity.objectives: Complete 10 world quests in Suramar.
identity.description:
Elisande's plan has backfired. She thought to stamp out our rebellion by making an example of the Waning Crescent. 

Instead, she ignited the flame of the shal'dorei better than I ever could.

We must maintain a cohesive campaign against Elisande and the Legion by fighting them in every corner of Suramar. 

Show the people that there is still hope - that there are still heroes willing to fight for them!

Completion.text: 謝謝你，$n。我們每一天都朝解救蘇拉瑪爾更近一步。
Completion.english: Gracias, $N. Cada día estamos más cerca de la libertad para Suramar.

identity.title: A Giant Problem
identity.objectives: Destroy The Ship
identity.description: Destroy The Ship

Objectives.text: 摧毁舰船
Objectives.english: Destroy The Ship

Description.text: 摧毁舰船
Description.english: Destroy The Ship

identity.title: Cinder of Cynders
identity.objectives: Bring the Cinder of Cynders to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
identity.description: The cinder seethes with the hatred that its former owner held for you.

Objectives.text: 把灰烬公爵的残渣带给希利苏斯的督军格尔库克。
Objectives.english: Bring the Cinder of Cynders to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.

Description.text: 这些残渣的前主人恨你入骨，它们因此而沸腾着。
Description.english: The cinder seethes with the hatred that its former owner held for you.

identity.title: Pearl of Fathoms
identity.objectives: Bring the Pearl of Fathoms to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
identity.description: The pearl is immaculately smooth, and surprisingly dense.

Objectives.text: 把深海珍珠带给希利苏斯的督军格尔库克。
Objectives.english: Bring the Pearl of Fathoms to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.

Description.text: 这颗珍珠光洁无瑕，而且出奇的致密。
Description.english: The pearl is immaculately smooth, and surprisingly dense.

identity.title: Salt of Shards
identity.objectives: Bring the Salt of Shards to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
identity.description: The Abyssal Lord left behind a small pile of faintly-iridescent sand.

Objectives.text: 把碎裂盐块带给希利苏斯的督军格尔库克。
Objectives.english: Bring the Salt of Shards to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.

Description.text: 深渊领主留下了一小堆沙子，闪烁着暗淡的虹光。
Description.english: The Abyssal Lord left behind a small pile of faintly-iridescent sand.

Objectives.text: 把西风之歌带给希利苏斯的督军格尔库克。
Objectives.english: Bring the Song of Zephyrs to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.

Description.text: 公爵的脚边凝结出一团旋转的精华。
Description.english: A swirling essence coalesces at the feet of the Duke.

identity.title: Coreforged Sigil of Skaldrenox
identity.objectives: Bring the Coreforged Sigil of Skaldrenox to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
identity.description: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was forged in flame.

Title.text: 斯卡德诺克斯的核铸印记

Objectives.text: 把斯卡德诺克斯的核铸印记带给希利苏斯的督军格尔库克。
Objectives.english: Bring the Coreforged Sigil of Skaldrenox to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.

Description.text: 高阶深渊议会的印记是用从其持有者的元素中萃取出的精华制作的。这个印记是在烈火中铸造的。
Description.english: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was forged in flame.

identity.objectives: Bring the Glimmering Sigil of Whirlaxis to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
identity.description: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was carved with biting winds.

Objectives.text: 把维拉希斯的微光印记带给希利苏斯的督军格尔库克。
Objectives.english: Bring the Glimmering Sigil of Whirlaxis to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.

Description.text: 高阶深渊议会的印记是用从其持有者的元素中萃取出的精华制作的。这个印记是用刺骨的狂风雕刻而成。
Description.english: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was carved with biting winds.

identity.title: Diamondine Sigil of Kazum
identity.objectives: Bring the Diamondine Sigil of Kazum to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
identity.description: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was carved from stone, then fused into a faultless diamond.

Objectives.text: 把卡苏姆的钻石印记带给希利苏斯的督军格尔库克。
Objectives.english: Bring the Diamondine Sigil of Kazum to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.

Description.text: 高阶深渊议会的印记是用从其持有者的元素中萃取出的精华制作的。这个印记是用石头雕刻而成，然后熔进了一颗无瑕的钻石。
Description.english: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was carved from stone, then fused into a faultless diamond.

identity.title: Tidal Sigil of Skwol
identity.objectives: Bring the Tidal Sigil of Skwol to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.
identity.description: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was crafted from coral and smoothed by the tides.

Objectives.text: 把斯古恩的潮汐印记带给希利苏斯的督军格尔库克。
Objectives.english: Bring the Tidal Sigil of Skwol to Warlord Gorchuk in Silithus.

Description.text: 高阶深渊议会的印记是用从其持有者的元素中萃取出的精华制作的。这个印记是用珊瑚制作，然后由潮汐打磨而成。
Description.english: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was crafted from coral and smoothed by the tides.

identity.description: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was carved with biting winds.

Objectives.text: 把维拉希斯的微光印记带给希利苏斯的大元帅斯诺·落雪。
Objectives.english: Bring the Glimmering Sigil of Whirlaxis to Field Marshal Snowfall in Silithus.

Description.text: 高阶深渊议会的印记是用从其持有者的元素中萃取出的精华制作的。这个印记是用刺骨的狂风雕刻而成。
Description.english: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was carved with biting winds.

identity.title: The Folly of Levia Laurance
identity.objectives: Ask around the city for information on Levia Laurance.
identity.description:
Levia Laurance was once a member of the Kirin Tor, long ago, and a good friend. Dabbling in shadow magic got her banned from the city, but she knows the streets too well to keep her out for good.

Levia has disappeared, and I'm gravely concerned. Her work may have attracted the attention of the Legion. It has before. It would be very dangerous for all of us if her knowledge fell into their hands.

She was last seen at the Militant Mystic. Ask around there and see if you can pick up her trail.

Objectives.text: 在城里打听莱维娅·劳伦斯的情报。
Objectives.english: Ask around the city for information on Levia Laurance.

Description.text:
很久之前，莱维娅·劳伦斯曾是肯瑞托的成员，也是我的好朋友。由于涉足暗影魔法，她被赶出了达拉然。但她对这里的街道太熟悉，我们很难真正阻止她进入这座城市。

莱维娅失踪了，我对此极为关注。她的研究可能已经引起了燃烧军团的注意。这种事以前也发生过。如果她的知识落入了燃烧军团的手中，那我们都会有危险。

她最后一次出现是在铭文师的殿堂。去那里打听一下，看看能不能找到她的去向。

Levia Laurance was once a member of the Kirin Tor, long ago, and a good friend. Dabbling in shadow magic got her banned from the city, but she knows the streets too well to keep her out for good.

She was last seen at the Militant Mystic. Ask around there and see if you can pick up her trail.

identity.title: The Acolyte Imperiled
identity.objectives: Help Ritssyn investigate Levia's ritual.
identity.description:
Truthfully, the Council knows little of Agatha, but she is more than just your average succubus. She has many allies within the sayaad, and is known to command armies of imps that swarm and overwhelm her foes.

To seek her out is folly, but Ritssyn Flamescowl repays his debts.

Come, let us examine what manner of fel powers this little mage of yours was stumbling her way through...

Progress.text: 让这些小鬼离我远点！
Progress.english: ¡Aleja esos diablillos de mí!

identity.title: An Urgent Warning
identity.objectives: Speak to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
identity.description:
<The soldier is wan and wounded, obviously in tremendous pain.>

Been held prisoner... since the assault on... the Broken Shore...

<He shudders.>

The demons... th-they are gathering... preparing...

Had to escape... to warn you. They must... be stopped!

identity.title: Adopt a Tadpole
identity.objectives: Select your favorite Winterfin tadpole and beckon it to follow you.
identity.description: One day every year, usually in mid-spring, the Winterfin tadpoles are given free reign of the village. I'm not sure why this tradition persists, as it usually results in heavy damage to the their buildings and food stores.$b$bI usually try not to interfere too much with the goings-on of the tribe, but today, I take exception. Go out and see if you can keep an eye on one of the tadpoles.

Objectives.text: 选择你最喜欢的冬鳞蝌蚪并让它跟随你。
Objectives.english: Select your favorite Winterfin tadpole and beckon it to follow you.

Description.text: 每年的某一天——通常是在仲春时节，冬鳞部族的蝌蚪们就能在村子里自由活动。我不知道这个传统是怎么保持下来的，因为这通常都会对他们的建筑和食物储备造成严重破坏。$b$b我一般不会插手部族的事，但今天我要破例了。快出去看看你能不能管住某个蝌蚪吧。
Description.english: One day every year, usually in mid-spring, the Winterfin tadpoles are given free reign of the village. I'm not sure why this tradition persists, as it usually results in heavy damage to the their buildings and food stores.$b$bI usually try not to interfere too much with the goings-on of the tribe, but today, I take exception. Go out and see if you can keep an eye on one of the tadpoles.

identity.title: Furthering Knowledge
identity.objectives: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
identity.description:
We have learned so much already about these artifacts it is incredible. 

Our researchers have been busy preparing notes for you and with a few more resources I am sure they can be used as a crash course in gaining more artifact knowledge. 

This is only the first step, with more resources we should have additional courses to help you catch up on your studies.

Objectives.text: 缴纳职业大厅资源，完成一次神器知识的速成研究。
Objectives.english: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.

Description.text:
我们已经很了解这些不可思议的神器了。

我们的研究员一直忙着为你准备笔记。如果能再给我一些资源，我就能用它们来开展速成研究，帮你获得更多神器知识。

这只是第一步，有了更多资源，我们就能开展额外的研究，帮你赶上研究进度。
Description.english:
We have learned so much already about these artifacts it is incredible. 

Our researchers have been busy preparing notes for you and with a few more resources I am sure they can be used as a crash course in gaining more artifact knowledge. 

This is only the first step, with more resources we should have additional courses to help you catch up on your studies.

identity.title: Knowledge is Power
identity.objectives: Provide Order Resources to unlock artifact knowledge.
identity.description:
Boss, you've been working every angle on the Broken Isles, infusing that ancient artifact of yours with power. But those demons won't give up, and we really need to unlock more of your weapon's potential... and I mean pronto!

Slow, steady progress is one thing. But today, we need to get busy.

Here's the deal. You fork over our order's resources so I can study the weapon's history, and I'll get you a way to up the value of the power you apply to that artifact.

How does that sound, $ct?

Objectives.text: 提供职业大厅资源，解锁神器知识。
Objectives.english: Provide Order Resources to unlock artifact knowledge.

Description.text:
头儿，你已经踏遍了破碎群岛的每个角落，为你的古代神器注入了许多能量。但那些恶魔是不会放弃的，我们急需解锁那把武器的更多潜力……马上就要！

缓慢稳妥的研究是一回事，但今天，我们得加快速度了。

我们这么办。你把职业大厅的资源交给我，我就能研究那把武器的历史，帮你找出增加神器能量的方法。

你觉得这买卖怎么样，$ct？

Boss, you've been working every angle on the Broken Isles, infusing that ancient artifact of yours with power. But those demons won't give up, and we really need to unlock more of your weapon's potential... and I mean pronto!

Slow, steady progress is one thing. But today, we need to get busy.

Here's the deal. You fork over our order's resources so I can study the weapon's history, and I'll get you a way to up the value of the power you apply to that artifact.

How does that sound, $ct?

identity.title: Knowledge is Power
identity.objectives: Provide Order Resources to unlock artifact knowledge.
identity.description:
Throughout our campaign on the Broken Isles, you have infused your ancient artifact with power. But as the Legion invasion intensifies, it becomes crucial to unlock more of your weapon's potential.

There is a time for slow, steady progress. But today, we must hasten our efforts.

By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we can rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact.

The shadows grow darker, $ct. Let us begin.

我们可以稍后再进行缓慢稳妥的研究。但现在，我们得加快进度了。

将我们的职业大厅资源投入对武器历史的研究，我们就能加快你的神器获得能量的速度了。

阴影正在滋长，$ct。我们开始吧。

identity.objectives: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
identity.description:
We've got the skinny on a bit of the artifact power already and I am working an angle to capitalize on it. 

We've been extorting a group of scribes to put together notes for you, yet they are holding out for a few more resources before they deliver. 

The good news is that we can squeeze them for a few more courses, but after that it will be back to doing our own research.

Objectives.text: 缴纳职业大厅资源，完成一次神器知识的速成研究。
Objectives.english: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.

Description.text:
我们已经让那个皮包骨的家伙去处理神器能量了，而我则在想办法最大化我们的收益。

我们一直在敲诈一群书记员，让他们给你凑出笔记。但是他们还是坚持，要让他们出货，必须再给点资源才行。

所以，好消息是，我们可以再压榨他们几次，让他们提供更多的速成研究，但是在那以后，我们还得自己慢慢研究。
Description.english:

identity.title: Furthering Knowledge
identity.objectives: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
identity.description:
I am amazed by what we have learned so far. I believe I can prepare for you some notes based on our initial research to get you caught up quickly.

It will take just a few more resources to prepare the notes properly.

These steps we take now should provide a boost to our knowledge and we can delve even deeper into the hidden potential of these weapons.

Objectives.text: 缴纳职业大厅资源，完成一次神器知识的速成研究。

我们目前了解到的知识实在让我吃惊。我可以根据初始研究成果，给你准备一些笔记，让你快点赶上进度。

只要再多花点资源，就可以把这些笔记准备好。

目前我们采取的措施应该会让我们对神器知识的了解有所提高，我们可以借此继续深入探索，发挥这些神器的潜在力量。

这些神器具有难以置信的强大力量。至今为止我们对它们的了解只是管中窥豹。

identity.objectives: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
identity.description:
I am surprised and awed each day I delve deeper into the history of these weapons.  

Our researcher has been going extremely well and we have been busy preparing notes for you. With a few more resources I am sure we can prepare something to boost your artifact knowledge a little. 

Remember though, this is only a first step. These weapons have been around longer than most recorded history so much deeper knowledge will take time.

每当我对这些武器的历史有了更深入的了解，我都会萌生出一股惊讶与敬畏之情。

我们的研究工作顺利无比，一直在忙着为你准备笔记。只要再有一些资源，我们就可以准备完毕，让你提升一些神器知识。

但请记住，这只是第一步。这些武器比我们的历史都要久远，所以要深入掌握它们的知识的话，就需要更多的时间。

identity.objectives: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
identity.description:
Studying these ancient magic and metals has given us great insight into the potential of these weapons.

Just as these weapons were forged with time and effort so can we forge you instruction on how best to wield and unlock them. With a few more order resources we will have a course completed for you to increase your knowledge.

This is only breaking the surface of what we will unlock, and as we break through the layers of lost knowledge it will take time to delve deeper.

Objectives.text: 缴纳职业大厅资源，完成一次神器知识的速成研究。
Objectives.english: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.

Description.text:
研究了这些远古的魔法和金属后，我们对这些武器的潜能有了极大的了解。

这些武器是投入了大量时间和努力打造的，我们也同样可以用知识来打造你，让你了解怎样才能发挥出武器的最大威力，解锁武器的潜能。只要再给我们一点职业大厅资源，我们就可以为你完成一次速成研究，提升你的神器知识。

这只是我们探索之路的起点。我们对这些失落已久的知识的了解会逐渐加深，进一步研究需要的时间也会越来越长。

identity.title: Furthering Knowledge
identity.objectives: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.
identity.description:
$gSir:Mam;, thank you and the Tirisgarde for this opportunity. Learning about this weapon of yours has been an absolute joy. 

To repay your confidence and trust in my abilities I have organized our researchers notes into an easily digestible course. If you have the resources I know we will continue to output even more valuable insights. 

I assure you it has been worth every minute.

Objectives.text: 缴纳职业大厅资源，完成一次神器知识的速成研究。
Objectives.english: Deliver Order Resources to complete a crash course in artifact knowledge.

Description.text:
谢谢您，还有提瑞斯秘法会能够给我这个机会。研究您的这件武器实在是充满了乐趣。

为了回报您对我能力的信任，我组织了我们的研究员一起进行了一次速成研究，很容易理解的。如果您有资源的话，我们会继续提供这些宝贵的知识。

我向您保证，您的每一分每一秒都会物有所值。

We have discovered much along the way and we can impart that knowledge. With the help of more order resources we will continue to bring in information from members traveling far and wide.

These shaman like you are the key to finally unlocking the full potential of these weapons and soon enough we will be back to the time consuming task of chasing down rumors to discover more.

我们追溯着这些神器的古老故事，听到了强烈的低语，暗示我们其中潜藏着强大的力量。
