identity.title: The Archmage Accosted
identity.objectives: Confront Archmage Xylem.
identity.description:
With the barrier dispelled, Archmage Xylem is finally within reach!

Hopefully he'll be cooperative in returning the Iris...

Objectives.text: 面对大法师克希雷姆。
Objectives.english: Confront Archmage Xylem.

Description.text:
驱散了屏障之后，大法师克希雷姆已经触手可及！

但愿他能合作点，归还聚焦之虹……
Description.english:
With the barrier dispelled, Archmage Xylem is finally within reach!

Hopefully he'll be cooperative in returning the Iris...

identity.title: Defending Broken Isles
identity.objectives: Defeat a Legion Assault in the Broken Isles.
identity.description:
In our zeal to reclaim the Broken Shore from the Legion, we cannot allow the rest of this land to fall into the demons' foul grip.

Kil'jaeden has dispatched his forces across the Broken Isles, threatening the homelands of the allies you have made. You must answer their call in this hour of need.

Turn back these demon assaults with haste, $ct. The Armies of Legionfall will see that the Broken Shore remains secured.

Progress.text: 我们已经胜券在握，绝不能功亏一篑！
Progress.english: We are already winning, and we must not fall short!

identity.title: Pillars of Creation
identity.objectives: Use the Pillars of Creation to seal the Tomb of Sargeras.
identity.description:
Our campaign on the Broken Shore has reached a turning point. The Armies of Legionfall stand ready to breach the Tomb of Sargeras and seal the Legion's gateway to our world.

The time to strike is now, $n.

The Aegis of Aggramar has been secured in the Cathedral. The echo of Magna Aegwynn said that the other Pillars of Creation are needed to seal the tomb. It is fitting that you have the honor of locking those ancient relics in place and closing down the Felstorm once and for all.

Progress.text: 必须终止军团的入侵。
Progress.english: The invasion of the Legion must be terminated.

identity.title: The Deceiver's Downfall
identity.objectives: Enter the Tomb of Sargeras and defeat Kil'jaeden.
identity.description:
Once he was as a brother to me. Then he bartered the soul of my world for his own power. Hounded my people across the stars. Twisted my son into a monster.

Now he has come to oversee the final assault on Azeroth. To end this world as he has countless others.

Kil'jaeden.

We must ensure he does not escape our grasp this time, $n. Storm the tomb. Break the Legion's hold. End the Deceiver's reign.

Progress.text: 绝不留情。欺诈者必须死。
Progress.english: Never show mercy. The fraudster must die.

identity.title: Using Lost Knowledge
identity.objectives: Start a Research Work Order.
identity.description:
I'm not sure you realize what this tome could mean for us. We can find even more knowledge on your artifacts to help the war effort!

Let's begin immediately. On your command, we stand by to begin researching again.

Objectives.text: 开始一项研究工作的订单。
Objectives.english: Start a Research Work Order.

Description.text:
我不知道你是否意识到了这本书对我们的价值。我们可以发现更多关于你的神器的知识，从而对这场战争作出更大的贡献！

我们马上开始吧。只要你一下令，我们就会继续开始研究。
Description.english:
I'm not sure you realize what this tome could mean for us. We can find even more knowledge on your artifacts to help the war effort!

Let's begin immediately. On your command, we stand by to begin researching again.

identity.title: Delivering Lost Knowledge
identity.objectives: Speak with the artifact researcher in your class order hall.
identity.description:
The very nature of this ancient night elf tome causes the book to seek out knowledge. This could prove to be a serious boon to your efforts to research your artifact weapon.

I'd wager the scholars in your order hall would find it of great use, possibly unlocking new avenues of empowerment.

I suggest you take it to them immediately. We need every advantage possible against the Legion!

Objectives.text: 与你的职业大厅的神器研究者谈一谈。
Objectives.english: Speak with the artifact researcher in your class order hall.

Description.text:
这本古代暗夜精灵之书生来就是为了寻求知识。它可以成为你研究神器的利器。

我敢打赌，你职业大厅里的学者会发现它的巨大价值，甚至能解锁新的强化途径。

我建议你马上把书带给他们。为了击败燃烧军团，我们需要利用一切可以利用的条件！

The very nature of this ancient night elf tome causes the book to seek out knowledge. This could prove to be a serious boon to your efforts to research your artifact weapon.

I'd wager the scholars in your order hall would find it of great use, possibly unlocking new avenues of empowerment.

I suggest you take it to them immediately. We need every advantage possible against the Legion!

identity.title: Arkhaan's Pain
identity.objectives: Slay 12 Broken in Oronaar Collapse.
identity.description: Darkness envelops us... the Light has gone from this place...$b$b<Arkhaan mumbles to himself before noticing you are still talking to him.>$b$bArkhaan could not save them. Brothers. Sisters. Whispers twisted them. The Light cannot see them. It turns away from us.$b$bArkhaan failed.$b$b<Arkhaan stares off into space.>

Progress.text: <阿坎恩语无伦次地自言自语。>
Progress.english: <Akane talked to himself incoherently.>

identity.title: The Light Mother
identity.objectives: Find Xe'ra within the Xenedar.
identity.description: We must know for sure whether the Light Mother survived, $n.$b$bXe'ra was weakened by sending her heart to Azeroth, but she is the prime naaru. She is the Light, and she cannot fade.$b$bLet's head into the Xenedar and look for her. Light willing, she will return to guide us once more.

Progress.text: 圣光之母……你一定幸存下来了……
Progress.english: Light Mother... you must have survived...

identity.title: The Hand of Fate
identity.objectives: Meet your escort to the Exodar at Bladefist Bay.
identity.description:
$p,

We have won many battles against the Burning Legion, but it is time to end this war once and for all. 

Final preparations have begun to depart for Argus.

Make haste to Bladefist Bay. A ship awaits you there to grant you and your allies passage to Azuremyst.

Completion.text: 我知道你会响应号召，加入战斗。很荣幸能和你一起战斗。
Completion.english: Sabía que te encontrarías entre los llamados a la batalla. Será un honor luchar a tu lado.

identity.title: Visions of Torment
identity.objectives: Activate the Sacred Stone to witness Argus' vision with Magni.
identity.description:
I've been hearin' whispers ever since we got to Argus. They're just like Azeroth's, only... they ain't hers.

I'm convinced that Argus has a titan of its own that's reachin' out to us!

The broken have a relic stowed away that's darn near holy to 'em. Hatuun says they hear whispers from it... I think it might have some sort o' link to Argus itself!

It's just in this chamber. Let's see what we can learn.

Progress.text: 我知道，我知道，这个要求很离谱，但我们需要一切可能的帮助，$G小伙子:丫头;！
Progress.english: Знаю, знаю, я прошу слишком многого, но нам сейчас важна любая помощь, $Gдружище:подруга;!

identity.title: Invasion Point Offensive
identity.objectives: Complete 3 Invasion Points.
identity.description: The invasion points are key to cutting off Legion reinforcements to Argus. Defeating their armies within the lesser portals will allow us to assault larger invasion points and extinguish the Legion presence within.

Progress.text: 攻击还在继续。
Progress.english: The offensive continues.
